Visitors can expect a warm welcome from Chris and be shown around the apartment and with explanantions on how everything works. Also they will enjoy a spotlessly clean

We were three people, a couple and a single person staying in David's Duplex. The apartment is located just 5 minutes from the Angel tube station in a quite court yard. It is very cosy and David is a responsive and forthcoming host who did everything to make our stay comfortable.

This was a great spot! You don’t even feel like you are in a basement apartment, it was super cute and modern! Also all the restaurants around the apartment are great and if you want to get away from the craziness of down town I would highly recommend exploring this side of town. It was so sweet that she left use Prosecco, and some fruits and granola, it was an amazing extra touch! We would love to stay here again, thank you for such an amazing stay!!
Well located as it is near Euston for those who are thinking of using the apartment for work purposes and if you're not staying for work then there's always Camden!

Robin was an amazing host! He gave us a list of recommendations and quick with his responses. Location was perfect for all the places we went, and it’s located in a quiet and beautiful neighborhood. The bathroom is spacious (compared to others we have seen), and the rooms are a nice size too. We will definitely return to his flat on our next visit and highly recommend staying here! Oh and his artwork throughout his home are fantastic!

Anne’s place is in a great location right next to the park. A perfect spot to get away from tourist areas, but still easily accessible. We got our own key, which allowed us to get more done during our short stay. The home is beautiful and very clean. We booked last second and Anne was very accommodating and quick to respond. I would highly recommend if you’re looking for a more laid back area to stay in while visiting.

Very cosy studio. Good location and very clean on arrival. Good communication at all times meant we had a great stay. Only problem is that during extremely warm weather the studio can become very hot without much cooling. Apart from this it was amazing. Would recommend to people who need somewhere affordable to stay.
Jamal’s place suited our needs and he ensured our check-in was smooth. For one night in London, en route to the continent, it was fine and well-located.
The best thing about Jenny’s flat is Jenny as a host. She was so thoughtful and very accommodating.  The location was very convenient for me and the flat was clean and orderly.
David is a great host, directions and check in and out were really straightforward. The place is clean, quiet and really convenient for the local amenities and night life. Thank you David.

Good for a night in London if you don’t mind sharing the flat with a few other strangers.
Kitchen and bathrooms kept very tidy and the room was secure with a lock on the door.
Easy check in and close to the metro station with a few good bars near the train tracks.
Not exactly an ideal holiday flat but for a night or two while you explore the city it’s an affordable option :-)

Simon’s apartment is very comfortable with a large lounge area, and a well stocked kitchen. I really liked the spacious conservatory bathroom with a great shower and bath. Washing and drying facilities are also available. Great location a beautiful street close to the station and restaurants and even though it’s a basement apartment it’s very light and airy and has a small courtyard. I would happily stay there again.

We had a lovely week exploring London with this apartment as home base! It’s quite small, but very manageable for two guests. We particularly loved the balcony, kitchen amenities and location! Max and Billie also provided excellent communication throughout! Definitely recommend :).

I echo everyone else's opinions in terms of how phenomenal Isabelle is. She's just the most delightful person I've met for one, and is the best host I've come across. I intend on returning in the near future just because of how amazing she is.

Stunning studio apartment, beautiful neighbourhood and really wonderful hosts!  The space looks out on the most beautiful garden and backyard.  Green space in London accommodations is sometimes hard to find - this place has it all.  We will definitely be back!

Very clean and very well managed. The location is wonderful to look around bankside- all walking distance from Tate Modern, Borough market and London bridge. The hospitality of the host is memorable. I enjoyed the stay.
A great place to stay in London. The location was convenient (easy to move around with public transport and Robin’s oyster cards) and the apartment was as described. Would recommend.
Good location however lacks character. Appears to be still under renovation. Basic bedding, lacks dishwasher & clothes dryer. Suitable for large group if you need a basic place to stay.
This place was nice break from the london bustle. Not for everyone, only those seeking a local experience . Good value for the price.

Orla’s place was great. The house itself is very spacious and we had plenty of space. The rooms were spacious and the living room and kitchen was great for us as a family with a one year old. Very close to the tube station and perfect if you want to explore London. Will recommend to anyone.
Great little find for proximity to Wembley. We had all the amenities we needed and was great value for money. The free on street parking was a great bonus. We’d stay again!
The hosts showed excellent hospitality and were very accommodating. The room was very comfortably furnished. The entire experience was convenient and enjoyable.

Sophie's place was great. I kept messaging her asking her questions about stored and restaurants, and she took the time to quickly respond each time. The flat is spotlessly clean. And very up to date.
Absolutely marvellously located apartment! Super clean, Kris was incredibly nice and friendly. Could not recommend more!

Fantastic location. Chris is an exceptional host. Very kind and always enquiring after our needs. His home is amazing. So clean, tidy and comfortable. We had access to our own private accommodation and we were delighted with so many additional  extras - fruit, cereal, tea, coffee, toiletries, washing capsules....  A 5 minute walk from the station. Train to central London, about 15 minutes. I highly recommended this accommodation. Fabulous location.
The flat is truly stunning. Plus it's perfectly situated for anyone visiting Wembley or the surrounding area.

The Garden Flat is a perfect Airbnb for your London holiday. The decor has an English Cottage flair, making it feel very comfortable and cozy. For a basement apartment there is a great deal of light, again making the flat cozy.
Carey is a gracious host. The communication was easy and clear. The flat was stocked with all the toiletries, basic groceries, and local tips provided.
The bed is very comfy and we were surprised by the water pressure and heat for an older townhouse. The Garden is very cute however the London rain kept us from enjoying it. Next time :).
The flat is conveniently located on the Victoria line and easy to get into the city center. It was nice to be in a residential area and feel what it would be like to be a Londoner.
We will be visiting the Garden Flat again!
Anne was a great host, breakfast was provided and the two bedrooms were a great size whole house really clean and very welcoming.

The accommodation is located in a very convenient location between 2 tube stations right in Camden. The flat itself is a bit old but it was clean and had everything we needed for our short stay in London.
The apartment is very well equipped and very comfortable. Clean and close to the center and shops. Good choice! Recommended.

This flat is comfortable, clean, stylish, and quiet and included everything we needed for our stay.  It was a perfect home base as we explored Kew Royal Botanic Gardens and the National Archives. The flat is located in a quiet residential neighborhood and is also only a few minutes’ walk from the Kew Gardens underground stop (on the District Line) making the trip to central London quite convenient (30- 40 minutes) when the train is not out of service. Rosie includes suggestions of good nearby restaurants and local attractions and was extremely quick about responding to our questions.  Highly recommended.

Tt's place is really great! Close to the tube, easy access to the airport.
Ms. Tong is wonderful, and very kind.
Room was spacious and kitchen was clean and easy to use, not a bad place to stay and value for money.

Anne was a great host if not the best ever in my case. She provided everything that me and my family needed. Everything was how it was supposed to be. I strongly recommend her offer if you're planning to visit London.

Big space which we needed for a family of 5 (3 young kids). Great location and lovely park view from the open plan living space downstairs. Everything went smoothly with host from entry to exit. Property came with residents parking just over the road but be careful as one area is for business use only! (host  provides parking permit). Would stay again and would recommend as a relaxed and informal environment with a host who appreciates family life.

My second stay in the flat, loved It just as much as the first. Wink is a wonderful host, was extremely accommodating of our dog and young baby. The flat has everything you would need for a stay and the location so close to Stockwell tube makes it so easy as a base to explore the city. Very highly recommended

Sophie is an attentive host and her flat is clean and well-equipped.  It was great to have two bathrooms and a shower stall as well as washing machine, appliances, and a fan.  We had a couple of problems, which Sophie quickly responded to via messages; however, we were not able to solve them without the help of someone in person .  The flat is as described and near a park, stores and restaurants, and the tube.

I am already missing Juste's place. Everything from pre- arrival to arrival were fabulous. Juste is really friendly and prompt in her replies. Her place is easily accessible by two tube stations and walking distance to borough market. Her place is really clean as well and I love how comfortable the furnishings are. It really feels like home away from home. I would definitely love to be back with Juste at my next trip to London.
Great cozy place to stay, really clean and great amenities, easy check in, would stay again.
Another lovely stay with the very friendly and helpful Inge.  Lots of interesting fellow guests to talk to and a comfortable place to stay.

Chris’ apartment is really well located close to a large supermarket (Sainsbury’s), and about a 10 minute walk to Wimbledon rail and tube station. The space is as described with all mod cons. I couldn’t get the temperature controls to lower the temperature (there is a large fan in the under-stairs storage), so having the info available to guests would be my suggestion.
The apartment is part of the main house, so while there is a separate side entrance, you do walk past the coats and shoes in the hallway past the main kitchen/laundry before heading down stairs to the apartment. This may not be separated enough for some guests. Chris is really helpful, and available via text or phone my whole stay.

Great Notting Hill apartment! The space is small but it was fine for my husband and I. The location is great and is really close to the tube as well as a good coffee spot. I would highly recommend staying here on your next trip to London!
Great location, easy to get into London on train. Close to Pickford Lane shops. Great sized bedrooms. Extremely helpful hosts

Lovely flat! Stylish, clean and comfortable in a great central location!  There were two of us and there was plenty of room. Our hostess Sophie is lovely as well. She offered many travel tips and genuinely cared about our experience. Highly recommend!

Perfect base to explore London. The flat is very nice, transport is very convenient and the host is very attentive. There are nice restaurants and bars too. We were very happy with our stay here and would book again !
The place is just as advertised. Perfectly fine! Miriam is a great host. And she makes nice banana cake ;) :)
Clean and comfy.  Host was great!  Very responsive and provided great information.  Great access to buses in exchange for a lot of vehicle traffic noise.

This accommodation is truly recommendable.  If you are going to the tennis at Wimbledon the location is perfect, or if you wish to travel further afield the underground station at Southfields is only 10/15 mins walk away.  A truly great place to stay!
Fantastic location for the tennis and good selection of local restaurants and food shops. Nice place, newly opened for AirBnB.

Kamals flat was very clean and close to Pancras and Kings Cross stations, just a five minute walk. The flat was very dated but you could see that Kamal did his best with what he had. Was disappointed that there was no air conditioning and the washing machine was broken. Other than that it was lovely.
Great location for easy access to sight seeing. Loved the flat. Ana was always available for anything needed. Perfect! We will be back.

This is a very spacious and comfortable house, spotlessly clean with a lovely garden and with everything in the house that you could need. The location is great for visiting the local attractions such as RIchmond and Kew. Definitely somewhere we would like to return to in the future.

Sophie’s flat was very spacious (especially, as I understand, for London standards) and very clean and neat! Lots of great kitchen supplies for anyone wanting to cook. We slept well in the comfortable bed and quiet neighborhood. Also appreciated the ease of check-in, check-out and the tips for pubs, restaurants, etc! Thank you Sophie!

I very much enjoyed my stay in this place. It is stylish, comfortable, clean: a lovely place to stay. The appartment is located just off a main road so you might hear some of it when the windows are open. The location of the place is good: it is very easy to reach all of London's great sights, as subway and busses are near to you. Would definitely stay again!

Miriam is very kind and supportive person:) Her place is super clean and very close to Paddington station. There are lots of shops such as Starbucks, Costa and Sainsbury’s. If you go to the station, you can see more shops. If I come to Paddington again, I’d like to stay her accommodation. Thank you, Miriam;)
Lovely house, great place to spend a weekend with some friends. Walking distance to Twickenham station too, and nice parks around the area.
The place served its purpose for our stay. Easy location to get to train, store, and eating places. Very spacious where we all had our own bed and room.  Easy check in. Thank you.
This London flat was wonderful!  Very comfortable!  Especially loved the doors that opened onto the courtyard!
I recommend this place for anyone,, very clean and super spacious, the garden is extra ordinary. Thanks Vikash

Tamara's place was very clean and modern. The kitchen is separate from the living room so it is easy to stay quiet when others in your company want to have a bit of a lay in. It is in a great location of London. A 10 minute walk from the tube makes it a breeze to get around London and the UK.

Miriam's lovely flat is conveniently located near Paddington railway station. Mine was a last-minute reservation for one night, Miriam replied quickly and was kind enough to let me drop off my luggage in the morning. Pay attention when you get out of the station from the underground, as Paddington's quite big. As a solo traveller I felt safe and comfortable at all times and appreciated the quiet hours and comfortable bed :)

Monica's flat is lovely, as is Monica herself! She communicated promptly and gave several helpful suggestions for nearby restaurants. The flat is in a wonderful location and is quite bright, especially for a garden apartment. Comfortable and very clean -- would love to return!

The room is spotless and very comfortable and Anshu is a careful host. I wasn't given a key, which was unusual and not ideal for me to, though Anshu was always there or nearby to let me in. The area is great and parking in the road was no problem.
Great flat. Very convenient for London and good to have a parking space. Carolyn was very helpful and answered queries rapidly. Thank you.
A lovely, modern apartment in a great location with good outside space.  Good quality supportive beds.
Humayun offered great hospitality, he was very welcoming and assisted wherever he could, the place was clean and tidy and he was very friendly. Thanks Humayun.
Miriam was great, there were other guests there too and we got along amazingly! Had a great chat over tea in the kitchen! Felt safe, nice clean place! Miriam was lovely!

Lovely place! We stayed during 4 days and we had a great time.
The place is small, but it's near everything you need like supermarket, restaurants, etc. I highly recommended to everyone.
Check in/out is really easy.

Ana's place is really well located around 3 tube stations which was very practical to move around. Ana was very attentive to our needs.
All in all lovely trip :)
Wonderful location, very secure and amazing nights sleep! James is very helpful and always responds promptly. Highly recommended!

Jennie’s home is a very comfortable and convenient place to stay in London. Large spaces so you have room to spread out. It was very quiet at night and early mornings. Jennie responded very quickly and was there to greet us. Welcome chocolates and basic food supplies.
I would definitely recommend staying at Jennie’s apartment.
Great location for Hyde Park playground and easy tube links. This was a perfect apartment for my family’s 2 night trip to London. We would definitely use it again.

Carey aka “Wink” was amazing! She was very helpful in guiding us wherever we needed to go. She kept the place extremely clean. The place is in a great area with quick and easy access to public transportation that literally gets you wherever you need to go. Highly recommend this place! We will be back for sure!
Great space and location in the heart of Shoreditch near trendy restaurants and shops. Close to Tube. Fabulous decor and lovely touches.
Fabulously location in leafy Chiswick.  Wonderfully refurbished and extended property with great space.  Thank you!
Fantastic location & amazing facilities. By far my favorite place to stay in London! Easy check in & check out process.

The accommodation was clean and very well located for my trip.
Communication with Akmal was excellent and would recommend staying here.

I would definitely recommend this apartment because of its cleanliness and location. It didn’t take us long anywhere we went.
Nonetheless, the couch is a bit small and uncomfortable - especially for two. All in all our stay was super and I would book this apartment again.

Easy communication , check in check out - good space , storage , clear instructions, great location
Only comment I would have is WiFi could be a bit better so if one has work to do this could be a challenge

Our second stay at Anne´s place on our journey back from Scotland was equally pleasant again. Everything was familiar already and Anne was very helpful in helping us get to the airport in time in the early morning, by organising our cab ride (which included her getting up at 5:00 AM, too) and giving us a tip for the fastest route to take (from Earl´s Court).
The landlord is very warm hearted and glad to Help. This flat is cute,  clean and located  in the Center of a small town, where convinient to the london bridge is. Very recommended.

My daughter age 15 and I had a wonderful 3 night stay with Isabelle and Mr Darcy. The bed is very comfy  rated 5 stars plus from my daughter. Isabelle really helped us to make the most of our visit with her helpful travel tips and places to visit off the obvious tourist map. The breakfast full of homemade goodies is lovely and nice to share with Isabelle to begin the day. Gorgeous house full of art, vintage furniture and books.  All in all the perfect stay for visiting London.

Richards place is trully a dream come true for anyone who loves city skylines, sky, dusks and dawns. The place is sparkling clean, comfortable and homey. The hosts are friendly and I would definitely stay here again! Reccomend 10/10.
We loved our stay at Sofia's place, great location and value for money. Sofia is a lovely host

Very nice flat, located in a living aera of London.
Breakfast was very good in the coworking area.

The flat was exceptionally clean on arrival and has a great sized dining/living area so that all our family could chat together. It was beautiful sitting down with a morning cup of tea in the quaint outside area and the flat was well stocked with all of the essentials needed for a weekend away.
We would absolutely recommend this to friends wanted to stay somewhere in trendy south London! It's in a lovely area and it was so quiet too.

A warm welcome and high quality accommodation tastefully decorated. Very attentive hosts (Especially Olga) in a comfortable area of London with a park equipped with sports fields and some local shops, all within 30 minutes of the centre by underground. Do not hesitate!!!!!
Photos don't do this place justice, flat is really nice & good location. Miguel is a great host also, thanks so much!
Robin's place is quiet, clean, and a nice walk from all the shops and transport you could need. I hope to be back in the future!

Great Airbnb location and Miguel was a great host.
Only thing of note is that the flat is located on the 2nd floor and there are about 30 steep steps to the front door. it wasn’t a problem for us but might be an issue for someone unsteady on their feet.
Would stay again
Excellent location for the rugby stadium and Twickenham town. Great outdoor space as well to sit out in. House has everything you need, it is basic for what you get, but suited our needs of our trip.
Carey is very considerate and friendly. She prepared everything we needed. Her place is in a very convenient location, we can explore London easily. Highly recommended!

If you look for a nice, secure, and clean home/room that's definitely the one I recommend
-near from the public transport (10 minutes from Oval Station by feet) or with the bus (Geoff provide clear information when you book and is here if you have any question ! )
-Clean and nice place
-The house is located in a secured residence
Everything was perfect, no problems whatsoever, great communication from Agat and met us at a time that Suited us

Matthew’s flat is very comfortable, had nice amenities and is conveniently located near a tube station. Matthew made us feel welcome, and check-in was easy. Fully stocked kitchen, including an espresso machine, dishwasher, and washer/dryer combo, and comfy beds made this stay like being at home. Our family of four thoroughly enjoyed our time here.

A very comfortable apartment for a family of 4, excellent location, but just enough out of the way so it’s not loud at all.
If you are looking for comfort, location and a well equipped apartment - this is for you

Nev was great to work with.  This place Was everything we were looking for. It was close to subway and very convenient for getting downtown.  The terrace was nice and home was inviting.  I would definitely recommend
Location was good, close to king’s cross and most importantly, there was a lift available to go up to the floor.
Good location; close to train station. Responsive hosts. Disappointed in overall condition... not as it appeared in photos.

This place was incredible! The location on Oxford St can't be beaten, especially for the price. There were 3 couples and we fit very comfortably with the 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Check-in was a breeze and the attention to customer service was exceptional! Thank you, Bjoern, for an amazing stay in London!
Perfectly situated near the Angel Station, extremely easy to get around, and found in a wonderful community.

If this apartment could’ve been in a more perfect location, I’m not sure where it would be. This place was exactly what I needed for my week working from a Clerkenwell office in London. Right next to Exmouth Market, amazing pubs and restaurants, a few cute parks... and that’s just everything around the apartment! Gina’s place was full of thoughtful, lovely touches that made the place really welcoming and warm to come back to at night. So glad to have found this place; I will definitely look for it again next time I come back!
Inge is a very nice host who is willing to share with you, give your suggestions, help whenever needed.
Rosario's place is perfect to stay at when in London. Everything is sparkling clean, comfortable, perfect location near a tube station and the hosts are very friendly and lovely!
Amanda’s place is a great place to stay and in a great location! It is a great space and we will definitely stay again!

The apartment is exactly how it’s advertised. It’s located in a quiet neighbourhood which I loved. The apartment is clean, spacious and perfect for either a single traveller or a couple. Overall - had a memorable stay!

The house is absolutely beautiful! Very near to the tube station and to tesco. The one bathroom in the house might be a bit of a problem if you are traveling in a huge group, but you can make it work! Overall, we enjoyed our stay as a family!
Great place to stay, and so easy to get to by the central line or the bus stop that’s right outside the door. Taylan is a great host, always responding right away. Would definitely stay again!

Even though we didn’t get to meet our host, we were able to communicate easily.
Host will write you a very detailed information package, before you even arrive, that sure was helpful.
Host will be in touch every day, see how your stay is and if you are in need of anything.
My husband and I sure enjoyed our stay at her flat, it’s in a nice quiet neighborhood and very easy to get around, close to two stations and bus access, nice places to drink and eat.
Ann and her beautiful home tick every box and more as an Airbnb experience. If in the area again we wouldn’t hesitate to stay with Ann. We highly recommend this listing.

Miriam’s place is a gem. The location is perfect in a very walkable area with plenty of cute restaurants nearby and right next to Paddington Station. The room was well appointed with a very comfortable bed and the bathroom is spotless and modern. I also appreciated that she had a blow dryer and flat iron available for use. Miriam was incredibly responsive and provided excellent directions. This is a perfect place for solo travelers and people in town for business. I would definitely stay again!

We stayed at Carolyn’s flat as a group of 6 friends. We were in London for an event at the Copper Box arena, so the flat was in an extremely convenient location only two stops away on the tube from Stratford/The Olympic Park. It was a 5 minute journey, maximum.
We all loved the flat and the decor is so interesting and stylish, we really appreciated the added special touches like the Pick and Mix, and the bread! I stayed in the front bedroom and really liked the eclectic wallpaper in that room.
Carolyn was so helpful sending plenty of useful information about the flat prior to check in, and communication was always quick and easy.
A locking bathroom door would have been the only thing I’d have liked to be different, but we soon developed a system and it didn’t impact on our fantastic stay here!
Thanks so much for a great experience, Carolyn.

Gary & Irina were very responsive, accommodated us and made the process super easy. The apartment was very spacious and clean. The neighborhood was quiet and we felt safe staying in the area. Would absolutely stay there again! Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful apartment!

My teen daughter and I stayed for a week in this beautiful studio. It was immaculate, full of modern elements, had a very comfy bed and was very quiet. Richmond is an easy 25 minute walk away, making a trip to Kew Gardens and a few train trips to London very doable. The neighborhood is absolutely beautiful and the hosts were gracious and welcoming. Highly recommend!
Beautiful flat in a great location, close to Camden, the tube, the canals and Regent Park! Home away from while in town for 3 weeks for work! Would highly recommend!
Very cute room in a beautiful house. Cozy and welcoming. Great location and value. Friendly and helpful hosts. Definitely recommend.
Great loft,  really comfortable bed !! We really felt home and enjoyed every moment there, would recommend it 100%
Wonderful place, small but stylish and perfectly clean when we arrived. Max and Billie communicated with us very well and we really enjoyed our stay.

Thank you for letting us stay at the flat in Surrey quays.
We ha great time and appreciated all your hospitality and assistance.
We felt very safe and comfotable at all times.
Regards Paul and Jacqui
So clean and so stylish and so fancy! Much much better than I could imagine! Thank you so much!

We very much enjoyed our stay at this flat. It’s well located with a 10-15 minute walk to the station, and from there it’s about 40 mins to the city on the District line. It’s also an easy walk to Kew Gardens. Rosie is an excellent host with lots of clear communication and welcome packs. The flat had everything we needed to enjoy our stay, including a very comfortable bed. Highly recommended!

Really nice location and the apartment is well kept. Could do with some salt and pepper and small things like that but I guess that is to be expected when staying with a group rather than an individual. Overall great spot and I would stay again.

Good location, very professionally run, clean and comfortable. The instruction booklet covered everything and was very helpful. Croydon is very good for transport links to central London and Gatwick airport.

Everything was great. Guests should know that two cats live here. I thought they were super sweet but it might be important to know in case someone is allergic. I was also very pleased that the room locked.

Great place for exploring London. Easy walk to Hammersmith station . Restaurants, shops and pubs near by. Would recommend. Be aware the steps down are a bit tricky with big bags.   Rules and regulations book was a bit of an insult to your intelligence. Would stay again.

WOW! the jewel in East London. Located near all transport links this stylish house with three bedrooms would be a good holiday home for a family or just as good for a business trip. Some lovely touches greet you.
Great host. Communicates very easy. The apartment was spacious and comfy!! All the luxury you need for a stay in London, next to Camden town.

We had a wonderful stay in this lovely house with a fantastic view of London. Great location, so close to Greenwich and Blackheath which was perfect. Lovely hosts, comfy peaceful room, and thoughtful breakfast with option of soy milk. We would definitely ask to stay again if in the area. Thank you 🙂

A highly recommended stay during a few days stop; the room is very cozy, the tube is quite close (getting to the the main attractions in London doesn't take much time at all) and the hosts are very friendly and accomodating!

Isabelle is the best host! Always helpfull and nice. She gave us many usefull tips and interesting information. Apartment is clean and charming. The location is very good, the tube station is a 5-minute walk from the Isabelle apartment.
I can't forget her breakfasts, it were delicious:)

This clean, modern room is located near public transport, cafes and food shops.
The fully equipped kitchen was fun to use as was the comfortable lounge area.
Best of all was Inga’s kind hospitality and I’d certainly return!
Another lovely stay with Inge the room is warm comfortable and stylish and a pleasure to stay in.

Isabelle's place is so beautiful - it is cosy, lovely and very clean. More importantly, however, Isabelle is the most fantastic host! From delicious breakfasts to helpful insights about visiting London, Isabelle will make you feel like you have a home in London.
This is a really super venue - great hosts, wonderful location and a fabulously peaceful setting.  We will definitely re-book if in the area again.
This was a great place 30min from London by regular trains. Great places to walk and eat. We loved this place.

Monica’s place is exactly as shown. Her apartment is very nice and clean. The conservatory and outdoor mini garden is a plus point where I would have my meals. Apartment is 5-7 min walk to the Shephard Bush station, highly recommend it.

Susana's place was fantastic and she was very flexible with check in/check out. The neighbourhood/location is great, easy to get around by foot and easy to get to and from the tube. A beautiful apartment with everything needed for a great stay. Highly recommend and would happily stay again!
Great position, nice and cosy apartment, amazing host, highly recommended! Will come back for another stay!
Nice place to visit London, quiet and cosy, as a little flat with freeze and , shared bathroom and kitchen. Not far to the metro station.
Tess’s place was beautiful and full of light. It was an easy Tube ride to many destinations in London. Tess was very responsive to questions and made our stay comfortable.
Needed a place to stay in Greenwich after travelling in between a work trip. The room was private, very clean, very comfortable and the host very helpful. Ideal.
This place is great value for money, super clean and has what you need. As others have mentioned there are a lot of stairs so just be aware of that when booking.

Anne place was a great place to stay.  She has thought of everything, with comfortable bedrooms, private bathroom and some lovely feline friends for the odd cuddle.  She was quick to reply to any queries and kindly flexible with our check in time due to our work commitments.   Would recommend to a friend!

This place was great and Hemi’s dad was incredibly kind and hospitable. The bed was really comfortable and facilities were lovely with access to a bathroom and kitchen. Overall a lovely experience and hope to be back!
What they all said: great location, easy communications, very comfortable flat. I'll emphasize that, in a busy neighborhood, there's NO street noise. Thanks, David!

The room and bathroom was very clean and as described. The attic ceiling is very low and I did bump my head a couple times so keep that in mind. It’s a bit of a walk to the nearest station and there are some hills. Other than that it was a nice stay.

Not only is this unique farmhouse a gem, but so is the host, Jaqua. Truly lovely and accommodating. We had a hen weekend in the house with 16 ladies and everything we needed was provided and more! Having the golf club so nearby definitely has its perks as we were able to get in home catering by the amazing Tracy. The food was delicious and included table service. We highly recommend Mayland’s farmhouse!
Amanda was very flexible. She prepared the flat even though we came a bit earlier than declared. It's a pitty there was no internet connection.

Ana is a fabulous host. She’s always available to answer your queries.
The location of the apartment is super central to great restaurants, pubs and cafes. We loved visiting Kensington Gardens and Diana’s Memorial Playgroup with our kids. You can walk everywhere - or walk few minutes to bus stops and few different tube stations.
The apartment was nice with modern fittings and furniture. It has everything you’d need for your stay, Ana even provided a baby cot and high chair for our stay which was a great touch. Even the fold out lounge is a comfortable bed to lay on - which is odd to say as most fold out beds are horrible!!
Highly recommend this apartment for your stay in London.

This apartment has large bedrooms which is great it also has usb chargers in the wall for phones etc. bathroom were spacious. Close to the Victoria tube which is great to get around town so long as you don’t travel around rush hours. Stayed there with a group of 6 guys total not small guys either it was plenty big enough for us. Great communication with the both the host and co host was my first experience with Airbnb will say it was pretty awesome will definitely do it again.

Evelyn is a very nice and kindly host. She really takes care of her customer and she makes you feel like home.
So don’t hesitate, you won’t be disappointed !
Thank you for everything again Evelyn !

We had a lovely stay here! Had everything we needed, close to the Bethnal Green tube station, and fairly easy trips by tube to main attractions. Really nice to have a kitchen and fridge space to store food. Super easy checkin and Taylan was great at communicating with us.

Great apartment, clean, complete facilities, very helpful owner and quick responses,
The water boiler is not usable, there is no internal lock for the apartment door.

In love with this place! Straight from check in, our stay at Ginas was seamless. We were able to leave our bags at the flat prior to check in. On check in we received a book with lots of amazing tips for our stay, fresh fruit, champagne, and fresh flowers. Super cute touch! The flat was sparkling clean - from common area, bathroom, and bed. Communicating with Gina was easy and quick. She was super reliable. Very good location. Central to everything we wanted to do - we didn’t take a metro or bus. We walked everywhere. We’re also able to leave our bags and have an extended check once since it worked with the flats schedule for next guests - a bonus for us. We can’t wait to visit Ginas flats again!

Great stay walking distance from Camden Market & The train made it easy to get around. Comfy beds and soft, cozy blankets were nice.
Thank Mo!

Great location and nicely decorated. The hot water wasn’t working which was unfortunate because we couldn’t shower on our last day. I reached out to Ana to let her know and she had it fixed two hours later which we appreciated.

The room is spacious and Hemi father's was a quite nice and precise host. However, there was an intese smell of mold in the room. It might need a better clean.  It's worth it if you don't have many claims.

Juste’s place is so beautiful, and in an ideal location to travel quickly and easily to other parts of London! (Tube station 5 minutes away) the apartment itself was super clean with everything you could need!

I loved this apartment and it’s location.  The apartment was modern, sophisticated, well appointed, clean and cozy.  The location couldn’t be better and the building was also very nice. Highly recommend.
Very nice area and cosy room. Miriam answers very fast and is a good host. I'd recommend this appartment.

The host has created a comfortable, clean, and welcoming space in a beautiful Richmond neighborhood. Rosie's thoughtfulness extended beyond the milk, juices and snacks available on arrival. Instructions and helpful notes were clear, and her suggestions for making the most of our time were greatly appreciated.  Rosie was quick to respond to any questions we had, and her help in arranging transfer to the airport helped smooth our departure. We hope to return for an extended visit in the not too distant future!

Lisa’s place here in Camden Town is in a great location being especially close to Mornington Crescent Tube station. The apartment was bright, warm and spacious and Lisa’s quick communication and ease of check in (with photos to explain) was very much appreciated.

Cozy flat in a great neighborhood!   Love the big front windows on the gorgeous tree-line street.  Detailed instructions make check-in, staying in the flat, and check-out simple.  Sleeping pod is comfortable, but can be tricky to navigate for a midnight wee.

This was one of my best Airbnb experiences! Tina is an outstanding host, very friendly, warm and caring, she made me feel like I was at home. The room is kinda small, but very cozy and the whole flat is very stylish, clean and bright. The location is also awesome, only 2 mins by walk to Central line, very safe place too. Shortly, everything was just perfect!

Isabelle is an amazing, welcoming host! Her home is conveniently located just a couple minutes walk from the tube and right next to the buses. In the mornings she would make breakfast and chat with us, giving tips for sightseeing, food, and activities. We had an amazing stay and would definitely stay again.

All exactly as described. The bed is a bit firm, but it’s a clean, comfortable place just down the road from plenty of Shoreditch spots, including the box park and key bars and restaurants. I would definitely stay again.

The place is excellent for your stay in London. Near the underground (7mins walk), everything was very clean, nice bed, private bathroom and living room. Sweets by the bed, free to use towels, hair-dryer and different phone plugs, all free of charge as an extra service. In the morning a freshly made continental breakfast and a hostess who does everything to ensure you are welcome.
Next time we would go here again, also because we fell in love with the housecat Mr. Darcy

Tina is the greatest host ever!
I had a really good time in the place and also with her! She was very kind and nice to me.. (love ya)
The room was clean enough and the location is perfect to go to everywhere.
I'd like to stay again once again!
Xoxo

There is nothing bad I can say about this spot. Perfect location. Responsive host. Clean. I travelled over alone and felt very safe the entire time. Best part for me was waking up on Saturday morning and being able to walk to Portobello Rd for breakfast and to check out the market. A great Notting Hill experience! Thank you Tom!
Annes hospitality is very special. It felt like coming home. Her two cats are loveley and the beds were super comfy. We would definitely recommend this accomondation!
Tina is a wonderful host. Even though she could not be there, she made sure everything is ready. Her home is at a great location and it is sparkling clean. I would stay again.
Outstanding place to stay. Sparkling clean, quick responses, great management, easy check in and check out... shampoo and shower gel included... can use the kitchen and the living room... GREAT!
Charming, cozy, and clean room. Super comfortable beds. Loved the tea in the bedroom. The location was great and the whole area was lovely! We highly recommend Anne’s place!
Toro’s house had everything I needed. It located great and very closed to central. I totally recommend his flat.

We stayed here for a month and a half. Great location and amenities! Miguel is a fantastic host - accommodating and quick to resolve queries.
The only thing we’d point out to other Airbnb-ers is that this property is at the top of a narrow staircase - if you have big, heavy bags, it might be slightly hard to navigate. Overall, we had a great experience and would recommend this property.

The host was friendly and welcoming and easy to get hold of.
We were able to meet earlier to get the key and drop off luggage which we really appreciated. The flats from the outside look a bit rundown but don't let that put you off, once inside we were pleasantly surprised, we had no issues with cleanliness and only a short walk from kings cross so ideal for a one night stay.
We would have appreciated a pint of milk, tea and coffee were available but couldn't make a drink in the morning as no milk but that's the only thing I would have changed, all in all for the money and location we were happy enough and would use again for a one night stay. Thank you!

Ana is an incredible host with insane response times! Whenever we had something (which was like 2 times bc we did sth wrong not her) she had someone come to the apartment in like 10 min. Just awesome! A great apartment with great style!
the place was ok, it was a bit noisy because of the traffic and flat was in the basement,,!!

A definite must stay! Jan is such a lovely and caring person, she makes the best food and her home is so warm, cosy and beautiful! I felt at home from the start and never had a better stay anywhere else! Thanks Jan!

Rosario is a nice and welcoming host, she is also a good company. The room was clean and she was so kind that she also got me some treats with which to have breakfast or afternoon tea and/or coffee. It was a very pleasant stay, I definitely recommend it to friends and family and if I ever will need to go back to London I will definitely stay at hers.

The apartment is ideally located and very stylish.
Alistair is available and very responsive.
It was a pleasure
The place is located in a very strategical place. It is a nice flat to spend time in , near everything. I really recommend it. The communication with Lisa is great too. I will come back !

If you is a Traveler and find yourself in London and looking for a reasonable spacious place to stay. I recommend the Evelyn, in  Brooke Road Walthamstow. Great location and close to wood street station, that will take you to Walthamstow Central onto Victoria line into central London.

This was a fine place to spend my last three nights in London, and I do recommend for short-term stays. Check-in was quick and easy and the location is great - a short walk away from two stations. It is close to a few grocery/convenience stores (a co-op is right down the road). You get a lot of space for the price. Thanks for hosting us!

Four adults stayed for 2 nights and we had an amazing time. The apartment is so stylish that I now want to redecorate my house.
We had everything we could possibly need. We even had a lovely welcome basket from Kirsty. She replied to any enquires promptly, and the apartment is spacious and everything is so neat and tidy.
Will definitely be coming back when we are next in London.

Rosemary’s flat is in a perfect location for walking to everything in Kew - the Gardens, Archives, and many good food and drink options (which Rosemary had great recommendations for). It was perfect for my purposes, and Rosemary was extremely easy and quick to communicate with.
I really appreciated that she left fresh milk for coffee and tea, some light snacks, and beautiful bath products.
Would recommend this lovely flat if you are in need of a place to stay in Kew!

There are not enough words to describe Isabelle's hospitality generosity and kindness! She helped us through London and gave us useful tips! Every morning she welcomed us with a full breakfast! We had the best sleep and we were always comfortable around the house! Isabelle thank you once again fo everything! we hope to see you again soon!
We really enjoyed our stay in this room. Nicely decorated, beds are comfy, great location. I can only recommend.
Really comfortable and the welcome basket was a special touch. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend this to our friends.

Jennie was a great host and the apartment is spacious and clean. Location is great and close to the Tube, stores, cafés, etc. Jennie made sure we had tea, milk, bread and chocolates (yummy) to start the mornings off right.

Awesome location, car parking, and super stylish!
Damion was available and on hand whenever he was required, one of the best Air B&B’s I’ve used.

Great accommodation, me and my family loved staying here, the location was great it was quiet and felt safe! A really modern apartment which was clean and spacious! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting London!

Lisa’s home is beautifully decorated and most importantly, clean! It was a little hard to find the location, as the Uber driver dropped us off in front of the first building and the not the second. However, it was an easy fix and I was able to ask someone for help. Otherwise this location is near eateries and transit, which made it easy for our travels. The best thing is, is that it’s about a 15 min walk away from Camden market. So many great food places and shopping!
Thank you again Lisa for a wonderful stay.
I was at VanZyl’s place with my wife for three nights and we had a very pleasant stay. The home is stylish, cozy and with plenty light. We hope to be back soon.

Thanks very much for your great place! It had everything we needed. A great location right in Hamstead heath with nice places to eat around,  near to a great walk to the Heath, and close enough to get to other nice sites like Camden Town.
5minites to tube,very convinent and super clean.there is almost everything in the single room.really love to stay here,definitely wanna come again~~~

Great place, close to the tube station and local amenities.  Carolyn was present when we landed and made us feel really welcome.  Can't recommend this place enough.  Great value for money, well presented and the little touches like milk and bread were much appreciated

The flat is really central and with the Victoria and northern line nearby you can discover the city perfectly. The apartment was a bit hard to find at first but the communication with Alistair was really good. Would definitely recommend

Rosemary’s flat was exactly what I expected from the pictures. Her flat his about a 7-10 minute walk from the Kew Gardens Station, and about a 15-20 minute ride into Central London. The flat has everything you need, including a washing machine and a drying rack. There are also three heaters in the flat to help keep warm during the winter. This was a great place to stay.
This is one of the best home to stay with small family and kids..the host also providing us a very nice comfy sofa bed for out kids to sleep.

I had a lovely stay at Anne's place! Anne is friendly and welcoming.
The room was exactly as in the photo, cozy and nicely decorated. The neighborhood was nice and quiet but easily accessible by public transport, also around midnight. Next time I travel to London on my own hopefully I can stay with Anne again!

Great stay with Rosario. I can get everything I need in the room and Rosario always willing to provide help. Nice talk with Rosario ☺️
I cancelled part of the stay due to change of my schedule cause by the strike in France. Rosario is flexible and willing to accept my changes. Really big help for me when I faced such difficulty. Highly recommend to stay in Rosario house. Good location to everywhere by train and supermarket near by.
Geoff's place is very well located, only a few meters from the Oval Station and supermarket. Communication was great and Geoff was very helpful allowing us to park before the check in.
Lovely space for my family and I. We were an infant, toddler and two adults and the bedrooms worked out well. Also the flat was great for a crawling baby ! Not much to interfere with for him!
This flat is beautiful and comfortable and the location is great: close to the tube stop and lots of shops and restaurants.

Location is perfect, but our rental did not look anything like the listing. This is a cross between a hostel and dorm room. The amenities provided in the room are older and do not look as refreshed as they do in the listing. We unfortunately had to leave because there were mice in our room. Not sure if it was just the room we rented or the entire building. Max and Billie were kind enough to refund our money.
Lovely place. Awesome location. Had some problems with water, but host was very responsive and eager to help.  All in all a good trip.

Jaqua was absolutely lovely from the moment I met her , the property had the loveliest Christmas decor and she even left crackers ! The rooms were comfy and the whole house was spacious. Thank you for an amazing stay

Inge’s place is just amazing. Maybe even better than the photos.
Her hospitality is great as she went above and beyond to be helpful during my stay.
I would stay here again for sure.

Adam's flat is wonderful, and the location is excellent, being so close to all the delights of Hampstead. Adam is an exemplary host. We weren't able to meet in person, but he sent clear communications every step of the way to make sure we had what we needed. He was readily available to answer questions and followed up afterwards to check that we were okay. In a world where business transactions can be cold and impersonal, it's refreshing to encounter someone like Adam who genuinely cares about his guests.
Rosemary’s apt was wonderful! Close to lots of restaurants/pubs within walking distance. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks Rosemary!
Very clean, nice welcoming, excellent breakfast, tips on what to see and how to better plan visit, overall excellent, would come back again.

I've been back to Geoff's place twice in a month! Ideal to stay in central London, Geoff and his wife are wonderful people who like taking care of their guests!
I absolutely recommend their options to anyone,
Antonio

About a 15min walk from the Tube. Stylish, Clean, Comfortable. Great amenities, cooked every meal in. Depending on timing, the flat above can be a little loud, but that’s common for having neighbors upstairs.

Great location next to nottinghill gate and its a quiet place right next to a maon tube station. There is no lift so be wary of that but place is cosy and close to all main bus and tube routes (central line on nottinghill).Will consider staying here again! 😊

Great spot. Great location. Walking distance to vibrant  streets , shopping and food. Tastefully decorated and comfortable. Would def recommend to others to stay here. Also very friendly, helpful and communicative hosts. Thank you.

Loved staying at Robins place. Very convenient location, place was clean and stocked with basic necessities. I loved the stylish artwork and living room. Felt quite at home! Would definitely stay again. Cheers!!
Geoff was an amazing host. The airline had lost my bag but he and his wife showed me incredible hospitality and really helped me out in every way they could. Highly recommend!
We had a fabulous stay at Kate and Tom’s it was made all the easier by their quick response to our questions. The property was comfortable and close to all transport

The room is warm, cozy and comfortable. You have your own fridge and kettle but share the kitchen and shower room. Even though the train line is behind the flat the room is quiet and relaxing. I shared the flat with the host’s father who was polite, welcoming and helpful but also respected my privacy. Overall a very pleasant stay and would not hesitate to stay there again.

Miriam’s flat was perfect for a quick overnight I had in London. Her place is a quick 10 minute walk from Paddington station, which you can get to directly from Heathrow - couldn’t have been easier to get to from the airport. Her place was quiet and clean and she was a very responsive and considerate host. Highly recommend and would stay again.
Lydia's home is a beautiful place to stay. We loved the spacious lounge and kitchen and quirky artwork. I hope I can find an excuse to stay again.

This lovely Covent Garden flat is wonderful! The sitting room is relaxing, overlooking quaint Neal St. The kitchen, bath, and bedroom are perfect. The neighborhood is quite inviting!
James, your host, is so kind and so helpful...from start to finish.
A wonderful experience!

Branca was very responsive and the flat had lovely detailed touches (e.g. milk in the fridge, ear plugs, etc). The only issue we had was that one of our towels wasn’t clean and that someone erroneously walked into our flat because the door seemed to not shut properly without being pulled closed. Luckily we were there and no issues! Location is great.
Tina’s place is great. Very clean, with a cute little sofa in the room. Location is awesome and is within walking distance to shops, restaurants and attractions. 100% recommend
We spent the NYE over at Hemi's the place was very clean and nice it worked perfectly for our needs.
Fantastic room and super check-in. Would recommend. Only problem was it was rather warm in the room and we were unsure whether you could change the heating because it was automatic.

Sandra is a awesome Host!!
Everything about the house is same as it’s described, it’s a Beautiful house.
We were 2 adults and 2 kids for us the location was not so convenient as it’s a resident colony and everything is at least 12-14 mins walk away. Other than that we had great stay there.
This is a charming place! The location to public transportation is excellent. It has a home feel and very comfortable. I would recommend to anyone!

Exactly what we were expecting for the cost we had to find afforable accommodation for 4 adults as close to London as possible..
Cat was no problem.

The apartment is very comfortable for 4 guests. It is a big apartment in Central London with an excellent and modern layout. The access is very convenient as well, it is 100% step-free. The location of the apartment is excellent. It is very easy to walk or move around London. Lynn is a fantastic host, everything was as expected. I would definitely stay again at her place!

This flat was amazing!  Location is perfect. Half mile walk to Wimbledon station which gets you anywhere and has enough shopping and restaurants to spend the whole day right there. The flat was very clean and pretty large considering the location. Our family of four had plenty of space. Kitchen was great with all cooking amenities and a Nespresso machine (which we bought as soon as we returned home!). The area is very safe and a pretty place to stroll around. Wonderful experience with Victoria. She was speedy in communicating and helped us secure cheap on street parking, which was a concern for our rental car. She couldn’t have made it easier! I highly recommended her place. I’ve stayed in many AB&B and usually find a reason not to stay in a particular one again, but this one was perfect! I would have no reason to stay anywhere else.

Anne is super sweet and the nicest hostess. The stay was perfect in every aspect. She is easy going and communication also was easy concerning checking in and out. Very much looking forward to coming back to London and staying with Anne.

My wife and I's stay at Anne's was wonderful. She was very accommodating of our strange check in and check out times and had loads of advice to offer for our time in London. Her two cats Casper and Merlin are also quite sweet and the entire place felt like a home away from home. If we're ever in London again, Anne's home is definitely at the top of our list for accommodation!
The loft is amazing- such a great space for a group of friends or family to stay. Richmond was responsive and friendly. Would for sure recommend!

Tina is very kind and she always replies quickly:)
The room is clean and comfortable!
The location is good. It takes just 2 minutes from apartment to subway station.
There are bus stops near apartment.
I could relax and enjoy in London!
I wanna stay her apartment again:)
Enjoyed our stay.  Sophie’s place was clean and convenient to the tube which was exactly what we were looking for.

Communication with the hosts is very easy and the place is beautifully done up with all the information and amenities you need to have a great stay. Would definitely recommend to anyone and will be the first place I look to come back to again if needing someplace in the area.

The flat is amazing. Defiantly somewhere I will be staying again when in the area.
Extremely clean and spacious. Host was excellent in communication. Check in process is perfect. I would recommend to everyone

Tylan's place was clean, comfortable and spacious. It is also very near the tube station Bethnal Green which is on the central line. I would definitely recommend Tylan's  place as it is great value for money.
The location of Robin's flat made it very easy to get to and a great place to explore the city from!
Branca is a a great host, very reliable and active communication. The space is tasteful and ideally located in the heart of shoreditch.

Tina was an amazing host- when I felt really cold, she borrowed me a heater, which really helped. The location of the apartment is also amazing- it is only 2 minutes away from an underground station and a bus stop as well. Thank you!

Great location and very inexpensive for London.. . However the unit itself didn’t live up to the photos. It was tiny with a grimy 2 seater sofa. There was dirt, grime and mold on the kitchen terrace doors, burned out light bulb in bathroom, floors were in rough shape and the mattress had zero support.

Do read the reviews before you book.  This is a spacious flat in a nice part of Dalston with excellent links to the City and Shoreditch.  If you’re ok with a bit of noise and a few steps  to lug your luggage up, you will find it very good value.

The apartment provides everything you need and it’s close to the metro (around 5 mins walk). Nearby you can find supermarket and restaurants. Overall - it’s good value of money. Do take note that this apartment only provides an aired bed plus a sofa bed (without a bedroom). It may not be suitable to ppl who have disabilities
It was again great staying at Sam and Nidhi’s place. They made us feel very welcome. A great and comfortabel stay we had, thank you
Clean, warm, the bed was a bit small for a couple (if one of the couple is a big sized person), but the bed itself was very soft and comfortable.
Robin had no restrictions or demands on me. I could rest very comfortably during the trip. The next time I come to London, the first thing I'll think of is Robin.

The two bedroom flat is conveniently located in central London and is of a good size. It was spotless and warm when we arrived on a cold and wet evening. When we encountered a tiny crisis in the property Ana's response was super efficient and sorted the problem in no time. Would definitely recommend Ana's property to those who wish to experience a homely stay in London.

Shaz was very accommodating! The flat was very clean and there was everything necessary for our stay. The indication for our arrival were very precise which made it a lot easier for us. There is a bus stop direct into London just around the corner which was perfect. Overall a great stay.
This is a great apartment, spotlessly clean inside and close to lots of interesting restaurants and shops. Very comfortable in every aspect.
Iyisha’s place was a perfect spot outside of the centre busyness. She’s really accommodating and her place is real good value for money. Would definitely come back.
Anthony is a wonderful host very responsive and attentive. His place is wonderful, modern and comfortable, warm and bright and fantastic view.

It was very convenient and low-key and I was able to get into and out of the place very easily. Geoff was communicative and very helpful. The location is nice, especially if you are going to see both south London areas and stuff that's north of the river. There are bus stops close by with the Oval tube station also close.

This is the place to stay in Wimbledon! Chris was a fantastic host and you can tell he takes great pride in being an amazing host. Communication was perfect, easy access from the train station, and the accommodation itself was top shelf. I’d happily return and stay again and again. Thanks for hosting!

Joanna and Stacy were quick in their communication and made sure we were as comfortable as we could be. The cute apt decor and the amenities make you feel at home. Would recommend this for short or long stays.

From the moment you walk in, you instantly feel at home. The host ensures the property is warm on arrival, linen and towels are also prepared for a comfortable stay. The property is close to shops, grocery stores and local sights. I really can’t fault anything, it was a beautiful retreat away from my usual busy life.
Marc's place was great everything was like in the pictures and everything was provided soap shampoo and towels! Also  great location near tube stations for easy access

I had a great time. The studio is really well situated, 1 min away from the station and is well equipped.
I had a few issues with the shower and electricity but Sarin was quick to respond and took care of it.
Perfect little pad ideally located as I work in Twickenham good access to shops restaurants and public transport, would book again
Isabelle has a great knack of making people feel at home! I absolutely enjoyed my stay in her wonderful apartment. Very clean with exquisite little touches. I would definitely recommend!

Lisa’s place is an excellent home away from home! Convenient to bus and tube, clean, and large enough to host a family.
Lisa was responsive and checked in to make sure we had everything. The booklet was helpful for groceries, etc. Stay here!
This place has a great location, just a few minutes between 2 transit stations so plenty of options to get around and explore the city!

Tom's place was great and had everything we needed for a fun long weekend in London. The location was perfect for us with close and easy access the tube. Being so close to Portobello Road made for great fun exploring the market stalls but with a home base close by to retreat to for a rest. Our family had a great stay and we would highly recommend Tom and his flat. The sleeping pod was also lots of fun!
Wonderful apartment! We had such a pleasent stay at Gina's place. Lot of space, clean and very comfortable. Would truly recommend

I’ve rented Anna’s place twice now for when my family comes over to visit. It’s a nice, clean apartment with easy access to the Streatham area. My family enjoyed their stay and says they would stay again.

This apartment is great! It is private and clean. The neighborhood is very safe even at night. Location! Location! Location is everything and this apartment is close to the tube.  Which makes it easier to get around the city. It is very convenient for all of the major attractions.  I will definitely stay here again on our next trip to London.  Ana is a great host and makes sure you have a great stay in her home.

Wonderful apartment, close to the underground in a quiet neighbourhood. It was our second stay here and we enjoyed it as much as the first time. Absolutely everything you need is present: from tea bags to ironing board. The place is large and very clean. Sian and her daughter communicate quickly. Would definitely recommend.

An amazing place to stay! I have pretty high standards when it comes to cleanliness and these rooms are well looked after! Julia and her family clearly care about their guests, I wish I could’ve stayed longer! The rooms are on the top floor, so get very warm, and the fridge in the room is quite noisy - but it’s still the best airbnb I have stayed in.

Really nice and tidy! The room is very stylishly and cozy furnished.
The bus station is right in front of the Entrance.

Amazing place, wonderful host and this stay will surely be long remembered. An unbelievable location, a romantic place and a person really feels like a fairy tale. I can absolutely recommend and certainly know that I will come back again during my stay in London.
Simon was exemplary in hosting. He was always available and very communicative. The flat was spectacular and in a wonderful location. Highly recommended.

What we liked:
Tyrone's place was very clean and the location is very good to explore different parts of the city. It's well connected and close to the few underground stations as well. We needed a room for three people so that was very convenient for us.
What we did not like:
He was not responsive to our messages and call after we checked-in, which we did not like at all and would never probably stay there again because of that. He mentioned about few things like hairdryer and iron in the description but we could not find them. We wrote to him, asking about it but didn't get any response. The bathroom light did not have a switch and it was turning off automatically after every minute. You always had to move your hand against the sensor to switch it on which was very annoying.
Lovely house, all rooms were spacious and host was very accommodating. Great garden if the weather is nice, perfect house for a gathering. Thank you for a lovely stay

I'm so very glad that I chose this particular airbnb. The location was all-round amazing, and the hosts very hospitable and thoughtful. The airbnb was very tidy and clean, and the bed was very comfortable.  I really appreciated how close it was to Paddington and Little Venice. So many places to see and/or eat at just a walking distance away! If you have the time, take a walk along the Little Venice and Regent's Canal towards Camden Market. If you're a solo female traveler, I would highly recommend staying at Miriam's.

I travel quite often and stay in Airbnb’s because of people like this host! I booked rather last minute and they were super gracious in communication and getting me in. The space is super clean, stylish, and efficient with the location truly being one of the best in city - walkable to everywhere you want / should be. While walkable to everything it remains tucked away on a quiet street. So happy with my stay and I’ll definitely plan to stay here again on my subsequent visits to fabulous London. Thank you!!!
Amazing apartment with own access and very close to the centre of Wimbledon. Stylish and comfortable interior with everything you could need for a stay. Home away from home. Thanks so much Chris

Simon’s place was absolutely perfect. The apartment was very spacious and incredibly clean and in a perfectly central location. As a host, Simon was very responsive and even let us check in early since we arrived in the morning. We will definitely seek this place out again next time, and I would highly recommend it to anyone.
Unfortunaly because of the situation and covid 19 i could not stay until the end. Just 2 nights instead of 7. But Ricahrd was a very good host. He helped me and be a real support.

Nikki and Stew’s place couldn’t have worked out better for me. Loved having my own entrance but knowing there was someone close by if I needed help with anything.  Super clean, it had absolutely everything I needed.   Great location with train station and shops near and lovely walks along the river. I will definitely stay again.
Thomas was supportive and an excellent communicator during my stay. The place was secure, private and perfect.
Great location and space. Really nice to have a balcony! Thanks to everyone in Nizam’s support team!
A decent space in a fantastic area. Our hosts Ana & Pedro were responsive and helpful, and went out of their way to accommodate our needs. Recommended.

Absolutely recommend! The place was cozy and stylish with beautiful patio. The host was very friendly and thoughful, and The neighborhood was quiet and safe, the river Thames was just 5 minutes walking distance. I will definitely stay again!

Max & Billies place was the perfect space. The little terrace is beautiful & was my favourite spot to have breakfast & dinner. In a beautiful area of London. Communication was easy & swift. Thank you so much!

This place is a MUST visit if you like a quirky place . There’s a little ladder to climb on top which I found absolutely Adorable! The balcony has a nice view and has a table and two chairs, we celebrated my best friend’s birthday there. The only thing missing is an oven which would make things a bit convinient but all in all it’s great!
This place is 5 minute walking from the notting hill gate station and you can book a cab to anyplace you like , doesn’t charge a lot!
Thank you Max and Billie for this experience and making everything worth it !
Great stay. Wonderful hosts, the couple were extremely friendly and hospitable - welcomed me when I arrived and made sure we were taken care of. Condo was clean and comfortable.
Great stay here, and great communication by Robin, who was especially helpful. Would not hesitate to stay here again

This is a spacious flat, very stylishly appointed, in a super location.  The extra touches regarding the furnishings give it a very pleasant ambience.  The parking space is a bonus in London. Our host was very accommodating with the extras we needed for a baby, thank you.

This place is amazing, however, the place has clearly hosted lots of parties and the neighbours are very unwelcoming of Airbnb guests. From the moment we arrived, we got messages and constantly disturbed even when not making any noise. Whilst I would recommend, this place is not suitable for groups.
Lovely space which seems bigger than it looks on the pictures, the balcony is a great touch too. Perfect spot for a weekend in and around Shoreditch.
really great space in the heart of shoreditch. roof terrace is incredible with a fantastic view.

The space is beautiful, with a particularly lovely terrace surrounded by a fabulous view. Every part of it is stylish, clean and roomy - you can expect to have a really pleasant stay when you check in!

I felt right at home staying at Carey's place. She is a wonderful host. The flat is comfortable and spacious with so many extras and thoughtful touches like coffee, tea, flowers, and some basic necessities on hand. There is a lovely garden which my dog and I both loved. The
The bed is so comfortable and there is more than enough space for storing your clothes. The flat is in a very convenient location close to transportation and a supermarket and coffee shop right down the street. I highly recommend Carey's place for your visit to London.

My family and I really enjoyed staying here. The location was fantastic as it was just over the road from Hyde Park, had two underground stations close by and walking distance to some excellent restaurants. The house itself was well equipped and spotlessly clean. Richard was a fantastic host and regularly contacted us throughout our stay to make sure we were ok. I would definitely stay here or at any of Richard’s other properties again.

the place is as advertised. very clean, very comfortable bed, gated community in a quiet area. all in all excellent value.
it was a pleasure Geoff. I enjoyed our conversations and hopefully our paths will cross again. take care.
A lovely, spacious room with lots of storage space and amenities. Definitely the best place to stay in regards to the location

We had a great stay at this apartment. The location couldn't be better, soon as you walk out the door you are in the heart of the action. The apartment was modern, spacious and had everything you would need for a short stay. To top it off, the roof top seating was great for an evening chill. The hosts were great and gave quick replies. Would recommend to others

The flat is great, exactly as described and in a really good location - there is a small Co-op (grocery store) at the top of the road as well as a pub and it is only a 5 minute walk into the Village or 10 minutes down to Wimbledon town centre .  Victoria was a great host who communicated quickly and resolved a small issue with the plumbing in just a couple of hours.  The wifi in the flat is excellent and was perfect for Zoom calls so made a good place to work from too.   I would thoroughly recommend it.
We had a lovely 2 night stay. The apartment was clean, the balcony was lovely for a breakfast. Would thoroughly recommend and we’ll definitely be back!

We were 4 adults and 3 kids and all had an excellent stay at Lisas place. The flat is very well located, clean and there's everything you need there! thanks a lot Lisa for the flat and the easy communication. x

Well appointed 4bed room property with 3.5 bathrooms (two ensuite) With a  rooftop which is perfect for BBQing or catching some rays and sinking some beers. Location is superb with loads of amenities on the doorstep .Great place to be your hub for exploring london. Throughly recommend.

Vikash was a very good and helpful host. The property is very spacious and the location was perfect for our needs. We did encounter some issues. However, Vikash, has responded to our feedback and I am confident that he has addressed the problems that we highlighted.

Jodie and family, we are so glad we chose your accommodation. You went above and beyond to make our trip easy, especially with the books and toys for our son. Always available for any requests and so friendly.
We would suggest this place to anyone who’s looking for a place with access to shops, parks and transport nearby as most places are within walking distance. 😊

Great stay at this fab little apartment. Exactly as it looks in the pictures and in a brilliant location. Check in and out was straight forward, apartment was easy to find and Rosie, the host, was available for anything I needed at any time.
Rachaels place is very well located and great for a young family. The kids had a blast!
Lovely people, lovely small space. Would be perfect for a solo trip, gorgeous location with outdoor space.

Amazingly stylish and trendy spot in immaculate condition, so much space to relax and retreat to from the confines of the city. Extremely close to Shoreditch and all the cool stuff it has to offer. Checking in and out was very smooth and straightforward and Julian couldn’t have been easier to contact or more prompt in replying to any inquiries I had. Awesome place and owner!

It has been such a wonderful stay.The house is extremely amazing taste and cosy atmosphere, very comfortable.I love the garden as well.Also Tess,surely she is the one of the wonderful owner-quick response,very very friendly.Thank you so very much.

Damion’s property is unreal. The decor is lovely and kitted with everything you need. Damion was a great host with great communication and tips on what to do during our stay. I would 100% recommend this property for anyone looking to get away.
One of the best airbnb's I've used in London. Good location, good amenities and a "feel at home" vibe. Would definitely recommend!
A clean apartment, with beautiful views of the skyline. Dahlia was a great host who was in constant communication throughout our stay. Thank you Dahlia!
Damion’s property was beautiful, comfortable and sparkling clean. Lovely touches such as luxury toiletries, nice tea and coffee made it feel like a home from home and we would definitely book again.

The bedrooms were not great and up many flights of stairs. the master bedrooms door handle was falling off, the 2nd bathroom was falling apart as were the beds. The bedrooms look much more kept and nice in pictures.
They would not give us a 2nd set of keys even tho they knew we were 2 people which was extremely inconvenient. They said it was a security risk for us to have 2 sets? I’ve never had this happen with an Airbnb
Was a nice place to stay but the place needs to be updated and maybe needs to find a way off making check-in and check-out easier especially for someone with luggage.

Although this space is small, it is so stylish and cool! Beautifully designed and has everything you need. Such a perfect location with Angel tube station right next door and all the shops you need. Even though it's on a busy road it's surprisingly quiet! Didn't have a single issue with noise. Definitely recommend for a short trip in the city.

The flat is just as described and pictured. It’s very conveniently located in the heart of Notting Hill and just 5-7 min walk to Notting Hill Gate station. It’s on a quiet tree-lined street and the bedroom is in the back so no issues with road. The flat was very clean and spacious. Simon was a great host who checked in regularly to ensure I had a good stay.
