Great location and extremely clear instructions on how to check in etc. well worth what was paid considering the late notice.

Awesome spot to stay when visiting London! Super close to Kings Cross station which is a great location and easy to get anywhere in London. The apartment was clean, Joseph was very responsive for any questions, and I'd highlight recommend!
Great location, although not surprisingly a bit noisy. The flat has everything you need for a great stay in London. Would stay here again! Thank you!

Fabio’s place is perfect! Even better than the photos, and kept really clean. Beds are comfortable and linen and towels good quality. The area is amazing, so many great food places and really easy to get around. Will definitely stay again next time we’re in London!
Had a wonderful stay at Van’s place, the apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfy. I recommend!

Many thanks to Bipin for a clean, comfortable and practical place to stay for the night - very private and well kitted out with everything down to an iron and ironing board (handy ahead on a work trip)!

This is a darling little apartment, located in a fun part of London with oodles of restaurants and shopping just steps away. We were pleased  to find a fully stocked refrigerator and a very accommodating host.   The tube at Sloane Square is an easy five minute walk, so the rest of London is easy to access. We highly recommend this quiet place in a very nice neighborhood.
The owner was very responsive and helpful. The room was clean and perfect for a visit to Wembley stadium

Zuzana's "golden sage" studio is a beautiful place for a short stay. The decoration is exquisite and the place was spotless. Zuzana was happy for us to check in earlier and replied immediately even late in the evening. Zuzana and the studio had a great energy!
Highly recommended!

Easy check-in, the hosts were very responsive. The place itself is stunning and beautifully decorated. Walkable distance from the Notting Hill Area, and the Notting Hill Gate station. Really private and quiet within the residence area, but it is located nearby the bustling shops as well.

Nice studio with all necessities for a weekend stay.
The bed was nice, shower heated fast, apartment was mostly clean (few spots excluded)
There are some improvements possible for the wifi.
Host was polite, helpful and proactive in replacing indoor mat(after asking for permission) and outdoor mat.

Andrew was incredibly responsive and helpful, he advised about parking and was quick to answer any questions. The apartment itself is spacious and was really comfortable.
The map / kitchen list was really helpful and a nice touch.
Had a tiny issue connecting to WiFi, but Andrew replied straight away and even tried to get a BT engineer to come out, thankfully it wasn’t needed but that was over and above helpful.
I would highly recommend the apartment, and Andrew as a host.
Look forward to my next stay
The apartment was beautiful and super clean! Even nicer than I expected. The bed was very comfortable. Super convenient location close to Tower of London. I really enjoyed my stay.

From start to finish the entire process was super easy. Natalie provided us with a check in video as she was unable to attend. We’ve had a little surprise left in the fridge also! This host is an angel and if there was an award for the best host hands down Natalie would win! 🙌🏼 10/10.

VanZyl was a great host. He always quickly responded to our questions. The flat was bright, modern and clean, as shown on the pictures. The beds were confortable and the kitchen was easy and practical. The WiFi was not always reliable and the furniture in the living room were not comfortable to sit in, especially the sofa.
Overall a great stay. Thank you Van.

Location location location and spotlessly clean. Bus stops are 5 mins walk away and really nice Cafe 5 mins away also . The place was spotless and there was lots of extra special touches ( quality toiletries , biscuits etc ). The area is very quiet and safe .
Beautiful apartment, centrally located in Mayfair, quiet street - what could be better? Matt was a perfect host - responsive and helpful - and we can’t wait to come back.
The location is amazing . But the place is very small and is in the last floor . So you have to carry all your luggage all the way up
Great place to stay. transport nearby for all the places we needed to go to. lovely surroundings.

Nico was a fantastic host! His place is beautiful, super clean, and there are so many things to do around the area. Even though I was in the process of relocating and using the place for temporary accommodation, he still gave me plenty of recommendations of places to visit, or activities to do within the area. Nico was also very considerate of my needs, and always made sure that I had what I needed to make my stay better. He is also very friendly and extremely easy to talk to, which made staying the weekend there even better and I always felt comfortable. The horror movie night was also a great bonus, and a terrific way to cap off a legitimate 10/10 temporary stay!

We loved staying here! Ground floor flat (about 6 steps up from the street) with an amazing street full of restaurants and shops one block away. I’d walk out to get breakfast every morning to bring back. Regents park is also walking distance and a beautiful space to let our toddler run around. The flat was very clean and comfortable. It took us a bit to figure out how to work the heat once it got cold, but it was very warm once we figured it out. Vas was very helpful once we reached out to him for help. The washer dryer combo didn’t dry very well (or really at all) but it did clean the clothes and we just air dried. Metro and bus both very convenient.

I had an excellent stay at Van's flat. The location is superb: a 5-minute walk from the heart of Camden Town yet the flat itself is in a quiet, low-key location. The flat itself is attractive with the floor-to-ceiling windows. The area is safe. One can get to anywhere in London from Camden Town tube station. Everything was clean. Having a dishwasher is a plus. Self-check-in is very straightforward with a lockbox. Property is exactly as described. Completely met my objective to both be active around London and restful between my outings.

Carla’s place like her photo and she was very responsive to what we needed.
She was very friendly and was able to accommodate any new amenities we required. Like any new bedsheets and any other items we needed.
The kitchen is top notch and all the equipments are very high quality.
Although the place was very cozy there were a few things that could be better.
There was a bit of musty and dusty throughout the place.
Furthermore, if you are allergic to cats or any other pets. Please do let Carla know, she will ensure that the place will be thoroughly cleaned.
Other than that, a cozy and relax place to stay in and there were quite a few shops that allowed us to get supplies.
I had a great stay at Karina’s. She and her husband are very friendly and easy going. The room  was spotless and the bed very comfy, I would definitely recommend staying with them.

Sandra’s place was lovely and had everything you need for a great London stay. The home was clean and well-organized and the 24/7 security gives you confidence. Nordine (co-host) was very helpful and flexible for early arrival; he was also very personable and gave the London run-down for things to do. The flat location is accessible to almost everything; I used Sandra’s guide daily for cafes and restaurants! I definitely recommend this stay
great host, the house was impeccable and clean and everything was very close by, I will definitely stay again.
I would recommend this place to all my friends and family. Great location and a great value for what you get.

I feel like at home when I stay at Mingshu’s house. I like to chat with her lovely 7 year- old son. The location is very good: near grocery stores and bus stop (5min walk) and Cricklewood underground station (10min walk). The room is cozy and clean, my deluxe double room has a nice view. I had a pleasant stay in Greater London. I will book Mingshu’s house again if I travel to London next time.
Very nice place. Simple but clean and quiet. The shower drain is not the best, but other than that everything was just exactly as expected.

Great place. Looks exactly as pictured, including fresh cut flowers and fruit on the kitchen counter! Super location, 100 meters from Pavilion Road. Angie is a great host - responsive, friendly and helpful. Felt welcome from the minute I arrived. I'd gladly return.
Thanks Angie!
A second visit for us. Very good to have a place close to Heathrow that we know is quiet and easy to access. Our host was friendly as before, and has made good improvements to the bathroom.

The flat looks exactly same as the photos. 10 mins walk from the Wimbledon station and easy to get into central London. Victoria always replies super quickly and very accommodating. Definitely recommend this place if you are travelling to london ans looking for place with nice neighbourhood, many nice restaurants nearby as well.

Very Nice place
Totally in line with photo’s
Very well equiped
Nada is a great host, very responsive
We strongly recommend this place

The apartment is lovely, in a quiet place in Fulham , it has all necessary kits you need and 10 mins walk to underground station ( Putney ), it is house, converted to 2 apartments, and the host is supportive always.
Modern and comfortable apartament. The host was friendly, with great communication. Perfect location, next to the underground. Thank you!

Shlome was a wonderful host. Very responsive and helpful!
The property is located in a quiet street lined with a community park/strip. Though it may be a little dark at night, the area still feels safe and is accessible to both bus and trains.
The place is newly re-furbished and was clean when we arrived. We loved the bathroom and the how spacious the common area was. Ideal choice for a family of 5 or more.
Will definitely consider this again in our next trip to London.
Place was easy to find with instructions and had the listed amenities, shower was a struggle at first but the place is very good value and good transport to the city centre.

Very beautiful house.
If we came in Summer, we could have enjoyed a lot.
We had a boiler problem but Kathy responded so quickly to send plumbers and electric heaters, even compensate for one night.

The studio is really cosy and has everything you need for a perfect stay. There were clear instructions about everything- the facility and also the public transport. Gary was really helpful and kind. I definitely recommend the place.
Inge is a great amazing lady,  she care about my visit, provide a lovely space for living: nice kitchen, great location, convince with underground and even I could run along the beautiful river.
Although the area around the accommodation is noisy and unkempt, transportation is convenient and the accommodation's many amenities were useful.
NIce comfortable apartment in great area. Slobodan was very friendly and helpful and really knows the area. Highly recommended!

Visit London and live with the locals! If you are looking for an authentic experience - this is the place to be. Comfortable flat for 1 or 2 people who enjoy a clean space to live. The heat works. Living room is comfortable and the bed is too. The water pressure sure is good. Kitchen is well-stocked so you can drink or eat in if that’s you’re preference. Short walk to the corner for excellent bus system or just a few minutes stroll to Clapham Commons train station that will begin your journey to anywhere you want to go. Sizeable park nearby for runners to explorer that has outdoor exercise equipment for public use. Nearby house of worship. Book now - this spot is great.
Lovely stay at Olivia's, very reactive with clear instructions. Clapham has everything and its station got us anywhere we wanted very easily

A lovely quiet space close to great transport links to all tourist sites and West End.Islington High Street a short walk away where you will find lovely restaurants ,coffee shops and lots of other shops to wander through and enjoy.
The house is bright, spacious and spotless with all one could need to cater comfortably for 4 if there for a longer period..We were there for a long weekend and did a lot of eating out..The beds are comfy and shower powerful.All in all a 5 star experience.Thank you Tania!

Geoff was in contact straight away with instructions and information, all of which were clear and easy to follow. The kitchen was well stocked and the bedroom clean and airy, all of which added up to a comfortable stay.
Claire’s flat is a great base for a few days in South London. We enjoyed our stay and would book again

One of the most beautiful places I have ever stayed at. High ceiling, clean, comfortable, bright, beautiful decoration and the location was fantastic. Just one minute or two walk to Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The fast Internet and TV with Netflix and Disney+ was a great hit with the kids.
I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment with my family. Raphael is a great host. Very responsive, friendly and helpful. He made sure we had everything we need for out stay. I would not think twice to book this place again if available.

The landlord proactively explained the way to enter the apartment in advance, the room is very clean, and the location has some traffic noise, but overall, everything is wonderful. Thank you for giving me a great London experience.

Alessia was very friendly and warm during the stay. The room and bathroom were very clean and she surprised us with very tender details that made our stay even more pleasant. If we go back to London, we go back to Alessia's place!! :)
A fantastic apartment in a good location. We really enjoyed our stay. Sebastian was responsive and engaging throughout our engagement and we would definitely stay there again.

Sancha was an incredible host, I felt right at home when I came. The place was squeakily clean and everything was great. She looked out for me like we were close friends, would definitely recommend. 5/5 stars.

Marijana is, without a doubt, the kindest host we've ever had the pleasure of staying with. The flat was impeccably clean, and we were delighted with every aspect of our stay. From the efficient heating and continuous hot water supply to the comfortable beds and well-stocked toiletries, everything was perfect. The location is quite remarkable, amidst a multitude of shops, restaurants, a supermarket, and a bakery. Thank you Marijana for making our stay truly memorable. We appreciate everything you've done for us!

Matt’s place was great. The flat was spotless and very nicely decorated. It was very close to Oxford Street and the Bond Street tube station. There’s plenty of restaurants nearby and shopping is more than plentiful. Matt was very good with any questions I had and was fast with responses. One of the nicest properties I’ve stayed in with Air BNB.
Jadin’s place is super convenient, easy to reach, and had flexible check in. Jadin is very communicative! I would recommend others to stay here and can’t wait to come back!
Had a lovely stay here with a friend! Very easy transport links and very easy to walk to local shops for groceries! I would highly recommend staying here!
Comfortable room in James' home. Quiet street. TV with a Netflix account was a bonus for a solo work-related stop over!

You get what the advert promises. A small but practical apartment, ideal for short stays for one person or a couple. Quiet and peaceful, no noise disturbances during my stay. Comfortable bed with clean linen. Transport is quite ideal, with easy access to the city centre and sights by bus and metro. Shop, restaurants are available nearby. Self check in is very easy and convenient.

Very happy stay a Frederica’s place. Everything was just as described. The bed was comfortable, great shower and the kitchen space with clothes washer user friendly.
Great choice for comfort and position.

A terrific location to get anywhere in London, or to stay in the neighborhood and find plenty of pubs, restaurants, and shops. The flat has everything you need for a landing spot as you explore. Jinny is super responsive. and made sure that we were comfortable and had everything we needed during our stay.

Location was great for us. Soho etc all within walking distance & some nice places for food/drinks in the local area (& a Tesco very close by). Flat was very clean & looked as described. Host was very responsive to messages & the option to drop bags off at our convenience was great. George was on hand for bag drop off & check-in, there was even the offer to hold our bags on check-out day! He was also responsive to messages. All in all, I would highly recommend this Air BnB for anyone visiting London.

Our family of 4 had a nice stay. The neighborhood is very pretty and quiet, although another family in the building did make a lot of noise one night and kept my children awake late. For the most part it was very peaceful and we liked that it was easy to get to Paddington on foot. The bedrooms are very small, but everything was clean and comfy, and there are shelves to put your clothes and things. The host was communicative and flexible with our late check-in time, which we appreciated. Overall would recommend.
I stayed in a nice little basement self-contained annexe flat. small, but cosy. The shower was really good.
A good clean quiet room located by Langdon Park station so London sites are very easily accessible (e.g. O2 arena).

The location is really central, quite nearby the most important things (Piccadilly station), is like a 100 mts from Soho. Nevertheless, guys take care of your stuff, we were pickpocketed in Soho like 3 blocks from the apartment, the location is central but the neighborhood is a little rough for tourists, when we were in the police station two other people were pickpocketed too.

This very charming flat surrounded by a lot of birds in his patio, is nestled in Hampstead and is perfect for anybody who wants to be in London without being in London (only those having experienced London in its heart will understand ;)). Thank to Megan for her availability at any times.
Cheers!

I stayed here with my family for a short city break & it was the perfect place to base ourselves. Fabulous property in great condition, close to everything you need to get around London & enjoy your stay. Would recommend 👍

Studio was really nice. Loved the bathroom the most, very aesthetically pleasing.
Would recommend staying here and would definitely stay here again.

Our stay at Matthew’s apartment was wonderful : the place is amazing : comfortable, clean, useful, cozy. It looks exactly like the pictures and communication was very very nice !
We recommend 100% Matthew’s place to make your London trip feel perfect :)
Thank you again Matthew !
Fantastic location, lots of underground options near by. Had a great stay in London. Just what we needed

Clarissa’s place was well kept and close to Earl’s Court station which was really convenient. Lots of great food nearby and little convenience stores in case you forgot something.
The home was clean, had all the amenities and we were able to use all of the appliances. Would love to stay again if I have the chance.

Herman was a good host, very friendly and we had a good communication in overall.
The place was good, in a very quiet and friendly neighbourhood.
I would like to stay there again.

Great location and just as described. Stayed here with my family of five and we were very comfortable. Anna was also very accommodating and allowed us to drop off our luggage early which we very much appreciated. Would recommend it!

Beautiful newly refurbished apartment.
Great location for Notting Hill.
Host always on hand if we needed anything.
Will definitely come back again.

Great location, clean comfy apt. George went above and beyond. Bed is cozy, shower pressure was awesome! Delicious restaurants and coffee just steps away. Also, it was quiet which is rare for central London. I’d stay again!
Excellent location, long staircase gives me a little bit problem, however, I will still rate 5-star. Excellent host as well.

Very friendly, helpful, has written guidebook to the area and has it posted it on Airbnb for access before the visit. Two co-hosts, easy to arrange personal check-in, no key boxes to hunt for at other locations or confusion about how to return key as with some places. Expect narrow stairs on way up to attic room. All pristine with a happy feeling to it and nice big bathtub. Location is up a hill with a good view.
What a find and how lovely is Sandra … I have stayed a couple of times and it gets better each time 🌸😊🌸😊😊

Yassine has been the perfect host and the studio is cosy and clean.
I loved the area, also walking distance from Shoreditch and with easy access to public transportation.
2nd trip for us in this b and b.Great host and perfect house for our bussisness trip. Will definitely book again.

First of, if you're in town for an Arsenal match this is the place to stay. You're literally in the closest apartment to the stadium.
Outside of that the space is very modern and clean. The location is a close walk to any of the train stations you'll need to move around London. Also, there are plenty of shops and restaurants around if needed.
The check in process was smooth and informative with Nordine and I'll definitely be looking for this space if I return.

Lovely little flat with everything you need. Easy to find and only a few minutes away from Oxford Street.  Spotlessly clean and nice and warm.   The sofa bed is surprisingly comfortable.  Had a great night sleep. I could actually live here!
Very nice and comfortable place. Fit the price you can’t beat it. There is a bus stop right in front of the location for an easy time getting around. I would 100% recommend

I had a great stay at Evelyn's house. The room is super clean, cosy, quiet and tidy with a private bathroom and shower. I also unexpectedly really enjoyed the neighborhood with nice coffee shops (check out Rebel Coffee, an experience itself) around, a lively street with a school and a beautiful par/wood just few minutes away. Evelyn and her family were welcoming, friendly and made sure I was comfortable the whole time. Thanks Evelyn!
Marijana’s place is gorgeous, clean, and easy close to the underground. We had a great stay!
Lovely, warm home.  Clean and tidy, great location.  Can sleep upto four, in which case its also exceptionally affordable for London..!

When you arrive home and wake up in your own bed but wishing you were still at Monica’s flat? Yes. That is how we felt.
We were so happy with the location, the flat, the communication, and the ease of getting there. The flat is a wonderful home base to almost all of the activities available in London. It is cosy, warm, and the garden area is a bonus. We will be recommending this flat (and Monica) to all we speak with. We could not have been more comfortable or happier with his choice.
Thank you Monica for the directions in helping us get settled and providing such a wonderful experience.

Alex’s place in Chelsea is a gem.
It is a beautiful space in a great neighbourhood.
Our family felt right at home in the comfortable surroundings. Plenty of natural light, beautiful art, and comfortable furnishings to help you relax after long days of exploring the city.
The location has many options for groceries and restaurants/pubs and easy access to transit.
The beds and bedrooms are very comfortable and the space is quiet and private.
Our family would happily stay here again.
I found Jadin to be friendly and very responsive . The place is very conveniently placed with easy access to transport and was perfect for what I required . Highly recommended .

We had a lovely stay here!
It's a great place, just like the pictures and very clean. Amazing location, just a short walk away from bethnal green station (central line). There are nice pubs as well as a Sainsbury's nearby. We'II definitely stay here again our next trip to London.

Cara was an amazing host, she was friendly and helpful! Her place is beautiful and peaceful! I felt so safe walking around in the neighborhood, more than that, the o2 arena is very close to her apartment, which was super easy to access! It was comfortable and extremely clean!

This property was everything we were hoping. The location was awesome. Communication with the host was quick and responsive. The description was as presented. Would definitely stay here again. We were here for seven days and the only downside was we are not here longer.
Peaceful, quiet and within easy walking distance of the station with a very welcoming and helpful host. Highly recommend. 👍
Simple, but convenient place to stay in London! Very central placement and close to the Underground. Helen was friendly and quick to answer:)

Good location.
Only worry was that balcony door wasn't locked and couldn't find a key.
Also no hot water in morning.
But overall good overnight stay literally arrived went to a gig ,slept in flat and left the next morning.
Had everything we needed for that .
Very responsive hosts, we had a small issue with hot water and this was sorted out quickly and easily via Clarissa and the handy man. Great location and spacious house

Great central location, we were able to walk to most of the major sites. Also super easy to get to from Heathrow.
Awesome selection of restaurants within 5 mins.

Booked the place for a family getaway. Location is easily accessible and even walkable from some of the main train stations if you’re not weighed down with too much luggage. Accommodation itself is very basic, but good value for location.

I left immediately.
There was a flashing light in the hall like a horror movie when we arrived.
The whole building smelt of weed and was extremely dirty.
Neighbours were arguing and having noisy sex.
Blood on the bedsheets.
I felt unsafe

My stay was very good. House was very good and clean, with with ample equipment provided. I didn’t walk around the area, so i can’t really talk about that, but the biggest plus was not a long distance to underground and bus stops with night buses. Also, there is a shop very close to the house. Hosts was very kind and helpful, they provided lovely space for me to stay and contacting with them was amazing! They responded very quickly and precisely and was there to help with everything- they even recommended me a lot of places to visit in London and gave me info about traveling around the city. Also i was feeling very safe there, house was in calm neighbor and i had lock in my doors. I also meet their lovely and cuddly cat, unfortunately only at the moment when i was leaving for my flight.  If I’ll be back in London I will surely get back to this airbnb. Thank you for everything!

The room was very clean and the accessibility very easy.
The only problem was the location and the bed that is really small (for tall people) and uncomfortable. For sure not for 2 people.
Great place for a peaceful stance, we love everything and you have transportation train and bus near to the house
I had a good stay. It was easy accessible, good walking distance from the underground, and in a fun area of London. The place was clean and fine to stay at for a couple of nights.

It was amazing experience. Our host Natalia was wonderful, she has super helpful, respectful and nice. I highly recommend the apartment. It is close to everything with amazing amenities. Everything we were looking for in London.

this is a lovely, clean and stylish home. It was perfect for our needs (work-related visit to Bromley). Easily walkable to Bromley where some good pubs and places to eat can be found. The flat is on a quiet cul-de-sac. There is a pretty well-kept garden at the back, which the living room looks onto and relaxing on the sofa you wouldn't know you are in Greater London. The flat is spotlessly clean, well-equipped and very comfortable. There is a large table which makes a good working space. Natalie was friendly, helpful and quick to respond from the start. I would highly recommend. Much better value and far better experience than a hotel! I will be back when I've next got work in Bromley.

We felt very comfortable in Andrea's home, which had everything we needed, and was very convenient both for Euston and for our daughter, who we were visiting. A quiet location, near to shops and transport. Ideal for us. Thanks to both Andrea and Veena.

Great place. The studio was located in a quiet area. Bus stop is like 5 minutes from the place. The studio was clean and had everything as mentioned. The host was very responsive and quick in communication. Perfect place to stay for the price paid considering how close it is to the main city centre and amenities.

Great location! Three blocks away from the Marble Arch and entry to the Winter Wonderland. Jamie responded very quickly to any questions we had. The Wi-Fi was strong. Very spacious place for two people. Everything in the listing was accurately described. The next time we visit London, we will definitely consider staying again. I’m afraid to recommend it too highly because I want to keep it to myself for my next holiday visit! It felt like home away from home. Thanks, Jamie, for sharing your beautiful place. My daughter and I really enjoyed our visit to London.

Great location, great flat, and had all the necessary amenities. We were in town to spend Thanksgiving with my relatives who live in the area, and this served as a great home base for my family of 3 adults and 1 infant.

It is with great pleasure that I write this review to express my delight in returning to Herman's place. After my previous exceptional stay, I knew that there was no better choice for accommodation during my visit.The room, as expected, offered the same level of comfort that I had come to appreciate. It was a peaceful sanctuary where I could relax and recharge, and the convenience of the location made it easy for me to seamlessly resume my exploration of the area.The completeness of the amenities once again proved to be invaluable, as everything I needed was readily available, contributing to a stress-free and thoroughly enjoyable stay. My return to Herman's place only reinforced my high regard for this Airbnb. I am grateful for the consistency of excellence that Herman's place offers and will undoubtedly return on future visits. Once again, five stars all around!

We loved our stay at Simon’s Airbnb. The space was clean, had all amenities we needed, and was in a great location. The neighborhood is clean, quiet, and centrally located. The Notting Hill Gate underground stop was a quick walk away. We had no issues whatsoever navigating to all of the places we needed to.
Nearby are some great shops, pubs, shopping, the Portobello Road Market, and coffee shops. Simon was an excellent host as he was very responsive and provided all necessary instructions to the Airbnb. Overall, a great location and experience.

Great place to stay right before an early morning flight out of Heathrow. Clean and comfortable. Host was kind and helpful. Easy to get an Uber in the area (even at 3:30am!!) for our early morning flight.

We felt safe and comfortable in the apartment . We where close to most of the attractions . George was extremely helpful with advice on how to take transportation and local thing to see and do. I would revisit here again.

Thank you so much for letting us stay in such a beautiful place! The coziness and privacy was amazing in a city like London and made us not want to go out for the rest of the night! Will definitely be returning 😁

Jamie was a very friendly and helpful host, easy to reach and respond to my questions. The flat is large, modernised and clean. The location is great - a stone throw from Oxford Street, with a Tesco Express round the corner and a Sainsbury’s Local not far off. I had an evening flight and so Jamie allowed a late check out at no extra cost. The only let down with this location is the building in which the flat is located. The building’s foyer, stairs and corridors need renovation and maintenance. The flat is like an oasis in that sort of building.  Also the lifts don’t work so I had to haul my suitcases up and down the stairs. Overall if you want a nice flat in a great location that’s central, close to all you need including the Underground, at a good price, and don’t mind the general state of the building, I recommend Jamie’s flat.
We were very comfortable and had everything we needed. Liked how close we were to Clapham Junction.

We recently stayed at Tracey’s Airbnb in Bethnal Green and had a wonderful experience. The location is incredibly convenient, making it easy to explore the city. We found the pricing for our 3-person, 4-day stay to be very competitive and appreciated the value. The apartment itself was comfortable, providing a cozy base for our city adventures. Tracey was exceptional in her communication, offering clear instructions and prompt responses. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy London from a convenient and comfortable location.

Host was responsive, location was great, space was as described. We had a few issues during our stay. Toilet was leaking, but host fixed it right away. None of the heaters worked the first evening, host fixed it the next day , but it was a cold night for all. Lastly, description said there would be extra linens for the sofa bed, there were none. I spoke with the host and it was assumed all travelers would be sharing beds. After explaining that our teenage son would not be sharing a bed with his grandmother, they brought us new linens the following day. All in all the stay was enjoyable, there were just some minor inconveniences to start off. However, the host made everything right and fixed all deficiencies in a timely manner.

The property was as described and it was tastefully furnished ..however we noticed the place was very cold from the moment we walked in.
We communicated this issue to Van and despite sending people to take care of this on 2 occasions, it remained cold.
On reading previous reviews, the heat ( or lack thereof) as been an issue with other guests.
To be fair, Van did credit us a percentage of our payment.
Guess my recommendation if you rent this property in the winter…bring your long underwear and a couple of hot water bottles!
I am sure the property would be lovely in the warmer months….
Excellent location, the apartment is clean and has everything that we needed! I recommend it 100%. would stay again.
Place was great for what we needed. George was quick to respond and help us as we arrived. We felt very safe and at home in the area.
Convenient and cozy modern place to stay near St Paul’s. We loved the easy walk one the Millennial Bridge to the Tate Modern and Borough Market. Having an elevator was very helpful with bags.

Sandra’s place is in a wonderful location - proximate to two tube stations to get anywhere around London and very walkable. A great neighborhood with lots of great cafes, restaurants and bars. The flat was clean, warm and comfortable with amenities as listed. Sandra and Nordine were ideal hosts - friendly and responsive. We were very delayed getting in to London and the host was flexible - meeting us late at night to meet us and ensure we were settled in. Would definitely stay again.

Nada was an absolutely stunning host. She makes us feel like home. Very well communicated with the train station and restaurants.
The house is beautiful and stunning.
You have all the little snacks and treats for yourself, really nice and much appreciated.
We will recommended this home and Nada 200%!

The location was nice, it was at a walking distance from subway and other transport. However the place was not actually warm. My parents had come from a temperate county and had a tough time in the cold as the heaters were not working very well. The property was lacking proper insulation as well.

A lovely studio apartment, a stone throw from Notting Hill tube which made it ideal to get around town. Max and Billie were fantastic on communication and sorting out any issues I had. It was a shame I didn't get to enjoy the balcony as that was a real feature of the studio. I was a women travelling alone and felt 100% safe walking to the apartment and in the apartmen.

100%
It was everything as described and a professional host.
Thanks guys! 💚

I'd stay again. So would my senior mother. Neighborhood and building are quiet, short enough walk to Bayswater, Queensway, and just a gew minutes more walk to Paddington. about a four minute walk to Hyde Park.
If you stay, bring a flashlight for the lockbox if at night. The building elevator has a several inch step-in when you get in, so take great care (not the hosts fault, but be aware).
It was centrally located, easily accessible to and from everywhere in London.  The tube station is basically across the street…. I throughly enjoyed my stay.

A fantastic recommendation for families in search of accommodation in London! This place exudes a warm, homely ambiance that truly enhanced our stay. The beautiful house was a delightful experience for all of us. Maria, undoubtedly our super host, impressed us with her proactive, responsive, and incredibly helpful nature. A definite 10 out of 10!
Fantastic location, everything you needed at the apartment down to shampoo shower gel and toothpaste. Wine was a lovely added extra, thank you 😄. Highly recommend and will definitely return

Everything was great except for the stairs
As the apartment in the top floor with no elevators
It was hard carrying the luggage
I stayed here with 4 more friends. It looked even better than described. Exactly what we needed for one night (good location, very clean…)

Overall amazing place for a first time London visitor and friend! Two girls stayed here comfortably, the area feels on the safer side and getting in and out of the apartment was a breeze. Host is very friendly and overall the apartment is so spacious and great, whenever I come back I will definitely stay here and highly recommend to friends!!

Tonia was a wonderful host and the place was great. she was incredibly responsive and the house is perfect for 2 people.
there are lots of kitchen supplies and little extras.
would stay again in a heartbeat
Very much enjoyed our stay. Great location. George was very helpful to coordinate check in and check out!

Andrea's home is in a quaint and nice neighbourhood. The place is exactly as shown in the pictures. Andrea is warm, easy to communicate with and is extremely flexible person. I had requested her for an early check-in and some extra time to keep the luggage after check-out, which she graciously accepted. Would certainly recommend her place.
Flat was very tidy, nice and warm and location was ideal for what we needed. Would stay again!

The apartment was very clean with all facilities we needed. The beds were comfy and there were enough mirrors (also full body mirror) everywere (very good for us girls). There is enough space for 6 people. Clean bathrooms, perfectly located. Big kitchen und dining table. The underground was very close to the apartment und we could reach Queens Walk and Tower Brige per foot. We would always choose this apartment again. Thank you very much.

We loved staying at Jodie’s place. It was perfect for our long weekend and they couldn’t have been more accommodating, letting us check in early and even providing some books and toys to help keep our toddler entertained. Next time we are in London we will definitely try and stay again.

Daria was a great host, the place was super clean and comfortable. There was a slight problem with the hob, however Daria was happy to help and solve our problem. I am very pleased and would definitely recommend😊

This was a very nice place to stay while researching at the National Archives. I was there during a cold winter week and found the flat warm and cozy throughout my stay. It was comfortable and convenient. It is well set up for light cooking, has a modern bathroom, and there is ample space to work and to relax. I certainly did not find it too small. I think there is good space for up to two people to be comfortable here. The neighbourhood is safe and it is about 10 minutes to the tube station. There is an excellent M&S nearby. Rosie was a great host. I will definitely be back.

The host is amazing 24/7 you will find her, helpful and flexible. I really like the location between soho, and covent garden less than 1 min. Place can fit for 4 easily, but a little bit tight rooms. They have good heater for the apartment and shower. My concern was about the price a bit high, but I understand it’s a season time. I would love to comeback to this place. Warm thanks for the host.

Really enjoyed my stay at Jose’s place. Jose was very helpful in communicating with ahead of my arrival. Very comfortable bedding and the kitchen had everything that was needed. I would definitely come back here.

I had a great stay at Jelena’s place! It was perfect for my last minute stay in London and she was super responsive  the whole time. She is a wonderful woman and her place makes you feel right at home :) It is a great location and easy to pick up public transportation, too. I would stay there again and highly recommend her place to everyone!
Great location in Shoreditch. Nicely renovated three storey building with roof terrace, great place to get back to after a day of exploring the city!

I booked this place for my parents to stay for a week. The place was very clean, easy to get in and out and it felt very homely. The host was very friendly , he helped and showed around. Definitely recommend this place :)

Small but well equipped flat in a good location. It was quite noisy at night. Access was via (lit) back alley and some uncovered steps which might be inaccessible for some. Check in was easy and convenient, we had a good stay!

Cara is a fabulous host, very good communication, and a lovely apartment with magnificent views. Will definitely stay again.  Cara was very informative about the area and was friendly but was not intrusive at all.
Good location ! Clean flat! The only problem was the lights in the house. It was dark inside. Other than that, we had a lovely stay! Thanks

Herman was a great host. I particularly appreciated his flexibility regarding check in when we had a transport issue.
Nice big room with a very comfortable bed - would definitely use again. Thanks.
I will definitely use this place again. The place was very clean. Nice size bed. Wifi & TV worked great. Very cute  & cozy. It’s was perfect for me. Thanks again

Lovely stay in Fitzrovia! Clean, modern and so well decorated. We had an amazing stay! Perfect for two couples. Great natural light throughout the place. Lindi was super responsive and replied within minutes whenever we had a question. Many shops and restaurants nearby. A bit of noise at night from the pub across the street but it didn’t bother us too much! Will definitely recommend to friends and family who are visiting London and will hopefully be back to stay again soon!!
Really great location! Lots of great restaurants and cafes within 1-5 minutes walking distance and plenty of vintage shops which was fun.
Great apartment in a really good location. Everything was very smooth and Jamie the host was great to deal with.

Fantastic stay, great location we enjoyed walking through Hyde Park to museums and Oxford Street and were pleased to find it was only a short walk to Bayswater Station.
The apartment had everything we needed and we were very happy that Ana and Raphael allowed an early bag drop off so we could enjoy our time in London on checkin day.

A really great apartment in a fantastic location: steps away from the hustle and bustle of Oxford St and Soho, but in a quiet street so you could sleep at night. Check-in was a breeze and the apartment was better than the description. All mod cons and very comfortable bed with good quality cotton linens. Lots of coffee and tea available and everything in good working order. Another great stay at Lynn’s apartment.

Check in was super easy, house had enough space and was clean.
Eddy was very responsive to questions.

This was my second extended stay (5 weeks) at Vas’s exquisite flat! It’s so spacious and bright! I am always so excited to settle into the posh neighborhood of Marylebone. Whether by train or walking, there is no shortage of options for shopping, restaurants, parks, etc. Vas is such a kind and personable host who is always available for any questions during the stay. He goes above and beyond to assure all is well for a comfortable stay. I always say - this flat is like my home away from home when visiting London Town - this time was equally wonderful. Looking forward to next time!

Debbie’s place was in a perfect location for the wedding we attended, was super clean and tidy, and was in easy walking distance to the train stations nearby. Debbie communicated clearly with us at all times and the clear instructions made checking in easy. We really enjoyed our stay! Thank-you Debbie!

Alice was helpful and communic  t during our stay and looked after us very well. The property is nice, secure and quiet, Alice has provided everything you need and this apartment works perfectly for us as a temporary home away from home.

Perfect place to stay for solo travelers who want a peaceful night after a day of exploring! The place had everything i needed and everything was picture perfect when I arrived. Julia even helped me figure out the best way to travel on my travel days.
Brilliant all round, a lovely place and a really good price for location. Easy to get to the tubes and travel around. Thanks Chris

Really great stay! Near bus routes that can get you to trains. Great restaurants nearby, and a nice nightlife scene maybe 15 mins walking. The place itself was much more spacious than imagined. It did take some time to get warm given no one was in the home prior to us arriving, but temperature was fine for the rest of the trip. We also had a slight issue during the start of the trip that was fixed based on the host’s productiveness, which was great. All in all I would recommend this place, but do know while it’s a beautiful neighborhood if you’re looking for a tube stop nearby, it’ll take a bus or some walking to get there.

fridge and cupboards full of food,
and not much hanging space for clothes.
but apart from that, a good little flat for short stay
in a good location for us

Nice little apartement in a quiet area. Evererything was Ok.
The host picked us up at the Underground station. He is wery friedly. The arrival and departure times were flexible.
Had a great stay at this air bnb, room was very clean and was much more spacious in person. Also really close to the station which was very convenient. Thank you for hosting, definitely recommend.
An incredible stay! I am a frequent Airbnb user and Federica’s flat was absolutely as described and exceeded all expectations! A great stay that I hope to repeat!

Everything was great.
Really good location to explore London.
Been here before and I'll probably stay in the future too
Samir and Family are very nice hosts, the room was clean and tidy, good Wi-Fi, nice quiet area, great price.....
I had a lovely stay here! If you want somewhere close to central but still relatively quiet then this is the space.

The inside of the apartment is awesome and gorgeous. There were a few issues that can be resolved. The exterior light in the outside overhang in front of the entry door does not work, which is a security issue. All interior hallway lights to the apartment are on slightly delayed motion lights which take a second or two to illuminate. Hopefully they will fix this. There were some communication issues with regard to check in and getting in. The location in the listing is incorrect, probably based on mapping location algorithms. Make sure you are very clear with the host where this building is and what apartment it is. Hopefully these issues have been sorted out by the time the next renter gets in.
This building is directly next to an elevated train line which runs late at night. I live in a large city, so I barely noticed but someone else might. Apartment was great, location did not work for me.

Jadin and his girlfriend were super friendly and welcoming. Huge thank you for the flexibility with the check-in as we arrived quite late. We didn’t spend too much time in the room, but it was clean and well organised. I can only recommend Jadin’s place if you’re looking for a short stay close to Canary Wharf.

Beautiful apartment in Maida Vale. Fairly close to the underground station. The apartment itself is just perfect. Ammar left more than expected for all of us (many towels for each room, food in the cupboard and fridge, anything you might need for a comfortable stay).
Thanks and hope to be hosted again sometime in the future!

Charming and interesting flat in a perfect location. Kitchen and bathroom were clean and both had all the essentials. The main bed (not the sofa bed) was in located in a small mezzanine accessible by a bookshelf/ladder and a little hard to access. However, we were made sufficiently aware of this and managed fine. Only minor complaint was the extra air mattress we used that deflated through the night. Otherwise has a great stay

Five stars isn’t enough to describe our experience of Isabelle’s wonderful accommodation and hospitality.  From the moment we arrived to hugs on our departure.  Isabelle was an exemplary host - more a family friend than a host.  She provided excellent advice and tips on what to do and how to get around the parts of London we’d targeted to see.  We enjoyed sharing breakfast catch-ups, life experiences and interacting with the delightful Mr Darcy (her cat).  We would definitely return and have already recommended her place to family and friends.

Nice comfortable accommodation within easy reach of King’s Cross station to explore London from
Local shop and restaurants within walking distance from accommodation
Great cafe next door for a breakfast and other meals and drinks
Ideal for what we needed

Very nice flat, very clean, nicely decorated and perfectly situated.
You need to be open to noise when you stay in the heart of shoreditch but some earplugs were left on our pillows which was a nice attention.
Great location for overnight stay after works Christmas party. Great value for money. Will definitely use again.
Always a pleasure to stay here. Peaceful but within easy walking distance of a short train journey into central London. Bipin is a friendly and very helpful host.

The stay in Hazel’s place was great. She is very friendly and helped us to understand the public transportation and we could communicate very well with her.The location is good, near to the train stations. The place is exactly like the pictures. She and her son, Jacky, are lovely people and welcomed us with so much care and we felt like our home.

The flat is really great. Spacious, clean, tasteful and has everything you need. It is within easy walking distance of the tube or down to the river, with shops bars & restaurants nearby.
Definitely a good choice for our stay in London.
Natalie was such a kind host and her property was a fabulous stay! Amazing location and jacuzzi amenity. We had a great time here.
Monica’s place is charming and greyto stay for a few days in London. It’s close to public transportation and easily to get to. Monica is easy to communicate with and provides clear instructions.

We enjoyed staying at Robin’s place. Not only was he kind and responsive, he was extremely helpful in recommending the best route to see all of London’s sights. I truly appreciate him taking time to assist us! Would totally stay here again!

I came to the area for work and the location was super convenient to my office. Close to several shops and markets, as well as the Hampstead Heath park (many suggestions by the host herself!).
Tara was very responsive and helpful. Hot water went out a couple of times, but Tara was very responsive and apologetic and got a handyman promptly. I was able to sort it on my own easily after. It’s tidy and plenty of kitchen equipment to use (I like to cook). It’s a little lived in - some cupboards and storage areas are occupied, but overall tidy and comfortable.
I would stay again!

Nina's place was fantastic! Located in a great neighborhood, close to so many fun restaurants and cafes, and incredibly close to the metro. It was easy to get to numerous areas of London. The apartment was charming and wonderfully decorated. And the bed was super comfortable! Really enjoyed our weekend in London and would definitely recommend this place.

Really lovely, spacious place for two people. We enjoyed our stay and felt it was a great location for visiting London.  As any place in London, most sites were about a 30 minute tube, but there were also plenty of walkable restaurants and bars in Chelsea that were certainly worth the visit. The washer and dryer were a very nice touch considering we’re on a quite long holiday. Van was very communicative and allowed us to check in early. Overall would definitely recommend!

Wonderful space in a great location for a very good price!
Check in was simple and easy and communication was brilliant.
I definitely recommend this place!
Great place to stay for our family of 5. Great host. With an easy walk to the train station and 20 minutes to get to central London.
We had a wonderful stay at Paolo’s place and it was a perfect location for exploring London on food and public transport.
Great location, decent sized flat for London with two modern bathrooms. We had a wonderful stay and would happily return next time we’re in London.

Great location in a wonderful neighbourhood and felt safe. place was cosy and had everything we needed. Note to remember that bedding sizing in UK might be different from US and Asia standards and so the bed was technically US Queen size. Nonetheless Ange more than made up for it with her welcoming greetings and with the place nicely stocked up with some necessities like milk, drinks, fruits and fresh flowers.

Perfect place to stay, not too loud, easily connected to stations like tottenham court road or liverpool street. Really clean, big space, and the check in was extremely easy. Overall a very good recommendation.
Evelyn and her husband are amongst the kindest and tidiest people I have ever encountered in life! I had a most pleasant stay.
Wonderful clean home in the heart of China town. Dom was very clear with the instructions and responsive. Would definitely stay again!

The apartment in central location
Very near from city center
Easy to reach
Was clean
Host Tamsin and her husband are very friendly

Michaels place is probably the most cleanest and amazing places I have stayed in London. Location was close to Westfield, very clean & quiet neighbourhood, Olympic park close by and easy access to central London from Stratford station which was a stone throw away. I had an amazing time with my family at Michael’s place and would highly recommend to anybody visiting London. His place will leave you amazed. Thanks Michael, would be visiting your beautiful and lovely apartment again soon.

Lisa’s place in Camden is in a really great location for getting in and out of London but still being able to stay somewhere a little more quiet and private. Within walking distance of Camden Market and lots of restaurants and pubs. We had a wonderful stay - thank you!
Great location, near everything meaningful to me, and surprisingly quiet. Alexey was always very responsive to my inquiries and needs. Grateful got my stay.
This was my second stay here and everything was ideal for me. Location and the flat were very convinient for a London trip. Host was also responsive and helpful even though it’s holiday season

The flat is great and very near to Earl's Court underground! It is easy to get anywhere from the station. Jinny's flat is fully equipped with the necessity. Take note if you are bringing a big luggage, it might be difficult for you to get up to level 1 as there is no lift.
Nice, cozy and super clean apartment. Quick and clear communications by Uri. We very much enjoyed our stay!
The room is very clean, the kitchen is very practical, the location is convenient, and the landlord is also very good, giving a lot of advice and help. Recommend
This is such a nice stay! You are very central to everything. Even though it’s in Chinatown which is very busy at night, it was so quiet! I enjoyed my stay a lot!
Harry’s place was perfect for us and as a host he was always super easy to communicate with and helpful at all times. Would recommend 100%
We really enjoy our stay at the apartment. Is very comfortable and nice! We like the garden so much.
My parents in law really enjoyed their stay at Inge’s during Christmas. Thanks so much for your flexibility and the wonderful location and hospitality you provided!
Harriet's house is a gorgeous and cosy home from home. Everything was incredibly smooth and easy. We highly recommend this as your holiday house in super cool East London.

Staying at Rosario’s place for Christmas was really nice, the room was very clean (although a bit smaller than the photos) but confortable enough and had all I needed for a short stay (5 nights).
The house was a bit noisy since Rosario’s family was visiting for Christmas but I’d recommend earplugs either way if you’re planning to stay here.
The house is very well located next to Stockwell station which takes you to central london in 15-20mins max.
I had an overall nice experience, and I think the room is perfect for solo travelers looking for a place to sleep at night after spending the days outside.

Yas's apartment is literally located in the heart of London's Oxford Street. It is walking to distance to almost everywhere in Zone 1. We walked to and from Covent Garden, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, and London Bridge.
The apartment is lovely, my family really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it.

We felt more than well from the beginning.
Beautiful apartment, very clean and decorated with good style, fabulous details and much love.
Would choose that apartment again for our next stay in London and recommend it to my best friends!
Fantastic communication and support!
A wonderful place to be!
Wow!

We had a great experience during our stay at this accommodation. The apartment was modern in style, spacious with a lot of of rooms and it had everything we needed. The host was consistently easy to reach and always responsive.
Overall, highly recommended.

Very clean accommodation which is the most important thing for our family.
The property looks exactly as in the photos, which unfortunately is somewhat becoming rare now.

The electronic check in and key system was excellent. The place is as described and only a few minutes walk from the nearest tube station. A bus stop is also very close. There are pubs, restaurants, grocery shops and McDonald's all within a 5 minute walk. The balcony has a classic London view, and you will rarely find that on other listings.
The room can get quite hot but this is solved by opening the balcony door for a few minutes.
We stayed there over Christmas and had a great experience! The place was tidy and the spot is really convenient since it’s close to a station and many bus stops. I would personally recommend it😊

We loved staying at Ana’s place as a family of 5.
Ana’s place had everything we needed for our 5 night stay. Location was excellent. So close to buses, tubes, trains, restaurants and supermarkets.
Ana was highly responsive and her communication was excellent. We especially loved the welcome/information pack. Very informative and helpful.
We would stay at Ana’s place again when back in London.

This place make you feel right at home everything you needed. The area is beautiful and peaceful and before I book the place Rachael help me by telling what I can do in the area and what I expect when I come. Definitely recommend to other place 10/10

Tina is a great host, made me feel welcome! The place is very nice and has all the commodities. For such a central location I didn’t expect the place to be so cozy as well. I would definitely stay here again!
Ariana was an excellent host! She always responded very quickly. The flat is outstanding! It offers everything you need during a stay of any length. Highly recommended. I will return here next time.

Emre was a friendly and responsive host from the beginning of our booking months prior to our stay through the booking. He responded to all questions quickly and even permitted us to check in a bit early. The flat was meticulously clean, looked like the pictures, stocked as indicated, and quiet. The location was perfect. We loved the proximity to major sites and walked everywhere. The Lambeth bridge is a short walk to cross the Thames. Great restaurants to fun local pubs are all located nearby. We would recommend this flat highly and stay in it again. And, Emre was a wonderful host who made us feel welcome and was always accessible.

The location was great and the neighborhood is amazing with plenty to do within walking distance (restaurants, coffee, shopping and transit). We were greeted with flowers, fresh fruit and small snacks as described. The descriptions says lower ground floor, which technically is the basement level (we had to look up to the street), which was not what we expected. But the location made it worth it. The bed was also not king size (at least by U.S. standards),  more likely a queen. We, a couple both over 6 feet, had difficulty sleeping. Overall I recommend it for one person. I really don’t think you can beat its location.

Even though we visited after midnight, Anne told us in detail how to open the door in advance so we could easily get into the house. The bedding was very clean, and Anne turned on the heater in our room, which allowed me to stay comfortably. Thank you for providing two towels. I'm going to book Anne's house again next time I visit London.
Jose is very responsive and helpful, the room is clean, and the location is close from the station.
Jessie was a great host, very friendly and her place is lovely in a great location in Clapham!
Alexey is an incredibly responsive host! This spot was in the perfect location for our trip and we loved staying here!

A beautiful home, so like a home away from home. All amenities offered and well equiped.
Enjoyed our stay immensely and would recommend and like to stay again.

The flat was fantastic for a couple of nights! It was clean and in a great location, not too far from central London. The nearest tube station is 10/15 minutes away. Bernard offered us an early check-in, which is always a plus, and left snacks for us when we arrived.

We were a group of six. We had five wonderful nights on Oxford Street. Right in the heart of things yet once you enter the apartment, all is quiet and peaceful.
Everything was clean and spotless, very well equipped kitchen.
We highly recommend this to anyone wanting a buzzy time in London.

Spacious studio apartment (by London standards!) on the top floor. Unfortunately we were both unwell during our London stay so we felt fortunate to stay in a spacious apartment with lots of good UberEats options nearby. Great views of the fireworks on New Year's Eve!
Stay was okay but service was good. Instant replies and support. Place is little bit smaller than the expected.

Rosario’s place has been the best amongst the places I’ve stayed so far. I wish all Air BnB are like hers. Rosario is the best host I’ve ever met. She and Rafael made me feel like I’m in my parent’s house. It felt like I’m with my family as the host made me feel like I’m family. I definitely would love to stay with them again and would highly recommend it. On a side note: if you prefer a hotel like situation then Rosario’s place may not be for you, but if you want the real feeling of a home away from home, then I would highly recommend Rosario’s place. Thanks Rosario and Rafael!

We liked our stay in London! The area was very nice and walkable, and the apartment was clean. Definitely was much smaller that the pictures portrayed, however. It was pretty expensive for the space. The laundry was also a process. We did our own, but it took multiple cycles to dry our clothes. But overall, a solid stay at Concepts place.

It was wonderful to stay for 9 nights at Sergio’s place with our 2 children.  Despite not being in the center of London, his place has easy access to the sightseeing sites by the excellent London public transportation system.  For us it was nice to come back “home” after a long sightseeing day — to rest in a quiet, clean, spacious place.  The restaurants of shoreditch and islington are easily accessible, and Sergio’s kitchen with everything you need to cook a meal at home.

Andrea's house was just perfect for our family holidays in London. Nice and cozy place, quiet location with easy access to transport to get to the centre. We had everything that we needed and Andrea was very responsive and helpful. We would gladly stay here again.

Amazing, nice and helpful.
I stayed for about two days. I feel comfortable. It is noisy sometimes due to some kids and might be their relatives visiting. But it can be occasional. Overall nice. Thanks!
Great location and flat in Chelsea. I saw reviews about the noise but I live in NYC so familiar with this kind of noise level.

We had an emergency and had to stay one night away from home with a newborn. The host was so so so helpful, was flexible around the check in time, let us in early was incredibly helpful and kind!!
I am so grateful!! You rescued us in a very dire situation!

My stay here was fantastic! The location is very convenient, with easy access to transportation. The flat is neat and tidy with everything you need. Pooria is friendly and promptly addresses any issues.

Kar was a nice host. However the apartment was smaller than expected and not very clean. One accident occurred while I was getting ready and the door was locked from the inside. However the cleaning lady was able to access with her own key. We felt unsafe leaving our belongings in the apartment after that accident

Lynn could not have been more responsive. Although we could not check in early, she did let us leave our luggage at the flat while the housekeeper was working. The kitchen had all the supplies you would need to make a nice meal. It is a comfortable flat with a lift to assist you.

Perfect apartment to stay in right by London bridge station and underneath the shard. This oartment was absolutely gorgeous inside and extremely clean. Directions for check in and checkout were clear and concise. Internet was fast and easy to connect to. Plenty of things to do within walking distance. Would absolutely stay here again.

Great location, close to buses, overground, and subway as well as lots to do. Street was decently quiet given how central it is and earplugs were provided. Would recommend bringing an eye mask as it can be bright in the room due to the city lights but the space was clean and exactly as described. Comfy bed, good sized room, great shower and great price!
this little flat was all we needed for a short stay, someplace to sleep, shower and cook simple meals. very close to good bus routes, and many little shops to fill any need.

Great apartment, I really enjoyed my stay, it was very clean and exactly as in pictures.
And the nighttime view over London is spectacular! Dhalia was very responsible and literally available 24/7! I definitely recommend staying at this place!
Great location and a large space. Somewhat noisy from traffic nearby. The apartment is in an OK state, but not more. The host is communicating well.
Federica was a great host and extremely helpful for us! It’s a great spacious place on a lovely street. Surrounding area is nice and the tube is extremely close to get anywhere in London.
Very well located near lots of restaurants and the theatres. Just what we needed for a short stay in London.

Absolutely lovely host and super understanding of some trouble I had with the Airbnb system. Place exactly as described, welcoming, and super close to the Excel where I was attending an event. Can't recommend the room more

My stay at Shlome's Airbnb was delightful! Shlome's communication was top-notch, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. She was always quick to respond and provided helpful information. The Airbnb itself was clean, cozy, and well-cared for, making me feel right at home. Shlome's warm hospitality and availability for any questions or needs added a special touch to my stay. I highly recommend Shlome as a host, and I'm grateful for her wonderful hospitality. Thanks, Shlome!

This place stood out when I was looking for a place to stay for a week in London and it proved to be a good choice.  Host was helpful arranging for early arrival and recommended a good dentist when we needed one.  Quiet building, quiet street, good location near Harrods and Hyde Park.

Pristine, comfortable, spacious, convenient, warm, beautiful, five star accommodation. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and miss watching the busy street activities through the lovely ceiling to floor front windows from the above shop aspect. I recommend and would be delighted to stay again.

Sebastian,
Was a great host and the home was perfect! He was extremely responsive and was available to answer any questions we had.
Will definitely be staying here again!
Another comfortable and peaceful stay at Bipin’s place. Highly recommended for its peaceful setting with close proximity to the station. Bipin is a very helpful and responsive host.
The place was nice but the mattress was very uncomfortable, I could feel the springs of the mattress on me. It was not soft. It was like I was sleeping on the springs.

Lovely stay, really beautiful set up and comfortable working space. So convenient and easy to get to places. The only downside is the noise from the main road but apart from that it was a get nice stay.

We had a good time, and were very kindly hosted by Ruth. The apartment was clean and generally well equipped. It's good to know that there is no dining table or any chairs in the kitchen-living room.
London was very cold during our stay, and the pre-programmed heating system made it somewhat difficult to keep the house warm.

Tina was an amazing host. She was so responsive and friendly, and always checked in to make sure I had what I needed. The space was very clean and had everything I needed. I strongly recommend this place, as its location is amazing and its host is the nicest!
Very central location (just a bit noisy furing the night, but this is London!). Clean pretty cosy flat. Everything was good and Yassin was very available. Totally reccommend it.

The place was exactly as described and had all the basic amenities. Check-in and check-out were very seamless. Jahed (house manager) was very friendly, helpful, and accommodating. The orientation on how everything worked around the house was very clear. Kamal was very responsive whenever I had questions and was quick to help me out when I had to change my booking within my stay. Area was good and quite accessible to public transport. Felt safe in the area and in my room, despite it being a flatshare and not knowing my housemates. Kitchen (especially cutlery, glasses, plates, etc) could be cleaner though (but I think this is more on the part of the other guests).
Lovely apartment in a great location. Although there were initial issues with the heating, it was sorted straight away. Highly recommend this comfortable & modern apartment for a stay in London.

Five stars isn't enough to describe our experience of Isabelle's wondeful acommodation and hospitality.
​We had a lovely stay.
​I hope 2024 Isabelle will recover soon and get better and better.🥰🥰🥰

-The instruction to get inside was very clear and helpful
-The room was lovely and just looked same as the pictures
-The shower pressure was bit weak and it probably because of the water leak
-Couldn't heat up the oven
This is an amazing flat in a terrific location, safe and lots to do in a really nice neighborhood, very easy access everywhere. Highly recommended!
Great location, cosy apartment, great host, very easy to connect with. Thank you for everything we had a great time !

We really enjoyed our stay in Deni's apartment, great place, great host. It was so comfortable, everything worked smoothly and even exceeded our expectations.
We can absolutely recommend the apartment and will definitely come back on our next trip to London!

What can I say? Perfect, lovely spot. Exactly as pictured. Great location. And Matthew and his team responded so quickly and professionally to questions (mine) and issues (mine) that arose! I was really impressed. When I return to London, I will definitely stay here again.
The flat was pristine, cosy and located very close to the station. Check-in was also flexible, thank you Katherin for our comfortable stay!!

Great stay, excellent location next to London Bridge train station. Lots of restaurants and shops in the area. The real plus was being a 5 minute walk to the Thames River and the Queens walk. Excellent walking area between the London Bridge and Tower Bridge. Borough Market, one of the best markets I have ever been to is a 10 minute walk.

I would highly recommend this flat over any hotel. You’ll get far more for less money. I was not there for Shabbat but could see things were well set up for a Shabbat stay. There was also a proper kosher kitchen with two sinks and supplies. Nice shower too. Bernard was also a pleasure to deal with.

Van's apartment is simply excellent- located in a classic London row house, the apartment has been updated with high quality finishes and fixtures including a beautiful kitchen with everything you'd need including a washer and dryer. The ceilings are high, windows large, the space is light and bright and the queen size bed very comfortable. It is well equipped in every way.
The tech is also great with fast wifi and access to all of the movie and TV apps in the TV.
Though in the heart of the very active Camden neighborhood the street is quiet and residential, yet only two blocks to all of that action, including the Camden Town Tube station making it very easy to get around.
Van is very responsive and focused on the guest experience. I would recommend this fine place to any guest who is looking for a home away from home.

It’s a nice and clean flat with comfortable walking distance to Underground and bus stops. 2 independent rooms are spacious. Everything is good except 2 wall lamps blink all the time. James and his team have fast responses to our questions.

Perfect stay after leaving a previously disgusting place at short notice. Justyna accepted my booking at very short notice. The place was immaculate and very high spec all round. Despite being on a busy road the property is well set back from the road and well insulated so no noise at all. Highly recommended

Victoria’s place is easy to locate, quiet and in a safe neighborhood, close to public transportation and restaurants. There are also shopping areas within walking distance. The house itself is as shown in the photos and it met my needs. Victoria was also very responsive and she was kind enough to allow me check out late. There’s nothing to fault about this space.

an awesome flat in a great location! Richard was a great host offering suggestions of places to visit, and was very responsive to any questions we had during the stay. would definitely visit again and recommend to others. rooftop is a nice place to hangout as well
The location was perfect, right in the centre of Camden, pub next door was very noisy, but it was fine because we were up partying too!
Natalia was super helpful and very easy to work with. Everything was as described and she provides all the stuff you need for your stay - and the wine is a great touch!
This stay was amazing. It was so close to the tube and had a bunch of restaurants and pubs around. Completely clean and felt like home. Would definitely stay here again if going back to London.

We had a wonderful stay. It felt like home away from home, in a lovely suburb within walking distance of three tube stations. Plenty of shops for buying groceries and many restaurants and coffee shops to choose from. The decor inside was modern and the linen fresh. Would definitely stay here again.

We’ve been to literally hundreds of AirBnB places within a dozen or so countries but we’ll definitely remember Paolo’s place very fondly.
Great location, clean, really quiet, equiped with all necessary amenities and also a good price considering the area (ultra-central London).
Will definitely come again!
Great stay! Location was about 12 mins from the metro, but not an issue. Plenty of buses nearby as well.
It was a great stay and extremely close to everything in Canary Wharf. Pretty far from Central London.

Great place in a perfect location. Calm street but close to cafes, pubs , restaurants, train station  and the tube to easily and fat get to everywhere. Raphael answers fast any question ( even if I had asked before and had an answer:)

Sebastian’s place is a beautiful gem. A fully equipped house, literally everything that i need is available with the property. With access to several nearby bus stops and Earl Courts tube station, access to anywhere in London was easy. Walking distance to Stamford Bridge if you’re a Chelsea fan. Highly recommended place for 4-6 pax group.

Absolutely fab studio. Beautifully done and everything you could possibly need thought of. Great location only minutes from restaurants , pubs and shops and a short walk to the stadium.
We will definitely stay again when we get rugby tickets.
Many, many thanks to you both.

The house is super clean and the location is superb. The only problem was there was no towel rack in the main bathroom as it got broken from the previous guests as per Lynn. Lynn is also a super hostess and v responsive. Shall definitely stay thr again

The apartment looks exactly like the pictures. Very close to the tube at Bethnal Green, and loads of great places to eat on the same street.
Yassine was nice, communicated well from the start, introducing himself when we happened to pass each other on the landing. Check in was really easy and instructions were clear / simple. Would use again if staying in the area.
Great location !! A lot of nice African & Middle Eastern markets and restaurants !! thanks for the stay had a great time !!

Lovely location and easily walkable! Less than a 5min walk to the underground station.

Hosts were very accommodating for a early check in, allowing us to store our bags.

Only thing worth noting is walls are quite thin, and easy to hear neighbouring airbnb stayers.
A lovely, stylish pied-a-terre, very handy for the museums and Kings Road. We’d stay here again.

Good location, can walk to Waterloo, Borough and Southwark. Even has bus 344 right in front to liverpool station.
Apartment good size. Has cigarette odour, I think coming from outside. If you have sensitive nose may be irritating.
The bed is not good, can feel the spring and sinking on the left side. Can sleep but not comfy
