Richard’s place is as described. A spacious retreat in London. Beds were comfortable and water was hot. It is close to the Tube and a variety of great restaurants and coffee shops. Would recommend a stay with Richard.

We very much enjoyed our stay in London! The flat was easy to find and the location was in close proximity to the Piccadilly and district lines making getting it a breeze to get around. Highly recommend!
It was a great stay in Tam’s house during our visit in London. The room is very clean and warm like own home, the transition is easy, and Tam is soooo nice!

The house itself is beautifully decorated, blending modern amenities with charming touches that reflect the character of London. The living space is spacious and well-lit, providing a perfect retreat after a day of exploring the city.
One of the highlights was the location. Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, it’s just a short walk from public transport, allowing easy access to all the major attractions. I particularly enjoyed the nearby cafes, which added to the overall charm of the area.
The bedroom was comfortable and cozy, ensuring a restful night’s sleep.
Perfect location and beautiful room with private en suite bathroom. My husband and I would definitely stay again!
We loved our stay in Hackney! James was a great host and was extremely responsive / helpful. The place was perfectly located and easy to access, and was extremely clean. Could not recommend more.

I had an excellent stay at this Airbnb in Kingston! The location is perfect, with everything you need just a short walk away. The apartment itself was exactly as described, fully equipped with all the essentials, and impeccably clean upon arrival. Terence was a fantastic host, very accommodating and kind, even allowing us to check in early when requested. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to stay in Kingston!

Amrita’s place was perfect location when my folks were visiting London. Right where we wanted to be. Check in was easy, no fuss. The flat was spotless just like the photos. Had everything my parents needed. They were very comfortable during their stay. Thanks Amrita.
Jadin is one of the best Airbnb host i have met. really wonderful chap and loves to engage in conversations.

Abi is a great host. The place is so amazing and beautifully decorated and everything is nearby. Abi is very proactive and very friendly. We enjoyed our stay. It’s like a home. Highly recommended this place. We will come again.

Lyisha's place was wonderful and Lyisha herself was an amazing host; she was friendly and very responsive and check-in was
very easy! The room itself was very tidy with a lovely sofa and a large bed. Her place was in a great location, on a quiet street but still a short walk to Romford station. I would recommend her place to anyone who wants to stay in Romford or in London generally.

We recently enjoyed a delightful stay in this apartment located in a historic building. It's surrounded by lovely cafes and is within walking distance of two tube stations. The apartment was clean and included a washer/dryer combo, which was  super convenient. The owner was very responsive and helpful. I recommend this charming spot for a great city experience! Thanks for a wonderful stay!
Beautiful home, excellent area and easy check in. James was so helpful and communicative, he left clear instructions and a lovely card. Would definitely recommend

The house was super clean and host was very friendly and responsive. My mom loved the place and how clean it was so it tells it really was very good. About the area if you are Indian then just 2 stops from here in East Ham you will find a mini India and lots of Indian restaurants which are cheap and good.

Stella is the warmest host I’ve met here. She was extremely helpful and accommodating.
The place was clean and peaceful.
We had a great stay at a cute, modern, trendy flat in Shoreditch. Mael was very proactive, responsive and a the flat was very clean and cozy. Would definitely stay there again!
Kelly’s place was perfect!! Great area - lots to do! easy instructions, flexible check in, it was the perfect stay!

Inga was a wonderful host. We felt right at home! Her place is walkable to lots of cafes and restaurants, an easy Uber ride into downtown London, and easy access to Heathrow. Would definitely stay here again!

This is a nice place that is worth the money.
Pros: great location, very clean, simple check in
Cons: other guests (room next door) tried to enter our room two nights in a row, middle of the night. I don't think the hosts can do much for it, maybe leave a night lamp in the hallway.

Such an amazing host ! Amrita was such a lovely and welcoming host. We extended our stay by another night and she was so accommodating and sweet. She answered quite quickly. The house has such homely feel , it is very spacious. It has a lot of utilities and equipment you may want. It’s so peaceful and calming. I would 100% recommend this place !!

Isobel was a great host who had great suggestions of places to visit. She was warm and friendly and made us feel more like we were visiting an old friend rather than a stranger. The bedroom was immaculate with soft linens, nice decor, and a comfortable mattress. The bathroom was spotless and the breakfast with her homemade jams and fresh fruit salad was delicious. We highly recommend staying with her and we will do so again in the future.

Amazing bnb! Very central and very close to the tube stations. Loads of things to do in the house and outside. Pool, table tennis and hot tub kept me and my friends busy on a rainy day. Very beautiful and artistic place. Loved everything about it! Richard was very responsive and helpful. Will be visiting again :)

Very nice apartment in Isle of Dogs, London: enough space for 4 people (best for 2 adults and 2 children), only 50 mt from Crossharbour DLR station and 5/7 min walk from South Quay area with shops and restaurants. Tesco supermarket just on the other side of the street. During our stay, we never cooked in the apartment but it seems to be well equipped. Kind, reactive e easy-to-contact host. Super recommended!

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The location couldn't be better—just a short walk to the underground and very close to London Bridge.
The abundance of restaurant options nearby and the proximity to Borough Market made it even more enjoyable.
The place itself was beautiful, with a well-thought-out design and plenty of space for luggage. The bathroom was modern and well-equipped.
Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely look to stay here again!

The location is very convenient, near the train station, a couple of streets away from the beautiful St. Paul’s Cathedral, Paul (a delightful bakery) and Ivy Asia (delicious and beautiful restaurant with a fabulous view of the dome of St. Paul’s), walkable to many top must see attractions and close to Uber boat docks to get you east and west on the Thames.  Very artsy apartment and we would definitely stay there again. Safe and secure building and great communication from the host.

The Airbnb was in a quiet and upscale neighborhood. We did have to purchase toilet paper at the store as one roll wasn’t enough for 4 adults for 3 days. The shower is quite small.  We had a lovely stay and felt safe. We were walking around day and night. I would definitely recommend this unit.

Perfect, nice and very clean apartment on a excellent location. Couple minutes walk to tube station. Tina is very friendly and welcome me personally. Street noise and noise from upperfloor are negligible. But honestly Tina mentioned in her description. Thanks Tina for my great 4 night stay

I felt right at home. An easy check in, Lukas and his partner were extremely approachable and friendly which was exactly what I was looking for. The description matched what the space was.
If you’re looking for a place to stay with easy access to London City and Heathrow airport I strongly recommend staying with Lukas!

Good place next to bus stops and trains stations, also next to restaurants and grocery stores.
The studio is quite small, but enough for a short stay in London.

The accommodation was extremely spacious and clean and very well situated for easy commute. Several buses passed immediately infront of the flat. The bedrooms are downstairs, which I don’t think was mentioned in the description and posed to be a bit challenging while traveling with an infant. I would recommend and would stay again

We travelled as a family of 4 and stayed at this place 6-7 days. We had a good stay. The host was very responsive and helpful when we had questions. We didn’t know where the extra bedding stuff was. The host took picture and pointed out where they were stored. We had question how the washer/dryer combo works. Same fast response. Thank you

Bernard’s flat was excellent in all ways. It was great for our family to be in Golders Green and getting to central London by public transit is very easy. Bernard is a perfect host ensuring we had a great stay. I would highly recommend this Airbnb and would stay again if visiting London!

The location could not be more central. Yet, the appartement is quiet and you can have privacy. I agree with the other guests, there is a ventilation and it's pretty cold. It didn't bother me too much, but you should be prepared. Personally I prefer that than mold on the walls 🙂
I recommend that place and would come back again.

Loved staying in this super cute loft and would absolutely recommend to anyone I know going to London. We stayed both here and in an even more central London location and I would say this area was better as still close to everything but much quieter neighbourhood.
Max and Billie were extremely friendly hosts and were easy to contact and had solutions to any problems we had :)
Great stay and great host. The accomodation was clean and very new and sleek inside. With a backyard space aswell. Enjoyed the apartment and would reccommend

I loved the house. The house was 7 minutes walking distance to the Vue Cinema, and close to ASDA, and Becontree station was within easy walking distance. A nice area to simply walk around in, the house being on a quiet street.
The room was spacious, with a comfortable bed, a desk to work on and the people in the building respected each others privacy, and were quiet etc.
The internet speed was good.
All in all I would certainly stay there again, and recommend

We had a great stay! Extremely comfortable beds with room to sleep 3 easily. Jaharul was extremely helpful throughout the whole trip and always responded to questions with lightning speed. He was flexible with us and allowed us early check in since our flights landed so early in the morning. The whole flat is stocked with whatever supplies you may need for cooking, cleaning, eating, hanging clothes, etc. The bathroom sink is very small but it worked out okay. Overall, we had a great stay and definitely enjoyed the flat! I recommend staying here especially if you like living in quieter areas. Thank you!

My stay at Antonio’s place was just perfect! 5 stars all the way around! I stayed 5 weeks. The public transportation was excellent near his place. Easy to get to and from the airport. Antonio was very responsive and helpful. The price was extremely affordable compared to other places in the area. Walking distance to grocery store & restaurants. Short train ride to Greenwich Park. Super convenient having the washer and dryer in the unit. Bed was comfortable. Best part was that it was near the train. Antonio is an excellent host and excellent communicator. Would definitely recommend this place to others. I cook a lot so having the full kitchen was perfect!
Thank you, Antonio!
Sincerely,
Frankie Churchill
The perfect place to explore Notting Hill and the surroundings. Very central and we enjoyed our days there.

Lynn saved my family and me when I had to quickly leave a horrible Airbnb unit that I had previously booked that was not at all true to its descriptions. Lynn’s unit was a God-send, and I felt so lucky that when I searched for an alternative, hers came up in my search and my family and I were able to secure renting the unit within no time. Lynn’s unit was amazing and met the true definition of luxury. Clean, tastefully-decorated and well-organized; I couldn’t be more pleased. The immediate neighborhood surrounding is amazing: lots of amazing restaurants, an 8 minute, scenic walk to PureGym, nail salons, grocery stores, gift shops, etc. couldn’t ask for a better location. So grateful to have found the unit at such a time of need, and I look forward to returning to either it or another of Lynn’s properties in the future. I HIGHLY recommend.
Had a great weekend stay at Kar’s Airbnb, great place and location! Would recommend and Kar is very helpful.

I took a leap of faith to use an Air B N B internationally.  The place and host were so great, helpful and the location made me feel part of UK. I walked everywhere and it was easy to navigate. The place was peaceful, quiet and amazing. I hope to return next year!
All good at Jadin’s place - had everything I needed, and he was a friendly, courteous and unobtrusive host

Terrific location, esp if you're flying into Gatwick and want a convenient base in the City next to the train station so it was super easy to get to/from airport (our goal). Close to Borough Market and Tower Bridge. Finishes are newer, was nice to spread out in a 3BR apt for the price of a hotel room. A little noisy next to train station, but honestly didn't notice it and trains quiet down and stop overnight - the location was worth it. Good restaurants nearby and beautiful along the River a block away.
A little tricky accessing the unit but great instructions with video were provided and we accessed no problem. Highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment in the center of notting hill! highly recommended. Usman is an exceptional person and very helpful!
The host was very responsive and so helpful. The location of the place is perfect and can’t recommend this place enough.
This flat is incredible, the location is very helpful to be around London and you have everything you could need on the flat. The sofa bed is very comfy.
We had an amazing time at Paolo’s! The location couldn’t have been better and Paolo was a communicative and accommodating host. We would absolutely stay here again if we are back in London.
Tess was an amazing host. She was very caring and made sure we had everything we needed. I wish I lived in this space in my everyday life. Amazing Airbnb and lovely host

Schlome was an amazing host, super responsive, accommodating, and communicative!
We were a family of three and a family of four (both with young children) visiting London for the first time. The space was suitable for all of us, but might be a bit snug for eight adults. It was as pictured on the listing - close to convenient stores, markets, restaurants, cafes and most importantly, transportation. Multiple buses take you to various parts of the city, although depending on your final destination might require multiple transfers.
We would recommend this place for those considering!
The location is central, great, easy access. It was easy to check in. Apartment is well equipped and quiet. Would love to come back. Thank you!
A home away from home. tv selection poor. Otherwise a great house, location, the assistant host was great

Staying near LHR before a flight can be a challenge in terms of price, location and facilities, but we never had to worry about any of those things. The room was delightful, clean and had everything we needed. The location was close to the airport which is almost a city in itself, however it is a very peaceful location and we slept very well. James is a friendly and knowledgeable host who made us welcome and was ready to direct us when there were roadworks making our route to get there slightly different. All in all we enjoyed our stay and would recommend it. Thanks.

good host and decent apartment. should have payed more attention to the listing, I took the 4 beds listed as a fact, the apartment has one queen and a pullout couch. The area is nice enough but the actual building is pretty rundown, sign is falling off the front and the last night we were there someone peed in the elevator. One of the permanent residents said this happens often
This place and the team were a pleasure - fully kosher, complete privacy in a detached building, in Golders Green and one block from Hendon. Great location. Looking forward to our next visit B"H

What a find. Right in the middle of it all but also felt cozy. Ignore anyone complaining about the noise in other reviews - if you don’t want noise, don’t stay in Soho?! Even for a small studio it felt big and had a bathroom size that shocked me with how big it was. Tina was fantastic and even when we had a hot water issue (not the fault of the host) she sorted in out so quickly. Would stay again.

Lovely quiet area. The host was very helpful, warm and welcoming. The flat is extremely well kept making for a cozy and relaxing stay.
Would definitely recommend.
Exactly what we needed to your london. Great location, close to London Bridge station made travel very easy.

Anthony’s apartment is located in a quiet area with tree lined streets and parks very nearby. Shops, cafés and wine bars etc are only moments away as are tube and bus options.
It’s spacious with lots of light but also black blinds if you wish and it has all the amenities you could need.
Anthony was very helpful and accommodating and replied to messages in minutes.
I enjoyed my time here very much.
Michael’s place was just the relaxing experience I needed. The apartment is spacious and clean and in a lovely quiet area. I highly recommend!
We loved our stay at Ben’s place. The home is beautiful, well maintained, and quaint. Ben was a great host and very communicative. Highly recommend!

Nice Flat in Chelsea. Well located in this area.
How has been good to communicate with.
The apartment was small, was more in South Ken than in Chelsea, was somewhat bland (not really an AibnB) and the attention to detail could have been better
Great location and great house! The apartment has everything you need and it is very close to the Tube and buses. Monica was quick to respond and very helpful.

Everything within perfect distance - we are a family of 5 (3 children or 5, 7, and 15) - this choice is perfect for friends or family - the location is exactly where you want it to be - and it is very clean, tidy and everything works perfectly.
Thank you for making it easy

We enjoyed our stay very much. The neighborhood has good pubs and it’s very walkable. The apartment is clean and comfortable. One bedroom had quite a bit of street noise at night but otherwise the bedrooms were comfortable. The hosts were very communicative.
Clean and cozy accommodation, you feel like at home and the view is spectacular. A big hug to Barbara and Richard, maybe we will see each other again soon!

I only stayed one night but was very happy with Cara’s place. Whilst I didn’t get to meet her, I was given clear instructions on finding the building and how to get the keys and gain access. The flat is just lovely. The view across the Thames, the cable cars and the Canary Wharf area are stunning. I went to see Peter Kaye at the O2 and it was literally 10 mins walk from Cara’s flat. I can definitely recommend this listing. I would not hesitate to stay here again if I was in this area. Thank you Cara.
Very good stay, only downside being the cleaning fee, but otherwise a very good location in central London with everything you’d need to live comfortably for a few days!
Frank was delightful to talk to and was such a gracious host! He was very flexible and was able to accommodate for changes during my booking. Would stay here again!

Richard and Kris communicated clearly about the check-in process and were adaptable when my plan changed at short notice. They were helpful in arranging a parking permit.
The house is in a very quiet street in a lovely area close to all the amenities in Greenwich and Blackheath.
The room is spacious, clean and bright with great views across the Thames to the impressive Canary Wharf skyline.
Would definitely book here again if I’m back in the area.
Nice and cozy. The room is quite small but it has everything you need. Exceptionally clean and located in a quiet area. Good value for money

Excellent spot in the heart of London - clean, cozy and comfortable.  Alexey made sure we had everything we needed and was very thoughtful and responsive with info.  I would definitely stay here again!

Super communicative host, it was an absolute delight to stay at their place which had all the amenities. The location was also very convenient and was well connected to the public transport. 100% recommend.

The location can’t beat, everything is within walking distance. Check-in was easy and George was great. It’s a small space but has everything you need, I will say the comfort level of the bed left much to be desired but it’s fine for a short stay

Jan is the perfect host, super friendly, professional and kind. All I needed was a room but instead I got a 5 star luxury stay. Jan made me feel right at home her place is amazing, everything was spotless and clean, her house and garden is absolutely beautiful. The area is peaceful, clean, beautiful and is the embodiment of community. If ever I need somewhere to stay for work or just a getaway to relax and enjoy the beauty of the UK, I will most definitely stay at Jan’s home again. I booked what was listed as a small room with a double bed, but what I got was a very big room that was absolutely beautiful in design and comfort. I recommend Jan’s home 100%. What a beautiful experience I had and am so grateful to Jan. Jan, thank you so much, what a lovely lady and host you are.
Amazing spot to stay! Felt right at home during my move in periods, free parking, easily accessed

the place was what you expected, the host was nice and friendly, however the radiator was dusty and the cutlery washed but had old stains. A big issue was that there were constant banging noices for us that really creeped us out through the night that continued untill 1 am and few screams and fence bumbs, but the host is not to blame but the isulation or other people staying there were, so potentially we just got unlucky with them not realising the isulation is not fairly good.

It was a perfect place to stay for two nights! Very central location to the tube and restaurants.
Very clean and very responsive hosts! Would definitely recommend

This was my first stay in the Chelsea Harbour area of London & I was absolutely delighted.  The unit looks better than it does in photos & is absolutely pristine. The Harbour is a beautiful neighborhood to explore; I enjoyed the path along the north side of the Thames that led all the way to Central London.

From the moment I booked Anne was warm and friendly and very helpful. I will definitely be returning to stay. The bed by the window was abit of London magic. The bookcase full of wonderful books. Very homely

George was very helpful when we arrived to give us a little tour and point out some places in the neighbourhood. The location was great for our visit and the place had everything we needed. The only downside we had was that the bed was not very comfortable and we used the couch (which pulls out to a bed) to sleep on instead.

Place was fabulous! Perfect for our party of 6. Conveniently located to transportation, grocery and pubs. Short train/tube ride to all of London's attractions. Hosts were super responsive to any questions we had. Hosts also provided one of the most comprehensive Guidebook. Would definitely rent again.
Thank you Anton and Kevin.

David’s place is extremely comfortable, very well equipped and in an amazing location. It was also peaceful and quiet. David was very responsive and checked in with us to make sure we had arrived and accessed the property with no problems. Would be very happy to stay here again!

I spent a couple of nights at Cara’s place for work purposes. The location was ideal. The area felt very safe (I was working late). Cara was very accommodating given the unsociable hours I was coming and going. The room is functional and very comfortable.

Although the place is small it was very nice to stay here. Very convenient to walk to most anywhere and close to multiple Underground’s. George was so very helpful at check in and check out. Allowed us to drop luggage early and held on to it after check out. I would definitely recommend this place.

Absolutely delightful stay at Frank's. Located in a peaceful neighbourhood, this beautiful house makes for a soul calming stay where you are surrounded by nature. The trees and plants climb all over the place adding a very fresh touch to the already beautiful surroundings. A collection of artefacts collected over a very fulfilling lifetime I assume dot the interiors each with its own story. The shelves are lined with books and the garden is as inviting as it looks in the pictures. Above all frank made sure that I always had what I needed and was always there to entertain my thoughts on life!!

Keagon’s place was well located in East London and easily accessible by both train and bus stops. Keagon and has partner were proactive communicating with the us and were seamless and quick communication wise. The house is spacious inside and had all the amenities listed - included a dryer which is a bit of a rarity in the UK. The only negatives we found is the bathrooms could have been cleaner and there were no paper towels and no closet or dresser to put clothes in, ultimately, none were a big deal for us as we were only there for 3 days and all else was positive and we enjoyed our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at the flat. It was spotlessly clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed for our long stay. The location is also very convenient, with easy access to both the bus stop and underground station nearby. I’d definitely stay here again on my next visit to London!

Lovely place to stay looks new inside.
Room is a good size have a desk/ chair and wardrobe
Great host made things easy and no stress.
Great location to local shops/cafes/supermarket as well as busses.
I recommend.
We had a wonderful stay for our mum's 70th birthday. Everything was perfect and communication beforehand was great. Highly recommend!

We had another perfect stay at Megan’s flat right on the edge of Hampstead Heath. The apartment is well equipped for longer stays, it’s somewhere you can feel right at home. You can’t beat the location - right on the Heath, with everything you could need right on the doorstep. Megan and her team are super-helpful, respond quickly to emails and generally go out of their way to make your stay as enjoyable and stress-free as possible.

We stayed at Paolo place this weekend and we had a great time. The place was very central and actually quite considering the location. It was perfect for 2 people. George was on hand , even for our earlier arrival that was pre arranged.
There was everything needed for a comfortable stay - especially some tea bags which were most welcome. There is a Tesco at the bottom of the road which is extremely handy.
I will be staying here again - locality is great

Host was very helpful. We found ourselves with no place to stay as the works on our house were delayed. He helped us making the room available for us last minute. The room was very clean, seconds from Leyton station and with lots of shops bars and restaurants. We had a couple of questions and the host responded very quickly. The room had amenities including hair dryer and iron, which was greatly appreciated. We recommend this room to anyone that needs accommodation close to stratford (1 stop) and even for central London.
A beautiful, organized, and clean house with an artistic touch, where Alex was very helpful with any inquiries.

Great home
Clean
Comfortable beds
Great local cafes and supermarkets
Train stations close by
HD everything for a great stay

We had a great stay at this flat. It was easy to find and very centrally located, 5 min walk to all the shops and cafes in Clapham (and a supermarket), and 3 min walk to the tube. Only a 10-20 minute tube trip into London's main attractions. The flat itself was gorgeous, well-decorated and maintained and very clean. Comfortable living area, well-stocked kitchen, and a peaceful neighbourhood. Can't wait to visit again!
Would stay again, the location was very close to the Tube.  Safe neighborhood and clean accommodations.

Perfect location on Oxford Street, super close to the Elizabeth Line.  Very spacious and clean apartment with quiet rooms.  The check-in and out process was easy and Gio responded quickly to any questions we had.   Overall, we’re happy we staid here.
I like it when you feel the love of the host. For its home but also the guest.
It was great place to stay and was very central to the City of London and just near my London office.

The apartment was a great size, and had a wonderful deck and view! We arrived late and had trouble getting the keys, but Dahlia responded quick and solved any issues! A nice host and a good place away from the bustle of downtown London!

Such a pleasure to stay at Shanes place. It far exceeded the images on the website. Nice simple, well designed spotless place. Quality appliances, furniture and linens. Fabulous bathroom. Quiet lovely street, with easy access to many great restaurants. Close to tubes and buses. Jedidias even met us and helped us with our heavy luggage at check in, and was so lovely and responsive immediately to any questions. Would definitely stay again and highly reccomend

Apartment is in an excellent location  and was an easy and nice place to stay. Well setup and clean was a great option for our time in London. Host was super helpful and easy to work with. Highly recommend it.

Great location, clean, airy apartment
Patrick and Katie were helpful
Would recommend!

Thank you for a wonderful stay!! we had a very comfortable and easygoing time. Michael and kelli were very friendly and gave clear easy instructions, we had everything we  needed and the flat is a very clean and cosy space. it was great to be able to have the back doors open onto the garden. easy transport links right outside the door and easy to walk to nearby shops! Thank you so much!
Great flat with a beautiful view. Clear instructions, it was easy to check in and check out. We really enjoyed our stay and hope to come back again one day. Thank you!

This was a lovely place to stay. Hosts were responsive and helpful. We were in London for a wedding and they were flexible on check in times so we had time to get ready. The studio is lovely, very clean and with everything we needed. We really appreciated the breakfast, milk and juice. It was a shame we were only there for a flying visited, would have liked to have stayed longer.
Beautiful, spacious room. The people at the reception were incredibly sweet. Nice that the gym is included. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

We had an amazing stay at this beautiful apartment. Justyna was very kind and welcoming. We truly enjoyed our time here and would love to come back again. We highly recommend staying at her place!
Best,
Shira
We enjoyed staying at Monica's place. Communication was easy and the tube station not far. We loved the opportunity to start the day in the beautiful private garden.
Enjoyed our stay. Was able to walk to multiple places. It was easy to find and they let us drop off our bags early. Would recommend.

I had a wonderful weekend in Shoreditch staying at Mael’s flat. I thought the space was accurately represented in the photos, and I loved the vibe. Great big windows offering lots of light, and great rustic floors. Comfy bed, chairs, and sofa too. The hosts were very communicative and helpful with everything and it was a seamless experience. The neighborhood is a bit young, but I knew that going in so it was fine for me. But I was delighted with the place, hosts were great, and everything was as advertised. I’d happily return.

Noticeable smell when you walk in.  Bathrooms smelled bad.  Low water pressure so no one could shower.  Host would not give us the code to check in until 10 minutes before check in.  We had to go to a market to pick up keys which was a block away from the airbnb.

The bedroom and the bathroom were clean. The only little thing was that once we arrived we were left alone, not knowing where was the bathroom, so we didn't know which door to open but appart from that Geoff answered quickly and our stay was lovely !
Jaqua home was beautiful was so clean and Tidy. She was so helpful when we needed help with a few things. She was very responsive. Will be definitely be coming back for another visit 😊

This is a beautiful spot and was perfect for what we needed. The apartment is brand new with very modern amenities and details. It is definitely tucked in to a residential area and we had to use electric bikes to get around as there isn’t a whole lot in the immediate vicinity.  E-bikes can easily be found around the neighborhood. There is a very cute little backyard that is shared by immediate neighbors. Unfortunately, we didn’t use the space as there was a lot of dog poop. Would recommend this spot if you are looking for a quiet retreat for two!  Thank you, Rosemary!
Great location, good sized room, very clean and easy check in. Perfect for stays between work days. 100% recommended.

The apartment is one floor up. The two bedrooms are decent sized for central London. There was body wash missing in one of the bathrooms and I felt some of the glassware was a tad bit spartan. The apartment is right across the street from a Tesco Express spot which has early morning loading activity. Be warned if you have your windows open. I use a white noise machine and so, it wasn’t that big a deal. Having said that, I take nothing away from the place. On a good day, the outside space can be a great expansion to the main living area. Very secure building and Elena was very responsive to our requests and updates. The location itself is unbeatable. We walked to the major tourist spots and restaurants. I’d recommend it to others to stay.
Pawel was an excellent host. This place is easily accessible. I had a wonderful stay and will surely stay here in my next visit. Thanks Pawel for the flexible checkout time you offered!

We enjoyed our week's stay in Camden. The spot made great use of a London apartment's limited space, and we slept 6 people without any trouble. We especially enjoyed having a balcony as well as plenty of space and supplies in the kitchen for a few home-cooked meals. When a couple of minor concerns came up throughout the trip, the hosts were prompt, helpful, and considerate in their replies. We always felt like we had a cozy home-from-home to come back to at the end of our long days. Thanks for a great stay!

What a charming and perfect spot for our family vacation in London!  Jennifer’s place provided a quiet and restful location after sightseeing all day.  It’s comfortable, well-appointed, and beautifully decorated.  We hope to be back someday!
the place is very clean and spacious I stayed with a family of 5 and we felt right at home. It’s modern and practical. Highly recommend Sam’s listings. Great value!
Very comfy, great location - easy to multiple tube stations and buses, and to sights. Hosts were great.

The area is quiet with a few pubs and restaurants.  At the end of the street is a convenient grocery store and across from that is a fun Pub: The Ship.  The tube is easy walking distance and China Town, Piccadilly Circus are also within easy walking distance.

Host went above and beyond to provide extra things you don’t normally get like tea and coffee and milk and bread, small gestures that made it feel homely. My only concern was that as a single female traveling alone I felt a little vulnerable walking home late at night from the station but once inside everything was perfect

I had a lovely stay with Inge in Hammersmith. The house is gorgeous, the kitchen is exactly what you need and the rooms are clean and comfy. Bedroom is closed to the main road so ear plugs are a must! Inge is very kind and has loads of great stories to share.

Very good location, and perfectly big enough for 3-4 adults although an armchair would be a useful addition to the lounge.
All in all I would certainly recommend the apartment as a good place to stay

Great location! A little hard if travelling with seniors as there’s a set of stairs to access the unit also the lack of washroom upstairs is inconvenient but otherwise great spot and Simran was very responsive! Thank you
It was a very nice stay with Tina, accomodation as described and reflecting the photos. Besides Tina is very kind, approachable and always willing to help👍🙏
Great apartment in a great location and accommodated our group of five perfectly. Would definitely stay there again.
We had a great time at Deb's place. The location is really central but because there's no traffic directly outside it is super quiet at night so you get a great night sleep :)

Lovely place, in a very cool neighbourhood!
We spent 4 nights with three kids and everyone was super happy. Harriet was very kind and helpfull.
Loved the two level apartment, with large windows and great views.  Very clean and modern layout, with lots of space to spread out. Well equipped kitchen.

Evelyn is a wonderful person with a beautiful home that she keeps spotless. I felt at ease from the moment I arrived, Evelyn offered me a cup of tea and we instantly had a very deep conversation as if we had known each other from another life. The room is exactly as described, comfy bed with clean and crisp sheets, lovely fluffy towels, all the amenities. Will happily return, thank you and all the best!
The stay was awesome, I would not recommend the neighbourhood for women staying there alone. Gary was really helpful, accommodating and a nice host for our Aribnb. Would recommend.

The accommodation was beautiful and peaceful. Very close to the station too. The hosts greeted me with kindness and went above and beyond offering me food in the fridge such as milk eggs juice yogurt and fruits as well as having shampoo and conditioner. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality.

A lovely unique studio in a peaceful area of London. The place looks just like the photos. I absolutely loved the decor and I felt really at home staying here! Would highly recommend having breakfast out on the balcony and enjoying the view in this pretty area of London. Billie and Max are great hosts who go above and beyond to make sure you have a good stay. Hope to stay here again someday!

Robert was very informative and responsive. Provided lots of information prior to checking in. Made check in very smooth. location was great! Just a few blocks away from the tube & train station and the closest bus station is just across the street. Area is pretty central so could definitely walk if you wanted to, too.
Things to note: the listing did say there’s a washer/dryer but there is only a washer with a drying rack. But that was perfectly fine for us and the drying racks were enough to lay out a good size load of laundry. The apartment is also on the top floor of the building with no elevator so keep in mind for anyone with physical disabilities.
There were a few broken fixtures upon arrival but nothing that affected our stay. Overall was a good place to stay for our 3 night stay in London:)

We had a very enjoyable 4 night stay at Victoria’s. The building is beautiful and quiet and the lovely flat is perfect for 2; cozy, nicely decorated, well stocked and clean. The bed is very comfortable. Victoria was easy to communicate with and always responded quickly. We found this to be a great location; convenient for walking to local shops and restaurants and close to two subway stops. We would not hesitate to book Victoria’s flat again.

This apartment was a great spot for our two night trip to London.  It’s definitely a budget option, it’s a pretty barebones space and there’s some things that could use a little TLC. That said it had most everything we needed and was fine for our short stay.  Showering is a bit challenging but doable if you’re flexible or have someone who can help. The location is great. It’s a little loud due to the street outside but not a problem with earplugs.

I had a great stay at Pawel’s place. He was able to accommodate me at short notice (the day before), and was flexible about check in. The room matched the description exactly, and was very comfortable for my three-night stay. It’s a 10-15 minute walk to Bermondsey tube station, which was convenient enough for me. Pawel’s communication was great throughout — he was very friendly and all of the instructions provided were clear and thorough. I’d be more than happy to stay here again!
Olivia’s place was just perfect for our family of 3 teens and 2 adults travelling from Australia. Close to transport links and everything we needed to explore. Highly recommend a stay here!
I really enjoyed my stay here. Beautiful apartment, located blocks from all the restaurants, pubs and shops. Super easy access to the tube. An AMAZING bathtub
Great stay, just outside the main hub of London, very quiet area. very accommodating, would recommend to others.

3 Cozy and clean room, close to Elizabeth line, walk 15 minutes or 2 stops by 2 public bus, easy access. Town house is next to a small garden, fresh air. Jason is a nice host. If it is a big family travel together, this is a good place to stay.

Other than the negligence in cleanliness, and some other minor things, the apartment itself is quite decent. The shower was great. The air conditioner was very functional and easy to operate. However, I would probably stay somewhere closer to the tube since this was at 10-15m away

The home was just perfect for our stay in Enfield. While still close to the hustle and bustle of Enfield Town it was so peaceful and quiet. We had a really great 6 days there and even travelling to Central London was a breeze being so close to 2 railway stations.
The home itself was just wonderful, full of charm and just how Ben described it in the listing. The 5 of us were very comfortable in the 3 bedrooms and having 3 bathrooms also made life just that little bit easier.
Ben is an exceptional host, always responding promptly and so very helpful.
I would highly recommend this home for a peaceful and restful stay in Enfield.
Thanks so much Ben for hosting us, we really enjoyed it.

Only stayed a night, but it was definitely one of my best airbnb experiences. Everything was exactly as described and photographed. Loved the location - peaceful, but not too far from the local spots, and easy to access the transport links. I had a few queries and Hannah responded in a timely manner every time.
Great place to stay in London. Close to everything and super walkable. George was very helpful and had great recommendations. Would definitely stay here again!

The location is great and probably one of the safest in London. The room matches the descriptions, and is comfortable and cozy. Tina is an excellent host and very friendly and communicative. Although my stay is short, I had a great time.
A perfect stay with a perfect host. Thoroughly enjoyed the conversation. Couldn’t have been more helpful and welcoming. Highly recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay here in Covent Garden. It was perfectly located for all of our adventures in London.

Alexi hosted my sister and her family for a short-notice trip to Hackney - and they loved staying at Alexi's flat! It is ideally located to explore Dalston and Stoke Newington, with its many cafés, restaurants, and bars. The flat itself is beatiful, very cosy, just a great place to stay in! Alexi was an excellent host, very easy to communicate with, and super helpful. Highly recommended!

Great host, shower wasn't very good. Water temp and pressure erratic.
The laminate flooring had a protruding nail/ screw at the edging where the kitchen was which is in a high traffic area

Sarin's place is good if you are planning to sleep at the apartment after exploring the city all day since it is small. The apartment met our expectations. The location is perfect, very close to the underground.

Great place, very clean and lovely neighborhood.
Also, Mick was a welcoming host, we will definitely come back to him.

This was our third time staying at Anne’s place and we once again had a fantastic stay.  Anne’s place is warm and cozy and Anne is the perfect host - very welcoming and friendly with great suggestions for how to get around London, what to see and where to eat.
Love this place. The best apartment and what an awesome area. There are so many food places and bars. Great set up and fun for the whole family. Will be back again.
We enjoyed our stay at Hazel´s home. She was so friendly. If we come back to London we´ll try to stay at Hazel´s for sure. Thanks for 3 nice days.

The host was proactive, responsive and very personable!
The property is in adjacent to some great parks for your morning runs!
This quiet residential area was the perfect location in central London for all the sightseeing.

I had really good time during my stay at Jelena’s home. She was so friendly and all her instructions were clear enough.
I hope to be back and enjoy as much as I did during my previous stay. Thank you so much.

It was a good stay - the place is value for money and great location. The studio is exactly as described and it is walkable distance from Hendon Central tube.
There was slight issue with the noise from neighboring rooms - you can hear TV clearly and in some cases even the talks.
Mo's place is clean tidy and  well stocked with items you need for a stay. very accessible location. I would stay again

We had an amazing stay at Daria’s place! The apartment was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect, close to great restaurants and public transport, but still in a quiet area for a peaceful night’s rest. Daria was super responsive and made check-in a breeze. I would highly recommend staying here and will definitely book again when I’m back in the area. Thanks for a fantastic experience!

The check-in guidelines were thoroughly detailed, and Herman's prompt responsiveness made the entire check-in process seamless.
The property has three rooms, and the one provided to us matched the picture shown on Airbnb.
The room was exceptionally clean, and the view from it was stunning.
20-minute walk from Canary Wharf Underground Station.
Just a 2-minute walk to Tesco, the bus stop, and a variety of shops.

There is no doubt it's an excellent place to stay and the location is superb. Easy access to both the tube (London underground) and buses.
Two caveats. First, be aware you need to go up at least three flights of narrow, steep stairs to get to the apartment. Second, unfortunately the wifi is weak and not dependable. Despite communicating this to the owner and her intents on addressing the situation, it did not improve much. Not the place to stay if you need to do online work, unfortunately.
The building has three washing machines, so they are always available. Using them as a drier is complex. Need to watch a YouTube video, and even then not too effective. There are clothing drier contraptions that can be used instead.
Enjoyed the coffee machine with an ample supply of coffee pods.
Great grocery shopping just across the street at M&S.
Well suited for three guests.

Great apartment with all the necessities that we needed for our trip. Close to tube station and shops, pubs and takeaways. Kinga (the host) was lovely - Very efficient and made sure that all information for check in/out was clear.

Great single room flat in an amazing location in London, around the corner from a tube station that Services Piccadilly, district and central lines. Unit is best for a single person or a couple on a short stay who plans on being out and about during the day.

I don’t regret choosing Al and Faiza’s place at all. It was as worth every penny. The hosts are really nice and receptive. The apartment is also nice and pristine. Very decent and quiet neighbourhood as well. The walk to the train station was good considering I hadn’t been exercising for sometime. In all I’ll rate it 5 because  we enjoyed our stay. Will recommend on any day
Stayed in Londen for three days, we absolutely loved our stay at this apartment. The perfect spot in the city, would definitely recommend it to others. Thank you so much for our great stay!
Thank you Adam for your flexibility in check in, the nice touches you included when we arrived, and overall a nice experience in London!

When I booked James’s flat, it was a few days until my trip. There were no reviews, but I took the chance and booked the flat anyway. My previous Airbnb host actually cancelled my stay and I was devastated and scrambling to find somewhere to stay. I am so happy that happened because otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to stay here. James’s flat was clean, convenient to the Highbury/Islington station, many shops and restaurants, all while being very peaceful. The flat was safe, clean, comfortable, and quiet which we appreciated. It made our stay very lovely. The flat is the top floor (4th) and has no lift. If that is something that you require, then you might not like walking up four floors . The flat had everything that we needed, even an umbrella and phone charger. The stay was perfect and I could not ask for more. Thank you James for the best stay in London, I hope to be back soon.

Great location, though can be a bit of a walk with luggage depending on which tube station you start from. Quiet, clean and comfortable apartment. George and Paolo very responsive in the lead up and during our stay. Really appreciated the ability to leave luggage after check-out. Quirky washing machine which we needed help with every time. Note shower is slow to drain, but we managed to avoid flooding the bathroom.

Monica was always friendly and responsive. Because of nearby family, this location is perfect for us. Visitors who want easy access to multiple areas of greater London - as well as a neighborhood experience, will also appreciate this flat.

Jelena is a really friendly person, always helpful and available for any questions. I felt right at home! As I wasn’t feeling well, she let me check out a little later and for that I’m really grateful 🙏
All in all Jelena’s place is a great value for money place, clean and equipped with everything you might need. I fully recommend it!
Thank you for everything Jelena! ☺️

The flat is good located in Kentish town with plenty of shops and bars. It was everything very clean and well organised.
We booked it for our family, 5 people, and felt rather small.
The bedrooms are orientated towards the main road and over the weekend can be very noisy.
The flats below where also rented, and unlucky the people where very noisy!
The agency who rent it out worked out very well though!

We were drawn to Tracy's place because of its quirky, charming and characterful appearance. And the location: in an interesting district, but so close to a tube station and no distance into central London. But with its quirky retro appearance I'd not expected it to be quite so comfortable and easy as a living space. The kitchen looks so gorgeously "vintage" but behind the scenes there's everything you need for modern day.
Tracy has thought of everything - the beds are super comfortable, the sitting room is lovely, the kitchen's great (and generously supplied with tea and coffee) and the bathroom is lovely, with a super shower, and a lovely big wash hand basin. It felt so welcoming and home-like, and staying there was a big highlight of our long weekend in London. Tracy's communication with us made everything go very smoothly. I'd definitely stay again, thank you so much Tracy.

Not only was the room and bathroom perfect for our stay, but Tam was a wonderful host! We loved our cozy space for the weekend and were able to easily get around the entire city from the airbnb. I highly recommend staying with Tam!

I highly recommend this place, we felt right at home! The house was clean, bright and airy and was much more spacious than we anticipated, plenty of space for our family of 5 to stretch out using the lovely garden and the upstairs terrace area. The infant package was very useful which included a high chair and travel cot etc. Host was accommodating and recommended a few local coffee shops and restaurants to go to. We enjoyed exploring the area, visiting the parks, used the local amenities and easy access into central London via the underground. We will definitely stay there again when visiting London.

The place is everything you need for yourself and guest max. Right in the middle of Fitzrovia and close to soho. Very clean. Asian grocery mart across the street. Apartment right in the mix of everything. Neighborhood is amazing as well. Make sure you register on the links they send you because check in info is on there
So close to the metro! It was perfect for a close place to our friend’s wedding. Clean and as described, has everything you need for a peaceful stay.
Location is great. Matthew was a superb host. Plenty of things to do in neighborhood. Highly recommend the unit if you like shopping, bars, restaurants, etc… Notting Hill is the best.

Sam’s place was amazing. It was spacious and accommodating all 6 of us. It was clean and looked exactly like the pictures said. The location in its self was amazing. Steps away from Pubs and restaurants and only a short walk to the tube. Would definitely stay again and recommend anyone staying in London to stay here.
We had a great stay here in London. The apartment was very spacious, nice central location directly next to St Mary's Cathedral, and checkin/checkout was a breeze. Would definitely stay again!

The house is gorgeous, and so close to the palace! Our co-host Andy was there to check us in, showed us all around the house, and was friendly and welcoming! We were also able to check in early/drop off our luggage since we were arriving from another city.  The bathrooms were great, and we loved the luxury rain shower head and the towel warmer/heater! Finally, we especially appreciated having bedrooms for all of our kids and an office where one of us could stay up late/get up early to get work done, or have a quiet reading area. Would definitely stay here again!
Really nice room/house, super easy to get to London Heathrow airport. Nice little work space in the room. Would definitely recommend

A nice warm welcome by the lovely Jonathan & Denise. Suite was perfect for one and just a short walk away from the AELTC.
Thank you
Perfect host, very fast on messages. Apartment is well positionned and although I did not use it so much during the day times, incredible view over O2, Docklands, the thames river

The apartment is in the heart of Nottinghill. Restaurants, pubs, shopping and more within a 10 minute walk. The beautiful living area allowed our group to enjoy each others company at the end of the day. The bathrooms are clean with great rain showers.
It is about a 10 minute walk to the tube and 7 minutes to nearest bus stop.
We would stay here again!

Terrific spot in London. Easy and quick access to the tube station. Lovely accommodations. Flat has everything you need. Host Monica was very responsive, and helped sort out a glitch that was in no way her fault very quickly. Great neighbourhood. Would definitely stay again.

We had a great stay! Isadora gave helpful instructions on how to get in and recommendations for surrounding area. Walking distance to Brick Lane/Spitalfields Market: two of our favorite spots in London. The apartment had what we needed and was clean/safe.

My wife and I visited Richmond/London to enjoy the history, beauty, and walkability. This was the perfect place. Rosie was an awesome host. She was easy to communicate with, had great recommendations, and the place was perfect for our needs. We will be back, and will definitely stay here again. Highly recommend it!
Great place to stay nearby a lovely Battersea park. Anne was very helpful! Highly recommend to stay at Anne’s
we had a fantastic stay, the place lived up to our expectations. The location is perfect, close to the underground station, supermarkets and restaurants.

Very nice and super clean house in Golders Green. Perfect for families with a lot of restaurants in the area. Lots of kosher eateries and shops. The host is proactive and very nice. We loved our stay there. Thank you.
Always happy to stay here with Herman, it works well for my overnight commutes to Canary Wharf.

I loved staying at Van’s place.   The best part is how walkable it is and how it’s in the heart of Camden town.  The only current drawback is that there is constant construction next door, which makes for noisy mornings, however it’s worth it for the location and big bright beautiful energy in the house.   Highly recommended spot!  I’ll be back for sure.
Great host, welcoming and friendly.  House is in pristine condition, spotless with everything needed, bedroom comfortable and quiet. great stay.

Anthony was a great host, when a problem arose even in the early hours of the morning. He was quick to fix the problem & offer assistance. Overall had a great stay, I would recommend staying at his place.
The flat was lovely and comfortable.  It was very quiet.  She was friendly and very responsive with her communication. Thank you Tamara!

This studio flat was clean and the location worked for us. It is a noisy area, however, the neighbours were very quiet. It is single glazed windows and the trainline is very close, along with sirens and busy road. We managed to sleep through it. The flat has everything you need so would stay here again if we were visiting the area.
Well positioned property. Good short stay accommodation well priced for central London. Host comms excellent. Great Mediterranean restaurant called The Hill close to house, highly recommended.

We had a great experience at Richard’s place. He was a great host and the flat was exactly as described. Lots to do nearby. Quick walk to Liverpool Street station (and others) for direct access to many different parts of the city.
Host was very helpful and accommodating.  Good location in Ealing, can walk to many restaurants and the tube.  Nice having a local pub next door.  The house handled 6 adults well.  Would come again.

Staying at Andrea’s was a great pleasure! Andrea was super responsive, friendly, and flexible. Her place is clean & tidy and the room was very comfortable. The location of her house was amazingly convenient since I was in London to see a concert at the O2 Arena, which is only one station away from Canning Town (nearby station to her place). Andrea helped make my weekend visit super easy, so I could fully enjoy my time there. Thank you Andrea!

Loved staying at the studio on the bottom floor with a mini patio. The room is for only 2 people for a reason. Others mention it is small but it is incredibly functional.
Everything is well thought out for a small space. The kitchen is brand new as well as the bathroom. Everything was spotless. The best part of our stay was being welcomed by George who lives on the premises. He showed us how to use everything, and even made a lovely local lunch suggestion. George is a star!
I would most certainly book at Paolo’s flat again!
Thanks for having us.

Max & Boola's were AWESOME.  They were the best hosts I've ever had! They treated you like friends and gave so much help and info.  Their place was amazing, but so were they!  This airbnb was everything we wanted. Windows and views!  Clean and comfortable. Close to everything. We walked all over London!  The sunsets were gorgeous from this apartment!  The windows are very noise cancelling at night when you are ready to sleep after a full day of adventure! Can't say enough good things!

Great, nice place. It’s just a few minutes from the Underground and bus station. Marks & Spencer is a few minutes from the apartment. The apartment is nice and clean and is suitable for two, a maximum of three people. We used the apartment just for sleeping. Just one thing I want to mention is that the double bed is a little small at 120×180 cm. Overall, it’s a nice apartment that is not far from Queens Park. It’s easy to get to all London attractions and museums by Underground. Thank you very much, Gareth, for recommending it to me.
such a nice place to stay and thanks for keeping the suitcases for extra hours after checking out. Prompt response and noting to blame!! Have a wonderful stay here
Great place and awesome host. Plenty of room for 2 people and clean. Only negative. There was some noise outside at night.
This was a great place to stay just moments from the Upper Street shops and restaurants. Very quick responses from the team and an impeccable apartment. We'd definitely recommend it.

This studio was perfect to end a 2 month trip! It had all the amenities that were much needed; a full kitchen, hot shower and a washer and dryer and I mean a dryer that most Americans are used to. The place was perfectly described, small but yet functional and felt completely safe as a solo female traveler. Paulo & George were great at rescheduling my visit and was always responsive! I would definitely stay here again!

Second time staying at Jadin’s. Would recommend to anyone to book with him. Clean, neat, and extremely convenient location. Easy access to the DLR, walking distance to grocery stores and restaurants. Thank you always for such a comfy stay! x
Great apartment with a lovely view! Very close to the station. Nice and clean would definitely stay here again! Thanks Bedirhan can’t wait to book again.

The flat was very clean and exactly as advertised. Shlome was responsive and informative. The area was nice, my family felt comfortable walking around. Could we hear the trains? Yes. Did it bother us? Not at all. Will come again.
Bed was uncomfy, walls were dirty. It was almost perfect just focus on cleaning the details like the walls, the dishes, make sure the sheets are completely clean.
Just a few niggles, no internal rubbish bins, fire alarm went off , no chopping board, but otherwise very comfortable

The place is well decorated,  fully equipped and kept very clean.  Conveniently located near the bus stop.   Robin was very responsive and helpful.   Would definitely stay again  for any future trip if available.

Good experience overall. Some furnitures could use overhaul. Unable to open window in the living room / kitchen.
The host was very kind and helpful.
Great host, very welcoming and clear communication. The house is spotless, and the room is very comfortable.

I was absolutely delighted with this place to stay! Beautiful interior, sink inside the room, quiet neighbours, good shopping centre nearby and close to parks and Notting Hill. The room, bathroom and kitchen are very clean and were a pleasure to be in.
Julia was always quick to respond to messages.
Highly recommended!
Great place to stay in London! Easy access to the tube and felt safe and secure. Lots of space inside for each guest. Would definitely stay again!

The location of this quiet mews is perfect. There is a great pub just down the block and easy access to trains, kensington high street, groceries, etc. The house itself was great space for the area and quiet at night. Felt very cozy and homey.

We very much enjoyed staying in Ben’s house. It was warm and comfortable, and had everything we needed. The garden was lovely too! It was a short walk to shops and cafes and was easy to find our way about.
We were in London for a family wedding and had to bake a few items for after the church service. Ben was very helpful regarding what facilities the house had, and we found the kitchen was great for what we needed. The oven was easy to use and Ben had lots of baking things!
There are lots of books in Ben’s house and we all spent time perusing them, and the lovely furniture and fittings. It was great to learn about the history of the house and the street. I recommend the book about Gentlemen’s Row.
In my Dad’s words ‘I love this house’!
Had a fantastic stay at Simon and Zuzanas, a really lovely mini apartment. A lot of thought was put into the decor and ambience. Will definetely stay again.
Richard's place is amazing. Great location right in the middle of everything Shoreditch has to offer. I would highly recommend this place for your Shoreditch stay!
It was an excellent flat just on the outskirts of london. Plenty of great restaurants to go to and the tube was within a walkable distance.

Thanks Tim for the wonderful stay, the morning walks on the canal were lovely and tube stations were very conveniently located. Tim was very responsive and answered all my questions promptly. Would absolutely recommend this place to people trying to get away for a City  weekend . Cheers

Wonderful stay in very clean apartment, newly furnished. Some more dishes/cuttlery would be handy because there is no dishwasher (minor thing)..Easy access to public transport, neighborhood „so/so..“.
Very happy with Carlos‘ super quick communication, thank you!

We loved our stay. Perfect for our family with two little ones. The washing machine and dryer so helpful after travelling for a couple of weeks. The apartment is just stunning. The kitchen very nicely equipped. There was a cot and highchair provided free of charge which was appreciated. Communication was so easy the whole process. Very very happy and would not hesitate in booking again.
I had a great stay for nearly a month – everything was comfortable and well-kept. Nina, the host, is very responsive and nice. Would definitely come back!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Mick’s place .
The apartment was great for us as we needed a longer stay whilst we waited for a completion on a sale .
The house is perfectly located and the finish of the flat is top quality with all mod cons including soundproofing .
The flat is super clean and modern
The check in was a seamless experience .
Communication was excellent .
Highly recommend
Highly recommended, cozy and clean place. Transportation to Central London is convenient. 10/10 would recommend.

Lovely and cozy flat, corresponds to photos. This is a modern lived in home, with well supplied kitchen and all the household amentities you need for a short or longer stay making for a true airbnb experience.
Quite location with the small front garden giving onto canal. Good transport links into central London from Barking station with district/central and Hammersmith and city lines. Great choice of local grocery shopping with large Tesco and Asda within 5 to 10 minute walk. Confortable double bedroom and bed/sofa in lounge area. Place was immaculately clean. Would highly recommend.

Beautifully appointed flat in a great location. Close to Ealing Common tube station for quick access into the city, Ealing Broadway and Westfield London.
Everything was as described and per the photos.
Other than that, I'd highly recommend Elsa's place to friends and family and I look forward to staying again on another visit to London.

I thoroughly enjoyed the couple of weeks I spent here. The place was large and comfortable and had everything I needed. It was just a few minute work to public transportation and easy to get around. I would definitely stay again if I am back in the area.

The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and was very clean. The location is close to lots of restaurants and is super accessible by bus and tube. Tay and Ma are super nice and were very helpful!! My friends and I loved staying here.
Tina’s apartment was nice, clean and at the great location! She was kind, flexible and answered my text very quickly so it helped a lot. Thank you very much!

Cute place tucked away from main London streets so it’s quiet and peaceful. Loved the minimal aesthetic, it’s perfect to get some work done and has the set up for it too (standing desk, extra monitors, ergo chair). Location is excellent as it’s in a fun and vibrant neighbourhood so you’re not short of things to do. Great communication and flexibility from hosts too which I really appreciated.

Great flat. Super well located/connected for all central london activities and with loads of nice coffee shops and restaurants around. Comfy beds, tea and coffee available so all in all perfect stay for a long weeked
We had such a perfect time at this venue. Comfy beds, homely feel (especially the fire place!) It was the perfect space for us to get together, connect and enjoy a cosy autumn day in London Town!
Absolutely faultless - lovely apartment, great location and we would definitely be happy to stay here again when visiting London in future.
Such an easy and lovely place to stay for the weekend, Tam made every effort for us to feel comfortable and relaxed. Great local recommendations, we’ll definitely be back. Beautiful stay.
We loved the place! Very clean and spacious.The area is very quiet and really close to the underground tubes. I would definitely book this place again 😊

Amazing location to visit SOHO.
Place is quiet even if it's central London.

I can’t think of a better base of operations for exploring the city than this place.
Incredibly easy access to local public transport as well as national international railways. Walking distance to grocery stores and shopping, this place really does have it all and I feel extremely lucky that we were able to spend as much time here as we did.

The room was clean and comfortable.
Andrea was quick in responding to my questions.
The location of the house was nice. It's great for those attending ExCel.

We spent a wonderful week at Peter’s place, and from the moment we arrived, it felt like coming home. Peter greeted us warmly, giving us a tour of the space and promptly responding to any questions we had. The location was peaceful yet conveniently close to lively streets with supermarkets, bakeries, and restaurants. The metro and bus stops were only two blocks away, making it easy to explore. We would have happily stayed even longer! Thank you for hosting us, Peter.
Best wishes,
Jeroen, Nicolle, and Nanne (1.5 years old)

Great location and easily accessible for all popular spots in London. Flat was clean, well stocked, well furnished and cozy. Alexey was responsive and helpful for the entire duration of our stay. Highly recommended for all guests looking to stay in central London

Victoria’s place was perfect for me and my husband to spend a week running around London together. It is close to two different tube stations so it was easy to get anywhere in London. Between Sloane Square and South Kensington there’s plenty of food, drinks and shopping. We enjoyed every minute. Highly recommend.

I had a great time at Antony’s flat. The views from the living room are fantastic!
Tube is nearby, the flat is nicely decorated, and everything worked smoothly…
We had a great time in London and had a perfect stay in Tam’s beautiful apartment. Thanks a lot :)

Fabulous light and spacious apartment- and warm and cozy on a November night. There is everything you need here for a comfortable stay in a great location- local park and canal side walk both 5 minutes walk away. Old street tube station is 10 minute walk away so travelling around the city is easy and efficient. There are lovely cafes nearby for brunch/ coffee. Local convenience shops. Free weekend parking. Really helpful  host - thoroughly recommend

Just home from a weekend at Fazile's home. This stay was the best experience, lovely home, exactly as in the photos. Fazile was extremely helpful and allowed us an early check in and held our luggage on the day we were leaving. The house is a five minute walk to the tube station so everywhere in London is accessible. I would highly recommend staying in Fazile's home and we will be booking the next time we return 🙂

Great spot. Close to most of the attractions where we only had to walk places, but it is also close to the Elizabeth station which made getting to and from places much easier.
Very spacious room and even had a small kitchen. Communication was fast and easy. Would definitely stay here again.

Loved this place. Was between two subway stations so depending on where we went we would take different trains.  Very comfortable place.  Had lots in the kitchen …pots and pans and such.  Enjoyed our stay

DLR is close by and therefore the apartment is noisy. Canapé lit when is turned into bed doesn’t stick together and is worn-out. Seamless for the bed’s mattress. Being in the ground floor, all windows are matt and no direct light entering. Otherwise, very handy location and well connected.

One of the best Airbnb experience I’ve had - I really enjoyed my 3 days staying at Julia. The room (house) is very cozy but moreover absolutely clean (including the bathroom and kitchen) - they really do take care. You have everything you need and I really valued that everything is silent and you have total privacy. It’s super well connected (tube, overground and buses) and plenty of shops around the corner.
Thank you Julia (&family) !

Super clean, neat, and comfortable!
Accurate description and everything in place as described!
Would definitely recommend Concept for a
relaxed stay and will definitely chose to stay at one of them again!
We stayed for a night and enjoyed our stay. James was really responsive and friendly! The location was perfect for the airport but far from the city.
We loved our stay here, it was perfect and had everything we needed. We loved the space, location and overall experience. Highly recommend!!

Lovely stay with a very responsive host. All in all, stay went smoothly.
Good area but it’s worth mentioning that South Kensington tube station is a 15 minute walk away.
My family and I had a lovely stay here and the area is quite safe too. Would come again!

The website did not say that you were not allowed to be two people in one room.
It said that there was a maximum amount of two people allowed, but there one of us to pay extra which we had to do.
They said if we didn’t pay extra, my girlfriend had to leave and wouldn’t be welcome to stay.
The people in the house didn’t really speak English at all.
They were kind of unfriendly and not inviting at all.
No small talk, no smiles, nothing.
The only good thing was the price.

Brilliant studio in a private location.
worth the price.
Host was straight forward and kind.

Every detail was so well thought out. It was a pleasure to come back “home” each night and to relax a bit in the mornings. Parimo was very clear with communication and fast to respond. We loved the apartment which was so spacious, clean, modern. It was a real luxury for London.

I stayed one night at Cara's place for a performance at the O2.  It's a short and safe walking distance. Cara kept the home very clean and tidy. The bathroom was even better than a lot of budget hotel. I would highly recommend to my friends if they would like to stay near the O2 or the Greenwich area. Everything was exactly same as the descriptions and photos.

Highly recommended if you’re staying in London for  few days or longer and want to avoid hotels. Location is great, felt cozy and easy to settle. Shlome’s instructions are clear and she was always helpful when needed.

Gio was an incredible host! The location and place were amazing. The water went off in the whole building and Gio quickly communicated to us and fixed the situation. The only feedback I have is that I wish there were more key fobs for large groups traveling. Will definitely try and stay here again next time I’m in London!

Clear and early instructions, we felt well supported. The location is great. We stayed in shoreditch before then which was pretty loud, west end is the perfect mix of quiet and bustling. Lots to do and the place was a great space for us.

Natalia‘s place is perfectly positioned to facilitate easy walking access to most of the key attractions in London.
Practically in Leicester Square, and just around the corner from Trafalgar provides many restaurants and shopping.
Natalia was fantastic to work with and incredibly flexible and helpful!
I have traveled extensively and have rarely found such a well positioned property. Strongly recommend!

Great little apartment in a really central location. Check in was easier than we anticipated, with a pdf of instructions but it was all fine, and well described.
The host was super responsive and always came back on email straight away.
Will stay again!

Near station, organised room and quick response!!
One thing..code is complicated to enter..
But totally very good!!!

Justyna’s place is exceptional, finished to a very high standard, with high end appliances, everything you’d need in the kitchen to prepare any kind of meal. Quiet and peaceful, comfortable bed, I really can’t say enough positive things. I would definitely recommend, and will definitely be returning next time I’m working in the area.
Absolutely lovely
Great little studio, amazing location, we really enjoyed our stay! No frills but cute and perfect spot if you need a quiet place to sleep after a day out in London.
What an amazing location and Victoria was an awesome host.  Very responsive and accommodating.  Thanks, Victoria.

Great location in the center of Shoreditch! It was great for our party of 5, with plenty of room to hang out together or get away when needed. Richard was helpful and accommodating. We would stay again!

Great accommodation. Good sized bedrooms, lovely area, great host. Only negative was small size of kitchen/lounge area, fine for us as we were out & about but maybe a consideration if you’re spending time at accom.

My colleague had a fantastic stay with Tiffany and said the place was very clean & tidy and in a fantastic location for working at Twickenham Stadium. Tiffany was very helpful and communicated well in the lead up to the stay.

Perfect location, quick access to underground and buses, and beautiful neighbourhood. You have delicious breakfast/coffee/brunch options a few minutes around.
Tina is a kind host and everything you need to know is in the flat description.
Great value for money in this part of the city.

Firstly, Mr Hamza was a great host and proactive , all instructions were very clear and he was very helpful and responsive to all of our requirements. the place in great location and easy access to pupublic transportation and supermarket. plus the building itself has a plus side, the roof garden,
and it's exactly the same as the pictures.
thank you Mr Hamza for everything.

Our stay at Maylands was fantastic! The house is gorgeous and very spacious and clean :)
Everyone in our group was blown away by the space and how well equipped it was - even has it's own large bluetooth speaker!
Jaqua is a fabulous host and was extremely helpful and kind.

We had an amazing stay at an Airbnb in Notting Hill. The place was beautiful, and Mathew, our host, made the experience even better. He was incredibly welcoming and thoughtful, ensuring we had everything we needed. Highly recommend this spot for anyone visiting London!

Had a wonderful stay at this charming London Airbnb! The location was perfect, with easy access to everything I needed, and the host was welcoming and attentive.
