The flat’s location was amazing right in central London, just a 5-minute walk to Waterloo Station and close to so many restaurants, cafes, and attractions. We’d definitely love to stay here again.
Thanks for everything, Bonnie!

We had a great stay at Sofia’s house. It was exactly as described and perfect for a family of 6 adults with enough beds and room to relax . We also enjoyed the roof top terrace for breakfast . We didn’t actually spend a great deal of time in the house during the day as the weather was fabulous and we had so many  places to explore and get togethers to attend but these were all made so much easier due to the central location of the property and the ease of walking around the area.  The kitchen is a good size and well stocked but we mostly took advantage of the close proximity to some decent restaurants and pubs for meals. Highly recommended for either groups or families for a stylish , comfortable, convenient , quiet and secure place for a London stay.  We would happily stay here again during future London holidays. Thank you Sofia !

We had a fantastic two-night stay at this lovely new Airbnb listing in London with our family. The home was spotless, well-furnished, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing stay. It’s clear the host has put great care into creating a welcoming space.
The location was perfect — set in a quiet residential area with easy access to central London. The nearest Tube station was just a short walk away, making it incredibly convenient for exploring the city with children in tow. Despite being so well connected, the neighbourhood felt peaceful and safe, which we really appreciated.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay — from the initial booking to check-out. Communication was prompt and friendly, and they went out of their way to ensure we felt at home.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return. Highly recommend this property for families or anyone looking for a well-located and comfortable base in Lon

this was our first time in London and we felt like we won a jackpot. Location was the best in Lomdon. the bed was comfortable. and the host was very friendly dly and offered a lot of useful recs for us. I would definitely stay here again. Great place!
Amazing apartment in French style. Extremely beautiful and clean. Very nice location. Hosts are very helpful
Well situated apartment close to transport, restaurants and shops. Easy walk-in distance to Camden Markets which is great place to spend the day.
The host was super accommodating. The place was spotless and the location was amazing. We had a great stay.

Taylan's place was absolutely ideal for a short and sweet getaway . The room was exactly, if not, better than described and was within commutable distance from bigger parts of London. The bathroom was absolutely spotless, the kitchen was great and we felt right and home with how secure and private the room was. As hosts, Taylan were absolutely perfect and proactive. 5/5, I would definitely come back again in the future. Many thanks for the kindness and hospitality
Super cute studio apartment within walking distance to all the best Chelsea and beyond has to offer. Host was super responsive. I would definitely book again!

Beautiful apartment in an excellent location.
Michael and Kelli were great hosts. Very friendly and provided simple instructions to collect keys. Would definitely recommend
The place was nice and so was the host but the hot water was shut off for around a day and a half, that’s the only problem I had during my stay. Overall a great experience

We had a great stay at this London flat! We enjoyed the public transportation by bus and train. We were able to pack in the London sights and then relax comfortably in the flat at night. There's plenty of space to spread out. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed, including washer and dryer. Hannah communicated clearly and reliably. This location works well if you're willing to stay a little ways out from the city center. We recommend this flat for a fun family trip!
It’s a very nice cosy place - very convenient and clean. Bed was comfortable and reasonably quiet so slept well. Good place to stay in this area of London!
Excellent place to stay, I would no doubt stay here again!, Location allows for easy access to public transportation. Also very clean.

You are simply the best out of 30 plus places I have stayed at in and around London
Tip top I don't normally write reviews but you are 100% worth it ;-)
A great location for our trip to London, 1 minute from the tube and some nice little restaurants just round the corner. Clean and tidy and easy to find. Had everything we needed.

Jessie is nice, friendly, easy going.
Absolutely brilliant experience staying in her apartment.
Recommend👍

Tracy's Airbnb is fabulous. The best I have stayed in. The flat was so beautifully curated and full of interesting books that I didn't need to leave. Clean with really well appointed and equipped kitchen. Handy for cafes and the nearest tube station a 3 minute walk away. I will definitely come back again. Highly recommend.

The flat was really nice, clean and well located
Gina gave us detailed instructions, was flexible on the hours and even offered us a nice bottle
Thank you again 😉

Sandra was like a mother and friend in a strange land. She was very responsive and made me feel at home and welcomed. She was my guardian angel that God sent to make my visit worth the while and enjoyable. Her place is indeed somewhere to be.
The room is basement floor and near the street a little bit noise but acceptable. Other than that everything is good. The kitchen is really nice if you need to cook by yourself

We had a very pleasant stay overall. The building is modern, with great amenities and comfortable spaces for both work and relaxation. The room was stylish and well-equipped, though the layout around the bed area felt a bit cramped. The bed can be lifted to create additional space, which helped, although it would have been nice to have a table in the unit to eat/work from. All the equipment was high-end and up to date. A fan was provided but circulation wasn't great. Communication with the host was excellent, and the staff responded promptly to minor issues early on. The location is also convenient, about a 10–13 minute walk to either the Underground or Overground, with a large Sainsbury’s nearby. Would recommend as a great stay.

Great location in the heart of London with easy access to the tube. Very busy area and can get loud (which was mentioned in previous reviews but wasn’t awful for our stay). We stayed there with 4 people, but I would recommend 2 maximum. The sofa bed is like sleeping on a bag of rocks (straight springs on metal). Otherwise, great apartment for a quick stay in London!

Isadora and Federico are great hosts and always responded immediately to all requests.
The flat was very nice and clean. The location is also very good and everything is easily reachable by public transport.
We really enjoyed our stay in London.

That was a really lovely room.
I appreciate that Mariam and her co-host 's kindness.

So beautifully decorated, comfortable for our party of 6 with every amenity you could need. Superb location w two Tube stations and many pubs, restaurants, stores nearby. Sofia very responsive and helpful. Place was immaculate. Would stay again!
Great place to stay! Good room, excellent bed, bathroom very clean, it's just amazing. About the location, it's 20 minutes from the center, and the bus or tube is 5 or 10min walk

The only problem with this place is the bed. Its surface is extremely firm and there were only two slim pillows. I know this is personal preference, but I have to emphasize that this bed was the most uncomfortable bed I have slept on compared to all airbnbs and hotels in the past (and I love camping and am usually comfortable in most situations). This is subjective, however. So if you’re booking this place for aspects other than a comfortable night’s rest, then it’s probably perfect for you. For me, I only needed this place for sleeping since I was out all day, so that’s why the bed mattered most to me. Another aspect to note: we weren’t able to check-in until 6:30pm which was challenging since we had a wedding to attend. Great location and great host, it was just a tough night’s sleep for me.
Would recommend this accommodation to anybody who needs a very clean, comfortable place to stay. Will book again.
Great place to stay! In addition, George, whom welcomes you, is very friendly and provides many recommendations.

Great location !!
The family enjoyed the distribution of the rooms to be able to have privacy but also common areas to be together during the trip

Great location. Easy to get to tube but was a bit sketchy after dark. Had problems with the water heater being off. But was easily turned on by a switch. 3 bathrooms but one of them didn’t have a working shower. No A/C so we relied on opens windowed and fans to air the place out. Otherwise. It was comfortable. Local eateries were within walking dístance and stores.
Very close to the mall for restaurants and shopping, grocery store was also at the mall. very convenient
The apartment was very well location. Close to the subway station and in a nice peaceful, safe neighborhood. We loved our stay.

We had a wonderful 6 night stay at this centrally located flat. It is in a great location just a short walk to several pubs and tube station. The actual king size bedroom was a huge plus - very comfortable. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which made the experience even better.
We would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.
We stayed in Jacks flat whilst exhibiting at the Design Centre and absolutely loved it. Best Airbnb we’ve stayed in in the area, highly recommend.

Absolutely loved this place! It has amazing views of the entire city of London including a huge balcony to enjoy those views.
The apartment was spacious and easy to locate.
Sweets and fresh soaps were also a plus!
I definitely recommend this location, and I hope to stay there again!

This was a great find and perfect for our family trip. The apartment is conveniently located near two main bus stops, grocery stores, and even a pub. We had a great stay and the hosts were super flexible with check-in logistics and the apartment instructions were super comprehensive.

Absolutely lovely stay at this Airbnb that is beautifully decorated. We were in town to attend the Imperial College graduation and it was extremely walkable to the university and local restaurants. The Airbnb also had a cot and high chair that was perfect for our one year old daughter. The rooftop patio is beautiful as well! Thank you for accommodating an early bag drop off as well!

4th time I’ve stayed. Nice clean flat in superb location near Westbourne Grove, good pubs and coffee shops away from the bustle of Portobello Road but close enough by to wander over.
Comfortable bed and nice bathroom.
All in all a really good flat

I had the absolute pleasure of spending a month at this lovely Airbnb and I can't recommend it highly enough. From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The apartment was spotlessly clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully stocked with everything I needed for a comfortable long-term stay.
The location was perfect — nestled in a quiet, safe neighborhood but still just minutes away from public transport, cafes, and some of the city's top attractions. It made exploring London incredibly convenient.
The host was exceptional — friendly, responsive, and genuinely committed to ensuring I had a great experience. Any questions I had were answered promptly, and they went above and beyond to make me feel welcome.
Having a cozy, well-equipped space like this made such a difference during my time in London. It truly felt like a home away from home, and I’d absolutely stay here again on my next visit.

Wonderful host who couldn’t do enough during our stay.
The apartment itself is killer, amazing views and everything inside is pristine.
Couldn’t recommend this host and apartment enough.
Mrs Evelyn accommodating my requests and was very helpful and pleasant. I would recommend staying here for a clean and comfortable stay.
Very responsive hosts, they were very helpful and quick to respond with everything we needed.  Convenient location, very easy to get around.

We stayed for 6 days in early june.  Antonio's place did not disappoint.  Everything met our expectations.  The area is very quiet, yet convenient. The home was perfect for us.  For early summer, it felt very comfortable, we could open the windows and experienced the cool summer temperatures.  It's a place we will stay again if and when we come back to London.

Clark was very nice and helpful all the time. The apartment is beautiful, stunning views of the city, nice neighborhood, we could walk to different places and the train and underground were very close as well. Highly recommended!! Thanks Clark for your hospitality and kindness.

The apartment was amazing, very clean, the host was always responsive and supportive with any request we gave them. It is highly recommended as it is difficult to find a place as clean as this apartment and as well maintained as this apartment. Will definitely rebook the apartment in the future

The space was just what my family and I needed. We were in London for a wedding and this was a great spot for people to gather, eat together and get ready. The home is very spacious and the garden is beautiful if you're lucky with the weather! it's about a 15 min walk from the train station in a peaceful area. We would definitely stay again
Thank you Justyna for another fab stay and for being so accommodating on the last minute date amendment!
Perfect stay for a night or two - had everything you needed. Compact space but also felt spacious ! And only a 15 minute walk to the tube station , not far from shops etc.

We had a wonderful day at Yasmin’s flat! It was spacious, clean and decorated with a lovely European flare. Communication was clear and instructions were easy to follow. The hosts were very responsive. We had a group of six and had plenty of room for all of us. The proximity to Paddington Station was excellent as well! Highly recommend!
Catalina was a great host who was always quick to reply both before and after our arrival! Fresh flowers and cookies in the kitchen was an added touch!!
Great deal and a great location. It was very walkable and felt cozy and like home from the get go.
We loved staying at Hapinest! It was a perfect location, the space was tranquil and amazing. Definitely a wonderful stay in London thanks to Hapinest! 💚🙏💕

Stellar apartment with easy check in, very close to an underground stop, grocery stores, and park with a playground.  Some great cozy neighborhood pubs.  Extremely well furnished space with eclectic and engaging decor - my toddler loved the ladybugs and extensive collection of children's books!

A perfect place to stay if you are visiting London. Located a short walk from the nearest tube station (Ladbroke Grove), you can be in central London in no time.
The flat was very clean, and beautifully decorated and comfortable enough for 3 people to stay in.
We will stay there again on future visits to London.
This is a great little spot. The flat is beautiful, bed was really comfy and everything was spotless. We felt right at home, thanks for having us to stay.
Great apartment with everything we needed. Perfect location with main London tourist areas in walking distance. Vivian was a great host, communicated clearly and responded to any questions quickly.

The pros first: Great Location and decent amenities.  It’s a stone’s throw from Earl’s Court tube station and has a lot of nice restaurants around. However, the property has a decent amount of wear is need of a refurbishment. The lock wouldn’t open and we had to waste an entire day while the host was unresponsive and inconsiderate. We could not step out and risk being locked out with a toddler. We had to constantly follow up and not once did she even bother to apologise for the issue. The host also refuses to accept that the bathroom spout button was broken. It works but it’s broken. The property has seen better days and deserves a good refurb. Totally not worth the money.

A very private very safe and secure self-contained accommodation. Situated in a cul-de-sac so no passing by traffic 50 metres away to 2 bus stops which 10 minutes away away from Wimbledon main train station and underground.
A very up class area that’s tucked away from the hustle and bustle but close to it of you want it !
Jill was always available and very accommodating helpful and non-intrusive. In the future, I will for sure be using this Airbnb for my next town.

The place is exactly like advertised, the comunication was super clear.
Location can't be beaten, right in central london, easy to walk to several points and accessible with different subway lines. Several options of markets, restaurantes, cafes, pubs and everything you might need.
Paolo and George were great as hosts, readily available.

I had a very pleasant stay. The room was well-maintained and clean, and the bathroom was excellently equipped with everything you need and indeed spotless clean. The neighborhood is charming and quiet, with plenty of nice restaurants and cafés nearby. There’s a bus stop right in front of the house although no train station is within walking distance. It’s perfect for anyone looking for a peaceful area. I traveled alone and felt safe at all times.
Alessia is an incredibly kind and welcoming host: warm, helpful and easygoing. I felt completely at ease staying here!

Amazing house with so much character it’s almost talking! Beautifully done, cosy, funky, large spaces, amazing garden, good vibes. Frank is a rare type, intelligent, humble and so easy to connect with. I wish we had days just to chat. Thanks for sharing your unique space and energy:)

We had such a lovely stay at Emily’s place! The location in Peckham was amazing – there was so much to do in the area, and it was easy to get great food. We really enjoyed exploring the neighborhood.
The airbnb was just what we hoped for - comfortable, clean, and in a perfect spot to enjoy the city.
Emily was super thoughtful as she sent us a pair of sunglasses we accidentally left behind, which we really appreciated!
Overall, we were really happy with our stay and would definitely recommend this place

Excellent host ! Vey friendly, very accommodating and very helpful. It makes your stay more enjoyable and relaxed knowing your host is always there to help. Great area - walkable distance to everything.

Gio's apartment is perfect if you want to be in Central London.
It's incredibly well located yet quiet.
It's close to many cool neighborhoods and restaurants.
It's big and enjoyable, so one can unwind after a long and busy day of visits or shopping.
Lots of amenities and great communication from the host too.
++++ can't recommend enough.

Host was easy to get into contact with when requesting a fan. Great place to stay close to Central London without being fully immersed in the center. Wonderful opportunity to experience a lot of diverse cultures! We enjoyed our stay.
Excellent location for our needs, straight across from the O2 which we were visiting. Very well presented and helpful, friendly host. Highly recommend

The apartment is in a good condition, spacious and adequately equipped. It is a 15 minutes walk from the metro station which facilitated our transportation to the city centre. Olivia is very responsive. We recommend it.
Really nice place, incredibly flexible hosts. Location fairly good - generally walkable to nearby areas. Enjoyed the stay a lot!

The housekeeper lady is friendly and dom is very patient to help solve our issues. The apartment is lovely and in a good condition, also in a good location so we could find all kinds of restaurants nearby. Very happy stay for our London trip, highly recommend~

Great Location, Friendly, Host, Always available.
One pipe was clogged. They fixed it right away. Unfortunate but this happens.
Parimo was extremely responsive and attentive to all needs. Place was very comfortable, clean and in a convenient location.

We were really happy with our stay in London. Amazing communication from the hosts, proving recommendations and offering guidance when I needed to purchase products for my child. The location was great with easy access to public transport.

Cristina Rosella and Federica (and Bailey!) were the absolutely loveliest hosts. So warm and welcoming and friendly, I felt like I was part of the family. The room is comfortable, spacious and has everything you need and the location can’t be beat. But the generous, Italian hospitality and warmth is what I’ll always be most grateful for! :)

Nice accommodation, where my partner and I spent one night. It was spacious and matched the pictures. There was a problem with a boiler but Jade did all in her power to make it all work for us. I definitely recommend !
Cozy Hideaway. I really like how responsive the host was when a situation arosed and was quickly resolved . I would highly recommend this place.
Good location, only 6-7 min from the nearest tube station. Place was comfortable and clean but the walls were very thin, and you could hear a lot of noise between rooms and in the hallways.
The most perfect place to stay. Such a great energy in that apartment. It looks so good and it s so cozy. Highly recommend!

Matt's place is really spectacular. Centrally located to some of the best shopping and eating in London, with a host of amenities that really set it apart from most other airbnbs (the home theater setup in the bedroom is particularly special). The bed is pretty comfy, the kitchen well appointed, the heated bathroom floors were really nice.
One thing that I wasn't aware of until check in is the large construction site directly outside the bedroom window. There was lots of noise in the morning, but Matt was kind enough to reimburse me for the inconvenience.

Lovely spot for our trip to London! My mom and I enjoyed our stay in Jenny’s home.
Jenny so kindly let us check-in very early after an overnight flight, which was so appreciated. She met us at the unit and showed us around.
The apartment is located out of the hustle and bustle of the tourist areas but convenient to the bus and tube lines. The apartment was well-appointed and well equipped.

We had a wonderful stay here, one of the most beautiful Airbnbs we have ever stayed in! We loved how charming the area was and it was so easy to get around. Gordana was so accommodating, attentive and responsive and made sure we always had what we needed. We would love to stay here again someday!

Tracy was friendly and proactive in her communication and has created a cosy place for visitors in London. The accommodations is a perfect location and has everything you need. Thank you Tracy for creating a beautiful environment for your visitors. Would highly recommend Tracy's cosy apartment.

Mostly clean except for the bathroom. Bed was comfortable and it does what it says on the tin. However, it does not mention it is extremely close to a pub which I believe will be noisy up until closing time.

I've been using Airbnb for a long time and this was the first time I had some issues, the house is completely different form the photos it shows on the website, the communication with the host is very very slow, I 've asked for something and never received.
I am very sorry that I didn't have a good experience as always.

Great location, flat clean and tidy and the letting agent responsive. The flat was nice but the pictures are misleading on the advertisement, there are various flats in the building and the photos advertised aren’t accurate. I was expecting a first floor but was in the basement. Unfortunately during my stay the flat above had very loud construction works from 8.30am in the morning throughout the day which was very disruptive.

We loved staying with Max & Billie! The location was in the heart of beautiful Notting Hill, just a short walk from Portobello Road and even Kensington Gardens. The flat was really cute and just like the photos. We obviously expected it to be small but having the bed set higher made it feel like a separate bedroom so you had more space downstairs. The balcony was our favourite thing about the apartment. So beautiful and such a luxury to have, just note that it is shared with the room next door. The view was also great! Max & Billie‘s communication was amazing and they always responded very quickly. Everything was perfect! Thank you! :)

Great little spot for us and what we wanted for our weekend.
Such easy to follow instructions from Daria to find the place and how to get there. Check in was super easy too.
Lots of lovely little restaurants and places to shop.
We enjoyed our stay! This apartment was in a quiet neighborhood and really close to the underground. Super easy to navigate the area! Matched description, Thank you for having us!

This place is in a great location, nice places to have breakfast nearby like Cafe Diana. Walking distance to Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Lots of things to do and see in the area. Short ride by Uber or subway to all the attractions in London.
Great SoHo location. Near a ton of restaurants and shopping. Beds were comfortable. Secure building.

We pent two nights in the apartment number 2. The place is 10mins walk from Euston station and the closest Underground station is the Warren Street (step free).
The stairs to the second floor apartment is steep and difficult to carry luggage.
We were worried about the vibrations of the underground railway as written by reviews from other guests. But felt no vibrations, only the sound can be heard of the trains passing underneath.
The host is professional with curt and strict instructions failing which reservation may be cancelled, as written in the instructions.
With the high price that is being charged, may have provided with certain provisions / goodies, which we enjoyed in Air BnB accommodations in Bath and Coventry. Please note of non-refundable cancellation.

Fazile is an outstanding host, and her lovely home is just that: a home away from home with everything you need. Short walk to great transport links, a nicely stocked kitchen you can actually cook in without having to buy oil, salt, spices, jams etc etc. 2 large double bedrooms and a light and bright lounge space, and clean and bright bathroom. A modest but beautifully designed and carefully tended garden, and lovely welcoming touches throughout. Thanks for being so responsive and helpful Fazile 🙏

Really great place if you want to stay with a couple of people in London!
Clarissa is also very helpful and responsive. Great host!
We loved our stay - Fazile was a great host who answered any questions we had. Property itself is presented beautifully and feels homely. Thanks again!

Loved staying at Ana’s place! It was very clean and comfortable. Ana made the check in process really easy and was always available if we had questions.
The area is walkable with a lot of restaurants and grocery stores near by. Finchley Central is a short walk away so it was very easy to travel around London. Would definitely stay here again!
The location was very good.  However the layout for our extended family (with a baby) was difficult.

First off it is an extraordinary location. Right in the heart of great restaurants, shops, elegant boutiques and museums you can simply walk to. Second our host was very responsive and helpful. I am older and we were given a higher floor without a lift and he personally carried both my wife’s and my heavy luggage up 4 flights of  stairs. The room was meticulously clean , well equipped and is in a really beautiful area to be in London. But a special thanks to our host who went well beyond the call of duty to help us carry our stuff to our room. And he was also super responsive to every request we had. Would  definitely stay there next time we are in London.

Personally would not recommend this stay. Basement level, street facing with no flowing air. Provided a non functional fan. Was consistently damp and humid. Expect to provide your own shampoo, soap and bathroom was consistently unavailable given the amount of people staying in the apartment. Listing was technically accurate, but felt deceptive in quality.

So many good things about Carey’s place - close proximity to tube and bus stops, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, Oyster cards to borrow, to name just a few. On top of all this, Carey was so hospitable and very generously provided things such as milk, bread eggs and cereal. All contributed to making our week in London very special. Highly recommended.

This place is excellently located. Parks a plenty and this is really well positioned and parking too. Very comfortable flat with a good feel to it. Buses right outside the door and depending which way you want to go, we found the H2 service was really flexible. No shortage of Ubers either. We’ll definitely return.

Lovely stay! The host was friendly and responsive, and the room was spacious. I really appreciated how she gave me plenty of privacy throughout the stay, while still checking in occasionally to clean and make sure everything was going well.
This was the second time I stayed there and it’s always the best location. Very close to bus stops and underground stations in a nice neighborhood
Very very cosy place to stay in! It felt like i lived there! I’d definitely stay there again if i need to within the area! The host was very helpful and responsive too - absolutely loved it!

Great location and an amazing stay. Had everything we needed in the room which really added to the experience. Such a comfortable space and bed and really clean. Great place to stay outside of central London and easy with a car

Bernard was a lovely host. He communicated for weeks before the stay and throughout the whole stay.The location was perfect for me and my 3 friends with only a 10 minutes walk to the tube station and multiple shops and restaurants.We had an unexpected power cut on our last night and Bernard instantly helped by supplying candles and sharing constant updates on the situation via messages.The house was clean and very spacious with everything we needed supplied to us.I would really recommend this stay to anyone looking as Bernard was a really great host

This unit was as described.  Large 2 Bedrooms, lots of space, not at all cluttered.  Close to amenities, a grocery store in the back parking lot, more stores just a short walk away.  Unit has the equipment to make and eat meals, clean towels and bedding. Small balcony to enjoy a coffee in the morning. Beds had lots of linens, pillows and blankets.  Quick response to inquiries. A multicultural neighbourhood with lots of food options.  On bus routes, walkable to trains.  25 - 45 minutes to different parts of the city.
We had a great time in London and the room was perfect! A bit small for 3 persons but it was ok! Great communication around the area!

Even though finding the place was a bit difficult -to the non British eye, all buildings look the same in that area- it was very easy to reach the host to get directions and was very patient and flexible with our check-in time.
The apartment looks like in the pictures and was clean and well equipped. The only issue was that the lamp at the bathroom and the doorknob leading to the toilet felt a bit flimsy and we were scared of braking them just by looking at them. Besides this, very good place in good and quiet location (10-15 min walking to diverse underground / bus stations that connect you very well with the transport network in London) close to the Borough Market, Shard, and Tower Bridge. In addition there is a supermarket that opens early and closes late not even 5-min away. Would recommend, specially for families and friends who want to discover the city.

Absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful home. This was our first time staying in a place with a courtyard in London and it was perfect for the beautiful weather. Excellent location, close walk to coffee shops but felt private and quiet in the courtyard.

I can't say enough about Michael's Airbnb!  First and foremost, Michael's space matches description / photos and is modern and spotless.  It is a space that is welcoming upon entering the door.  Micheal is very responsive, which is helpful in a new setting.  We accidentally locked our keys inside and Michael resolved the matter quickly.  Everything is new and clean / bright.  There is a wonderful outdoor space, which is a plus in London.  Bus stops are right outside your door.  The neighborhood is wonderfully diverse and interesting to explore.  The kitchen is well stocked with everything for cooking and grocery stores are a short walk away.  Coffee and tea and other amenities are well stocked.  We rented a car while there and were able to park off street right in front of the Airbnb.  I can't say enough good about Michael's space.  This is exactly what you'd hope for upon arrival.  I would definitely stay with Michael again.

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was lovely—clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. The host was incredibly responsive and provided clear, detailed instructions that made the entire process seamless. Highly recommend this place and would definitely stay again!
Located right in the center of Soho/Chinatown, perfect spot to be close to it all. The underground and many food and tourist attractions are steps away!

Excellent stay in the heart of London! Our family of 4 really enjoyed the space and location. There are lots of restaurants, cafes and pubs nearby. Fairly short walk to St James or Victoria to catch the Tube. We stayed during a warmer spell in London and were happy with the fans provided for the bedrooms and living area.

Great location - close to everything, yet quiet. A bit empty (wish it had a few more things in the living room/kitchen), also wish it had a few staples like salt and sugar (most Airbnbs have them). Spacious and comfortable.

A family of five on vacation in our favorite city - this house was perfect for it! In fact, the best of the several we have stayed in.
Comfortable beds, nice kitchen and dining area & table, everything as described + some extras such as USB type A sockets for charging the phones and a washing machine. Peaceful residential area with rows of Victorian houses for eye candy. 10 min walk for District line tube which transports people to the core of London without changes. Grocery shops & cafes near the station. Quick and precise communication by Pam and James. Thank you for hosting us! We recommend this house. 😊
The house is fantastic , although a little bit expensive, the location lies in central London, underground and bus and even boat is very convenient, highly recommended

Isabel’s lovely apartment was very  comfortable and provided everything we needed. Isabel was an engaging host, who made us feel very much at home. She gave us lots of useful information and provided an excellent breakfast. All in all the perfect base from which to explore London.

Andrew was very helpful, communication good and considerate.
Happy to stay again and recommend.

Lisa was very accommodating and the place was as described.
The neighborhood was quite noisy, but this was probably amplified as we needed to open the windows due to the warm temperatures during our stay.

The appartment is very cosy and pleasant. I would not recommend a stay during the warm season - it's a top floor and therefore gets extremely hot. Unfortunately it was 30°C during my stay.
The shower is quite disappointing because of the low water pressure.
This location is not convenient to central London. If you’re visiting north London primarily this might be a good fit for you. There also will be other visitors in the Airbnb as well.

Good place in a central location. Sarin was extremely communicative and ot was very easy to check in and out. It got quite hot in the room, but it was one of the hottest days of the year so no surprise there! The right sort of place to stay for a night or two in London

We really enjoyed our stay in this nice and spacious flat. It’s in a quiet and safe area, close to Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park – great for a walk or a jog. Just a 10-minute walk to Westfield shopping centre with lots of food options. There’s also a small convenience store just around the corner, which was super handy.
Good transport links nearby – both train and underground stations are about 15 minutes away on foot. The flat was easy to find and check-in was simple. Michael was quick to reply and helpful whenever we had questions. Would definitely stay here again!

Perfect flat for exploring central London. Easy walking access to many tourist attractions and nearby lots of bus/underground lines. Flat was comfortable and had everything we needed. Deb was also a fantastic host - extremely responsive, friendly, and helpful. Would definitely recommend!
Me and my daughter enjoyed the place, it was everything we knew it would be. We will definitely come again.

It was a great stay in an extremely central  location. The key collection point was a 2-3 min walk away not right outside the flat. At the price point, AC for the summer should be a given although it isn’t.  I would definitely recommend for its location, apartment quality, and responsiveness of the host :)

I had messaged kristina she didn’t respond. Initially I had said I was staying with my younger sister who was 17 years old and she had let me book this knowing this message was sent. Then on the day when I travelled all the way from Birmingham to London she had cancelled the booking saying I had to be a legal guardian to my sister. So it was very much inconvenient. Horrible communication as she didn’t respond. Very much unhappy overall.

It looks exactly like the photographs.  It was clean and comfortable, perfect for my two night stay.  Daria was very responsive to my numerous questions.  I appreciated that she let me drop my bags off early and also let me leave my bags- later than my check out time.  The location is perfect- walkable to shops and restaurants. I felt safe since there was someone at the front desk 24 hours.  I highly recommend!  Thank you Daria!

Perfect location,walkable or easy accessable by a close by bus stand .Nice surrounding gardens,very calm to sleep.
Easy access via key safe.
Everything is exactly as described and on the pics! Very easy,well explained access,but not possible for wheelchair.
Very!!! clean,no shoes allowed.
Room is spacious ,bed is soo comfy.A couch is available which can be used for a second person.Also a small table,which can be used as a bedside table.Plenty of possibilities to charge electronic device.
Kitchen got everything one needs,very clean and hygienic.
Communication with Naoka was very good.Always friendly and quickly available for any upcoming questions.
A clear recommendation for everyone who likes a good price /value accomodation in Wembley ,close to tube and bus system to reach central London .I will definitely come again.

Good location! The place is quite small but good for a weekend in London. The apartment came equipped with basic kitchen and bathroom essentials. Host was responsive and flexible with our check in / check out times which we appreciated.

I thought I needed to bring bath towels, shampoo, shower gel, laundry detergent and so on. In fact, I brought all these things, but Evelyn provided them, so I used the bath towels and shower gel provided by Evelyn. If you have any questions, send a message to Evelyn and she will reply to answer. As long as it is not too much, Evelyn will help. It‘s too hot in summer. The room in the attic will be hotter,but I will slowly feel better after taking a shower at night. In short, I think this room is nice.
Thank you Tamara - we had a lovely stay in Notting Hill. Even better than the photos with a terrific modern lounge suite. Great location and communication 👌
Great flat near Ealing Common. We’re local but needed a 2br for our move out during packing. Nice kitchen and reception.
Had a really nice time at Herman’s. Herman was nice and very responsive to all my questions. The parking space was the cherry on top. Very helpful. Thank you for having us Herman.

Quiet and fresh space to relax in a central part of London.  Isabelle was easy to communicate with. Delicious breakfast and a nice chat with Isabelle is a good way to start a days exploring of the city. Recommended.

The place was accurately described in the listing, and overall, it matched our expectations in terms of location.
However, there were a few things we wish we had known in advance.
The flat was a bit dusty and could have used a more thorough cleaning before our arrival. In fact, the bed appeared as though the sheets hadn’t been washed, as well as the towels, so we chose not to use it.
Also, we didn’t realize the apartment is spread over multiple levels and requires going up some steep stairs, which might not be ideal for everyone.
Additionally, there is no air conditioning only three small, inexpensive fans which didn’t do much during the warmer days. Just something to be aware of if you’re staying in the summer. Otherwise, it served its purpose for a very short stay.

This was my second time staying in one of the properties managed by Artur, and I would stay again. The place was exactly as the photos show, easy to find, and the instructions were very helpful. From what I can tell, the shared bathroom was cleaned every day, and the flat was a walkable distance from the station. I've stayed during a particular hot day, but the room stayed relatively cool; there was a fan in the room, had I needed it.

Enjoyed our stay. Close to two tube stops.
Spacious for our family of 4.

Jenny is friendly and a good communicator. she took steps to replace the tv when we found it broken. the house was nice and pretty close to the train station. it does get a little warm in the summer as windows don't open but it is not terrible. all in all, worth it.
Great location! Ellie always responded within an hour. She did her best to help us to get into the accommodation early. Will definitely recommend to other travellers!
Jadin was a great host. Clear and easy to follow instructions. Place was as described, shared with the host. Next door to the DLR so great for assess. Great value!

We (along with others) found a real gem here in London. We wanted a place that was central, neat and tidy, and allowed us to live like locals during our stay.
Lindi’s accomodation ticked all of the boxes, and gave us the experience we were looking for.
Don’t underestimate the stairs getting up to the apartment though, it’s a great leg workout particularly with luggage.

We had a fantastic stay at Shaila's, the apartment is beautiful, it had everything we needed,
convenient location for public transport (bus stop just around the corner)
along with a Tesco, and takeaways all in walking distance.
Shaila is a lovely host and was brilliant to communicate with she sent us the information we needed to find the apartment and a video on how to get in.
we would definitely recommend and hope to be back soon
We loved the stay! Sadly we couldn't let that many fresh air in as we hoped. But overall, really nice!

We loved our three night stay here.  The Chelsea neighborhood was charming and also convenient.  The flat is a block or two from Kings Road, across the street from Sainsbury’s, easy access to the tube - we mostly used Sloane Sq. b/c the walk to the station was so pleasant.  We enjoyed the nearby restaurants and loved wandering around the neighborhood and to the Thames after dinner.  As other reviews mentioned the space is on the cozy side (we were two adults and two children ages 11 and 10).  Kids shared the sofa which was tight for them but manageable.  Easy check in/check out. Great hosts.   Would definitely return here for another stay.

We had a fantastic time staying at Kingas apartment. Location was great, easy to get to and close to everything we wanted while having a London holiday either the family. Will recommend to all friends visiting the UK. Thanks for having us

The help and communication was without fault, thank you for making our stay so easy and enjoyable with two small kids in tow.
Brilliant air b’n’b for exploring London!

Ideal place for what we were looking for (proximity to a wedding in Twickenham- to accommodate several couples). Large house with great outdoor space. The house is older and needs some updating - but it is was what we were expecting and great value
Disappointed about the shower situation and felt like with the amount of people we had there wasn’t enough space for rooming/sleeping.

This location is perfect to access all the Islington high street has to offer, from Angel to Highbury; shops, restaurants, cafes and transport. The space was perfect for our family of 4 with one child sleeping on the sofa bed. Everything was clean and ready to go.

I had a great stay! The unit looked exactly like the advertised pictures — stylish and just as expected. It was spotless clean upon arrival, and the beds were super comfy, making it easy to relax after a long day.
The location is also convenient, just a short 10-minute walk to the nearest train station and bus stop.
Elsa was a kind and responsive host, always quick to reply and helpful throughout my stay. Highly recommended!

I chose Monique’s place because of her super host rating. I think she deserves it and a lot more. She came to pick me from the station on my first day and subsequently helped with the shopping I needed to do especially the heavy items.
It was a stress free experience for me. Monique is easy going and nice, makes good conversation and is quite knowledgeable.
If I find myself needing accommodation in the area again, Monique’s will definitely be my first choice.
It was a lovely place, with a nice location and easy access to transport. I would come back again.

Perfectly situated for my needs on a training course. Great comms with the hosts. The apartment was spotless. The cleaners gave us an additional fan on what has been the hottest week in London - it certainly helped.
Recommend this apartment. Would book again.

Ying’s place was nice. Beds were so comfortable we wanted to fit them in our suitcases and take them home. Since there was a heat wave in London during our stay we did need more fans but she said none were available. The shower was very small so every time you turned around you bumped into everything. There were dead bugs on the shade in the kitchen and on the floor in the bathroom, unfortunately I hate bugs so that was a con for me. Maybe providing more instructions on how things work? (Nespresso machine, shower, washer/dryer) Overall, this place was great!!! Close to the underground and bus stops. Water pressure was great, beds comfortable. Will stay here again when in London!!!
Thanks Ying for a great stay.

Enaam and her team were super helpful and always very responsive. There were three of us staying, and we were really comfortable. The place has a cute little terrace, which was such a nice spot to hang out. It did get a bit warm during the day since there’s no AC and the sun hits the apartment directly in the evening, but once we opened the windows and the balcony at night, it cooled down nicely. The terrace door was a bit tricky to close, though. The apartment is really close to the train station, and we could easily get anywhere we wanted with at most three transfers. The neighborhood was also nice to walk around in. Overall, we had a really pleasant stay and I’d definitely recommend it to others!
Amazing accommodation with a lovely space outside and everything else just fell into place. A beautiful home away from home 😊
Excellent place for our family to stay during our trip to London. Super close the Mornington Crescent underground so it was a great home base for exploring. We also loved Camden town!

Deb’s flat is in a great location. The inside is so well kept, you will definitely feel at home when you are here. Deb is super friendly and helpful with all instruction. She was able to accommodate our schedule and very flexible.

We were able to easily see everything we wanted to see in London from this well located Airbnb! Near several sights to see, several Tube stations, stores, and good restaurants. We really appreciated Joanna's willingness to meet us at the Airbnb, so she could give us instructions, the keys, and answer our questions. I absolutely would stay there again!!

Just back from our second stay at Anne’s.  The comfortable light room has a touch of dignity with its lovely window, lots of bookshelves and its beautiful polished furniture.  Anne is a perfect host, making one feel at home and helping in every possible way.  We had dinner at the Italian restaurant she had recommended the first time (6 minutes walk away) and this time tried the Italian café she mentioned, 3 minutes away - all good.  She arranged very convenient parking.  She’s just marvellous!  We recommend this Airbnb and will certainly want to stay there again.
Enjoyed my stay. Comfortable room and location was very close to the tube. Kitchen is well equipped and everything was just as described. Would stay again. Thanks

We appreciated being close to a few metro stations that made it very easy to navigate London and get to different areas. There are several restaurants and grocery places near the apartment. The kitchen was  well stocked for cooking. We had a few things pop up, but the host was responsive in getting back to us in a timely matter.
My stay in Sandra's house was perfect. There are many accesses to public transportation and Sandra is able to help. Also, she's very communicative and friendly :)
Our stay was excellent. We felt right at home. The flat was spacious and the four of us were comfortable. We enjoyed going out to the back yard. Our stay was peaceful inside and outside.
My kids and I loved the location. It was very easy to move around the city with easy access to bus and underground. Katherine was quick to respond when massaged and always helpful.

Stayed for one night for a gig in Brixton, and the location was perfect for this. As other people have mentioned the shower is very small which was quite difficult, however it is as pictured in the photos.  Easy check in/ out and quick communication allowing me to check in early. The only real negative for me was quite a strong smell of mould/ mildew, which was fine for one night as just needed a place to sleep but wouldn’t have been great to stay any longer.

Perfect location, close to the tube, a block away from the market, restaurants, shopping and grocery store. This property is very clean and well organized. Kitchen was fantastic for cooking some of our own meals! Susana adds many special touches for travellers in case you’ve forgotten something. She was also very responsive when we had any questions. Would definitely recommend!
Note that the bedroom is in a very unique little enclosure. We loved it for sleeping but someone with mobility issues may have difficulty getting in and out of the area.

Loved my stay here! the pictures on the listing doesn't do this lovely home justice. The apartment was very clean, had parking which is a massive bonus and had access to the garden which was great in the sun.
Would definitely stay again, thank you Michael.

A hidden gem in Earls Court. Close to tube station, from Warwick Road entrance. Direct connection to airport by Piccadilly line and other major attractions by District line. Host was very responsive and flexible. The house was very cosy and clean with all amenities needed. Good size for 3 people in London. Plenty of restaurants and groceries on the other side of road. It was not so noisy eventhough the house is by road side. Would love to stay here if I’m in London again.
really clean and cozy place, there’s a pub right outside which means it can get quite loud at times but wasn’t problematic

A lovely flat. It is a bit small for a family of 4 but we made it work. The AC works well and during the summer that was important to us.
Thank you!

Absolutely perfect stay! The apartment is stylish, spotless, and fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. Free parking right in front of the building is a huge plus, and the nearby bus stop makes getting to the city center super easy. We loved our time here and will definitely try to book again the next time we're in London!
We stayed at Alexandra’s apartment for five nights. It was cool and cozy and clean. A great location and felt very safe. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

We had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, cosy, and in a great location. Check-in was smooth, and the host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout. It really felt like a home away from home. Would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

Honestly for what you get included in Maria’s Airbnb it’s so worth more than what she offers so personally I think it’s amazing value for money and I’m so glad I decided to go with her place since she has one of those large industrial fans which was sooo needed in this heat, great host, great place, her team is so friendly and so understanding honestly will stay here again 100% in future .

We had a nice stay, the place was very clean. The plastic sheets were a little uncomfortable and gardening first thing on a Sunday morning was a little frustrating as we were very tired due to transport issues coming from Wembley. Apart from that it was perfect for what we wanted and needed. Reasonably priced for the location too.
Ana’s place was wonderful! The garden is beautiful and the garden house has everything you need and more for a London stay. Ana was extremely helpful and a lovely host. Highly recommend staying here!
We had a lovely stay. The apartment was very clean and well appointed. It was warm but as it was a heatwave that was understandable. We would stay there again.

Very friendly host. House needs maintenance.  Shower was very poor. It was either boiling hot or cold. It was very hard to even achieve cold. Nice atmosphere in the house   Great location. Nice small garden.

The place was great and met our expectations. There were a few hiccups in getting into the flat late due to it still being cleaned, but when we lost the key Jonathan was excellent is getting someone out to sort another.

We stayed with 5 people for 2 nights in this nice, clean and spacious apartment. The accommodation looks exactly is you can see it via the pictures on airbnb. We totally enjoyed the terrace, access to the gym and having 2 bathrooms. It's the perfect apartment for a small group until 5 people. Further, the neighborhood is quite, clean and offers a lovely café at the corner (rada café) and a nice supermarket. The host was really supportable, clear in communication and friendly.
We definitely recommend this apartment/host and will rent it again once we visit London next time.

Located within 10 mins walk to Wembley stadium, perfectly comfy for one nights’ stay.
Ayub responded quickly to our need for more sheets / pillows and provided before our return and good comms on the key handover beforehand.
The set up is one double bed with a bunk bed in the same room, a second bunk bed in the other room - as two couples we spread over both rooms. The bunk beds were a little wobbly so larger adults may struggle, some of the windows a little stiff to open and the blinds didn’t always open / close properly which meant it was bright (but with eye mask and some earplugs like I’d planned it was fine).

Both Tadé and Tobi were really kind hosts. They were always friendly and ready to help in any way they could. The apartment is very well maintained and exactly as shown in the pictures. Although it is not located in the most central area, Lewisham Train Station is only a five-minute walk away, and trains run frequently. The apartment is also perfect if you’re planning to stay in London for work in Canary Wharf — which is what I did. I would happily stay with Tadé and Tobi again anytime.
The flat was small but served our purposes perfectly and a short walk from anything you could need. Akrox was communicative and helpful and we had no problems at all 🙂

Excellent spot!! Emma was a great host who was very happy to help out and ensure that we had a great stay! The place was very cute and clean and we will definitely be coming back if in the area again!
Nice small area with easy routes into London centre, nice little room with a nice clean bathroom, no complaints at all 👍
A great basement apartment in a lovely central location.  The apartment was nice and cool to return to after a day out in the heat.  It was very spacious and had everything we needed for our stay.
Jacqueline's place was clean, and good value for money.  Can't say anything bad about it.

Shaz’s place is much cuter than the photos give it credit for! Has been freshly renovated from the previous pics. Check-in was really easy and smooth. Area is a little noisy, but was not overbearing. The balcony is nice to stand on and look at the sunset. Lots of good food in the area, pizza place and Vietnamese place across the street are really great food options.  Easy access to overground and tons of buses lend to easy to the entire city.  No lift is a bit of a bummer in terms caring bags up, but not the end of the world, just something to keep in mind. Very responsive. Enjoyed my stay overall!

The accommodation matched the photos. The bed was comfortable and the room did not heat up too much during the very hot temperatures we were experiencing during our stay. Having a lift to the 4th floor and not too many stairs to walk up was appreciated. We liked the locality as it is on a regular bus route and quite close to the Northern Line underground train station. Jessie was very welcoming and we enjoyed some interesting conversations. We would 100% recommend staying with her.

Yulia's flat is a great place to stay to visit London and feel like a Londoner. Great location, 5 min walk from Portobello market, Ladbroke Grove tube station is only 1m walk distant. The flat is comfortable, fully furnished, newly decorated and very clean. The kitchen is fully equipped. Highlights recommended.

The location of the property made it ideal as it’s walking distance from the tube station; and also many shops, bars and restaurants. The property was spotless and the facilities were in good condition, modern and easy to use. Communication with the host was also brilliant and very responsive. 100% would stay again.
Anne was a lovely host. Her house is super cozy and homely with a cute backyard. The bed was a little too soft for me but otherwise great place and location. Highly recommend it

Sofia’s property was exactly as it appeared in the photos and description. It was perfectly located close to transportation. Sofia was very responsive and allowed us to drop our bags off early so we could enjoy the sights before the check in time. Our family felt safe and comfortable here. I would definitely recommend this property to friends and family. We had a lovely time in London!
James was very responsive and helpful. House was easy to find and very clean.  There was lots of amenities in the room and it was very private. Would definitely stay again

Very nice flat! Host was very kind and met us at check in to give us keys and show us around the space. Very responsive when we had questions.
Lovely location close to bus stop and Hampstead Heath.

The stay was really good. The apartment was clean and setup well. It had all the amneties listed and they also helped us with a baby cot. It also had good books for babies. The home itself have messages to unwind and relax, I found it really helpful. Location is at a walkable distance from tube station, very peaceful place. There is a Sainsburys store nearby from where we can get all necessary stuff. The host was really good and friendly. She was quick to respond and helped us with all our queries. Overall it was a happy stay for us, value for money.

We had a great time with our large group. It was lovely that each bedroom had their own bathroom and there was enough spaces to get together as a group. The location was perfect for exploring and getting around London.
Dainius was very responsive and dealt with our concerns/issues in a quick and professional manner.
We had a lovely stay. Lots of space, close to great transit, very clear communication. We would certainly stay again. Thank you!

Well appointed and newly renovated, quite spacious and well connected to west end and central London by direct tube at 7 minutes walk or bus right outside. 2.5 bathrooms and a parking space, area is quiet and peaceful, good base to explore London. The portable AC came in very handy during the June heatwave. Friendly hosts who were quick to address some minor issues.

Isabelle is an incredible host. She welcomed us with coffee and other assorted drinks and took an hour and a half out of her day to educate us on the layout of London (it was our first time).
Every morning we were greeted with a healthy breakfast to fuel us for a days worth of walking and friendly conversation.
Isabelle’s care and attentiveness to her guests is unmatched. We are so grateful for our time at her flat and look forward to returning!
A bit noisy due to the night life and nearby hospital, but the location was quite convenient to an underground station and walking distance of Hyde Park.

Lived up to all of the previous great reviews - great location (particularly for arriving from Heathrow - but also for Regent’s Park, Covent Gardens, etc). George was welcoming and helpful. Would highly recommend and would stay here again.

Great location, close to public transport and shops,  lovely neighborhood and quiet location. Stewart and Nikki were great hosts, lots of recommendations for what to do in the area. London had very warm weather during our stay but the flat was cool and Nikki gave us a fan which was useful.

While the apartment's interior was good, the outdoor space was a letdown compared to the pictures. The online photos don't accurately represent the dark, unkempt 'jungle' that actually surrounds the property. Another major drawback was the lack of privacy. The main entrance features a large glass door and window - directly facing the three floors main house - and with only sheer curtains provided offering minimal screening, especially at night with interior lights on, making it very easy to see into the apartment from outside, very little privacy was guaranteed.

We really enjoyed our stay. This bnb is so cozy and comfy with everything and more that we needed. Love his plants and art decor as well. Most of all, he’s extremely responsive, giving us all kinds of useful suggestions. Also, super helpful to arrange how to pick up the jacket we left at his place. Truly a home away from home. Thx a ton, Alistair! Highly recommended!

Nicholas' place is very clean and spacious. Nicholas' communication is extremely responsive and informative. Check in was easy and location is close to many attractions in London. I couldn't recommend Nicholas' place enough! You won't be disappointed!

gorgeous little apartment in a really lovely quiet area, exactly as described and super easy to get to from the tube. Billie and Max were great hosts, quick responses and very helpful when my phone was being dumb about the wifi. would highly recommend! the bed was also very lush and comfy!!

Daniel was very attentive and responsive to all queries. The apartment was clean and I really appreciated the fan that he had left for me as I arrived in a heatwave. The location is accessible around 15 minute walk from Seven Sisters tube station which takes you central London.
I arrived at night and felt a little apprehensive walking alone and in the dark as a woman but the apartment is located on a busy main road which helped calm my nerves.

Apartment was gorgeous and Usman was super helpful and responsive. The bed was slightly uncomfortable and could have used more/better pillows, but other than that/ everything was great! Location is unbeatable.
Wonderful place in a great neighborhood. Michael was extremely helpful and always quick to respond to any questions we had.
Chris was a fantastic host. Friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to make us feel right at home. The space was clean and modern and in a great location.

Jaharul was one of the most responsive hosts I've had. He let us check-in as soon they were done cleaning which was a couple of hours before. Apartment is located on the ground floor which is amazing for people with difficulties walking. There is also a bus stop right in front of the building and a overground metro next door. The only downside for me was that the only window opens right on the street so you can't leave it open when you're gone or asleep
Great apartment as advertised public transport very close, only downside was due to current heatwave in London drains giving off a bit of a funky smell in the bathroom.

Vuong accepted me on a last-minute, same-day booking. All instructions were clearly provided and the house has always been clean, tidy and beautiful. She allowed me to use all the house facilities, including the piano and washing machine, which have been a great bonus for my stay. The room and bathroom were both clean and comfortable, and the surrounding area quiet and full of options. Vuong and her children were polite and welcoming and it has been a pleasure to spend ten days with them.

We had a really great stay at Jadin’s place. From the beginning, communication was smooth and friendly. Even though we had planned to check in early and ended up arriving late, Jadin was incredibly kind and still greeted us warmly at the door, which we truly appreciated after a long day.
The space was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. It’s in a great location close to town with so many shops, restaurants, and things to do nearby. It made getting around super convenient, and we enjoyed exploring the area.
Overall, we felt very comfortable and well taken care of during our stay. Jadin was such a lovely and thoughtful host, and we’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Hi we had a good, comfortable stay. No problem at all.
The only issue we faced was as the weather was hot, we needed fans in all the 3 rooms. There were 2 fans available in the apartment, I hope you can add another fan to the third room. Otherwise, it gets really hot at this time of the year.
Very responsive and easygoing.  she is a genuine host it's her home that is being rented, very sweet

I would recommend, with a warning. The place was in a great location and the hosts were wonderful. Place was clean and well taken care of. I would recommend to anyone capable of making the climb up stairs. My wife and I took our mothers — who are in their 60s — and the stairs posed a bit of a problem, especially with luggage. Otherwise,  great place! Would recommend. Thank you!

Always well received. Very responsive in case of a problem, even a minor one.
The neighborhood is very pleasant and quiet, very easy to access with public transport. The amenities are great, the places are very beautiful and well maintained. We will come back.
The apartment was the perfect location in a very lovely part of London and convenient to the train station.
Great host, great person, great family. They will make you feel like you're visiting your close family.  Very nice stay.

Host was really lovely, great communication and sent lots of pictures and instructions on how to check in and where the place is, which made it way easier. Apartment was just like the pictures small and cozy, great furniture and lots of kitchen appliances. TV in bedroom with Netflix etc and in my opinion a comfy bed. Lots of bus stops and shops near by including a co op! for the price it was great and I really recommend it. The host made a good impression on me!

We needed a place to stay after an evening event in White City and this place was perfect! It was very clean, orderly, and welcoming. Foluke was very helpful and responsive when I had any questions, which was really appreciated. All in all, we had a great stay.
Nina is lovely. The house is Very nice and Very quiet area. We had a really nice weekend!!

Had a really great experience staying at the Erith house! Lovely garden and plenty of space in the living area as well as multiple en-suites. Harv was responsive and clear with instructions for our stay, was overall very good!

Great stay in a perfect location, just 2 min from Bermondsey tube station and an easy 15-20min stroll to Tower Bridge. Small supermarkets around the corner. House was very clean and well maintained with spacious rooms. We felt very welcome and would definitely stay again.

Really great stay but most of all
Andrew was super helpful and when I asked if I could check out a bit later he responded quickly and gave us 2 1/2 hours extra
Great host

Jamie was great, all the instrucción were very clear, the apartment very nice and clean!
Jamie responds very quickly and she is so nice.
I would definitely recomendó to stay here

Great place to stay! It had everything we needed and more, and was very clean. The host was extremely responsive and helpful. Location wise it was very convenient between kings cross and Easton underground stops, and it was a quiet neighborhood.
Great apartment, and excellent location! I would definitely return to this Airbnb, but suggest the owner invests in a few fans for the increasingly hot London summers!

Andrea was a great host- very easy to communicate with and very attentive once we arrived. She explained everything about her property and was always available to answer questions.
The property is fine for two people. The sofa bed was comfortable and the bedroom was cosy.
Location is excellent- lots of restaurants and pubs on Archway Road plus just 10 minutes walk down the hill to Archway tube if you want to go to other areas.
We were very happy with our stay and would book again.
James is an exceptional host with an exceptional home.  I could not have asked for anything more.
Very nice and communicative host! Perfect location with a little cute pub only 50 meters from the flat.
Great location, lots of transport near, very clean and had no trouble getting inside. Can be a little loud in mornings due to loading dock but overall great
Well kept room which was very comfortable. opening the windows created a nice breeze in the muggy weather too. Parveen was very friendly and accomodating

just returned home after a great stay with micheal and Julie ann. room was great with private bathroom clean and tidy. helped us out with transport which was much appreciated, great area nice and quiet but also easy to get around as it wasn't too far from busses, trains, underground etc. Will definitely use the air b and b again.
thanks again.
Urszula’s house is beautiful and absolutely spotless. The bed was super comfortable and I had the best sleep. She is a kind host and super helpful. Walking distance to Crystal Palace Park too!
Ronan was a fantastic host, very kind and proactive with instructions. The place itself was clean, close to the tube, and we felt right at home immediately. Would definitely stay again.
Great stay - fab, well equipped apartment in a great location. The hosts were easy to communicate and super accommodating by ensuring they had a cot available for our toddler. Thank you for having us
We had a great time here, the underground station is just a 5 min walk, apartment was nice and the balcony was a great feature. Would definitely stay again when back in London! Thanks

Good experience in this studio. Easy to find, good instructions, clean as expected.
Location is amazing - restaurants, coffees, atmosphere is great.
Two things to keep in mind when booking there: bed is 140cm large (which can be challenging when traveling with a friend!) & it is tricky to make the place fresh (heat is kept inside - hopefully, ventilator helps, but I don't think it is convenient in case of high/very high temperatures.

Denise and Jonathan’s place was excellent. The room was very comfortable and  relaxing with a view over their beautiful garden. Mini kitchen and fridge a big bonus.  Both Denise and Jonathan were extremely welcoming and helpful . On a lovely street in a beautiful area.

Spend 8 days at Katherine’s place with my wife and teenage son.  Place was perfect, spacious, all amenities available, beautiful building over looking gardens and  church.  Location was perfect to get to underground and bus routes, plus walking distance to Hampstead heath and primrose hill, nice in summer time.  Katherine was a great host, extremely accommodating on check in and out.  Would highly recommend the place, very central but so peaceful

Overall a fine stay. We did 4 people here. 2 took pullouts, 2 shared a bed. The room was fine for our split price,hard to beat 135 GBP split 4 ways. Great location, very quiet, felt very safe.
Only things I'd knock it for are
* lack of electrical outlets
* Very aged. While somewhat clean,it was very old
* The hot water wasn't working and we had to call to get it fixed.
The host was very quick and responsive on the last point and it was fixed promptly.

lovely place for the price! big and spacious and nicely decorated. location is great too, very close to the tube station and near a co-op! the area is nice and peaceful. gareth is lovely too, definitely would recommend :)

Ying's place was right fit for us. 5-7 minutes walk from the closes station, we were able get around london with no issues. Place itself was clean and in good condition. Ying was easy to get a hold of and everything was as described.

Bhupendra was very nice and responsive!
Great location and a cozy place to stay if visiting Islington.

Very nice clean apartment! The double and single bed both very comfy. Good connections to Aldgate East tube station and walking distance to Spitalfields/Brick Lane.
My party felt safer using Aldgate East station rather than Whitechapel (which may be recommended on some navigation apps). The journey to Aldgate East sticks to main roads.
The Breakfast Club was a nearby breakfast highlight near Liverpool Street station
The apartment is very nice. However stairwells and hallways were filthy and in disrepair. Very close to Brentford Bees football stadium.
The place was clean, great location and the host was very responsive and good to communicate with. The place is a bit smaller than what the photos seem but good for a 2 or a small family of 4
Great location, instructions clear & nice flat! Apart from a couple things this was spot on. Communication from the host was good & entry was easy, would definitely return :)

Fantastic home in the heart of Shoreditch.
we had a great time and we highly recommend this place 😃

Definitely worth the price. The accommodation is brand new, very clean and comfortable. There’s a lot of grocery stores, restaurants, cafes and pubs around. Also several options of public transport.
The host was very kind, answering my messages very fast and trying to be very helpful. They organized everything and accepted my request for the early check in.

Staying at Alex place was a special treat for us. We spent a few days at his place, surrounded by beautifully curated art and interesting art pieces. Very comfortable beds and just the right number of rooms for my family. Secluded from the bustling city of London (quiet and private) yet located very centrally (Chelsea and S. Kensington) close to all major landmarks in the city. Would definitely stay at Alex’s place again!
Yulia was the perfect host, friendly, proactive and highly responsive with her flat being 10/10 in terms of location, quality and value.
Very good location, steps from earls court tube, quiet street, close to museums, pubs and supermarket. Very clean house. Jonas always answered quickly.
The location is perfect.  It is about a 5 minute walk to the London City Airport.  This is why we stayed here.

Clarissa communicated really well before our stay and was responsive when we were staying in her home.
Her home was in a great location for us - very close to the tube, lots of pubs and restaurants, food shops around.
It was clean and accomodated 2 couples well - being spacious in the living areas downstairs and 2 bathrooms upstairs - the second bedroom was a little small for 2 adults and our suitcases.

Wow what a flat!
This flat really does have some of the best views in London! An uber cool, spacious flat in a great neighbourhood with a park literally on your doorstep. This would suit both a family with kids or people looking for a fun time in London.
Bryony was an excellent host, communicative and helpful and offered great recommendations of local cafes and restaurants.
I would absolutely recommend this flat and we will be back again!
This was a nice place to use as a home base to visit London.  We walked to a lot of places, and used the tube as well. Nearby Regents Park offered a quiet respite from busy London.

My adult family and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Maylands farmhouse. A really interesting building, well kept with lots of character and amenities,  and with spacious, comfortable bedrooms. The outdoor space is lovely and perfectly suited to a summer party, which we hosted during our stay. Jaqua is a welcoming, friendly host, always proactive and responsive and attentive to our vacation needs. The location is very convenient, only a couple of minutes from the A12 and the M25, and a short  five minute drive to local shops and the Elizabeth Line tube. I would highly recommend this location to any group looking to spend vacation time together.

This was one of my favorite stays after 10 years on Airbnb! Pavel has thought of every detail and the space is so aesthetic and functional—beautiful kitchen and bathroom, ample storage, top-of-the-line fixtures. Pavel is such a lovely person and a kind and social host—even meeting me in person for a late check-in and providing lots of great neighborhood recs. Definitely stay here and enjoy all Hackney has to offer! I will be back next time I’m in London :)

Laura was extremely responsive and helpful. The room itself was clean (flat's public area was not), nice and cozy but you could hear the neighbor's sounds. Would have appreciated tissue papers/kitchen papers etc and a better working hair dryer for the room price but overall a nice stay. It is about 10 min walk from the Shepard's Bush Market Station.

Vasif was one of the best owners/property managers I’ve ever worked with. Extremely customer-focused, friendly, very accommodating. He really went above and beyond. The location is excellent, the 2 bedroom. 2 1/2 bath layout was perfect. The bathrooms seem like they were recently remodeled and were sleek and clean. He went above and beyond in terms of things that were included for guest convenience: shampoo, body wash, luxury hand soap and lotions, water, paper towel, box of delicious chocolates, etc. The location was a very short walk to the Baker Street tube stop and a 15 minute walk to Bond St. where you can catch the Elizabeth line to Heathrow.
