very cute and quiet, got all you need (no air-conditioning, but 2 ventilators).
communication with Federica is perfect, respond almost immediately.
not suitable for disabled (narrow and too many stairs).
bottom line - recommended.

Ali is a lovely host and was accommodating of my requirements. Flat is dated, but very clean although plumbing needed to be addressed as there were some blockages which Ali set about fixing. Comfortable but a little over priced compared to the competition.

Ideal for travelers on a budget, this flat has all the basics and a new bathroom and kitchen appliances. Also, the lobby and access to all the flats is secure and locked.
It's only a couple of blocks (about to 6-minute walk) to Kings Cross and St Pancras stations. The lift was out of service during the time of our booking so check with owner if climbing a few flights of stairs is an issue for your party (in case the lift is still out of service).
It would be a bonus if the property had WiFi although our group made do using our mobile phones.
This property is clean, tidy, and has all the basics plus laundry and a balcony to hang out your washing. Our group agreed that we'd book this same property if we find ourselves returning to London in the future.

This is an excellent place to stay. It is well connected , being a short walk from Shepherds Bush Market tube station. The room is very clean and well equipped, including a much appreciated fan.
The shared bathroom and kitchen are well equipped .

My stay at Rosario’s was just what I needed - a cozy bed to sleep in after a long day of exploring London. Rosario and Rafael were extremely kind and thoughtful during my stay. I was only in London for a short period but Rosario made me feel at home and provided toiletries, sweets and coffee/tea. The location is southern London but a 5 minute walk to the Stockwell station with access to the Victoria and Northern line bringing you to the heart of London and it’s tourist attractions. I felt extremely safe at Rosario’s which was important to me as a woman travelling alone. Would recommend!

We had a lovely stay at Sergio’s flat! Good location, close to buses and trains. The flat was clean and well equipped with everything we needed. Our 4 year old son loved the bunk beds and toys! Sergio was easy to communicate with and responded quickly.
Amazing stay, couldn’t have asked for a better house for a small group of people to stay in.
A very convenient place to stay if you need somewhere close to the Heathrow airport terminals. Very clean.

Wonderful light, airy and quiet apartment a few minutes walk from the train station.
This fully equipped apartment sleeps 5 comfortably with a large lounge and kitchen and 2 bathrooms.
Tamara is a super host and we will definitely be back.

The apartment was very spacious and had most amenities. The location is fantastic. Very central and close to stations (Baker street & Marylebone are 5 & 7 mins walk respectively). It is 15 mins walk to Bond street and then Oxford circus just further up. Excellent location if you love to be in the Centre of all attractions and shopping in London. Communication was good and effective. Vas was very kind and reasonable and accommodated my requests. Check in and check out was seamless and he even granted us a late check out. Overall, my family and I had a lovely stay and we would definitely be back again.
Great location, incredible view! If you’re looking to get a lot accomplished and feel safe, informed, and comfortable, this is the booking for you! Max is a great host.
Super nice place in a very serene location in London.  Very sizable, bright and sunny apartment fully equipped with all mod cons and two balconies. You can really stretch out and relax here!

We have just returned from a lovely few days staying in this Air bnb. Fantastic location and a great flat. Very clean, comfortable (especially the bed!) with everything you’d need for a city break. Also, great communication throughout. Very kindly kept our luggage on our last day to enable us to do some last minute sightseeing. Would highly recommend!
Alexey's apartment is very comfortable with many facilities. The location is great. The communication with Alexey was great too. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT.

The apartment is superbly located, it is functional and tasteful. I particularly appreciated the bathroom,  small but equipped with both bathtub and shower, and very new - definitely not a given in London. Communication with the host was perfect and smooth.  Would definitely recommend.

Incredible flat in one of the prettiest parts of London! Super comfortable with everything you need for your stay. Quiet street that is only ten minutes away from Hyde Park and Notting Hill Gate. Lots of incredible restaurants and things to do nearby. Easy access to transport links. Loved my stay and highly recommend it.

communication and response time, checkin, cleanliness and location is great and lovely, and many other guests mentioned good feedback which i agree with.
3 important points to note.
1. Its mentioned that there is 1 bedroom and a common area, but the bedroom has no door, its just a big opening near it, with no privacy, which brings up the 2nd point.
2. It was listed as for 4 guests, but it actually good for 2, for me and my wife with 2 kids, it was a bit tight.
3. Not good in summer with heatwaves, the flat had no aircon and only one small fan, the air doesn’t circulate, which made it unbearable to stay in, in some days
If the host addresses the 3 points above, i think it will be a good place for max of 2 people to stay and enjoy anytime away from summer.
Great Location, easy access to public transport! Granola and milk was a super nice touch, gina was easy to contact, great for a short stay!

Clare is a lovely and attentive host. The home is just as beautiful, if not more beautiful in person.
We had a lovely stay.

Eliana's space is exactly as it is in the ad. All very clean and quiet. There is a bus stop on the same street that connects you to the center, places to eat and shop also close by. Easy access also to the overground at a 15 minute walk. My experience was very positive!

Lukas is a cool host. He is a humble guy and is service person and takes care of details. All as expected !
Thank you Lukas!
Tidy well-designed studio near Notting Hill Gate-underground. One small remark: the bed on the shallow vide is less suitable for the taller guests.

Couldn’t recommend Nwike enough as an amazing host if you’re looking for a lovely, private place to stay in a great location just outside of the city centre. My trip was extremely enjoyable and Nwike’s communication was extremely helpful whilst I stayed the night.

Spacious, easy-to-find townhouse with the bonus of gated parking. Great communication with the host, checking on us beforehand with reassurance to get in touch if we had any questions.
The house is large, comfortable, and homely with good facilities nearby and an easy walk to Southfields underground.

Just perfect!! Amazing location, super clean and really functional. Paolo and George were highly responsive to any questions and helped make our stay and visit to London an amazing experience!!. Will definitely stay here again on any return trip to London!
A lovely apartment, really comfortable and no problems at all with getting keys etc. Communication all very easy. Location is great too; a really handy walk to the District Line tube.

Thank you Ayo. My family enjoyed their stay.
Rooms and shared areas were clean, location is walking distance to tram and served well by buses.
Overall a very good stay.
Thank you for being a kind and helpful host too!
A great apartment in a great location. Quiet and peaceful with a lovely garden to relax in.  Finished to a high standard. Highly recommended
Great location in quite street near underground, however the aircon and wifi were not working at all the whole time we were there. Very frustrating

Frank was very hospitable and kind! The room was airy and spacious, and the bed very comfortable!
Highly recommend, check in was easy and accessible!

Helpful hosts. A lovely,  clean and well-equipped apartment, with comfy beds too.  A great,  central location,  which was quiet at night,with a couple of nice cafes just around the corner. Ideal for activities in Central London.

Tina’s BNB is a gem! My checkin was smooth and the room + bathroom are spotless and very cozy. There is a lot of storage space in the room which is so rare. Tina was respectful of my privacy as well as super helpful. The neighborhood is a huge plus with the tube and many cafes right around the corner. I particularly enjoyed the closeness to Hyde Park. I would recommend this BNB to anyone who is considering a budget yet, comfortable stay!

Nice, cosy apartment located conveniently for the centre of London, with easy access to the underground including the new Elizabeth line. You can actually walk through the park in front of the apartment to the Thames path, by beautiful gardens and equally beautiful athletes and runners. The apartment is 5 mins from a 24 hour Tesco and 20 mins from the Thames ferry. It has a toilet and separate shower and bathroom. The kitchen includes a hob and microwave and expresso machine. Excellent wi fi. Nice area in general.

My boyfriend and I stayed the night here after traveling back from Croatia to break up our long trip back to California.
Good value and in a great location…the bus stop is right out front to take you to Heathrow.
The house is definitely older and has kind of a smell to it but it didn’t bother us. Comfy spring mattress and a large shower!

The location is excellent!  But as others have said, there are 55+ stairs, and it is very difficult with overseas luggage (unless you are young!).  The interior stairs to the bathroom are a bit challenging during the night as well.  Otherwise, it is clean and comfortable.
Good value for money. Apartment is exactly as it is on the pictures. James is such a kind soul, he made our short stay very pleasant. I 100% recommend.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Peter is a wonderful host who is very easy to communicate with, very helpful with anything I asked. Would definitely stay here again.

Small room but great people who offered it.
They even put free snack bars and some water in the room when I checked it.
Apart from that I have to say this was probably the most clean Airbnb I ever had!
Would highly recommend
Great host, the place was clean and was at a good location! Didn’t disappoint! Loved my stay

Lovely home and garden, responsive and helpful communication with the host, great for traveling with children. Plenty of shops and takeout nearby, but also really easy to get to the city center on the tube. Thanks for letting us stay!

Great host, communication was great and fantastic location for the Tower of London & Thames. Beds and bedding and sofa really comfortable and clean, nice bedding. Ideal for a short stay to explore. We would stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay in this unit. Paulo and George were helpful. The location was fantastic for us. We were able to walk almost everywhere we wanted to go. Mind you that we have no problem walking 10 miles or more a day. It’s it’s also close to several tube stations. The flat itself is quaint and had everything we needed. We were glad we booked this unit
Great place to explore London from. Quiet at night, close to the train, and tons of small bakeries and coffee shops for morning walks. Shower works well and the bed nook is cozy.
Great stay, clear contactless checkin, right near the train, quiet, clean. Would definitely stay here again.

Wondaful home away from home. Has everything you need.
Getting in and out was super easy and comfortable.
Location is great. Very near the park (which has playgrounds) and mall.
A slight problem with one of the showers kept this at 4 stars but  this was an immaculately clean, ideal base for our family at a very reasonable price.
One of the best located airbnbs in all of London. Large flat with plenty of space. Great host
Great place in London! Location was perfect, and the apartment was very clean and practical. Loved all the modern touches and how close we were to everything. Would highly recommend.
This was a wonderful spot to stay! Walking distance to Kings Cross and many great restaurants & shops. We would definitely stay here again when visiting London!

It was beyond our expectations and so beautiful. It is on the third floor so I wouldn’t recommend for a buggy or heavy luggage, but we did not have either in this trip and it was honestly incredible.
Location
Spaciousness
Decor
Amenities
Roof top
Thank you so much x
We enjoyed our stay at Paolo’s. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet and is the perfect location. The Airbnb is great for a quick trip to London!

What an amazing stay!
Clean, amazing location and safe! Really impressed and the sweet tray was an extra cherry on the top!
10/10 would recommend to stay!

The apartment was just as described, charming and a fantastic home base for exploring London. It’s just a short walk from Old Street street station and right in the middle of the restaurants and nightlife of Shoreditch. We enjoyed our stay and would love to visit again in the future!

Isabelle is an exceptional host. She was helpful and kind but not overbearing. It would be difficult to regret staying here. Everything is brilliant: smooth check-in; clean; spacious; well-located (next door to a pub, close to underground, etc).
And her cat, Mr Darcy, is delightful and just as friendly as her!

We stayed at Daniels property for over 2 weeks whilst between flats. There are not a lot of amenities around however it is very close to bus stops, Seven Sisters tube station and overground trains. Nice neighbourhoods are a 30 min walk away. I would note that the property is situated on a main, busy road so can be very noisy at night with vehicles. Daniel is an extremely responsive host.
John was a great host, very helpful and friendly. And the apartment is just as advertised. I enjoyed my stay!

2 bedroom/2 bathroom flats aren’t all that common in London. Excellent location & walking distance to several stations as well as Hampstead. This is located in a residential neighborhood and is a flat inside a large private residence. There is some outdoor space & everything works well. There is even an electric clothes dryer which is also unusual. Excellent value for the size/location.
Great location. The apartment has everything I needed. The place is clean and looks better than the pictures. Highly recommended!
This place was perfect for me. Sadly I was here for a funeral. However, the location was ideal, and Jan was lovely, a great hostess.
The room was clean and I had a nice time at the apartment. The host was very friendly and responsive to messages. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Sergio's place was great and he and Denise were fantastic hosts. Communication was efficient and responsive and they were extremely helpful and accommodating with regards to our arrival/departure schedules.
The apartment has everything you need and is very comfortable. Despite being close to a number of pubs (which is great in the evening), the apartment was nice and quiet at nighttime.
I highly recommend the place and would be happy to stay there again in the future.

Big spacious bedroom in beautiful flat. The location and value were amazing and being able to spread out in the room was really so delightful after being on the road for a while. The bed was incredibly big and comfy!
Suzy was an exceptional host. I was a bit worried about sharing someone's space as I had never done it before but she made me feel welcome and had everything I needed. Including letting me borrow some extra hair tools and helping me with laundry. I came and went as I pleased and she was full of recommendations in the neighborhood... which is awesome. I would definitely stay again.

Choose this house if you want a comfortable stay during your stay in London.  The host is very friendly and will try to make you feel comfortable.  The interior is well and cutely decorated.  Cooking and laundry can all be done at this home.  However, i cannot hide disappointment because i found several spiders in the kitchen, especially on the countertop.  I'm very surprised as I'm not used to seeing pests in my house, but I recommend this house to those who don't care.

Safe and quiet area, clean and everything needed is supplied, good price for travelers in London.
The host is really nice and kind to reply our questions. We have a good communication.
I’ll recommend this house to my friends who will stay in London.
It good quality for money accommodation in Poplar . The apartment is clean , all utilities/ appliances are up and running . The host is responsive , cooperative and helpful .
Next to the road very easy to find. A little bit noisy at night time(you can hear the cars passing from the road). Otherwise this is the perfect place for staying.

Anne is a fantastic host! She is kind, meticulous and extremely well organized.
The room are wide and very cleaned, and beds are super comfy!
The place is very well served by buses and the train station is at just 10 minutes walk distance.

I enjoyed my stay at Starzeus' home. He was very welcoming and helpful. A cheerful face that put me and my friend at ease. He offered me and my friend a little nugget of hidden London that was a boon for us. His place is very clean, very spacious and very peaceful.  I do recommend this property for anyone looking to stay in a small town in South London for respite and/or as a base to travel into Central London for sightseeing and/or nightlife.
Wonderful little place. Tucked away nicely with no street noise. Clean with a lovely plush carpet and very comfy bed. Refreshments provided.
Conveniently located to tube stations, or a short cab ride to anywhere you need to go.

Tom's Notting Hill flat is as described, conveniently located and a great base for exploring all things London.  The tube station is just around the corner, Portobello Market is two blocks away and Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park are an easy walk.  We would gladly stay again.
Emily’s flat is fit for small family or small group to travel in London.  It is close to Borough Market and there’s a coop within a few minutes walk.
This was more than expected, everything was amazing and especially the terrace which was great to have. Location is very close to everything. Rob was amazing and helped us with everything.
All was great, well stocked, great location, good communication. We are in many nights and was very comfortable and the stay for two couples was very nice. The location couldn’t have been better.

The unit location is absolutely brilliant, close to many restaurants and the tubes. Very convenient and enjoyable. The only issue we had was the shared bathroom and toilet which were unfortunately very untidy when we used them.

It is a good apartment with top location that worth the money. Not noisy but in the centre, large rooms and comfortable bathroom.
Definitely worth a visit at Kula!

What a cute, fun place to stay in Bethnal Green! Just a two minute walk from the tube station, in an historic bldg settled over a great coffee shop [Sazzy&Fran]. We could not take our eyes off the decor and found something new every day. Clear instructions provided for everything, and the beds were really comfortable. Well-stocked kitchen. A lovely place to come home to after a day of walking around London!
We had a very nice trip, the location is perfect, the room is clean and spacious but it's very noisy, we heard everything like we were in the street and the certains aren't really usefull

Totally recommended place, particularly if you're going to the O2 for some event. The place is a walking distance of Canary Wharf Station (just one stop from the O2).
The room is spacious and Humayun is there if you need anything.
Great value and a fab location. Close to lots and also close to public transport. The little cafe around the corner called Kin was delicious too. Sofa bed was comfy too.

This is a wonderful place to stay, the flat is just as the pictures show it, perfect for a couple on a long or short stay. The location is amazing;  close to shops, restaraunts and the tube, and just around the corner from Portobello Rd. Simon is a great host, very responsive, and we will definitely be back.
Fantastic flat.  Lots of room, very comfortable, easy access, host was excellent.  Highly recommend this flat and we intend to stay again in December!

Omer is a great host, flat was amazing and very clean, Omer helped us with brand new table fan within a short time. Place is very close to shepherd bush market station hardly 5/6 minutes walking distance. There are so many good restaurants close by, 10 minutes tube to Oxford street and nearby. We’ll definitely come back to stay. Thanks Omer

Great location - so close to the station and nice and quiet! Just be wary there are quite a few steps up to the unit. Could also have been more amenities like soap in the shower and more than 1 towel provided. Overall, a comfortable stay.

This studio flat was more than enough space for one person let alone two people. The kitchen had more than enough appliances and there was shampoos, conditioners, etc offered. It was a great, quiet stay in a beautiful private patio. I absolutely recommend this to anyone who's looking for a stay in downtown London.

Lovely place in a great location. Lots of fast trains from Bromley South into the city so very convenient for travel.  Bromley town is quite large so lots of shops and restaurants there too to explore. Great hosts - very responsive.
I had a great time at Artur's place because it is clean and comfortable and has everything you could need.

The host was very kindly! And the home was very clean and wonderful.
I had a really comfortable time here. The surrounding neighborhood is safe, too. I'd like to stay here again.

Jill's apartment is comfortable, tasteful and has most everything one needs. I was there for a three-week stay for work and am glad I booked. The pictures don't do it full justice and the garden itself offered a wonderful place for breakfast or an evening cocktail. This is a fully functioning flat and has basic utensils/appliances for self-catering (I even baked pizzas with the counter-top microwave-convection combo oven).
One caveat is that this part of London did NOT offer great cell phone signal for my international carrier (G@ogle Fi), and unfortunately Jill's wifi seemed on the fritz during much of my stay. That meant I had to go to coffee shops to work, download, upload, etc. more than I would have liked. Raynes Park is pretty convenient for that.
Perfect little studio apartment, has all the amenities. Super cozy in the cold weather. Great location, easy communication.

This apartment worked for our quick stay in London, though if we had stayed longer it might not have been the most comfortable. As mentioned in the listing and noted in others reviews, it is quite tricky to get up to loft sleeping area so definitely be sure to look into it before booking. The location was great, close to the tube and a bus stop, a good home base for exploring local Portobello Road as well as other London spots further out.

What a perfect stay - probably the best Airbnb we have ever visited. We came with our 9 month old baby. Everything was spotless and well kept, very spacious floorplan, and Lynn was very prompt with communication. Wouldn't change a thing.

Our stay was perfect, the apartment was very clean and included everything we needed and even more! A very good view from the balcony, beautiful sunsets. I loved our stay and would definitely come back again. There was about a 12 minute walk to the tube however but it wasn’t much of an issue.

We stayed at a few air bnbs while in London and this was hands down our favourite. Host is friendly and easy to communicate with. Location is very central including walking distance to lots of coffee shops, restaurants, beauty salons. Apartment is very clean with necessary items. Bathroom has a towel warmer which is a great feature! Overall loved our stay. Would absolutely book here again in the future.
Great location, room was clean and comfortable, the only issue I had was poor communication between Inge upon arrival. Nonetheless, amazing Airbnb!
Highly recommended. Great value and location perfect for a single traveller on holiday or just a weekend break. Close to transport links across London including the underground.
Great location near to three subway stations. Quiet neighborhood but an easy walk to surrounding areas,  several good food and drink places nearby.
We absolutely adored Crashpads Shoreditch. It was clean, comfortable, and very well located, and we would happily stay there or another Crashpads location again in the future.

This place was absolutely fantastic.  This why my wife and it’s first trip to London, and we felt right at home here.  We loved the Chelsea area, and it’s proximity to most places throughout London. We would certainly stay here again!

Tess’s little basement apartment was cute and conveniently located for us. The listing is accurate to what it says and we enjoyed our stay. The only thing I will say is just be aware the stairs to get inside are steeper side other than that no complaints. Tess was super fast to respond always and answered any question I had.

Great little room to stay at, very close to Greenwich Village, the Cutty Sark and the Maritime Musem, with all kinds of fine restaurants. This location is especially good if you are doing the London Marathon, as it is a short walk to the starting area.
Really recommend, pictures don't do it justice and much bigger in real life! Great location and would stay again

My stay with Vladimir was very pleasant. The room is a large size and it’s in a good location close to Stockwell. The house was clean with all the basic amenities. Vladimir himself was very polite and nice. Would highly recommend!

Perfect place to stay in London. Three subway stations are very close to Christian´s place.  Also possibility to use the kitchen was a great value for me.  I would book the same place again if my way will bring me back to London. Recommend also to others.
We had a lovely stay, very close to Kew Gardens and access to public transport within 10-12 minutes. We did not meet Rosie, but she kept in touch via email. We will come again
Lovely area and a fun guesthouse-vibe in a beautiful house. Sure, the shower can be tricky and it's a bit dusty here and there - but it's a great place if you're not fussy, and Frank's a great guy.

John was very helpful with organizing a parking permit, and had great communication, however the Appartment did have a funky smell due to it being a basement Appartment and an old building, the pictures were not an accurate depiction of the Appartment, the the bedroom being set out in a different manner, with no tv, and the back yard not kept to the standard of the photo, kettle was dirty and the cutlery wasn’t very clean, and there were a lot of down lights that needed to be replaced, with mad it hard it the dark,  however the location was fantastic and if your not as fussy as me you’ll enjoy your stay,

Great location, super clean flat, and easy check-in. I'd definitely stay here again.
One thing to note, there isn't a lift, so if you have large luggage or if you don't like walking up stairs, you might not want to consider staying here. However, the stairs didn't bother me and didn't affect my stay!
Best location. The room was  kept clean and tidy all the time. room 5 is a bit noisy. Closest room to the main entrance of the building and you hear the buzz of the main door at nights.
Clare is a very nice and easygoing person. Her apartment is amazing. It was a 10/10 for us. Will recommend it 100%

Really grea location. Pretty quiet street just a couple blocks away from big city life.
Place was a decent size, a full small apartment. A bit spendy, but it is London. Only areas for improvement are the lack of a dryer and the bed being a bit worn in. Enjoyed our stay.

Tracy's apartment is very nice and cosy. It's like a museum with all the vintage stuff.
The mattrasses of the beds are a bit hard/old. But other than that; it's an awesome place.

My review’s based on a 10 day stay at this bnb.
I couldn’t recommend this place more if all you want is a smooth, and hassle free experience.
Lukas and Mali go above and beyond to make sure you feel at home while you’re living with them. They’re a kind, easygoing couple and it was always fun to have a lil chat with them. They’ve kept me up to date about everything and are just a text away from sorting any queries you might have. The aspects that I appreciated most about this accommodation, would be, how tidy it was all the time, the privacy they allow you, and the ease of access (5-6 min) to the southall station + a 25 min drive to the airport if you’re travelling. The only ordeal for me at this bnb would be lack of network in the room that I was in, however their wifi worked perfectly fine which helped loads.
The apartment is great for a couple and very well located. It has all kitchen utensils, good hair dryer and bathroom items. We really enjoyed staying there!

We had an amazing time at Harriet’s wonderful place during our week long stay in London.
The house was great and felt really warm and cozy - comfortable living room and dining area, good fully equipped kitchen that leads into a small outside garden and a clean and comfortable bathroom.
The area is easy to walk around and there’s few public transportation options in a walking distance. Also, some great coffee shops and restaurants are less than 15 mins walk - so you can easily start or end your day close to home.
The communication with Harriet was easy and smooth and we would definitely recommend staying at her place.

This is a great little place to settle while being out and about in the Notting Hill area. Great location near all sorts of activities, dining, bustling or quiet -- depending on what you like. The loft area was just a bit taller than me (5'6''), so my 6' partner had to stoop -- worth knowing if you're tall. And, the galley ladder up to the loft means you need to pay attention (even in the middle of the night if you need to use the bathroom!) :-) There's just enough of exactly what we needed in the kitchenette. This was a great landing pad to recover from our jet lag at the beginning of our London vacation!

Amazing location; within walking distance to Fulham Broadway & Imperial Wharf which made using public transport easy, house was nicely decorated and checking in and out was super easy. Would recommend for anyone wanting to stay in Chelsea.
The apartment was nice and comfy as in the pictures. The host replied relatively fast. There was an issue with the bed but the host was fast to reply and hopefully that has been fixed.
Highly recommend! Jodie and James is a very nice host. Fast response and good communication with guest. The place is very good and warm that provide enough private space.
Sadly, I had to miss this stay, but my friend went with her parents instead. The location and place was great for their trip.

Fantastic room that's incredibly well kept in a very handy spot that's right beside Canary Wharf. Speedy internet too!
Thanks to Humayun for being such a welcoming and responsive host.
Charming unit in an amazing location. There are wonderful restaurants and pubs a short walk away. Convenient to the underground and Thameslink. We would definitely stay again!

Such a cute little place and perfect location! Great for a few nights in London on our honeymoon but might not be suitable for anyone who has issues with a lot of stairs. Access to laundry on top floor was an nice perk!! Would definitely recommend and would stay again! Thanks for everything!
Inge was a very nice and friendly host ,thank you for making me feel at home 😊

Monica’s place is amazingly located in a lovely and safe neighborhood, best part of UK I’d say. It’s so easy to get around with multiple bus lines and subway. The place itself is also very cozy and clean. I really enjoyed my stay.
Monica is a great host, constantly checking in on me to make sure I’m doing great. Would definitely recommend this lovely place to others traveling to London.
A perfect place to stay for a solo traveler. Close to every store you’d need and the tube! Easy to reach host regarding any questions.
Lovely little place for my stay throughout London! Andrew was very helpful and the place had everything needed for a pleasant stay. Nice location & not too far from transport.

Everything looked exactly the same as shown in the pictures.Rosie was a very kind and helpful host.She answered all the enquiries and questions.
It took us 15 mins walking from kew gardens to the place.
From kew gardens station,it's easy to navigate around london.
There are alot of shops at kew gardens station and you can easily get anything you want.
Neighbors are friendly too.
Overall i enjoyed the stay there.Just that you need to walk alot from the place to the tube station.

Our 5 night stay with two teenagers was lovely. Clapham is a great neighborhood with supermarkets, pubs and restaurants right around the corner. The apartment was very cozy and questions that came up regarding the heat were answered immediately.
I used to stay at Geoff's house twice. This is a really good place, the room is spacious and silent, with the large comfortable bed. The location is just 10 mins from Oval station. Highly recomended!

We really enjoyed our stay! The flat was comfortable and in a great location. It was our 1st time to London. My daughter and I felt safe and comfortable with everything! We were able to walk to dinner every night after touring London by Uber and the tube.  We look forward to coming back in the future! I would completely recommend this stylist stay!

We had a great stay at Tay and Marina‘s Airbnb. We stayed in the Mimosa room. When we had a question about something they responded right away. The location suited us really well, a bus stop is right outside the door and Liverpool Street Station as well as Shoreditch High Street are close. I can really recommend it.
Perfect cheap place for a layover/ early morning flight. Walls are very thin. But does the job.

Great location and quite quiet for such a central location.  Well laid out apartment and nicely decorated.  Good local shops, restaurants and pubs.  Very good value for money and hope to come back again.

If you really want an amazing stay in London, this place is WORTH booking!! Very friendly and caring hosts! Everything you read in the description details is 100% accurate. The place is extremely clean, hosts make sure that if anything is required- it’s provided. Booking here will really make your stay memorable! 5/5⭐️
Absolutely loved my time at Suzy’s, the room is great and Suzy is super lovely and welcoming. Definitely recommend!
We had a great stay here, the apartment was beautiful, spotless and in a wonderful area. Can highly recommend!

I had a wonderful 8 night stay at Dahlias apartment, it was very clean and very well equipped. I can’t think of anything extra the apartment needed.
Kitchen, fully equipped with everything needed for your stay.
Bathroom, a nice deep bath and good water pressure for shower plus hair care products
Very comfortable bed with quality bedding, plenty of wardrobe space., nice small balcony off bedroom.
The apartment is in a very safe and secure building with a 24hr concierge.
I had a few minor glitches during my stay but these were dealt with immediately by Dahlia, her communication and follow up to make sure everything was working was exceptional.
A very comfortable apartment with lovely views especially at sunset.
Can highly recommend.

Great location, great stay and great host! Host was very responsive to my messages, they made the check in process very smooth! The apartment looked exactly how there were in the picture! Only thing I could fault is that it can get quite hot in the apartment and there is no AC. Other than that i would highly recommend this place

Very clean and lots of nice touches (loved the hot water bottles). Great location and very spacious for us. We were two couples and had plenty of privacy. Neha was always quick to respond to messages and give advice on the area. There’s a parking spot a 1 minute walk away on JustPark and on street it is free on Saturdays and Sundays. Fab host!

Really nice appartment. The location was good, a lot of bars and restaurants around it.
Good public transport communication.
Communication and check in very good. Suited our needs for the night. Location good for Kings Cross.

Sarah was a great host - very responsive and accommodating. The flat was in a good location, conveniently located for access to the Tube. Yhe room was great, had everything we needed. Would highly recommend!

This is a lovely, well-located apartment just a few minutes' walk from the nearest tube station (Kentish Town). There are two bright double rooms, and a dining lounge/kitchen which has everything we needed. Camden market is about 15 minutes' walk.
There's a convenience store just up the street, and there are loads of interesting, independent cafes, restaurants and retailers in the area.

Great location. Julia's sister was very helpful.
Big lovely room.
Great place if you don't mind walking up with your suitcase 3 flight of stairs
Amazing place , clean and spacious , lovely complimentary coffee machine , Daniel was very friendly and a welcoming host . Will definitely visit again soon

I had a great stay in Evelyn's room.
Comfortable bed ,nice privet bathroom ,shower and easy transportation to the city center of London.
Great communication and care from Evelyn
Harriet’s place is lovely and cozy! Excellent for a small group. Location has easy access to east London
An amazing place to stay! Would highly recommend. The checking in process was really easy and we had a comfortable stay. We felt really welcomed and Jadin was very considerate.
Rooms are as described. Great location near Victoria station in a fairly quiet place in London. WiFi is fixed.

Perfectly located in the center of London, this spot is great for those who plan to stay for a few days. You have everything you need in this airbnb, public transport is within walking distance, meaning all the hotspots are very close. We found the only downside to be the bed. It was too hard, the pillows weren’t for us. Apart from that, everything was good- great even!

Isabelle was a wonderful host - Welcoming, friendly and very helpful with her London knowledge.
You feel very much you’re sharing her home. Our flat was comfortable and absolutely perfect for our needs.
The location is also very handy for reaching all over London on public transportWe couldn’t have been looked after better.

I can highly recommend the apartment. Location is perfect . You can reach Oxford Street, Theatre Land, the British Museum and a lot more by foot. But the underground is also nearby. The flat was big enough for me and my adult son that we did not have to share a bedroom. So it was a relaxing here holiday. Everything that’s necessary was in the apartment and check in was easy. I would like to come back again.
Very small but perfect for two people. Location was great, just a few minutes to a couple different tube lines. Lots of restaurants nearby as well. Loved it!

It is a nice, spacious flat with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room and a kitchen. Everything was nice and clean, communication was quick and professional, both arrival and departure went as announced. For the centre of London, the price was great, too. The place is really close (some 900 meters?) to both London Bridge and Tower Bridge, and there is an amazing view of London skyline from the balcony (you can see the Shard, Gherkin and all the famous scysrapers). We enjoyed our stay here a lot.
Booking the place for the second time here! Honestly, the hosts are super cooperative and very understanding! They’ll guide you through out if you’re new to the city!! A must book Airbnb!!

A home away from home, for my first few weeks in London.
Starzeus was a warm and welcoming host, and gave me lots of tips for navigating the city. The house was very comfortable, with a private bathroom to myself. The weather was a bit too cold to enjoy the deck but it must be lovely in summer.
Easy walking distance to the station and the shops, and regular buses a few hundred metres down the road.

This was a great clean, roomy flat in a quiet residential location. An easy walk to restaurants and cafes on Munster Road, Fulham Palace Road and Fulham Road, just keep in mind this part of Fulham doesn't have great tube access. We had trouble with the radiators but the temperatures never dipped below low 60s and VanZyl made a concession to compensate us for the trouble. In all, very satisfied with the property and would definitely return.

Thank you for another wonderful stay! The Rookery location is delightful, right on the Common. The unit is spacious, well appointed and has a lovely garden. It is a great home away from home.
Lynn and Mike

I didn’t get to explore the area but it was easy to get to the central. The room gets cold but there’s a heater in the room. There were 9 rooms in total but it didn’t seem too busy which was nice. The roof top was beautiful

Nothing more than I can say about Sandra’s place other than that it was perfect accommodation! Communication was perfect, apartment was modern and comfortable and for football fans out there, right next to the Emirates Stadium which made for some perfect snaps!
Would 100% stay again and highly recommend anyone else to do the same!

We have the best airbnb experience
with Isabella and lovly Mr. Darci. We were given very good breakfast and we borrowed umbrellas in rainy days.
Isabella is very friendly host and we had interesting conversations about our common interest: art and design.

This is the perfect Air B and B. Spacious, stylish, comfortable and a home away from home. It is a flat full of character with a lovely kitchen, big bathroom,and most importantly the bed is comfortable and the shower is great! Although it is in the heart of trendy Dalston, it is on a quiet leafy road.  This was our second stay.  As locals, we needed somewhere for a few days whilst building work was going on. I have to admit, I was so pleased I had the excuse to stay again!  Alexi is also a great communicator - responsive and personable.

Max and Billie were wonderfully attentive in their response. Their home is clean and tidy, with many short-stay essentials. It is a small and tight apartment-style room. The bed is accessed through a ladder-like stair case and if you have a hard time accessing steep stairs, I would look elsewhere. The room is located in a great area of Nottinghill, close to the busy street, yet quite at night
Great place and excellent communication with the owner. We had an excellent time in a large and confortable house.

Perfectly located house, close to transportation and amenities. Would be great for a family of 4 as advertised if the convertible couch in the living room was not broken (as such the stay was very uncomfortable for two of us).
Worth the value, but the walls and ceilings were dirty and it is very humid and cold in the room. Also you are rushed to check out before the checkout time.

We were up for the weekend for the rugby and Vikash's AirBnB is in a great location and easy to find. Everything was clean and felt like a home away from home.
The beds were comfy and there were extra pillows in the cupboard which we found on night 2.
We will absolutely stay again next time we are up in Twickenham.

Had a business trip in London and stayed at James’ place with my family. Being new to the city, this location is absolutely perfect and beautiful. Everything is in walking distance and we were greeted by Andy, a sweet guy, who helped us around and showed us the place as well! This house is absolutely gorgeous and even better than the photos shown. Highly recommended!!

Gorgeous stay in a really fun part of town! Lots of art, shops and restaurants close by. Keep in mind it’s a very lively part of the city with a younger population so activities regularly go well into the night. The provided earplugs were very useful :) no worries for us though! We loved the excitement and seeing all there was to see in Shoreditch
Everything was fine, very close to Notting Hill Gate Underground, we‘ve had a nice stay in London! No problems at all.

the place is really like home. everything is avaliable. stayed 8 nights, the washing machine and clothes iron and dishwasher is avaliable. saved my business trip. the location is great, next to the police station, and 6 m walking from the tube. the hosting representative is kind, answering really fast and helped me check in early. the neighbors are so kind also. greatrestaurants near by as well.

Comfortable stay - only small problem was one of the electrical power circuits tripping out around 8am this morning
The lighting circuit was not affected
Above was as I reported to Bipin in my telephone call this morning
Very nice and clean flat. Andrew was very communicative and helpful. We had a great stay.

Stephane’s place is well located and transport was easy to access. The flat is clean and functional and directions and access to it good. There is a lovely park, Ravenscourt, nearby and a good pub, the Duchess, with great food.
We had just the best time here. The location is fantastic and the apartment is beautifully maintained. Highly recommended.

Needed a place to stay whilst in London for a conference, the property was in a great location with easy access to public transport.
The host John was informative, polite and quick to respond to my questions.
The property itself was very clean, spacious and was as described in the advert, I will definitely stay here again the next time I am in London.
We had a great stay and will definitely be back. Beautifully equipped apartment with thoughtful extra touches. Great location also. Really recommend.

The apartment was right in the heart of Camden Town and easy access to Camden and a short walk/ bus ride into London. The apartment was well appointed and provided everything for our stay. The lounge room is facing south allowing for morning and afternoon sun. The kitchen is large  enabling ability to cook a meal.   Overall a great place to stay ! -

A lovely house with a lot of space -and a pretty courtyard. Tania is a very helpful and friendly host. You can get everywhere easily from the house and it’s quiet. There even is a little park right in front of it.
We loved it and would love to come back.

Fantastic host and perfect location.
Thanks Vladimir for the lovely stay and your kindness, it was lovely meeting you.
Vladimir made my stay the easiest and most comfortable stay ever. Very flexible and welcoming, I would recommend anyone !
Fab place, Nwike as a host was great and helpful regarding my stay. I would absolutely recommend as the stay is in a great location too.

The place is clean and spacious and safe , very close to local shops . The host Daniel is always very helpful .the cleaners were also very nice and cleaned the place spotless . I would definitely visit again .
Lovely place to stay, perfect for family staying in london. Very homely. Police station nearby so lots of sirens but this was quite exciting for our 3 year old and didn't affect our sleep.
Was my pleasure staying at Sovans place. The communication was very good and I felt quite comfortable. Thank you!
Had a lovely stay and Inge was a great host! Location could be a bit noisy as it was next to a main road, but very close to shops and a tube station.
The location is great, right around the corner from King's Cross Station making getting just about anywhere quick, easy, and accessible! Well furnished and very comfortable!

Location was great and property was okay if you were on your own. The place needed some work doing. Everything just needs a touch of paint and some care to get it into better shape. Place didn’t feel that clean. Lots of marks

A great place! The bed was comfortable, the bath great. A small but adorable place right next to shortditch station.
Branca let us leave our luggage after check out and was quick to respond.
we recommend!
It was a lovely stay! The room was clean and looked exactly in the photos. For those who have big luggages though, it can be quite a challenge as the room is on the top floor and there is no lift.

What are find! Clare’s apartment is beautiful, clean, clutter free &!close to amenities and links into the city centre. It was a pleasure contacting her as she responded promptly usually within an hour …nothing too much trouble & She clearly took great pride in making sure I’ll stay special.
Can’t recommend Clare’s apartment enough

Lovely place to stay in except that rooms and washroom on the lower level would have made our stay very comfortable 😊
Will recommend though:)

Definitely will come back here. Such a lovely house in a lovely neighbourhood. Fully furnished and laundry is next to this house. The host is very resposive and helpful. The neighbours are all so kind. No regrets booking this house

Simple flat 2 blocks away from Kings Cross. Sainsbury Local downstairs.
Once access to the unit was gained, everything went smoothly.

Great house! not far from the tube( about 8-10 mins)
Well decorated and equiped house. Even if we didn't meet Graeme in person we were texting and everything was allright !
I recommend

The stay was very pleasant. The rooms and the bathroom were clean.
Bus connection to the tube was very convenient. Taking a bus to canning Town or Custom House could take you to central London relatively quickly depending on where you wanted to go.
There's also a convenience store below the apartment, which helped as well.

This was a 5 star host and airbnb.  Very clean and timely communication, generous hospitality.   Wonderful place so spacious and modern close many within walking distance to everything we needed - shops, restaurants, transportation.  We would absolutely recommend Lynn’s place.

We enjoyed our time in Londen very much.
With the busstop around the corner, shadwell and whitechapel station nearby it was easy to travel to the centrum of the city and back. It is even doable to go back and forward for a relax-break between a morning and evening program. Sometimes the body needs a little rest form al the sightseeing 😉.
The appartement was clean and well equipped. The bed however is a bit small. For our mother and daughter trip Nazim’s place was perfect: easy startpoint for sightseeing (during the day ) and relaxing in the evening, with good wifi and Netflix (since that is very important for a 15 year old).

Best place to stay in London! In the heart of city centre,close to subway,yet quite neighborgood with few nice coffe places and restaurants.Paolo and George were super helpfull,giving us some so much needed tips from locals.The apartment is perfect-bed is comfy,kitchen is well equipped and the Netflix and couch is very usefull as well:)Definately recommended!!!

Rosario is a good host and clearly cares about the experience of whoever is staying. Most places just supply the necessities but she goes further by offering water, some food, toiletries and more. She has some house rules, but they're standard but worth knowing about. Overall I was happy with the stay, location and host. Thank you Rosario.

Very close to the Kentish Town station, very convenient, lots to do. Rue was delightful to work with - highly professional, friendly, and responsive. Would definitely stay in one of Rue's properties again.

The location and apartment was perfect. Just about 10 mins away from the train station. The apartment was spacious, quite accessible and near to Sainsbury's.
The downside was the washing machine which was spoiled and somehow ruined our clothes as the dryer isn't working and eventually the whole washing machine stops functioning. It took days for them to send someone down to check despite us informing them for days and at the end they cant do anything about it. It was a bummer as we have a toddler that needs clean clothing but we are not able to wash it as we stayed for more than a week. Hope they will check their equipment before listing out to the next guests.
The room is well situated for buses into Central London. Whilst it is on the main road it is incredibly quiet.

Helen was great and flexible, clean cozy room overall great, the only thing is the bed had a dip in middle and if you’re over 6ft tall you won’t be able to stretch out legs fully.  Well worth the price and right in China town/soho lots of action and people right outside. Thank you Helen!
Location was super convenient but the place is very small and not kept very well. The shower was full of mold and the toilet seat was smaller than the toilet.

Mr Ashok was so friendly and welcoming person. The room is big, clean and warm enough, also there is a small heater if you need.
the private bathroom is clean too.
I recommend this place 100% for a short time staying, long staying might be a bit hard beacuse you don't have access to kitchen and washing machine.
but everything is perfect.

Very good airbnb service.neat and clean room.robin was very helpful
even though I checked in late overnight.bus stop to Heathrow Airport is just outside the airbnb ,takes only 10 mins to reach terminal 5.
Hazel was wonderful and very accommodating from the start. She is a great hostess who pampered us very much. The place is super cozy and relaxed. Gladly again.

James is friendly and helpful and went the extra mile and picked me up and dropped me off at a moments notice when my bus failed to arrive. The bedroom and bathroom is lovely, and it’s real value for money. I would definitely recommend this as value for money. Very close to the airport!

Lovely apartment, very clean and in a beautiful area. The only issue we had was with the shower which didn’t work properly. Apart from this the bed was comfy, there was tea and coffee provided and it had a lovely little balcony
Jan is the perfect host! Amazing room - very comfortable. Check in all very easy. Jan went above and beyond to ensure my stay was good. Thank you.
Marijana's place was perfect for our two night stay.  clean and cosy.  with everything we needed.

you can't fault the location, with Notting hill and Bayswater tube stations within easy walking distance. the flat was compact and clean and communication with the host was perfect...always responsive. we had 4 adults and 2 children and the space was ample. the amenities were as described.

very nice&clean studio appartment very quiet with alot of privacy!!!10min walk to east croydon station from there u connect quick to london bridge.Gary&Bianca pass u all the info on how to check in and more ,very friendly hosts!my stay was excellent🥰🙏🏽
Super convenient location, very spacious flat and communication with Lisa was absolutely perfect. Would definitely stay again.
Very cute and cozy place! The host was great with communication and helpful. Would definitely recommend this place as a stay.

We had a great time at Ana's flat. It was very clean and warm. Ana was great at responding all the queries and giving support. The place is quite and close to tubes stop and at few minutes walking to hide park. We do recommend stayingat Ana.

Loved staying here. Very charming and comfortable place I felt lucky to call home for 2 weeks. Spacious, airy, and serene, with beautiful light all day. Really close to the very convenient Earl's Court station on a pretty, quiet street. If you have lots of luggage stairs will be a bit of a pain, but at least the flights aren't very high (not an issue once you've settled in) and being high up makes the place feel very private. Bonus: a great selection of books to dip into, mostly history with some fiction and art books. I hope to stay here again, especially in the warmer months to make use of the spectacular terrace.
Nice spacious place! Lots of stairs but got help in carrying our bags up so that was very nice!

It was a great stay at a great property.
The hosts were responsive and helpful.
They even posted one of our colleagues' mobile phones left by accident, going the extra mile.
I would recommend

A very good apartment
Next to the hydepark
A great location and absolutely clean👍🏻👍🏻

Great apartment. Stayed from Friday till Sunday. Good location for getting around London. Lidl food shop literally around the corner which was handy.  Yea coffee and sugar provided but nothing else if wanting to cook.
The location is great, near the subway, in a safe neighborhood. The flat is very clean, and Tina’s is kind and helpful, i recommend !!

The room in which we stayed and the whole apartment was super clean and the surroundings are quite and there are several Cafes, Restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The host ist very friendly and welcomed us warmly in London. Thank you very much!

The studio was clean, and basically with all needed appliances, such as hairdryer. Even though it is quite far from the center of London, you can get to Victoria station with one train and one bus (if you don’t fancy walking 15mins to the train station). It doesn’t take long, so it is a very good location. Price of this airbnb was really good, so you really can’t ask for more. There are shops nearby, if you need to buy anything. The instructions about everything were really clear, and you can even find literally a book inside the studio with all the information you can need. Host was very responsive, so if you need anything he will help you really fast.

Great location, great host, and the place was just right for the price. There’s a pub on the corner, a convenience store nearby, and Dalston Junction very close for easy transportation around London. Really interested in staying here or at another of Shaz’s rentals. 5/5 all around.
Easy to find and excellent if near canary wharf area. Clean place, good host and comfortable
Amazing host, warm friendly and a real pleasure to stay here , Jan will make you feel at home from the start

Thank you Ashok for hosting me and for your helpful travel advice; it was truly a pleasure meeting and chatting with you.
The room was lovely and incredibly quiet and peaceful, and each morning a beautiful breakfast was served. Everything was just perfect! Thank you so much for hosting me.

The check in process was easy and communication excellent with the host. We were a bit disappointed by how small the apartment  was, and think accommodating more than 4 people there would be difficult, especially with only one tiny bathroom. The sofa bed was not very comfortable. Apartment was very clean and other beds very comfortable. Great location for walking to transport/ pubs and Kensington gardens.

Nice flat, excellent location, within easy walking distance of public transport. Quiet, no traffic or people noise. Some nice cafes and restaurants close by. Very flexible with dropping off luggage early and keeping it for us after check out.

The apartment is in a great location, opposite Liverpool street station and in an area with lots of restaurants, bars and shops. Unfortunately the heating didn’t work at all in the bedroom and didn’t work well in the living room. As a result it was very cold in the apartment, which couldn’t be fixed during my stay.
Staying in London on business, easy to find and access. Information from host was very useful. Flat was warm and shower was great.

We had a really lovely stay here. Our room was beautiful and the en-suite was modern and well designed.  The bed was very comfortable and the room clean and warm.  Our host was very kind and helpful and looked after our dietary needs too for breakfast which was lovely.  Thank you for a great stay - we will be back!

Agat is a gracious host. His home is clean and well kept. His home is close to the airport and the train station. It’s easy to get on the Elizabeth line from his home.
He makes every stay comfortable by providing basic amenities.

I can’t recommend this lovely apartment enough, it’s actually even nicer than the photos. Andrew was a fantastic host, really proactively communicative and was so clear in his instructions. The flat itself is beautifully presents and cosy, the bed is comfy and it feels very homely! Perfect for a weekend trip to london and Surrey :)
Starzeus was an amazing host and an even better friend throughout my stay. His home was warm, clean, and he did everything he could to make my stay comfortable. Can’t wait to stay with him again. 💙

Daniel was an amazing host, extremely helpful and quick when it came to communication. The place was clean and well maintained. Walking distance to the nearest underground train station,  close to local shops and grocery stores. The view was spectacular at night. Definitely would stay again and recommend for those looking for a private and safe stay in London . 10/10 thank you, Daniel 🙏🏽

We had a great stay at Paolo’s apartment. It’s definitely small for 3 people but absolutely fine if you are planning to be out most of the time. The location was perfect, almost everything was walkable and the area felt very safe even at night. Also only a short drive from the main international train station. Would highly recommend!

Hazel is an amazing host! For me, represented  lovely  moments at her home to experience my first travel to London and feel part of it.  BTW Hazel breakfasts are great :). Absolutely recommended!!  You can find  overground subway station 10 min walking, and also bus stops to approach you to conection points for tourist places. Hopefully I could repeat at Hazel´s.

Carolyn place is near to the metro within 7 minutes walk .
Her response to our inquiries are always prompt and helpful.
We have a great stay there. We would like to thank Carolyn for extending our stay till 1 pm .

It is a lovely split level apartment. The large lounge is furnished beautifully with comfortable seating, TV, PlayStation, a comfortable desk area and eating area. The kitchen and bathroom were spotless and well appointed. The bed was very comfortable. We chose a freezing cold week to stay and the heating worked really well and was warm and cosy.
It is a short walk from Twickenham centre and the green. There are plenty of eating places, coffee shops and artisan stores along with Sainsbury's, Tesco's and Waitrose.
I highly recommend this apartment. Andrew gave us very clear instructions and was available to quickly answer questions throughout our stay. Thank you Andrew, we had a lovely break

Location: Really convenient for public transport, buses to Hammersmith, Kensington and Chelsea, plus two Tube Stations within short walking distance (Parsons Green and Fulham Broadway both on the District Line).
Accommodation: Very chic and comfortable ground floor flat where you have your own living room and bathroom, all very tastefully furnished and decorated. Extra touches such as the towelling robes and slippers really appreciated.
Breakfast: Excellent, continental breakfast comprising of Cereals, fresh fruits, juice, toast and homemade preserves plus coffee and teas.
Host: Isabelle is an amazing person, so helpful and makes you feel at home. I cannot praise her enough and nothing is too much trouble for her. She has a in-depth knowledge of both the surrounding area and central London which is so useful especially if you are short of time. In addition, her adorable Tabby cat, Mr Darcey truly makes you feel at home!
Good decent place for a short stay. I would recommend if they could add some tea coffee options in the kitchen. A tv to the room would also be good.
The place was fantastic! George was lovely and Paolo was very responsive. The only thing I could’ve asked for would’ve been a comfier mattress, it felt really uncomfortable.

Great host, very respectful and responsive.
The apartment is beautiful and clean, we really enjoyed our stay.
Would definitely recommend.

Isabelle is a perfect host, very friendly and tentative, her home is warm cosy clean and comfortable and she makes you feel right at home instantly, staying with Isabelle made our weekend even more perfect, we will definitely be visiting again and would highly recommend it. Lisa and Stewart

Everything was great with the apartment. Clean, modern, and beautiful. The only Challenge is how far the reception is from the apartment. So you would have to talk a five to 10 minutes walk to the reception whenever you have a delivery or expecting a guest. Which is quite stressful

we had such a nice weekend in the apartment.  dahlia was a very friendly hostess.  the stay was very clean and large.  the neighborhood was very safe and we had a great view of the london skyline.  we will definitely be back next year.
Geoff’s place was ok. Clean house and room. It was a little bit far from the main touristic attractions I think. Not so friendly at they describe themselves, but as helpful as they could.

Great tiny house for a good price! It had everything we needed for our month in London. Every time we had a question or needed something James and Jodie were able to help us out. The hotplate in the kitchen only has one burner which makes cooking a bit more time consuming but it was still good enough to make some decent meals. The location was great, the house is close (6 & 17 minutes) to two different train stations which made it easy to get into London. We would definitely come back!

My family & I truly enjoyed our stay at Slobodan’s. The entire place is well equipped, very clean & super comfortable. Olga is very nice & friendly. Thumbs up to both host & hostess for providing the best and making our stay a memorable one!
Best neighbourhood and location, cool interior and friendly host! Thanks for the uncomplicated and great stay Tom.
Amazing stay. Truly the best neighborhood and location. The space was spotless, had anything you would need. Branca was extremely responsive and helpful, we would love to stay here again

Thank you Simon for a great week in your flat! The location can't be beat with easy access to the tube and bus stops! Not to mention restaurants and pubs. The flat is spacious, clean and just as described. We appreciate your wonderful and timely communication - would definitely recommend your place to any friends heading to London!
Best place I ever stayed , The house was so clean and quiet, I was there for one week never heard anyone talk. Monique was so respectful and responsive, check in was great. Definitely recommend it
Jennie's apartment  is very clean  and  so close to the underground. She replied me quite quickly and answered all my questions. The flat is very comfy.

Amanda was a great host - she gave us clear instructions for check-in, lots of great local information and was very responsive.  The flat was super cozy, clean and welcoming.  Easy to walk to shops, public transportation and restaurants.  I would definitely book again.

It was a nice apartment, just a bit smaller than expected from the photos. Good communication from the owner. Uncomfortable sofa bed. Good location for access to lots of places to visit and easy access to food shops and public transport.

The location of the apartment is close to the underground station, which is really convenient for travelers. There is cleaner to clean the apartment everyday, which is great. Overall, it was a great experience to stay in the apartment.
A lovely flat very close to the underground station, Tina is always nice to talk to, and the room was extremely clean.
Anna’s place is great. Everything impecable clean. Nice quiet place and kind neighbourhood .We had a problem with leaking on kitchen but she solved it out. I recommend

Great spot in Notting Hill! Close walk to everything we wanted to do in the area (only a couple minutes walk to Portobello Markets) and so close to the train station. The space itself was clean and spacious and the interior was beautiful and well decorated. Felt very homey.
Tania is a lovely host! Great spot, and perfect for our family of four. Thank you!
The location place is nice and strategic near to hackney central. House is nice and clean and private property.

Lots of positives:
Great central location
Relatively quiet considering area
Compact yet more than adequate space
Bed very comfortable - took away our achy backs after lugging around backpacks most of the day.

Convenient location, huge supermarket right across the street. It’s a very quiet,  clean and safe neighborhood. The sofa bed also very comfortable (considering to get one for my own home). The house is quite warm as well, we didn’t need to turn on the heater most of the time. Aj is very responsive and provided step by step check in instruction. We had a lovely stay. Thank you AJ!

Kate and Tom are great hosts. It was so easy to communicate with them and we enjoyed our stay at their lovely and cosy home very much.
I booked their place this Christmas for a reunion with my family and we had a very comfortable and joyful stay. Their house is very lively with plenty of space and everything one might need. It’s really a home away from home. The spacious kitchen allowed us to cook together and gathered us around the table each morning and evening and we had so much fun playing boardgames.
They had also decorated a Christmas tree which completed our seasonal joy.
In terms of commute Bounds Green station is only 10 minutes walk and it takes you directly to central london and there are some food shops near the station. There is also an off licence 2 mins away from the house which is really handy.
I highly recommend Kate and Toms place.
Cosy place in a quiet neighborhood with easy access to public transport. Stephane was a very responsive host and our stay was very enjoyable!
Easy check in, very private and the pictures are accurate. There are many amazing restaurants within walking distance.

Was a very helpful host and allowed us to check in early, sent us helpful instructions with finding the property. Communicated with us throughout the trip regarding places we could go. Only about 5 minutes transport from Canary Wharf, great view from apartment rooftop

The feel was as it should be for the concept of AirBnB.  Professional but more personal and open than a hotel booking.  Most importantly a host that understands the concept of flexibility and coziness that Airbnb culture was built for and differentiates it from standard hotel bookings.
Fantastic place close to everything. Very clean and compact - has everything you need for a short stay in London!
It was a lovely stay, Damini and Ashok are great hosts and made us felt at home. Their place is beautiful and easy to reach by tube and bus.

Great location. The place is lovely, quiet and well furnished,
Giovanna has accommodated everything we might need,
I highly recommend this flat.

We booked very last minute yet hosts were so quick to respond made everything easy for us. I would definitely visit again. Hosts were very kind and friendly. Place is actually better than you see it on the photo.
Great place with great energy!

Very beautiful apartment, perfect for couple stay near Canary Wharf. Host was extremely responsive. Key pickup was slightly awkward, but not ridiculously difficult. Only issue we had was cleanliness in the apartment, the dishes were dirty from previous tenants and there were things left behind such as random earrings and empty packets of medication. Overall, very good experience and I would recommend and be back to Dahlias place again!
Comfy enough for a short term stay, very kitschy and artsy but definitely needs a deep clean in the kitchen and bathroom. Host seems a but crotchety and touchy when this is mentioned…

Stayed very well with my family including babies.
Vikash was very kind and helped alot for us.

We had a great stay at Matthew and Annabelle’s place. They were always very responsive whenever we needed something. We had a small issue and they solved it right away to make sure we had the perfect stay.
The location is really great, quite central and close to the underground for a direct access to both the train station and the airport.
The apartment was as shown in the pictures: clean, modern enough and with everything you would expect to find in an air BnB.
Overall the apartment is great value for money compared to other listings I saw while looking for a place to stay. I would definitely recommend Matthew and Annabelle’s place for anyone looking for a lovely home away from home while in London.

Beautiful place! The apartment was spotless, more than sufficient clean towels were provided. The bathroom floor was also heated which was a pleasant surprise! Check-in was super easy with clear instructions provided beforehand, and the place was easy to locate as well.
The apartment is also conveniently located in a beautiful neighborhood with many great cafes nearby. Also felt safe throughout the stay. Overall a really great place to stay in London!

The place is very clean and accurate described. Checkin process was very smooth, we were able to store our luggage at the place before the checkin time since our flight arrived early morning. However, the sound proof was not very good and we could hear people walking up and down, talking, and moving stuff late at night. Also the apartment is higher up with a lot of stairs and there is no elevator so moving luggage up and down was a bit of a struggle. Overall I’d still say the place is worth the price despite the small inconveniences.
Not a bad place to spend the night if you have a long layover or one day trip in London. It’s only a few minutes away from the airport which is nice.

a truly amazing stay in an absolutely superb location. Rosemary's place is true to the description - so peaceful and perfect for our week long stay combining a bit of work - comfy to work at table - and pleasure. Will definitely see availability next time we're in the area. Highly recommended

Had a great time staying here! Place was super clean and well decorated. Just a quick walk to the train that is on the main line so also super easy to get anywhere. Jennifer was super responsive and helpful when we needed it!

Stayed here for my birthday. Absolutely amazing, especially at night where you can see the city on the balcony. The parking was what took the longest about checking in, but once that was done, we had a very pleasant stay. Travelling to central did not take long either, very good location.
Definitely a place I’d stay in again.

Houst’s place is very decent with lovely wall paintings that accentuated the beauty of the living room.
I also found Houst to be very responsive whenever I had questions.
I did have a small problem with the wifi as the signal wasn’t strong in the bedroom but other than that, it was a fantastic stay.

I took an earlier flight and did not communicate this to Sam, when I landed, he expected me 2 hours later. With that in mind, he still arrived at the Airbnb before I did to make sure we were all set and checked in, that was so kind.
The location is good and close to the park! The CO-OP across the street was so awesome for daily fresh fruits and veggies, oh, and croissants. The pub that is a quick walk up Baker was great and was our first stop when we got in. It was a great experience!
Apartment is updated and very nice who high end touches. It is near the intersection of a busy street so does get loud. Otherwise it’s beautiful, well furnished, clean place.

A clean, spacious house with basic amenities that's good for a large group of people and conveniently located for public transport links.
Good communication from the host who met us on arrival and offered advice parking within an a few minutes walk.
Shops and good restaurants were also close by.

This was an overall great place and Sophie is one of the nicest and friendliest hosts that I have come across. The instructions on her House Manual were very detailed and helped us a lot. The house itself was nice and clean with a number of well thought out amenities. The location was great too with access to lots of good restaurants, a bus stop and a train station all within walking distance. I will definitely love to stay here again!

Nada was the perfect host, very flexible with checking in times although we managed to check in before she left which was great. Vwry friendly and professional. Such a beautiful space with plenty of snacks, drinks and anything else you may need. Only stayed one night but thoroughly enjoyed my stay with nada would definitely contact her if I was in the area again :)

We had a wonderful stay in James’s beautiful flat in Covent Garden. Although it was in a location which was perfect for easily accessing all London’s attractions, it was surprisingly peaceful and quiet. It was homely and so comfortable, and James was attentive, kind and incredibly helpful. Thank you so much.
Hugh was very friendly and easy to communicate with- the house is lovely and easy to find and get to via public transport. We really enjoyed our stay.

Samantha was fantastic to deal with. Super responsive and helpful. The flat was beautiful and had everything we needed. It was very easy to get to on the tube and there were great shops and supermarkets at an easy walking distance. Would highly recommend.
Not like on the pictures, mold on the walls and the room needs serious maintenance. Building also dirty overall.

Denise and Jonathon were responsive & accommodating! Their place was beautiful & my partner & I appreciated how secluded it was while still being connected to their property. I was staying here because I was getting an operation at a local hospital and this was the perfect place to stay. When the weather got cold, Denise even sent a message warning us to watch out for ice. Overall, a lovely place with fantastic hosts!
Quiet peaceful warm cosy - another lovely stay with Inge.  Highly recommend Inge's rooms you won't be disappointed.
Close to tube, have parking on request, the house is spacious. Also, Orla is extremely nice and responsive.
Antonio was very responsive and gave clear instructions. He even allowed me to check in a little early. Overall the service and apartment was great!
We had a last minute change of plans on our trip and were so thankful for the quick arrangement to stay at this lovely flat in Fulham. Beautiful, great location and exquisitely clean.
It was our 2nd time staying here and Dora is always quick to response to my messages. Apartment was conveniently located and clean. Would definately recommend it.
Very clean, central location, helpful host, perfect for our stay in London. 10/10 would recommend.

Really enjoyed my stay at Anna’s place with some colleagues. The kitchen was well equipped with a frying pan and utensils for a home-cooked meal. Place is very clean and spacious - rare find in London!
Very clear instructions. Apartment had everything we needed, starting from spare linens to teabags:)

Great accommodation for a reasonable price, surely would recommend! Although I didn’t get to meet the hosts, I’m sure they’re very nice people. The location is not that pretty, but is well located and in a walkable distance to the city center.

This was our second stay here for work.
It ticks every box for us, location is very quiet, but close to all main routes.
thoroughly recommend this place.
