The Wimbledon tennis courts are literally around the corner and there are nice cafes and places to eat within walking distance from the studio. The studio is a 15-min walk from the train station, but there are several bus stops right next to the studio that will take you to the station or to Wimbledon village. Uber is a good option too—ours arrived in 0 mins after booking. We highly recommend Denise’s place and will definitely stay here again!
Great location and nice place. Only issues is no ac (gets very hot) and very poor Wi-Fi signal

Great location right next to Portobello road and nearby tube station. Plenty of room for 3 people with great storage space in the closet. Bed was very comfortable. It was an unusually warm week in London so glad there was a fan to use in the bedroom. Host was very responsive and accommodated a late checkout. Overall a great stay!

This place is great place for catching public transport, and has pretty good food places near by! I had a great time staying here! However I’m pretty sure there are four flights of stairs and not three. The place was clean and great for two people
The Beds were very uncomfortable and hard, tried sleeping on couch but the couch needs a good cleaning.
Exactly as described, clean and perfect for a short stay. Noisy area but ear plugs provided which were great! I would definitely recommend this stay. Thanks both!

Lovely apartment, very clean and well decorated. Giulia was super friendly. Easy to get to from the centre of London.
I would happily stay again :)

Great location! Very clean with good shower. Close to transit and very walkable. Good security , we felt very safe. There are a lot of stairs so if you have mobility issues be sure to ask questions to see if the suite is suitable . Overall a super place.
Lawrence and Otto
Gary and Bianca’s place was great! They always responded extremely fast if I had any questions and Croydon has a lot of great food and activities to do!

Goo’s place is superb - exceeded expectations, it’s decorated to a high standard with attention to detail, in every aspect
It’s the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in
Bedrooms are huge with two bathrooms
It is just so peaceful despite being in the throng of the city
So easy to get around London but perfect for escape from the hustle and bustle of London
The decor is stunning, the beds super comfy, linens immaculate
Attention to detail - coffee pods, range of teas, sugar, honey, olive oil salt and pepper
Easy access to the apartment with a lift to transport our luggage
This place is an absolute find
Thank you
Can’t say enough about Jennifer’s place. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four. Loved everything about the flat and the neighborhood. Will definitely try to go back again!

Great position, just a few minutes away from the underground. The room is in a shared house and matches the photos. Good value for money, the price is quite convenient — in terms of quality you get what you pay for. Could be cleaner though

The apartment was lovely, exactly as described. Amanda sent through lots of recommendations for things to do around the area. We stayed here for a week and is close to the tube station which takes you both to wembley stadium and into london. Beautiful apartment in a lovely quiet area.
We had a wonderful stay! Close to trains and buses, very easy to see all of London and come home to a quiet area
I'd recommand it despite the issues I mentioned. It's close to one of the largest malls in London Westfield, the neighbourhood is not the best but quite familiar.

The flat was in a good location, close to two stations, easy access, a valuable parking space and Clare is a very friendly helpful host. Lovely sunny lounge room with shutters, the outdoor area we found very difficult to access and needs some attention. Quite a number of restaurants, taverns within close walking distance and very close to Clapham Common.
Most convenient place to be if you are travelling for work. The place is quite, comfortable and well connected. The host was very cooperative.

Paolo’s place was perfect location in soho.  Walkable to everything.  He has an on-site manager George who was there to greet us.  Only negative if any is no a/c, which normal in lots of flats in London.  Needs fans in every room and it would help.  But that was minor.  Thanks for great trip.
walking back from east croydon railway station to the appartment late at night is not a good idea. we did not feel safe. But the taxi was a good alternative and only about £9.
Loula was really nice, her place is clean and tidy. The flat is really well connected (underground, dlr and buses)

We loved Harriet’s little house in Hackney. The pictures really depicted the house. We asked to check in early because we were arriving on an international flight and Harriet was very accommodating. Harriet was also really prompt answering any questions we had. The house was really clean and really well supplied with dishes etc!  We loved it. The backyard was perfect for a glass of wine!  We wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

An amazing location in walking distance to great pubs, cafes, shopping & easy transport into London. Kathy’s place felt like a real home away from home, including sweet treats on arrival. A sweet backyard and lovely kitchen/living space for the whole family to enjoy. We would happily stay again in this charming home.

Our family of four had a wonderful stay at Tracy's!  The place was larger than the pictures convey, which was a pleasant surprise. Our teens were very comfortable on the pull-out sofa, and the second bedroom. The location was great - under 5 min to walk to the Bethnal Green metro, and multiple bus routes to choose from. We also ordered excellent carryout from a Thai place right up the block.
Fantastic location! Super comfortable and roomy flat.   Vas was a fantastic and gracious host.   Absolutely loved our stay, location was ideal for us and super convenient.

We had a great time, everything was as described. The place is very easy to find, we had very clear instructions on how to get in and stuff. Clean, cozy, and extremely pretty overall, and I wish we would have stayed longer.

Great Place BUT not ideal for tall people as the second room had a sloping ceiling under the bed and the bathroom.
great for 2 couples.
The house was so lovely and Sandra was really welcoming! The facilities were clean and great to use, and the room I was in was extremely comfortable and had everything I needed! A great stay! :)

Helen’s place was fantastic. Great location and steps away from public transportation. She was very responsive and communicated well. She was also flexible in allowing me to store my luggage after checking out, great host!

Had a great stay at Heydon’s place! Great location, comfortable room with nice lighting and a beautifully decorated apartment. Heydon was a great host who was flexible with check in and great at communicating throughout.
Highly recommend for a solo traveller!

Kristy's place was great and she was a wonderful communicator, both at checkin and with questions during the stay.
The bus stop right outside was very convenient as well.
Perfect for the 4 of us for 2 weeks!
Tina’s place in Soho is very cool and at the heart of nightlife in the area. The place was spotless, comfortable and easy access to countless restaurants and activities.
Easy entrance, nice and clean. But was too hot inside without any alternative. Leaking from bathroom down to living room. Not good curtains, too bright at morning.

Exactly as described. Pristine sparkling clean. Safe working class friendly neighborhood.
1/3m to N Bromley station but the S Bromley station is a .7 miles walk and is more practical (and a fun walk through the pedestrian shopping area or a 9£ taxi) for reaching LonDon, as it is a non-stop 15’ train to Victoria station.
2-3 pubs within 300 yards of unit; and many good cafes just by N Bromley station .3 miles away. Also a large Sainsbury’s food store there.
Parking is easy but confusing. Free street parking right in front except noon-2 Monday- Saturday; have Faiza buy you the scratch off 4£ dash display paper if parking then OR have Faisa show you where you can park safely on street all day free just 1-2 blocks away. We did both.

I think it was the cleanest place I’ve ever stayed via the airbnb booking. Very modern facilities and renovation. Lukas was helpful and friendly. If I were not rushing for the coursework deadline , I would definitely explore more about the surrounding.

Anne welcomed us into her home for a short day. Slept really well. Great location. Very accommodating of our dogRosie.
This was our first time sharing someone’s home which I was a little anxious about but would definitely stay again.
Thank you Anne
Carey was a fabulous host with a real personal touch. The flat was close to transit and beautifully taken care of. I would definitely stay here again!

Inge was absolutely lovely! The place was very clean and private. Well located with many cafes and restaurants nearby.
We definitely would come back :)

Jeff's place was perfect for our short London visit travelling with our 3 small children.
He was very helpful and flexible around the checkin and was available when we had a question.

I had a wonderful stay in Suzy's apartment in Hackney, wehre I felt at home right away. Everything, from checkin to checkout, went absolutely smoothly. The room was very spacious and homey, and the location perfect for exploring London. Suzy is incredibly generous, warm and friendly. She gave me lots of great advice to explore the neighbourhood, regardless of her busy work schedule. I can absolutely recommend her and her room to anybody who wants to experience the true Hackney vibe!

The apt is in excellent condition and very clean.
Bathroom and kitchen-corner are renovated and the bed in the bedroom is very comfortable.
Location is very near to bus stations.
Alexandra responded immediately to our questions.
Dear Alexandra we thank you very much for hosting us!!
Beautiful place to stay. Close to any amenity you would need and a quick tube ride to local attractions. The neighborhood was very nice and easy to navigate. Would definitely stay again!
Sandra was an excellent host. The appartement is spacious and very well equipped. Recently renewed and close tò Arsenal Stadium, it's the best place tò stay for your next trip to London!
Dominic's place is very close to the tube station, which was great for us. Dominic answered quite quickly when we had any doubts. The pictures reflect exactly how the flat is. We enjoy our stay.

Debbie was a great host, and the apartment was perfect for our needs.  Very centrally located, close to several public transport options, and nearby lots of great London attractions.  The apartment was clean and comfortable, with plenty of room and a nice kitchen space.   Would absolutely stay here again when returning to London.

I enjoyed my stay here - I was a bit nervous about sharing a bathroom at first but you didn’t even notice there were other people. You had your own room with a shared bathroom and kitchen space. Room was clean and tidy!
I had a great stay at Alessia’s flat. She was super helpful , friendly and made me feel at home. Her place is super confortable and well connected. Thank you again !

Victoria's Place is a lovely flat.  Very clean and comfortable with excellent amenities.  A short walk to the tube and some great pubs. It was nice to be in a quiet location like Wimbledon.  Victoria made the booking and check in very easy.  Everything was clearly explained. Would highly recommend.
I had a fantastic stay. Iyisha was so helpful and very responsive to any queries I had. The area is nice and private but accesible to transport links. I will definitely be back!

larger room than the pic, less than 10 minutes from Stockwell Underground station, kind host , clean room , fast reply worth to pay
it's little bit tricky to find, stairs are bit narrow but not a serious problem

Amazing accomodation, very close to London. Very comfortable accomodation. Beds were great. Getting in was easy and the location is walkable to a Lidl or Tescos.
There were buses every couple of mins to London and nothing took more than 30 mins. Kirsty was very responsive. No issues with the place. Highly recommended.
Jadin has been a great host , friendly and communicative. The place is right next to DLR station so getting to the place was pretty easy . I would love to stay again !
We stayed here for 2 weeks and it was wonderful! Spacious and we felt right at home. Easy transportation to and from the city and we felt safe in the area.

It was clean and very good located for Terminal5.
If you have time, you should visit Harmondsworth and the park with little rabbits.
I slept with earplugs really well!

Really nice room, had everything you could need, and having access to a balcony is just so nice. The place was clean and Ajit is very friendly and helpful. The walls are thin though, and I think there is a school nearby as there were a lot of loud kids in the morning - I recommend bringing earplugs if you are a light sleeper. Other than that, it's a very quiet area, with many different tube and train lines within a 10 minute walk.

We had a wonderful stay at Kinga's apartment. It was as described and pictured, was comfortable and clean and in a really lovely area. Kinga's instructions for getting inside were extremely helpful and informative, and we really enjoyed our stay. If we are ever in the area again, this would be a first choice of accommodation. Thank you!

Great location especially for Hyde Park.  Very nice touches with cold bottles of water in the fridge, biscuits and fruit.  No WiFi but it just meant we used data or actually talked to each other.  Bathrooms were spotless. Bed was too soft for me but that’s the luck of the draw. Overall I would stay again as it has everything we needed.
Gina is a terrific host; kind and responsive. The appartement was just what we wished for. Nice little restaurants and bars just across the street.

Monica’s place was perfect for our weekend trip to London fir a weddings it was a great location and the street was very sweet. We loved the back patio and the flowers/garden area and the conservatory.
Both mornings we ate at a great little place around the corner called Zarathustra Cafe. We highly recommend it!
Monica was a wonderful communicator !
Very nice place, had problems to check in but host was very responsive. Overall a charming place:)
A great place to call home. The apartment had everything you could wish for. Beautifully appointed an considered. A great courtyard to enjoy the London summer!
Jamie was a great host and his apartment is conveniently located and spacious. We enjoyed sitting outside and the 3 bedrooms are large and comfortable.
Enjoyed our stay. Easy check in. Good place if you want to visit London but avoid the busy areas. Easy access to the train station too. It’s a bit warm at night time but fan is provided.
Jadin was very friendly and helpful at check out. Room was cozy and we enjoyed our stay. It was also a good bonus to have a monitor in the room. Thank you.
Very nice place near the overground train station, restaurants and a supermarket. Great base for exploring London.

perfect location for those who wants to shop or party in Central London, complete amenities such as laundry machine, full kitchen set and comfy bed
perfect for solo or young couple, as you may have to walk up and down the stair with your luggage
will be back for sure

Marvelous place, lots of livingroom space and big bedrooms, great apartment for 4 people. Neighboorhood is really nice and close to wonderful Hamstead Heath. But Crouch End is also lovely for a quick dinner and drinks. Try Banner's! And with the Archway tube you reach the centre in 20-30 minutes. If Steve allows us, we will come back.

Staying at Jose’s place was awesome! He was super helpful and I couldn’t have asked for a better time there! His place is close to some amazing cafes and restaurants and only a quick walk to Battersea Power Station and the tube.

We only had one night in London but this apartment was super convenient to the train station and I loved that the bedrooms are on the lower level and it was very quiet. And the Blue River restaurant on the same street was excellent and so convenient!

I had a nice stay here. The location is great. It's about a mile from South Bank so very walkable.
I was there about a week and didn't have any major issues. I believe there are 4 rooms being rented out in this place so there are people coming and going if you are there long enough, but it was fine. I will probably stay there again next time I'm in London if available.

Julia’s property is very nice and clean. It has a mini fridge in the room which is ideal and very useful. The room is very comfortable and no fault to say, to be honest. It is a walking distance to Westfield Mall and Shepherd’s Bush Market station.
Would definitely book again.

Perfect in every way for my needs. Comfortable bed, perfect location and nice to sleep in. Recommend sleep mask and earplugs due to street noise and boiler. Loved the place, will definitely stay again if I’m London. Recommended.
Fantastic location for access to underground and Lords cricket grounds, very safe and clean. Host was very responsive- even organised fresh towels during our stay.

If your looking to not stay in the business  of London this area was perfect. Retrieving the keys was not the usual for an Airbnb. We have stayed in multiple Airbnb maybe suggest a a lockbox. We honestly thought it was a scam upon arrival. Other then the key issue this flat was as described.

The space was amazing!!! It was very clean, comfortable, and all the amenities worked as advertised. Additionally, the area is very accessible via the tube, and a lot of local stores and malls around. I would definitely rent this space again next time I am in London!

This is a good, clean & comfortable house. It had all we needed for our stay. Vikash was very helpful & answered any questions quickly.  This property is situated in a quiet (as much as you could get in this part of London!) cul-de-sac, but has easy access to buses and trains.
Helpful host and easy location from Canary Wharf tube or the DLR. Well priced for the area. Would consider staying again.

Tod was very helpful and quick to respond to questions. Location is great for local amenities and transport links into the West End. Park is only a short walk away. The Eagle pub  is just around the corner and is dog friendly with a great beer garden. Perfect for a summer afternoon after a stroll in the park.

Extended family of 15 stayed here comfortably. Huge yard, lots of room for kids to play, toys and games for every age group.
Jaqua was a wonderful host and went out of her way to ensure that we had everything we needed
Gareth was fantastic with responses and communication. The room is small with all listed amenities. Slightly different to pictures but not significantly. Very close to transport

Absolutely loved our stay! Mael was super communicative and so kind. The apartment looks just like the photos and was the best place to feel right at home in Shoreditch. BoxPark and so many great restaurants nearby, right off the train- I can’t wait to come back!
Great location , close to all stations and restaurants ,  clean and beautiful penthouse apartment . Would definitely stay again !
Tania was an exceptional, friendly and efficient host. Her accommodation surpassed our expectations and made for a wonderful stay in London. Would highly recommend. 10/10!!!

Great little studio, and had everything we needed for a couple of nights. Hani responded promptly to messages and provided good details on access. 5 minute walk from the station and near lots of restaurants and bars. We'd happily stay there again.

Cara is a lovely host. Very helpful and made me feel at home. The place is perfect for the O2 or short breaks in London. Would definitely recommend. Would be my first choice if I have another event at the O2 in the future.

A great place in London location wise, especially if you are visiting the Olympic Stadium or surrounding areas. Neha and Paul as the hosts were extremely proactive and helpful right up until check out. The house was perfect for our needs as a place to stay for a couple of nights, and was very reasonably priced given the location and with it being London. Would definitely stay again!

Overall a good stay in a diverse neighborhood. The rooms were comfortably furnished and the kitchen was generally well-stocked. The building is shared with four other rooms so it can get crowded and busy, but it was easy to get in and out. The room was cramped with the sofa bed laid out and the shower only had soap so we had to buy shampoo. The building must be a little thin, as normal noise can be heard across the building so it’s necessary to stay extra quiet.

Perfect little apartment in a great spot. If you're not bothered about the quality of the WiFi there's nothing to mark this place down. I needed it to be more stable and more bandwidth to do a little work and it wasn't up to it. Otherwise, an absolute gem!

This house was a cosy retreat and was welcoming to return to after busy days exploring London. We enjoyed watching TV in the comfortable living area. The house  is beautifully decorated and well-equipped. The garden was a nice bonus. I  would recommend the house for a family. Our teenage son and daughter each got their own bedroom and there ia a en-suite master bedroom.  All the rooms are very bright and clean and we found the beds to be extremely comfortable. I loved the nearby train connection from Bromley North to Charing Cross. A very simple platform change is required at Grove Park. Bromley South is a great shopping and eating area in its own right with fast direct trains to Victoria. Faiza gave excellent recommendations and stayed in contact but was never intrusive. It was an easy and fuss-free check-in and out.  I hope to return to London next year and would be very happy to stay in this AirBnB again.

Ali’s place really great, it was just what I need for a 5 days stay… it has everything you need.. Ali was really kind and helpful… he helped with my suitcase and always checked on me! And the bus stop just by the side of the building was the icing on the cake… train station is a 10 minutes walk from the place… lots of stores and restaurants around! I had an amazing time. Thank you Ali

Nash was very helpful and responsive when making the booking
On arrival both he and his wife made me feel at home and after checking in we chatted whilst I waiting for a friend.
The room and house is very clean and spacious, the bed was large and very comfortable
The bathroom was very clean with a very good and large shower.
I could not find any fault with Nash's house and the reception I received from his family was exceptional.
The next time I go to Wembley I will definitely look to stay again with Nash
Thanks very much Nash

Spotlessly clean and inviting! This is a fantastic find of a high standard! Inge is interesting & interested in each guest.
Her guest house, apart from her own residence has its own side entrance, is well designed offering much light, modern warm furnishings in a spacious sitting/ dining area and an outdoor patio adding its own ambience. Bedrooms are up a flight of stairs .
Great location for upmarket restaurants and pubs close by.a A short walk from train station, Stamford Brook. Local Sainsbury’s is small but offers a selection of prepared meals etc .Home has all amenities for cooking.
Inge deserves all the accolades for her efforts to ensure each guest is well cared for. Highly recommend and would love to return one day

Vladimir and his family is heartwarming hosts 😊 I felt at home in a foreign country. He always tries to find a better solution and always replies quickly.
Nice access to the station and supermarkets, reasonable fee, it saved me a lot.
Thank you Vladimir 🙏✨
Alessia's place is very nice, clean and in a nice neighbourhood. Alessia is very friendly and supportive! There are some nice places for lunch in about 5 mins walk.

Inge is a lovely host. Really fell in love with Inge’s place once we step in. Nicely decorated, with all the necessities provided. It’s located in a beautiful neighbourhood. 10min walk to the nearest underground stations. With parks nearby & walks along the Thames river are really enjoyable.

Marijana’s place was amazing ! The location was perfect in earls court. Train station very close by and a walkable. Place was very clean and as described! If you are planning on doing work remotely at this stay keep in mind the wifi is a bit spotty and sometimes would not work. Besides that it was a great stay!
I highly recommend Adam's apartments. There was everything you needed to feel like at home. Adam was very friendly,hospitable, attentive and polite. We will definitely come back again.

Our stay here was one of the worst we have had if not the worst. This was our first big trip with our toddler which is difficult on its own so we really needed the place where we were staying to function properly. Being in that apartment was unbearable!!! The first night the AC stopped working in the middle of the night. we were told to just restart it. which we did. it worked the following day but on the 3rd day it didn't work at all. you would think it wouldn't really matter when nights were in the 60s but there were no windows we could open. I have no idea how it would get as hot as the 80s/90s in the early morning but it did. we were provided a fan that was so weak it basically did nothing. it was absolutely miserable no one slept well and we tried our best with the toddler.  the people were nice the space was fine but it was a miserable experience

We had a great stay at the House of Kip’s! The location was key for the City Center, right at the canal and walkable to museums, shops, food and more. Rene was incredibly responsive and all of our needs were met. Thank you!🌈☀️
It was nice , clean . It was very loud street noise, and the WiFi was not working, so could not watch tv or use phones much

Mingshu is an awesome host, friendly and enthusiastic and very communicative. The room was supremely comfortable and clean so also the bathroom. The accommodation were immaculate and cozy and with a nice view. I love it 😊.  I really enjoyed my stay. I highly recommend for other guest
Franks place is awesome. Leafy and green everywhere, nice relaxed vibes, and a massive house. Would very happily return - thanks Frank!

Tonias place was perfect for our first trip to London. The 3 of us fit comfortably in the flat. The flat was cute, very clean and had a nice TV! The park near by is very peaceful and location is very close to Warren St which has cute coffee shops and restaurants and the Tube!
Tonia was very responsive and even offered suggestions of places to try during our visit.
We will definitely stay here again when we come back to visit
The place is very cozy and spotless clean! Jacqueline is an amazing host and person, who did everything to make us feel like home! Very friendly and helpful! Totally recommend!!
Pristine apartment with everything you need. The bathroom is extremely modern. Location was very walkable and King's Cross is straight down the main street.

Great flat in a quiet residential street within easy walking distance of Tooting High Srreet and the Underground. It was clean and comfortable and ideal for our weekend exploring the local area. We will definitely look to stay again.

The building is a little tucked away from the street and the hallways could use a uplift but other than that it was easy to check in and out. the place was more spacious than a hotel. Bathroom was a bit tight but it was manageable. Limited toiletries, so bring your own soap and shampoo would be a recommendation. Two days short stay so it was good for that.

Jaqua was a really helpful and lovely host. We hosted a bridal party and she went above and beyond to make sure we were catered to and was very responsive to all my questions. Her place is amazing and is very beautiful, particularly the garden and marquee space. Would recommend! Xxx

Shlome was a lovely host, super responsive and alway available when needed. The home was super clean and very homely and I enjoyed my stay as a whole.
I will note for future guests that the bedroom has a skylight above the bed that doesn’t have a blind, so if you are a light sleeper please bare this in mind as we did not know.
Generally speaking, Shlome was great to us and this place was easy to settle into!

fantastic Host ***** luxury Property everything Need, modern decor no detail missed :) property was Fresh and vibrant without doubt the best Airbnb place we've stayed in 100% can't thank Justyna enough for the superb service.
The stay with Vladi and his family was nice. They made me feel welcome. An advantage is that they speak so many languages. The location is great (3 or 4 tube stops to the heart of the city).
This is a great spot to stay in order to access center city via Clapham Junction. Easy walk to the station and well appointed apartment.

Evelyn’s place was exactly what I needed for my solo strip to London for a week. Her directions to/instructions for the place were detailed and accurate. She was immediately responsive in all communication. Her home is situated in a lovely quiet neighborhood in northeast London, very close to the tube station. My room and ensuite bathroom was exquisitely clean -seemed almost brand new!  The bed was super comfy (sheets were immaculate & crisp!)  Good value for the money - I had a great stay!
This location is SO amazing. The neighborhood is quiet and so walkable. I wish I lived here! The space matched the description and was very quiet.

This place needs a lot of maintenance. Their was mould around the windows and on some walls. The microwave wouldn’t work, the garden/backyard was unusable and not as pictured at all. The neighbours upstairs were noisy. The rug shed with every movement. The lock on the bathroom was broken as well as the fan and when my 7 year old got into bed the bed collapsed and hubby had to fix it. The centre rod wasn’t even attached properly. The hosts were very responsive and happy to give more towels, blankets but they also wanted to enter on more than two occasions which was uncomfortable. I know the location well as we’ve lived two streets away. This is more Harlesden than Kensal. I’d suggest staying closer to the city if you’re in London.
The place is really clean and easy to find. We love the recommendation wall. Will deffo go back soon. 10/10 Thank you xx

We had originally had plans to stay with friends. However the train strike meant a last minute change of plans.
This place was a huge bonus. There is no way we could of done what we did of we had stayed with our friends!!
Great location - two doors up from Bond Street Tube Station. This place was secure and very clean and spacious given its location. Would recommend it as a great bade to explore London from.

We stayed 10 nights here and it was excellent. The apartment is clean, modern and quiet (the living room looks onto a pedestrian-only street, the bedroom onto a small alley). Matt was an excellent host – all communications were great, he responded to every enquiry almost instantly. He sends videos prior to arrival to explain how everything works (it’s quite a high-tech place).
Location: there’s a Waitrose supermarket a couple of blocks away, and the nearby underground station has food outlets like Pret-à-manger.
The apartment itself: recently refurbished to a very high standard and with top-notch kitchen appliances, TVs, screen etc. Comfortable double bed, high-quality linens and towels, tableware. Note: there are 37 steps from street to the apartment.
No hesitation in recommending both the apartment and the owner – we had high expectations and they were absolutely met.
Very clean and well supplied apartment.  10min walk to closest tube which was fine. lovely place. thank you Tamara

We had an excellent stay at Orla’s place and truly felt at home and relaxed. Very close to the tube station and supermarket which was excellent as we had no car.  Everything was as described and Orla was a great host. Thank you

great location - 4 minute walk from tube, really clean room, easy to access and everything clearly labelled, a fan was on when I walked into the room which was perfect as I was so hot! really responsive hosts if I needed them - comfy bed, fast wifi!

Unfortunately, the room was not cleaned after the last visitor when I arrived (an hour past the check-in start time). The host, Mingshu, explained that she was abroad and had not realised that the housekeeper didn't visit. She was very apologetic and I was offered a partial refund for the trouble, but due to this mishap and confusion I ended up staying in a different room nonetheless. Hopefully this is an isolated incident, but still a disappointing stay overall.

Great stay for the week! Convenient location, just wasn’t as clean as expected and needs a-bit of maintenance as photos are outdated
Host was lovely and refunded us after being informed of a broken couch which was really nice of them.
Would stay again!

Our stay at Dahila was pleasant. The check-in did not go flawless. The cleaning lady was waiting with us for the key at the checkin-point at the check-in time, so she still had to clean when we arrived. We just left here to do her job, got some coffee in the park and came back two hours later to a spotless house. Dahlia gave us a partly refund on the cleaning-fee for the inconvenience. The hot water did not work at first. But Dahllia was very helpful giving us clear instructions by app. The neighborhood is quiet but ideally located to explore The Docs. Around the corner a nice park to chill and we also used the gym. Dahlia's apartment has a beautiful view and everything you need is there. There are some little interior-things that need to be addressed that we shared with Dahlia. But overall we recommend the apartment.

Our family had a fantastic time- the weather was summer sunny cool so the temp indoors and out was perfect! Location was exactly where we needed to be and the kitchen/washing appliances top notch- not “ikea”. We would come back again- Samantha was very quick to answer any questions we had- very appreciated. Thank you Samantha!

Maria's place exceeded all expectations! everything was amazing! the place looked better in person than in the photos and we felt right at home being there. Maria was super responsive and super friendly and made the stay really incredible. The place is walkable to a bus station and a train station and it is pretty easy to get into the city center with a train. Our stay was amazing and I would highly recommend this place to all. It was in a peaceful, quiet neighborhood with parks and restaurants. The bed was very comfortable and the room stayed pretty cool with all the windows and the fan they provided. The way the house is set up makes it feel like a mini apartment and it feels very private. Maria was super helpful and friendly and an overall great host with a great place to stay! :)

We had a wonderful stay here! Great location with local restaurants and walking distance to the bus and tube. The flat was clean and very nice. Appreciated the waters provided! Vas was very responsive.

I was a little hesitant about this listing at first, but my stay here it was great! I was concerned about being on the third floor in the summertime with no air-conditioning, but the temperature ended up being fine as the weather wasn’t that hot in London at the time. There were windows and fans, although the main window only opened a couple of inches, likely to prevent anyone from going outside of it onto a rooftop. The place was very clean and tidy, and exactly as seen in the photos and description. I absolutely loved the neighborhood! I was very diverse with lots of grocery stores, a variety of restaurants with various types of food, and some really cute patios and bars - all within walking distance. There is a handy bus that stops right next to the apartment and several metro stations within walking distance. The owners were very communicative.
Lovely apartment on a great street in a perfect location. Extremely clean. We hope to stay here again.
The location is very good, and yet it is very quiet at night. It's suitable for 3 people, including one child. I highly recommend it.
Responsive host. Well-equipped house. However, this is a good property let-down by the poor state of decor. Some investment in decoration etc. is needed.
Perfect stay for a short stopover on the way to Heathrow. James is a great host who made sure we had everything we needed.

Was attending an event at Olympia and was a great place close by and nice an private room to come back to after the convention and Julia and her mum where very helpful in getting settled in the house during the check in.

One of the few not super expensive places in the neighborhood, but really tiny! We stayed with three people which felt too small. I think two people would fit really well. The place was less polished than it might be—there were some maintenance issues (like missing knobs in the bathroom and some wobbly shelves) that should be attended to to make the place feel more comfortable. It’s also a really loud street from traffic noise, which I wasn’t aware of before I tried to sleep with the windows open for the airflow. Heavy sleepers would probably sleep fine, though! The location is good and would recommend for that reason.

Great place to stay, wonderful communication with hosts, and very close to the transportation to the city. We loved it there, it was very nice room, everything was clean and tidy, which is very much appreciated. We would definitely come back in a future opportunity!

HIen & Jason couldn't have been more responsive, accommodating, and friendly throughout the entire booking process, our stay, and check out. Every bedroom was just as accommodating and having a bathroom on each of the three floors was the perfect layout with our stay included additional family members. Plenty of space to sit at a table in the kitchen or to enjoy the TV at night. It was a very close walk to the New Eltham train station and made getting to/from London Bridge easy. Not related to their home, strongly recommend arriving in Greater london with an Oyster card ahead of time to make transportation logistics much easier.
You can't go wrong with this home if wanting the 6 bedroom space for a larger group. Thank you Hien & Jason for allowing us to stay at your home while in London!
Thanks Bipin. Your apartment was just what we were looking for and a home from home. Exceptionally clean throughout and in a very safe and quiet location. We will certainly want to use again.

Convenient, clean and well located.
The use of the kitchenette is much appreciated also.
The noise from the tube isn’t too bad at all (and is very clear from both the advert and Julie, so no surprises)

Thanks for a great hosting.
Place was very clean, Lukas was nice and friendly.

I chose the Rookery because of the park across the street and the short walk to a train station. Not only did we enjoy these amenities, but the apartment was clean, modern, and cheery. Coffee, grocery shopping and the train were all within an easy walk and on the day that is was cold and rainy, we enjoyed laying on the couch and watching Netflix. We would definitely recommend this area and this apartment!

I can recommend Peter’s place. It’s great for families. The place totally met our expectations. It’s located in a great neighbourhood with plenty to do locally and good public transport options. The cat was a favorite of my children.

This was a good place to stay in Kingston. Very convenient, a big store next to it and right across from beautiful Richmond Park. great bus service in and out of Kingston and London. Even though it was next to the main road it was lovely and quiet. Sancha left us everything we needed in the room!
Alex was a very responsive and friendly host. The location of the flat was great; close to many attractions, shops, and restaurants.

I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!
First Maria let us wait for 1.5 hours and couldn't be reached over the airbnb app as well as by phone, even though she told us the apartment was ready and we could come anytime now. When we finally got a hold of her, Maria was very rude and disrespectful on the phone. After 20 minutes more somebody came and gave us a key, but it was for a different apartment than the one we rented. this is not acceptable! additionally, the apartment was not clean at all. Maria did not reply to my complaints.

Nicely decorated home with a useable backyard for afternoon tea. Split levels for rooms with internal staircase.  Fully equipped open kitchen.  Two clean toilets.  Just right for our family of 4 (2 kids).   Free public street car parking from 5pm-9am just opposite to it.  2 Sainburys within walkable distance, with 1 providing free 2-3-hr free car parking.   Located in Fulham residential area, about 2km joggable to Chelsea FC!  Overall my family is very satisfied with it.

This has been one of my best Air Bnb experiences to date! This was an absolutely perfect stay. Nada’s flat is bright and airy and spacious, with all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. We stayed for about a week, and the Air Bnb started to feel like a real home away from home.
The location is perfect, with enough peace and quiet but walkable to Wimbledon for easy connections to central London on the train or Tube. It is also close to Wimbledon village and all the shops and cafes there for when we didn’t want to go too far.
Nada was an extremely responsive host and provided everything we needed and was quick to answer any questions we had.
We would have no doubts about staying there again in the future, it was the perfect place for me and my parents (who are in their late 70s/early 80s) to enjoy a quieter stay in London.
Nice apartment, close to the underground, shops, restaurants and a few pubs. With the underground very easy acces to the city. Easy online communication with the host.
Paolo and George are great hosts, location and the place we're great too. We will come back!
Great location, brilliant stay for the price and ideal for what we needed this weekend! Would definitely book again

It was so lovely time to stay in Tam’s house! All thing is well organized & clean! She is always welcoming and helpful. I super recommend this place to you guys ! Thank you for all things of our staying:)

Lovely stay. Flat was very clean and well presented.
Andrew was very communicative and friendly.
I had a slight concern about the potential traffic noise before visiting but it was not a problem at all.
Will very happily stay again

Beautiful short stay! Had it not been for work, definitely would’ve stayed for longer. The place was pristine and exactly as described. Instructions for the property were clear, and Justyna was friendly and super responsive. Can’t recommend it enough!

This place is worth every penny.
I love how peaceful the environment is, how clean the house is. The host made the stay worthwhile
It was a great stay for us. We happily come again! Great area- all walkable! Thank you Helen- we really enjoyed our stay!
Had a very nice stay. Quiet neighbourhood. Comfortable bed and bathroom. Check-in went smoothly and host is friendly and helpful

Fantastic place to stay in inner south London.  Carey was very helpful and a perfect host - and stocked the fridge and pantry with some delicious items.  Highly recommended and would definitely stay there again.

Place was not that close to the center of London But very Good communication by bus or tube. Many shops and corner shops  also small restaurants around. Very easy to chec in. Kar was answering for questions So quick :)
Great location, responsive host and well kept accommodation. Check-in was nice and easy. Amenities were all up and running room was nicely setup and the location was just perfect!
Great host, well designed interior, very clean, and decent transport links to Central London. The area is also quiet, so it's easy to get a good night's sleep.

Our 10 day stay was amazing! Everything was within walking distance and the surrounding cafes and restaurants were great as well as the tesco which was conveniently a 30 second walk down the road. The flat itself was very spacious and was equipped with everything we needed in regards to cooking, cleaning, and overall entertainment. George the housekeeper was extremely helpful as well! Would definitely recommend!
A great house in a terrific area of London, I stayed with my parents, sister and brother in law and we had a great stay in every way. Recommended.

The place is located close to the tube station and was very easy to find, there are lots of supermarkets, shops and cafes just down the road and Golders Hill Park is a great place for walks. The bedroom is large and nicely decorated, everything was clean and the host responsive and accommodating. Thank you!
Sancha is a great host. I foud everything that I needed fir my stay there. Room is very clean and well equipped.

We stayed at Sandra's place for almost 2 weeks with our 6&8 year old daughters. Lovely garden flat in great location to all the amenities of chiswick high road. Close to the pubs on the strand also. Many public transport options to get in & out of central london. Flat was equipped with all we needed especially kitchen as we tended to cook in for kids. Great pub right around the corner with garden is a must try. We will be back again!
Very friendly host, the house and room were very clean and homely. The only thing  missing was a teabag :)

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in London! The place was clean, charming, and felt like home. The location was great, close to the train station. The host was friendly and helpful. I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting London!
A very large centrally located apartment. Very close to Oxford street and Fitzrovia. Plenty of restaurants, coffee shoots and great breakfasts very close by.
Gio was super helpful and responsive in the chat. The place was great. We could walk to many attractions and shopping easily.

We are a familiy of 3, with a teenaged daughter and spent a week at Paolo’s place in August.
We really appreciated the quiet neighborhood with good coffee shops, restaurants and pubs, quite close by foot to some of the points of interest for us (british museum, oxford street, soho) and easily accessible by tube for the rest.
The place was as described in the post and accommodating for our party needs (we were out visiting for most of the day) and we were pleasantly surprised by available toiletries and kitchen stuff. For an even better experience, we would probably suggest upgrading the pillows and consider a dishwasher.
Very good experience with check in, check out and overall communication during our stay, highly appreciated recommendations.

The AirBnb was perfect for our family of four, with two under two. The kosher kitchen made or lives much more convenient. There was plenty of space for the toddler to roam around without getting bored, and the backyard was a plus. Furthermore, the location itself was extremely convenient for food and shul.
All in all, a great experience.
Great location. Great facilities. Perfect little garden for families. Kitchen well stocked with utensils. Tess was so helpful and responsive with any queries

Good location for travelling to London. Easy to reach and the parking permit makes life a lot easier. The apartment was newly renovated and offered enough space for 6 people.
Thanks for everything!

The space was just what I needed for a few nights, aka a shower & bed. Simple, basic, but clean! It was lovely to have 180 degree views of london, stunning! It was peaceful & even though there’s no door to the attic room, I barely heard others in the house. I’m short, but I found the space quite small due to the low, slanted roof, so just as a heads up (no pun intended!!) for taller folks it might be a bit tricky! Overall ideal for a few nights stay, thank you Richard & Kris!

We spent 10 very happy days in Katherine’s home. It is comfortable, peaceful and practical with a fabulous view onto the Priory’s garden. We loved being near Hampstead Heath and connections to central London are easy and accessible.
Katherine was always helpful with any problems and quick to respond.
Perfect base for Shoreditch and the City. Mael was a perfect host. Lovely and light apartment and great for remote working.

my friends and i loved our stay at Tod’s place! lovely little apartment that was stocked with refreshments and snacks. conveniently located near a bus stop that brings you straight to oxford street shopping area and a 10min walk from ravenscourt park station, about 30-40min train ride to the city centre. beside the apartment was a co-op convenience store and there were eateries around the area as well. Tod was very responsive and helpful - even helped us to replace our water kettle and gave us instructions on how to open the main door (we didnt know how to use UK doors!). was able to meet him on our last day and he even helped us with our luggage (-: would definitely recommend staying here! thanks for the lovely stay Tod!

The place itself was very nice we were all very satisfied with it!! The neighborhood has lots of bars and restaurants and the metro makes it easy to go anywhere in the city. We’d definitely recommend this place!
Though we did have a little issue trying to check in as the cleaner had kept the keys and the hosts weren’t really helpful but everything worked out well in the end and it didn’t really bother our overall experience as I’m sure this was a one time thing! :)

Host very friendly and kind. He checked that everything was ok all the time and if we need anything. Also brought clean towels in the morning. Very good service. The place is very nice and spacious. Recommend.

This apartment is highly recommended for a short or long visit to London as it provides you with a lot of tools like cooking pan,etc. The most important thing that I would like to highlight is the location. It is very convenient to travel around zone 1 and 2 as it takes about 20 minutes to London Bridge, about 30 minutes to London Victoria, about 25 minutes to Clapham Junction.
My second time staying at Frank's and I'll be back. I love the house, the area and he's a great host and lovely person. I recommend!

Tracy’s retro accommodation was an excellent choice of location for us .
The apartment was extremely clean and we enjoyed staying there.
Easy walk to many local attractions including parks ,markets,shops and Bethnal green tube station was only a couple of minutes walk away.
Tracy was a great host easy to contact and very friendly as was Russell .

We stayed for 3 wks and feels at home. Very easy transportation to everywhere. Contrary to what people say, we always feel safe even when returning late at night.
The host is very responsive and flexible as we need to do late check out due to our flight time.
Abundance of grocery stores too!

Absolutely beautiful flat in the middle of busy Oxford St. in Central London. Adequate space for a large group. Loved the terraces and back patio.
Well decorated space with easy access entry and a lift for heavy suitcases. I highly recommend this flat.
Gio was great and very responsive! Fantastic welcome and very accommodating.
Very good option for anyone looking to stay in Nothing Hill. The hosts are very responsive and helpful, we didn’t love the height of the pillows and we had new ones on the same day!
Really top - nicely done rooms, very clean house overall. Easy check-in and everything setup well for you to manage on your own.

Location was ideal however a little noisy at times due to being located on the main road. Facilities were adequate & the Murphy bed was fine. Suggest a easier way to obtain the keys but would gladly stay there again.

Jeff's place is in a lovely, quiet part of London that has its own sense of character. While it isn't in the middle of the city, that's actually it's best perk: it's peaceful. It's also very close by a bus station (right outside the flat) that'll take you into the city quickly, and a tube station that's only a ten minute walk.
For some reason, Airbnb listed Jeff's place as having 4 beds, which isn't correct. Note that it sleeps 4, but in two beds. My party of four was able to manage just fine (both beds were large enough for us all to sleep comfortably), so it wasn't an issue.
Jeff was an excellent host who listened to us and provided the perfect suggestions for our trip. The Mayflower may just be my favorite pub in London thanks to him! If you stay here, know that Jeff will take care of you.
Only downside of this appartment is that you can hear noise from bathroom.   Last day there were people who started drying hair at 5AM and made noise and we could not sleep.

Walkable from overground. Easy to get there by bus too. Many restaurants around.
spacey bedrooms & dinner room. Included breakfast.

Nice apartment and facilities. Everything was as advertised and the apartment clean and everything worked. Area itself is not very interesting, but it has all the necessary amenities. It’s about a 7-10 minute walk to the nearest Bakerloo line tube station, from which you can reach the entire city. Would recommend this apartment
Small but very modern airbnb! We enjoyed our stay, location was great and super close to Underground and bus stops. Only thing: Kitchen could be a bit more stocked.
Very good location and clean studio. However, it is located in a very noisy area and the studio is smaller than it looks in the photos.

Loved our stay at Alistairs place! So easy to get around from the location and offered so many good food spots nearby. The location itself is lovely, quiet and like I said close to the trains. His pet fish was very friendly and treated us well haha
Mike is very friendly and nice, he always immediately help us to solve our problems, the place is easy to get there and convenient to visitors spots ,we had a great time here😀

It´s a lovely apartment with a little garden to get a rest if you went to busy Central London for sightseeing. The park nearby is nice and you can go for a coffee to the Rookery Cafe. We stayed for a week and were completelely happy with everything. Thanks to Anna & Craig!

We had a wonderful stay at Tamara’s - lovely to have a nice big kitchen where we could gather and plan our days and spend the evenings relaxing in lovely big lounge room - great to watch the people go by.

A cosy stay in a great location, a stone's throw from the main street meaning plenty of excellent restaurants and public transport all around. A little noisy on a Friday night, but nothing unusual for how close the place is to everything!

Wr stayed here when we came to London to meet up with family and friends for my partner's 40th (he used to live in Colliers Wood) so was a perfect location. It's an absolute gem of a place, perfectly located for an easy walk to the Tube station which is on the Northern Line, lots of restaurants and pubs nearby.
The place was spotlessly clean and perfectly equipped with everything you could need for a stay here. Katherine was a really friendly host, going above and beyond to share lots of helpful and clear information for our stay.
I would absolutely use this place again.

I enjoyed my stay at Sandra’s - the bedroom was spacious and comfortable, and I used the kitchen quite a bit which was a lovely space and well-stocked. Sandra is friendly and helpful. Would stay again!
Great space with privacy and easy check-in. very convient with the central line only a 15 minute walk away.

Very clean and fantastic hosts always checking in.
Close to transport links to get into london .

Great place and comfortable location with proximity to bus and tube. Clean apartment with all amenities that you’ll need. Sergio and Denise were very helpful and responsive!!
Really enjoyed staying in their place and highly recommended!!!
Superb Location right next to Underground station, Lots of restaurants nearby , The host was very responsive and flexible. Value for Money!!

Felt like I was on a dream couldn't recommend more. The ambient feels like home, Samir and his family always try to help, the room they gave me was so big that I could definitely sleep on the wardrobe.

Vas’s place was quite nice and in a great neighborhood of Marylebone! We had a nice stay there. The only comments would be echoing some other feedback: the beds are quite firm and we did have an issue with the hot water our final night. Otherwise, it was a lovely place with loads of space! 5 stars!

The Wimbledon flat is a fantastic location. We had a beautiful week-long stay. Perfect for our family, two adults and two kids. It is close to the tube station and several supermarkets nearby. Also, a beautiful green park is very close, ideal for running. The flat is very clean, exactly matched the description and in a quiet street. Victoria was responsive and very helpful. Staying at Wimbledon flat is very recommended.
Had a great stay, place was very close walk to the underground and was surrounded by lots of markets. The place was a bit loud but that’s what I would expect in London
Great location, nice host, plenty of restaurants nearby. It was a little hard to sleep with open windows because of the noise and smells from the restaurants downstairs.
Angela was very friendly and responsive before and during my stay.  She also was really helpful when train strikes meant I had to alter my transport method.

George was actually who we dealt with, and he was friendly and accommodating and very responsive.  The flat is a small but charming spot near SoHo, very quiet but within walking distance to tons of things, including a ton of restaurants, coffee shops, the West End and even Buckingham Palace.  Excellent place to take in how wonderful London is!

Our stay was brilliant. Very clean and easy access. Not too far from the train station and the bus takes you right outside too.
Really enjoyed our stay and felt like everything was supplied to make our weekend as efficient as possible.
Thank you so much☺️

This space was great. Super close to the train, bus, shops and pubs. Super quiet area with great walk ability and very easy to get into the city. Rosario was so welcoming, warm and accommodating. He made sure to be available when needed and was so flexible and friendly. I would definitely book again.
Very clean, in a nice leafy area (Rotherhithe). Everything as described. Van and his cleaning staff were very pleasant.
Me and my girlfriend had a great stay here. The space was extremely homely and in an ideal location. Esteban was a great host, would definitely stay again!

fantastic stay and Anna was really helpful.  Brilliant location within easy reach of central london. A peaceful and beautiful retreat on an evening from the busy days in the city. A relaxing home away from home.
Vas was super communicative, very accommodating and just an overall great host! Would love to stay here again on future trips!

Wow - an incredible place to stay and we can’t wait to book the place again. The positive energy hits you from the time you enter and a place to be enjoyed and experienced. The galaxy projector was the icing on the cake. Of all the Air BNB places I’ve stayed at, I will never forget this one.

Clean, functional living space.
Easy enough room for the 6 adults who stayed.
Would definitely recommend and use again.
Thank you for the advice and support leading up to the visit. And for allowing us to drop our bags prior to check in as we had an event to attend.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay in the Chelsea district of London, and much of that is thanks to your exceptional accommodations. The property was not only well-located, allowing us easy access to local shops, restaurants, and iconic landmarks, but it also offered all the comforts of home.
The attention to detail in the decor and amenities truly made our stay special. We were particularly impressed by how clean and well-maintained everything was. Your recommendations for local dining and activities were spot-on and greatly enhanced our experience.
Thank you for contributing to a memorable trip. We look forward to returning in the future.
Best regards,
Thomas
Joseph is a Super great communicator. Everything was so smooth … prefect location as we needed to get back on the train from king cross the next day… !

Mar’s place was in a fantastic location to enjoy London! The apartment is located a very quick walk to Vauxhall metro station and has a great view of the Thames. Due to many listings in the same building our actual apartment differed to the pictures shown, but we were very happy with the apartment and it was spacious enough for a family of 4 with 2 adult kids. We did find check in a little difficult due to the many buildings in the vicinity, so it is important to throughly read the check in email. The security deposit is also not a requirement I have come across throughout my many Air  BnB stays, but I received email confirmation that it would be paid back to me in a reasonable time frame after checkout. Overall, a fantastic stay and would recommend!

Had a great stay, lovely comfy bed, very clean apartment, lots of local shops & restaurants around each corner, apartment was easy to find and would definitely stay again. 10/10.
Thanks again to Max & Billie ⭐️ x

It was a great stay at Isabelle’s place! She was very friendly and made us delicious breakfast every morning. It was helpful for us to hear her recommendations in London! Thank you for accommodating us ❤️
Helen's place is conveniently located at the heart Leicester Square. Perfect for a couple/solo traveller with no lack of food, entertainment and public transport options around.

This apartment was centrally located, looked just like the photos and was perfect for our London travels. It was very comfortable and thoughtfully decorated- the ideal home-base for our busy itinerary. Great area with lots to do if you want to stay local, as well. Branca was very responsive and accommodating- wonderful experience!

It was a nice experience, did not spend a lot of time at the house because of the working hours I had to do at that time. Imran is a friendly, caring and generous host. He was eager to know what is my feedback every now and then so that he develops the facility even more so I assume the room would get better and better with time which is a very good sign. The only thing I would love to see is a more organized/cleaner bathroom and thats it basically. I was satisfied with the stay and recommend it 100%.
Not to forget that the location is perfect because its only 2 mins away from Harrow Town Center.

Natalie is a fantastic host and made sure our stay was easy and enjoyable. The welcome package was especially appreciated after our 30+hr journey from NW Australia. The house is stylish and comfortable and had everything we needed. Thanks Natalie.

Everything is just as indicated, no surprises, well equipped kitchen. I liked the cafe place on the corner and how close it is to the Lea, great for a morning run. I would recommend staying with Eliana, she was super helpful and responded  quickly to any questions I had.

Excellent location, cute little loft apartment, beautiful balcony, hosts were very responsive, quiet street, walkable to restaurants, train station, coffee shops etc.
Max & Billie’s place was perfect for us for a few nights, we loved it! However, we would not recommend if you are older as the stairs are very steep to the bed in the loft.
Will definitely stay again when we visit London!
Vikash is very friendly and accommodating. He allowed us to check in early and has great car parking facilities. Very good sized rooms and communal areas.

Great Airbnb. You share the house with other Airbnb guests which in our case worked very well. All other visitors were respectful and mindful about their noise. However, I can imagine that your experience may vary if you get unlucky with other visitors.
All facilities are pristine, nice kitchen and 2 clean bathrooms. A key box outside the apartment is a great way to check in whenever you like. The only point of critique for our stay was the bed. For somebody who is 1.91m tall, the bed was too short for me, I also think it will be too small horizontally for most couples.
In summary, I would definitely recommend this place but be aware that the bed might be smaller than you're used to at different Airbnbs.
Location was perfect to be in the center of all the great sites to see in London. Helen was very helpful to getting settled and the room had everything I needed!

Gio's place was absolutely fantastic!! Location was perfect, right on Oxford St but not too noisy. It has been really hard to find a 3 bedroom place where the building had an elevator and where all the bedrooms were on one floor - and this exactly fit the bill. It was spacious, spotless clean, beautifully furnished, had everything you would need in the kitchen and bathrooms, and had a nice terrace. Gio was very communicative and helpful in the checkin. Highly recommend for groups of 3-6 if you are looking for a place in Central London.

I stayed at this place for 7 nights with my daughter while the location was amazing with great access to public transport and nearby cafes and supermarkets, the room was extremely cramped even for just two people. The check in and check out was fairly easy and the staff was responsive.
Would totally recommend this place if space is not an issue.

We had an incredible stay during our trip and the best part is easy access to public transportation. The place is very well maintained and the host is very friendly and responsive. Highly recommended.

I would definitely recommend coming to this Place. He is helpful and friendly happy to give any help required. Place had everything you needed and was private and peaceful. And in walkable distance to the bus station.
overall experience Excellent👍

A lovely, cozy, clean and tidy apartment with a trendy interior design, artistic decorations and comfortable beds. Its location is quite convenient with easy access to a number of bus routes. The property owner, Shlome is very nice and responded promptly to the questions and requests raised by us. We had a pleasant stay in this apartment.
Perfect location in Shoreditch, very walkable area in general and close to an overground tube station that allowed us to get anywhere quickly. Would stay again!

We had a wonderful stay.
I just loved it.Would recommend everyone .❤️❤️❤️
Thanks!!!
Lin was a great host and her place felt right at home.  Charming with lots of nearby amenities.  Would certainly recommend!

So glad I chose to stay at Din’s place! It was perfect for me as a solo traveller and I can also see how convertible he has made it for multiple people to stay too. The area was peaceful and walkable to all the major things I wanted to see - plus walkable to tube stations. Dins was super easy to communicate with. Would stay again!

Michael was very attentive and easy to communicate with.  His house is very cozy, with a very nice back yard visited by squirrels and neighborhood cats, and even foxes.  The Maryland station is close by and access to the city is easy.  We thoroughly enjoyed staying at his house.
Andrea is very kind and helpful, the house was clean and situated in a strategic place. definitely recommended.
Fantastic host - Hayley was super responsive and helpful . The flat was great and we have a lovely stay
Gonna make a note and save this to anyone who comes to London to visit me. Great price, location and place overall.

5 stars!
Gio was very responsive and helpful. Beautiful, clean and high spec apartment. Great location!

The place is very comfortable and Amanda is lovely! She is responsive and clear. I was there with my elder parents so the whole flat being on the ground floor is perfect. The train station is walkable (8-10mins) but if you’re traveling with elders with long walking/standing difficulties, I suggest looking for another stay with bus station nearby or check if the bus number 187 will get you where you need in general. Overall we had a great time there and would love to comeback next time! Thank you, Amanda :)

Felt like being at home! Very comfortable and grateful for the Dyson fans to cool the place down with higher temperatures. Bus stop nearby and 15 mins walk to metro. Takes about 10 steps to get from street level into the flat; bedroom and main living areas downstairs with one bedroom and bathroom upstairs. Also enjoyed garden evenings to have some bubbly and chat at end of long touring days.

Great location, perfectly clean room and bathroom, easy communication and instructions. We really enjoyed the stay!
I appreciate that the noise was mentioned in the destription of the accommodation, we were prepared and didnt mind at all, thank you for being honest.
Good place to stay. Street noise was a little loud, but otherwise very solid option outside of the center city. Would stay again!

What a lovely flat and warm and helpful hosts too! I only had one night here, but would have loved to have stayed longer as the flat is very convenient for major rail stations and lots of restaurants etc, but is amazingly quiet.  For me, the essence of Airbnb is being able to stay in a home-from-home, and this definitely fulfilled that requirement. Really-well equipped and comfortable. Hope to return.
The flat was great and clean. You need roughly 20 minutes to London Victoria by train which run every 10 minutes. Perfectly fine and to be recommended.
Good location for a trip to London! Looks like in the pictures and good value for price. I would book it again!

Place looks exactly like images, clean, it’s quite hot though. shops around but they don’t have a lot of stuff like snacks, have to take the bus to get to the high street places, flat is in an alleyway so be cautious if alone
Great location, and the apartment was as expected. Immediate response and fixing what I requested right away. I enjoyed my stay there. thumbs up to the apartment, Regards.

We enjoyed a wonderful few days at this fabulous apartment in Notting Hill!  Matthew was very helpful and the apartment is pristine and as immaculate is it looks in the photos ! Would definitely recommend this apartment highly and it’s very professionally run!
Great host. Compact flat with everything you need, situated in a quiet neighbourhood, very close to heart of Wimbledon

Great place for a short stay in London.
Bars and restaurants in Shoreditch are within walking distance.
Located on a busy road so cannot be noisy at times.
Marijana was a great host !

I stayed with my mom and we had a blessed! The location was perfect, we walked to Shoreditch, the restaurants around the place were good, near by a big supermarket and we enjoyed also eating at home. The host was really nice and useful, I would come back again!

Absolutely loved out stay! Lovely area in London w lots of shops/ ready air ants nearby. Isabelle provided home made breakfast daily. Lovely bedroom w nice decor, mini library I really enjoyed and a very comfortable bed. Everything was perfect. Highly recommend!
Great spot, close to coffee shops and bus routes, and one bus to a train station. Quiet area to sleep with the windows open. Lovely property, well furnished!

James' place was spot on. It did exactly what it said 'on the tin'. Cheap, cheerful and brilliantly priced. I would definately use it again as a base for that area of London and James was welcoming and answered all queries quickly and easily. A great find. Thanks James.

A good place in a good neighborhood in London. Close to subway station, only disadvantage is a hot water system. It needs to be preheated with a button, it takes several minutes to heat. but not too long, you just need to remember about it. A place with a good self check system
We would stay here again.  The only thing I was disappointed in was the patio.  It could be a special place but needs work.
The place was clean and well presented. Justyna was responsive and helpful. Thank you for the pleasant stay!
I had such a lovely stay here, it was exactly what I needed. Zuzana was extremely flexible with an early check in and the room was cozy and charming. Would highly recommend :)
Thanks for a wonderful stay. This flat is beautiful and in a fantastic location. Easy check in, secure, private, and homely. I would happily recommend staying here!

Great place to stop, Hames is a friendly guy and provides a comfy bed bit far from LHR.
Aldi up the road too.
Highly recommended

Ariana is great. I think we would have given 5 stars but the flat is beside a really busy street with a lot of noise. Since it was hot, we had to keep the windows open so our sleep was interrupted. Space itself is great.
Omar’s place was great! Only the bed can be improved but other than that I would definitely stay again when I come back!

We had a brilliant stay at Megan’s flat, which actually exceeded our expectations. Couldn’t have asked for a more comfortable place to stay, and the location is perfect: right across from the Heath, with all the amenities of Hampstead Village just moments away.  A real home from home, and somewhere we wouldn’t hesitate to book again.
We had a great stay at this quaint little studio. It came with everything you could need. Nicely redone.
Would definitely return. Great central location and all the amenities you could need. Communication was quick and clear too - thank you!

Nice flat and really handy location, perfect for a few days in London.
Kar was also very friendly and helpful :)

By far the most peaceful Airbnb I’ve been to with my travels to London. Alessia was so kind and thoughtful. Very flexible with my arrival time and even stayed up to greet me!!! Her home is so peaceful and quiet which was perfect for my stay.  The bathroom is spotless! So clean with the extra goodies to take care of your skin :) Bedroom was very clean and she had a little snack bin and a electrical kettle for some coffee and tea! I will most certainly come back to stay with her again!

Great property, the space has been well designed, is modern and very well looked after. Our family of 4 have really enjoyed our stay . Tiffany is a really good host, she has been very helpful and communication is quick and easy. We would thoroughly recommend at stay at Tiffany's!!
Great place to stay, very nice room with tons of light, really well equipped, too. Short walk to a few parks and trains and buses to pretty much anywhere in London. Would stay again!

Carolyn was a spectacular host!  Super communicative, detailed videos and instruction. I was super impressed. The train station, market and other things are in walking distance. The house was spacious and beautiful and she even left milk, bread and yummy treats for us. Highly recommended. If I return to London, I will definitely stay again!

It was a pleasure to return and given the chance, I will be back again. This is superb accommodation at a great price. Don’t be put off by the distance from the centre of London, there’s a bus at the door to East Croydon station and you can be in the city in 40 minutes. Use the money you save to cover your Oyster card; several extra days in town; and a few West End shows – that’s what we did. And on the days you want a rest, the local pubs and the Chinese takeaway are great.
Sollah was great at communicating with us the entire stay. The apartment has everything you need and is close to public transport as well as bars, restaurants and cafes

We had an absolutely perfect stay at Damion’s gorgeous home. Such a beautiful space and we instantly felt at home. Such a treat! Damion was incredibly communicative and made sure we arrived at his home without any issues- despite our late arrival. The location was brilliant for our east and central London adventures with great bus/ night bus services and a short walk to the underground. Would highly recommend Damion’s home, one of our favourite Airbnb experiences. 🤩

Debbie's apartment is in a great location to access London's attractions and train to nearby town as well as other European cities. The apartment is well maintained and clean. We have enjoyed our short stay in such a cozy apartment. Debbie is also very prompt in her response.
They are very polite and helpful and the house, toilet and common areas are very clean. There is a lovely woman who cleans the house constantly.

Monica was responsive and extremely accommodating.  We were arriving a little earlier to London than normal check in, but Monica allowed early check in with my arrival time.  Overall a great experience.

The location was perfect. Lots of restaurants, pubs and supermarkets around the corner. Close to the tube, Piccadilly and Central line covers a lot of places without changes. The house was clean and Clarissa helpful and super nice.
Can definitely recommend this place.
Thanks Andrea for being responsive and supportive throughout my entire stay! The place is kept tidy and clean, and is quite suitable for short stays with not-too-many luggages.

Overall the house is nice. This location is not suitable if you have difficulty climbing narrow stairs. The house is on multiple levels and requires you to climb stairs to get between bathrooms, kitchen, living space. There was construction ongoing in the unit directly below us during our stay and unfortunately this started at 8:00 a.m. every morning, loud noises and power tools.

Really nice, compact apartment in a fantastic location, just outside the busy areas of London, but very accessible due to being very close to the Underground.
Apartment was very clean, and had all the required amenities, including a communal washing machine, which is far easier than finding and lugging all your clothes to a laundromat.
Checkin was provided in very clear, concise instructions.
The Notting Hill apartment was tastefully decorated and very comfortable. Great location near restaurants and the tube..would highly recommend.

I had a fantastic stay at Sovan's place. The accommodation was spotlessly clean and conveniently close to amenities. Sovan was an incredibly helpful host who made my visit even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this place for a great stay!

Splendid flat near Clapham junction. Everything was exactly as described with very clear instructions.
The location was strategic in both transportation and groceries. My family really enjoyed the place as the flat was fully equipped and quiet.
for sure if we have the opportunity, we would choose this location again.
Great location for tourists. it was clean and the staff very friendly. it was a little loud at night because of the windows but overall it was great.

Max was the most responsive and helpful host I have ever had. He helped me figure out public transportation, gave recommendations on things to do, even offered to give me a private tour of London! His apartment was stunning with beautiful views and it was the perfect location right by covent garden.  Highly recommend max and his apartment!
Comfy bed, great little apartment with everything you need in a posh, family friendly neighborhood. Great pub within walking and close enough walk to transit.
