Raphael was a very helpful and accommodating host and a fount of knowledge about all things Bayswater. We would definitely try to stay here on future visits!

Perfect home for visiting London. Calm neighbourhood, but near to underground station.
The flat is small but everything what you need.
Recommend the restaurant Fumeiro near the flat.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly welcoming and attentive, ensuring that every detail was taken care of. The space was immaculate, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, with easy access to local amenities. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay.

It’s a great place to stay in London. It was the best experience staying there. This place is very well maintained...Upon arrival we were warmly welcomed by the Owner(Aunty). Hosts were extremely friendly. The room was spacious and comfortable. We loved the ambience
I would highly recommend this place!!
Thank you Aunty & Uncle for being a nice host.
The apartment was nice and matched the photos. Monica was very helpful and responsive. Easy access to the Underground to get where we needed to go. Great experience!

Fantastic one bedroom flat in a great area between Leicester Square and Covent Garden. It's a busy area so it's not silent outside, but there were ear plugs provided and the location was worth it. The pull out couch worked great for our two kids as well. We would absolutely stay here again!

Michael was very helpful and flexible with my group's need to check-in early, replying to all my messages promptly and helping us with our demands however he could.  He was incredibly pleasant and hospitable in person, and the flat was clean, comfortable and cosy.  Will absolutely be booking with him again when next in the area!
Richard was a lovely host. His place is a great location and super awesome vibe in the city!

Our stay was wonderful. The home was very clean, decorated beautifully and close to Kings Cross. Giovanna was very accommodating for our early baggage drop off and always responded to our messages. Great size for two people, had everything we needed. We would certainly book with her again!
we stayed here for MCM comicon and it was a great place! a quick walk from the excel centre, comfy for my friends and I, and a quiet neighbourhood with enough space on the drive for 2 cars.
James is an amazing host! Very responsive and accommodated our check in time. Room was clean and nice . Would definitely stay again .  Provided water , cookies and coffee , totally worth it .
Everything was just as described. Louise and Shelly were very responsive. Amenities provided were very useful. The area was very peaceful. In short, had a wonderful experience!
We had a great experience! Place was clean, close to the stations and very comfortable and cozy.

We had a great stay at Mael’s place, it’s spacious and central to everything we wanted to see. Great recommendations for places to eat and drink, top notch/nosh!
We had a late flight so he let us hang out after the normal check out time, this was a lifesaver as I had a sick child.
Thanks Mael.
Nice in general. Tidy. Kitchen is quite big and equipment is clean. Ventilation is slightly not enough, making the process of cloth drying very slow. Toilet looks very clean but shower head is weak.
Our week at Katherine's very modern basement flat was ideal,  providing  the much needed comfort, privacy and homeliness after weeks of travel.
Had a good stay on my business trip. Close to Tufnell Park station and Kentish Town. Thanks you, had everything I needed with some little complements!

Iyisha was so kind and made sure I had everything I needed for my stay. Very comfortable and quiet so was able to work and think and slept very well too!
I would definitely stay again without hesitation.

We really liked the place. The apartment looks like on the pictures. We stayed one week and we missed nothing. The communication with Adam was fast. He is a funny guy. If staying in London once again, we would come back to Adam’s place.
The apartment is located near coffee shops, stores, bars and restaurants. The bus station is 2 min away and train station around 10 min away.

What can I say, this flat was amazing. Very close to multiple bus stop and tube stations, so getting around the city is convenient. The place was amazing, and had everything we needed for our stay. This is an amazing flat to book for your stay if it is available.

This apartment is great and very close to the metro station, making transportation convenient. There's a park very close to the apartment where you can go for a run. Sophie responded to messages quickly and was very considerate and kind. We had a wonderful week in London.

Brand new, spotless, high-quality, well-furnished large room. 60 seconds away from the bus stop, and from the tube, and from restaurants. Perfect, really. I would have liked thicker pillows, but I guess that's a personal preference.

Perfect apartment in a perfect location. We loved being in the thick of Notting Hill. Can step outside and right in the heart of everything - but not noisy! Outstanding host. Thoroughly recommend and way better than staying in hotels

Peaceful, comfortable, clean and convenient.
We had a good nights sleep on good quality bedding. The location is tranquil and handy for convenience stores.
It was good to have a separate kitchen and this was very clean and functional.
Room was spacious, light and airy. Overall a very pleasant stay.

Great host, very very responsive; super convenient location (few minutes walk to two different metro lines; it's possible to store luggage before and after the stay (after confirmation from the host).
Thanks for this stay! :)

Good location near metro station 2-3 minutes to walk. The apartment of rina is very clean was a pleaure to stay here
Thanks

The place was great in every way. The hosts provided lots of things like drinking water, coffee, condiments etc. The location is amazing, super close to the Paddington station which for us was great as we were in London for the Champions League final. The terrace was lovely as well and the place was very clean. Would definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a nice and quiet area with subway stations nearby.

Amy’s flat is a great place to stay. Easy to find and in 10 minute walkable distance to Balham high street and tube station.
The flat itself is located on the 1st floor of a converted house and spans over 2 floors. It was clean and well stocked with all the amenities we needed.
Beds were clean and comfortable.
Amy as a host is everything we needed, always prompt at responding to messages and answered any questions we had. Thank you Amy for letting us stay at your place and wouldn’t hesitate in staying again.
We had a lovely stay at the flat. It was super clean and tidy, a lot more spacious than expected. Photos do not do the property justice. Great location. Would recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay. The place is so nice. The only issue we had was the trains were quite loud going past.
Second time staying here.  Stylish and well located space. Richard the host is always very responsive. Highly recommend.
excellent choice, very clean and a great location.  Julia and her  mother are very polite and helpful. 100% recommended.

Amazing week in London and ideal location to both go into the city and drive to locations outside the city limits. Comfortable accommodations and centrally located for several tub stations/restaurants, groceries, etc.
Parking was a little tricky but that's no reflection on this listing!!! Private patio is a great "tucked away" space to unwind!! I would definitely stay here again if I return to London. Many thanks for being such a great host!

Cara's place was absolutely perfect for a concert at the o2, was home in 10 minutes. Great location and host as a solo female traveller. Cara was really helpful before and during my stay, flexible with check in as I arrived a little earlier than expected. Would definitely stay again if attending the o2 or needed to be in Greenwich area
Jinny’s place was spacious, clean and in a great location. She was very responsive and overall had a good stay.

We occupied this space for a month. It is immaculate and comfortable. It  was easy walking to the southeastern rail station, shopping and restaurants. We can't say enough about our gratitude to our hosts. One of us had a medical emergency and was in the  hospital for a week. Our hosts went above and beyond in their attention and material aid. This included personal  hospital visits. We can give no higher recommendation to our hosts than what we write here.
Very lovely host and everything was as described. Location ideal to go the o2 and easy access to transport

Great location but can be loud in the evenings, but nothing too terrible. The liveliness of the area is expected. Host is responsive and provides lots of amenities that many would not expect. Absolutely great flat for a stay in London.

A great apartment that met all our needs! Great location close to fabulous restaurants and shopping and convenient to Clapham common and Clapham junction station. The apartment is small but had everything we required. Communication with Kelly was great and she responded immediately to any questions we had.
Would recommend!
Lovely  place, ammenties neaeby a home away from home. we will be back soon
A lovely place that was right near the train station and nice and quiet  A great place to stay.
close to the stockwell underground therefore very easy to get to it and go to the center of London. Neighborhood is chill and the place is quite peaceful.

Staying in Chingford was a delightful experience, largely due to our wonderful Airbnb host. The host’s friendliness and willingness to help with all our queries made our stay stress-free and enjoyable. The house was just as described – spotless, cozy, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The host’s lovely dog was an added bonus, providing us with some joyful moments. The location was perfect for our family visits, and we appreciated the tranquility of the neighborhood. We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming stay in London.

This is a fabulous flat, we highly recommend.
It is very spacious, this everything you would want, from kitchen equipment to bathroom items, even fresh roses in the lounge room.
It was very clean, well maintained, and has quality linen.
It is located in a beautiful and quiet area but only 5mins walk to the tube station
Simon is a lovely host, very friendly and thoughtful.
We hope to stay again one day.

We loved our stay! Beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to paddington station and Hyde park. Also easy access to bikes. The home was very big - three queen sized beds and 2.5 baths. All
On one floor (below grade). I would recommend this flat for a group or family! Thank you Gordana for being so welcoming and helpful!
great stay at Numa London. great location with easy access to public transportation. Room was small, but if you're only using it to sleep like we were, it's totally fine.

Clean and spacious flat. Neighborhood has quiet evenings and lively days, and feels very safe. we were so happy we didn't stay in tourist central. Sophie is attentive yet unintrusive, excellent communication, and a top flight professional.

The location is perfect: in Chinatown, (great food) and adjacent to Soho, Covent Gardens and Westminster. It was surprisingly quiet. Right outside on the street is the bustle of Chinatown, but the flat is on the second floor and facing to the back, so there was no noise.
There is a lift, which was very helpful for the luggage. The flat is small and very practical: several sockets and therefore easy to recharge your phone, place to hang clothes, microwave, kettle, fridge, etc.
The check-in was in person which was nice.

Recently stayed at Michael's place.  Location was perfect for our weekend visit to London and for attending a sporting event at London Stadium.  15 min walk to train and to stadium.  Michael was very responsive to questions and provided great info re: train travel from airport and location of closest grocery store etc.  Looks exactly as pictured.  Would highly recommend

Easy to get to Northern Tube station to take you in to London.  Also bus stop just outside flat.  The flat is in a very nice area.  And inside appearance is nice and comfortable.  Adam was very helpful and ready to answer any questions we had.  Over and beyond, even helping us pick a stay for our next stop on our holiday
the coziest 2 bed flat with a lot of space. i was very surprised at how big it was but it was absolutely fabulous and perfect for a 2 person trip. would deffo book again as gareth is a lovely host xx

Alexi is a wonderful host and that alone makes this worth 5 stars. The cherry on top is the home. It's beautifully unique to London, there are even views of the Shard and other skyscrapers from the upstairs room. The hot water and pressure were excellent. The beds were comfortable. I would come back and recommend!

Staying with Isabelle was like coming home to my sister. She was welcoming and more than helpful with finding the best way to get where we wanted to go. Our breakfasts were exactly what we wanted to start the day, and Isabelle was flexible with that, too. Our bed was very comfortable and the room exceptionally quiet, especially considering the wonderful pub next door. (Wonderful food and drink there too!)
We appreciated having the front room to relax in and Mr Darcy (the cat) was surprisingly good with staying out of our bedroom but came for some pets when invited to.
We loved ‘coming home’ here and recommend this lively lady and her home.

Loved being close to the Borough Market and everything else around the Tower Bridge and Southwark area of London.
Great rental for a family of four with two teenagers thanks to the pull out sofa being a comfortable third bed.

We had a lovely stay in Damini and Ashok's lovely house in a quiet neighbourhood. After a warm welcome and chat with both, Ashok showed us to a well furnished room with generous bed and thick curtains to give a dark room. En suite bathroom had a good shower and facilities. Breakfast in the  morning set us up for the next day. Spot on for us. Thank you!
Great place, really clean and very good and easy communication with Marijana. This is my second time staying in this airbnb and would definitely stay a third!
Great stay and perfect for our stay! Incredible location to paddington station, making it easy to get around everywhere. The hosts were great and easy to work with.

Fitzroy Square is such a special place - a hidden treasure in the heart of London. Rebecca is a wonderful host, is so flexible and helpful, and made us feel so welcome. Loved the treats she had for us in the flat after arriving from a long overnight flight.
Anyone who stays here will understand what a great find this is!

Evelyn was a wonderful host. She was always quick to respond and gave clear instructions upon check in and check out. The accommodation was great and well-located to get into London. Thank you to Evelyn for a wonderful stay!

Really comfortable and clean with high quality fittings.  Quick responses to queries.  This place was great for our two night stay and pretty easy to get to using public transport from central London.

My family and I had the most pleasant stay in this spacious and upmarket apartment in central London. Our host Ana was most attentive and accommodating to all our needs.
Definitely coming back!

My family of 9 stayed in this lovely 6-bed house during our weeklong trip to London. It exceeded our expectations - very clean and comfortable. There was a travel cot/crib and high chair available for use during our time. Being right next to a pub was no issue; we never had any noise in problems when bedtime came around. Location couldn’t be more perfect - close to shopping, food, transportation, and even a large park with a popular playground for the kiddos. Would definitely stay here again next time!
The place was exactly as it looks. My teens usually prefer a hotel but loved this apartment.  Great location (quiet yet close to it all) and very responsive host! Hope to be back!

After more than 200 trips to Europe, I know a little about where to stay, and Olga's flat was superb.  Super-quiet back street, yet close to public transport and Santander shared-bike stations.  Charming furniture and decor, a great desk for working, fully-equipped kitchen, and wonderful details seldom found in Airbnbs, like motion-activated nightlights in hall and bathroom, and posh bedding.  And Olga is a fabulous host, friendly and responsive.  A great place!

I am afraid not much to write home about. If it meets your budget, it’s a place to stay and that’s about it.
The shower water temperature control is broken and needs to be fixed immediately, it only pours scalding hot water at all settings. I tried to raise this with the team but they misunderstood and simply sent me a video on how to operate a it rather than send someone to fix it.
Location was perfect for the activities we had in mind in our stay and we did have everything we needed

Nidhi and Sam are helpful,  responsive hosts. Marina was a lovely greeter too! The welcome pack and flowers were very nice. We ate the fruit and toast for breakfast every morning. Location in Marylebone and close to the Baker Street tube are very convenient. The only request is one more comfortable seat for relaxing after long days touring London!

We had a warm welcome and help with our luggages. The fridge was packed with basic necessities such as butter, coke and milk for us to use
We had spices, sugar, coffee and they even got us cookies upon our arrival which was thoughtful and nice
The toaster was not working but all the other amenities worked properly
Jodie also helped us book our Uber to and from the airport upon request since we could not do it with our e-sim to avoid us pay expensive airport transfers.
The location was perfect for what I wanted to see in 3 days walking distance to many great places in center of SoHo- had a great time
Shola was a great host. Gave me great recommendations in what to do while and London. Very gracious and flexible about checking-in and out. Shola was incredibly responsive as well.

We had a very convenient experience living at Maria’s. Not only was her house all well equipped, it was beautiful. We’d love to stay at this same place whenever we visit London.
Maria is so organized, responsive and nice that it was easy to get any questions answered. She was also proactive in sending all instructions in much advance.
We appreciated our stay at her place very much

Very hip flat that actually feels like a home (not at all a typical sterile Airbnb experience!). Kirsty was super responsive and helpful and gave us the sweetest gift baskets of goodies to help celebrate the wedding we were attending. It’s a short walk to buses and some nice cafes. Would definitely come back!

Monica’s flat was just as described - looked exactly like the pictures.  Very cozy and inviting. Lots of immenities available - from shampoos and soaps to coffee, oils and vinegars.   The location was perfect for us - less than 10 minutes to walk to the local tube station that took us everywhere.  Neighbourhood is quiet and filled with local pubs and restaurants all within walking distance. It was nice to come back to a quiet place after the hustle and bustle of London.  Monica was very proactive and responsive.  Would highly recommend to anyone.

Had an outstanding visit to London in Matthew’s Notting Hill apartment. Location was excellent and communication before and during our stay was incredibly helpful.
Highly recommend!
There was a sink leakage problem but the homeowner fixed it quickly and promised to make a discount for it. That was responsible. Also very easy place for public transportations.
The location of the house is great. It’s clean and very close to transportation options. You’re a 5-minute walk from Hyde Park. We had a wonderful stay with our two children.

The Host Ali is an absolute gentleman allowing you to enjoy the beautiful property that he has created.
Does not disturb at all except for when we go to him for inputs.
Quite proactive in giving inputs and instructions and immediate response to messages

what an amazing host and great place to stay great location will definitely be staying there every time I go to London.
it feels so homely and comfortable inside its literally gong from home to home,
Fazile always replies promptly when asked questions,
really is 100% amazing

This place is a GEM in the heart of Sloane Square.  It is perfectly furnished and felt homely. We mostly walked everywhere but it is very close to the underground.   Ate in the surrounding neighbourhoods.   Thanks Ange.   See you next year.
great little appartement. very comfy clean and fully furnished. the host was always available and very helpful. the place is 30 min walk from London bridge.
Cozy and cute place to stay for some nights. Wembley is very nice. Near to accommodation is London designer outlet shopping centre. Easy to get to central city.

This place was lovely and clean and the host was very welcoming and respectful. Made us aware of local amenities.
The en-suite was perfect for us.
Would have been nice to have a TV in the room but not a big issue.
Nice and clean and easy to find plenty of free parking in the street.

Accommodation just as described, ideal for a short stay. A convenient location for exploring. Kar was very responsive and helpful. A tiny bit of noise from people entering adjacent studios but very quiet for London. Our only points for the future are the lack of tea towel (the side was very wet after washing up) and a fan for summer months. Thank you for a wonderful stay 😊

We thoroughly enjoyed our time at this Chelsea flat - location was great for walking to the tube or enjoying the local areas. Neighbourhood was very quiet, which was a great relief after being in the busy downtown London streets all day. The flat is as described and very clean - just note that one bedroom/bathroom is quite a bit smaller than the other so allocate rooms accordingly! Would definitely stay here again on another visit.
This is a straightforward and no-frills Airbnb but it was all easy (though probably helped by my knowing the area in finding it) and safe, and certainly well worth the cheap price.
Tina was the kindest host! The noise was not an issue for me at all. The location was perfect to go sightseeing with a quick jump on the tube under 2 blocks away
This is my favorite airbnb in London, and Inge is a wonderful host.  I have been coming back here where I am in town for business for eight years.  So sorry others have found out how good it is.
All great. Stayed for one night. As described. All clean. Next to station. Would choose again.

Great stay in London! The apartment is in a strategic location, close to the tube, buses and supermarket. Lovely area. Spacious apartment. I highly recommend staying here and we will be back. Thanks Katherin!
Another comfortable stay at Bipin’s place. Very useful as a base when exploring or commuting into the centre London, with a very friendly and helpful host.

Fazile was a great host providing a welcoming and friendly home and atmosphere. The apartment is really beautiful and relaxing perfect after a busy day/night in London - with especially cosy beds for a perfect night rest.
Fazile is open and easy to communicate with providing clear instructions for everything, and good recommendations. She really cares about her home, neighbourhood and your stay - thank you so much for the milk!

Very comfortable room, centrally located, clean and quiet.
Had an issue with the passcode not letting us into the room - sent a message on Whats App and sorted within a few minutes.
Very responsive - would highly recommend.
Definitely will stay again
Max was very helpful, and readily available to answer questions I had. It was a pleasure to stay in the lovely flat.
Nice place, great location, getting the key was a bit of a challenge because it was stored elsewhere.

Fantastic place for a big group! I couldn’t believe how spacious this was for being in London, nor how nice it was! Looks exactly as pictured and was very comfortable for our group of 9 — could certainly have held a couple more without issue. Very thankful for this and how well it met our needs!

A perfect stay in a gorgeous apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in London. We had a wonderful time at Wlad’s place and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good base in London. The apartment looks exactly like the photos, was completely spotless, and is super peaceful but surrounded by a lively neighborhood with lots to do. We would love to stay again in the future!
The house was clean. It was comfortable for families. It was close to train station. We arrived to Trafalgar in 30 min.

Cara was an exceptional host and her place was perfect for a weekend stay. The view from the single bedroom over Canary Wharf and the cable cars added such a nice touch, and the place overall was clean and cosy. The location was also perfect: Less than 10 minutes walk from the O2 and North Greenwich Tube station.  I would definitely recommend for a short stay if you are looking for somewhere affordable with a view near Greenwich :)
Lovely and convenient place to stay. Loula was very communicative. Thank you. We would love to stay again
The house was beautiful and so interesting historically. We loved our stay here and Ben was great at communicating during our stay. We just wish we could live here!

We had an amazing weekend celebrating my friend’s hen do at Maylands. The house is beautiful and it was perfect for what we needed - big kitchen, lovely dining area with plenty of seats for us all to share meals together, enough beds for everyone and a gorgeous big garden with hot tub and bar. Jaqua was really friendly and the house was beautifully set up when we arrived which added to the special occasion. Great house for getting a big group together for a special occasion!

We enjoyed staying in Monica's lovely house!
Monica is very nice and always helpful.
We recommend staying here!
Thank you again for everything!

The location is perfect for exploring London! Taylan and Marina were very nice and they responded immediately to any questions we had!
All in all a great flat!

Very Nice overall, but the sewers smell coming from outside.
Supposed to be looked at

Jordan is a great host and his place looks extremely nice, I like how private, neat and new the listed apartment looked and you also have a private entrance..
If you're staying in London and need a private space, I highly recommend this.

What a find! The flat is just how Alexi describes it, and the photos show it! It is in such a peaceful location, and the views from the top bedroom are outstanding esp at night.
Alexi is an excellent airbnb host- thank you for letting us stay in your home.

Great stay - perfect for what we wanted as a family. Great three-bedroom house in a quiet neighbourhood 20 min walk from nearest tube. Away from the hustle and bustle. Clean throughout, great bathroom and shops nearby for essentials. Bedding very clean with comfy mattresses!
We loved our stay in this prime London location. Close to the common, restaurants and uunderground, it could not have suited us better!
A bit noisy during lunch/dinner time, but closing the windows cuts it down pretty much. Worth it for the location.

Matt’s flat was an excellent place to stay - with all the needed amenities. The apartment was spotless and is steps from the Bond Street tube stop making it the perfect jumping off point for seeing all of London.

Had a great time here at James’ place. He was very friendly and nice. He even printed out our train tickets which was very kind of him. It was easy to get from Heathrow airport by public transportation to his home as well. Definitely recommend staying here if you need a place to stay after flying into Heathrow.

Tina's apartment was clean and spacious. It is in a great location, close to everything, quiet and safe. Noise was not a big issue - during the day you could hear footsteps upstairs and the boiler in the room, but at night it was not a problem.

The space was great! We found it easily! The neighborhood is about a 40 min drive to all the famous London attractions. The neighborhood was just fine and we even found a cute local delicious coffee spot named coffee lovers. The place was great and very comfy and spacious. Would definitely stay here again.

Everything was as described! We enjoyed staying in the apartment. The bus stop was 5 minutes away with direct connection to the city center (Euston, Kongs Cross) and Camden market. We would recommend staying there. :)

This was a nice - very central - place to stay! We were there for an unusually hot week, so it was a bit tough without ac, but everything else about the apartment was so nice. Very clean. We had a great time!

I stayed for a couple of nights whilst down in London for work. The flat was in a great location - close to transport, shops, cafes etc but really peaceful at night. I slept really well. Flat is clean, spacious and well equipped. I’ve booked again already for next trip - so that should tell you I was happy with it!
This is a great spot near Kensington gardens, the balcony alone makes the flat worth it. Though small, the kitchen is well equipped. There is no washer in the unit but in the building.
In this shared house I felt such an immense level of privacy and comfort. Was able to come and go easily for my trip and was able to enjoy my plans without a second thought.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Rosemary’s home.  She is very communicative and was a great host. Kew is awesome and it’s not a bad tube ride into west/central London. Would absolutely recommend staying here.
Amazing place and loved the location. Highly recommended for anyone looking to stay in the heart of Lodon
The room is very clean and well located. Also Deb is super friendly and responsive! Really enjoyed staying here
A great location for us, loads to do around as well.  It is on a busy road so suggest if not used to noise you take earplugs.  Not enough furniture if there are more than 4 people in the lounge.

This is a great spot for a budget traveller in London. Bicycle ride using Lime to Tower Bridge area is safe and convenient. Weatherspoon's pub is inexpensive and handy. Tesco supermarket is close-by. Park is quaint and a nice place to chill. Travel from Heathrow is a breeze (Elizabeth line to White Chapel, then take Overland South to Surrey Quays).
Bedroom is comfortable, clean, and quiet. Kitchen is small but usable. I couldn't get TV to work. It can get very hot in the unit but a fan is provided (it was not setup). If you're coming from abroad, access check-in information via Google Docs before departing as it's very difficult to access if you don't have a hotspot in-country.

Richard is an excellent host and the house is a fun place to stay - great character and style, located in a lively neighborhood and a short walk to great restaurants, the Tube and many attractions. Looking forward to our next visit!

I highly recommend it, the communication with Zuzanna was wonderful, she was very helpful and replied quickly. The location of the apartment itself is perfect for everyone visiting London for the first time, but also for those who know the city. The location in the city center and the proximity of the metro are very helpful in getting around. The room was 100% consistent with the description, we had everything we needed and the option to leave our luggage made the organization very easy.

We absolutely loved our stay in Susana’s home! It’s located right off Portobello Road with plenty of shopping & restaurants within walking distance. Susana was responsive and so kind to assist us with our needs. The flat was perfect.
Ahmed is a great host. It was hot the week we stayed in the house and he brought us fans. The place is great for families and larger groups with a grocery store right around the corner

My friend and I stayed at Anne's apartment for several days, and I think I speak for both of us when I say that we felt very comfortable throughout our stay. The apartment was easy to find, and Anne welcomed us warmly upon our arrival. She always endeavored to offer us a pleasant stay and assisted us with all our questions about London and her apartment. Our room, as well as the rest of the apartment, was very clean and tidy, which we appreciated very much. We spent most of our time exploring the city, but in the end, we miss not only London but also Anne as a host. We are looking forward to our next visit.

We stayed for 20 days , the place was good the location even better, the host is very responsive
Some problems tho , you can’t close the stores in the living room, it starts to be so hot when its sunny and the sun light reflects on the Tv so you can’t see anything
A little bit noisy when someone get upstairs for the other condos you can hear it like its in your condo
Everything else was very good, very clean, everything is available in the kitchen, shower and living room , the beds are very comfortable
You can easily go anywhere in London in just 20-30 minutes

The room was clean and tidy.
I really liked the interior.
The host was caring and wonderful woman.
I really had fun staying at this place.
Thank you so much:)
We had a fantastic stay! Tod was very responsive and helpful, and the home was perfect for us.

Great location! In the heart of Covent Garden.  Easy to get to most places in London.  The Tube was easy to navigate from there as well.  The flat worked well for our family of four.  We had a little hiccup with the electricity for one day.  Also, wasn’t clear on the check out instructions.  But overall, a good experience and great trip to London!
Great place and perfect location, Micheal was very helpful and responsive from start to finish. Would happily stay again.
Andrea’s place felt right being at home! She has been extremely helpful and kind. I loved my stay at her place and look forward to visiting next time! 😄
Aleena's place was spacious, easy to find and her/Ejaz were super responsive. Comes exactly as advertised. She also provided some great recommendations within the immediate vicinity.

Isabelle is wonderful. She is an amazing hostess. Her charm and depth of local knowledge is invaluable. Our breakfast was delicious, nutritious, and matched our schedule. We enjoyed learning about local events as well as upcoming attractions to catch or ones to avoid. Her insights are very good.
The space includes a bedroom with comfortable queen bed, a sitting rooms with fireplace and bay window, private bathroom with hot shower and fluffy towels.
The house cat is a cheerful addition.

Thanks to Nash and his family for the warm welcome and much needed bottles of cold water when we 1st arrived and again when we returned from the concert, we had a brilliant time and were very grateful to be able to walk back from the Stadium and not queue for the station with the other thousands of people! 🤩 x

The location was ideal for us as we wanted to check out Camden Market and some bars around Kentish Town - it was a lovely and spacious flat with plenty of amenities, and a lovely view from the windows! Good communication/responsiveness from Valery, would definitely recommend and stay here again!

fantastic responsive host who helped us enter the main door when we couldn't push the door. user error rather than any mis-onformation from the host. would recommend for anyone looking for a short Central London stay over.

Branca's place was a great end to our trip. Since we got it last minute, there was a discount applied which was a plus. Space was ideally located, clean, and comfy. It was nicely decorated as well. Instructions were clear and it was easy to get in and out with a keypad lock.
Thank you!

Beautiful location, with an easy stroll to the river, pubs and restaurants - the area has a great vibe, especially on long summer days!  The home is decorated beautifully and the candles everywhere leant a nice touch. Tima was really responsive and sorted out any issues we had personally, which is so helpful when you're staying in someone's home.
Michael is friendly, accommodated our requests, replies promptly. He prepared his place for our stay. We enjoyed celebrating my son’s birthday in his place. Thank you Michael!

Amrita’s place was lovely and clean. Great location close to shops, bus stops and train stations. The flat has everything you need and the garden was a great place to relax especially with the sunny weather we had during our stay. Amrita is a great host, always helpful and responsive. We highly recommend. Thank you!

Joanna was the perfect host. She welcomed us personally and when the blow up mattress leaked, she quickly got us a replacement. The apartment was in a wonderful location - easy access to eateries and buses/ tube. The apartment was a good size and wonderfully furnished/ decorated. Would happily stay here again!

Highly recommend! The bus stop was a mere 50 yards away and underground was barely a 5mins walk away, and lots of good restaurants and cafes in between. In a predominantly family friendly neighborhood, the place itself felt very safe with code access required to get through the gate and the front door. The apartment was clean and the balcony was a wonderful extra space to hang out in, especially as we had fantastic weather through our entire stay. The apartment is ideal for 2 persons or less, not more.
Dan was responsive and accommodating as host, I will certainly book with him if the opportunity arises again.

Nicholas' flat is great-- spacious, tastefully decorated, comfortable and nicely kitted out with all the necessary amenities and more. The flat  is bright and has a nice feel to it. The neighborhood is great, at the heart of London excitement--fun to explore in any direction you head. And Nicholas is a superb host. He took the time to acquaint me with every detail of his flat so that I had no unpleasant surprises and knew to how to use all the equipment in the flat. He's an unusually generous host who makes sure that the place is equipped with everything you need. I don't think I've ever stayed at such a generously supplied accommodation. Nicholas  was also readily available to answer any question I had, responding to my texts seconds after I sent them. This is superior accommodation with a top notch host.

The Airbnb was fabulous, just like the photos. It was clean, comfortable and secure.
Throughout my stay, I contacted the hosts with a couple of requests and every time they responded very positively with an answer.
One great aspect of the Airbnb is it very close to Angel train station.
I can highly recommend this Airbnb.

This flat in Shoreditch was perfect for a girls trip to London. Slept five of us comfortably.
The flat was so cute and had everything we needed, loved the roof deck! The location was great, walkable to so many great attractions. Our host, Richard, was kind, communicative, and flexible. We ♥️ London

My family of 3 stayed in Matthew’s place for 2 weeks and everything was perfect. It is the best value considering the location you can find in London. From my point of view, if you choose this apartment you will stay in the best neighborhood with all attractions at a walking distance. Would definitely stay again and recomand to our friends
Kinga was very helpful and the location was perfect for using the the metro and getting around London!
Overall it was a 10/10  experience.  no hassle whatsoever. Nice location. would definitely highly recommend. even for Netflix on the TV
Paolo’s apartment was very easily accessible and in a perfect location- we were within walking distance to transport, many restaurants and cafes.

Our stay at Katherine's was perfect. Excellent location for our day at Wimbledon, a direct bus a short walk away and also a short walk to the underground that gets you into central London within 20 minutes. The flat is lovely, it's modern and decorated beautifully, and has one of the comfiest beds I've slept in. Katherine is a fantastic host, responsive, understanding and extremely helpful with local recommendations. Would absolutely stay here again.

Our family of 5 had a great stay at Chris' place. It was immaculate and a good space for us all. I highly recommend it for families. A convenient spot to take in the sights of London. Chris was very responsive and accommodating of an early check in too. An excellent place!

Great location, spotlessly clean, responsive host. Would happily stay again. Easy to find from Baker Street, there is a convenience store within 5 mins walk of the apartment. Safe neighborhood. We also really appreciated the welcome pack of snacks and water when we arrived.

Nice area next to some great restaurants and not far from Kings Cross. Attentive host and clear instructions. Clean, organised and perfect for people who just want to get out into the city without interruption.

Your place is such an incredible place to stay. I felt same as home. The most important thing is the place is very clean and nice to stay. It also very convenient to travel since it is nearby the station. Moreover, it is provided the instruction cover all the things you need. It is also full of equipments. Next time, if I come to Uk, 100% stay here again
it was easy to find and check in was easy. Ok for short stay. the bed and the room had unpleasant heavy smell.
Amrita’s place is lovely. It’s spacious, clean and bright! The decor and details are lovely. Amrita is very responsive and helpful! Will stay here again.

We were on a family (of 4)  visit to London at stayed at Rosie's place for a few days. the place was exactly as described - very clean, comfortable and quite close to transportation that can get you into the city within 20-25 mins. The back garden area was an added benefit in the evenings where we could chill with some snacks and wine. We really enjoyed the stay and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice cozy place to stay on their London visit.

Jadin is a friendly host and made sure all the logistics of the stay were seamless.
The room itself is a great base for which to explore London, particularly because of the flat’s proximity to public transport.
Everything was clean and tidy and Jadin also provided complementary bottled water, which was a nice touch.

We HIGHLY recommend Rosie's flat. We felt right at home the moment we crossed the threshold. It is in a beautiful part of the city, close to Kew Gardens, the National Archives, and the Thames River path. The flat is cozy and peaceful--the perfect retreat. And Rosie was a superb host, brimming with great suggestions for restaurants nearby and proactive in her communications with us. We hope to stay here again!

Stayed at Jamie’s to go to BST at Hyde Park. Perfect location as literally 5 minutes walk away.
The flat is spacious, clean and had everything we needed. Close to amenities and there is an amazing shop / deli next door with Lebanese cuisine and fresh produce. Try the deli food. Delicious!
Jamie was responsive and helpful the whole stay. Thank you!

Was the perfect spot to crash before a long travel day home. Felt relaxed and right at home after checking in and enjoyed the nearby “Parker House” cafe for breakfast the next day. I had one of the best pastries of my life there.

We stayed here in July. It’s like a home away from home,cosy& clean .It’s comfortable for 3 people  to stay. The Tesco  Sainsbury & Edgware road underground are all in the same lane. Walk straight to Hyde’s Park in 15min.A peaceful place bang on the main road. Equipped with a  working kitchenette, iron & dryer it’s a good place to stay. The only deterrent is the flight of stairs if you have huge suitcases. We had a tough time with those. I recommend the place &  I’m coming back  here whenever in London. Thank you Kaz.
A great deal for what it is. Location was convenient, if a little loud. Only complaint is the beds were quite hard. I feel like a mattress topper or something similar would be good for the future.
Ideal location for catching the bus into central London. Well equipped apartment with everything you could need! Very clean, spacious but also homely, we particularly enjoyed a visit from Mr Littles.

Orla was a very responsive, friendly, and accommodating host. She promptly and happily answered any questions we had, and her attitude helped us feel even more comfortable in her already lovely space. The townhome was clean and has great character, the kitchen and dining area are spacious, and is only a short walk away from the tube station. We were very pleased with our stay here!

The location was excellent close to many restaurants, a mall, the tube, and the Kings Pub next door was an amazing addition to our experience. The food and drinks top notch next door.
Plenty of space for all of us in the home. Very clean

As shown, everything was clean and tidy, and a short walk to Finsbury Park for gigs! The local restaurants were very friendly and had great food. Amos was very friendly and just a message away if we needed anything.

We went for a concert in Crystal Palace and stayed for one night at Urszula's place. We were very happy about our choice. It's easy to arrive from the train or from the park, and the distance did not bother us. Her home is pristine, everything looked spotless and the bed was very comfortable. 100% recommend.

My 12yo daughter and I had a great stay at Tom's flat.  It has a very convenient location, 1 long-ish block from the tube and a Sainsbury's grocery store, 2 blocks from the Portobello Road market (Fri-Sun).  The bed up the ladder was an adventure at first, but we got quickly used to it--and it felt very safe and cozy while sleeping.  The kitchen is small but functional.  Simple decor but with stylish touches throughout.  Overall, the flat felt like a garden sanctuary during an otherwise very busy trip to bustling London!  We felt like locals after only 3 days...

Geoff and Marcela are great hosts. Very prompt and friendly. I stayed at their place only for one night. But it was very comfortable and clean. Their home is very conveniently placed. All the tourist attractions are a few stops away from the bus.
Really enjoyed the stay, really convenient location for public transport. it can get a bit noisy but we were used to 'city noise'.

This is a clean, basic apartment, with plenty of space.  it's a bit inconvenient as far from tube stations.  We were familiar with the area so not a problem for us, but first time London visitors might find it difficult.
This was the scone time I have stayed at Inge’s AirBnB. A great location for a short stay

Great location near St Pancras and Kings Cross however if you have seniors you need to be aware it's on third floor with narrow stairs and no lift access, the other thing we noticed is we couldn't open windows because of the neighbourhood smell, toilet door was also broken. But to be honest location and price were really good. Beds and bed sheets were clean so I would rate it 6.5/10.
Great place to stay near the heart of Camden. Short walk to the underground and to the market. Lots to do in the area.
Beautiful apartment and perfectly situated to discover London! Jenny was a great hostess, super responsive and accommodating! We would love to come back!
What a beautiful comfortable and clean space. Great bedding and so many touches to make your stay five star. Would highly recommend. Clean and bright. The perfect place for our stay. Many thanks 😊

Extremely comfortable and cosy flat with wonderful conservatory looking onto a garden. Beautiful flowers and birds singing with your morning coffee – lovely! The flat is very clean, well-kept and fully equipped with everything needed in the kitchen, bathroom etc. The bed is very comfortable and I slept well. Monica is a great host, very accommodating, excellent communication and clear instructions for the self-entry to the flat.  The location is great,  just 5 mins walk to the Underground (Shepherds Bush) for easy access to London (on the Central line). Also easy access from Heathrow. I highly recommend Monica’s place and I hope I will be able to stay there again.

Tonia was an excellent host, the apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed. Only negative was that there was a very strong smell in the apartment block hallway from the neighbours cooking. However Tonia has done an amazing job to make sure that her apartment is smelling clean and fresh, not affected by the neighbours. Thanks for having us.
It was a newly made beautiful and clean apartment. You’ll find every little thing you need in there. The host is very cooperative and it’s close to a lot of good restaurants.

The studio was super clean, excellent location and felt quite quiet in the neighborhood despite that it was 3 min from the metro/subway..  the street was very quiet. The apartment is quite new especially the bathroom. Communication was prompt. I spent 3 nights and it was worth it. Thanks!

My dad and his friend thoroughly enjoyed their stay in Mick‘s space. Everything looks and feels brand new, it is very close to all the restaurants and pubs in Crouch End and easy to get into central London as well. Mick was great to communicate with as well, all around a great stay! Would 100% recommend.
We had a perfect stay at Tod’s place and would highly recommend! The apartment was clean, comfortable and matched the description. Lovely pubs/ food places around too. Would stay again, thank you!
Jacqueline was a fabulous host. She was always responsive even when we arrived very late at night. Her flat was a few minutes away from the public transit.
Very nice place, Tamara very helpful and very quick to respond if we reached out.  Nice neighborhood, place very clean and gute

We all really enjoyed our stay at Mal’s place. The location was great - train station just around the corner and good pubs and supermarkets within easy walking distance. The apartment had everything we needed and the outdoor area was a happy bonus.
We had a wonderful stay! Thank goodness for the elevator. The view on the 4th floor was a great way to wake up.
Good location to explore Wimbledon though the flat was noisier than we had expected due to ongoing building work in the building itself and surrounding area.
A fantastic find in central London - the flat was clean, well fitted out, easy to locate and a fabulous outdoor decking area to enjoy a morning coffee on!

We particularly enjoyed our stay with Alistair in London. The accommodation is tastefully decorated and functional.
Very well located in central London and close to public transport. The neighborhood is quiet and pleasant.
Alistair is a great host.
We highly recommend this charming space.

Andrea was really good with all questions i had, considering that this was my 1st time in London and using Airbnb. I had a small mishap due to being extremly under the weather, but she was reallu understanding and was helpul.
would reccomend this place for anyone
This was a highly enjoyable stay. The apartment provided a quiet a relaxing space for our adventures in the city. Tess was very responsive and there wasn’t any problem at all with anything.

Richard’s place was exactly as per the pictures and previous reviews are spot on. Richard was super welcoming, the place right in the middle of bustling Shoreditch and there was plenty of room for the 6 of us. If you’re looking to stay in Shoreditch this is where you want to be!
We had a lovely stay at Sancha’s place. It’s very quiet and near beautiful parks. Sancha is a great host and was very communicative and helpful even prior to our arrival. Highly recommend!

Wonderful location and short walk to Earls Court tube. Lots of great places to eat and a perfect location for touristing. If traveling from LHR, it’s a straight shot without transfers. Great place, awesome host, and would definitely stay here again in the future.

Damon was nothing less than a great host! He was very responsive and helpful throughout my entire stay, he gave a lot of recommendations as far as things to do and places to eat locally. He gave direct instructions regarding how to get to his home. I appreciate him for allowing me to stay in his home for Wireless Festival 2024. I would definitely stay again, I felt right at home. Would definitely recommend!

Stayed there with my parents and sister. The inside is so beautiful, spotless, the bathrooms are clean, watch TV, Netflix or YouTube if you want to.
The place is big too, Oh the kitchen, just wow. It’s 5*, there’s an AC, the cutlery too. My parents felt really comfy, it gives everything from family to friends or couples or just you alone. The host is really good, so responsive and friendly. She’s really responsive and there to help in any way possible.
You will feel at home, from the decor to the service itself. You will love it! 🥰
There is an additional damage waiver which we weren't aware about and the house maybe beneficial by providing a fan during the summer.

The amenities are very good in the property other than no TV. Great washing machine/dryer.
Very clean and a terrific host.
One of the best AirBnb Ive stayed at. It is very mordenised and makes you feel at home

Great Experience, highly recommended,
Great communication, spotless accommodation everything I could ask for just like a hotel but more private and better. 5⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fantastic location and good value for money. We had a great stay. Wonderful to have three bathrooms in central London when travelling with teenage boys 😊

We had a great stay at Matthew's apartment! At first, the place seems a bit far from the center given that it is located in Zone 3 but it is possible to get there quickly by train. The train station is within walking distance and there is a bus stop in front of the building. The apartment is great. Matthew is a delightful host and was very kind with our early check-in request.

Alexi's place was exactly as described and perfect for what my work colleague and I needed with two separate bedrooms/ toilet & shower. The beds were very comfortable and clean. The house is nicely decorated with plenty of charm and has everything we needed for being away from home.

What a lovely place to stay.  It was light and bright and extremely comfortable.  Kristie had gone to such an effort to make it welcoming and she went over and above with all her information on local amenities etc.  She could not have been more helpful.  The flat was actually pretty quiet considering it was in the middle of London.  It was extremely well located to get around. The incredible views were off the scale.  You could see for miles across London above the trees. It did not feel like you were in a city and yet everything was on our doorstep.  The underground and overground were easily walkable. It was great for our dog too as the communal garden was easily accessible.  All round  fantastic place to stay.  Highly recommend

Another comfortable stay at Bipin’s. Peaceful and relaxed and a very short walk to a train that takes you directly into central London. Bipin is a great host, very friendly, responsive and accommodating.

Great place - the pictures and the place matched as advertised.
Excellent location and great accommodation - we had everything we needed
Lindi was very easy to communicate with.  Everything was really clear.  Her place is in a great location.  Clean, Safe, Lively with lots of restaurants and close to the shopping areas.

This is a good place to stay. We stayed with our family of five and it worked well. It was pretty hot the days we stayed and there is no a/c (common in London) which made sleeping more difficult because we were hot. We requested fans from the host but she simply replied “they were not listed in the amenities so we could purchase our own.” It’s was a good stay for us but location and the fan issue made it good but not great.
This was my second time at Agnes' place, and it was just as perfect this time around! Everything was spotless and I slept like a dream. The extra touches were also so lovely. Thank you again!

Outside of the odd feeling of bushwacking to find the key the place was awesome! It is a full bed tho,  not a queen, but the place was cozy and peaceful. The adjacent park was perfect and Sophie’s rec of Bread by Bike was yum!!!

We had a lovely stay in Katalin's house.
We did worry about the cat being in and we felt she was a little overwhelmed with 6 of us being in her house.

A beautiful, well appointed home in an excellent location. Sitting in the garden on a Summer’s evening and wandering down to Barnes for a bite to eat was a real treat. James was great at covering all the bases. We loved staying there and would love to come back!

Located in Soho. It was the really great location traveling for short or a long period of time. Staff is very responsive and helpful with any problems that arose within my travels. Great value for the space.

Daniel was helpful and did his utmost to sort out any issues, though I would have hoped the tv and the light that had been removed from their fittings would have been sorted before our arrival. Nonetheless he quickly got someone out to sort this, was very apologetic and I liked the area.

We absolutely loved our stay at Sarah’s place. One of the most homely stays we have enjoyed, the house is well equipped, we especially loved the barbecue grill, coffee machine, bathrooms (shower pressure), pillows (and overall bed comfort) and the bright kitchen (which has a lot of natural light). Sarah was super communicative and went the extra mile for our infant and parking permit application. The location is also really nice. We would love to go back one day.
Jadin was very friendly and accomodating. The place was perfect for overnight stay if you’re going to O2 arena. Easy access to public transport.

I was very pleased with everything about this room. It is quite big for one person, there are two bathrooms avaliable for the guests (6 max.) and the kitchen is always tidy. I simply have nothing bad to say, would definitely stay over there again.

Carolyn is a very warm host, provided clear checking in instructions. The place accommodated 4 adults and 2 children comfortably. I would stay here again when I come back to East London. Accessible to train, buses, supermarket, and other shops plus restaurants.
Great value for money for the location. Studio was exactly as described and spotless. Communication with hosts was quick and check in was super smooth. Would stay again!
We really enjoyed our time at Susana’s apartment. She is a wonderful host and the location is perfect.

Shlome was a fantastic host; very accomodating and responsive to anything we needed. The place was nice and clean with a lovely living area and patio. If i were to ever be back in Islington I would surely be booking another stay with her.
The appartement was near a lot of restaurants and shops, and the bus stop and underground was close to the place. Lisa was helpful and answered my questions quickly.

We feel so lucky that this unit was available for our stay. Diana and her daughter met us at the unit (it’s always nice to meet the owner) and were so warm and welcoming. The unit is perfectly located, the space is bright and breezy, the wallpaper is so charming, everything is as pictured or better! And the welcome basket of food is such a great way to start your stay! If this unit is available during your desired time, book it! We hope to be back someday!
Great place, close to the stadium, tube and restaurants. Well equipped kitchen, great shower. Ayoub was very easy to reach and responsive.

Our stay at Sanchas was flawless.
Self-check in was super straight forward thanks to Sancha’s clear instructions and set up at the property.
After a long travel journey, we arrived to a well-aired spotless room that was very well-equipped. The bed was comfy with four pillows and a blanket that was light yet warm. It felt like a cosy hotel room!
The shared bathroom was also pristine, which is so appreciated when it comes to shared spaces (some are simply atrocious!).
You can tell that Sancha pays attention to the details and puts genuine care into preparing a warm and welcoming space for her guests. Sancha herself is lovely—we spoke with her briefly after returning from a day trip to Richmond Park (which is only a 10-15 minute walk from the accom!), and she was very friendly and easy to chat with.
Thanks Sancha for a fantastic stay.

Great place to stay! Close to everything you need and in the heart of London. Clean and very cute. Natalie thinks of all the little details which is lovely and was great work communication. Would definitely stay there again!

We spent a few days in this Airbnb whilst visiting London and had a lovely time. The Airbnb is very close to a tube station and so getting around London wasn't an issue. Would recommend to people looking to visit

Esteban’s place is the perfect London stay! I had a long stay and it truly felt like a home away from home. The neighborhood is great with plenty of pubs and places to eat nearby. It’s a quick 10 min walk to the underground and other transportation. The space was exactly as described and very clean. The kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to cook and the bed is very comfy. Esteban responded quickly to any questions or inquiries I had and was lovely. I’m definitely looking forward to staying here again next time I’m in London, I highly recommend.
A very good location with extremely convenient transportation. An apartment with three bathrooms is a luxury experience for London!

There were multiple issues faced during our stay, most of which the host did fix, but was slow to respond to us (it was 14 hours from sending our first message, shortly after arrival, to receiving a reply the next day).
We did receive some compensation from host and airbnb as a result of our issues.
I wouldn’t say it is very child friendly - it is up 4 flights of stairs, and once inside the bedrooms are split over 2 floors. This wasn’t in the description and none of our 3 young children wanted to sleep on separate floors to us.
It is a good flat for older children / adults. It’s large and has a good central location.

Had a lovely stay at Gareth’s. The apartment and the location of it was great. The check in and check out process was easy thanks to great instructions. The kitchen was nice and had all the utensils you need. If you’re looking for an apartment fairly central with great access to public transport I recommend renting through gareth!

What a wonderful way to experience London! This isn’t your cookie cutter Airbnb but something far more interesting! From the moment we entered Ben’s home we felt as if we were walking into a timeline of London’s history! We cherished every moment of our time here because each room has its own charm and story as the actual house was developed over several hundred years. Ben and David have done an excellent job making it an enjoyable and comfortable living experience while retaining the original charm of the structure. Thank you both for sharing your beautiful home with our family. We truly loved it!

Ayub was responsive prior to and during our visit. The apartment is extremely handy for Wembley stadium, spotlessly clean and comfortable for the 3 of us. Would recommend for anybody going to an event at Wembley.

Isabelle and her super charming flat were the perfect spot for me to stay in London. Her flat feels so much like a real home, breakfast was amazing and her cat is the cutest. Also, everything is super clean and the bed is so so comfy. I really enjoyed talking to Isabelle about the city and so much more :) Thank you!

Booked based on the reviews online and I am happy I did. When I got the details didn’t expect it to be a space at the back of the garden but did that stop us from enjoying the space ...NO. In actual fact it felt really peaceful and private.
The property is very comfortable with good quality goods. Justyna actually took the time to decorate the space. Feels homely the moment you walk in. A home away from home it was indeed.
We will definitely stay here again.

Gio our host was extremely responsive and helpful and the apartment itself was lovely and in pristine condition and in a fantastic location in the west ended near all of London great shopping streets.  Would absolutely stay here again.

This was a fantastic place to stay. Located in the heart of London, it offers convenient transportation to every attraction. There are also plenty of great restaurants nearby. The living space is spacious, with clean bathrooms and comfortable beds, making our week in London wonderful!
Great location and flexible service :) Actually the place was nicer than the pics on Airbnb. Highly recommended!
We really enjoyed our stay here. Easy walk to the tube, restaurants, and lots more. Its in a perfect part of London and Victoria was an excellent host!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!  The place was immaculate and comfortable - kids loved having their own rooms!  Transportation to/from central London was easy, and we enjoyed the Eagle pub and Portobello Road, both walking distance from the flat.

Earlier check in as expected,, a plus. everything as advertised, without a noisy bip of the washing machine it would have been 4,5 stars.
a nice touch to the super kitchen that we did not use to cook would be a microwave.
all in all a pleasant stay
Excellent Stay. Less than 2 min's walk to the metro. Close to all restaurants and supermarkets. The apartment is large and comfortable and had everything necessary for life.
Great place. Clean and a nice neighborhood. I would stay again. Just wish the mattress was a little better. If he bought a £100 mattress topper it would make all the difference.

A wonderful place to stay - Nikki and Stew were friendly, easy to communicate with hosts and their space was clean, comfy and had everything we needed to feel at home. Would highly recommend, and will definitely stay again.

Very nice airbnb feeting perfectly for us 2 with our 2 children. Place is located near the theater and nights activity so it can be noisy but Natalia offers ear plugs to counter that. The flat is nice and spacy and well furnished.

Fazile communicated in a friendly manner and always responded very quickly to any questions or queries we had.
Her home was lovely, in a great location and offered everything we could need for a weekend away.
We all slept brilliantly on comfy, big beds with soft, clean linens.
Couldn't recommend Fazile more!

Mael was an excellent host and very graciously accommodated us with some specific needs we had during our stay, including an earlier check in and helping us store our luggage after checking out.  The loft was perfectly comfortable for our family of three and the location was very central.  Highly recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Lynn's Airbnb in London! Lynn was a fantastic host - very responsive and proactive, making sure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable. The location couldn't have been better - right in the middle of the city, it was almost perfect for exploring all that London has to offer. I highly recommend staying here for a great experience in the heart of London!

Tess was very communicative and friendly and the flat was sparkling clean and very bright.  The beds were very comfortable and the neighborhood was fun and lively.  There were restaurants and other amenities near by and the flat is five minute walk from the train station.  It must be noted that a train runs directly behind the apartment every few minutes  (it emerges from underground and is above ground as it goes by).  The train runs less frequently through the night and the noise was not as distracting in the bedrooms which were toward the front of the apartment.  Otherwise, it was a very nice place to stay.

Thank you Samir.
I recommend staying with him. It is a quiet and beautiful place, in addition to a very clean and cooperative house

Flat was very conveniently located near the Romford station, within a couple minutes walk. Easy access to downtown London. It was also close to grocery stores and restaurants. The place was very clean and easily accommodated our family of 5. Wei met us at the flat to help us in and was a very responsive host.
Thank you for a nice stay!
Shola is a great host and id defenitely reccommend to stay here cus of the peaceful locality and also the access to all kinds of transport

Peter is a lovely, responsive host, who offered excellent recommendations on where to eat and services around the area. The bathroom includes a gorgeous, huge tub. Be advised, the tub, while luxurious, can be slippery. You also have to step up into it, which can be a challenge for shorter and older folks. All in all, though, would stay again!
Great location, great area to be in if you’re planning to walk places. Very easy to get groceries and food. We enjoyed our stay a lot.

Cute place in a great location. Emily was very responsive to the questions we had and getting some fans delivered. Leave it to use to be in London on the sunniest and warmest days!  We walked all over and it was super easy to get to Hyde park on foot and pretty much everywhere in the city via the public transportation.

Slobodan's apartment was great for our family during our stay in London. It was a bit warm but the fans provided were great at keeping us cool in the evening. The Maida Vale tube stop is close by and the Paddington Rec area has an awesome playground. Lots of restaurants and amenities within walking distance.

Excellent flat, great location and well appointed. Please be aware that there is a high cleaning charge per person which makes the accomodation less value for money than first appears by the listed price.

Huge thank you to Diana for being extremely welcoming and accommodating to us during our holiday to London. The flat is in a great location and around the corner from a phenomenal park. Diana, you helped make our stay fabulous. Thank you!

Great experience.
Like be back again.
Will meet soon.
Thanks

Paolo's place was absolutely perfect for our long weekend in London. The location couldn't have been better. We did every "touristy" thing by foot as the location was very walkable. The host was responsive and his on site caretaker, George, was very friendly and helpful. We were given the option to leave our bags before check in and after check out for the day. Their description of size of the apartment is very accurate, it is small, so pay attention to their accurate description, but the space was very functional with lots of hooks and shelves. kitchen looked brand new. (Face/bathroom) Washclothes weren't provided, so bring those if important to you. The apartment was very private, only thing that could have been added was a curtain over kitchen window. We would absolutely stay here again. Thank you Paolo and George!
Great location, friendly staff, loud music next door at 4.30 am which was annoying for a holiday though
Stella was very kind and helpful. She really loves children and we were able to unwind in her nice living room. Our room was clean and light too. Thank You.

Amazing place and amazing host! This place has a wonderful and relaxing view … Cara helped me with all my questions and was always answering immediately.
Very safety place. Close to the train station and uber boat . I recommend this to everyone 😊

Oh Zuzana’s place is just lovely! I’m a host myself and I was quite charmed by the interior design as was my daughter. Very zen, calming. Also centrally located near the metro & many historic sites. Plenty of options for restaurants & stores nearby just within minutes walking distance. Absolutely worth the price. She probably should charge a little more lol.

James was a great host and gave very clear instructions for getting inside! It was a great place to stay in between travels and conveniently located when coming from Heathrow. It had everything we needed for our short stay!

I had a lovely stay at Anne's and wish it could have been longer to explore the area. I stayed for one night. I stayed in the twin room which was light and airy with a comfortable bed. Shared bathroom was clean and fresh. Would definitely stay again. Thank you Anne!

A cosy 2-story flat in a unique house near the city centre and close to Central line. We enjoyed our stay there, we had everything we needed, comfortable beds and a lot of items and books to look at. Thanks Tracy!
Majority is good, however, the property is close to main street and a bit noisy at night.
Had a great stay near St. Paul's cathedral in London. Great top story apartment with nice skyline views and very comfortable. Great neighborhood.

Very nice flat, quite small - but furnished with style. Super comfortable bed and good strong shower. Peaceful and yet central, would recommend this flat and would definitely come back. Liked the coffee machine and that tea and coffee was available in the flat.

We absolutely loved our time at this beautiful home! It's just steps away from Hyde Park, two tube stations and so many restaurants! We stayed as a family of 7 and had more than enough space. My in-laws traveled with us and have minor mobility issues and this house was not an issue for them at all. They only had a few steps to go up or down for their bedroom on the first floor. We loved the proximity of this house to everything and on top of that Richard was a fantastic and responsive host. Would definitely stay here again while in London!
Great stay, would definitely recommend if you want something affordable near canary wharf, thanks Herman!

We enjoyed our stay. This apartment is walking distance to Canary Wharf and it is a beautiful walk along the river. The DLR is right next to the apartment. We had to leave the windows open because it was so hot, that the noise from the train was loud. It was tolerable for us. Kinga was very responsive when I reached out to him. Wish the apartment had some fans to cool it down and more pillows. But overall it was open and nice and we would stay again!

We absolutely loved Wlad’s place!
The design and aesthetic of the place is beautiful! It was very clean and really spacious. Perfect for a group or family.
The location of the place was great, close to broadway market and the flower market. It is walking distance from Shoreditch high street which has great shopping options as well as restaurants.
Wlad was very responsive and super helpful throughout our stay. We will definitely be back!

There was a great little patio out front- Kitchen easy to use- Metro station 100 yards away- Two supermarkets within walking distance- I accidentally locked myself out, he came running- everything was perfect- my third time in London, best Air BnB I have booked into so far. - And now there is patio furniture out front too. Really wonderful experience this year, even with my broken foot and hobbling around London

The space was perfect for our stay! The bed was very comfortable and everything was clean. This was perfect for us as two college students on a budget. It does take about an hour via public transportation to get to the city center but it was easy to use since there’s a bus stop 3 minutes walking. Sancha also communicated well and made check in easy. Definitely recommend!

The location of this Airbnb is excellent, with easy access to the Victoria Line and just steps away from Vauxhall Pier. However, the stay had some drawbacks. The listing mentioned king beds in both rooms, but we only got queen beds, and the mattresses were very firm, making it hard to get a good night’s sleep after long days of exploring. Finding the lockbox was a maze, especially for someone new to the city. The instructions provided were not the best, and it took us a significant amount of time to locate it, which was challenging with all our luggage in a complex with so many apartments. Additionally, communication with the host was a bit misleading; we were told there were no pots and pans in the kitchen, so we carried our own, only to find the kitchen was well-equipped. Despite these issues, the place was decently clean, and we did enjoy our stay overall.

Superb location and fantastic stay. Communication with Matthew was always quick and accurate, the apartment was modern and clean and the location was brilliant.
Ideal place for a long weekend of discovering London.

The apartment is super clean and modern, located on a safe residential street with plenty of shops and amenities. I especially loved the kitchen and bathroom. The best part of the experience was the host, who was very understanding and helpful. I will definitely come back when I need to visit central London. Thank you!😊
I really enjoyed my stay here as it’s super neat, just as displayed and felt just like home. Great Host; she’s thoughtful to have provided guests with useful amenities.

We’ve been here for 3 nights. We had wonderful time, the place was next to the stadium and so close to the underground station close to the center of London. The house was tidy and peaceful, with everything we needed for this journey. The host was so friendly, and always replied to help us. I highly recommend them if you go to visit London and want a place next to the center

I’ll definitely stay again in Ipek’a place if I go back to London, her place exactly the same as in photos, the location is quiet and 25min from center and her as host was amazing, super understandable and nice.
A group of friends and I stayed here for an event we were attending locally in the area. The house was easy to access and exactly as it was in the pictures! We would stay here again.

Loved the location of the Airbnb! Safe, easy to get around and located near plenty of eateries and cafes.
Tina is gorgeous, friendly and respectful. The only downside may be the sounds from the upper floor but she did warn me on the first day. Overall, the place is worth the money and looks better than the pictures.

We had a great stay at Janice’s apartment. Exactly what we needed after attending an event at Wembley. Great location for Wembley, a ten minute walk to Wembley way. Big Asda round the corner which is handy. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay again if we needed accommodation in the area. Thank you!

Great apartment, super central, very clean and safe. The bed is very comfortable and the kitchen well equipped.
Natalia is super responsive and helpful.
I would stay there again and recommend it!

House beautiful, surroundings peaceful and enchanting.  Lots of room.  Ben was always responsive and helpful. Loved the ability to walk to quaint town and get anything we needed.  Loved the canal and birds.

Awesome place on an amazing street in Notting Hill.  Great shops and restaurants steps away.  Communication with Matt was easy, place was nicely redone.  We would definitely stay there again.  Great experience all around.

Our stay at Paolo’s accommodation was wonderful!!
The location is 8 minutes on foot from the Oxford Circus station.
The place was clean and beautiful.
I recommend it for anyone who wants to spend beautiful moments in the center of London.

Geoff and Marcela were patient with my questions and very helpful.
