good area, cute space, although i will note the wifi connection is terrible and service isn't amazing either but it's not that big of a deal to me

Stayed here for a week whilst working in London. Lovely and super private place in London which for me has been really hard to find over the years
The apartment was super clean on arrival. Ana was a super host with clear instructions on how to get in.The private and secure parking was a super plus for me with my work van and staying London!! The apartment has everything you need and more for cooking and has your everyday needs covered!!
Tube was a 15 min walk away same as the gym with loads of pubs and restaurants 5 mins walk away!!
Ana is a 5 star host don’t pass up on staying here if you working or just visiting London
Will be booking again if I’m working in London

We had a fabulous stay here! It's a lovely apartment and feels very homely and cosy. The beds are comfy and the kitchen had everything we needed. Martina was really helpful and responsive. The batteries in the TV remote control ran out on the first night and Martina had some delivered the next morning so that it wouldn’t impact our stay. The TV in the bedroom isn’t a smart TV so needs something plugged into it but this wasn't an issue for us. Only a 15 minute walk to the tube station with shops close by/along the way. We would definitely stay here again!
Sam & Nidhi were great hosts. They were always very responsive and friendly. The location is excellent.
Great spot right near everything worth seeing. Easy to find and quick walk to all parts shoreditch + overground

Great location near good restaurants and shops.
The number 360 bus was opposite and frequent.

Had an amazing weekend here, so convenient as the DLR was just outside as well as shops and place to eat. Very clean, had all the amenities listed, the host was always responsive, check in and out process was simple; we didn’t have any issues. We would love to stay here again!!
Thank you, our stay went very well. The place is spacieux and the room are nice
Great apartment for staying with friends, comfy beds and good sitting room area. nearby Old Street so handy for anyone staying east!

Daniela was a kind, very responsive and flexible host . We appreciated being able to leave a little later on Sunday morning.
The bedrooms and bathrooms were immaculate however the kitchen and dining area which was cluttered and tired-looking.
It was also a shame that we couldn’t get the hot water system to work so that we all have a hot shower in the morning.

A great place to stay. Excellent area with restaurants and cafes very nearby. 10 min walk to the Underground station and just a few stops needed to get to most places you want to visit
Will hopefully stay again in the future.

Paolo was a perfect host. We received a very friendly welcome and were allowed to leave our luggage before check-in. Paolo was also extremely flexible when we checked out, thank you very much!
The apartment is perfect, equipped with everything you need. Oxford Street and many central points are within walking distance, as well as a supermarket and many cafes and restaurants. We would happily stay with Paolo again anytime.
Jason’s place was very convenient - located close to Excel center and was very spacious.  Multiple bedrooms with more than 1 bed.  He was very flexible and always responsive as a host.  A+

Usman was a super host. he went above and beyond to accommodate us. Parking was easy, and the building was easy to get into. the location was perfect, a stone throw away from the station and portobello market.
The flat was very clean and with everything you need and more, full of character and stunning high ceilings, very cleverly designed. Definitely will be staying here again. It felt like home!

The perfect location for attending an event at the O2, just a couple of minutes walk to the cable car & less than 15mins walk from Canning & Custom House train stations. The apartment is a great space, spotlessly clean & with views of the O2 from the balcony.
We don’t know the area but found more than anticipated, with the Excel Centre at the end of the road, a Tesco Express a short distance away, along with restaurants and a lovely semi permanent pop up street food market.

A stunning apartment in such a great location. Perfect base for public transport nearby - plenty of bus and tube options.
Very comfortable beds and hot showers too. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby - good for groceries. Recommend the deli across the roundabout for yummy pastries and fruits for breakfast. Matthew was a responsive and friendly host. Communication great too. Would definitely use Matthew’s place for future visits!
He is a great host and the place is nice! Recommend to stay when u visit London. London street and selfridges just 10-15 mins walk from the house.

The room was nice along with the rest of the apartment. The lockbox would not open when checking in with no communication from host, only the cleaner. This unfortunatly delayed my plans for the evening, but despite that I was appreciative for the cleaners communication and was able to come to the apartment relatively quick. The location is great public transport wise, tubes and busses are 8 minute walk away max, although at night it can get quite loud from outside.

The place was great. Would definitely go back if I needed to be in the area, felt more like a hotel with all the amenities. Really enjoyed my stay.
But full transparency because I think it’s important to know: My information got stolen & I had a woman texting me claiming to be from the company & saying I needed to re-confirm my bank details or my booking will be cancelled. She had all my personal details to confirm she knew the booking. But because Airbnb says to only communicate through the app, I never gave any info so I’m safe. But this was very scary. The company of this listing did email to apologise about the situation. Just thanking God I wasn’t dumb.

Pictures are a little outdated and the apartment can use a bit of love
The apartment is spacious enough for a solo traveller, and location is pretty good for access to public transport
The service is wonderful. Kerisha has done a good job. I am looking forward to come back soon
stayed here with my son for a trip away to London. the flat had everything we needed for our trip and was close to the tube. would look to stay again if we're down again.

Excellent place!
We were warmly welcomed by George, who kindly explained the basics and gave us great recommendations for our stay in London.
The apartment is small but charming, with everything you need for a stay in this wonderful city. It’s located in a great area with the Underground nearby. Nice neighborhood, good shops, and excellent hospitality.
We highly recommend it to everyone and would definitely come back!

I stayed here not long ago and had a last minute trip come up and was able to stay again and had another great stay. I think this will be my go to place to stay when I’m down for work if it’s available. Spacious , homely and comfortable . The little details like secondary glazing show the thought that’s gone into making this a relaxing place to stay. I was surprised how quiet it was in such a central location . Look forward to visiting again !

Overall the apartment was great.
The only downside was the shower. The temperature dial did not work and it was really hot + the shower door is missing which makes the entire bathroom extremely wet which lead to mold on the ceiling
Great location but flat could use some repairs (lights in main room flickered, shades on windows were broken, etc)
Great location, Ellie was very good at replying at any time, answering questions swiftly and helpfully. Would stay again.
Brilliant location a stone’s throw from London Bridge and Borough Market. Flat was comfortable and ideal for what we wanted. Thank you!

This Airbnb exceeded my expectations. The cleanliness was top-notch, the bedroom was generously sized, and the bathroom & kitchen’s cleanliness was a highlight. But what truly made the stay special was the amazing host, who went above and beyond to ensure I had a comfortable and pleasant visit.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly accommodating, friendly, and quick to respond to any questions, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. The apartment itself was spotless, just as described in the listing, and located in a great area. A special touch was the complimentary snack basket, which was such a thoughtful and appreciated gesture. Overall, a fantastic stay—I would definitely book again!

Really cute place!
We had a really nice stay. The flat is super clean and cosy, and in a beautiful area too.
Well connected with the tube at 2 minutes and buses to Notting Hill.
The only thing were the other guests, a little too noisy during quiet hours.

Great place to stay,the house was clean and you gonna find everything what you need,Close to shops, bus stop and DLR station.
The host was very responsive.Definitely recommend.
The Airbnb is located in the heart of all the action. It’s above a pub, The noise at night made it very hard to sleep.  This when on to about 2:00 to 3:00 in the morning.

I booked this apartment for my parents and they absolutely loved it. James and his team were very communicative which I appreciate, all intrusions were very clear. The apartment was spacious, clean and they had everything they needed. Will book again in future. Thank you.
Very good location and clean house!  Host very responsive. All we need was there. Only issue was heating, that could be a bit better.

The stay at Mo‘s place was wonderful. Alessa answered any questions quickly and both her and Mo were very lovely in person. Due to the flexibility on the day I could even leave my luggage a bit longer in the room before leaving. Thank you so much for the pleasant stay - total recommendation!
Matthew's place was modern, spotless, comfortable, and in a great location. He was one of the most responsive and caring hosts I've had. I highly recommend.

it was a great spot, very clean and organized, the shower was hot. Artur answered always very quickly any question.
The localization is very good, at Zone 2, less than 10' by foot from Bricklane and Shoredish, the coolest places at London. The tube was 10' away, 3 diferents lines, including Elisabeth Line, straigh foward from Heathrow.
I recomend 100%.

We loved Anthony’s apartment. It is well located, and a great space with everything that one could need. In addition he is a very friendly and responsive host. As is evident from all of the reviews, his apartment is ideal for all those wishing to be in central London and particularly those seeking a long-term stay.
The flat is in a tower block of council housing in a large social housing area that is not safe to walk around alone at night. The inside of the flat was as described and very comfortable.
Great apartment in a quieter part of London, super easy to get around the city. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Excellent location. A bit noisy in the morning (construction or similar) but nothing out of the ordinary. Apartment is beautiful and matches the description very well. Very comfortable beds. Sofa i bit stiff but that's snormal.
Quiet in the evenings.
Missed coat hangers. I think we spotted one in the whole apartment. 5 people (3 teenagers) so we missed a 2nd bathroom but that's on us. Feels recently renovated, and it is very nice, but perhaps not top notch in all details. Cleaning was ok, some of the kitchenware should have gone another round in the dishwasher.
But overall, a really nice place to stay for a few days.

I had a great stay.The flat was beautiful and very clean. It had all the amenities you would want.
I loved the full bath and big TV. Shaileen was always helpful and responsive to any questions I had which was great. I really liked the flat because it was so safe and secure. I would definitely go back to stay again.

I had a great stay at Anne's place! Location is well connected by buses which bring you to the main metro stations. The neighbourhood is lovely and felt very secured. The bed was comfy and very clean, so I slept like a baby.
Overall, Anne is a great host who made sure I have everything I need to have a pleasant stay!

This was possibly the best Airbnb we have stayed in! If you want luxury of a hotel but the comfort of home, this is it.
The space is incredible with a full kitchen, shower, washing machine and more. The addition of a smart TV and fast internet meant we could work from home when needed and we had entertainment for the nights we weren’t out.
I honestly couldn’t have picked a better place to stay and Michael and Kelli were great hosts.
Thanks again!
Great, quiet location and a clean space. Perfect for a couple or solo traveler. Walkable to really good restaurants and the British museum. Would definitely recommend!
The flat was great and Olushola was a really good host! I'm glad that the flat was in a lovely and safe area and would happily stay again! :)
Everything was perfect and perfectly explained. Marijana was super reactive for any question or doubt. Thank you so much!

Staying at Alexey's place was a delight. We were there almost two weeks to go to theater, music performances, and museums. Often the theater was only a 5 minute walk away and restaurants were everywhere as well as good grocery stores for supplies to eat at home. This was our best stay in London and I know that was due to the location! It was also very quiet once we were inside and the bed and sofa were comfortable. Thank you, Alexey!  I would highly recommend to anyone who wants to actively experience all that London has to offer.

Ana was super friendly throughout, went out of her way to help us with the best route to take with multiple options for transport throughout our stay.
Inside was beautiful with a fabulous of outside space!
Had everything we needed for our stay to be comfortable: would absolutely stay again;
Thank you so much Ana it’s was a pleasure.
Everything was fine. Nice and quiet place, close to the centre of Twickenham and to the stadium (15 minutes walk).
This is a small but nice, clean and well located place to stay in. The host is very nice and replies quickly.

Jadin is a friendly host who received us very well and made us feel welcome at his stay. He insisted we feel the place to be like our home. The place has all the listed amenities, we cooked multiple times and ate our Indian food which we so dearly missed. The place is literally next to Langdon park DLR station and we have a bus stop right opposite to the stay. Good frequency of buses and trains to Central London.

I had a really nice stay in this apartment. Parveen and Shoban were reactive and flexible, despite my late arrival. The apartment was clean and well-furnished. It was very close to Horseroad Station (Victoria Line), which made the access to the city center easy and convenient. There was also a supermarket and a few shops nearby. This apartment was ideal for my trip, with a great quality/price ratio.

Exceptional apartment close to the city. Walking distance to Clapham Junction.  Maria was extremely helpful and went out of her way to accommodate us. The apartment is  very well set up for toddlers. Our boy was right at home.
Affordable, Convenient, Clean. Everything was perfect. I would like to come back again. Thank you very much !

Excellent appartment located in the heart of Shoreditch.
During my stay there was construction noise in the building. Otherwise I would have given 5 Stars. Branca was responsive and offered a solution.

Monica was a wonderful host--friendly and very quick to respond to any questions. Her flat is lovely, and had all the amenities you'd need. I was there for a convention at London Olympia, and her flat was a pleasant 10 minute walk--so the location couldn't have been better. It's also close to the underground and overground trains. Sadly, I didn't get to spend time in her garden or very cute conservatory/dining room. The bed was incredibly comfortable--which is important when one is on a business trip! I would stay at Monica's lovely home again.
Fantastic location by Hyde park with access to multiple bus/subway accesses nearby and very spacious. We had a good stay with 7 of us comfortably.

This was my third stay at her house. Everything was perfect as before. The room and its bathroom were clean and tidy. As I mentioned in my previous review, it's only 5 minutes from Wood Street Station. Thank you, Evelyn 🙏🏽
Perfect location for us. Very well appointed house, kitchen in particular. We had a really good stay and would recommend

Right from the first phone call to Harv i knew how good this property was going to be and how responsive he was going to be. This property is to a very high standard and is most definetly  home to home. Spotlessly clean and well stocked with all you need. Highly recommend this house and will definetley return.

As neat of a spot as it gets. The flat is a vibe, and so is the area. Go check it out!
Spacious, light, right next to the canal.

The place was perfect for what we required, the only trouble was the Phone key to get in , which was my own fault as I missed the email.
They was quick in replying and helping out when required!
Fully recommended!
Carolyn was such a lovely host, always quick to respond to questions and had such a lovely flat. Would definitely recommend to any who is visiting London as the location is fab as well.

She is an amazing host . She’s very responsive and very kind and helpful . Helped me to get their gave directions. Also cooked a really yummy meal for me. The room was very nice and clean and very spacious. The bathroom was very clean. Best price for the value for someone Iike me who travelled to London on a budget
we loved the whole of the stay! beautiful home in a great location. Victoria was very responsive and gave good instructions of how to get there and access. very flexible with check in and out too!

Amazing place - great central
Area close to public transportation , plenty of cute places to eat and walk around . The place had 5 bedrooms , each with their own bathroom which was super impressive and convenient since we were a large group . Would definitely stay here again !

We had a very pleasant stay in Raphael’s place. It’s located in a beautiful and peaceful neighborhood, short walking distance (6-12 minutes) to restaurants, grocery stores and public transportations (Paddington station, bus 94 and 205, two metro stations etc.).  Convenient self checkin and checkout, and we were able to get an early check in too, very flexible and friendly host!

Our stay at Shlome’s place was great. Shlome was a great host who regularly enquired if we were doing ok and needed anything. Shlome also let us checked out a bit later on our departure day without additional cost. Communication was great and easy. Shlome’s place was very comfy, clean and spacious!
Highly recommend !
Great location, perfect for Wembley events, clean, good facilities and excellent communication from host.

I had an amazing stay at Pawel’s place.
From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The home was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The bed was incredibly cozy, and the space was thoughtfully stocked with little extras like coffee, toiletries, and local recommendations.
The location was perfect, close to my workplace yet quiet and peaceful for a good night’s rest. Communication with Pawel was seamless; he was responsive, friendly, and truly went above and beyond to ensure I had a great experience.
Looking forward to staying here again in the future.

I very much enjoyed my time here! It is a perfect
part of england so that everything was in walking distance!
It was my third time at Paolo’s brilliant flat, and once again couldn’t fault it. Looking forward for the next time!

I had such a lovely stay at Adam's place. It was the perfect respite I needed after traveling for more than a month before heading back home to the states. Great location with tons of places to shop, eat, and hang out. Adam was extremely communicative and expertly helped me navigate how to enter the apartment when I arrived. Thanks so much!

The location is perfect if you want to be in the premier shopping district of London. Everything is easy to get to. The place is surprisingly quiet for being right on Oxford Street. We very much enjoyed the location.
I was very happy to enjoy a few nights. It's a  great location , easy to every where.
The host was super friendly and made check-in really easy. The flat was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. Would definitely recommend!
Huge room with plenty of space in a great location for Canary Wharf, O2 and the city.
I had a great stay at Sandra's place.  Very spacious double room, everything was clean and tidy. The area is very quiet and close to public transport. Would definitely recommend.

We picked this spot as our last night of stay before ending the trip. The flat is located about 20 walk from Kingcross, accessible by foot, bus or metro, very convenient. For those with large/heavy luggages, this flat is on the 2nd floor with stair, we booked knowing this info so it wasn’t a problem for us. The flat is equipped with everything Travellers would need, highly recommended.
Was a very nice view from the apartment at night times, decent gym to use as well, all round good place

This was perfect for my needs when visiting a friend. A comfortable, private and well presented room in a nice quiet residential street, a stone’s throw from the bustle and vibrancy of Harringay’s Green Lanes. Unal’s communication was proactive and the check in instructions super helpful and clear. It was also very good value for money. Highly recommend.
A great stay! The host was super friendly and commutation was amazing! Would defiantly stay again! Thanks so much.
One of the best Airbnb places where I've stayed! The flat was lovely, very clean, easy to get to. I'd gladly stay there again.

Cool apartment overlooking Croydon and right by Boxpark, east Croydon station, Sainsbury’s nearby etc. Very spacious and clean. Probably lacks a little character / amenities but overall it was a great place to stay.

Another great stay! This was my second time staying here, and it was just as comfortable and welcoming as the first. The host is consistently responsive while considering my urgency situation of flight cancellation and thoughtful with all possible help and support , and the space is clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. It really feels like a home away from home. Looking forward to coming back again!

As a family of 5 girls we had a great stay.  about £25 in an Uber to ABBA Voyage and a great place to lay our head for the night too.  Olivia was very responsive through messages too. I would stay again.

We had a great 2 night stay at Elsa's place. It's very comfortable for 4 people, very clean, well equipped with everything you  need for a short stay. The apartment was warm and both beds very comfortable. We were specifically looking for an apartment close to Ealing Broadway and this was perfect. We'd have no hesitation in recommending it to others. Couldn't fault anything.
Already our second stay, the apartment is lovely! Perfect neighborhood, with nice cafes, pubs  and restaurants. The bus just across the street brings you directly to the zoo :)
We had a great time staying at Natalia's. The location was excellent, and made it very easy to get around London!

Great value for money!
Host communicated well throughout the stay and check in instructions were clear.

Shlome was very kind and responsive to help accommodate our early check in! The location is absolutely perfect to explore central London with the tube and busses just a short walk away! Spacious and tastefully decorated!

This flat is in an excellent location. Short distance to the Norther tube line, many coffee shops and restaurants along the street, large Marks and Spencer within walking distace for groceries. Although the flat is on a high street, it was very quiet at night. We highly recommend this unit would easily return.  Adam was super easy to work with and responded to our questions right away.

It’s a very nice building and a very nice location. Management communicated with us consistently. We had a problem with one of the mattresses that was broken to the point where one of my guests had to sleep on the floor. Sadly, they were unable to fix it on the weekend and that was definitely the biggest negative part of our experience. Everything else was lovely.

This is the perfect place to stay when you’re in London as a solo traveler or a business traveler. Victoria’s flat is exactly as described and is the perfect combo of cozy and comfortable. The bed was great and the kitchen had everything you needed to cook in! The area is the best— walkable to the tube, the bus, the grocery store is across the street, and the King’s Road is just 5 minutes down the road. I highly recommend her flat and would gladly book here again!

Very nicely refurbished apartment. The entrance, the hallways are clean, refurbished as well. Very quiet environment and close to the vibrant Covent Garden area. I would definitely come back if showing up in my searches.

Very cute and well decorated place in a very good location! The ladder to the loft is no joke, tho—my reasonably bold 11 y/o couldn’t do it (not quite big enough for the hand holds to work) and it felt a bit treacherous even for me. Overall we had a very nice stay!

Our stay was great. Richard was a great host. He was also responsive and had great recommendations. The flat is spacious and comfortable— and a perfect base for exploring London. Easy walking distance to the Tube with great restaurants within walking distance as well. As others have mentioned, some street noise is present. Also, be aware that the primary bedroom on the second floor has a skylight.

Kappy was a great host, the apartment was clean and had a few added touches that was a nice little surprise, exactly like the pictures provided, clear instructions and kappy was on hand if you needed anything, would be more then happy to stay again

The room is suitable for a solo traveler. The host is nice and friendly and always keeps the common area clean. The downside is that you’ll live with their family and sometimes they talk pretty loudly late at night. The location is not the best but convenient enough to go to main attraction by metro.

Amazing stay, Yovish is an exceptional host, always available for queries and very helpful. He strives to make your stay comfortable. The room was spotless with fresh linen on the bed. Water and kettle was available in the room along with tea bags, coffee etc. He even provides shower gel and shampoo. Had great interaction and he has good tips for places to visit and shop in the vicinity and London. Highly recommend and hopefully I’ll be back when I visit London

For what I paid, I could not have expected more from Razz's place. Although a little run down, it is cleaned well and free from clutter. There are some permanent residents who live there, who are very polite and adhere to house rules. Host Razz was on the ball with communications and a very nice lady at that. I would recommend staying here.

The property has everything you could need and very close to the shopping centre while also being peaceful.
Very happy with the property and Simran's communications.

Had a wonderful stay here. Very clean, comfortable and a great location near the tube station. Was easy to find the keys and check in.
The only downside is that the downstairs neighbours loved a party, and had a party the two nights we stayed. Didn't get much sleep.

Matthew’s place definitely looks better and bigger than in the photos. We really felt at home and we love the sunlight and spring breeze when you open the windows. We definitely enjoyed cooking and watching dramas and movies using the projector. Having a dishwasher is also a bonus. The Lee station is also near which is good. Easy to book Uber and order food from the delivery apps. Really had a lovely stay in the flat!

Fantastic location with Two tube stops and buses close by. Easy to walk to the museums or Hyde Park. Nice quiet location but with everything you need within walking distance. The apartment has everything you need.
Lovely flat in a great neighborhood. We really enjoyed our stay and felt at home. Very close to public transportation as well as easy Uber or taxi drop off. Clean and comfortable.

The location of the house was really great. It was very close to both the tube station and the buses. The neighbourhood is very lively, beautiful, quiet and safe. The loft area is quite large and very well lit with two big windows.  Everything was spotlessly clean and tidy in the room. The hosts helped me as much as possible with everything. They were both very kind and very polite. I would especially like to thank Shoban for taking care of me so much. :)

Fantastic place to stay in London. Not central but with very good connections to everywhere by tube. Amazing two bedroom flat, with a kitchen,  living room and a balcony. The hosts are very responsive, pro-active and communicative. The flat even has plug adaptadors so you can charge your EU phone on the English plug type which was amazing (we had forgotten that). Highly recommend this Airbnb
Have stayed many times in Inge's comfy place. It's always great and I will keep returning as long as I am coming to London. See you soon Inge!

I had an amazing at Anke's place. The apartment as clean and had everything that I needed for a comfortable stay.
The bed was comfy and living room bright.
The location was perfect—just a short walk to Chiswick Park station, with great cafes, restaurants, and shops nearby. The area felt safe and peaceful, yet well-connected to central London.
The host was so friendly! :)
Can highly recommend this place!
Great little home away! Close to metro stations, the business district and bars and restaurants. It’s a roomy and lovely little loft . I’ll be back.
We had a lovely stay in Tom’s apartment. In a great location with easy check in. Would recommend!
The whole house is super-clean and very comfortable to stay in. The only thing disappointing me a bit was the water pressure of the shower, that was minimum as Sandra mentions.

James was an exceptional host who made me feel right at home. Since it was my first time in the UK, he provided clear directions to his place and ensured I knew my way to Heathrow Airport. His hospitality and attention to detail made my stay seamless and enjoyable. Highly recommended!

Olga was very friendly and took the time to make sure we knew the highlights of the area.
The kitchen and bathroom were well equipped and the apartment was very homely.
Communication was clear and checkin flexible.

Bhupendra was a wonderful host, very kind, responsive, and helpful the whole way through. The flat is in a great location near all Angel has to offer. The flat was generally clean, although wouldn’t say prestine. A great place to stay for one or two people, especially when you’re mostly out enjoying the city- awesome location near lots of transport options.

The studio was just as described & in the photos, set in a lovely peaceful setting but very convenient for public transport. Own parking on driveway is a bonus.
Very proactive hosts & super quick to respond.
Would highly recommend.

The flat was perfect for what we needed, it was clean, well presented, very comfortable beds (always worth knowing!!) and the location was great.
Victoria was quick to respond to a couple of queries we had.
Will definitely check out availability again, next time we’re in Wimbledon.
Fabulous location and excellent communication before and during our stay. Thank you Matthew for helping with our additional requests also.
Very nice owner. We stayed a few days in London and chose this place since it's close to synagogues and kosher restaurants. No problems. Thoroughly enjoyed every bit.
Easy check-in and good communication. Fridge could do with an upgrade and tv channels didn't really work but overall a comfortable stay for a night away for work.
We all loved our stay at this house and would definitely stay again. Great location, super clean, plenty of space.

Clark's place was absolutely perfect for what I needed while staying in London. He was always responsive and a pleasure to communicate with.
The amenities and thoughtful inclusions were great.
It was well set up and the views are AMAZING!
A short walk to Vauxhall station meant everything was super easy to get to.
I would definitely recommend Clark's place to anyone needing a centrally located place to stay.

Friendly and timely communication before our stay, a comfortable and attractively decorated room in a quiet neighbourhood, sole use of well-appointed bathroom next to our room -  we couldn’t have asked for more for our one night stay in Norbury.  Two well-behaved cats added to its charms! Thanks Alice - it was all perfect.
Thoroughly enjoyed staying at Jason’s Airbnb, it was perfect for 7 adults. Jason was extremely helpful and we could fault nothing about our stay.

I couldn’t recommend this host and apartment more. Was a beautiful place,everything was as pictured in the listing and extremely clean,amazing views and a super easy check in and check out.Kappy was an amazing host,very responsive and welcoming for the whole of our stay.10/10 100% will be returning.

Sancha is a very lovely person and we felt really welcomed in her place☺️ In the room there was everything we needed and we really appreciated the water bottles waiting for us in the fridge with few sweet treats! Everything was nice and clean including bathroom. We had no problems with our stay and would definitely recommend 😁

My 3 friends and I are very satisfied with our stay in Katherin’s accommodation. The apartment was very clean. The host was very available when needed. I recommend this accommodation.
Thanks Katherin !
Overall this apartment is close to a public transportation and clean and easy to find. The apartment is rather small but large enough for 2 people traveling around.

had a great 2 month stay here, the place is very clean and well-kept. they provide us with biweekly cleaning service as well. the house is conveniently located near a main road with plenty of food options and supermarkets. it's very convenient to go to central london, takes 20-30 mins by bus. the hosts michael and julieann are very attentive and responsive to all our queries. all amenities are working properly as well.
As always, a great stay at Tracy's place. We love the location and the fun vibe of the space. It's our home away from home in London!

I loved my stay at the place, excellent for those who love to train, it has a great gym, the professionals are always very friendly and attentive, but the shower was very bad, as the water didn't come out properly, that's the only thing that left something to be desired, but I would definitely come back.
Gunalan's apartment was modern, clean and finished to a high standard. Gunalan was incredibly responsive and flexible, which we appreciated. I would definitely consider staying here again.
I loved staying at this place, very clean and in the city centre too. The apartment was also aesthetically pleasing, bummer that there’s no lift but other than that everything was perfect!

Lovely stay, the place was spotless, stylish, and had everything I needed. The bed was super comfy, and the location was ideal. The host was friendly and helpful throughout. Would definitely stay again!

Cozy flat with a central location, right next to the metro with a market just below it. It can be loud on the street below on a weekend night but that is to be expected given it's location by so many shops, restaurants, and pubs.

Great location highly recommended well appointed very clean property we will add to our favourites and will book again
Thank you

We enjoyed our stay here, place was quiet, clean, safe, and roomy enough for us. The walk to the subway and back when we arrived home was about 12 -15 min each day to get to all the sights so we did have to take transportation alot which for us we would have preferred being closer to walk to everything but that wasn't a negative. Host was very responsive and helpful and would recommend.

Short stay whilst we working in then area
House was exactly why we needed would definitely stay again

My stay was superb in Eson2,
it is located in a strategic and quiet place, the place is really very clean and new, and I would like to thank the staff very much for their availability and especially a big thank you for Mr. Kostantinos who is really kind and helpful, I really appreciate your help you are really professional and attentive well done.
We had a wonderful stay at Alexis's place, which is in a fantastic location! We had a minor issue with the TV, but Alexis sorted out a replacement immediately. *****
The most beautiful and peaceful location close to the subway - quiet street. The beds were comfortable and there were plenty of towels for everyone.
Absolutely loved this place spotlessly clean, peaceful, and in a perfect location. Would definitely stay again!
Perfect spot to call home while visiting London. Easy to get to, in a great neighborhood, and a very comfy bed!
Great location, very easy for us to visit central London on foot. The flat looks good and modern, recommend 👍

The Dove Mews house was almost as amazing as working with Sofia, she is a wonderful host! Sofia was quick to respond to all of our questions, was super accommodating to our requests & was very helpful when a minor issue happened with the washing machine!
The house was as described, had a lot of amenities, awesome location and made you feel right at home! Highly recommend Sofia’s place if you are traveling to London! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I enjoyed my stay at this lovely 2 Bedroom flat. Walking distance to the tube . A bar walking distance from the flat. Ekaterina was very understanding . I would book this flat again .
Amazing location, but the place needs maintenance.  Don't go if you are allergic to mold and picky about cleanliness of the place. I hope hosts take care of the issues before the next visitor.

We had a phenomenal stay at Gordana's flat. The location was perfect: close to many transport options, nearly across the street from Hyde Park, and just a quick bus ride up to Oxford Street. My wife and I needed a flat with two workspaces and it was perfect for that, but the place could easily accommodate three couples staying comfortable. The flat is beautiful and Gordana was super helpful letting us arrive a little early. I will absolutely try to stay again in the future.
Super cute stay for a solo traveler or couple. Lovely neighborhood. Host is very accommodating & easy to reach. Would stay again. Thanks!
Beautiful flat which was the perfect size for 5 of us. Raphael was super helpful and shared lots of recommendations for places to eat & things to do.

I loved staying in Richard’s lovely home. So welcoming and comfortable. Richard is kind and friendly - a lovely little chat on arrival and another chat in the morning. Felt able to completely relax and make myself at home. I would definitely stay here again if I find myself in this part of London.

Perfect for me for an overnight stay while transferring between flights at the airport very comfortable and clean, easy to get to and very easy self check-in and self check out and great Indian food spot right next door.

We were pleasantly surprised with the apartment. It is beautiful, spacious, clean and the building has gym too. Its just 2 minute walk from Croydon train station and trains are very frequent. It was about 20 minute train ride to central London.
I would highly recommend it and definitely will stay here again.

the airbnb was in an amazing location in mayfair! on arrival we were able to drop off our belongings before check in however we were told that our original place had a leak and we stayed in another place that we assume was the same. We did also have one incident where we couldnt get out for 5 minutes but we figured it out! The place was spacious and clean and had a bed that we fit 3 of us in. We were also allowed to also leave our belongings after check out. Overall lovely and accomodating host!

Flawless! Spotless, convenient, high quality amenities and a host trying their best to go above and beyond. If youre stuck choosing, stay with Agat, especially if youre attending the Excel centre one tube stop away!!!

Had a great time staying at Michael's flat! Everything was as described, and the area is very walkable and close to public transportation. The nearby mall has anything you'd ever need in ways of groceries, restaurants, etc.

I had a very unpleasant stay at this property. The host was extremely rude, constantly nagging about small things, and made me feel very uncomfortable throughout my stay. There were clear signs of discrimination in the way I was treated, which was both shocking and disappointing. On top of that, the host's cousin kept knocking on my door, disturbing my peace and making it impossible to feel any sense of privacy. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a respectful and relaxing environment.
Catalina’s place was perfect for our trip to London! It was in a great location and provided excellent value for money.

The overall complex was quiet, walkable, and seemed newly renovated and very nice. The unit itself was very clean and had a very easy checkin experience. The big drawback for me was that this place is significantly smaller than it appears in the photos, and the photos of the listing represent different layouts. For example, the unit I was in did not include a nightstand or bedroom lamp, and I found it uncomfortably small. While I stayed in it by myself I don’t imagine a couple would be able to stay in this space comfortably. I would recommend listing the different layouts as separate units for greater booking accuracy.
This was a lovely quiet spot in a great location. 25 minutes walk to Victoria station. A beautiful, safe neighborhood. Also the best electric kettle ever!

One of our most memorable trips to London with our family! Very responsive hosts, great squeaky clean place and probability of being the most well equipped kitchen we’ve ever seen!
Thank you Guys!

Great location with restaurants downstairs.  It’s on 2nd floor so need to haul luggage up 2 flights.  Internet was down when I arrived but turns out it was the power box surge protector so switched it up and everything worked again.    It’s a great unit and didn’t even take the underground the entire time I was there, and got 15-20k steps per day walking to various business meetings near Berkeley Sq and Picadilly, and then Chinatown for lunch or dinner, and then Oxford Street.

I was so satisfied with our stay here. The place is exactly as described. I needed to figure out how to turn on the hot water and Jacqueline was so helpful in helping me set up everything. This pace is definitely a great stay and well worth the price. I'll be staying here  whenever I go to visit London.

Kappa is one of the bests hosts I’ve dealt with on AirBnb. The apartment is beautiful and in a fantastic location just steps from the Cloud Sky transport. We especially enjoyed having our morning tea on the patio. The bed is very comfortable and the blackout curtains make for a peaceful sleeping space. We enjoyed it so much, we booked again for our return trip.
Very nice place really enjoyed the flat however I would some neighbors were very loud at odd times in the morning but other than that exceptional apartment
sharp stairs to the apartment but it is s very central location - 20 min walk to  kings cross which is easy and nice without luggage
Everything was great! Amazing host and a great place. I wish there was a kitchen to use though
Julia was a great host, this was a perfect base for me whilst working in London. Thank you!

Our stay was excellent. The room was calming and private and not far from a Tube stop, which made travel into London easy and quick. Tam was very helpful and gave us an excellent recommendation for dinner nearby. No complaints about our stay at all.
It was fine for just a night, and it was what you would expect for the price you pay. Nothing amazingly super special but nothing bad either.
It’s actually a beautiful amazing place. If they make the place less dusty, the bed less squeaky, the room less hot (I.e. have their AC working), I would stay here again.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in London. The flat was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. We ate breakfast every morning in the spacious, sunlit room around the large dining table as we planned for the day ahead. There’s a Tesco close by which made it easy to pick up snacks and stock the fridge. The hosts were friendly and responsive and provided us with clear instructions. We would definitely stay there again.

Great location. Clean and comfortable. I had a great stay at Tonia’s for a month and particularly appreciate the early check-in and late check-out which she kindly accommodated. Will I stay at Tonia’s again? Absolutely yes :) Once again, thank you, Tonia. Best of wishes xx Renee
This was a nice room. The place was clean. It was just located far from the center of London, so I had to do a lot of walking.

Sarah was very attentive and communicated well leading up to our check in. The Airbnb was well situated for the price with only a ~35-40 minute walk to attractions such as Buckingham Palace and the London Eye. It was also well situated near train stations. The place was clean and appeared as per the photos, however we were not expecting the apartment to be an apartment inside a house. This meant that sound travelled significantly. We were lucky that our neighbours were quiet and respectful, however it makes you feel like you can barely have a conversation without disturbing someone else.

Wonderful Property, 2 Parking Space, Loved the En- Suite, Fast Response, Smooth Checkin, 3 Minutes walk to Chadwell heath Station. Easy Access to the city by Train. Many Local Amenities. Will be back in the future.
Thank you very much

Amazing location, small but clean apartment. However, the bathroom had a very unpleasant smell to it and there was mold on the shower ceiling. I feel like these things could be fixed easily with mold spray and a room fragrance.
I would consider coming back if the bathroom situation was improved.

Great location and lovely home.  James couldn’t have been more helpful throughout the whole booking.  House was spotlessly clean, very well equipped and ideal for exploring London. Parking was extremely easy, managed to get a space directly outside the house.  Can’t recommend James and his home highly enough, thank you!

Vikash was a great host. He really took great care an provided anything required. We enjoyed staying with 3 kids. Close to Twickenham Stadium, Redlees park, St. Margrets. Next train stations to London city just 10-15min walk. Supermarket just 5min. Friendly neighbours, too :-)
Thank you!
Lovely apartment, amazing view, felt more welcoming than a lot of other airbnbs I have stayed in
Very nice accommodations, and great location. Walkable to the underground station, and Portobello Road shops. The apartment was very clean, and kitchen and bathrooms were updated.

My family stayed at Alex's house for spring break; it was the perfect respite from long, busy days walking and seeing the sights.  The beds were comfortable and the sofa provided an extra bed for our oldest son.  All in all, the location was great - cute street with some fun restaurants, close to the tube, good shopping, close to tourist sights.  Would definitely recommend Alex's place for a family.
Would definitely recommend this flat.really clean and modern couldn’t fault it and the host was so helpful and fast to respond.will be back again in July

Chris apartment is a nice place to stay . Exactly as described. I do not like the appearance of the external building but I wasn’t bothered as I had more business with the inside .
Overall, nice space for a family , kitchen provision for cook like home , convenient self check in .
Difficult to use WIFI as some numbers and alphabet were erased . Useful to write passwords on piece of paper for your guests next time .
Lastly , I know it’s summer but the spiders terrified my kids . They are everywhere now but a little bug spray could be useful before guests arrival in summer
We had a lovely time at this very nice place in one of our favorite neighborhoods in London. Everything was as described. And better. Thank you very much for hosting us.

We really enjoyed the stay, place was clean and with all the required amenities (in the kitchen, bathroom).
Catalina was very nice and responded immediately with helpful advice and was very flexible.
Location is in off the center of Oxford street but not noisy.
Host was extremely easy to contact and was quick to respond, Location is ideal good travel links. Home is Cozy and has everything you’d need.

We had such a lovely stay at Kerisha’s place! She was super responsive, kind, and very helpful throughout our visit. The place itself was clean, cozy, and had all the essentials we needed. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable stay!

James was very responsive. Location was good - walkable to tube and restaurants. If you only need a place to sleep, its fine. But if you are looking for more of a relaxed and cozy place then this might not work.

Wow wow wowwww! This place is so beautiful inside the picture didnt even do the place justice, check-in was super easy hosts instructions where nice and Clear to follow. Only down side was the place does get pretty cold but other than that stay was amazing quick 15 minuet walk to Victioria station .Really enjoyed my stay overall x
Marc is a great host and gave us a very warm welcome. He gave us helpful Information about supermarkets and pubs in the area. We felt at home from the very first moment and would love to come back.

The house was very clean and comfortable. It's located in a quiet neighbourhood near bus stops and a tube station which is very convenient if you want to travel and see London. The house is equipped with everything you might need for a short or longer stay. Ipek was an excellent host! We highly recommend this property.
Very relaxed stay on a work trip. Home was clean and tidy. Thanks, Mingshu!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in London but the experience read like “a series of unfortunate events”. We were contacted as soon as we arrived in the City that our original booking was not available due to scheduled maintenance (?). We agreed to an alternate listing in the same area. Communication was good but it was the beginning of some “issues”—clogged toilet, lack of directions for stove usage, leaking ceiling, furniture that bore no resemblance to photos, etc. But our contact persons (via Airbnb) were
always prompt, friendly, and even bought us a toilet “air blaster” that did the trick. It’s difficult to explain, but we had a wonderful time, laughed at the insanity. But really, they need to go in and make sure all the apartments, kitchen tools, etc. are adequate and spic and span.
This place was beautiful! It was in such a beautiful area and quite quiet. Check in was super easy, and it smelt absolutely amazing! Amazing price and we really enjoyed our stay !
Great location and very clean, good bed too (important for me), spacious place and would love to stay again.
Nice flat, very quiet neighborhood.  We had a lot of trouble with the hob (stovetop), so you may need to ask the owner for instructions as to how to use it.  She is lovely; very friendly and helpful.

I booked this flat for my friend while she was traveling with her daughter in London. They had a wonderful time and were absolutely amazed by the flat. I feel so lucky to have found this place for her, giving her such a great impression of staying in London. Sarah was incredibly helpful and kind throughout the whole process — she was always available to answer our questions and willing to assist whenever we needed.

We have stayed in the area previously and wanted to stay there again. Our stay previously was for almost 3 weeks and this time 2 weeks. We became familiar with the area last time and felt comfortable returning to what we knew with walking distance access to the Almeida and King’s Head theatres and Sadler’s Wells together with great local pubs and cafes. Whilst opposite the Tamil Crown pub we had no issues with noise
Very good stay at Imran’s place. Kitchen was bright and airy - bedroom is a bit tight but that’s London for you… great location, under 20 minutes to Leicester Square.
Great apartment in a fantastic location. Felt very homely with great furnishings. Clean and practical. Would definitely stay again.

Anne has shown the rare caring and consideration that we always would wish in a b&b hostess ...she is the best and that's why we returned again this year because we felt that she treated us as friends and family... there aren't too many people like her ...she is priceless, she is the best of the best, and her home and pets are adorable,  and we recommend her highly to anyone who wants to have a truly great b and b experience in London
Great stay with a responsive and helpful owner. No faults, would state that it can be quite loud with the surrounding affected with construction at times

Really enjoyed my stay! Nordine fetched us at the door and explained everything to us and comfortably checked us in. Although near the Emirates stadium which was great, it wasn’t noisy at all even on match day. Overall a great place and would stay again!

What a beautiful apartment! We couldn’t have asked for a nicer place to stay - comfortable, wonderful windows and light, lovely decor.
We loved the neighborhood and communication with the host couldn’t have been faster and easier.
We enjoyed our stay at Jennie’s — it was steps away from the subway station and a clean, comfortable stay. I would recommend Jennie’s place to other guests!

This home is stunning. It is beautifully decorated and has any amenity you could possibly need. It is extremely spacious, comfortable and homey. There is a grocery store that’s accessible by a short walk and a  bus stop feet away from the door that will take you all over the city. I loved the stay so much that I spent an entire day inside. We had a small plumbing issue and Antonio handled it immediately. Even with that I have no complaints. I was sad to leave and look forward to coming back. Thank you Antonio!
Great apartment for an overnight stay. Host was responsive and clear with instructions which made for a pleasant stay.
Great place to stay! Emma is very responsive and the flat is very homely, would recommend this air bnb to anyone!

One of the best AirBnB‘s I have stayed in. Great house in a perfect location.
Richard is super helpful and friendly.
Also always very responsive. We will come back.

The place is nice except that the carpet need to be cleaned as it has some hair which I noticed. Also, I did not like the corridor smell which I think is out of the landlord control. Other than that, it is nice place to stay in.

Spacious, super clean and modern. Apartment hotel and has a reception to check in and out of. £100 deposit on arrival but was refunded within 24hrs of checking out. Only disadvantages were that my room faced the main road and it was loud when certain cars went past and that the blinds weren’t blackout. Other than that I couldn’t fault it - felt very luxurious.

Fabulous stay at Mary Joy's - space is exactly as listed and really gorgeous! Everything worked well: heat, a/c, kitchen, everything. Location is stunning, you can walk everywhere and the best thing is it is really quiet. Beds are super comfy. Will definitely return

Kate couldn’t have been a better host! Proactive and clear instructions, the home was beautiful and everything was easy and as described.
If you are looking for a private and secure place in London to go easily exploring, we couldn’t recommend more!
Location is perfect, especially if you have a little one like we did (great play park just a short walk around the corner).
Bonus of having dedicated car parking space and outside courtyard!
Will definitely look to book again!

Had a lovely stay in Finchley at Ana's guesthouse. The accommodation is modern, clean, and comfortable, and it looks out onto a very spacious garden that is clearly tended with love. It's a beautiful and peaceful retreat, just a 10-minute walk from supermarkets and the tube—very convenient for city centre activities, and especially ideal for me, travelling to London via the Eurostar, as the journey to St Pancras is quick and direct. Ana is a great host: very helpful and accommodating—couldn't ask for more.

We had a wonderful weekend at Frederica’s place.
A little paradise that we loved coming back to after a long day exploring the city.
I highly recommend this place and can’t wait to return!

I stayed during london marathon and the location was lit - 25 mins to the central part with 1 buss - amazing. Place was very quiet and lovely. Enjoyed my stay. House was clean, bathroom clean and very quiet.
It was a great stay, easy Tube access, all the Camden Town attractions right around the corner.!
We had a great stay! Very comfortable and clean and felt safe. Hosts are lovely and very communicative answering all questions we had very quickly.Highly recommend!

We had a great stay at Amanda's apartment. It was bigger than we expected, the interior is very nice with lots of unique details and there's also a big garden.
The kitchen is fully equipped (there's even an airfryer!), the beds were made when we arrived and Amanda even put some snacks on the kitchen counter and drinks in the fridge.
Amanda responds very quickly whenever we had a question, she is a great host.
There's a bus stop in front of the apartment and the nearest Tube station is only a few minutes' walk.
The area is family friendly with nice shops and restaurants on walking distance. We would definitely book this apartment again.

Great place and off a nice quiet street in the Holborn area. Lots of different restaurants and cute places. We loved our stay. Was very comfortable and easy to get inside. Only one thing to state was that the bathroom tub area could get a little slippery when wet. My parents, who are older, would have liked a bar to hold onto while stepping out of the tub. I was fine, however. Great place overall!
Very nice inside, exactly like pictures. Very close to shops and Brixton Station, 5 minute walk. Thanks for a great stay!
Would recommend 10/10. So homey and cosy. Laura is super helpful and friendly. The place was super clean and Laura even left us a bottle of wine. :)

I stayed 3 nights at Sandra’s place.
Everything was great: the house and the room were clean and tidy.
It is also in a quiet neighbourhood allowing a good rest over night.
Sandra was kind a quick to respond to my messages.
I would be glad to stay in her house again.

Terrible stay. The apartment is much smaller than it looks in the photos (clearly taken with a wide-angle lens) and is on the 5th floor with no working elevator — I had to carry five heavy suitcases up and down every day.
The hot water didn’t work properly. I had to sleep without showering multiple times, even on my birthday. The host offered another apartment just to shower, but I didn’t pay a high price to use a shared bathroom.
I booked 17 nights but left after 8. After I got a refund from Airbnb, the host got angry and falsely reported me for throwing a party — totally absurd, since the place barely fits two people standing.
I do not recommend. Misleading listing and dishonest host.

This was our second stay at the penthouse and it was absolutely fantastic. Even though we knew what to expect we were still blown away by the quality of the loft and the friendly warmth of the host. The perfect luxury escape from the bustle of the city in the perfect location. Can’t wait to come back again!

In my opinion, this is a big deal for alone travelers that want a place to rest while they are in London. It’s well connected with public transport (Underground, Buses, Cycles) and it’s very close to Central London. Also all were as described. You will find some essential services in a few steps. Rosario is a lovely person that will help to be good in all moment and make it feel like home. So I totally recommend it.
This was not a complaint for me, but take into account this info based on my experience:
- Most of the building features are narrow.
- You'll be up a few floors.
- Internet connection is OK but maybe could not working fluently for work. (it was reported and to solve at the moment to check-out)
- Sometimes you could hear some noises in early mornings.

Great place to stay in Clapham. Being directly across the street from a tube station made getting around London extremely easy, and it was walkable to lots of local spots in the Clapham area as well. We stayed here over a month and it provided us everything we needed during our long stay. Having a private little outdoor space was also a bonus.
We were only there one night, but it was perfect and we were very happy. Would definitely recommend! Thank you, Jade!
Great flat in a great location! Both George and Paolo were great - super easy and friendly check in and out. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Problem with the hot water.
Regardless we’re good at responding to my messages but no solution was forthcoming during our stay however they organised a refund via Airbnb

Good communication and clean place. My issue is that the apartment stinks of weed - it’s awful. The cleaner came and mentioned it was a previous Tennant, and that not much could be done. He did leave sprays and that was kind but something can and should be done. It stinks, and is off-putting. If you’re a weed smoker then you’ll be cool with it, but I’m not. Also; the WiFi wasn’t great, and so had to tether.
Otherwise, great place!

This was a last minute booking after a very stressful day! The host went above and beyond to ensure that the studio was ready and welcoming on arrival. Lovely location, clean and comfortable with plenty of nearby take away/dining options. Train station was just around the corner and the parking was really convenient and safe. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

Darius‘s place was great. The only downside was no air system so the room was hot. She communicated to me later that the building had a maintenance issue that wouldn’t be resolved to the following week.
The room was clean and was exactly how she described. It was a good space for the night and I thank you for the last minute availability.
Iyisha's place is very lovely and comfortable.  Had a great time staying there and it's in a very safe area. Will definitely be back. Thanks again.

Fabian’s place was very clean and tidy. It is a small flat but it’s cosy and comfortable for 2 people (we were 2 and 1 toddler). Location wise it’s right by the station which has quick links into central London. I’d definitely recommend his place for exploring London. The management company were very quick to resolve any issues. It’s a great Airbnb!

We had an exceptional stay at Sandra's flat! Sandra and Nordine were extremely helpful with fast communication and recommendations around the area. We tried many of the noted restaurants, and they were great. The location is nice, quiet, and super close to a tube station making it easy to travel to and from town. The flat was spotless and spacious; no complaints at all.
It was one of those trips where you are left speechless as everything was perfect. We hope to get another chance to book this spot in the future. Highly recommend!

A beautiful flat in a wonderful neighborhood. Stepping into the magazine worthy living room and seeing the bright light streaming in through the windows I said, I may never leave. This Nottinghill flat is in the best area with restaurants and shops right outside your door. Style and grace inside and out. Willdefinitely be back. Thank you Matthew! You made it so easy for us. Appreciate you and your team.
A great experience for our first trip to London! Just a short walk to Victoria station, and fantastic recommendations for food. We had a wonderful stay!

Luxurious and comfortable spot with a large kitchen and private bathroom. Lovely park down the road and very close to bus/tube as well.
Inge was very helpful and a pleasure to talk to. I’d happily stay here again and likely will in the future.
It was all good and we were happy to stay at the apartment! For a family it was perfect

I stayed at Anne‘s place for one night and had a lovely time! The room was very beautiful and cozy, and the area was also really nice and calm. I felt very safe! Anne was also very nice and gave me some good recommendations on where to go – and she was understanding when I changed my plans spontaneously and always answered very quickly.

The apartment is in a great location - near shops, restaurants, transport and Hyde Park! The hosts were helpful and very communicative at all points. The kitchen is well equipped and the bathroom has a lovely modern shower. The apartment could use some small updates/ touch ups.

Lovely house, very close to the Stadium
within walking distance.
House had everything we needed for a great, two day break.
Vikash was easy to get in touch with and responded every message promptly.

Place is perfect, Anna is very generous and kind host
I’d book the place every time I come to London.
Highly recommended.

Lovely flat located close to Hackney Wick tube station with everything you could need. Lots of local bars, food places and green areas nearby. Sabrina was very accommodating and friendly, we had a lovely stay in her flat  :)

The room was exactly was I was looking for a in a short trip to London.  I chose this place to be close to Euston Station for train travel north which was within walking distance.  Lots of places close by to get something to eat.  Room was well kept and had everything that I needed for my trip.

The only complaint I have is the apartment has restaurants on the main bottom floor. The noise was loud from 1700 to 2000. During the weekend, the noise was unbearable until 0400. Otherwise, everything is perfect.

This apartment was perfect for a family, two good sized bedrooms with ample storage. The living room was cosy with a large TV. The kitchen was well equipped for basic cooking with a good sized dining table. The host greeted us on arrival with a tour of the flat. Local amenities were on the door step and plenty of local parks in walking distance
Main bathroom had terrible smell. We have to clean and disinfect on first day to get out smell.

Wow wow wow! What a great find! Ana’s place is truly amazing. It is furnished with everything you need and looks exactly like the pictures on the listing. Lovely welcome ‘Thank you’ card along with chocolates and shortbread as well as a pint of milk and water in the fridge….so kind and well received.
Location is a 10 min walk to Finchley Central tube station and so access to London is ideal. Free parking and being inside ULEZ zone again makes it a perfect location.
Excellent breakfast / brunch at Lush Coffee also on the doorstep.
I can’t recommend Ana’s place enough and know I will certainly book again if in the London area.
Many thanks Ana!
There is nothing i can say but its really amazing and worth to booked 🥹🤗🫶♥️

Disappointed that shower tap handles were not seated on the shower taps, despite asking for them to be corrected, this was not done, making the use of these shower facilities near on impossible. The reply to my request to have them corrected was late and showed no just intent or care to get them fixed. The taps remained this way during my whole 8 days. Just not acceptable.
Paolo and George were very responsible and accommodating, Every question addressed in minutes. Nice apartment in a beautiful neighborhood.

this is a really good apartment ， I like the sitting room so much, and Isabella is really a very good person, the breakfast is very good and full of nutrition ,especially the French Sunday classic food! And everyday help a lot to offer the information of trip and transportation. We really enjoy the days in London because of this apartment choose!

Richard was fantastic.  Check in was flexible and Richard met us and helped us to localize.  The home was great- bright, spacious. There were 5 of us and we all had enough space.  We especially enjoyed the rooftop patio and playing pool.  And transit was all close by.  Would certainly recommend
Perfect location right in the heart of Chinatown - tons to explore and everything is within walking distance. The apartment is spacious and comfortable for two people. Great stay overall!

Julia was a great host, always responsive and helped accomodate an earlier check in. The apartment was very clean and it had everything you need for your everyday.
The location being very close to the White city Westfield was a great plus and also very close to metro.

Tom’s place was wonderful. We only stayed two nights but it was a great stay. It was easy to access downtown London. We took the train and had no issues. It was an easy place to find and great location. Clean apartment and matched what I was expecting! Thank you for a wonderful stay! We would definitely stay here again!

Beautiful and well-maintained place with all the amenities you’d need for a comfortable stay. We were lucky to get warm days and made full use of the lovely courtyard. The area is very peaceful and quiet, perfect for unwinding after a day out. The only downside for me was the lack of a nearby tube station, but there are bus stops about a 10-minute walk away, which made getting around manageable. A great stay overall, especially if you’re in London to relax or explore at a slower pace.

Massive thank you to Jason. We stayed last week for a girls trip to London and it was so easy. Great communication, luggage drop off offered, checked in to make sure all was well and the location was better than we anticipated. All round great stay. We are already looking at coming back. 😀

I stayed on a work visit for two weeks and it was perfect for my trip. Great location, very well connected to central London as well as lovely local area of Hammersmith and Fulham. The flat had everything I needed - clean and spacious, with a fully functioning kitchen as well as laundry facilities. Laura was friendly and quick to respond to messages.

We had a fantastic experience at Anne’s flat in London. The location was perfect—set in a charming neighborhood with lots of cute cafes and just a short walk to beautiful Battersea Park. The flat was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay. Anne was a wonderful host—responsive, kind, and so sweet. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting London!

Great stay at Laura’s lovely place, which is well located for supermarkets, restaurants and public transport. Despite being so close to the main road it’s nice and peaceful. Very comfortable bed and all beautifully set up. Laura was a helpful and responsive host.

Hosts very responsive and friendly 🥰 Will definitely be coming back 🤩💖
Honestly, you’d be lucky to stay here. Michael’s place is a perfect location with access to the best of London .
Fantastic stay! Tongtong was accommodative and responsive. The place was convenient to the tube and various busses!

Lovely, quiet & peaceful and so central for our needs. Easy to get about on foot or public transport. Nice and convenient place to stay right by Kentish town tube station so easy access to everything. The place did seem to still be being renovated with things like no carpet on the stairs but otherwise a pleasant stay.

I forgot my passport in the Airbnb, and had already left to another city. Martijn and the team not only found it, but thoughtfully coordinated a time for me to pick up my passport a few days later! We enjoyed our stay at this cute apartment! Cool location, walkable distance to a lot of different restaurants. The host is super responsive even late at night, and understanding. Clear instruction with everything as well. Thank you!!

We had a great stay. It was a great location with a tube station within a 10 minute walk. Neighborhood was safe and a small local grocery store was right down the street. George gave us a discount QR code to use at the store.

Great location, lovely flat and views all across London. Lots of transport links nearby and plenty to do around the area. Self check-in super easy and well instructed by the host. There is a bar nearby so at night the neighbors can be a bit loud, but nothing unmanageable. The kitchen is very complete and functional and the shower is very good. The stay was perfect!

Charlotte home was the perfect  location for us near our son's flat. Bus and tube across the street. Flat was clean,  bed very comfortable, a peaceful night sleep. Charlotte gave excellent direction for checking in and out.
Great stay in London, the apartment was in a great spot that was easy to get to everywhere from! It had everything you could need for your stay, we had a lovely time, thank you!

I wish I could give Hazel more than 5 stars! She and her family were so welcoming. Adorable accommodations, clean, comfortable, and we really appreciated the delicious breakfast she provided. Caspar the sweet kitty was an extra bonus! Would absolutely stay again ♥️
Great host this is prob the 4th time i’ve stayed. Very friendly, safe and homely. Thank you so much 😊

Very happy with the opportunity to stay at Aderonke’s place.

Great apartment in a nice area.  Close to tube stations, restaurants, grocery and shopping. The owner, Rebecca, was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Would stay here again.  Highly recommend.
Perfect comfortable stay that was so close to the overground and busses. Daniel is extremely responsive and kind. Absolutely would stay here again! X
Just 11 mins from terminal 5 by bus .  excellent place to dock for a nite or two especially if you have an early check in at the airport. Good pricing and all.
Carey's garden flat was great! Everything was exactly as described and clean. The bed was comfortable and the kitchen well equipped. Communication was easy and Carey was very helpful.

Exceeded our expectations.  we were too tired at nights, so noise soming from metro or thin walls didnt stop us getting a good sleep like some previous visitors. just a tip for future visitors, 'bounce"app provides cheap luggage storage with a location just around the corner of the airbnb. since we there was no flexibility for checkin times we have used their services , was convenient. overall perfect stay. thanks james.
Good location for links into central London, warm welcome from Mingshu. Lovely kitchen space, nice room with comfortable bed and a great shower in the bathroom.
Nina is a great host. Very helpful and responsive. The apartment is clean and well appointed and we enjoyed our stay.
Overall it was fascinating and cozy! Except the front door lock is a bit hard to open at the beginning, been stuck their twice at least 10mins to figure out how to unlock the door.

We couldn’t thank Jadin & his partner enough for hosting us during our last minute stay. We were free to self check-in & felt at home instantly. Jadin was very helpful with recommending public transport, things to do and overall lovely to chat to. The apartment was clean & cozy and we massively enjoyed our stay. Thank you :)

Ying was a great communicator and offered lots of tips and advice on the area, even down to suggestions with where to store your luggage after checkout, if needing to spend more time in the area.
Thanks Ying

We found the flat to be a suitable place as the jumping off point for all the activities we had planned during our stay.  Everything was easy and the flat has everything that's needed.  Would definitely recommend if you want a place for City of London/East End activities.

We loved our stay here! Tamara's home is lovely and in a quiet neighbourhood of London, but also so easy to get to all the main attractions. Excellent venue, location excellent to explore London. Everything needed is close. George met us and helped us during our stay. Gave us some sweet tips and guidance. Overall very happy

Julia’s place was amazing. Great location, easy transport links and loads of restaurants and shops for everything. The apartment was nice, clean and check in was super easy. Julia is a very lovely, accommodating and responsive host. Would definitely recommend.
Very friendly hosts and spacious rooms. We were very happy with the additional bed tucked in the niche. The lift for bringing luggage downstairs was a huge help!
Great spot that felt private and homey,  but it was also walkable and just between 2 main roads with tons of shops and restaurants. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Great host and great place. Walkable to the tower bridge and tower hill, as well as many walkable station for public transport. The host was great and flexible.
The check in was easy and the room is clean and smell good, the place was quite and peaceful

Room was perfect, lot of space and clean. Bathroom smells a little.
The Kitchen was clean and you had everything you need.
Next to the airbnb is a great area with a lot to see, eat and drink 😍
Really enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment.  It was spacious, clean, and had a well equipped kitchen.  Easy access to all the sightseeing sites of London via the Tube.  A great value.

I had a lovely stay in this elegant, charming flat. The location is great, the flat has everything needed and the host is most helpful. The gardens are gorgeous and I loved the peace and quiet. Highly recommended!

Decent place and host. If you’re out for a gig in Camden does the trick.

Excellent all round . Beyond my expectation . I felt right at home, and with excellent breakfast to start the day .
Isabelle is more than just after host .
Thanks .

Very kind host ! Extremely helpful and responds fast, the flat was beautiful, clean and spacious. Even after contacting let us drop our bags in earlier then the check in time. Would definitely recommend !

What a fabulous stay me and my family had here. Serge was an amazing host, super fast responses to messages/queries, very friendly and helpful. Apartment was very clean and clutter free and the area was so peaceful and quiet. Beds were comfortable and warm. Would highly recommend to everyone!

Chris is a brilliant Host even though he is 6 hours behind us, extremely responsive and took additional care to help me extend my stay.
I can definitely recommend this lovely flat to families, and couples.

We had a great stay! The self check-in worked perfectly, which made our arrival super easy. The room and bathroom were spotless, and the kitchen had everything we needed for our four-day trip. Overall, highly recommended!

I had a really enjoyable stay, the location is great, with the DLR being just outside. There's plenty of shops and places to eat nearby with a few grocery stores.
