This place was a good place to stay. Robin was helpful and non-intrusive. We found it easy to get the bus and tube to travel all over london. The four flights of stairs didn't bother us. We would definitely stay there again.
A great deal.
Very kind host, and smooth communication, enjoyed staying very much. Easy access to the town by few buses, and close to the park!
THE place to be, so nice house, so nice people in a quiet district close to many parcs, canal, and transport. hope we will have opportunity to get back!

Anne was a very welcoming host. Accommodation was in a perfect location only a stone's throw from Battersea Park - one of the best parks in London. I didn't take public transport, opting to walk through the park and along the Thames to work in the morning. It took me 45 minutes to Lambeth Bridge and was the most stress-free journey to work I've ever had. Bed was very comfortable. Shower was hot. Dogs were very friendly. It felt like a proper home from home.
It was a great experience! At Anne's place I felt like at home! She was lovely and the room was very comfortable! I hope I will be back soon to see Anne, the dogs and... London!

I enjoyed my stay very much. The twin room is spacious and very comfortable. Anne is a very gracious host and very accomodating regarding hours, luggage dropoff etc. Close to bus routes and Battersea Park.

Had a comfortable stay here.  Didn't have any problems.   Price was very reasonable compared to many other central properties.  Tube station is really near to property, which made getting to and from Julias easy.  I didn't have much contact with Julia, but when I did, she was helpful and pleasant. Thanks to Julia and her mum.
staying in Anne´s house was very nice. she is very, very sweet, the room is very cosy and the house also cosy and very clean. she has two very nice dogs.

Ula was a fabulous host.. She had great advice for local eats/pubs, and was incredibly helpful with managing the train system - turns out there is a gorgeous walk through the woods to the Sydenham Hill station - just a handful of stops to London Victoria.
The room we stayed in was lovely - she has just recently done a substantial refurbishment and it all felt very homely and comfortable.
I would highly recommend staying at Ula's place!

Julia was a great host who avails herself to accomodate my check in/check out time. The room is as the pictures on airbnb show, thus you can rely on the pictures. Room is clean and tidy. The bed was comfortable as well. Only drawback was the location is a bit off from city center. Tube station (Shepherd's Bush market) is very close though. Would recommend if you have the luxury of time to explore London slowly.

nice flat,great location and reasonable price.
overall great place where to stay in london

The appartment was really great clean and comfy. This place is like home with everything you need towels, bed sheets, shampoo and so on. Morever the location is perfect : restaurants and stores just in the neighbourhood.
Paolo gave us a bigger appartment than the initial one and it was really awesome and so kind for him to do it. He is very welcoming.
very satisfied of my stay with Richard. He was very kind and helpful, no problem recommending him to other guests!

Julia was very responsive and welcoming. If it's summer/good weather this apartment would be perfectly located between the beach(es) and the centre of town. It's also well-priced compared with other more expensive options in Santander.

As I was staying again at Richard’s home, it was a pleasure.
Richard is very nice . The room is very nice too.
Very well located place.
Paolo is a super fun host :D Lovely place, really AWESOME location, couldn't ask for anything more central :D

very pleasant, very clean room.  Just what I needed for a 4-day stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay with Richard again.  Richard himself personable and helpful.  Two small issues I had were that the main shower was out-of-action but it wasn't a big problem, and its located at the top of a hill, which made for great views but weary legs :-)

My family stayed here for 3 weeks and though it was small and basic, it had everything they needed - decent bedroom, bathroom and kitchen with all the essentials. Paolo was friendly, professional and available to help iron out any issues along the way - a big thanks to him. We would both recommend this place and stay here again in future. Great value for fantastic central London location.

I am a new user of air b&b and found Paola's apartment to be excellently located and clean. He is extremely helpful and friendly. The apartment is in a safe area close to transport and shopping. As a single girl traveller I would recommend this apartment.
The room was very  comfortable and Richard was a kind, gracious and helpful host! Definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in the Greenwich area!

A brilliant studio in a marvelous location within 5-10min walk to Oxford Street. The flat has a very nice, clean, modern design with new furnishings. The bathroom is to a very good standard with a very nice shower facility. Which is quite important to me, as I'm a bit OCD when it comes to the bathroom!! Overall it has everything you need for a lovely stay in London.
Paolo was an excellent host, very polite, it was a pleasure to stay in he's studio flat. I would stay again

A great location and an excellent host. The flat is about 5 minutes walk from Oxford Circus so is perfectly located for exploring Central London. We arrived a little early and instead of making us wait Paolo took our bags into the office and moved them into the flat before he left allowing us to spend longer exploring London. He also had a lovely conversation with us checking that we knew where we were going and what we were doing.

The flat was excellent having been newly refurbished. It has a TV and a full kitchen and a small but perfect bathroom.

A perfect place to stay, we'll definitely be returning.

The studio is very comfortable with nice modern fixtures, in an excellent location and easy to get to other parts of London from. The double bed which folds down from the wall is very comfortable. Paolo is a welcoming host. The light bulb in the shower room went on the first evening, Paolo was quick to get hold of a new lightbulb for us that same evening. The wifi was a little unreliable but everything else was great! Would definitely recommend this place, had a great stay.

Richard was a lovely host! But we had a couple of minor issues - a broken radiator (now fixed) meant the room was very cold and the supplied heater was noisy. The shower was also out of commission, and the pillows could do with replacing. But the view was lovely, the bed was perfectly comfortable, and Richard did what he could to help.

Very good location and very pleasant guest!! We had a great time in London walking around from such a central location (10 min walk from Oxford Circus!!! :P) or taking the tube for further places (3 stations to choose from depending on what line you want to go!!)
and cherry on top : good Italian restaurant/take away at the corner of the street :D























I certainly advise
Everything was as described. Lovely room and I had a great time. I'd definitely go back there again. Thank you!

I stayed at Julia's for two weeks and it was great!
Very nice, clean room with lots of storage, good bed and your own fridge and sink. The location is also really nice, very close to Shepherds Bush Market Station and a small walk from Shepherds Bush Station.
The room itself feels very homey and you can have your privacy if you want to. The kitchen with microwave and the washing machine was also convenient for my longer stay. I would definitely recommend this room to anyone!

Very nice place ! Paolo has renovated and configured this little flat in a quiet little courtyard. A lot of fourniture are also available in the flat. Paolo is an available and very welcoming host. Great location close to the city center. We will definitely return.
Good stay at Anne's, nice room, nice host and great big park right next door!

We stayed four nights at Anne Abel's home and we enjoyed it. The room was spacious, warm and very clean ; good breakfast too. Anne was very helpful.
Dog's very friendly and quiet. The local transport is only at 20mm to Victoria's station. Good place to stay.

We are two couples and  found Tim’s comfortable and spacious apartment the perfect place for our stay in London. It is in a quiet location overlooking the Regent’s Canal, yet just around the corner from a supermarket, vibrant Camden High Rd, and the underground for a quick trip to central London. The apartment had everything we needed plus many thoughtful extras such as an espresso machine and printer. Tim was very friendly and helpful and was quick in responding to my emails.  The apartment key is kept in a key safe on the property which made arrival and departure very simple. Thank you Tim, we had a wonderful stay and will recommend your apartment to our family and friends in Australia.

House that seemed to appear in the photographs. Everything you need and more was taking place at home. The heating system was working fine. Sheets, towels and house overall was clean. The design of the house was perfect. All equipment in the kitchen to prepare food at home was taking place. Write everything you can take a very long time. To sum up Tim's flat is excellent. I would recommend it to anyone.
Urszula is a very warm and communicative host. The house is great and the room comfortable. Travel to central London, if you're happy to walk 10 minutes to the station, is no problem.

We loved everything about the place!
The location is great - close to all possible types of transport, lots of places to eat, shops, everything, but still a very quiet and a calm place.
The apartment itself is very comfy and cozy, fully equipped with a great terrace and a BBQ
Tim was great to communicate with, I received responses immediately.
Would recommend and stay there myself again!
Our stay was really great. Marcos` flat is beautiful, very clean and only a few steps away from all you need (supermarket, tube ...). Marco was a great host and kindly straightforward. Thumbs up!

I was a little hesitant but very pleased with my first Airbnb experience!! What a great find and value for the money!!! Aj was a wonderful host during our stay in London. He was always available if I had questions or needed anything. The property is very clean, well kept and very convenient to shopping, great restaurants and the train station. I have already referred a few friends to stay with Aj and my husband and I are planning to return in January. I highly recommend!!
An amazing well equipped apartment, perfectly located to explore London. The hosts communication and help/advice also was excellent and help aid the trip . I would highly recommend

The location of Anne's home was fantastic. One short bus ride from her home to Victoria Station, and downtown London. Her location to Battersea park is also key. When London gets to be too busy, and you want a break, the Park is at your doorstep.
Ann is a fabulous hostess. Kind, helpful, and interested in knowing you are having a good time. The room was bright and cheery, and her home was organized and clean.
I wholeheartedly recommend this BNB location to anyone visiting London.

AJ is a polite, friendly and helpfull guy. He's appartment is in a perfect location near Camden and tube station, it is a very new and clean room. A very good place to stay. In the night is very quite, you don't hear mutch the traffic from the road. This guaranties you a good sleep at night. If I go to London again, I will come to he's place again.

The room is exactly the same than I could looking it up on web. The quartier is quiet and you have shops and market near. You can go walking to Notting Hill and Portobelo. Two Undregroud Station only walking 5 or 10 minutes. Very convenient if you arrived at Heathrow Airport. I only met Julia for some minutes so I can't tell anything about her. Everything was, more or less, good. The only thing didn't work properly was the shower.

I really enjoyed the stay in Marco's nice and lightful appartment. The key hand-over was very easy thanks to a key locker I was able to open myself. I tried to get a flat to very last minute and Marco was very helpful and flexible to support me. His documentation & FAQs about the flat is perfect. The location is not really downtown but the tube is a few meters away and get you quickly into the center or to the Excel exhibition center. Definitely a spot to recommend.

As my first experience of Airbnb, Aj was absolutely a perfect host. He was very friendly and helpful.
The place is brand new with modern and amazing decoration. There is even a lovely garden where you could enjoy sunshine.
The location is convenient as well, really, just 2 mins walk from the station. There are many nice bars, restaurants and a big Sainsbury around.
The Camden market is quite famous and busy as well. Worth taking a look.
I strongly recommend it to all, Aj and his lovely modern places are smart choices if you want to enjoy London with such a reasonable price.
Great location, with fantastic views over almost all of London from the attic room. Richard was very welcoming and accommodating, thanks for everything!

it was my first experience with Airbnb and I am satisfied.
As we arrived, Tess greeted us with a smile - obviously, she has all the time!
The apartment is warm, comfortable, clean, new.
it is very functional.
2 spacious bedrooms, one is very large.
the living room is extended by a veranda: TOP.
Kitchen facilities are recent.
A minor annoyance: the proximity of the railway line.

The place is very convenient for visiting London overground, underground, buses, Whose night nozzles).
supermarkets and all shops.
The area is very quiet
I recommend!
Thierry

I Booked this house for my brother and his family and everything was great.
Asa and Howard were very helpful and friendly ... even when we had a little trouble with the washing machine ;-)
It was really brilliant having my brother stay around the block from in a beautiful house instead of in some generic hotel.
The room is liko on the pictures. Tidy and enough space for luggage. Her mother was also helpful when I got questions

The apartment was great! Very comfortable, cosy, with lots if unusual and quirky things around to make it a bit more interesting than your typical London flat. Bert was very friendly and accommodating too.
The room was clean and comfortable. The host was friendly and accommodating. Use of small kitchen area including fridge and microwave was a welcome bonus!

The flat was small but compact, very bright and central. The underground is very close and there are a great network of buses nearby at the Surrey Dock shopping centre. It is a place I would stay in again.

Sophie's flat is bright, spacious and modern. Ideally located between Camden Town and Islington, one has access to a wide range of activities, restaurants and transportation options. If you are looking for a chance to explore the London that locals live, this is your spot.

Had a brilliant weekend in Tim's apartment. Lovely bright apartment with and classy neutral colour scheme throughout right in the middle of Camden Town.  Great location for getting around on the Northern Line and the walk/jog along the canal in either direction to Regents Park one way and Kings Cross in the other direction made it a perfect place to start the day.  After a day of shopping/sightseeing coming back to the apartment for a gorgeous shower and then wine on the balcony was just perfect.  It was an added bonus being able to park the car securely as well. Thanks Tim

Greenwich is a great place to see London but feel relaxed. Richards home is very handy for all forms of transport and the attic room has charm and a very comfortable sofa bed. We enjoyed our short time there. Thank you Richard.

Marco communicated well by txt/airbnb and gave us adequate instructions for access and use of his apartment. He responded promptly to any concerns or questions. He was flexible and obliging with regard to check-out time.
The apartment is small but light and bright with good availability of wardrobe/drawer space and of fridge and pantry space. It is well-equipped for self-catering.
The location is very convenient for overground/underground and buses.
The outlook onto Southwark Park is very pleasant, and the bedroom is quiet. The area felt safe.
The steep stairs are something of a challenge for older folk (ourselves!) and the steps within the apartment often caught us out.
Over-all, a good experience and value for money. Recommended.
Ian and Janet

This apartment was lovely. It was immaculate throughout. It is light, bright and airy and was a very pleasant place to stay. The location is excellent, close to a number of train and tube stations and very close to the main road to easily hail a cab. Tim was friendly and helpful throughout all communications. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting London.

Richard was polite and friendly when I arrived and the room was clean and as pictured. It doesn't have a door which is a little strange and may make some feel uncomfortable.
The kitchen and bathroom were not particularly clean and the lounge off limits, meaning if you want a cup of tea you have to sit in the kitchen to drink it.
I didn't see much of Richard as he disappeared into the lounge and closed the door shortly after I arrived but he did say I could knock if I needed anything.
I only stayed one night here but the accommodation was clean spacious  and easy to find. Urszula was very helpful and friendly.

Marco provided clear information on how to get to the flat and how to use everything.
He also responded quickly to any questions I had during my stay.
The flat was exactly as advertised. Very clean and tidy and all the facilities that I needed.
Location was good. I was working in Canary Wharf and the flat is less than 10 minutes walk from Canada Water tube station. Tesco supermarket just around the corner.

An excellent experience.  The flat is in a perfect location, with great shops and restaurants and easy access to the Notting Hill Gate tube stop.  It was a perfect retreat at the end of the day, and great to have a washer and drier on vacation.  The wireless Internet access was a lifesaver as one of our devices turned out not to be configurable for the UK.  The flat is bright and tidy, and all as decribed by Simon, who was very eager to ensure that we were well situated when we arrived.

Bert was a brilliant host, even with a couple of hiccups on my side she was understanding and helpful. Her apartment is something special. It's perfectly located just a stones throw away from broadway market and has loads of interesting shops/cafes nearby. The apartment itself was great too, full of quirky oddities and loads of personality, a place you can easily feel at home. Would definitely recommend this flat for anyone who wants a chance to see the creative side of london properly.

I transferred a guest as my apartment had some leakage trouble which later went on to disturb the electrics. She welcomed our guest with much grace and patience. A lovely comfortable home. Just what it said on the tin

Monique went above and beyond her call of duty re.Hosting
I myself also host via airbnb & suffered maintenance issues which
prolonged welcoming a guest to London.
After much tiresome searching and emails i fell upon Monique
whom agreed with the kindness of her heart to accommodate my
guest under rather complicated circumstances.

A true delight and everything was as advertised. My - Now her guest is truly comfortable and contented with their accommodation.

I highly recommend this host for your stay in London.
David was a very nice person, the house was fairly new and clean,everything was in good condition. my family had a great time there.

Eliana is more than just your host. She will be your mom away from home. She's really quick on feedback and can really help you find your way around the city. Location has a nice quiet neighborhood and even though it's not city center you can easily get a bus there (runs 24/7).
Rooms and the house are really cosy. Thank you for everything Eliana!

Wonderful staying in Marco s apartment, the house is very comfy and clean. Is very close to the tube station and is perfect for a short or long rent. Marco is been very helpful before and during our staying. What can I say more ... 5star plus

!!! Very nice, clean and cosy place in the right location !!!
I can only recommend Marco's apartment for short or longer stay.
Marco was very helpful.

Tim was an excellent communicator and host - we received concise and timely instructions about our home away from home and the apartment was clean and bright, with plenty of lovely linen and modern appliances. We were handy to transport and found it easy to find our way around London, thanks to plenty of brochures and information supplied.

Great experience! I had the chance to meet interesting and friendly people here. Flora has been so kind to welcome me in, and Eliana is truly helpful and caring, she's a great host! The room is spacious, bright with a comfortable bed. The house is well located in a quiet and fascinating street intersecting with Chatsworth Road, which is full of local stores, independent coffe shops, restaurants and other inspiring places, plus a local market on Sunday where you can find genuine and organic food. It’s a lovely area, well connected with busses, five minutes distance from Homerton Station.
Everything was chilling and relaxing in the house and it was really nice bumping into flatmates now and then and have a chat
I’d like to mention that Eliana has accepted my last minute request without any sort of issue, and the communication has run smoothly. Definitely highly recommended, especially for young, curious-minded travellers.

Tess made us feel as it was our home,
Flat it's amazing we wish to stay but longer.
I would highly recommend this to anyone,!
Thanks you for everything

Stayed at this lovely apartment for a week. And here are my reviews: 1. Marco is really kind. And he replied my email very quickly. 2. House location is very convenient.  10 sec walk to the overground station and only take 1 min to change to underground. 15 to 20 mins to many famous places. 3. The house is kind of at third floor, it's s little bit hard to move the big luggage case.  Overall, the house worth the price. Already miss this apartment and london. Lol

We stayed for five days in this brilliant apartment, so handy for Islington's great restaurants and the Angel tube station. Very roomy and private location in a quiet residential neighbourhood - a lot more peaceful than many top hotels purport to be! The apartment was clean and had everything that we could have wished for - David is a very caring and meticulous host who met us when we arrived, making us feel comfortable and welcome.
Highly recommended.

The description of the apartment on Airbnb website is complete and clear, full of information and pictures of each room. Additionally, Tess has been very helpful and proactive since we booked the flat, answering all my questions and doubts.
Unfortunately we couldn't meed her when we got there, but she put us in contact with a friend of her who waited for us to explain all the details of our stay. Furthermore, Tess has always been in contact with us, just to make sure everthing was ok and we've also been given a 'book' with lots of information on the house and surroundings.

Tess appartment is really great, is exactly as in the pictures, very nice, clean and organized. We found everything - ´everything´ what we need and even more. However, we never met Tess, which is fact is really not relevant. Until the moment that you need help, which happened, when we had an electricity problem, and was really tough to find answers on time. We made lots of calls. Finaly problem was solved and the rest was really great. Even Tess helped us to book taxi to go to airport.
So the balance is positive.

Tim had great communication and direction to let ourselves into the flat which we appreciated. The area of Camden is a gritting London neighbourhood which is what we wanted. The Market which is a 5 minute walk is on daily and you could really spend hours there. We felt safe with our two kids there and walking to and from the tube was easy. Having the large grocery store right on the way was also handy.
Nice and very frindly flat, exactly as showned on picture, nothing missed. Placed on a peachfull road within few meters from underground and restaurants and food stores.

Nice location near Battersea park, very quiet en friendly neighbourhood with some good restaurants and Italian breakfast. Easy to reach Victoria Station and the centre of London. My son and I felt very comfortable at Anne’s house. A nice place with a lot of books and two dogs… She is very friendly and helpful. We had a wonderful time.

My entire experience with Isabelle was phenomenal! Her flat was clean, beautifully decorated and spacious. Fulham was a great neighborhood (safe and easy to get around). I really appreciated having our own bathroom and living room, as well as getting breakfast each morning. Isabelle was very informative, offered great food and bar suggestions, and even showed me around the neighborhood. The best airbnb experience I have had. Highly recommended!

I missed David around to some extent about my arrival time but he was accommodating in that respect. The apartment was just as described and the neighbourhood was surprisingly quiet given it was in the middle of Islington

I was made very welcome at this address and the room was just as expected, with the added bonus of the bed been very comfortable.
The location of the accommodation made it very easy to find from central London as it was just a case of more or less following the Thames.

The twin room was exactly as pictured, very comfortable and plenty spacious enough for two people.
Anne was very welcoming, even meeting us in South Kensington to share a taxi to Battersea as she was out the evening we arrived.
The neighbourhood was lovely and quiet and we managed a lie in until after 10am.
Anne was very hospitable and allowed us use of the kitchen in the morning to toast a couple of bagels which was great for us.
All in all a lovely place to stay, 2-3 mins walk from picturesque Battersea Park. We also walked to Sloane Square tube in the morning which took around 40 mins, so not too far if you are not in a rush. Buses do run right by the house though.
I'd definately consider returning to stay with Anne and her cute doggies :)

We enjoyed very much our 3 night stay in Jennie's place where we instantly felt at home: the apartment is nicely decorated, bright, spacious and very quiet while being close to the underground and supermarkets just down the road. Interesting books and even a playful enormous pilates balloon kept both adults and children entertained. All of us had very comfy beds and enjoyed the open-plan kitchen well equipped to cook and where we found some food items (bread, cereals, olive oil, milk) very useful for our 1st meals. Thanks Jennie for making our London stay such a success with your cozy flat.

Our stay was just perfect, a home from home and thanks to Anne who made us feel very welcomed! The location was convenient for trips to Knightsbridge and Central London with bus routes near by. Anne thoughtfully provided us with directions and bus numbers.  The area is quiet and very pleasant to walk around, though sadly, we didn't have time to explore Battersea Park at the end of the road-next time!

This was my first Airbnb experience and I thought it was great. Thanks to Anne for being a very lovely host. The room was great and was just as I had expected from the listings. Anne was helpful with travel info to get to her place, the room was good, the bed was comfy. I felt safe and secure and my trip was good. I also loved meeting Forest the Dog. Thanks Anne : )

Perfect welcome by Aj, just as described by previous visitors. The room is fine, nice bathroom, use of kitchen if needed and above all; the location right in the heart of Camden town is so very nice. Aj was there to welcome us, even though we arrived very late. Good host and very nice place to stay and enjoy London!!

A great experience staying with Eliana. She was extremely welcoming and offers to help with everything she can, and communication before my arrival (and after) was easy.
The room is a very good size, nicely-lit, clean and comfortable, and the house is well equipped and arranged for visitors' needs. I worked from "home" during office hours on weekdays of my stay and it was quiet and convenient. The two cats are adorable, but won't bother you at all if you don't want them "around".
The neighbourhood is lovely - residential, settled and well-connected with buses to other parts of London. The house is also walking distance to the Hackney Overground stations if you prefer. Also near parks/canal and shops for an exceptional stay.
Lovely big room in lovely big house on a really nice street. Great price, comfortable bed. Can't recommend more

Why to invest tones of dollars in 5 stars hotels while you can get same service even more at marco's property ? Marco was helpful, supportive and give you the feeling that you are home! the location is amazing, the apartment is clean, comfort and beyond expectations, i would recommend it for any other couple, i spent an amazing week with my wife many thanks marco :)

Great apartment with everything you need inside and Robin is a relaxed superhost. He responds very quickly and has gathered some nice tips for the area and London. We took our folding bikes on the train and from St Pancras station it's a 10-15 minutes biketour. For us it was a great spot from where we've explored London.

Anne gave me good instructions as to getting to her home.
The room was well set up and she explained everything very well

Isabelle made us feel very welcome and so kind and helpful with any questions we had.
A lovely clean and spacious and quiet apartment in a very nice area.
Very close to shops, underground and buses.
We would definitely return and very highly recommend Isabelle.She is a lovely person and we thank you for your hospitality.Catherine.

Aj was a good host. It was a nice room at a great location. The room was exactly as mentioned in the description. We stayed at his place with 3 persons, the extra matress was also fine and there remained enough space to walk.
One evening he sent a text message that he would be home late because of a late incheck somewhere else. It was nice that he told this on beforehand, however we did not hear him when he came home :)

Both Jennie and her flat were fantastic!  She met us at the coffee shop within just a few minutes of our arrival, and she was very responsive to texts and questions.  Her flat was very conveniently located and super bright and cheery.  Jennie also left us with some staples like milk, bread, and coffee, as well as a bottle of wine, which was a wonderful surprise.  We loved all the fun Royal Family decor and books, and her Best Pubs of England book led us to Blackfriars Pub, which we loved.  We were very comfortable and happy at her flat and can't recommend it highly enough!  :)

The flat was great, and was as described with all the amenities required, Robin was friendly and helpful, and provides a very high standard of hosting, whilst being unobtrusive, I would definitely stay here again.
Stayed there the second time. It's a very comfortable cosy appartment. I enjoyed my stay very much. Marco is making sure at all time that all works fine.

I had a great stay here- the room was comfortable and it was very handy having a fridge and sink in the room! My host was very friendly and helpful. The area is great, very close to the tube station which was convenient, there is also a public park and Westfield right around the corner. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Isabelle's place is very agreable and clean. Fulham Broadway is a great neighborhood, with gastropubs and fine shops in pedestrian streets, which she has shown us around. Excellent transport connections to Central London.
Isabelle is an amazing host, very helpful and friendly. She offered us delicious season berries and home made marmelade for breakfast! We went together to North End Road Market, where she introduced us to the best falafels ever!
Comfortable bed and soft sheets, bedroom a bit on the small size, but all together a very pleasant experience. Thanks, Isabelle! Marcia & Seldon

Truly an excellent experience with an excellent hostess manager. Location is great to be close to everything and feel more local away from all of the tourism. Nice local pubs and great shopping nearby. Hope there is reason to come back to London and stay at Julia's place again!

Wonderful experience. The flat is big (basically two separate studios), immaculate, bright and confortable. The location is simply perfect and David is a very professional, responsive and nice host. Thanks again for everything. I hope I'll have another opportunity to stay at David's place.

Our second airbnb experience was truly outstanding.  This is a superb garden flat, so clean modern and convenient.  Everything was catered for and Tess was in constant contact when we had silly little questions.  Located between two key train and underground stations and pubs at each end of the lovely tree-lined street.  Supermarkets, Starbucks, artisan bakery all so close and easy.  I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again if in London.

The apartment was really nice. Comfortable, clean and quiet. The neighbourhood is residential, nice if you want to relax, only 1 block from Thames riverside. It's not very near from the underground. It's takes some time to go to central London, mostly at night. If you want to go to pubs, theatre and nightlife in general it's not the correct place. Nice to go with family and relax

AJ is a very nice host : he guided us around, he gave us a nice place to eat and advised us about transport in London.
He cares about his guets feeling welcome and confortable.
The room was very nice and cosy, clean, modern and well equiped (hair dryer, electric adaptator, WiFi, towels, ...).
The location is very central, with close tube and buses station.
Thanks again AJ!

It was a perfect week. The flat is really beautiful and so comfortable the garden is a wonderful addition. The location of the flat was perfect for our Wembley concert and trip to Harry Potter studio. The flat had everything we needed and was a real home from home. The area was great between Queens Park and Kilburn High road. Nice pubs and shops nearby. Wonderful experience thanks you Tess.

It has been an enjoyable stay in Tess's house. It is a very different experience to live in a British house than the high rise at home. My children were very excited about it.

Tess and her friend are very helpful and their house has everything that is needed. It is the same as what it looked in the picture. Tess is very organised with her full operation manual of the house clearly explained everything.

Last, thanks for arranging the taxi for us when we leave.

Simon always make me feel welcome even when he is not there and unable to greet me.....I cannot say enough nice things about this apartment it is the best value for money in the most amazing location, Im pretty picky about where I stay, and this is very comfortable, well appointed, great living space, really nice bathroom, and very comfortable bedroom.

Marco was a very helpful host during the course of our stay and responded to us immediately if we had any concerns. The place was also located in a nice and quiet area with an easy access to public transport.
It was easy to communicate with Sian. The location of the flat is great, very near the tube station. Would recommend.

Staying with Julia was a real treat.  The house was very quiet and secure (only a 2-3 walk from the tube station, which was easy to access the rest of London.)  The room itself was extremely cozy with clean linens, fluffy towels, and plenty of amenities (separate fridge in each room, hairdryer, washer/dryer, iron, fan, etc. ) Everything was so clean and simple, I will absolutely stay here again!  Thank you Julia!

My stay at Richard's house was very enjoyable. The room was very comfortable and looked like on the pictures. House is located just couple of minutes away from the train station and buss stops. Richard was really helpful and kind. I would definitely recommend his house and I am pretty sure I will come back there next time I'll be in London.

As everyone else has written Simon's flat is superb! We spent a wonderful week and found the flat to be extremely comfortable and spacious. The kitchen was fully equipped and we were able to cook some great meals. The bathroom is extremely modern with an excellent shower. The bedroom is comfy with plenty of storage space.
The flat is very quiet and was an oasis of calm to come back to in the evening after long days that were spent exploring busy London. We would love to return.

Friendly, happy, welcoming lady with a lovely room! :)  I was in and out most of the time but never felt unwelcome. Bumped into a couple of others sharing the house too who were lovely, respectful and quiet! Nice place! Thanks Eliana!

Isabelle was an absolute delight to stay with.  She was there to welcome me from my long trip with a cup of tea and made sure I had settled in okay.  She had lots of useful information about where to go and how to get there etc. I felt I was staying more with a friend than with a host.  The rooms were very comfortable, especially the bed and Isabelle was quite relaxed about me using the kitchen and dining room.  Fulham Broadway is a very lively area of London with lots of shops, restaurants and decent coffee places, close to Central London in the tube.  Her house is a short walk from the tube station, but is in a quiet street.  I highly recommend Isabelle's place as somewhere to stay in London

The room was ideal... light filled and clean with plenty of good books to read.  The shower was excellent.  The two dogs were friendly but silent the entire time.  Anne was extremely kind and helpful with directions.  I'd definitely recommend this listing to anyone.

Jennie was out of town when we arrived, but arranged a friend of hers to meet us and give us the keys. The communication with Jennie (and Paul, who met us with the keys to her apartment) was easy and uncomplicated.

The apartment is just as it looks in the pictures, it's very lovely and perfectly located to get into the city centre in a short time. It's clean and bright and Jennie even provided a few things (bread, milk, etc) for us, which was very nice!

Also Jennie left us a letter with lots of information. We tried out one of the recommended pubs, which had great food and a wonderful atmosphere.

All in all a perfect airbnb-experience! A big thanks to Jennie (and Paul :)

Marc made sure we had all the information we needed to make sure our check in and check out process went smoothly. The apartment is just as pictured- clean, simple, and lovely. There are restaurants, bars, a supermarket, and transit nearby. Our stay here was great and we would be happy to visit here again!

Everything worked out great for our stay - way better than staying in a hotel. The flat was very comfortable for the 3 people we had. We loved the kitchen and the extended dining area with the extensive windows. These windows gave it a great open feel and looked out onto the grassy backyard. While the trains were running in back, they did not interrupt us nor could they be heard while sleeping. Flat was a short 7-10 minute walk to the tube station and we were able to get around London easily. We will be recommending this to our friends if and when they go to London.
the apartment is great, we have everything that we need, traveling whit two children s, great location, to repeat! :-)

Richard was warm and welcoming and the room and facilities were perfectly clean and comfortable.  The location and the view are amazing - you can see all of London's landmarks from the window - but at night it's quiet and calm.  We had a delicious breakfast nearby (thanks to Richard's recommendations!) and explored Greenwich and Blackheath which are right on the doorstep.  This was our first airbnb experience and we were very pleased with it - we'd be very happy to come back!

It was a wonderful stay at Isabell's flat: a perfect place to start your tour at London and to relax after after a long day - it was like coming home. Isabelle is a very friendly person, attentive to our needs and she makes you feel to be welcome. The rooms are very comfortable and artfully furnished. Supermarket, bus, tube, pubs - everything is nearby.
We would definitely come back to Isabelle and we can recommend this place to everybody!

Communication with Olga was good and the apartment is like in the pictures. Location is great. Just 5 minute walk from West Kensington Tube with shops, restaurants, a pub and Tesco express juts minutes away.

Olga was friendly and also invited me to go with her to a huge park she frequents which was full of deer and a nice gesture from her.

The apartment was clean and a good spot for a short stay in London.

I stayed 2 days at Monique flat. We met at Victoria on time and Monique gave me the key. She also provide me with the precise description of the way to her home.
I had a nice spacious bed. Everything was clean.
When I was leaving she gave me the lift to the station.
It was very lovely, thanks again!

David's apartment corresponded exactly to the description. It is very clean and perfectly equipped suitable for a 2/3 people. The surroundings are very calm and within a 5-minute walk nice cafes and restaurants are to be reached. David is a very nice host and tries his best to make you feel good in his apartment. I would definitely go there again.

Tim's apartment is in a great spot for exploring London with access to the overground train, give and several buses.   Tim's instructions for accessing the apartment were also very helpful. Def recommend. Thanks Tim.
The flat is really nice and comfortable! And it is really close to the tube station! You have everything to enjoy your visit! Thank you very much Marc.

Richard was very welcoming. He is extremely helpful with any information you may need. The room was perfect for my needs. Private and comfortable with great views of the city. Greenwich is a fantastic part of the city and somewhere a little more interesting to stay. Plenty of good restaurants and pubs nearby. There is also easy transport links for getting into central london.

Had a lovely weekend in Nina's home while visiting London after a conference in Belfast. Her home was spacious, clean and cozy. Close to transit and on a quiet neighbourhood street, her place was a perfect home-base for our weekend in the city.

Nina was flexible with our late arrival, making arrangements for keys to be available for us without a fuss. She also made sure to check in with us once we arrived to ensure that we had everything that we needed.

Would definitely recommend a stay at Nina's.
Rania was an excellent host who went above and beyond to make sure our stay was successful...great experience...highly recommended...thank you Rania.

James really respond quickly when my last booking was cancelled by the other host.
As the first guest here, I can sure that the place is brand new and just like the picture, everything inside is brand new as well.
Location is 1 minute walk to the tube. James works upstairs so he will taking care of anything conveniently.
He is also flexible about check in check out time.
A place you don't want to miss.

Absolutely fantastic experience. Nikki and Stew both seem like wonderful people...inviting me into their main home when my schedule placed me in town a bit earlier than they'd expected. Stew made a delicious cup of coffee and we exchanged great talk of rugby.  The flat was very clean, the bed was quite cosy, and it was quite a large space.  I plan to stay with them again this spring for Six Nations!  Thanks to you both!

A wonderful I had an amazing weekend in London while staying here. The room was very comfortable and the apartment is in a great neighborhood. Getting into the city to see all the sights was no problem at all. Anne was a perfect host and was very helpful with advice on how to see everything I wanted to see in London.

Isabella's flat was really beautiful. Everything in her flat were so lovely! And Isabella also was very nice and friendly - she gave me good advice for sightseeing and prepared breakfast for me. The bedroom and bathroom were quite clean and had everything I need. It was a nice stay with Isabella. Definitely recommended! Thank you Isabella. Best wishes! :-)
I had a lovely time at Anne's house. The room was clean and spacious and very quiet. I really enjoyed my stay and Anne was very helpful with any questions I had.

Tina is very friendly and good host. The room is very clean and location is one of my favourite in London.

Thank you Tina!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The photos and descriptions of the unit are . accurate and Tess was constantly in contact. This is a great location as the tube is only an 8 minwalk away and you are on the Bakerloo line so heading into barious parts of the city is very easy.

My mother, friend and I stayed at Tess' beautiful flat during our week stay in London. We could not have asked for a better location or a better home to come back to after busy days in London. It was all so wonderfully decorated, supplied and comfortable. Tess was unfortunately away on business abroad but was so helpful and easy to speak to that it felt as if she were there. I would highly recommend her flat to anyone looking for a home away from home while in the city.

I stayed at Tina's place for 1 night and even though it was a short period of time she really made me feel like I am home. She is very nice and friendly. I literally felt like staying at a friend's apartment! Her apartment was really clean and the room is big and comfortable. And the location of the apartment is superb!

Tracy was great! Extremely
Responsieve and helpful throughout the booking prices. The flat is lovely, and conveniently located close to the subway, from which can you can easily reach all attractions in London. Would highly recommend staying at this place!

Justin is a perfect host, as well as having a fabulous home also came to meet our needs, recommended. Flat is located in a great area and romantic, metro and bus stops are very close as portobello road, what to add? Go there and you will not regret

This apartment was a real find. It is stunningly presented and has all the conveniences you would need for a stay. The garden looked lovely, but the weather in November sadly made it redundant for us, but we can only imagine what it would be like in summer - a real haven I suspect! The apartment itself is well located in North West London and is 5 minutes from two Tube stations and one Overground Station and there are numerous buses routes available to get you to where you need to be in London. There is a wealth of local shops and pubs (can highly recommend The Salusbury, for Sunday lunch) as well. Tess, the host was n absolute pleasure to deal with and we would not hesitate staying here again!

My family and I had a great stay at Tim's lovely apartment. We stayed for a week and this was an excellent place to base our visit to London. It's close to the underground and overground rail, and the apartment itself was warm, clean, secure and quiet. Tim was extremely helpful both before, and during, our stay. I'd highly recommend this apartment to other travellers.

Tina his nice and welcoming, had a few chat with her, very kind. House was clean and as posted. Location it's perfect for visiting downtown and very safe.
Definetly a place i would suggest for a stay.

Isabel was a great host and made us very welcome. The quality of the accommodation was great value for money, and we could not have asked for a better location. The tube and buses were easily accessible and very convenient. Isabel was extremely helpful in providing advice on things to do and how to get there. It was great there were no steps which can be a hassle with luggage when you are traveling. I would definitely recommend Isabel to others.

Anne has been very welcoming and available, making my stay at her place, although just for one night, smooth and pleasant. The room is nice and comfortable, exactly how is looking in the pictures and all the house is cozy, located in a beautiful area of south London, pretty close the center. I recommend Anne house to anybody needing a good accommodation in London for a quite covenient price.

Samir and his wife rented me their room for one night in the last minute ( i arrived two hours after i was talking to them for the first time via airbnb). It is a very comfortable and quiet room. They were very friendly and they made me feel at home from the moment i entered their house.
Thank you very much!
We very much enjoyed staying at Robin’s flat. It’s spacious, clean, and very close to the city centre. There is really nothing bad we can say about it and we would definitely stay there again!

Richard is very kind and helpful. The room is really cosy. For us, the location was ideal: close to Greenwich park and away from the busy city. As Richard's house is located on the top of the hill you had amazing views over Canary Wharf and London city from the attic window.

Tess was a wonderful and friendly host and also very accommodating. She met us at the flat and explained all the details to us. The flat was beautifully styled, giving off such a calming feeling - lovely to have somewhere to relax in the middle of London! We loved the huge bath and the beds were gloriously comfortable :) The place was well equipped with everything you would need. The backyard was huge and would be tremendous in the summer (lovely to look at in the winter). I couldn't recommended this place highly enough to anyone wishing to stay in London. One of the best Airbnb's we've stayed in. Good connections around the city and quick walk to tube stations. Wish we could have stayed longer - thanks Tess!

Fantastic place to stay in a great location. Easy access to Twickenham station for the fast train to Waterloo in Central London. The flat is in a lovely quiet suburb. Nikki and Stew were absolutely amazing hosts. They accommodated our extra long booking and sorted out some details with Airbnb for us, as well as arranging a comfy couch! I think one of the best aspects of the flat is that it feels like a home, not like a hotel room. You can really relax and unwind when you get in from work or trekking around London.

We've already booked to stay again over the new year!
Excellent location only minutes from the closest tube.  The apartment is very nice and exactly like the photos.  Woud stay again!
It was lovely to return to the clean and tidy flat after a chaotic Christmas!! Thanks very much, we would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone!

The place is nice and convenient, good for a small family. I had a good time but all got spoiled in the end with a dispute arising. The matter has been referred to the resolution centre. Please be careful and always ask for close pictures of all the furniture otherwise might end up in dispute.

Federica was nice enough to meet us at her place and show us around. She is very quick to respond and is a very easy person to speak with. She has a great flat with a balcony. We would definitely visit again, it was a pleasant stay. Thank you

Dear Justin we sent you a sms to thank you for our stay in your flat. We hope that you received it.
Anyway you have be really plesent and helpfull when you welcomed us on our check in. The flat is really well furnished and nicely decorated. Notting Hill is a really good place to stay and so close from center of london.
We would be definitely interested to book again next time we will be back in london.
We thank you again and wish you the best for 2016. Happy new year to you and all your family.
Best regards
Frederique and Vincent

Everything was perfect. The apartment was as advertised, no surprises at all and we were very confortable there. Very good communication with Jennie, she kindly answered all our questions and requests, like late check in, she even left some food for us. The flat is very well situated, with tube station and bus stops very close. Several supermarkets within  5 minutes walk. The area seems safe and secure. I would recommend Jennie´s flat without hesitation. Thanks Jennie!
VanZyl was kind and helpful, even when I had some trouble with communicating on the day of my check-in. The space was just as gorgeous as the photos and had all the essentials. Would stay here again.

We are a family of 5 and found Tess' apartment very comfortable. The kitchen and light filled living space are a very high standard. Tess is a wonderful host and very helpful with anything we needed. The neighbourhood is good with public transport very easy to use.
As a returning customer, I once again had a wonderful nights sleep at Anne's place.. Would definitely recommend.

Anne was such a delightful host! As soon as I arrived I was welcomed graciously into her cosy home along with the friendly canines. There was a complimentary kettle for tea and coffee laid out ready in the room - life saver!
Location was very convenient into the city for work. I will definitely stay again.

Tess was a great host.  Replies to our emails where always prompt and she was always accessible by phone.  Tess was at the flat when we arrived to welcome us and show us around. She was very efficient when we asked her to organise an airport transfer for us. The kitchen was very well equipped.  The flat was just as expected, even down to the vase of white roses on the kitchen bench.  We particularly appreciated the nice size shower with good water pressure and enough hot water for our family of 5. The atrium and view of the garden provided a very pleasant and relaxing experience. Queens Park station is 10 minute walk away along a quiet suburban street.  We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

Anne is such a lovely host! Her home is warm and cosy, particularly the bedroom with two single beds. It's perfect for one or two people and was especially convenient for me from a work perspective as it had a desk. It also has a sitting chair, which was perfect for my evening reading. I'll definitely look up Anne's place again when I'm next in London.

Fantastic property, exactly as described. We found it very clean and comfortable, ideally situated for a short underground ride into town.  Couldn't of asked for a more helpful host, check-in and checkout were simple and Tess was very flexible.
Lovely room in a beautiful flat. Made to feel very welcome by an amazingly hospitable and helpful host. I've already booked to return :)
Very modern and comfortable flat. Perfect if you work in Canary Wharf area. There is a big park just in front of the house very handy if you are in to running.

I only saw Tina at check in as I was out most of the time, but she had bought milk especially for me and provided shampoo and other essentials. Communication was good. The room was as described, quiet and clean and warm. It's also in a great location, 2 minutes from Notting Hill Gate tube.  I would stay here again.

Tina was fabulous with setting up my stay on short notice. She was extremely welcoming, and handed a helping hand whenever it was needed. Her place is right next to Notting hill gate, which is a great subway stop if you're looking to sightsee your way through central London. The bedroom was clean and comfortable, and the washroom was fabulous. Thanks Tina!

The apartment was close to the Marylebone Station and therefore quite accessible to visit most attractions in London. The place is more or less as seen on the pictures. It is a quite small apartment and good for a young family for a stay of couple of days. One down side is that since it is on the 3rd floor, carrying your luggage up three flights of stairs with narrow access can be quite challenging.

Richard was a really good host, he welcomed us well and explained to us all the things that we needed to know to visit the district. He also offered us help to get to know the best places to visit around. Richard recommended us a fabulous place to have breakfast where we had a delicious smoothie, milkshake and a full English breakfast. The room also was as you can see in the picture, the bed was comfortable and the views from the room were amazing. Really nice to sleep in Richards house.

Sophie was very accommodating and was readily available should we have queries / questions.

The flat is as per the description, it's very quiet and close to central. We really enjoyed our stay at Sophie's flat and would definitely recommend it.

I really enjoyed my stay at AJs appartement! It really is 2 minutes away from camden station and the camden market. The room was very clean and AJ was always helpful when I had any questions. I defenetly would book it again!

Staying at tina's was great. She is a very good host, attentive and helpful.
Her place was better than described and perfect for location.
The room was clean and cosy and i had access to everything i needed.
I would reccomend anyone to stay at tina's, i will definitly be returning when im next in London. 10/10

Anne is a lovely person and very welcoming. A vase with some fresh flowers standed on the desk. I recommend this place where you feel like at home and close to the center of London by tube and by bus. Bedding  is very comftable. I definitly will return.

The apartment was wonderful! Clean, quiet and convenient. While we had a bit of trouble with the key box at first, everything went smoothly during our stay. The place is located only five minutes walk from the Jubilee line and two stops from London Bridge. There is also a bus station two minutes walk and a huge grocery store around the corner. I highly recommend staying here.

I felt at home at Anne's place. Her two dogs are also very friendly and lovely to hang out with. Anne did me a huge favour when something unexpected occurred during my stay and was very understanding. There are buses running 24/7 around the area so transportation really wasn't that much of a deal to me. I felt safe in the area as a solo female traveler. Would definitely stay at Anne's place if I had the opportunity to visit London again. 5 stars!
Hi, I have been staying at Tina's place several times already. She's been always welcoming as the first day. I will certainly come back.

Isabelle's home is lovely!!  She was so easy to get in touch with and she was ready for us upon our arrival.  Her maps, tour books, as well as the information she shared with us regarding taking the bus and the tube were invaluable as it was my husbands first time in Europe and I hadn't been since I was a child.  Isabelle even walked us to the bus stop in the rain to be sure we knew where to go!  Her warmth and kindness continued with a wonderful homemade breakfast the next morning, including homemade jam (I told her it is good enough to sell...yum!).  We highly recommend her lovely home!
Had a great stay, Beautiful place making great use of limited space, cosy and very inviting - high end throughout.

Sandra's home is exactly what we had hoped and expected!  So warm and welcoming and the perfect spot to unwind after a busy touring day of bustling London.  The short walk to the E3 bus and short ride to the Turnham Green Station were ideal and Chiswick had many delightful places to eat before turning in for the evening.  Could not have booked a more ideal home for our week in the UK!

Aj is a very friendly and helpful person, he made us feel welcome in his house. The bedroom was big, really nice and clean, thinks like towels and hairdryer provided. I would absolutely book his room again =) thanks Aj

Ideal experience. Richard welcomed me into their home for one night. It was just as described on the site and was comfortable and with great views of Canary Wharf. 10 minutes stroll into Greenwhich market. I had a lovely, if brief, stay.
Tina was a great host, very friendly and patient. Her room is clean and very pleasant! I recommend it without hesitation

Lovely little apartment! Very modern, clean, with all the comforts needed for a superb stay! Excellent location, in a very quiet neighborhood, very close to the overground or to Jubilee line subway.  Marc is a great host, prompt to respond. Will definitely return.

Fantastic location in Notting Hill, close to shops, restaurants, and the tube! The flat was spacious and clean with a well equipped kitchen. The washer and dryer worked great. Unfortunately, the heater was broken when we arrived but Simon worked diligently to schedule repairs that wouldn't inconvenience us. Also, the windows in the bathroom were at an awkward angle and left us feeling a bit exposed. Overall, we would definitely stay here again!

For us, this Airbnb experience was sub-standard. Compared to others, and we've been to many, the place was not clean enough and the furnishings were very basic. The building itself is nicely built. The neighborhood is sketchy with some nice spots. I always took a cab home late at night. However, it is centrally located. Like I said, this is our own personal experience.
The perfect stay in London for work! David was a great host and the flat was clean and welcoming for our arrival.  We will definitely stay again when in the area!
Great place! First time with airbnb but definitely a success. Much better than a hotel.

This was my first experience with Airbnb and it was delightful. Anne was a great host.She lent me her London map and was able to tell me about the closest buses and tube stations. I found the location very central and had no difficulty getting around. I recommend Gail's restaurant for breakfast. Yum. My daughter and I enjoyed playing with the dogs. I would definitely stay again.
AJ's place is super. I had a very good stay there, he was very nice and helpful with everything. Would come back any time to stay here. Thanks so much!

My daughters and a friend stayed here 3 nights while on a trip visiting many cities in the UK and Europe. They loved this apartment. It was very clean and just as photos show. They loved the neighborhood. Lots of great places to eat and very centrally located.

What a lovely place to stay. Great location!!! I have short legs and it was only 20 mins to the station. Stew was so friendly always there to help! Definitely stay again and would highly recommend!! Thanks Nikki and Stew!!!!

Isabelle is lovely and the room is great! Breakfast every day is a wonderful treat, we used it as a chance to pick her brain about what to do in London for the day... while eating her delicious home-made jams! The front room is beautiful, the location is an 8 minute walk from the tube station. Great neighborhood with lots of good restaurants and bars. Would happily stay here again! Thanks to Isabelle and Darcy (the adorable cat!) for a great stay!

Absolutely perfect location for exploring London.  Quiet neighborhood with wonderful restaurants very close and easy access to transportation into central London for all of the tourist stuff.  We had a great time!

Sian is a great host and the nice and superclean apartment that is located in a quiet neighborhood with Marylebone Station just 2 min away by foot is ideally to reach all London attractions within a short period of time.
Grocery store and restaurants are nearby as well and the apartment is fully equipped with all amenities that you need.
Very special thanks again to Sian for giving us the opportunity to store our belongings in the apartment on our departure day until the evening which allowed us to have a full day in London and Windsor without having to care about the luggage.
We would definitively stay here again on our next visit to London as we really enjoyed the stay with Sian.
Cheers, Carsten

Staying in one of the rooms that Julia keeps for her guests is always a pleasant experience. The rooms are clean and comfortable. Julia is a very understanding person and makes her guests feel like the are at home. j recommend her to any person that wants to stay in central London in a nice place at a reasonable price.

The location and accessibility of this home away from home is perfect. We spent a few days holiday making and the rest at the Ibis Lilly Rd conference center.  The house is clean, the bed is comfortable, the bathroom is modern and plenty of warm water. We had to do some work and used the living room which was entirely at our disposal during our stay. So in terms of space, this beats any hotel room in town! Now - Isabelle is a wonderful host. She is extremely kind and flexible and she helped us with wonderful vegan breakfast every morning! Fresh berries, home made jams for sour dough bread and oats. She has maps of London, called for taxi and lent us oyster cards! We couldn't be happier with our choice of HOME in London.
Anne's place is located in a beautiful area, right by the park and some nice places to walk and eat.

We had an excellent experience at Sandra's lovely flat. Everything was just as we hoped. It was clean, comfortable, and the kitchen was very easy to use. We found it a great base for our touring. It offered us a bit of peace and quiet after our adventures around London.

Urszula was a very gracious (and flexible) host. We arrived mid morning to her home after a long international flight where she was  kind enough to make it possible for us to book in early. Every thing was clean and just as described. Our stay was so very handy to family, shops and transport which worked brilliantly for us. We would def come here again.

I stayed in Julia's house to visit an exhibition. I wasnt staying in the room I book, but another room, other rooms have the same furnitures and equipments, they are all great.

I really love Julia's rooms, it is big, it has table and fridge, lots of lights, even hairdryer and a sink!(so i dont need to go out to brush my teeth, haha, lazy), as an artist, this room is like a perfect room i always look for. I really wish i can stay longer there.

The appartment was close to a rail station but you have to change lines to get the tube.
It was a little too far out to walk to any key areas you could get to town via train.
The appartment was cosy and clean, also quiet however the neighborhood wasnt very nice.

Our family of five thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Tess' garden flat.  It is just as it appears in the photos.  Bright, clean, modern, and full of convenient appliances.  We have young boys that took full advantage of the garden in the back and we enjoyed watching and listening for the trains that whiz by on the lines behind the garden--added to the charm and true London feel.  The walk to the nearest tube station is a pleasant 10 minute stroll and allows you quick access to the city.  We enjoyed the wonderful shops and restaurants on Saulisbury street nearby.  We were sad to leave and look forward to returning to this flat next summer for our annual trip to London!
Anne was very accommodating and helpful. Great location in a very quite neighborhood. Diffently recommend.

Isabella is a friendly and helpful hostess who provided everything we needed, nice food and information. She seems to know everything about London, nice restaurant, bus route, museums and the things go on and on. The breakfast is amazing with homemade jam, freshly prepared fruits porridge and toast. The jam is. Just amazing!  You will definitely love it! She also gets a lovely cat darcy who is hospitable and friendly as well haha.  Recommend Isabella's place to you if you want to find a lovely place with quiet neighbourhood to stay in London.(the district line to Isabella's home sometimes can be confusing to people who have never been to uk as it gets different diversions which is tricky )

The listing was exactly as described. The location was perfect, close to transportation and many theatres, restaurants, and attractions. The amenities were fantastic and everything worked great. I really appreciated the key code system and housekeeping services, it made the stay much more accommodating. I would definitely stay here again were I to go back to London.

We had a wonderful stay here. Close to all transport into central London and a very safe neighbourhood.  Perfect location.  Tess is a lovely host and her home is beautiful. All amenities are here!!  A home away from home. The garden is beautiful.  We would definitely stay again.

The apartment is just as described and in a great location. It was perfect for our work trip and recommend to anyone wanting to stay somewhere that is peaceful and only minutes away from the London buzz.
My second stay at A.J.'s place in camden because the last time was perfect! Highly recommended!

Loved the house. Exactly how it is in the pictures. Shelly was always available from the day I booked, asking questions in regards to transportation and so on and through out our stay. I was able to text her and she replied right away. We did not get to meet her but Nelly checked us in and she was just as helpful! The house was clean, had all the amenities we needed, she had a binder with all house tricks, with suggestions and where to find things. She left maps for us as well to get around. It was a quiet and safe neighborhood, we were very comfortable. Only thing was which we read on the house tricks later was the water in the shower either came out really cold or really hot. Oh! & she left us a bottle of wine for our stay. I would definitely stay here again.
Good location, accurately described accommodation, clean and tidy. Overall very happy with my stay. Thank you Julia!

We much enjoyed our stay at Anne's place. She was very lovely, welcoming and helpful. Her flat is located in a very nice area with a bus stop nearby. The room was spacious and looked exactly like in photos. Her doggies were very friendly and it was great to spend some time with them as well. We will definitely be staying there again next time we're in London.

The description and photos of the apartment were very accurate.  Our host provided concise directions and simple information for our entry. The location was EXCELLENT and close to many restaurants, theatres and within 5 minutes of two convenient tube stations.  The apartment was clean and had a very functional kitchen. The maid service and clean towels were also appreciated.  Unfortunately the Internet was sometimes inconsistent and the apartment was hot and made sleeping unbearable during the hot summer nights.  Nonetheless, we still made the most of our visit and had an excellent holiday in London!

My son Theo had a great time staying at Tina's. It was an incredibly convenient location, near all transport. Tina was very welcoming and provided everything I needed. I would highly recommend  Tina's apartment.

Daniel has been really nice and always available. He met us in person to give us the keys, show us the apartment and explain all we needed to know about the house.
The apartment is amazing, even better then the pictures in the ad, clean and beautifully furnished.
The staying in general has been great!

Really nice little house, not far away from a really big supermarket and multiple busstops. Nice kitchen and bathroom, though using the shower was a bit getting used to. Shelly communicates good and is good to reach.

Located on an unassuming but convenient street, we found the flat to be comfortable & quiet. Note that it is a basement unit; tall people may hit their head in places. The "private patio" or whatever it was called is a light well, unappealing. But for two jet-lagged people the flat was fine. We never met the owner; someone from the real estate agency upstairs let us in. There was a problem with the wifi and we had to wait 40 min or so for someone to arrive & straighten it out. Otherwise all ok.

We had a wonderful stay at Tess's flat in London. It was in a lovely, safe neighbourhood that is very close to an excellent bakery (Gail's), the Queen's Park station and a Marks and Spencer grocery store. Although we didn't have an opportunity to meet Tess because she, also, was traveling; we met her sister and parents who were also delightful and very helpful.
Excellent first Airbnb experience and trip to London! Thank you Tess!!

I book the apartment for my family and they really love it.
The apartment is big and bright, perfect for 4 adults.
Daniel is the perfect host.
Many thanks
Maria
Everything was as advertised. The location was fantastic and the apartment was clean and comfortable, with everything we needed.

Thanks Justin for a wonderful stay in Notting Hill! The flat was exactly as described - clean, comfortable, and close to the tube station. I had a few questions during my stay that Justin quickly answered which was greatly appreciated. My friends and I would definitely stay again!

Isabelle did everything possible to make us feel very welcome, everything there was great, lovely lounge to relax in, very clean, neat and tidy beautifully decorated apartment. Isabelle provided a lot of information about London had lots of brochures and provided very handy advice and help on the public transport. Isabelle s very knowledgable on tourism, shopping, restaurants and other highlights in London and always around to answer questions.  We had some great chats too. Its a great location and close to public transport.

The house was really clean and tidy and the space was enough for th 4 of us.Very quiet neighborhood and tracy was very quick in answering to our questions.close to the bus and underground,you can go everywhere very fast from there.

The place is beautiful, clean, comfortable and in a good location. At night it's also very quiet which is great.
My one problem was that the wifi was not working for me, which was a disappointed since it was listed as having wifi and I really depended on it. The welcome instructions mentioned that they are "in the process of taking over a new line" and to use the building wifi in the mean time. But the wifi in the building was not reachable on my iPhone or iPad.

Jenny is an excellent landlady. She helped us very much. Even she arranged a cab for us. Jenny`s flat is new and very nice. It is like the photos. It is very close to metro station which was very important for us. There are everything in the flat. Especially if you will stay for a long period, this comfortable house is very good for you. Thanks Jenny :)
Good location, especially during notting hill carnival. Well-equipped kitchen is great. Tom is warm-hearted and helpful.
Julia was kind and kept communicating with me through out the time. The house was so clean and lovely area I loved it, I definitely recommend this house.

Found Vikash to be very helpful with any questions or issues I had prior and on arrival.
Great 4 bed house with plenty of room.
The house was in a great location, what with Twickenham only 10min walk away and also a supermarket just around the corner for any amenities you may need.
Had a very comfortable 2 night stay and would highly recommend staying here!
Thank you again to Vikash for all your help.

It was a tiny but comfortable & adequately equipped little flat in a lovely quiet neighbourhood with excellent access to all amenities and transport links. The keys were kept in a secure box by the front door making the checking in procedure very easy and flexible. We appreciated that checking out was not until midday relieving time pressures. The mattress on the mezzanine was  exceptionally comfortable and cool.

An excellent place to stay in the heart of London.     A stunning apartment.    Simon was a great host - made us feel welcome.     Great facilities, lovely and quiet with all information to make our stay one we will always remember.   Highly recommended.

Rosie's flat was absolutely lovely! It had everything I needed for my stay (was exactly as pictured) and it is situated in a lovely part of London! Rosie was very helpful, providing great information on the flat and the area. She made sure that I had everything I needed and always responded quickly to emails. Thank you Rosie for having me stay at your flat!

Simon was very responsive and helpful.  The flat is in a terrific location in Notting Hill: close to the tube stop, and right around the corner from the many shops, restaurants, and pubs that give the area its charm.  A great place to stay while in London.
Flat was quiet as advertised & near to tube stop. Robin was very helpful & friendly, providing useful information of local area.
Lovely fly, beautifully clean, but the sleeping situation wasn't for me, although I'm certain it would be fine for others.

I've had a wonderful time in robin's apartment. The place is great full of incredible pieces of art. The neighborhood is nice and quiet and very convenient with public transport. Robin is a great host.
Nice clean house. Everything worked ok. The host helpfully left some milk in the fridge for us. Beds weren't very comfortable, one of them was possible memory foam which was better than the rest!

We did not meet Rosie but all the arrangements were perfect. We especially appreciated getting into the place earlier(we had lost baggage to deal with) and the welcome groceries etc provided. Location was nearly idyllic-this is one of the very best areas of London.

Anna was a great. No problem at all gaining access to the apartment which is wonderfully located directly in front of the common....sainsburys is super handy, probably a two minute stroll away...I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this property to anyone.
I would highly recommend this flat to anyone. I was positively surprised with the both location and size of the flat for the price. Tess seem very professional and the hospitality is great!

Sarah's apartment could not be located in a better spot in Covent Garden, perfect for our week stay in London. You can reach with ease all major attractions. The tube is just one block away. The apartment was clean and tidy and everything we needed was explained to us upon arrival. A great security system to get in and hand over the keys. A surprise bonus was having a maid coming every day to do light cleaning up and a change of fresh towels after three days. We would definitely stay again at Sarah's apartment.
quiet neighbourhood and conveniently located next to the tube. it's an excellent location if you're planning to travel out of town via king's cross, which is only 1 stop away. we enjoyed our stay!

Robin was a great host. As first time visitors to London both him and his flat were great first experiences. Robin was super helpful and accommodating especially with small things like the Oyster Cards which turned out to be a huge help. The place itself is nice and in a great location. It was a walk no longer than 10 minutes from the nearest Underground stop. That stop seemed to be on a line that went straight through the city and made sightseeing super easy and doable. If the opportunity presented itself I would definitely consider staying with Robin again. Nothing but positive things
