The space was clean, spacious, and very well stocked — everything we needed was provided, from kitchen essentials to extra blankets and toiletries. The layout worked well for our group, and it was comfortable and accessible for our mum, which made a big difference.
Giuseppe and his partner were fantastic — responsive, welcoming, and thoughtful throughout our stay. We’d happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it to other families, especially those traveling with older relatives. Thank you for a great stay!
Very lovely place, Akrox was responding very quickly and was very clear with all instructions, definitely recommend.

A very spacious apartment, within walking distance to both Metro and ThamesLink stations. The kitchen was well equipped and the bathroom was clean with hot water in the shower. There are plenty of shops and restaurants within 5-7 mins walk, the street was pretty quiet throughout the day. All in all, we enjoyed our stay here and would definitely reconsider it on our next visit to London.
This is a great flat in a peaceful neighborhood. It's spacious, comfortable, quiet and is a short walk to nearby tube stations and London activities.

Shantanu and Jonathan (Danny) were absolutely brilliant, super warm and gracious hosts. Highly recommend this to anyone seeking a clean, convenient stay and will make you feel right at home. It’s perfectly located between two underground tube stations with easy access to central london.
Will definitely be visiting again, thank you once again for the excellent hospitality guys.

Great location and a perfect place for 6 of us to stay before my Daughters Graduation. Kitchen and front room bigger than I expected it to be. Will try and stay again if I need to be in Central London again for any reason.

Federico's place was great!  We were able to drop our bags prior to check in which was really helpful so we could start sightseeing right away.  The apartment is close to the tube making it easy to get around London.  Federico is really responsive, we had a question about the WIFI and he got back to us within a few minutes.  We would definitely stay here again!
A stones throw from Harrods and conveniently located between Knightsbridge and South Kensington stations making getting around easy. Would definitely stay again!

Stayed here for 2 nights, no issues at all
Comfortable beds, clean room and bathroom.
Kitchen with everything you might need except a microwave (if that matters)
Will stay again if i get a chance.
Me and my family had a good time here. There was a little facility problem but it didn’t affect our stay. Highly recommended.
Very nice stay at Jaharuls place. Very clean and tidy. Tube station next door which meant easy commute into the city and there wasn’t too much noise in the night. Highly recommend.
Lovely place to stay, exactly as described on listing, brilliant location for what we needed, will definitely be booking again.

We had a lovely stay! The apartment is spacious, tastefully furnished, and had all the amenities exactly as listed. The location is very central, which made getting around easy. Natasha is an exceptionally kind and accommodating host, and she truly made us feel welcome. Highly recommended!

Susannah and Elias were exceptional hosts – incredibly helpful and easy to communicate with. Their apartment is not just beautiful, but clearly a much-loved home, thoughtfully maintained and full of personal touches. It was ideal for us – a great location, safe and quiet, and within easy walking distance to lots of amenities and the underground. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Excellent！It's not just home from home but more. We spent a very very happy and comfortable two-weeks vocation in Nada’s house. Nada is very helpful and kind guidance offerer, more than a qualified owner. Very appreciated and impressed~ strongly recommend!
Very good location, near the British Museum and the city center. Super big property that suitable for families or friends. Responsive host!! Highly recommend!
Great location but the decor was dated and it had a bit of a musky smell. Bigger than expected, beds comfy

Charlotte's place is beautiful!!!!!! Really beautifully decorated and had everything I needed. Charlotte was a great host. She is a very lovely person and a pleasure to deal with. She accommodated my early check-in request. The location is perfect. A short walk from the main street at Dalston and the stations, and an even shorter walk to some great pubs. I loved my stay. Thanks so much, Charlotte.

Deb's intructions were great. Check-in and -out easily done.
Great location. Most of the the tourist spots close.
We used st. James park underground station, but Pimlico is also nearby.
Two grocery stores are nearby.
Aparment was good enough for our use. Fans were great extra.
Peaceful location and it was safe to walk in the evenings.
We had great holiday.
Keep up good work Deb 😊
Tee was really helpful and easy to communicate with. Lots of bed’s in the house which was perfect for a few of us staying away for work. Extended for a few more days and tee made it easy and simple.

My family of 5 and I loved our stay at Richard's townhouse! We went to London to sight see and to visit some other areas of England. This was a great location. The location is super close to two tube stations and walkable to multiple groceries and restaurants. Also, it is just across the street from Hyde Park!
It was nice having a workable kitchen and grocery stores close for the nights when we needed a break from eating out. It was also nice that we all had our own space which we would not have had in a hotel.
Richard was flexible with check in and had the place clean upon our arrival even though we were a few hours early. It was so helpful because we were worn out after our travel and the time change.

Isabelle (and Mr. Darcy) was a wonderful host! The rooms were lovely, comfortable, very clean, and had everything I needed.
Isabelle gave me a rundown on good places to go visit, and showed me how to get there using transit.
Breakfast was scrumptious! She’s a great baker and was able to accommodate my food allergy.
10/10 would recommend. Can’t wait to come and stay again!
Had a lovely stay in this Airbnb. The host is so incredibly friendly and welcoming. The place is beautiful, the location is lovely as well. I highly recommend this place. Would definitely come back.
Perfect location, good communications, and a tidy flat. Enjoyed our stay and will no doubt be using again. A very comfortable stay and sleep. Thanks
The apartment is very nice and beautifully designed, the host was very communicative and I really felt at home 😊😊

Clean and modern flat which was perfect for two nights. Contactless check in and even allowed us to check in early which was a great bonus.
Area felt safe and transport links close by. Would definitely stay here again if I came to London, thank you
It was a lovely stay , clean convenient & value for money . East Croydon train station is great for getting to London Central in 15 mins . Area not the greatest at times but ok for couples or pairs .

Nice family and a good bed. Everything we wanted.
The center is accessible via bus in front of the house and by subway via oval station.

Fantastic stay in a great location, close to the tube station and only 15/20 mins into central - but nice to come out and stay in a quiet private area. Very secure accommodation but still easy to find and check in.
Will definitely consider this accommodation for all my London visits, can’t say enough good things about it!
Had such a lovely stay! Sancha is an excellent/ helpful host and our room was super well-equipped with everything we needed and even some nice treats/drinks.  Would 100% recommend.
Kelly’s place was lovely clean, comfortable, and perfect for a short stay. It’s in a great location, walkable to almost everything, which made getting around super easy.

The place is ok. House is somewhat rundown, musty, not too clean. No toilets in bedroom floor. Beds are small. Amenities provided were minimal (e.g. one hand towel for a family of 4 for an entire week). Cupboards not attached securely to wall; need to go up and down stairs to use shower and toilet, but no curtain on corridor window…good location, with several cafes and supermarkets within walking distance. Far from tube but reasonable bus services. Communication with host was functional, but not warm or inviting. Was okay but will look for another place next time we visit London.

The apartment worth its money. very neat and perfect for guest  without kids . Transportation from the apartment is so easy against what many people told me. the apartment is a semi smart- home. I will recommend for my friends travelling without kids .

Overall a nice flat and easy access on the ground floor. An ideal location for town centre, Richmond Park and the river walks. Not on the main road so it was nice and quiet.
Really comfy bed and sofa, loved the bathroom and toiletries.

We were a family of four and had an amazing time! The apartment was very clean and comfortable. It’s located close to the underground, and it only takes 20–30 minutes to get to central London by tube. We’ll definitely come back and stay here again! 😁

Tina was a wonderful host. She gave great, clear instructions on everything. She opened her home to me during the stay, inviting me for tea and conversations and checked in with me mid week to see how everything was going. Will stay with her again.

We had an excellent stay at Richard's flat.  The accommodations were spacious and has as described.  The location was perfect for us, as we were heading to Wembley, but it was also easy to get to the tourist attractions as the Tube station was close.  We would definitely come back.

When traveling, the most important thing to me is a feeling of safety, and I felt safe the whole time! Great area and easy to get to the busier part of London!  The beds were comfortable, but the couch is for looks only.
We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It was clean and quiet. The location was ideal, just a short walk from Waterloo. Communication was excellent throughout.
Had a lovely stay at Susana's place.  Perfect location to enjoy everything that Notting Hill has to offer, and close to the tube.

Perfect Place! Clean and welcoming. Nice and well equipped kitchen and modern bath room.
We stayed with our 1 year old. It was clean and toddler friendly.
The park with playgrounds was right around the corner and the bus stop a 3 min walk. We wouldn’t have objected if the kids bed was already set up and towles and linens available for the little one, but we figured it all out with Max‘ help :)

We had a wonderful stay at this charming house with cosy, well-appointed bedrooms. Getting into the city was quick and easy by public transport. Breakfast offered a lovely variety of spreads and cereals, which we really enjoyed. There was also a small fridge, which made it easy to store our own breakfast items.
Anne was absolutely lovely – always available with helpful tips and suggestions. And last but not least, the sweetest dog who loved a cuddle and made us feel even more at home.

This place was great! Surprisingly serene given the chaos of London outside, spotlessly clean and smelled lovely too. Very well catered with iron, ironing board, coffee machine all necessary utensils. So dog friendly! Our blind dog was so safe and happy. Parking is a massive bonus too. Loved!!!!

We had a wonderful stay at Lawrence’s place! He was a very responsive host and let us check in early after a long international flight which was so appreciated. The home was well equipped and tidy, and Lawrence was very responsive to all my messages. The location was great - close to public transport and nice restaurants. Overall a wonderful place to stay!

We fell for the old school building, it was really nice to see how they re-purpose buildings like these and it was the ideal base to further discover London. Bus stops were around the corner and took us to Central London within half an hour!

Perfect spot for our family of 4 to stay while visiting london.  Staying here gave us more space and the comforts of home which was ideal given we had been travelling already for 5 weeks.  Very friendly, thoughtful and responsive host.

Superb apartment, tasteful decor, great location for us to visit our son in “Askew” and also for me to recuperate for a few days following a procedure at Charing Cross Hospital.
Had everything we required for a short 3 day stay and is handily located for same excellent pubs and restaurants close by.
Our hosts gave extremely clear instructions on how to locate and access their property, supported by numerous highly helpful photos. They were also very quick to respond to any queries we had.
Would highly recommend a stay here.
The location was great and the check-in process was easy. All as described, comfortable and peaceful.

The apartment was beautiful and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was great - close to tube/DLR stations, so getting around the city was really easy. On top of that, Kappy was a genuinely kind and helpful host. She gave me really useful advice for getting back after a late event, which I really appreciated. Would definitely recommend and stay here again in the future. Thanks Kappy 🥰

Tom flat was in the perfect location. It was near the metro and looked cal buses. Also, near the portobello market and other great shops to check out. Anytime I reached out to tom with questions, he replied within the hour. My son enjoyed the loft bed, it is a vertical climb to get to it. Overall, I will stay there again when I visit London.
Great host, place was clean and exactly as showcased in the pictures. Nice neighbourhood as well, close to the underground. Overall had a nice stay with no problems!

Ornela's place is a gem. Floor to ceiling windows across two floors flood the place with light and airy.....in London that is a rare thing. Well equipped kitchen and everything else you could possibly need. Everything is less than a 10 minute walk - stations, supermarket, gym; and it's 20 minutes' walk to the city. Absolutely perfect
A comfortable place to stay,  with great hosts! It is our second stay here and we will definitely stay again. Clean, easy to find, great location and always very clear communication from Stewart.

I cannot began to say enough good things about the incredible hosting that Mark gave to my family and I.  He handled all of our inquiries in a timely fashion and ensured we had everything needed during our stay.  The flat is in a location that’s about a 5 min walk to coffee shops, restaurants, and pubs in the neighborhood.

This is a nice apartment with plenty of room for two.  The kitchen is well equipped, good frying pans and stove, oven, microwave.  There is one flight of stairs to get in.  Every day was peaceful, as this is a quiet family neighborhood next to a small park.  Grocery stores and restaurants are within reasonable walking distance, but not too much variety, and the stores are quite small.  Obi was very helpful in recommending shops and things to do in the area.  He even carried our heavy bag up the stairs!

Very nice and simple little flat! Great for a weekend trip around the area! Easy to get to and to access into the building! Lots of transport, restaurants and shops close by. Such a spacious Airbnb with lots of light. Would definitely recommend especially for a nice evening by the river!
I had a nice stay at Mariam’s place. She was very helpful at check in and was always available to answer questions.

A very comfortable place to stay in a great and very quiet location.
Cleverly designed house over 4 floors which worked perfectly.
Great location for walking, buses, shopping etc.

World class rental experience, Sofia was responsive and available whenever we needed her. The property was exceptional, the location was perfect, and the comfort was infinitely better than a hotel with 3 spacious bedrooms. Key exchange / check-in was a breeze.

Thank you so much to Shelly for such a wonderful home!
We truly felt at home — it was cozy, comfortable, and had that charming English touch. The house is equipped with everything you might need, with every little detail thoughtfully taken care of.
Located in a quiet and peaceful area with lovely neighbors, yet just 15–20 minutes’ walk to Tower Bridge or a few minutes to bus stops that take you to all the major sights. In the evenings, we were even visited by foxes in the garden — a magical touch that added to the London charm.
Shelley was incredibly kind, allowed us to check in early, and was always available with helpful tips and suggestions for places to explore.
We’re already dreaming of coming back! 🏡💫

The apartment was clean and looked exactly as described. Check-in went super smoothly, very clear instructions and the apartment is in a good area with great transport links to the centre of London. Would definitely recommend!!
Beautiful flat with two spacious bedrooms. And a very big bathroom! Stoke newington is peaceful with cafés and a few pubs nearby. Really enjoyed our stay!

The place was very nice, I stayed there with a group of friends while visiting London. There was everything that someone might need. The beds were comfortable, the balcony where we had breakfasts every morning was very cute. It was also great to have a washer&dryer.
The neighborhood was close enough to some nice cafes/restaurants and a grocery store. Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay here.

The location is everything if you want to explore london . This accommodation is only 15 minutes walk for jubilee and Elizabeth line . We really enjoyed the views at night from the balcony after our busy days .

This stay was close to the tube and had walkable restaurants, bars and shops. We loved the flexibility to either eat near the bnb or take a short tube ride to another community. The place was spacious and well organized.
Hannah place was exactly as it was advertised. The house is clean, and located in a beautiful place. The host was always responsive and friendly. I would recommend people to stay in Hannah property.

It was a little odd to have to walk through the cafe to get in/out of the property, but otherwise the house was clean & quiet. Good location, near the tube station, buses, and local shops. I would stay again.
I was attending the Jazz Cafe festival at Burgess Park and this place was the perfect location for the visit. Clean and comfortable, would recommend!
I had a great stay! The host was quick to respond to any questions, check-in was super easy and smooth, and the place was spotless. Would definitely recommend!
A lovely place to stay! Jade was very quick to respond with any issues or questions we had.

Laura’s place was our first stopover for 4 nights after arriving from Australia. Her communications throughout were absolutely outstanding. Prompt, clear, courteous and informative.
I was travelling with my young adult son so we needed two bedrooms (& ideally 2 bathrooms!).
We immediately felt like we were home. The house was super clean and comfortable and quiet, exactly what we wanted.
And such a short walk to the Oval for cricket with some amazing take away and dine-in options nearby.
To say I was happy with Laura’s place would be an understatement. I would have no hesitation in staying there again or in recommending it to others!
Very close to the tube station, very lovely house, feel stay at home instead of bnb. Will come back for sure😀

I had a nice stay at Georgie’s flat. The kitchen is lovely and the living spaces are nice and bright. It was quiet and peaceful even with being located on a main road. The flat is located at the very top of three flights of stairs - just a heads up for anyone traveling with a lot of luggage!  Overall, a super cute place to stay in Hackney with a great pub across the street :)

We had such a wonderful stay at your place! The space was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and thoughtfully decorated with everything we needed for a comfortable visit. You were incredibly responsive and helpful with all our questions, which made checking in and settling in a breeze. The location was perfect too, with easy access to all the spots we wanted to explore. We truly felt right at home and would absolutely love to stay here again if we’re back in the area. Thank you so much for being such a fantastic host! Highly recommend!
Brilliant stay. Amazing views of the o2 and a modern clean apartment. Definitely recommend!

Raphael's flat was the perfect place for our four day stay in London.  The space was clean, stylish, and well-equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect—quiet yet close to transport, shops, and great cafes. What truly made the experience outstanding was the host, who was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful with our myriad of questions. Communication was quick and friendly from start to finish. Great recommendations for local eateries - especially for Sunday roast!   Highly recommend this flat for anyone visiting London—it’s an absolute gem!

The flat was exactly as described. Very nice, clean, and freshly renovated. Enjoyed the quaint neighborhood, nearby transportation, grocery, and restaurants. Very communicative and flexible check-in was a big help. Would recommend without hesitation.

We had a great stay at Rutendo’place. The place matched the description. Rutendo is very thoughtful in providing what guests need during the stay. Two supermarkets nearby, and station is one minute walk. The place is very clean and quiet as it is not facing the road.

Had a great stay here, apartment perfect, exactly as described, handy for central London too.
Jacqueline is a great host, everything in the apartment exactly as described, spotlessly clean too. Thank you.
We really enjoyed our stay. The location was perfect and the apartment was really well kept and very clean. The host was very responsive. Thank you
Was a nice stay and the host was helpful to sort out any hiccups along the way. Was comfortable, clean and nice.
We had a great stay! Loved the location and the beautiful, bright living room. Had great walks along the river and enjoys local pubs and cafes.

We truly appreciated the apartment, and the flexibility with check in and check out.
I’d go back to it. 5 stars.

Forget about Fabien. He doesn’t exist ;). You will deal with a team that’s there to manage the unit professionally. And they do it rather professionally.

I enjoyed staying in this apartment due to it’s location with the river nearby. It was peaceful. Transport connections and shopping facilities were also easily accessible.
The apartment was super clean and comfortable with everything you required to make yourself feel comfortable.
Giulia was very easy to communicate with and always wanted to make sure I was comfortable in her home.
I highly recommend this Airbnb.
Lovely home, lovely host. The kids felt comfortable and at home. Lovely parking just by the building.
Central location and clean apartment. Room gets quite warm in hot weather and noisy from other rooms with the window open.

Me and my partner had an amazing stay,Fatima looked after us and gave very clear instructions from how to find the property,checking in,checking if everything is okay,parking queries and more.The guest house is beautiful and so cozy,I loved the fish tank in the room!😌

My family and I had a great time in London, and Agat’s place was part of it.
The place matches the photos.
Clean place with all we needed.
We needed Agat’s help, and he was very responsive and helpful.
The location is close to the Elizabeth Line and the DLR. It is served by a grocery store, fast-food restaurants, and other amenities.
Thank you, Agat, for your hospitality.
See you next time we visit London!

Gio was a terrific host.  Apartment is central to so much in London so it was great with young kids to be able to get around so easily with the tube right next to us.  Home had everything you would need/expect for an Airbnb.  Had a small issue with the WiFi and Gio responded super fast to resolve.  Check out was also a breeze!
Really lovely place. Fantastic location, well equipped, nicely finished and spotless. Can't fault it. We hope to return. Great hosts too!
Had a very pleasant stay ay Darryl’s. The flat was clean, matched the description, and was close by to Brixton station so very easy to walk to. I would strongly recommend

I actually would have extended our stay if it wasn't already fully booked.
I recommend this location.
great location..very close to everything...Catalina is great she is helpful and respond very fast..clean flat.

Great house for 4 persons.
Clean and all facilities there.
Antonio was very helpfull and responded quickly.
Second time staying at Sabrina’s and was just a good as the last time. Great area and great host x

Everything was simply perfect! Olushola is an amazing host, all went super smoothly and felt at home right away. The place was very clean, quiet, and the private bathroom is a perfect addition to it. Will choose Olushola's place for the next time as well!
The location is great, right next to bus stop. Peaceful place with a great view of the park from the windows. The decor is very nice and feels like home. Marc was a great host.
A great cozy stay with a residential feel in Greenwich. Richard and Kris were responsive and amazing problem solvers

The apartment was centrally located making it super convenient to walk to most places of interest. Lots of great restaurants and shopping located very close by.
The apartment was spacious and very well maintained. Lynn was checking in throughout our stay and responded quickly to any inquires that we had.
All in all definitely a place we would come back to again for future stays in London.
Michael

We had a lovely time at Elsa’ place. Really homely, a spacious living and kitchen area with two decent sized bedrooms. It was perfect for the weekend we had in a great location. Would definitely recommend and would stay again if needed. The only thing I would say is that the shower did go cold whilst showering a few times but it quickly sorted itself out. Thanks very much Elsa.

Great flat in a fabulous location, close to Battersea Rise and Northcote Road but the flat itself is very quiet. Balcony was nice to sit and catch the morning sun. Only thing is the drain smell from the bathroom which at times is overpowering.

good price especially for the location, there was an issue with the bed the first day but they immediately came to solve it.
also a bus stop right in front of the house as well as great food spots

Chris is a great host, helpful and responsive. The flat is perfectly situated—a quiet respite around the corner from bustling Westbourne Grove. The flat is up several flights, we had large suitcases but once settled it was fine. Perfect size for a couple. Would visit again!

We stayed at the farmhouse for a hen party and it was perfect for us!
The garden and outside area was a highlight and we really appreciated all the space and outdoor bar.
Jacqua was a great host, easily contactable and very welcoming

Place was very well priced, and as well as that, the staff were very friendly and supportive to our needs. Very responsive, and always happy to help where they can. Place was exceptional, nice location and scenery, good pricing, and overall a great experience.
All Perfect, the room is clean. Communication about check in and check out also great. Very well. Recommended
Adam was a great host.  Lots of communication, met us at his home and helped us with our luggage.  Would definitely recommend!!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The property was spotless and very well maintained. It came with all the amenities I and my family needed for a comfortable visit. The host was excellent, friendly, responsive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our stay. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean and welcoming home away from home.

Enjoyed 4 nights at this beautiful townhouse. Orla and Rob were very good with the instructions and suggested few local places to visit. The hosts allowed us to check-in earlier, which we really appreciate. There are two bedrooms one with a large king size bed and the second one with small double bed. The second bed is arguable not big enough for a comfortable sleep for two adults.
a quiet and peaceful place, one thing that really annoyed us was the creaking wooden floor.

Nice apartment and location, however there were issues when I came home one night and realised the cleaners had come in during my stay stripped the bed and left it unmade. This was an invasion of privacy and left me quite unsettled, unfortunately the management team weren’t particularly helpful.
Thankfully, the owner reached out and she was very understanding and personally resolved the issues which was very kind. Seems like I was unlucky, she addressed the management team & cleaning service so it wouldn’t happen again.
Brilliant accommodation in the perfect location, managed to book us in at late notice with no issues, would highly recommend.

Had a lovely stay at Ellie’s place. A beautiful little apartment in a really great location. Really close to the tube and the main attractions and was really easy to find. Ellie was helpful and super quick with her responses. Would definitely recommend a stay here!
Loved my stay here! The place was super clean and host was always so responsive and helpful! Will definitely stay here on my next visit to London!

It was actually better than I expected. Room was nice and clean. Location also was good. 10 minutes walk from the nearby station. For a solo  traveler, it was very good. I would love to stay here again. Thank you Arthur

We had a good stay at Lisa’s Airbnb. The place was squeaky clean and looked just like the pictures. The host was extremely friendly and went above and beyond. The Airbnb was in a nice area and was close to public transportation. I would recommend this place to anyone!
this place is super easy to  find,  feels like home, not noisy neighborhood,  lot of options to  go for walk and restaurants,   I love this place

Peter's apartment was great. Had everything that you could have asked for. Peter is an amazing host and he let me an early check in and late check out. I loved the stay and would definately be coming back here again. Thank you Peter.

Thank you Reshma and family for allowing us to stay at your property. Exactly like the photos. The welcome basket was a real treat too!
Thanks again
Kieran

Stayed at Rebecca’s place for almost 2 weeks as a family of 3 (with a 4year old kid). We had a great stay, it’s a spacious apartment with everything needed. It’s located within walking distance of public transport and restaurants. Rebecca was always a message away, and very helpful and responsive on all questions / requests from us. I would highly recommend staying here!
A friendly host, attentive and responsive. A lovely place, well looked after, host gave great tips on things to do nearby and places to visit. Recommend highly. Will gladly return again.

Wonderful place, best coffee place across the street. Little noisy area on the weekend but that’s not a complaint.
Loved it. Would stay again. 10/10.

Great stay, great location, great host. Water pressure in the shower was good which is a need after walking around London in August! The beds are quite firm and the room was very warm but the host very kindly left a fan.
Just a note that the entrance we had been using had locked in the evening and caused a slight panic! Did manage to find another entrance but something to note.
Would definitely be back

I wish I could give this more than 5 stars , Charlotte and Matt were wonderful, perfect place to lay your head down after a night out, could rave on and on about how wonderful everything was but it would be a whole essay!would book again if I were to come back to London!

We had a lovely time at Sofia’s place - perfectly placed location walking distance to lots of food, shopping, and things to do.  The air con was nice as strong which was very important for us in a heat wave and a luxury to have in every bedroom plus living room!
Can’t recommend this place more. Excellent location. Rooftop views are beautiful. Anna was responsive and very helpful. Would stay again.

Amazing place to stay for 2 weeks. Mark was able to be flexible with both check in and check out. Room was lovely, could run hot at times due to no AC but there was provided fans and the communal rooms had AC and were lovely to spend time in. The outside amenities such as the seating outside and balconies were beautiful and lovely to lounge around. I would absolutely recommend staying here!
We had a very enjoyable stay in Wembley - the location was super (and very welcome at the end of the night).  Lots to see and do in the area. The apartment and host were great!
Lovely and unique downstairs apartment ideal for a short stay over the summer. Felt extremely private and was in a great location due to nearby transport links. Would stay again 100%

Great location for visiting around London, works very well as a modern one bedroom base for a London trip. It’s a top (4th) floor home but we didn’t find the stairs a problem. Everything in the accommodation worked as expected, nice lounge and kitchen area, comfortable bed. Good value, a better choice that using a hotel

We had a great stay at Richard’s home. Very convenient for Greenwich and the 02. Easy walk there and back or bus 129. Greenwich is a beautiful place, very chilled . Great views from the attic bedroom.
A very comfortable and cosy home. We felt just like home. An ideal place for a family with children. Can’t wait to book it again for my next trip!

Great spot and very spacious, the living room and bedroom are both quite large, including a walk in closet. The apartment is in quite a busy area, but I never had any issues with noise at night. Would definitely stay here again!

Great accommodation for your stay in London:
-close to a big station linking you directly to other cities and neighbourhoods,
-plenty of stores and restaurants right down your apartment,
-the accommodation itself is fully equipped and beautifully decorated,
-the room is located at the back of the building and was very quiet despite being in the middle of the animations,
Zuzana is an amazing host: she is responsive, helpful and friendly.
Will come back next time we come to London!
Very clean, lift was broken sadly, kitchen very well equipped. It was pretty loud because of the street but you get used to it.
Great place in a great neighbourhood! Short walk to the tube and plenty of Cafe's, Bar's and Restaurant's nearby. Would definitely stay again!

First time using airbnb so didn't know what to expect. This was a last minute arrangement so Anton's quick response and helpfulness were appreciated.
Check-in day was hot and arrival was late in the early hours of the morning. Anton stayed in touch and had cold water ready which was a thoughtful gesture.
Small note for future travellers, bathroom and toilet are upstairs.

Lovely cosy ground floor flat which had everything we needed for a great stay. It’s well decorated, spotless and was ideal for the three of us. Fazile was so easy to deal with and always on hand, she is a great host and very helpful! We will definitely be back to stay again in the future.

I feel very lucky to have found Alex’s place. It’s in the heart of Covent Gardens so getting to restaurants and shopping was very easy. My wife has mobility issues so this was extremely important.
The place was very comfortable, it was very clean and had most of what we needed in the kitchen. It was a hot week but the fans provided helped a lot!
There is no lift however and this flat is on the 2nd floor so carrying luggage up a narrow staircase can be a bit tricky but aside from that, it was perfect for our week away.

I had a great stay here! The place was clean and peaceful, exactly what I was hoping for. The check-in process was smooth and straightforward, and communication couldn’t have been better, her responses were always quick and top tier whenever I needed anything. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Awesome place! Great location and neighborhood. Easy walk everywhere. The apartment is smaller than it appears in the photos but it wasn’t a problem for us. Would recommend.

Great flat close to shops and transport.
FYI, the flat is on the second floor and the steps from the ground and then up into the flat are steep and narrow. Not a massive issue unless you have mobility problems and something to consider if you are travelling with a couple of heavy suitcases.
Parking is difficult, only an hour in the surrounding streets between 8.30am and 10.00pm six days a week, so leave the car and use public transport.
Overall and excellent flat, very clean and well stocked for a few days stay.
A great choice for long stay. Lovely apartment and great host. Antonio is very pleasant and responsive. Highly recommend and would stay again.

Natalia was a great host. Her place was perfectly located. We comfortably fit four people in her flat. Her communication skills were amazing. She checked in on us to make sure everything was OK. If we stay in London again, we would certainly stay in Natalia’s place. Thank you so much for hosting us.

Photos

Oguz's flat was perfectly located, very private and spacious. The window overlooks a back alley, rather than the market, so it's not noisy. Everything you'd want is right there -- 24-hour food, coffee shops, some fabulous restaurants -- and Angel station is a 4-minute walk. Fabulous stay.

Fantastic location with all amenities needed. Responsive host who gave tips for luggage storage as this was not possible
In advance of check-in. Clear communication and expectations, would definitely return

The owners were helpful, when there was a problem it was fixed right away.
The location is amazing.
Lovely apartment and great location and they were really easy to communicate with. Thank you for a lovely stay.
Wonderful place! The location cannot be beat. Loved having two floors of living and super easy to navigate around the neighborhood.

The location wasn’t what I was expecting, right near Chelsea stadium and not very close to tourist sites.
It’s a townhouse with tons of stairs, I think there must be at least 5 floors, several of which are underground which felt very dark.
One of the bedrooms was facing a very loud and busy street, which meant it was too loud and noisy to sleep on properly. Every time a car went by, the headlights lit up the whole room and it was impossible to use.
Very unsuitable for families with young kids, due to stairs and noise.

You feel at home instantly when you arrive, because you can tell someone actually lives here (not just a staged, soulless Airbnb). The flat has everything you need (including a nice book collection), the beds are comfy, and the neighbourhood is quiet with cute shops and cafés nearby. It’s a little far from London’s main highlights, but it's well connected with the overground and buses — and easy to reach from Stansted.
Daniela was super friendly, easy to reach, and made sure we had everything we needed.

very clean, very comfortable and also def worth the price. If you’re on the street side it can be noisy but with the windows closed it’s perfectly fine (they also give u ear plugs) stayed for 3 nights and honestly loved it, would definitely recommend. showers were clean and the place had everything needed. location wise also super handy, close to public transport and also has a bunch of cute little bakeries and cafes around. walking distance from the nice streets in hackney and the park. thank you for everything!
Roomy and super convenient for getting around the city! We slept well, and appreciated the close proximity to the tube and lots of places to eat and shop.
Top shelf AirBnB host and accommodation - I would highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for a great stay!

Absolutely stunning property with unbeatable views of the London skyline. The location is perfect just a short walk to the IFS Cloud Cable Car, ExCeL, and the O2, with great transport links all around. The host, Kappy, was fantastic, clear, friendly, and made check-in and check-out effortless. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay. I’ll definitely be booking this place again.

I had such a lovely stay in this sweet studio flat. It was clean, cosy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location was convenient, and the space felt very welcoming. Perfect for a solo trip or a couple’s getaway. I’d happily stay again!

We had an absolutely fantastic stay! The apartment is spacious, comfortable, and had everything we could possibly need (and more). The host was wonderful, always responsive, kind, and flexible, which really made our trip easier.
The location is perfect: Victoria Station, St James’s Park, and Buckingham Palace are all within walking distance, with plenty of restaurants, pubs, cafés, and a Sainsbury’s nearby.
Little touches made a big difference, like finding an extra plug adapter just when we needed it, and great coffee ready for us to brew in the mornings.
Truly a perfect stay, highly recommended!

Very nice apartment, perfect location and a host who deliveres! Good communication and perfect hospitality.
Definitely coming back!

Really nice comfortable home in an excellent walkable location to everything. Lovely neighborhood! We (5 of us) were apparently the first guests at this BnB, and Sacha was super friendly. Although they were still in the midst of getting things ready for business that week, they  communicated well with us and made sure they delivered and dropped off all the things we needed for our stay. Very nice hosts :)

Harriet’s place was perfect! Very clean and the garden was lovely to sit in and have breakfast through to dinner. Was a definite sun trap. Rooms were tight but nothing wrong with them.
It was an easy check in and out and close to 2 overground stations. Harriet was quick to respond and checked in with us over the weekend.
A perfect host and a perfect property! :)
Hazel is a great host, very friendly she and her family make you feel at home. Lovely house to stay in. Highly recommend

Easy check in! Lovely and clean, super responsive and an amazing location. Not one thing to fault! A huge thank you! We loved our stay so much and had a lovely weekend with our friends & family. Thank you so much :)

I really enjoyed my stay here. The flat itself is very comfortable and cosy with everything you need, in a fantastic location, especially if you're going to watch the Arsenal! I'll definitely stay here again next time I'm in London.

- apartment had everything we needed
- good location
- good Indian close by
- really good transport links. Lots of options making it easy to get around to different places
- pictures are for the block rather than the specific apartment, but was still very nice!
Alessia was very responsive and gave clear instructions, the apt is very well located, clean and nice space to stay.
Nice stay, close to a lot of stuff whilst also being private area. Easy check in and lots of room there.

The apartment was perfect for us with the separate full bathrooms. Very easy to get around with public transport. Laura was easy to communicate with during the stay and gave us good local recommendations. Thank you for being a great host. Will definitely recommend this apartment.

The lovely garden flat was located on a quiet street off the main Streatham high Road, with several supermarkets. Lots of buses and not far from the train station.
The flat was modern and spacious, the large bedrooms and the beds were comfortable.
I would certainly recommend this property and the host Laura 🙂

everything was great and up to standards apart from the neighbours being so loud untill sunrise every night.
the hosts were great and would recommend

Danny is a great host - very responsive and helpful. Were arriving late in the evening but he was happy to accommodate us. The property is in his back garden with secure access. It is much larger than the photos showed and would be great for a longer stay as it is well equipped. Easy 2 minute walk to the nearest bus stop for access to Romford station & Elizabeth line (10 mins by bus, or 35 mins to walk). Would happily stay again

Very comfy with a homey feeling. It is very lovely place, rooms and bathroom are spacious, the living room is quite spacious  and not crowded. The home is a 12 minute walk from the mall which has all the shops you need.

During my visit to London, I stayed in Kingston. Rosie’s Airbnb was lovely—clean, comfortable, and perfectly located near both the train and bus stations. There are also some fantastic restaurants just a short walk away.

nice flat bit outside London but very convenient outside straight river stop of Uber ferry which takes you straight into London. Underground 5 min walk. 20 min you are downtown. 2 nice bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, super quiet. Slowly needs some renovation here&there meaning in general all fine.

Agat is a warm and wonderful host, and his apartment is easily one of the most comfortable I have stayed in. Every little detail and need had been anticipated and catered for. The location is also very close to public transport and a lot of shops
Unfortunately, the overall location and neighborhood doesn't quite match the apartment itself. The neighborhood could be cleaner, but that's not within his control.
I still give it 5 stars, because the apartment itself is fantastic and Agat is a wonderful host

A good location. Nice and close to Earl's Court Tube and local shops. The 4th floor apartment felt a bit smaller than we thought from the photos. Due to no air-con it was very warm and stuffy (okay, it was August and a warm weekend) - we had to keep the blinds down and windows shut all day and the fan running all night just to be able to sleep.
The fridge was useful but the rest of the kitchen area was pretty redundant due to lack of space and not wanting to heat the room up any more.
The bathroom was well stocked with an excellent shower.
Maybe a lower floor apartment would be better in warm weather but air-con would help.

Great location and lovely to have a court yard.
Basement bedrooms spacious and clean but damp smell .
Steps down also a little challenging for pregnant guest and unstable spindles .
Construction in flat above very noisy first evening but very considerate when we asked to stop.
Was great for 2 night stay.

Do NOT be put off that this is at the back of a council estate. It is a lovely clean room, a few minutes walk from Camden Tube station and offering all the delights of tendy Camden. There are shops and bars and restaurants all over the place and it is a short walk to Chalk Farm if you want the various markets.
Nice place to stay, clean, host was responsive and proactive. huge garden as well. Amenities are excellent

The house is stunning, beautifully clean and perfectly situated with easy access to the tube, overground, buses and other transport links. Dainius and Casey were incredibly helpful in resolving a minor issue which was quickly rectified. A great stay. The house was exactly as described and perfect for the 9 of us. Would definitely recommend and return.

This place is located in a nice quiet neighborhood with lots of great pubs, restaurants, and shopping nearby. The host was very helpful and the space was very clean. We would definitely stay here again.

Was a beautiful place with beautiful views. Totally enjoyed our stay at the property, we didn’t have to do heavy lifting as lift is available unlike other properties around. The apartment was clean with a lot of kitchen accessories.

Oguz’s place was in a great location where we could easily walk to the local underground. Plenty of handy supermarkets and eateries too.
Our only complaint was the noise of trucks offloading supplies at a loading dock during the night next door.
Had a great stay- it was a very cute flat, well located, and clean. Branca was very responsive and accommodating, would stay again!
This is a fantastic airbnb in a great location. The road is very quiet and the apartment is spotlessly clean. Mick was very helpful and responsive in his communication. I hope to stay again!

My second stay at James’ place and what I love about this Airbnb is the easy walk to the station, quiet street, the super comfortable bed and traditional decor which reminded me of home.
Additionally, James and his wife are both friendly and welcoming, James was always responsive and they are perfect examples of great hosts.
Would definitely stay again - it’s a gem of room in a beautiful home, on a lovely street. In fact, I don’t want others to book this so I can keep the place for myself! 😁
Thanks for another lovely week James!

We had a wonderful stay at Dominics cosy Apartment. Dominic is a very friendly host who welcome us and gave us very useful  Information when we arrived. Stratford Station and Shops are nearby. We really recommend this Place for visitors who want to explore London.

The hosts were super accommodating and helpful, even when contacted lateeeee at night for check-in. The place was spacious and perfect for our get away! they also provided very clear instructions to get inside, as well as local things to go and see which was extra and very nice

Our little home in London was in a great location. Only about 1klm from Tower bridge/Tower of London and Tower Hill tube station.Located on the 3rd floor of a modern apartment block we felt very secure and a service station and McDonald across the road was great for those little groceries and food. Walking distance from St Katherine Docks and great old Pub. We very much enjoyed our stay.

Great communication, great location for a wedding we were attending.
The place was nice but just a couple of points that would make it better:
Parking should not be an add on extra cost as it’s literally in front of the house.
Also the fish tank in the bedroom was a bit too loud!
Other than that it did the job!
Rosie’s place is conveniently located near Kingston station and town center. The neighbourhood is quiet. Rosie as a host is very good at communicating.

I booked this place last minute and the hosts were kind enough to offer me a great discount despite the short notice. The response from the team was insanely quick—every question I had was answered within seconds.
The Airbnb itself was perfect for our group. The place was spotless, and the location was absolutely brilliant. It’s literally in the heart of London but not too deep in central, which made it perfect. Plenty of shops are within walking distance.
The check-in instructions were very clear and straightforward. I will 1000% book this place again when I come back to London.
Thank you very much, guys!🥰🥰

It was clean and nice. The place is small, but enough for 4 people, especially when you'll be sightseeing every day. The beds were comfortable, kitchen was also great.
The only con is the noise from the neighbours - it's not something the owner has a control over, but just a heads up, they can be loud at times.
Overall, I'm very happy with the place and if i ever come back to london I'd consider booking it again, thanks for the great time :)
Had a great time, room has a beautiful view of the city. Clean modern space with a lot of amenities. Definitely worth it.

The location is very good. The landlord is also very nice. But when we checked in, there was a tenant in the refrigerator who didn't throw away the leftover food. The garbage bag has not been replaced.

Overall place was great! Very warm, we even had to sleep with windows open. Area is great and very close to tube. Getting there from LHR is so easy with direct Elizabeth line.
Apartment is quite big, which is rare for London.
It was overall clean, but some areas felt like cleaning company did not really spend time actually cleaning. Eg when you transform sofa into bed, there were a lot of dust and hair. And we found someone’s nail under the table.
Host was very responsive and always available. Building is very safe and quiet.
It was worth the money.
Was comfortable for 3 people. Even though we ended up not using sofa bed as it wasn’t the most comfortable to sleep.

Loved our stay here !! HIGHLY RECOMMEND if you want to be at a walking distance from all main attractions and literally two mins from the tube station that’s so well connected, you need to book this place now. The apartment itself was very clean and comfortable. Thoughtfully done and Natalia has taken little things to consideration. Feels like home when you check in. Perfect for a family of 4.

Thank you so much for everything. We had an amazing time and enjoyed our stay at your home. There were three adults and one 8-year-old child. The location was great. The underground was much closer than I thought, and there was also a bus, line 55, which takes you to Oxford Circus/Piccadilly and stops right next to the house. The house was great, very clean and had everything you need for a wonderful stay. You don't need anything else. Very convenient and easy to get to and from. There are supermarkets nearby where you can buy food for breakfast, lunch or dinner, as the kitchen is very well equipped. I would definitely come back again. Thank you very much for all.

Great experience!! 10/10, they were so helpful, fast responding, the area was so walkable!! So many things are close by walking distance, the underground was so close and it even felt safe walking back there at night. Even the people around the area were nice, there’s a coffee shop just a few doors down which was delicious and so convenient! And the place itself was fantastic, super clean, super cozy, definitely recommend staying here!
This is my partner and i’s 2nd time at this place and it is 10/10 , will definitely be back again.
We had an amazing stay at Michael’s place. The apartment was very beautiful and spacious. Neighbourhood was nice, relaxing and quiet. Michael was a great host.
Very responsive host. Something came up and she let us cancel our stay early and provided a refund!!!
We spontaneously spent a night at Anne’s place. Everything worked out perfectly on short notice. Thank you so much for everything :)

not quiet as expected, the photos looked great,so we chose the accommodation over others in the area, but as it seams to be a running problem in the area, the property doesn't match how good the photos are, we was disappointed and wouldn't stay again.

We absolutely loved Sabrina’s flat! 🩷 from her fantastic collection of plants and the lovely big windows, Sabrina’s cosy, light filled flat was perfect for us. Communication was spot on and we had everything we needed. It’s in a great location directly on the canals and close to excellent waterfront bars and restaurants and 5 mins to the overground. I’d recommend it. Five stars! ⭐️
Found this place in a great spot near our office. Everything went well the host was quick to respond and made the whole process easy. Really appreciated how smooth and hassle free it was.
Amazing stay, would absolutely stay here again! They also have a very helpful guide book that I would highly recommend!

Great little apartment in trendy neighbourhood. Right next to the station which is really well connected to key areas of London. Quality bed, silent at night, clean, accurate, easy check-in and responsive host.
Fantastic place, with great amenities and stunning views. Anna as a host was very helpful and proactive, would highly recommend her flat!

Daniela’s flat was the perfect spot for a few days in London! Our group was familiar with the neighborhood and loved having easy access to stoke newington and busses and TFL system. The flat was clean and cozy but just what we needed. Lockbox instructions and communication was easy. Thanks, Daniela!
We had a great stay, although we experienced some hiccups with the WiFi connection but Akram came through and got it back working for us. Nice comfortable place for a quick stay. Thank you

Sacha is a great host. I mixed up my booking ,I have no where to stay at night of my arrival, yet she accommodated me. Just by updating my airbnb booking. the place is accessible to a supermarket and bus stop is just 4 mins away. it was a good experience.
thank you, Sacha. I will definitely come back.☺️☺️
An amazing location for those who wants to be around Hampstead Garden superb and to Hampstead parks.
The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Jan was quick to respond and made everything smooth and easy. I’d definitely recommend staying here, it's ideal for wembly stadium.
Was a great stay! 15 minute walk from the train station. Very comfy bed and great shower, always warm water! Was a lovely stay and would definitely recommend
A very nice stay at Olumide’s Airbnb. The place was clean and beautiful. Olumide was very helpful with any issues and was kindly at our aid throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

Thank you for the lovely stay for our holiday in London! The area is convenient, with cafes, restaurants, groceries and the train stop Earl’s Court nearby. The checkin instructions were very easy (with a video and description), and the host is responsive and helpful. We love the aesthetic of the flat, great interior and furniture!
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and everything went smoothly. Would definitely recommend!
Very responsive, always attend promptly to any issues. Tee went all the way to get us fans during the hottest day. Kind host.

The place is in a great location close to central. The place was tidy and exactly what I needed for 1 night. I wouldnt recommend more than 2 nights if I am honest, bed isn’t all that and you get a lot of commotion / police on the high street outside.
Cant fault the place price wise for what it is.
Host was great with communication and for what I needed it for, it was fine.
Also the blinds need sorting abit, really tatty

Flat is in a really convenient place. We were at an exhibition at Olympia and it is so handy for that and Westfield shopping.
It’s on the basement level and the conservatory makes a lovely place for happy mealtimes!

A very comfortable place to stay when you are in London. There is a bus stop right across the street and it is a very frequent one to reach the center. The house has all the amenities one can need and the hosts are very responsive.
Thank you.

We had a great experience. Everything was on point. From arrival to departure. The host was also friendly and made us feel at home.
Easy to locate. The facilities were top grade. Love the bathroom
Really good value for money.

Enjoyed our stay here - a friend and I stayed for one night for a gig and it was ideal to crash and only 20 min walk from the Electric Brixton venue. As I think other reviews say, I wouldn’t book again if I had to stay in the air b n b all day or for more than a night, as it is in the basement and is a small space. The mattress is pretty worn/not v comfortable, and the shower is also pretty small, but we did know the latter beforehand. But absolutely serviceable/clean otherwise.
Darryl was great at responding/communicating!

Michael was so easy to communicate with from start to finish. The property was exactly as described. It was very clean which we appreciated. Loved having a back garden. It was a little messy when we arrived but it was cleared while we were there which made a difference. There was plenty of cleaning products and garbage bags so didn’t have to buy anything. The storage place in the bedroom was very good.  We were very happy with the flat and we would definitely book it again when coming to see our son in London.
A beautifully presented 2 bedroom terraced house, in a quiet neighbourhood. Which was exactly what we needed, was helpful with travel instruction (there was a tube strike on ) would highly recommend
Billie was so responsive, kind and always ready to help with anything and everything we needed! Thank u Billie for being an amazing host <3 100% RECOMMENDED :)

I absolutely enjoyed my stay, the neighbourhood was great and full of many stores that reminded me of home, the bed was nice and comfy so nothing to complain about, Laura is an amazing host as well :)

Jenny was a friendly and accommodating host who went above and beyond for our stay. She greeted us and made us feel comfortable in the space before leaving, whilst providing us with useful information of the surrounding area. We stayed at Jenny’s for a gig at Wembley Stadium and we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay - it was so close to the stadium; we were back into the home within 20 minutes (taking into account the masses of people coming out of the stadium after Coldplay!) We are looking forward to returning to the property when the opportunity arises and cannot fault our stay at all. Thank you so much again, Jenny! ☺️

Charaf was great. Really communicated very well. Apartment I’d great for two people and when Charaf finishes his plan’s it’ll be a great place to stay. Really close to three tube stations and Westfield London.
Loved it. Will use again next time we’re in town.
Wonderful.  Anne is very friendly, very welcoming and very knowledgeable about the area and things to do.

A lovely place to stay, comfortable, clean and friendly - Anne is a great hostess - helpful and charming. I loved the bedroom and the bed was a dream - I haven't slept so well in ages! I can't wait to return. My only fear is that too many people get to know what a good place this is!!
Sadly, I was too ill to travel, but my Hostess was most understanding. I will certainly look forward to staying there in future.

Our stay at Robin´s was really nice. Although we unfortunately didn´t meet, we were supplied with every information we needed - from traveling around over shopping facilities, eating out - to milk and coffee in the flat at our arrival....
The flat is in good condition and easy to find in a seven minutes walk from the tube-station.
The surrounding is clean and silent which is really great after a busy day in the city.

Found everything as described. Nice place with the added touch of Oyster cards provided as well as a laptop with lots of info about the area.
Location is great, near Camden Town and its markets but also easy access to public transport and the West End.

This place was a good place to stay. Robin was helpful and non-intrusive. We found it easy to get the bus and tube to travel all over london. The four flights of stairs didn't bother us. We would definitely stay there again.
A great deal.
Very kind host, and smooth communication, enjoyed staying very much. Easy access to the town by few buses, and close to the park!
THE place to be, so nice house, so nice people in a quiet district close to many parcs, canal, and transport. hope we will have opportunity to get back!

Anne was a very welcoming host. Accommodation was in a perfect location only a stone's throw from Battersea Park - one of the best parks in London. I didn't take public transport, opting to walk through the park and along the Thames to work in the morning. It took me 45 minutes to Lambeth Bridge and was the most stress-free journey to work I've ever had. Bed was very comfortable. Shower was hot. Dogs were very friendly. It felt like a proper home from home.
It was a great experience! At Anne's place I felt like at home! She was lovely and the room was very comfortable! I hope I will be back soon to see Anne, the dogs and... London!

I enjoyed my stay very much. The twin room is spacious and very comfortable. Anne is a very gracious host and very accomodating regarding hours, luggage dropoff etc. Close to bus routes and Battersea Park.

Had a comfortable stay here.  Didn't have any problems.   Price was very reasonable compared to many other central properties.  Tube station is really near to property, which made getting to and from Julias easy.  I didn't have much contact with Julia, but when I did, she was helpful and pleasant. Thanks to Julia and her mum.
staying in Anne´s house was very nice. she is very, very sweet, the room is very cosy and the house also cosy and very clean. she has two very nice dogs.

Ula was a fabulous host.. She had great advice for local eats/pubs, and was incredibly helpful with managing the train system - turns out there is a gorgeous walk through the woods to the Sydenham Hill station - just a handful of stops to London Victoria.
The room we stayed in was lovely - she has just recently done a substantial refurbishment and it all felt very homely and comfortable.
I would highly recommend staying at Ula's place!

Julia was a great host who avails herself to accomodate my check in/check out time. The room is as the pictures on airbnb show, thus you can rely on the pictures. Room is clean and tidy. The bed was comfortable as well. Only drawback was the location is a bit off from city center. Tube station (Shepherd's Bush market) is very close though. Would recommend if you have the luxury of time to explore London slowly.

nice flat,great location and reasonable price.
overall great place where to stay in london

The appartment was really great clean and comfy. This place is like home with everything you need towels, bed sheets, shampoo and so on. Morever the location is perfect : restaurants and stores just in the neighbourhood.
Paolo gave us a bigger appartment than the initial one and it was really awesome and so kind for him to do it. He is very welcoming.
very satisfied of my stay with Richard. He was very kind and helpful, no problem recommending him to other guests!

Julia was very responsive and welcoming. If it's summer/good weather this apartment would be perfectly located between the beach(es) and the centre of town. It's also well-priced compared with other more expensive options in Santander.

As I was staying again at Richard’s home, it was a pleasure.
Richard is very nice . The room is very nice too.
Very well located place.
Paolo is a super fun host :D Lovely place, really AWESOME location, couldn't ask for anything more central :D

very pleasant, very clean room.  Just what I needed for a 4-day stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay with Richard again.  Richard himself personable and helpful.  Two small issues I had were that the main shower was out-of-action but it wasn't a big problem, and its located at the top of a hill, which made for great views but weary legs :-)

My family stayed here for 3 weeks and though it was small and basic, it had everything they needed - decent bedroom, bathroom and kitchen with all the essentials. Paolo was friendly, professional and available to help iron out any issues along the way - a big thanks to him. We would both recommend this place and stay here again in future. Great value for fantastic central London location.

I am a new user of air b&b and found Paola's apartment to be excellently located and clean. He is extremely helpful and friendly. The apartment is in a safe area close to transport and shopping. As a single girl traveller I would recommend this apartment.
The room was very  comfortable and Richard was a kind, gracious and helpful host! Definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in the Greenwich area!

A brilliant studio in a marvelous location within 5-10min walk to Oxford Street. The flat has a very nice, clean, modern design with new furnishings. The bathroom is to a very good standard with a very nice shower facility. Which is quite important to me, as I'm a bit OCD when it comes to the bathroom!! Overall it has everything you need for a lovely stay in London.
Paolo was an excellent host, very polite, it was a pleasure to stay in he's studio flat. I would stay again

A great location and an excellent host. The flat is about 5 minutes walk from Oxford Circus so is perfectly located for exploring Central London. We arrived a little early and instead of making us wait Paolo took our bags into the office and moved them into the flat before he left allowing us to spend longer exploring London. He also had a lovely conversation with us checking that we knew where we were going and what we were doing.

The flat was excellent having been newly refurbished. It has a TV and a full kitchen and a small but perfect bathroom.

A perfect place to stay, we'll definitely be returning.

The studio is very comfortable with nice modern fixtures, in an excellent location and easy to get to other parts of London from. The double bed which folds down from the wall is very comfortable. Paolo is a welcoming host. The light bulb in the shower room went on the first evening, Paolo was quick to get hold of a new lightbulb for us that same evening. The wifi was a little unreliable but everything else was great! Would definitely recommend this place, had a great stay.

Richard was a lovely host! But we had a couple of minor issues - a broken radiator (now fixed) meant the room was very cold and the supplied heater was noisy. The shower was also out of commission, and the pillows could do with replacing. But the view was lovely, the bed was perfectly comfortable, and Richard did what he could to help.

Very good location and very pleasant guest!! We had a great time in London walking around from such a central location (10 min walk from Oxford Circus!!! :P) or taking the tube for further places (3 stations to choose from depending on what line you want to go!!)
and cherry on top : good Italian restaurant/take away at the corner of the street :D























I certainly advise
Everything was as described. Lovely room and I had a great time. I'd definitely go back there again. Thank you!

I stayed at Julia's for two weeks and it was great!
Very nice, clean room with lots of storage, good bed and your own fridge and sink. The location is also really nice, very close to Shepherds Bush Market Station and a small walk from Shepherds Bush Station.
The room itself feels very homey and you can have your privacy if you want to. The kitchen with microwave and the washing machine was also convenient for my longer stay. I would definitely recommend this room to anyone!

Very nice place ! Paolo has renovated and configured this little flat in a quiet little courtyard. A lot of fourniture are also available in the flat. Paolo is an available and very welcoming host. Great location close to the city center. We will definitely return.
Good stay at Anne's, nice room, nice host and great big park right next door!

We stayed four nights at Anne Abel's home and we enjoyed it. The room was spacious, warm and very clean ; good breakfast too. Anne was very helpful.
Dog's very friendly and quiet. The local transport is only at 20mm to Victoria's station. Good place to stay.

We are two couples and  found Tim’s comfortable and spacious apartment the perfect place for our stay in London. It is in a quiet location overlooking the Regent’s Canal, yet just around the corner from a supermarket, vibrant Camden High Rd, and the underground for a quick trip to central London. The apartment had everything we needed plus many thoughtful extras such as an espresso machine and printer. Tim was very friendly and helpful and was quick in responding to my emails.  The apartment key is kept in a key safe on the property which made arrival and departure very simple. Thank you Tim, we had a wonderful stay and will recommend your apartment to our family and friends in Australia.

House that seemed to appear in the photographs. Everything you need and more was taking place at home. The heating system was working fine. Sheets, towels and house overall was clean. The design of the house was perfect. All equipment in the kitchen to prepare food at home was taking place. Write everything you can take a very long time. To sum up Tim's flat is excellent. I would recommend it to anyone.
Urszula is a very warm and communicative host. The house is great and the room comfortable. Travel to central London, if you're happy to walk 10 minutes to the station, is no problem.

We loved everything about the place!
The location is great - close to all possible types of transport, lots of places to eat, shops, everything, but still a very quiet and a calm place.
The apartment itself is very comfy and cozy, fully equipped with a great terrace and a BBQ
Tim was great to communicate with, I received responses immediately.
Would recommend and stay there myself again!
Our stay was really great. Marcos` flat is beautiful, very clean and only a few steps away from all you need (supermarket, tube ...). Marco was a great host and kindly straightforward. Thumbs up!

I was a little hesitant but very pleased with my first Airbnb experience!! What a great find and value for the money!!! Aj was a wonderful host during our stay in London. He was always available if I had questions or needed anything. The property is very clean, well kept and very convenient to shopping, great restaurants and the train station. I have already referred a few friends to stay with Aj and my husband and I are planning to return in January. I highly recommend!!
An amazing well equipped apartment, perfectly located to explore London. The hosts communication and help/advice also was excellent and help aid the trip . I would highly recommend

The location of Anne's home was fantastic. One short bus ride from her home to Victoria Station, and downtown London. Her location to Battersea park is also key. When London gets to be too busy, and you want a break, the Park is at your doorstep.
Ann is a fabulous hostess. Kind, helpful, and interested in knowing you are having a good time. The room was bright and cheery, and her home was organized and clean.
I wholeheartedly recommend this BNB location to anyone visiting London.

AJ is a polite, friendly and helpfull guy. He's appartment is in a perfect location near Camden and tube station, it is a very new and clean room. A very good place to stay. In the night is very quite, you don't hear mutch the traffic from the road. This guaranties you a good sleep at night. If I go to London again, I will come to he's place again.

The room is exactly the same than I could looking it up on web. The quartier is quiet and you have shops and market near. You can go walking to Notting Hill and Portobelo. Two Undregroud Station only walking 5 or 10 minutes. Very convenient if you arrived at Heathrow Airport. I only met Julia for some minutes so I can't tell anything about her. Everything was, more or less, good. The only thing didn't work properly was the shower.

I really enjoyed the stay in Marco's nice and lightful appartment. The key hand-over was very easy thanks to a key locker I was able to open myself. I tried to get a flat to very last minute and Marco was very helpful and flexible to support me. His documentation & FAQs about the flat is perfect. The location is not really downtown but the tube is a few meters away and get you quickly into the center or to the Excel exhibition center. Definitely a spot to recommend.

As my first experience of Airbnb, Aj was absolutely a perfect host. He was very friendly and helpful.
The place is brand new with modern and amazing decoration. There is even a lovely garden where you could enjoy sunshine.
The location is convenient as well, really, just 2 mins walk from the station. There are many nice bars, restaurants and a big Sainsbury around.
The Camden market is quite famous and busy as well. Worth taking a look.
I strongly recommend it to all, Aj and his lovely modern places are smart choices if you want to enjoy London with such a reasonable price.
Great location, with fantastic views over almost all of London from the attic room. Richard was very welcoming and accommodating, thanks for everything!

it was my first experience with Airbnb and I am satisfied.
As we arrived, Tess greeted us with a smile - obviously, she has all the time!
The apartment is warm, comfortable, clean, new.
it is very functional.
2 spacious bedrooms, one is very large.
the living room is extended by a veranda: TOP.
Kitchen facilities are recent.
A minor annoyance: the proximity of the railway line.

The place is very convenient for visiting London overground, underground, buses, Whose night nozzles).
supermarkets and all shops.
The area is very quiet
I recommend!
Thierry

I Booked this house for my brother and his family and everything was great.
Asa and Howard were very helpful and friendly ... even when we had a little trouble with the washing machine ;-)
It was really brilliant having my brother stay around the block from in a beautiful house instead of in some generic hotel.
The room is liko on the pictures. Tidy and enough space for luggage. Her mother was also helpful when I got questions

The apartment was great! Very comfortable, cosy, with lots if unusual and quirky things around to make it a bit more interesting than your typical London flat. Bert was very friendly and accommodating too.
The room was clean and comfortable. The host was friendly and accommodating. Use of small kitchen area including fridge and microwave was a welcome bonus!

The flat was small but compact, very bright and central. The underground is very close and there are a great network of buses nearby at the Surrey Dock shopping centre. It is a place I would stay in again.

Sophie's flat is bright, spacious and modern. Ideally located between Camden Town and Islington, one has access to a wide range of activities, restaurants and transportation options. If you are looking for a chance to explore the London that locals live, this is your spot.

Had a brilliant weekend in Tim's apartment. Lovely bright apartment with and classy neutral colour scheme throughout right in the middle of Camden Town.  Great location for getting around on the Northern Line and the walk/jog along the canal in either direction to Regents Park one way and Kings Cross in the other direction made it a perfect place to start the day.  After a day of shopping/sightseeing coming back to the apartment for a gorgeous shower and then wine on the balcony was just perfect.  It was an added bonus being able to park the car securely as well. Thanks Tim

Greenwich is a great place to see London but feel relaxed. Richards home is very handy for all forms of transport and the attic room has charm and a very comfortable sofa bed. We enjoyed our short time there. Thank you Richard.

Marco communicated well by txt/airbnb and gave us adequate instructions for access and use of his apartment. He responded promptly to any concerns or questions. He was flexible and obliging with regard to check-out time.
The apartment is small but light and bright with good availability of wardrobe/drawer space and of fridge and pantry space. It is well-equipped for self-catering.
The location is very convenient for overground/underground and buses.
The outlook onto Southwark Park is very pleasant, and the bedroom is quiet. The area felt safe.
The steep stairs are something of a challenge for older folk (ourselves!) and the steps within the apartment often caught us out.
Over-all, a good experience and value for money. Recommended.
Ian and Janet

This apartment was lovely. It was immaculate throughout. It is light, bright and airy and was a very pleasant place to stay. The location is excellent, close to a number of train and tube stations and very close to the main road to easily hail a cab. Tim was friendly and helpful throughout all communications.
