The flat is close to the tube and Overground stations, a couple of stops on 1 line to all the main attractions in London. Tesco is very close by, which is convenient for groceries. Flat is clean and comfortable.

Shelly's home is, as already described by the other guests, lovely, cosy and nice furnished  appartment in a quite neighborhood very near to the center of London. Shelly is a very nice person, she responded to our questions immediately and help us to prepare for our trip as best as possible. I definitely recommend her appartment!
Great communication from the host, great location, easily reach many parts of London in 15 mins. the apartment was spacious, clean and in a quiet neighborhood. Highly recommended! Thanks Robin

The place was in a great location, with the bus and tube stations very close by. Robin welcomed us on the first day and was very friendly, giving us tips on places to eat and drink nearby and also on general London touristy stuff. Overall a great experience.

Monica was just lovely and very communicative. Upon arrival, she was nothing but helpful and friendly. As I stayed for a conference at the Olympia, this was a great place to relax and easy access to the conference. It was also so nice to have so many restaurants and only a short walk to get to the Westfield shopping mall! Wonderful stay and highly recommend it!

Simon's place is in an excellent location, in a residential street but very close to the trendy shops and cafés of Westbourne Grove and Notting Hill Gate, and a stone's throw from Portobello Road. Easy access to everything you need including groceries, public transport, hairdressers...!  Spacious and clean with a very well equipped kitchen and a large and lovely conservatory bathroom.

Thank you so much Nina, I had a wonderful time staying in your flat. This is one of the rare occasions where the flat actually reflects the images on air bnb. Next time I come to London I will definitely be checking if this flat is available!

Very cute and clean spot. The yard/garden was wonderful. Short walk to Bakerloo line @ Queen's Park station made it easy to get around. Overground train was a bit noisy but not too bad. Would stay there again. :)

We had a great stay! The apartment is very cool and close to some amazing restaurants, cafes, and shops in Notting Hill! It was also just a short walk to the tube, so it was easy to get to other areas in London!
Very clean and nice room, which is pretty close to the tube and supermarkets. The host is so friendly and helpful. We had a very good time here. I will definitely recommend this room.
Lovely property, helpful owner and a perfect location to get into London. Highly recommend. Thanks!

Tom's place is incredibly charming - his home is very clean, uniquely furnished, and well situated for getting around to other parts of London. The neighborhood is quiet and quaint, but close to all the activity that Notting Hill has to offer, so definitely take time to explore the neighborhood such as Portobello Market while venturing out to other parts of London as well. Tom thoroughly provides all the details needed, which was extremely helpful for our stay. The mezzanine bed was a cool experience, and his home receives tons of natural lighting during the day when the sun is out. Definitely recommend this place!

We got all we expected from our stay in Robins apartment. Great location and although we never met (no fault on Robins behalf) Robin provided all the information we needed including the use of a computer and opal tickets. Your help was appreciated Robin and for us the whole week was perfect
Thanks again

We stayed in this cute and cozy flat for 3 nights. The owners are lovely people and were very attentive, made sure we had everything we needed during our stay.
I Would definitely stay here again!
Thank you!

We had an amazing week in this perfectly situated flat. It had everything we needed, close to tube and restaurants. The communication was perfect and checking in was seamless. The neighborhood was quiet, clean and convenient. The flat was lovely and filled with light. I would highly recommend a stay at Sian's.

Tess's place is perfect for a family exploring London. Public transport is an easy walk to either the underground from Queens Park, or the bus from Kilburn High Road. We found the underground took us everywhere we needed to go with ease. The apartment is warm and cosy and bedding very comfortable. Tess provides little extras which make the place very homely and allow for a family to easily self-cater. The kitchen is well equipped, and the ability to wash and dry clothing is fabulous when traveling. We had a wonderful stay.

Lovely! The rooms are perfectly clean, and beautifully decorated. We loved the addition of a private lounge, stunning decor and a handy TV. (The shower is also amazing!). Isabelle provides a smashing breakfast perfect to set you up for the day with real coffee and her famous banana bread! Isabelle was a super host, friendly, approachable and not intrusive at all. Isabelle gave great advice on transport for getting around London and provided s super map which she annotated to fit our travel plans and needs. Isabelle even recommended little pockets of London to explore during our stay after listening to what were were interested in and what sort of things we were looking for. Would definitely recommend.

I was a solo traveler seeing London for the first time, so a safe and private flat was exactly what I needed.
This flat was PERFECT -- clean, well-equipped, safe, and convenient. Definitely would be staying at this flat again the next time I visit London!

Clean, spacious and fantastic location. Comfy bed. Quiet location, despite being close to shops, restaurants, tube and market. Well appointed flat. Recommend checking out the Amy Winehouse exhibition at the Jewish Museum, which is close by.

Isabelle, you are a wonderful hostess!  We really appreciated your flexibility, generousity, and warmth.  Your place is charming, breakfast was delicious, and the neighborhood was just right.  It was a real pleasure staying with you! Sincerely, Joshua and Marjorie.
The house was just what was needed. Beds, cooking equipment, hot showers and parking. Vikash was welcoming responding to any problems we had. It was a great stay.

The room is lovely exactly as described as well as the on-suite bathroom. Very confortable and clean. The house is in a lovely and quiet road. It was my first time in the area and I liked it very much.
I highly recommended it if you need to be around.
Wonderful and helpful host!

We had a good stay at Tracy's place. It is located nearby a Tube Station, and in walking distance (20 min) of Brick Lane.
The appartment is beatifully furnished and suited for a longer stay.
The beds could use an upgrade (quite tiny and hard). And we were bothered by the street noises at night.
Tracy and Justin gave us a very warm welcome!

Steve's flat was the perfect location for us being a short walk from the tube, parks, shops and buses. It was light and bright, easy to manage and stress-free for a young family of four visiting family and friends. We'll definitely stay again!

Flat is a good value, well located for getting around by bus, Overground line or Jubilee line. Tesco supermarket right behind it is a luxury. Quiet at night. Ideal for one or two, add a third guest only for a short stay.
The stay was great. Awesome location right next to a tube station and several coffee shops. The apartment was clean and as pictured. Check in was a breeze. Justin was friendly and helpful!
This was my second stay with Anne and it was so nice to already be familiar with the area. Anne made sure we had everything we needed. It was like coming to friend's house to stay.

Great location!
Had an amazing time in London.
So close to good food (the Shed, the Mall Tavern) and attraction (Hyde park, Kensington Palace)
Check in was very easy, super prompt response to any communication I had with Max and Billie
Would definitely stay with them again

I thoroughly enjoyed my one night at Anne's.  I must admit I was a literary apprehensive about how well I would sleep as it was a really hot day In London, but Anne was helpful enough to suggest I sleep on the bed next to the window. Anne was great at keeping touch with me with regard to my ETA and was at home when she said.  Anne explained everything really well! The home on a relatively quiet street and the bedroom I was in was on ground floor facing the leafy back yard, very picturesque! A lovely room and comfy bed! I will try to book again the next time I'm coming from to London!

Tt is very responsive. Her place is very close to a Tube station so it was easy to get to different sightseeing spots via public transportation. Nearby her house there are two small supermarkets  which turned out to be very helpful for us to get beverages, snacks, and fruits. The beds in our room are clean and comfortable.

Anne's double room is comfortable and quiet. Anne is very welcoming. The location a few minutes from Battersea Park down a quieter street which is good. Half a hours walk through the Park over a bridge and we arrived a Chelsea Flower Show. Would use Anne again and highly recommend her.

Like everyone else has commented, I really appreciated the location of the apartment and the comfortable setup within itself. Justin was a very good host too in that he communicated the instructions very clearly and checked in on my stay. Overall, I had a great time staying in his place and London!
We had an amazing time at Carolyn's funky apartment. The neighbourhood was very cute, the host lovely, and the rooms picture-perfect!

Simons place was perfect location for us.  Close to the tube lines circle and central lines.  With those lines you can get to anywhere in London in no time.  The place was quite and nice.  Pictures were accurate.  It was great to have washer and dryer in the place.  We did laundry every day as we only did carry on for our trip. If we come back to London we would stay here in a heartbeat.

Very comfortable flat in a residential and quite location. Very easy access to Kew Gardens which was the first aim of our trip.
On walking distance to Kew village and its lovely monthly market, pubs and small shops.
I fully recommend it to get a taste of the nice suburban London life.
Rosie was very helpful about our needs.

Lovely flat, good location close to the train station and Regent's Park, comfortable bed. No bath soap was a surprise, and the wifi speed and signal were very poor. Also it is up a flight of steep and narrow stairs so just be aware for those that might be a problem for.

Anne is a lovely, friendly host and her place is in a great location.  It's so easy to get into Central London as there are many bus/train connections, as well as being situated just around the corner from Battersea Park and various good restaurants and bars. You will no be disappointed!

Isabelle's place is just perfect. all the stars for location, value, comfort, conversation and BANANA BREAD!!!!! I would highly recommend it. The walk from the tube station is quaint, safe and enjoyable. And Isabelle is a gem with her recommendations and kindness. :))

We had a great stay at Justins appartment.  Super clean, great communications and in a nice area. Justin was a great host and was in touch with us and asked if we had any questions when we arrived. I can absolutely reccommend this place to anyone who wants to have an "own" place in London.

I went with two friends for a weekend to the Aky's apartament  and he was very nice with us and very patient with us. The apartament is in very good situation. If you go to London I recommend without doubt Aky's apartament.

Really good house with clean environment and good price. Although it is in Zone2, the transport is very convenient to get anywhere in Zone 1. The host is responsible and very kind. Really good airbnb experience.

Rosie's place and Rosie was just fabulous! Rosie was very helpful throughout - checking in; offering honest suggestions about the area etc. The apartment itself was very clean and quiet - and everything was just perfect. Thank you Rosie for being a genuine and excellent host! Would definitely recommend :-)

Vikash's home it's really big for London, with 4 big rooms at the second floor and a big kitchen and living room at the bottom. So clean it seemed brand new. Perfect communication with him, so I'd recommend his place to anyone :)

I stayed in this flat for almost two weeks, and I felt totally at home there. Bert was super easy and reliable for checking in and out. The neighborhood is nice, and the location of the flat, just two minutes away from the canal and Broadway Market, is great. The building cleanliness is not super, but acceptable. Good value for money all in all.

Lovely room in a great location with easy connections to London centre. Anne is the perfect host and more than happy to chat with you and in my case, help me with a few things I needed to sort. Would love to stay again.

The place is as described. It's a off the main road but close to a store and a 10 minute walk to the overground station. The hosts recommended The White Swan as a pub and place to eat- they were right best food in the area we had. The hosts are amazing and the communication is great. Really great place and close to Heathrow for flights but you don't hear the air traffic.  All in all a wonderful experience.
A lovely and. Imfirtabke house in a convenient location close to the tube. Hosts were very responsive to our minor questions. Would certainly recommend it

As real estate agents say, location, location, location. We did so much of the "big ticket" items in London in because we were within a 20 minute walk of them. Trafalgar Square, Parliament, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, Cleopatra's Needle, London Eye, British Museum, Benjamin Franklin's House, London Underground, London Train... all within a 20 minute walk. We stayed with our sons age 14 and 11.
The accommodations were adequate and the location was incredible.
The apartment is in a busy part of the city, but the windows are great for muting nearly all of it.

Charming, romantic and equipped with everything you could possibly need in the heart of London. Superb location with the tube, bakery, food stores and other shops on the doorstep; theatres just minutes away. But the flat itself is an attraction - filled with art, books and comfortable club lounges, it's a very quiet and comfortable retreat. A dream pad for us.
Richard's place was perfect for my needs. Comfortable bed, nice and quiet and central location to greenwich. Would use again.
We had a wonderful stay in Leyton/London, thanks to the hospitality of Megan's family.
Isabelle's B&B is really more than a room to stay at London. It's like your friend's place or your home. Love everything in Isabelle's flat.
Stay was nice and clean. However host did not contact us at all regarding check in which was annoying. Overall good stay close to the tube.

We loved our stay in Monica's very charming place - it's a perfect place to return to after a busy day.
The central tube line is near, shop for groceries nearby, cinema and Westfield all within a very short walk. The appartment has all you need, is clean & cosy with a garden of flowers. Thank you, we shall return.
Spacious, nicely renovated and decorated english house. Perfect for families. Breakfast amenities were great suprise. We had amazing week, thanks Orla!

This experience was all aces. Megan kept in touch with me, initial access was easy, the location is travel friendly, the neighborhood is quiet, and the home is lovely. I highly recommend this place to any family visiting this area of London.

Marc's place was great, very close to the subway/metro and a local market place, and bar/grill.
I would definitely stay again

Chris was an excellent host, very welcoming and wanted to ensure I enjoyed my stay. The apartment is amazing. Very well located, being a few minutes walk from the tube station, Wimbledon village and the tennis.
The place itself has been finished to a very high standard and has extra features which placed it above my expectations; with the rain shower, the 10' ceilings, touch control skylight, sensory room lights, abundant storage space and private exterior space...could have stayed there longer!

Richard has been an amazing host. The attic room is clean and very comfortable. Richard’s place is located about 10 min walk to the DLR station and walkable distance to the observatory and cutty-sark museum. There are also quite a few decent restaurants and pubs nearby, very convenient if you fancy a relaxing drink and snacks after spending a day in the city. Richard also prepared quite a volume of guiding information both for central London and for the neighborhood, very useful especially if you are touring Greenwich for the first time. We really had a great stay and look forward to coming back soon.
Very close to the center of the city and very comfortable room. Anne is super friendly and helpful. Good place to stay in London !

Perfect Location especially for Finsbury park for wireless festival. House was spotless and TT was very nice and friendly and welcoming. 10/10 would recommend to anyone. So close to the Piccadilly line so a great stop and a 2 minute walk from 2 tube stations. Would stay again.

Great little studio, perfect for a stress free overnight stay like ours - check in process was very simple and quick with keys located in a lockbox. Furnishings had a little bit of wear but the studio was very clean, comfortable and well equipped with all the nesessities. Lovely comfy bed!

Great host very helpful, apartment is in a great location.
Apartment was clean had all the required amenities very accurate description provided . Would recommend to others .

I stayed one night at Richard's place and it was very well. The room is as seen on photos, very clean, comfortable and quiet. Richard was very welcoming. From his house it is really easy to reach the center of London. Therefore I thank Richard and recommend his home!

This is a wonderful property on a residential street in Chiswick - a few blocks from shopping, restaurants and public transportation. The flat itself is very well equipped including all the kitchen equipment needed. My favorite feature was the "garden" area which gives a private, relaxing outdoor space. Sandra, though traveling, was easy to contact and extraordinarily helpful. I absolutely recommend this property.

This apartment is located in a great neighborhood right around the corner from the tube. It's pretty small and there's a ladder that goes up to the bed like a treehouse, but it's good enough after a long day of exploring London to sleep in. I would definitely recommend this apartment and would love to come back!

Good central location and a quiet flat despite being so centrally located. Nice little park behind the flat and good transport options.
Sophie was very communicative and the flat was clean, tidy and had all essentials. Only thing I'd change is adding a full length mirror!
Thanks Sophie.

What a gorgeous flat! Light, airy, sunny and beautifully designed. It was the perfect place to meet up with our London-based friends. It's an easy and pleasant walk to tube station down tree-lined streets. The kitchen is lovely, well-equipped and opens up into a garden with climbing fragrant jasmine and flowering lavender bushes. Highly recommend. Thanks Tess. You are an amazing host!
Great find. Well located and a really nice apartment. Carolyn was very responsive to any queries. All in all we loved it. Thanks!

Room is as described. Very clean and comfortable. Rosario stocked the room with everything you would need when first getting in. The small fridge in the room is a real bonus. I'm heading back there to spend another week !
Loved the location, layout and inclusions of Pembridge Cresc. Simon was a great host. Highly recommend this place for a London stay.

Sovan is a wonderful and very welcoming host. The house and the room were well equipped and clean. The neighborhood is quite & safe and I had no problems. Also Sovan was always reachable if I had questions on any topic.

Aky's little flat was just what we needed for the last day of our London trip. Being close to Paddington Station and even closer to Edgeware Road Underground was great.  The loft bedroom charmed my young traveling partner.  The kitchen is so nice, I wish we had cooked.  Best shower of our whole vacation, too!
Sarah's place was spacious, clean and within walking distance of lots of sites and just around the corner from the tube.  I would highly recommend her place.

A confortable, quiet and well equipped apartment very well located, very near the Angel Station (a few minutes by walk) and many bus stops (as well as a lot of shops and restaurants). The apartment is just perfect for a family of four. Excellent and very reactive communication with David before and during our journey in London. We certainly recommand David and his apartment.

Katherine's place is really special.  It is in a beautiful building with a fantastic view of the priory from one of the windows.  The apartment itself is incredibly well equipped, comfortable and beautifully decorated.  Katherine is a fabulous host, ready to help, always available and very generous.  We had a wonderful stay!!

The apartment is very convenient for getting in to the centre of London quickly, and for us, to get to the Queen Elizabeth Park at Stratford, equally fast. The apartment has everything that you need for a stay in London, and is extremely stylish. All my family enjoyed it.
Fab location, only 5 mins from Angel and lots of bars, cafes and restaurants nearby on trendy Upper Street. Great communication from host. Would recommend!

Great, modern, clean apartment only a few minutes walk from the the underground (Leytonstone on the central line) with shops, pubs, cafes etc 5 to 10 minutes walk away.  Carolyn couldn't have been more helpful and ensured we had a great stay in London. The apartment has all of the mod cons and was furnished and decorated to a very high standard. There's also free private parties king. Would thoroughly recommend.

Staying in David's flat was a great pleasure.  We found it to be so comfortable and so well placed that we came back for a second time this year.  David is among the most attentive hosts I have had via Airbnb.  His communication is always thoughtful, clear, timely and detailed.  His flat, situated in a quiet courtyard of a beautiful set of buildings is just perfect for exploring Islington in any direction you would like to go.  The space is comfortable, spotless and well equipped, with a great kitchen and new appliances. If you've not been to Angel before, an absolutely beautiful neighborhood of  lovely shops, restaurants and elegant residential streets, you will not regret it.  If you've already been then I'll just say that this is the flat for you!

We had a wonderful time in London and especially at Wordsworth Place. The flat is well equipped and a perfect starting point for many activities. We enjoyed the loving atmosphere, the calm surroundings and original location. We will gladly stay again in this lovely apartment.

Slobodan's apartment is perfect - it's a very charming and spacious apartment on the ground floor of a beautiful Victorian build - which is very convenient. Gorgeous high ceilings and very tastefully done up house. The check in and check out was very easy even though we did not meet Slobodan personally. Very close to Maida Vale tube station - less than 10 minute walk. My parents loved staying here. Thanks for a wonderful stay - we will be coming back and highly recommend this place.

Whether you're staying in London for a night or a week, this is a great place to stay. It's within walking distance to a lot of fun stuff, and Max and Billie are very helpful. Highly recommend this staying here.
Sophie's place is just as described. This is the second time I stay here and it was just as wonderful and full of joy. I'd recommend staying here if you're in London.
A great place to stay - Tracy was very welcoming and the apartment had everything we needed - superb location. Thank you!

Beautiful apartment, exactly as described and in a lovely neighbourhood. Lots of great places to eat locally, and transport is a breeze.
Finding the place and checking in was simple and stress free thanks to great communication and clear instructions from the hosts.
Would highly recommend Max and Billie's apartment to anyone visiting London.

This was my first AirBNB experience and Juste has set the bar high!  Everything from her responsiveness, the checkin, cleanliness, and the modern and very creative fixtures were excellent.  The bedroom was very bright with a huge window, good quality blinds that blocked light to well, and a good sized cupboard full of hangers .  I like firmer beds usually so initially thought I may not find it comfortable but it was VERY comfortable indeed !!!  With quality sheets and a nice duvet.  Also the temperature in the whole flat was ideal.  The location was perfect for me.  It's steps from the bus, 5 min to two tubes, and walking distance to London Bridge.  It took me 10 min bus or 20 mins walk to get to Monument.  Note - there is also a great, large, covered, food/drink/market across the street called Mercado Metropolitano which is excellent.

My daughter and I stayed at Nikki and Stew's for the past 2 weeks. We are moving my daughter to the area from Australia to attend Ballet School. The flat was in a perfect position for us to walk to St Margaret's and Twickenham. From those areas very easy to travel by bus or Rail to anywhere. The surrounding areas are very beautiful and an extremely safe area. The flat itself is exactly as described and had everything you would need. Lovely and clean and spacious. The hosts Nikki and Stew could not of been any nicer or more helpful. They offered help and advice with moving our daughter to the area. I encourage people to stay as it will be exactly what you want!!Thanks Nikki and Stew we will always remember our stay fondly. Leanne and Bella

Great two bedroom apartment with all the necessary amenities and a lovely backyard to relax in and enjoy.  Location is excellent with just a short walk to the London Tube, buses, restaurants and a variety of shops.  The host is excellent, welcoming and  friendly, and always contactable if necessary.  Would highly recommend this place for a stay.

We absolutely loved staying in Simon's flat. The location is perfect. We took our daughter to the park every day, which was only a 10 minute walk away. The tube is just around the corner. The flat is light and airy even though it's a lower ground flat, which is so lovely. And for a London flat it's incredibly spacious, which our daughter really appreciated! The sofa and bed were both very comfy and the kitchen had everything we needed. Simon was quick to respond to any questions we had and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again! Thanks Simon for a lovely start to our holiday!

I think that Samir's place is excellent value. The rooms are well maintained, very clean and Samir is extremely accommodating and went out of his way to help me. It's situated near to both rail and bus and within easy reach of Ilford, Romford and london.

Great flat - roomy and bright. Both bedrooms have comfy beds and plenty of storage. Great water pressure and wifi. Daniel was excellent, responsive, amenable and thorough. The building is beautiful and there's a lovely garden area in the parking lot too - about 10 min walk to Queens Road Peckham overground but 3 min from buses that'll take you everywhere. Need to walk about 10 minutes for restaurants but it's easy and scenic. Lovely parks near by including Burgess, Surrey Canal and Peckham Rye. Thank you again Daniel - can't recommend high enough!

Had a nice couple of days at Rosie's, I was working so didn't get to spend a huge amount of time there but the flat was lovely and true to the photos and the area is a perfect one for anyone wanting to spend time at Kew Gardens or Richmond Park

Great value for the price.
Bed is very comfortable. Grocery store nearby, close to overground and underground station. You will find your way easily to any attraction.
Appartment was very clean. The place is small but it has everything you need.
Host was easy to communicate with. Also we are very thankful they provided us a brand new baby crib.
Very welcoming but not intrusive hosts and accommodated our late check out without any hassle! Perfect for where we needed to be during the weekend.
Such a lovely spot, right between Richmond and Twickenham. Stew and Nikki were really helpful and polite.

Incredible apartment, perfectly set up for all a traveller needs, great to be able to come back to your own well equipped apartment after busy days, great location, 5 mins walk to Queens Park tube on Bakerloo, simple access to all central locations via that line. Our 8 and 6 year old daughters enjoyed having their own place, and we stayed at 5 and 6 star hotels in Paris and Berlin but you just couldn't beat the ability to come back to this place after busy days. Uber Eats and some great little local places which Tess will advise on made the location great, we felt like we were back living in London like we did 16 years ago. Tess was amazing in communication, not one thing went wrong.  Thanks heaps Tess, put those two single beds in the second room and you have a perfect place for any London visitor.

Nice room with plenty of space and a desk for laptop work and closet to hang clothes. You get your own cabinet and shelf in the fridge which is nice. Takes about 30-45 minutes to get into central London but is very close to bus and tube stops. Good deal for the price and Sovan is very helpful as well.

Good located, very clean and tidy.
I just can recommend for everyone.
Ms Tong was helpful, she could answered for all our questions.
Perfect accomodation.

Great place to stay, right near Broadway Market and the Canal.  Flat was clean and comfortable and Bert checked in by text several times to make sure everything was okay.  Would definitely stay here again in the future.

The place was just a few minutes from Camden Town Market, Mornington Crescent and Camden Town stations. The room was clean, bed and pillows really comfy, clean towels. As mentioned in other reviews, the only issue is that there is only one shower so you have to get in the moment you notice is available. I felt really safe in the apartment and the area. Didn’t interact much with Alessa but she was a good and friendly host. Thank you for everything!

We enjoyed our stay at Robin’s place. This was our first Airbnb experience, and we were pleased. While we were not able to meet Robin personally, he kept in contact and had a thorough guide for us upon arrival. Robin’s apartment is a 10-15 minute walk to the metro which allowed us to travel all over London. The Oyster cards were money saving and incredibly helpful! We loved the beautiful artwork throughout the apartment and building.

Isabelle is great person, very easy to communicate and very helpful. His apartment is so clean and I love her home made cake and breakfast.. Room is much more better than any hotels.. I can say that Everything was great...
Good deal, great host, fantastic location! The only one,negative thing is the smell in the house. But if I come back I would use it again! Thank you Alessa:)

Katherine's place is lovely, peaceful, and perfectly placed within London! We loved the apartment, the neighborhood, but most of all the attentive hosting that Katherine brought to our experience. The apartment was spotless and perfectly ordered, with many details carefully thought through and taken care of. Katherine communicated exceptionally clearly and promptly and her introduction of the home and the resources she provided were so clear and helpful. We hope very few people find out about this place, so that Katherine's place can be our home away from home, any time we travel to London. :)

This is a wonderful cosy place with a separate sitting room. Great location for most areas of London to both walk and catch public transport. Isabelle is a very helpful, kind Lady that has endless amounts of knowledge.
Great room in the heart of Camden. Room and shower are tidy and clean, the rest of the house not so nice. But if you're looking for short term stay this is perfect. And the location is A+.
A lovely place, very comfortable and well located (close to park, train to airport and shopping centre). I booked for a family member--we recommend it highly.
Everything was fine. Francesco is a service minded and helpful host, and he responded quickly when I had questions. The apartment is exactly as described. Recommended
Juste's apartment was amazing. Very clean, accommodating, quick walk to the tube. Would happily come back!

We needed a place to stay at the very last minute for us and our pet dog, and Carey helped us out at the 11th hour.  The basement flat is beneath her lovely house in Stockwell, a couple of mins from the Tube station.  The space is very homely with an amazingly comfortable bed and a large garden which Wilson had free reign of and loved.  Especially loved the drinks cabinet with honest box!  Carey was an impeccable host, very friendly and helpful, we highly recommended as a place to stay to visit London
I have stayed at Simon's four times this year and the only reason I am not staying for another two times this year is because it is fully booked, love staying here

Nico’s place was great, conveniently located just down the road from my office. The place itself was lovely and tidy just as described. Lots of restaurants and bars are just walking distance away. Definitely would book a stay here again.

The apartment is amazing, great location with lots of places to eat and drink at anytime. Only 15-20 minutes away from central London. The off road parking is very handy also. I will definitely recommend this to friends and family, great value for money. We will be back!

This was a real gem of a place to stay.  It was my first Airbnb and I feel very lucky I found Isabelle and her lovely flat.  My hotel that I was meant you stay at fell through and I found those place last minute the night before.  That was really fortunate as I know Isabelle gets really booked up.  Odd strongly recommend this location.  Gorgeous rooms, immaculately kept with lots of little extras and a delicious breakfast.  Isabelle is also a brilliant host.

The flat is a 5 minute walk to Stockwell tube station, with a Sainsburys along the way. My hosts were very friendly and helpful, the room & bathroom were very clean. The bed was extremely soft and the room had fantastic amenities: a fridge, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, milk & snacks which were saved me when I forgot to grab some food. Central location, not far from the centre of London by public transport. Great price, I would stay again 🙂

We had a wonderful weekend staying at Carey's flat. Carey is a warm, friendly & considerate person who made us feel very welcome.The flat is extremely comfortable & spotless with thoughtful touches of fresh flowers & everything provided for a home from experience.
Thanks Sandra. We felt very happy and have great freedom. Swift reply all the time. Highly recommend.
Lovely, design lead apartment in a perfect spot. Will still again when I have meetings in the same place.

Tina has a location at the start point of zone 1, notting hill. It get you around very easily in regards to attraction sites and shopping areas. I would recommend for people who travel in London for their leisure.

Place is amazing. Rosie gives alot of tips and was very helpful with the airport transfer. Everything is great. Just need ard 30-40mins to head to central london. But wasnt that difficult to head to the kew garden station.

My wife, daughter, and I enjoyed our stay at VanZyl's Chelsea apartment. The space was as nice or nicer than the airbnb photos and description. The bathroom was very small, but well laid out. The living areas were spacious and the bedroom was perfect for two. Our six year old daughter ended up sleeping on a futon at the foot of the queen size bed in the bedroom. This was fine for us, but for older children, or a third adult, might be less desirable.
The apartment is located on a quiet street with no noise at all. Great Indian takeways less than a block away. Public transportation was accessible, with both the Fulham Broadway tube station and the London River Bus less than a 15 minute walk away. We'd happily stay here again.
Great hosts with great communication. A joy to stay at and we'll definitely be back next time we're in London!

Great location for families with small kids.  Bus stops close by, tube stations not far either.  Lots of non-touristy, quality restaurants within walking distance.  Sergio and Denise were excellent hosts and flexible with check in.

We had a fantastic stay at Tess's flat and it was a wonderful home away from home. Tess's flat was clean and comfortable with a well-equipped kitchen. It was also conveniently located with easy access to the Bakerloo and Overground lines and the buses.
Fantastic stay, very warm welcome from Danielle’s mum and dad, very friendly and kind, great clean room with a very comfortable bed, would definitely stay here again if we are ever in the area.

I really enjoyed my stay at Federica's lovely flat. The location is wonderful being so close to Earls Court station and everything in the flat is as described. The flat is well-furnished and the outside patio is amazing for this area of London. Great value for money.
Federica and her associates were kind, responsive, and flexibile with check-in, etc.
Would definitely come again. Thank you!
Nico's place is exactly what it states in the add. Great location in a vibey area, everything you need in the apartment itself and Nico is friendly and helpful.

Sandra's home in Chiswick is about 20 minutes from London on the underground. Her home is quaint, clean and in a very nice residential neighborhood. We spent most of our days in London, which were filled with site seeing, shopping and dining. It was nice to retreat to Chiswick in the evenings and get away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Marc's place is perfectly situated for easy travel around the city. Plenty of shops and restaurants nearby also.
The space is clean and presented to a very high spec, would highly recommend to anyone needing somewhere for a few days.

Cosy, quaint, and perfectly located. Carey’s flat was the perfect home away from home for us. We were able to park directly in front of the flat, and what’s best is that we were able to bring our 2 dogs with us (with Carey’s prior approval, of course). They were able to run through the beautiful back garden- which was a nice little holiday for them, too!
The flat itself is situated just a few steps from the tube station, and there were several bus stops along the road as well. Venturing into central London was easy from this garden flat.
Unfortunately, Carey was unable to meet us, but she ensured we were well looked after from start to finish.
We hope to be back again!

We rented this house as a group of 6 for it's close proximity to Twickenham Stadium. It was perfectly located to the ground and in a very quite cul de sac. Good size double bedrooms with comfortable beds. Kitchen well equipped for cooking simple meals for our weekends stay. Would definitely stay here again.
Really great place, cozy, clean, close to the tube, a mall and groceries. The room is as is the photo. The house is also quite, I recommend it for sure.
Fantastic room and bathroom. Lovely range of tea coffee and nibbles. Friendly hosts. What more could you ask for
This was one of the most pleasant vacation with airbnb. Perfect in all the aspect. Extremely recommended

Slobodan and Olga are absolutely fantastic hosts. Could not have been kinder or warmer. We stayed while our home renovation was delayed, and they didn't bat an eyelid at the amount of bags and boxes we showed up with. They both went out of their way to be helpful and accommodating.
Great location, lovely flat and lovely hosts. Thank you!

My stay at Nico's place was brilliant. The place is very clean and well equipped. The location is perfect for Shoreditch but at the same time it is quite calm.
Nico is very helping and friendly, a super host! It was very nice meeting you

This was a wonderful house. A little loud at nights with the local community but, it’s so close to the underground stop that cannot be prevented. The host made amazing accommodations for us and responded very quickly.
We would recommend again.
I only had one night here, but it was very comfortable, warm and clean and l felt very welcome.
Lovely house. Very warm room and host. Would definitely stay here again if visiting this part of London. Thank you

This was my second stay at Simon's and it was as wonderful as the first time. Perfect location, private flat with everything you need and a lot of space for spending a day escaping the horrible weather as I did during the recent wild weather. It was lovely to sit inside and watch the snow fall on the sweet garden through the french doors.
Simon is incredibly prompt with responses from early inquiries about booking to any questions around the flat once in London.
I had some complications with flight cancellation at the end and Simon was wonderfully helpful.
I would happily stay here again the next I visit London.

Tina was incredible! She picked me up at the tube stop. Her apartment was amazingly clean, and she was more than happy to accommodate any needs that arose. I would stay here again in a heart beat. She was very warm and welcoming. I don't have enough nice things to say about my stay with Tina.

This flat has an amazing location in Notting Hill and connects to everywhere in London. The room we stayed in is in close proximity to other rooms within the building, so noise between rooms can be an issue at times, but an overall excellent value for a place in London.

The host was friendly and willing to answer questions and offer help. The room was good, but the heating is on timer, so when you want to heat outside the times (mornings and evenings), you have to go downstairs and switch the boiler to "on" (and later to "timer" again). The bathrooms were relatively clean, the showers weren't great, but okay. Other guests weren't conspicuous. The location of the house is great, just a few minutes to the tube. If you're looking for a cheap place to stay, this is it, but don't expect too much.
Good location. Comfy bed. Good communication. Easy check in. Would be even better if we did not have to share the bathroom or living room.

Geoff and his wife are very friendly. The place is clean and location is good! Easy to go anywhere in London. Nice breakfast and thoughtful guide for transportation.
Happy new year!
Cute little place very well located, and max and Billie made the check in process very easy!

Amazing!   The best cost effective one! We enjoy staying here. The couple are super friendly and helpful. Cozy house and delicious breakfast are memorable!Extremely recommend! I will definitely book again!   Thank you so much.
Carolyn's apartment is really beautiful. She was also very responsive and nice to us (even when my friends got lost in the city!). I definitely recommend her place to groups of people.

This airbnb is better than some hotels I stayed at. The room is spacious and clean, so was the private bathroom.
I really liked the privacy Greoff and his wife gave us, yet he was always available when needed.

The place has a very nice location close to the city center with convenient access to underground station. The apartment is very stylish and I enjoyed the design and the smal plants and books that they have. The bed was comfy as well. The communication was great as Juste had prepared all the necessary information in a file for us that helped us to check in very easily. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to visit London and have a place close to the city center (and is not afraid of climbing a few stairs).

Beautiful apartment for 2/3 people from 30 minutes to the city center. Subway and bus station really near to the apartment and convenient stores nearby. Tracy is really nice and will welcome you with one big smile. Everything was good and we didn’t have any problem.

This is a beautiful, light, airy and spacious flat in a wonderful location; coming off a long haul flight, having well known shops and the tube within very close walking distance was great. Justin was very easy to communicate with and very accommodating. I highly recommend staying here.
Nice flat in the heart of Notting Hill! Close (5min walk) to the Notting Hill Gate tube station and 15min walk far from Kensington High Street. Very good communication with the hosts.
Simons place was everything it said it was great location but quiet, clean and spacious . Simon was a great host and responded to queries straightaway
Very good experience! Geoff is very good host, very helpful and quick to respond to all messages and questions asked. I highly recommend this place.

The place is adorable! Very very clean and tidy! It is a little bit small but perfect for a couple travelling! It has a stunning balcony overlooking an adorable neighbourhood! It is a 5 min walk to the tube which covers the entire city and is easy and quick to get to central London! There is a cute bakery on the corner for coffee and breakfast! It includes everything you need for your stay! We had a great time

Good location, good size, oyster roast cards are available for guests use which was so helpful!!! Great food. A Turkish place called Aspendos, highly recommend, only 5 -10 min walk. Also the proximity to the underground station and other local markets makes this place that much more valuable.

I loved my stay st Geoff and Marcela's place. Geoff is a friendly and interesting guy. The room is very comfortable. Marcela is a nice lady who I found myself communicating 24/7 in spanish as it was much easier to do so than in English. On a negative note, my  breakfast which consisted of an omlette and few fruits had many many pieces of hair stuck to it. The hostess was apologetic though. The breakfast is at an additional cost, but thoughtfully presented. Kitchen cleanliness questionable? However the house is amazing and as I said, cozy and homely. I would stay in it again for sure! Thanks :)
Taylan’s place was nice and handy to public transport. Although there were several guests staying there at different times you didn’t really notice and with the multiple bathrooms it wasn’t an issue.

We really enjoyed our stay at Isabelles  home. Hospitality and welcome was exceptional. Isabelle is extremely charming and unfailingly helpful. Her home is very comfortable attractive and spotless. All facilities were just perfect.  We would definitely visit again.  Thank you Judi

I have stayed at quite a few AirBNB’s and when Isabelle says this is “more than a room” she is understanding it by a mile!Isabelle was an absolute dream and so was her home! I felt like I was going and staying with an old friend. She made my friend and I feel so warm and welcome. She prepared beautiful breakfasts and helped us prepare our plans and how to get around for the day.  My only wish is that I had a few more days to enjoy her, her home and area as we were only staying in London for 2 nights. The bedroom was comfortable and had everything we needed. I will absolutely be recommending Isabella’s home to friends and family and will go back again and again! Thank you Isabelle!!!
Robin is a great host and the location of the apartment is excellent, we will definitely consider staying here again in the future.
Great location very close to central London. Stayed while on business and was perfect for what I needed.
Great place to be and visit London. To see the real London and life's of people living London this accommodation offers you that! Thanks for the hospitality again!

Richard's hospitality is fantastic. A very friendly host who offered all the small extras and not just a room which made it very easy to feel at home. The room was clean, bright, and exactly as advertised. The house is very easy to find and located a short walk from Greenwich station. Highly recommended.
Beautiful house and Anne is very welcoming, right next to the beautiful park of Battersea. I'm happy with my trip.

Francesco responded very fast to our emails and so detailed that we didn’t need to ask for further explanation. We met up with Antoaneta who was amazing! Gave us a tour of the home and explained every room and amenities of the place! Provided 2 keys to the place and offered her personal whatsup if we  needed anything to call her direct! I thought that was special! Thank you Francesco and your team for providing us a great place to stay while in London!!

Lovely place
Lovely people
Lovely comfy bed
Quiet
Friendly hosts
Spacious room
Nice gated area to stay in
Fabulous breakfast 🥞
Much recommended

Tom and his apartment were wonderful. The check-in & check-out process was incredibly simple, he has everything about the apartment detailed for easy use (he has a well stocked kitchen by way of appliances), and it’s really close to Portobello (5 minute walk), which has great food/shopping. It’s an even closer walk to the metro for easy access to the city. 100% would stay here again.
I have very comfortable staying at Anne's place. It was perfect for my last minute need! highly recommend :)

We had a great stay in VanZyl’s apartment. The apartment was very clean and had all the right amenities.
Great local pubs and close to the river if you like running!
Little extra touches like shampoo, conditioner and even toothpaste for just your use and very centrally located.
Anne is a great host and the accommodations were exactly what I was looking for. Very clean and comfortable and Anne made sure I had everything I needed. Wonderful quiet location. Sweet dog too! :)

I stayed here for 2 nights the previous week and because of the close proximity to the tube (Oval station) value for money I rebooked for a further 4 nights. I would have liked to book long term but Geoff didn’t have the availability. Great host, clean and tidy, quite location and secure, I definitely would be happy to come back. Thanks Geoff and Denise.

This space is lovely! A great size and private space with separate entrance to the main home. Situated in an excellent location, a short walk from shops, restaurants and the station. Chris was a brilliant host with local tips and a friendly welcome. I would certainly book again! Thank you Chris!

Simon's flat is very well situated and has all the basic amenities required.  Simon was quick to respond to any inquiries and was very accommodating.  Looking forward to a future stay at Simon's place.
Rosario was a very warm and friendly host, made my stay very comfortable and gave good advise when needed. Great value for a good price as well. Perfect for solo travellers.

The place is just really cool. Lots of attention to detail. It's clean and you feel very safe here. Easy to find and close to Camden. I'll definitely come back because this was an excellent place to stay!

This is the second time I've stayed in Anne's lovely home. Both times she has made me feel very welcome and relaxed. The room is really comfortable and clean and she leaves lovely touches like a beautifully scented candle, tea and coffee in the room. Her dog is lovely too. I hope to return again soon.
I enjoyed my stay at Gina’s. It was well equipped and comfortable and the location was great.

Tina is an excellent host and goes out of her way to make sure that your are comfortable. Her apartment is spotless and close to some great shopping and restaurants'. Entrance to the subway is very close by. Its very easy to get around London from her location, tnx again Tina! Regards Patrick

My stay at Ursula's house was lovely.  She is a charming hostess, her house is very nicely decorated, and has a nice peaceful feel to it. The place is kept in immaculate condition and I felt comfortable in my room which was very well appointed and nice and quite and private.  I definitely am going to book again and soon!!! loved it..
Nice apartment, quite near to the overground station and also to Canada Water underground station. Nice place nearby a park, no noise at all.

This is a wonderful, bright, and very clean flat that is extremely well thought out and easy to live in. Everything is very high quality, and Joanna is responsive, kind, and very professional. The place is even better than the photos suggest. I feel fortunate to have stayed here.

My husband and I stayed here for our London stop of our trip and found it to be perfect for the 2 nights we booked. In fact, I wish we had more time. The neighborhood is lovely, quiet and within walking distance to the public transit, restaurants, local shops and the Kew Gardens.

Robin was a very helpful and attentive host. He checked on us to make sure our stay was going well. Very thoughtful. Easy access to underground, buses and apartment was in a very quiet neighborhood. His place was spacious and clean. I would definitely stay there again. The price was amazing for a London pad.

Simon's flat in Notting Hill was perfect! Modern, spacious, quiet and in a perfect location.  Close to great shops, restaurants & the tube station is just down the street. Simon responded to all of my questions immediately and came by the day we arrived to greet us. We would definitely stay there again and recommend the flat to our friends as well.

The flat is spacious, airy and comfortable. It's well situated for transport links and really close to the bars, restaurants and other facilities that Peckham has to offer. Lydia was a great host and a good communicator.

She is more than a super host as same as more than a room ! She’s very kind and gave me great tips about local , where to eat , what to see, best way to get there , etc.
I’ll definitely would like to stay at Isabella’s when I have a chance to visit London again.

Isabelle is ONE OF A KIND. Isabelle is (always) a great host, very caring and interested to get to know her guests. Her apartment is exceptional, sparking clean and great amenities. The location is well connected and easy to get to/from with bus and underground. The trendy neighbourhood. She has a very interesting personality, lots of insider tips for London. I am highly recommend Isabelle's place and you will have a blast with her uniqueness.

Joanna is great host: accurate and client-oriented.
Location is very nice: centrally-located and quiet enough at the same time.
Was a pleasure to stay!

Marc’s flat is a lovely small quiet hide-away away from the manic hustle and bustle of London, and was perfect for the London marathon race weekend. The hustle and bustle of the city, and the race start, is easily accessed by great transport links within a short walking distance of the flat, as are tourist areas like Greenwich and up-and-coming neighbourhoods like Bermondsey.

Undoubtedly Isabelle's house is a place where I would recommend staying. Isabelle is always willing to help you and make your stay as comfortable as possible. By the way, the breakfast jams are spectacular ;-) We will certainly repeat the experience. Thanks, Isabelle! See you soon!!!
It was really great and friendly! The room is nice and the kitchen well equipped! The apartment is near the underground, in a good place. I’ll recommend this accommodation to my friends.

The house is in a very convenient spot in Bexleyheath, within easy walking distance of the train, shops, playgrounds, and the town center. It’s clean and comfortable, there are TVs in every room, there’s a large garden, and Hyacinth is a lovely, communicative host.
Joanna's place is the perfect pied-a-terre. It is beautifully designed and Joanna was very helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

Nice place. Excellent communication with host and quick response time. Great location. Very quiet and no street noise. Negatives were that mattress in couch is very thin and uncomfortable and not much light as it’s a ground level apartment which basically means you are not at street level.

Jennie's apartment is as advertised. We were extremely comfortable and the location was really good for us; close to the tube (Piccadilly Line) and the bus into London central. Jennie was very helpful and available for any questions.

This studio was an excellent place to stay in London! Right next to Kensington Gardens and Palace and very easy to catch transportation to anywhere else in London. The apartment was clean with a nice balcony and loft. The bed was comfortable and check in was a smooth and easy process. Would definitely recommend!
Richard was a Brilliant host. He was friendly and very welcoming! One of the best stays we have had using airbnb! Thank you Richard!
This is a lovely flat in a great location. Clare was quick to communicate and answer any questions. Would definitely recommend it.

Tracy is a wonderful and kind host who goes out of her way to ensure you are well provided for. Her house is quirky, cool and comfortable in a great location. She even was sweet enough to get me a birthday gift! Absolutely delightful- thanks for sharing your wonderful home with us Tracy. Sam 😊
Beautiful and lovely house! You can run everyday because there is a big park in front of this flat. Also tesco is very close. Highly recommend and want to stay next time again.

Tina was a super host, maybe the best I never had! It’s sure, next I have to go to London, I will come back to her flat!
Thanks again for all Tina :)

Quiet, clean, safe area near the Thames. Great place to stroll and soak on the architecture and parks. CoOp was a five minute walk and had everything we needed. Buses were fairly close by and taxis were readily available.  Lovely flat with darling garden. Nicely decorated and excellent kitchen.

We had a perfect stay at Manisha‘s house! She always replied really fast, everything was clean, the location is good and offers a good access to public transfer. I would return to her house if I would stay another time with a bigger group in London.

Isabelle’s home was so cozy and comfortable that we hated to leave. She made our visit to London very special. We felt very comfortable and at home, including sharing a lovely and tasty breakfast with Isabelle each morning. And she was so sweet to accommodate my running before breakfast! The house is well situated close to public transit  as well as many places to eat and shop nearby.

Nicely furnished and clean apartment in a trendy area of Southwark.
Bermondsey Street with its restaurants, bars, coffee shops and galleries is within short walking distance from Paula's apartment. London Bridge tube and train station in about 10 mins walking distance. Paula was very responsive to the few requests we had during our stay. Would always come back.
Nice little place in a great location. The space is quite small but great if your staying a few days.

We spent wonderful days at Eugene’s place and we really felt at home in London! His place offers all one needs for a stay. And there is something special in this place, which is not easy to be found in London: charm, style and space!
Great location with many great dining options that Gina recommended. The room was very comfortable and had everything you may need to make your stay enjoyable!

Monica was a great host, responding promptly to messages and being very flexible about check in/out times. The flat is comfortable, full of character and charming with a small garden and a conservatory to eat in. Check in was very easy and everything we needed was there. I would thoroughly recommend staying there.

Great location, great place to stay. Tidy and clean with all amenities needed.
Orla was very hospitable and so generous to open up her home to strangers.
Coffee machine was great!
We enjoyed our stay.
Thank you so much Orla x
Rosie's place is a perfect location for a stay in London, you get the whole apartment and it really feels like home away from home. I would definitely stay again.

Daniela’s place is lovely. Me and my friends each got private rooms and the surrounding neighborhood was beautiful to look at. The only issues we struggled with was the door being tricky and some spotty WiFi. If these issues get resolved for future visits, I have no doubt guests will love their stay!
Samir was a terrific host--he even upgraded my room when I asked for a TV!!  Nice big room. Lovely kitchen!

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at your property. It is a beautiful apartment in a great location. The facilities available (kitchen appliances etc) were superb and we greatly appreciated the toiletries, milk etc left for us. We would recommend to anyone and hope to return next time we’re in London. Thank you very much.

Rosario really wants to ensure you have a comfortable stay. It is very clean, with lots of items available in the room (accompaniments to meals, biscuits, toiletries, etc). She is friendly and helpful and the flat is a 2 min walk from Stockwell tube station (no parking restrictions Sat and Sun. I found a space, but not necessarily easy).

We had an awesome stay at Tracys place. She explained us everything and gave us some useful tips. The apartment was clean, spacious  and quite close to the tube. We would definitely come back at our next trip to London.

I truly  enjoyed  this   pretty  apartment. It  has everything you need .Plus   your personal  garden!  It's   very close  to the public transportation and shopping centers . The neighborhood is nice and quite. Monica is a great host . She gave me all of the information I needed  and made my stay very comfortable
Sergio was a wonderful host. His place is exactly as described and very comfortable. Great access from the airports and excellent access to the city. I highly recommend Sergio’s home.

There are not enough nice words to describe Isabelle or her home! It was quite literally the best Aibnb experience we have ever had! The room was comfortable, well-appointed, quiet and private. The bed was also so comfy! The home is close to the tube and bus stops and within walking distance of a bunch of great restaurants.
Isabelle was a gem! Her hospitality and kindness will put anyone at ease. She helped us map out a sightseeing plan and gave us directions and tips. She even walked us to the tube one morning! She generously made us fresh banana bread, fresh fruit, toast, and coffee for breakfast daily. There is a cat (Mr. Darcy) but he is a sweetheart and keeps to himself. Be sure to ask about Mr. Darcy's history--it's quite the story!
This is truly more than just a room--Isabelle makes this place feel like a home away from home.

Fabulous location , doesn’t feel like one is in London, beautiful parks on ones doorstep & so much to see and do .
House was magnificent, stunningly beautiful.
A beautiful flat. Great bathroom! Very comfortable and perfect location near restaurants and tube/buses. Host was very friendly and helpful.

We had a lovely time at Anne’s. She was such a lovely host that responded very promptly to any questions we had and was extremely accommodating. The room was perfect for a couple of nights and Anne provided everything we required, towels, WiFi, useful information about the local area.
Thanks Anne!
This place was perfect for us, great location, close to the underground and in a very nice neighborhood. It had absolutely everything we needed and was very comfortable.

One of the best very accurately described and woudl certainly stay again. Great amenities and communication, extremely clean. Also perfect for myself and two sons as it was easy to keep clean and tidy.
Very convenient location and just what you need for a lovely stay! The place is perfectly located to enable exploring London and enjoying a nice neighborhood with good options for food nearby.
Modern, clean apartment. Stayed a week. Liked the kitchen for preparing occasional meal, laundry facility.

I have stayed here for few days and found it quite a homely enviroment . Hemi dad is a good company if you like being around older people . Easy access to the train station working quick walking distance .
Hemi was responsive to queries .
WiFi signals could b an issue but improved on leaving door open . That can certainly be improved by hemi as in future for greater good of upcoming guests.

A wonderful room in a gorgeous house, full of character! The bed was comfy and attentively made, and Anne was wonderful in giving directions, and being friendly and welcoming throughout!
I would recommend this space to anyone needing afordable but high quality accommodation in a prime location in London!
Wonderful family home, with everything you would need to make your stay comfortable, and perfect if traveling with a toddler.

The location of the flat is lovely.  Kew is green and pleasant.  The accommodation is accurately described, stylish and full of light.   We did not get to meet Rosie personally but we had an  issue to deal with during our stay (not related to the accommodation) and Rosie was sympathetic and very helpful.   I would recommend this property.

Really nice room in a nice flat. It is really well situated. Anne was very nice and helpful.
She gave me every instructions to come easily to her place.
I would definitely recommend her place to stay!
Lydia's space is terrific, very conveniently located in an up and coming part of south London. Short walk to public transport, had no problem exploring London at all.

Get ready to see great artwork in her lovely home, good conversations at breakfast. A good friend to help you plan the day in London. The comfy bed and warm shower and of course Mr. Darcy her cat! :D I am allergic to cat hair and not a single one was in our suite. Also a great location to try fish and chips!

I have stayed in over 20 airbnbs and Isabelle’s place is by far, the absolute best. She went out of her way so many times for us (accommodating our schedule, letting us do laundry, taking us to the train stop because we were late!), and was just such an incredibly generous host. Her place is absolutely beautiful, so comfortable, super clean, and had so many small touches of detail that we appreciated. Her breakfasts were also wonderful and we loved chatting with her every morning - it’s obvious she cares so much about ensuring that her guests have a great time. In addition, her neighborhood is the cutest - especially if you’re like us and wanted to avoid the tourist crowds. Our only regret is that we didn’t stay longer! Thanks Isabelle!!
Great location if working at Biggin Hill. Hosts are both really friendly and down to earth. Would recommend!

Probably the best AirBnB experience we’ve had!!
Denise and Jonathan were very helpful in the lead up to our visit, check in was easy, location was absolutely ideal for anyone visiting Wimbledon for the tennis, and the apartment is beautiful.
There were so many thoughtful touches (the fluffy mat in the bathroom is heavenly, and homemade flapjack didn’t last very long at all!) and our every need was catered for.
We’ll definitely be back when we come to Wimbledon next year and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this place!!

Nidhi and Sam's apartment was absolutely perfect. You can't beat the location and the apartment was spacious, clean, and modern. Also, Nidhi and Sam were extremely gracious hosts. We were traveling with our 4 month old who needed a crib for the night, and Nidhi and Sam not only bought a crib but also purchased a fan given the unexpected warmth in London that week.  They were quick with their responses to my questions and gave us a lot of great tips on family friendly places to visit. I highly recommend their place for families visiting London!

This is an awesome choice for a stay in London in which you want to do some sightseeing but then retreat to a quieter neighborhood for sleeping. It is a short walk to the tube station that can get you anywhere in central London rather quickly and easily. Jennie was one of the best hosts I have had with Airbnb. She was able to accommodate an early luggage drop off and was quick to respond with any questions we had during our stay. Highly recommend this place and host!
Pretty conveniently located for access to Camden and has an easy check in process.  As with most shared spaces, a little loud in the morning with everyone getting ready.

Anne was a wonderful host! Directions to her place were clear and helpful, and she was always available if we needed her. Her street is so cute and very close to public transport. Would definitely stay here again.

I stayed here for one night due to needing to be in London for work. The apartment is conveniently located a few minutes from Notting Hill Gate tube station and whilst the apartment is small, it's fine for a short stay.  The place was very clean, the check in was easy enough and everything I needed was there.  Will definitely stay again if I need another night in London.

2nd time I've stayed at David's apartment in Islington. Very clean and modern apartment, and the location is fantastic. Very close to Angel tube station and great restaurants.
The communication with David was very straight forward and prompt. I look forward to staying here again.
Great location, great host. The flat is charming and has all one needs for an escape to London. Thanks Isabelle.

The flat is stylish if a bit cramped. It is on the outskirts of Chelsea but reasonably close to the Kings Road and all the amenities. Bathroom is very small and the flap is much smaller than it appears  on the website. It is directly under the Heathrow flight path and is very close to the Batersea Heliport which means that from 6 AM in the morning it  is very noisy particularly in the summer when you have to open doors and windows. Lovely open kitchen-patio areA. Overall a nice place to stay, but bear the noise in mind.

Got extremely prompt replies from David, which is really important if u r looking for a bnb hotel. Very safe and quiet apartment with convenient connection to central London. Supermarkets within 5 mins walk. Each room has its own balcony. Highly recommended.
Perfect place to relax after a long day. Very comfortable, cozy, and in a quiet neighbourhood.

The apartment was clean, stylish and well equipped. Gary was more than accommodating and friendly. We had a great visit. The area is a little bit rough around the edges, however we just took the train into London each day anyways. About an 18 minute walk. We were appreciative of all that the apartment had to offer and felt right at home.

In a city as hectic as London can be, Anne’s adorable home was the perfect, quite respite I needed. Her space is warm, welcoming and very comfortable. She was an absolute joy to stay with and helped me not only navigate the tube and busses, but transport to the airport as well. Having stayed elsewhere in London on previous trips, I can say with confidence that her neighbor is by far the cutest. It is well-located and easy to get to central London via bus and/or tube. My only regret is that I didn’t stay longer :)
Lovely home, incredibly clean and in a safe and convenient area. Ms Tong is a very accommodating host, I would recommend staying here.
Good place to stay for a few days if you have no problem with there being no windows. Excellent location, you can reach many places and train stations on foot.

Samir was a great host who welcomed me in to his home. His place was clean and the room was bigger than i thought it would be.
Bathroom and kitchen were kept clean and had all the stuff i needed. The room itself felt like it was renovated pretty recently and the wifi reception was good. All in all great value!
Richard's room is very comfortable. Amazing view of London from the windows.  Richard was very welcoming. I would recommend Richard'so room to friends.

Had a short stay in July, room was spacious and comfortable. Just a few minutes walk from the underground with convenience stores on the way over. Would recommend if you are looking for an affordable and quiet environment to visit london

Lovely apartment in Notting Hill. A home-away-from-home experience in every little detail. The apartment is spacious, clean, bright and comfortable with all amenities. The host, Justin, is absolutely superb, taking care of the little details which make one’s stay great and certainly made ours special.
Highly recommended!

A well appointed place that was walking distance from the tube. The place was very clean and the room comfortable. The breakfast was yummy complete with homemade banana bread and homemade jams. Our host also was extremely helpful in mapping our adventures in London.  Isabelle is definitely a hostess with the mostest!

Tess was a fantastic host, helpful with tips & loved the little touches with biscuits for the kids & orange juice & good coffee after our long flight. The bakery she suggested was exceptional & I loved how easy it was to get around from the beautiful flat. We loved the conservatory atmosphere & the green yard that made you feel like you were in the countryside.

It was my second stay at Rosario's place and everything went great! The room is well equipped, clean and comfortable. Rosario is a nice and gentle host, who is genuinely interested in helping her guests. The location of the apartment is just great, 3 minutes from a tube station and very close to supermarkets, shops and restaurants. I highly recommend this place!

Possibly the best host and stay I have had through Airbnb. Eugene was very helpful, thoughtful, easy going, responsive, and extremely accommodating. He gave us great local tips, and helped us plan for our long stay. The apartment was great, clean and comfortable. We love to cook and was very well equipped for that too. The building neighbors add a lot of value to the place too, very helpful (one even got out an inflatable jumping castle just for our kids!!!). The location is great, lots of nice shops, places to eat and parks around, and you can be in central London in no time. Highly recommended.

When you walk through the front door into the flat you are immediately struck by the light and space of the large living area. The conservatory space and stylish decor throughout together with the well equipped kitchen and bathroom make this a very comfortable haven. The outlook onto the garden is charming. The variety of shops at either end of the road is very useful.
Good place, friendly owner. Close to station and train tracks so can get a bit noisy when trains pass.

Stylish, spotless flat in a perfect location, one stop away from King's Cross and in a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants, shops, pubs and small theaters. The arrangement of the space in the flat is especially convenient if you need two separate sleeping areas (I was traveling with my teenage daughter). Thanks, David, for being such an attentive host!

Property was exactly as shown in photos. The host was not reachable by phone, only via Airbnb emails. This was acceptable the first couple days when I reported clogged shower and kitchen leak, and host responded promptly. However, on waking up for our early morning departure flight, we found half the house to be without power. Host never answers the phone number I sourced from an Airbnb mail, and I could not email because internet went down with power. In any case, I doubt host would have checked emails at 4.30am. Cold showers at 4.30am and no breakfast before leaving for airport definitely not appreciated. I emailed the host from the airport but received no response. I will not risk another Airbnb host who does not provide a phone number.

Miriam was a friendly and welcoming host. Communication was good and easy check in. Great flat in very central location.
Quiet, clean and simply furnished room.
Amazing stay. Amazing communication. Amazing apartment. Best value for money I've had on AirBnB for a while :) Cheers

There is No Air Condition or Fan in the House and there is only one window opening in bedroom and It is just about 4 inches. This could be a very important point to be considered if you are booking your stay during summer. Other wise it is good property and you will enjoy here.
We enjoyed our stay there very much. It was a nice appartement and we felt really comfortable.
Very nice flat, perfectly located, spotless clean. Myriam was very welcoming and arranging for check in and check out.
Clean, quiet and perfectly situated for Paddington station. Miriam was very helpful with communication and check-in.

Just a fantastic apartment hidden in Peckham! It is so cool, has outside space. Lovely bedrooms and communal space. The kitchen has everything you need. And the location is close to everything. Peckham rye parks and Dulwich Park are all within 10mins and then there is Peckham Levels and busses building for nightlife and restaurants. Lydia was so communicative if we needed anything. Would highly recommend and will hopefully use again if we head back to the UK

Gorgeous house with lots of space to relax. Beautiful garden-we were planning on having a barbecue but then it rained... we still enjoyed the view out the kitchen window and having an early morning coffee outside. The tube station was a pleasant 10 minute walk away through a pretty neighborhood. We had one problem with the alarm but it was solved quickly by messaging Anna. Our feline hosts were very welcoming too! Thanks to Anna for opening her beautiful home to us!
Sophie was absolutely wonderful. Always available to ask advice and provided lots of recommendations for great places nearby

Rachael's place is spacious, comfortable and she's a really friendly person. It was difficult to get a place in London with parking spaces, and my big family came with 3 cars, and could park with no problem at all. Her place is close to some very good parks which was really good. Definitely recommended to stay at hers!
Good location, very close to public transport. Apartment is very small, but cozy. Self checkin was very comfortable for us. At the end I would recommend it for single or pair.

Tracy's flat was the perfect "home-away-from-home" for our family's first trip to London together. It is a cozy, stylish and clean unit, with the perfect amount of space for us to spend time together, but retreat to our own spots when we wanted some downtime. The location is great! It's not in the middle of the crazy touristy areas, so we could escape the crowds, but definitely close enough to everything we wanted to see. It was a short walk to the Tube, and the neighborhood has great amenities...coffee shops, groceries, pubs, parks...all within easy reach. We were able to walk to the Columbia Road Flower Market and Brick Lane, which were two highlights of our visit. And we even had time to explore Victoria Park one evening after dinner, which we loved.
And with the Central Line around the corner, we could get everywhere in London easily and quickly. Thanks for everything, Tracy!

Centrally located, good to reach via tube and excellent check-in and checkout experience. The communication was very good and we enjoyed the clean appartement. The bed was quite comfy. The only thing you need to aware of is that it’s in a building with multiple other apartments and the walls aren’t very thick. We would stay there again.
