You cannot get a better location than James' flat. A gorgeously decorated space right in the heart of Covent Garden. Walking distance from EVERYTHING, if not, only a stop or two away on the tube.  We stayed for 5 days and it was perfect for our trip. Would absolutely recommend to anyone - the bed is amazingly comfy as well, always a plus! Thanks again James.

We spent a gorgious week in Lydia's very quiet, spacious  and cosy flat, which had everything we needed. The beds are very comfortable.  The location is perfect to take one of the nearby busses or tube into central London.  Lydia was very friendly and welcoming and answered prombtly if necessary. Our son loved playing the old piano.  We can highly recommend this terrific flat.

Great spot. A bit noisy depending on how many people are staying there and especially if light sleeper. Some travellers are just not respectful of others. Helpful with directions and very close to tube station. Thank you.

Katherine is an outstanding host: caring, attentive, helpful and extremely knowledgeable. The apartment is exceptional, located within walking distance to wonderful attractions such as Hampstead Heath, Camden Market, London Zoo, Regent's Canal and many more, as well as to Tube and bus stations and of course grocery stores and excellent eateries. We are very grateful for finding and staying in this hidden gem, thank you so much Katherine!!
Great location and just as described with plenty of local features and things to do in Islington. Would definitely stay again!

the house was great, it was cosy, the kitchen was spacious, with toys for the kids, 3 bathrooms were available so no morning queue. the host was forgiving, polite and helpful, I highly recommend the place

Loved the look of the apartment, the color scheme and the art were adorable. All new and fancy appliances were included. But my favorite was the TV.  It had every channel imaginable and it was great for a relaxing night of binge watching after days of going out. There's also a cute grocery store within 10 mins walk, which helped cut down costs from constant restaurant dining on my travels.  Gary answered my questions quickly - Thanks Gary.

Alex's home exceeded expectations.  The exterior is typical London and blends into the Chelsea neighborhood that itself has so much to offer. The interior does anything but blend. It pops!  An impressive interior with a well-curated art collection will bring your vacation to life.  We felt the privilege of being in this home instantly.  I highly recommend staying here.  Staying at a place of this caliber will only enhance a visit to one of the world's most amazing cities. Thanks Alex for allowing us to experience your beautiful and comfortable home.
It’s the second time that I had stayed at Ms.Anne‘s house，who is such a kind lady. The bed is comfortable and the room is clean. The location is also convenient.Recommend！

Isabelle’s place is darling! She provided perfect instructions on getting there and made sure I had everything we needed for our short trip in London. She made sure we had a fabulous little breakfast before we left and offered us great advice. I would definitely stay again!

Spacious, clean and great value for money. We were a party of 13 and fitted into this place comfortably. Each room is very spacious and the home is very well maintained. The hosts assistants was outstanding, making this a 5 star home to stay in. Would love to stay again if ever we were visiting London again. Great experience
Richards place was perfect for a festival myself and my boyfriend were attending at blackheath. It was warm, clean and cosy, and Richard was a great host! Highly recommend.

The place was very well located very close to earls court station and was clean
I didn't have any problem

A total of four rooms in the house and one of them is occupied by the co-host! One bathroom with toilet upstairs and another toilet downstairs! Not too congested and crowded even all the rooms are rented out! It’s clean and tidy and has almost every amenities  you need! The kitchen ware could be tricky to use but the host are helpful to resolve all issues and sort out every you need, just let them know !  Very good location as well! Highly recommended and value for money!

Nice apartment in a beautiful building and guiet neigborhood . The apartment has everything to feel and be at home and looks like the pictures.   Close to tube station Angel , shops , pubs, restaurants . Would like to stay here again .  Clear communication with David .
Hyacinth was a great host, the property inside is absolutely fantastic. Box office tv system very clean and modern, we would 100% recommend this host to anybody thanks again for accommodating me.

Our family of 3 has had a brilliant time and the apartment has been a wonderful place to come home to at the end of a busy day. There was nothing we could fault, from the responsiveness of Tess, to the apartment, comfortable beds and location, we couldn’t have asked for more.
Thank you Tess.

Miriam’s flat is in a really good location, quiet but well located for bus and underground links.
The room was as described, simple but comfortable. It’s not ideal for staying in during the evening but I was out and about so this didn’t bother me.
Miriam welcomed me personally when I arrived and kept in touch during my visit. I was out and about a lot so we didn’t actually see much of each other but I knew she was available if I had any problems or questions.
The place was just right for what I was wanting: quiet and well connected.

Good location close to the oval, however its a small house with thin walls, so experience heavily dependent on other guest. We were unlucky in that the other guest was loud and kept us up with music and phone calls around 7am on the weekend.
Sian's apartment was as-advertised. Clean and in a perfect location. We'd stay here again
Isabelle is very welcoming. The appartement is perfectly located and is quiet, nice and very pleasant.

This is a great house in a very convenient location in outer London. It was spacious, offered 2 separate meeting areas (which we found so useful) and was very comfortable. The kitchen needs some additions made in terms of better utensils, but overall it was very comfortable and what we expected from the listing. Thank you!

Mo and Alessa's place was perfect me and my friends needs; great location with short distance to the Tube and bars, and great facilites, especially considering the price for staying there. Communication with Mo and Alessa was efficient and satisfactory, and I'd recommend anyone looking for affordable and cozy accomodations to check this room out.
Thank you for the pleasant stay :) great location and hostess! Miriam was very accommodating and considerate!

Carolyn is very responsive and helpful. Her apartment is close Leytonstone underground which is really convenient and she gave really clear check in instruction which is really helpful. Highly recommended accommodation

Geoff was really reactive in term of communication. We were really cold in the bedroom and he bought us a new radiator so we could be warm and cosy in the room. The location is good, about 12 min walk from the subway station. There are also buses you can take not far from his place. overall it was a nice stay. You pay for what you get.

Stayed for one night at Denise and Jonathan’s and couldn’t have asked for better hosts. The amenities within the flat was excellent and would stay there again. Highly recommended. Thank you Denise and Jonathan for the lovely stay!
We had a great stay at Anna’s before we left the country. Was the perfect location for us.
We loved staying at Isabelle's place! She was the perfect host, and was super helpful and accommodating. We know where we will want to stay the next time we are in London!
Super clean and comfortable space. Isabelle was friendly, hospitable and helpful. The breakfast was such a nice touch. I highly recommend staying here.
An awesome stay.  All that one would expect for a perfect Airbnb experience.  Value for money, convenient for airport and downtown attractions.  Will certainly return!
Nice place, nice and clean. Only issue was the noise on the street outside, very busy area.
Carolyn is a great host , the property is first class . Thank you for a great stay .

Staying at this property was a pleasure. The hosts were extremely obliging with our unexpected late arrival, friendly, considerate and went above and beyond our expectations. The property was extremely clean, well presented and provided us with all we could have required. An extremely comfortable bed too! Would happily book here again.

We had a very nice stay. Hosts did a great job communicating with us and providing very helpful  information about getting to, exploring, and enjoying the neighborhood and broader city. The apartment is in a great location in Central London with easy access to go anywhere in the city.

Geoff's place was absolutely perfect for a week's stay in London. It was affordable and yet very close to Central London, with Oval Tube station and plenty of bus stops nearby so that you could get to all the important places in about half an hour or less. Also, Geoff and his wife were fantastic hosts and I felt very welcome in their home. I can definitely recommend this room to anyone coming to London who is looking for a quiet place to stay for a few nights or maybe even just a day.

Geoff's place was ideal for us. We had a rental car and he had free parking for visitors in a closed safe compound. The communication was clear and prompt. The room clean and comfortable. Highly recommended!

Lovely place, great location. Clean, easy to check-in and out. We really enjoyed staying there, would recomend to :)
Sure, we’ll visit again.
I'd recommend Miriam to anyone looking for a clean, welcoming, and thoughtful environment. Also, close to paddington station which is very convenient

My daughter and I stayed in apartment 11 at Max and Billie's place in Nottinghill for 8 nights. We found the studio exactly as described and depicted in the photos. The studio was very easy to find and so accessible via public transport, even with heavy luggage. The check-in and check-out process was seamless. Max and Billie, or their very efficient team, were always available to answer any questions I had. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this studio!

Gary's place is a great place to stay away from central London. It's a quick 20 minute walk to the train station and within minutes you will arrive in London allowing you to transfer to the Underground easily to reach any destination you are looking for. The area has great convenience stores and restaurants all within walking distance from the apartment or the train station. Gary and Irina were extremely responsive to all the messages and calls making the entire process from booking to check-in as simple as possible. Would highly recommend Gary's place!

It was a big pleasure to be with Damini and Anshu. They are very friendly and we had some nice chats during our stay. The breakfest is very good. The ensuite and the whole house are very luxury and we recommend it without hesitation. Thanks for everything.

Our four night stay in Rosie's flat was very enjoyable. Access to Kew Gardens and the tube into the city was very easy from there. Rosie herself was great with communication and nothing was too much trouble.
Kew itself is a lovely area to make a base to see the sights of London.
As always Hyacinth was the perfect host great communication, great house with four fantastic rooms. looking forward to staying again in the future.

The apartment was great, very clean and great value for money. The hosts were very kind to allow me to stay less then the advertised advert, so ask if you do wish to stay less time, you might be pleasantly surprised. The place has plenty of mod cons, which I'm not use to, so found a little difficult using the oven, but sorted it in the end. Overall a great place and would definitely use again

We only stayed there for a night, so not a bunch to comment on.  They were really easy to communicate with and the location is close to St. Pancras station, which was our intent.  The room was cosy and comfortable.

Fantastic location and fantastic hosts. So quick in responding
Small studio but it was as we expected and very clean and perfect for a couple of nights

We had a great stay in very comfortable surroundings despite AirBnB’s attempts to cancel our booking - we don’t know why and our hostess (Jan) was great so we’re glad we persevered. We spent the better part of a day at Downe House, home of Charles Darwin where he wrote Origin of Species and Descent of Man - what an idyllic place!
Proximity to the train station was great and the neighborhood was awesome. Lot's of options for breakfast and dinner. The room was as we had expected and perfect for those on a budget.
The location is everything i could ask for, Tina was very friendly helped me with all my inquiries, she’s cool too :p loves it
Nice location, close the subway and shops. Very convenient location. The host response very quick and helpful. Thank you!

This place had a such a kind and helpful host. We had our own space but also felt that Isabelle was there to help if needed. She also made us a delicious breakfast before we headed off. Thanks for an amazing stay!
Never to disappoint, every time I have stayed in this property it has been absolutely perfect. thanks Hyacinth for hosting me
Very easy place to access London from! On a quiet street in a good neighbourhood would recommend to anyone who plans on spending their time in the city and needs a convenient nice place to stay!

Perfect, this is what airbnb is for. Super safe area (woman, travelling alone). Tina was a perfect hostess. Everything nice and clean, good bed, good shower and very close to public transport (tube). Absolutely recommended!
As always the property was spotless clean, perfect for me and my team. Hyacinth is a great host always there to tend any needs thanks again for hosting me it’s been a pleasure
Olga went away for a short time and made sure that everything was in order for me to continue enjoying staying at her lovely flat.

We spent a wonderful time in family at Lydia's place. The flat is spacious, atypical and convinient. The train is at 10 minutes walk. Lydia answers very quickly and she is really concerned about helping you feeling comfortable.
A beautiful apartment, wonderfully kitted out with everything we needed. Lydia was very quick to respond to our queries despite being in a different continent!

Great space! All the facilities needed for a short or longer stay in London.
Fantastic guide made up by Robin to London with absolutely everything you will need to know during your stay. Thoughtful touches such as Oyster cards, UK adapters and the guide to the area, food, shops and transport made for a wonderful smooth trip.
Top floor with a view over the street and old buildings of the area which was beautiful. Very light apartment, with constant heating making it very cosy and warm.
Thanks again robin!
Great location, close to the Paddington Station which suited me!  Miriam was kind and helpful all the time !

We stayed at this place for 12 days and it felt like a home away from home.  The house was very self contained it had every necessary thing, even in the kitchen, extremely well maintained and clean. The location was spot on as it was exactly a 2 minute walk to Oxford Street. An 8 min walk to both Oxford circus and Tottenham stations. Next lane had a Sainsbury, a lovely cafe down and a buzzing bar across the road. The house was in a by lane so no disturbances. Check in was very easy with the safe box. Lynn was extremely prompt with her messages whenever we needed. The apartment is just like what is in the pictures rather bigger.  Next time in London we would definitely book this place again.. Lynn was a super super amazing host and awesome house:)

Chris's place was beautifully appointed with all the mod cons and several thoughtful touches. Great communication and so central and convenient as well. Really look forward to staying again in the future!
This is a really great space for two people (no more IMO) in the Covent Garden / Seven Dials area of London, which is the place to be if you like theatre and eating out.
Isabelle is more than a host, she makes you feel home. P. S. Wonderful breakfast!

Really great, buzzing area, centrally located for Shoreditch, Spitalfields and Brick Lane.  The apartment is exactly as described, really clean and comfy beds. Stay if you're fine with stairs. Check-in was really easy - the managing agents are super friendly and provide easy instructions. I felt very at home here.

Comfortable room for 3 guests, well-furnished, clean, fridge and small sink in the room are very useful. Excellent location, close to underground, plenty of shops, bars and a variety of restaurants. Very good value for money.
The place was simply amazing, clean, stylish and close to a Central line station. The host was helpful and quick to reply. Definitely keeping it in mind for future trips!
As always Hyacinth was a great host tending to all our needs. thanks for being such a fantastic host. looking forward to staying in the future.

A great place to stay,  for a large group...very near to the station  (just a 15 minute journey to St Pancras )   very clean, comfortable and warm ( a must in chilly November)  would highly recommend, a great price and quality accommodation, which can be difficult to access  in London.  Good size bedrooms and plenty of communal space to get  together to eat, chat etc   Thank you Guru.

Great place to walk from.  Everything is 1-3 miles away and Taxis take just as long in most cases to get you there.  Covent Garden is an easy tube on and off point about  .1-.2 miles away.  Super easy.

Great location (near tube station and services) but flat not as big and chic as shown on the pictures. It needs to be refreshed (repainted). The photos aren’t reflecting reality and we had higher expectations.

Bo is not honest about his place
He has a bnb and student rental. So we had to share the bathroom with four other bedrooms

Beautiful apartment in a silent surrounding. Just a little walk to the train which will bring you directly to the London City Centre. The apartment is absolutely clean and has everything you need. The host is friendly and responds within minutes. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb!

This very stylish flat is in a great location, is very quiet and comfortable. There was plenty of space for 4 people. Paula was very quick to respond to contact and was very helpful. I highly recommend this flat.

We were a family of four adults and stayed three nights in Carolyn's apartment. We found it very comfortable and well located within 5 minutes walk to the underground station and a big local tescos. The apartment is modern, well equipped, clean and all furnishing are of high quality. The space is compact so maybe ideal for up to 4 people, there is only one shower room with a toilet. We parked  our car for free at the back of the property which was very convenient. Unfortunately, we did not meet Carolyn but we stayed in contact through messages and she responded always very promptly. All in all a very pleasant stay.

This is a lovely place with great facilities. Kirsty is a great host with lovely personalised touches waiting for you on arrival.
Roughly 10-15 mins to the nearest tube station, and 15 mins to the heart of busy London.
The location is good and the landlord provides a lot of useful information. The newly painted walls smell a bit strong

It was lovely staying at Simon's, the flat is perfect for a weekend in London and was also ideal for us - two adults and a nearly 2-year-old. The flat has everything you need, it's spacious and light with a large and airy bathroom and a big tub which especially delighted our daughter who'd have gladly spent the entire London getaway splashing about.
The area is lovely and peaceful considering Portobello Market and a lively restaurant and shop scene literally minutes away. We highly recommend staying at Simon's flat and we'd love to stay there again next time we're in London!
The landlord is very good. I met some small problems when I checked out. Thank the landlord for his patience and tolerance.
It was my first time in Taylan's place, but definitely not the last one. Good value and excellent location

Great place in the heart of Paddington only a few minutes from Little Venice, the canal, and Hyde Park. The room was super cute and the flat very comfortable, with a kitchen stocked with breakfast items and coffee. Pablo and Miriam were very welcoming and flexible when my flight was delayed several hours. The late check out time is also a huge plus!

Jennie's apartment was in a great location. A short walk from the tube. We had everything we needed to stay for the weekend. Jennie was in constant contact while we stayed there. The building was very quiet, and we also appreciated the bottle of wine left for the visit.

This apartment is so wonderful and very spacious. We met Victoria at our arrival and had a thorough introduction to all the amenities and gadgets so it felt like home right away. Would absolutely recommend staying here.
Loved the flat. It was very clean and contemporary. It was a 30 second walk to the underground station making it very easy to get around London   Would definitely recommend a stay here.

Isabelle has a super comfortable and stylish place in an excellent location. At her recommendation we were able to jump on and off London buses, enjoying views of London we would otherwise have missed. Isabelle's knowledge of the area is fantastic, making for a very enjoyable couple of days.

Tina's place is very conveniently located for transport and places to eat. The room was very comfortable, quiet and clean. Great amenities like a full kitchen. Tina is really friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.
Isabelle is a great host.  The accommodation is clean, comfortable and well located.  The breakfast is great! We could certainly recommend her home to any Airbnb guest.
Richard is very kind and friendly. He is always ready to help. His house is clean, tidy and quiet. I was pleased to live in his house for almost 2 weeks.

Great location if you want to be close to Kings Cross.
Flat was great, clean and would stay here again

Just a 3 minute Walk to the underground. The Location is close to many restaurant, all kinds of shops  and a supermarket. Exzellent central Location so it is easy to access many places in London.  Good value for money!

Very warm and welcoming host, location is superb just a stones throw away from Greenwich Pier and Greenwich Observatory. Neighborhood is also very quiet and safe and of course the view through the window is just magical.

Best Airbnb rental ever!
I absolutely loved my stay. Everything was perfect as it seemed online. The room was clean, and the bed very comfortable. There’s also a nice en-suite bathroom. I needed some work done so I was very happy with the desk and fast WiFi!
Also, Evelyn is a great host - communicative and reactive. She provided me with all the information I needed and showed me around.
The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and perfectly located: 5-min walk to Wood Street Overground station with trains to Central London. Wood Street itself is a lovely street full of shops, cafes, restaurants whatever you need. There’s even an indoor flea market :).
I would absolutely recommend to stay there!
Great location to explore the city.  Debby is a good host (clear instructions/communication for check in & out).  The apartment has everything you need.

Alex’s home is a very comfortable, well equipped, aesthetically pleasing place that easily accommodated my family of two adults and three almost adult kids. The two bathrooms and extra lavatory was certainly very convenient. The home has all conveniences one would expect in a modern home that has been renovated to a high standard. including TVs in all the bedrooms, underfloor heating in the main bathroom (a big plus for us), and a kitchen fitted out to a high standard which home cooks will appreciate. We really enjoyed having a proper tea pot and plentiful good quality crockery and cutlery (not your usual IKEA stuff here). The main living area is a delight, filled with interesting art and plenty of  comfortable seating for large groups. The linen was plentiful and we never lacked for towels. The bus stop is conveniently close. We had a very pleasant stay. Thank you Alex.

Very nice, clean and cozy home in a great location (about 8 min walk from Paddington tube station). The hosts are wonderfully accommodating, providing whatever is needed as soon as they can. This is my second time staying in this flat and I would gladly stay again in the future.
Paula’s Place was fantastic. Cosy, big and nicely decorated. Communication was good and would definitely stay again.
Great room, really comfy and clean. Only comment would be its not for light sleepers, as the road noise was very apparent, but didn't effect me too much.

Awesome and really caring host. Great apartment with really interesting pictures and a really good interior. Robin provided all the important information and tools for a successful stay in london! Really friendly.
The location is Camden what means that you’re not only in a interesting part of London, you’re also near Camden market. Further more there is a tube station near the apartment where the Piccadilly line stops so you’ll have a direct connection to the center and the airport Heathrow.

Alex’s place was perfect both in location and facilities
The house is set back off the road and was very quiet . The area felt very safe even at night.
The accommodation was very light and spacious
The facilities were of a very high standard .
Communication was excellent and Alex’s friends were there to meet us
If you are looking to stay in Central London then we can thoroughly recommend Alex’s place!

Isabelle’s home is lovely and she is a very gracious host.  She goes out of her way to make your stay comfortable but also tries to afford you as much privacy as possible.  I would highly recommend staying here- convenient location (it’s an easy walk to the tube), clean and comforting space, and a very amiable host- an Airbnb win!

Clean, neat and much more private than I expected (which is positive). The place is accessible, safe for girls and just nice. Taylan has been very helpful and he'd even accommodated my luggage before the check-in time. 7 days of wonderful stay and definitely not the last one!

We loved our stay at Isabelle’s place! The room is small but very comfortable, we had a delicious breakfast every morning and Isabelle had a lot of useful tips to give us. The house was very clean and cozy and you’ll find buses and the tube very close by which is very convenient. We definitely recommend Isabelle’s place.
I only stayed for one night but this place was lovely! Very cute little loft bed and the balcony was gorgeous. I’d stay here again!
Inge's the best host I've ever had. she's so accommodating of all your requests and the place is beyond amazing. the location is great, everything you need is just 7 mins walk

The place is everything you would expect from it, if you look at the pictures. We stayed there with a total of 4 people and the two bathrooms make it ideal to share the place with friends. There is a parking space in front of the appartement.
A beautifully put together one bed flat, close to the river and all that Kew offers.  Comfortable and a lovely stay.

This apartment has everything you will need plus it’s extremely clean and an excellent location.
I would highly recommend.
Vikash' place is good, as expected based on reviews from previous guests. The house is clean and tidy. Vikash responded quickly to any query. In general all of us happy with the house.
This was a great place to stay! We only stayed one night, but we could’ve easily stayed longer in such a nice place.
Carolyn is a very attentive host. The apartment is cozy decorated an fully equipped. It's located nearby a subway station and you are in a few minutes in the center of London.
Vikash’s place is outstanding in value and size for my large family visiting London and it’s outskirts. I would recommend it to would be travellers.

Agat is an excellent host! Very friendly and helpful. Cannot ask for a better host. The flat itself is great, we had a pleasant stay there. The bed and sofa was super comfy, spacious bedroom, kitchen n living room. Thank you Agat!

The apartment was exactly as the description as well as clean and very cozy.  Unfortunately the host was not present, but everything worked very well. We got a detailed description of everything and it was well organised.  Thank you very much for letting us stay in your apartment and experiencing London at New Years Eve! We will definitely come back soon!

A great location. The walk from Kew Gardens underground is about 5 minutes.  There is a big Marks & Spencer within walking distance as well.  The flat is very bright with high ceilings.  The bed was very comfortable.  Kew is on a flight path to Heathrow and the train is nearby so earplugs are a good idea.  Wonderful little shops, cafes and pubs in the area.   A Sunday Roast at The Greyhound is a must!

Great location close to tube. Tracy has an amazing, eclectic space which we loved coming home to, with lots of interesting ‘knick knacks’. Shops and restaurants close by. We loved it - especially having some plunger coffee!

Sparkling clean place! Even big enough for 3 people. Super-convenient location: big supermarket, bus stop and stores to top up Oyster cards outside the house, many good restaurants in Camden town, and just a few steps to the tube station.
Stayed overnight in London for work. Great location for me and good communication from a welcoming family. Thanks!

We stayed for a weekend and wanted a comfortable place to come back to knowing we’d be spending most of the day sightseeing and eating out. Ana’s place was perfect.  The flat was very clean and the beds lovely and comfortable. There was plenty of space for 3 of us. We only used the kitchen, which is very small, for making tea and coffee but there was a large fridge-freezer if you wanted to do more self-catering. The location of the flat is fantastic - 5 mins walk from Notting Hill Gate, Bayswater and Queensway tube stations but there is also plenty of shops and restaurants within a couple of minutes walk of the flat. Ana has put a helpful guide together for transport options and local businesses and she was also very quick to respond to any questions and gave clear instructions for check-in and check-out. I would definitely recommend this place.

Isabelle is an absolutely wonderful host and I would highly recommend. It was great to chat with her over breakfast in the morning. She offered good recommendations on things to do in the city and her place was central and clean. Mr. Darcy was a delight. She went well beyond the requirements of a bed and breakfast and is a superb host.

Great house in a great location. 5min walk from a underground station where you can get in the Picadilly line which is one of the main lines if you are visiting the city. The Flat was really cool, had everything you need for a few days in London. Definitely a place to repeat

Super convenient location for Notting Hill, Hyde park and the museum district near the Royal Albert hall which was my main destination.  Room is clean and comfortable with shared facilities very homey. Tina is a great host and easy to communicate with.
A very nice apartment in a quiet part of Kew.  The plan is very convenient for Kew Village and Station as well as Kew Gardens
Lovely apartment in a gorgeous red brick house. Quiet location. Great facilities and was perfect for our business trip. Spacious and comfortable.

Gary's place is clean and everything was in working condition. host was also very responsive to any inquiries and check in check out procedure was simple and hassle free. Only thing is that place is slightly inaccessible from airport and to city centre so had to spend quite a bit on travelling. other than that, everything else was wonderful

This is a very spacious, warm and bright apartment in a quiet location. Great for exploring a lovely part of London on foot. Comfortable bedrooms, a lovely kitchen, very clean, with two nice bathrooms and plenty of hot water. Tamara was very easy to communicate with. The apartment is great value.

Fantastic location. Nidhi and Sam go out of their way to welcome you with lots of little touches, including a little bag of Turkish delight on each bed, milk and snacks in the fridge, a well stocked kitchen, and great suggestions for things to do/places to eat. The house is spacious, clean, warm, newly renovated, a 5 minute walk from 2 tube stations, and very secure. A grocery store is literally across the street and Regents Park is an 8 minute walk. The home is close to many big attractions. Highly recommend!!!

Evelyn was a dream host, really friendly and thoughtful. She really made me feel welcome in her home and was very quick to respond to messages. The room itself was spacious, bright and clean, with a desk which was handy for work. Location is about 40 minutes into Central London, 25 minutes direct into Liverpool Street, really wasn't a hassle travelling in at all.
Great place, really easy to get to and the hosts were wonderful and very accommodating of me. I would highly recommend staying here.

A very well thought out space with everything you need. The internet connected smart TV and RFID locks makes the place fun and simple to use. Buses are available just outside which makes it very easy to get to East Croydon Train Station which will let you get anywhere you need to. Gary was very easy to communicate with. Would recommend, 5 stars!!

Tina is very hospitable and kind; and her place is perfectly located, clean and connected to the public transport, she is very hospitable.
It is the perfect option if you are traveling alone.
Juste’s place is tastefully decorated. It is very clean and well kept. The location is great, but the street can be noisy at night.
Amazing place - communication was great with them and being new to London, they made our trip so much easier!! :)

Thanks to our lovely host Sian - a gordious place with a wonderful atmosphere : tastefully furnished, quiet, clean, nothing was missing.
At any time Sian was reachable for questions and support.
Everything needed was in walking distance - it couldn‘t have been better. Just unforgettable!
The sheets smelled soo good, I want to know what laundry detergent she uses, ha! Such a great location, Tina picked me up promptly and carried my massive suitcase up for me.  Thanks Tina!
Excellent opción if you are looking comfort, privacy and a place well located also clean and cosy. Tina a wonderfull hostess, really a very kind person 😊
Richard and Kris were so quick to respond, even though I arrived later than anticipated they let me in, no problem and were really understanding. Room was exactly what I needed.
Sam’s local tips were amazing! The place was centrally located and very cozy and warm after spending the daytime exploring London. Great location near Regent Park is a runners paradise!
Tamara's flat is really nice and clean, I absolutely recommend to rent it for your stay in London!
Rosie’s apartment was super clean, in a great location. Rosie was very helpful, responsive and a great host.

Fantastic place and one of the best Airbnb’s in London. If you want to have private space, in well presented accommodation this is very good value for money. I’ve stayed at both Taylans places a few times. Highly recommended.
Ana’s apartment was lovely, has great facilities and location. We enjoyed our stay and would return if we are ever back again.
Parking, no problem! Shops and tube/bus station all within easy walking distance. Loved the decor, very funky. Carolyn is a very helpful, honest and pleasant host.

As a family we loved this home- great space for being together, eating, chatting, relaxing and playing board games.  Good kitchen space and dining area.  Close to local supermarket.  We enjoyed our stay very much especially being able to get to Hampton Court Palace easily for our daughters first half marathon!

Staying with Hayley is very uncomplicated. Pick up and bringing back the key was very easy. We were seven people so all beds were full. there is only one blanket per bed so if you don‘t want to share bring your own. the kitchen wasn‘t good equipped. we missed a large pot and some good knifes for cutting. and the fire alarm goes on very easy- be ready! :D overall it was a good stay! beds were confy, it was clean and we loved the two bathrooms (even though one is very small). thanks for the good stay! we would definitely book again ;)
I had a lovely stay at Geoff’s, it was quiet, safe and very comfortable. I stayed for one night as I was working in the area and would recommend highly it.
We had a lovely time at Evelyn’s place. She is an great host and always tries to be helpful. It was the best welcome to London we could imagine. We definitely would choose to book it again.

Anna's apartment was perfect for our stay in London. The apartment was lovely & clean, everything me & my family needed was provided. The car parking right outside & being close to public transport was very convenient. My children really appreciated being so close to the playground on Stretham Common too to help wind down at the end of a busy day.

Place is exactly as described, in a nice neighbourhood (surrounded by parcs). There's public transport nearby and you're quite close to everything. The host is friendly and respnds quickly to any questions you may have.

The stay at sians place was exactly what we needed : a central and big apartment with easy access to the tube, good communication with Sian and a nice neighborhood to stay in. Check - in/out was quick, the cleaning lady was great. So, overall very happy with our stay, and would truly recommend it.

My parents and I are very happy and we have a great stay.  Gary and Irina are great host.  They allow us to check in early because we arrived London early than expected.  They also allowed us to check out a bit late. The house is beautiful, clean and modern.  Its a bit far from the London city but dont worry because there are a direct train to London bridge and two stops to London Victoria.  Everything is great and I would recommend to other travelers.
Check-in was flawless. Lynn was a great communicator. Flat was clean, comfortable and in a great location!  Choosing this flat, made the start for a fantastic holiday!

Lovely little apartment. 1 bedroom and pulldown double bed (felt just like any other bed) means this is great for 2 friends or 2 couples. It is fairly small with the bed down in the living room, but more than enough space to sit and watch TV, to cook and to eat at the table. Great location only a few minutes from Oxford circus and good restaurants on the doorstep. Surprisingly quiet at night. It is the perfect place to explore central London from, and to escape and relax at the end of the day. Great value too.
Always a delight - whenever in London, this is my go-to place to stay. Anne is lovely, the location is excellent, can’t fault it! :)

Incredible location to South Kensington and less than a 5 minute walk to the Tube! Fabio is an incredible host with impeccable communication. Definitely will be back and recommend this booking to all.

Th room is exactly the same as described. It's a cozy, tidy and quiet place. Great location. Richard and Kris are very friendly and helpful.
Although there is no door for the room, I don't feel the problem with privacy at all.
Thank you for having us! :)
The house is nice and tidy to host a large group of guests and well situated. Lots of shops and food stores near by. And an easy access by bus or train.

My wife and me had  an overall very pleasant stay. Geoff was very quick to respond to any questions we had in terms of directions and the place was nice and clean. Absolutely nothing negative to say really. We will gladly come back for another time. Thanks to the wonderful hosts.

A lovely house, very clean and in a great location in Wimbledon.
Chris was always very responsive and very helpful.
Absolutely perfect staying. In a small Street off the main road. No traffic noise, warm environment and comfortable staying for working people

Gary & Irina were awesome hosts and this apartment was amazing! It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The check-in and check-out process was easy and finding the apartment wasn't difficult at all.
The location of the apartment is just outside the center of London, but using public transportation you'll be able to get to where you need to go and experience the big city without having to stay in the hustle and bustle of it all.
Overall, I'd say our trip to London was made 10x better by the hospitality offered by Gary and Irina. Will definitely be staying here again on our next visit! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Joanna is a super host, extremely responsive and helpful! Quick responses to all our enquiries and do offer helps whenever we need!
Joanna’s apartment is located at a premier site, just a few steps to Harrods and bus stations / tube. The nearest tube station is Knightsbridge which is at the Piccardily Line. It makes you easier to get from the airport or to every popular sites in London.
The check-in/out process is the smoothest one we have ever experienced while Joanna has come personally to greet us in the early morning during check-in.
The apartment is clean, spacious, equipped with everything you need. More importantly, it has a great wide view so you can see the nice scenery outside. Will definitely come back again!

Juste's home is a dream come true for any working woman in an alien city. I had to stay for 3 weeks and felt like I was leaving my own home when I had to vacate. It's just lovely in every aspect.
Thank you Juste for providing the travelers with your gorgeous stay. It truly feels like a home away from home.
My stay is extended for few more weeks. Hope your space isn't rented out already.

This flat was in a great location and had wonderful amenities. The host is very helpful and thoughtful. Everything was sparkling clean and very comfortable. I would highly recommend this property for 3 to 6 people. When I come back to London I will try to stay here again.
It is a 20 minute walk from the train station, which is super convenient, it's also close to Camden road with lots of neat coffee shops (Beans and Music is a fav)

Christian’s place is fantastic! Very good value for money, very near the bus stops, tube and you can also walk if you’d like. I walk from the place to Westminster and even went up to Leicester Square and Trafalgar Square. Place is clean and cozy. I felt at home right away. Just a little bit of honest review here though, if you do not fancy stairs this is not the place for you. Older folks may have a hard time especially with large luggage. Just saying. But apart from that, I enjoyed my stay. Christian is very warm & friendly :)

A very nice apartment in a perfect location. We felt very comfortable. From there, shops/restaurants/pubs and everything worth seeing can be reached on foot, but also the connection with public transport is of course perfect. Two small supermarkets are nearby. The communication with Lynn was very friendly, helpful and fast at all times. Thank you, Lynn.

It's the second time I have been in this place, and the experience was fantastic.... the location is amazing -lot of things to do and very good to commute even at night-.... the place was very clean and the check in was easy to do.
The only thing that could be improve is the mattress, for me it's quite soft and I could not sleep comfortably. However due the high standards of the host I'm sure they will change it soon.

Marc's apartment is clean, modern and stylish, exactly as shown in the pictures. Carolina responded promptly to my messages and was always happy to help. The living room has a nice view on Southwark Park and the bedroom faces the courtyard. Nearby (2min walk) there is a shopping centre and Tesco is open 24h. Great stay!

The flat is located walking distance to Victoria station, bars, restaurants, and a big supermarket.  It is in a quiet street.  Check-in and check-out process were very easy.  While guests are not allowed to smoke, we walked in and the apartment smelled like cigarette.  We were disappointed by this as we are non smokers.

Great place,lovely location ,close by everything you need and will wish to have in your time in london. Full profit for your money. Hosts are very nice and welcoming. Make sure you visit warmly recommended.
We had a fantastic stay at Carolyn’s. Carolyn was very hospitable and her communication was excellent. Would highly recommend

Good flat, very good location. Sian is super reactive. Would advise you to go there. The couch in the living room is not super comfy however so it’s not for sensitive people. But no problems with the bed and the bathroom

It’s a very nice and cute house.
Paula is a very friendly person and gave us some advice on our trip.
Super clean and cosy apartment with reasonable price. Close to the Stockwell station, and quiet at night.  Strong recommend.

We stayed here as a family of four. The flat is very handy for the tube station and local shops, restaurants, etc. Very cool wallpaper and everything you might need is here. The beds were very comfy too. It was really convenient to have a car parking space at the back of the flat. It was lovely to meet Carolyn and she was extremely helpful in showing us around the flat, providing bread, milk etc and telling us about the local area. Highly recommended!

I would recommend Lila’s house to anyone. My family and I stayed here and had a lovely time. The house is modern but with lots of nice paintings and features, which gave it a homely feel. The kitchen is well equipped and spacious, with a separate dining room.  The living room is a nice and relaxing place to hang out, with a TV and some nice books to read. The bathrooms were very clean -- a bath/shower upstairs and a rain shower downstairs. We all slept very well; it’s on a nice quiet street. It also near to Elephant and Castle and the underground, so we were easily able to travel. Lila provided some great tips for the local area which was very fun to explore!

A very cute private studio well separated from the rest of Denise and Jonathan’s beautiful house immersed in their garden.
Making it a relaxing retreat.
A few hundred yards from Wimbledon Tennis stadium and park and bus to Wimbledon village, walking distance from district line, about 10 minutes.
Denise kindly welcomed us personally and adjusted before our arrival on our demands.
Can only recommend.

Joanna's accommodation was well designed, clean and located close to amenities. She was also a wonderful host and provided some great suggestions for restaurants in London. Thanks Joanna making my stay so welcoming and inviting.
This is a great place located in Chelsea and the location was terrific!! The hosts were so accommodating, and we really enjoyed VanZyl’s flat. Thank you for all your help!!
This is a perfect apartment for the couple willing to explore London. Carey’s place is very well equipped, comfy and we felt very welcomed in her place. Looking forward to come back!

A very nice and secure place to stay in london a 10-15 minutes walk to oxford. Very close to boutiques with Starbucks and a supermarket  just across the road . House was very clean, the room is quite small but compared to london hotels its spacious. Recommended!!

Inge’s home is well appointed, with everything you need-kitchen, laundry, and en-suite bath. Though there are other guests it is very quiet and everyone has their own space as well as the common areas. Very convenient to District tube like into center city and all attractions. Very safe and lovely neighborhood of Chiswick. Great parks and green spaces nearby and many dining options between Hammersmith and Chiswick High Street. No need for a cab-very walkable! Would definitely stay here again.
Jose is great host.  The flat is in a great location for public transport with a Tesco  metro close by.  The flat is very clean and the kitchen/diner is  well appointed and has plenty of equipment.

This flat is conveniently located with walking distance to Nottinghill shops and Kensington Gardens. The flat is cozy and is located at the basement level; however, if you are not planning to be on-the-go and use the flat just for sleeping, this is a good value.
Tamara's apartment is really nice and clean, I absolutely recommend it for your stay in London!

Isabelle’s place was great for our vacation to London.  My wife and I enjoyed our stay and we appreciated Isabelle’s hospitality.  She provided many local tips to help us navigate London.  Also, she provided breakfast each morning which included delicious homemade jam.  We would stay with Isabelle again and recommend her place to others.

Christian's place is  close to the Waterloo station/London Eye, which makes very easy to go anywhere in the city. This area is very safe, very residential and quiet. Also, the place is clean, very nice, nice kitchen, nice dining room and a cool balcony.  Christian was very helpful, communication was fast and he gave a lot of useful local information. We had a  nice chat about a lot of thins, which was a nice cultural exchange. I'd stay there again!

The apartment is beautiful and meticulously clean. It's in a great neighborhood and is close by train to London. The owners are responsive and friendly, checking in and out is so smooth and the apartment has everything you need. I'll definitely come back-it's a great value for the location and the amenities!

Geoff’s place was great, just like the pictures. We never met Geoff himself only the wife and she was kind. They allowed us to check in early due to us having and extremely early flight and previous guest leaving before we arrived. Location was great, in a very quiet and safe area, only 25-30 from all the tourist attractions via bus or metro. Buses were a 3min walk from door to bus stop and oval statin was a 10min walk.

There's not a lot I can say that hasn't already been said about this place. Sam met us upon check-in with light groceries, flowers, and a wealth of recommendations.....certainly above and beyond. The flat was clean, modern, and perfect for three of us.  It's a few blocks from 2 tube stations and there wasn't anywhere in London we couldn't get to in 20 minutes or less. Don't think twice about booking this for your trip. We already miss it.

The Flat was clean and maintained. It is in walking distance to a lot of the sights, the London Tube, places to eat, and a grocery store.
The manager was quick to respond to any questions we had.
We stayed in a clean room and it was comfortable and hospitality is so good . We were very relieved.
The place is lovely and the hosts equally so. It’s about a 10-15 minute walk to the closest tube and shops. Ideal for a quick stop in south London for work.

Super cosy place that's super close to the underground. Loved every bit of it. Half the fun was seeing how every part of the studio was utilized to full potential. I'll happily stay here again the next time I'm in London.

The apartment is just like photos and description... and even better !
There is plenty of daylight, the place is really quiet, and the apartment is top quality. Shane and Jenny also helped us for check in and check out times, and I really appreciated that. I hope to come back on my next trip to London !

The flat itself is lovely...beautiful art, a wonderful library, comfy furnishings, and a soft bed!
The location is ideal. We walked to everything we had planned to visit and there is plenty to do in the immediate area as well. We found good coffee everywhere. Loved Neal’s Yard for pastries, coffee, pizza and a cool vibe!
We loved our London visit and hope to be back to this flat.
James is so helpful and easy to work with. He was quick to get back with answers and information. We highly recommend!

Christian offers a great place to stay which is close to the centre of London but without the hustle and bustle of the city. The accommodation is clean and well kept and Christian is quick to respond to any queries. I appreciated the small touches he added such as a bottle of water in the room on arrival and the toiletries made available. I would definitely recommend this place as an affordable place to stay for anyone visiting central London.
Billie was excellent at getting back to us quickly and accommodating some last minute luggage needs we had. We highly recommend this place!

Ali is a lovely man who looked after us and went above and beyond when i got lost in Kingston! The apartment was beautiful, well located and as expected. It was excellent value for money and the check in out process couldn't have run smoother. There is loads of parking outside that is available for free on weekends. I couldn't have asked for anything more. Thanks Ali.

Excellent place - great location and communication. Less than 10 min walk to transport (underground and buses) and shopping in local shops, supermarkets and super big Westfield. Three flat very well appointed, equipped and comfortable for two persons. Communication with the host instantaneous. One of the best places in our long history of traveling with Airbnb. Recommended with no reservation.

The location is great, especially if you want to visit the Greenwich/Canary Wharf area (which you should!). The views are beautiful and it's very close to the O2 arena - good choice if you're going to a gig. Communication was great, hosts were super flexible and the place was warm, cozy and clean. Highly recommended.

What a perfect place to stay. Felt like a home away from home for our family over the long weekend. Such character but still so communal and warm. Lydia was the perfect host and helped us discover the best SE London has to offer. Gracias!

Lovely apartment to stay in London. Clean noise-free with very pleasant staff. Excellent location by walking distance, city tube, or bus connections. Bars, restaurants, pubs and shopping places just nearby.
Many thanks Michelle for taking care!

Absolutely amazing little apartment! Perfect for two! We had booked for just under two weeks to be in London for a bit of work and pleasure. Alexandra collected and dropped us at the Paddington Express which is conveniently close. The apartment is very spacious and is filled with lots of light, newly refurbished and very central. Great Internet and had everything we needed to live in London for the two weeks. Nothing was too much effort for Alexandra to arrange for us. She really is a "Super Host".
Will definitely stay there again!

Wonderful apartment with comfortable beds with countless pillows, blankets and towels. Fully furnished kitchen with washer and dryer in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood. 10 minute walk to the underground. I would definitely use Tamara’s apartment in the future.

Isabelle's house is a great spot to spend time in London. Handy for the bus or tube into town and on a quiet residential street. The room is spotless and cosy and it was great to have access to a living room to chill out in after a busy day. Isabelle (and Mr Darcy the cat of course!) is a fantastic host and she was really helpful when it came to planning our journeys into town. Top of our list for return visits to London!
Another lovely stay with Inge - this place is great and perfect for a business or leisure trip. All amenities are here and it is a very comfortable and stylish place.
Perfect accomodation; location ideal and convenient; apartment spotless, well appointed, and comfortable; hosts were great (responsive, helpful, kind); would stay there again in a heartbeat
Great apartment in a quiet residential neighborhood. Very clean and comfortable beds.  We were there only one night but were very happy with this place.

Best host ever. Very kind and friendly. Is now a beloved personal friend. The apartment is modern, new and beautifully decorated. Near Woolwich's Tesco and all sort of commerce. Two blocks away from the DLR. Can't recommend more.

Very nice flat, with great location to reach Central London. Perfect and easy organisation for arrival and departure. Lots of little details in the flat that made us feel very welcome! Highly recommended!

The flat is in the second zone, not far from the Tube station. It takes about 30 - 40 min. to get London center.
Rosario and her husband are very friendly and polite.
I stopped for 9 nights, that`s why it was not completely comfortable stay in the tight and crammed with furniture flat and room.
Great location.  Stylish flat with added bonus of cute outdoor space when the sun was shining.

Humayun’s place is ideally located for Canary Wharf, with the offices only a short and pleasant walk away.  His place was sparkling clean and exactly as described and photographed.  I arrived very late on my first night and he was very accommodating. The room was very quiet and the bed was very comfortable, the bathroom was modern, clean and the shower was excellent. I had a great couple of nights and would be very happy to return for another stay.
We enjoyed our stay in London at Sophie’s place. It was clean and close to the tube station. Would recommend!
Great appartment in a very nice nabourhood, great hospitality. We really recomment Sam’s place!

Megan is a wonderful host. Everything was very easy and she helped us a lot with organising the parking which was fantastic! The appartement is perfect, very clean and functional. The beds are great and enough space for everything. Wifi works very good and everything else was perfect as well. The location is also very good, park 2 min away, short walk to the tube station, nice pubs and restaurants in walking distance. After a busy day in London we enjoyed the quitness in the back garden. We will probably try to stay there next time we visit London.

This apartment is in a great location, incredibly clean and has lovely extra touches included to make you feel even more welcome. Our party of six had plenty of room and everyone enjoyed their time spent there. We felt this was due to the hosts thoughtful planning of amenities. The host was very quick to reply to all my messages from booking, to checking in and out. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Robin’s flat is perfect for a visit to London . Centrally located and lots of tips from Robin . Clean, charming and Robin is great to answer questions promptly. Very obliging with various check-in , check out requests too.
Isabelle is such a kind person and the place was very clean and tidy. Thanks so much for the great conversations and tips!

Cute house which is small but works , and in a fabulous location and great street. Super check-in.
Downsides are it’s abit tired and needs a few little repairs and would benefit from a spruce up abit!
To be honest Christian was amazing. He replied quickly, the instructions were exact,  and the place made staying in London a lot more comfortable.

We had a lovely stay at Anne’s home. It was my second stay so we were made to feel very welcome.
Anne was extremely hospitable, responsive and gave us a great tip for a local Italian cafe for a very delicious brunch.
The bedroom was very comfortable.
I will definitely stay again if we need accommodation in South London.

Jenny’s place was totally perfect, I booked the flat for a work colleague and they had a great stay. Jenny was very helpful and responded very quickly to messages. Would definitively book again. Thank you!
Thank you for your prompt response, hospitality and flexibility for late check out. Great hosts, friendly and helpful. Good location for rugby and all round good service

The 3 C's. Cool. Clean. Couldn't ask for a better place
This place will not disappoint

We had a great stay at Eugene’s place. The location is great, with lots of good pubs and cafes nearby, and is only a 10 minute walk to the tube. The place itself as very bright and comfortable. Communication was great throughout the entire process.
Small and compact, but with everything you need. Our little boy loved the mezzanine bedroom and location was great for a London long weekend. Thanks

Wonderful space - comfortable and quiet, yet very convenient to restaurants, pubs, shopping and transportation in the Notting Hill area.  The apartment is spacious and well appointed. Simon was a pleasure to work with and answered all inquiries promptly.

Excellent location with a perfect amount of shops and utilities on the doorstep. The spaces are clean and well looked after and it is very obvious Fabio invests a lot of care into keeping the rooms and building well maintained. The kitchen is quite well stocked though we did struggle with a few things missing, like an oven glove and some teatowels, but overall most things have been thought of. Fabio was very responsive and communicative and we very much enjoyed our stay.
Visitors can expect a warm welcome from Chris and be shown around the apartment and with explanantions on how everything works. Also they will enjoy a spotlessly clean

We were three people, a couple and a single person staying in David's Duplex. The apartment is located just 5 minutes from the Angel tube station in a quite court yard. It is very cosy and David is a responsive and forthcoming host who did everything to make our stay comfortable.

This was a great spot! You don’t even feel like you are in a basement apartment, it was super cute and modern! Also all the restaurants around the apartment are great and if you want to get away from the craziness of down town I would highly recommend exploring this side of town. It was so sweet that she left use Prosecco, and some fruits and granola, it was an amazing extra touch! We would love to stay here again, thank you for such an amazing stay!!
Well located as it is near Euston for those who are thinking of using the apartment for work purposes and if you're not staying for work then there's always Camden!

Robin was an amazing host! He gave us a list of recommendations and quick with his responses. Location was perfect for all the places we went, and it’s located in a quiet and beautiful neighborhood. The bathroom is spacious (compared to others we have seen), and the rooms are a nice size too. We will definitely return to his flat on our next visit and highly recommend staying here! Oh and his artwork throughout his home are fantastic!

Anne’s place is in a great location right next to the park. A perfect spot to get away from tourist areas, but still easily accessible. We got our own key, which allowed us to get more done during our short stay. The home is beautiful and very clean. We booked last second and Anne was very accommodating and quick to respond. I would highly recommend if you’re looking for a more laid back area to stay in while visiting.

Very cosy studio. Good location and very clean on arrival. Good communication at all times meant we had a great stay. Only problem is that during extremely warm weather the studio can become very hot without much cooling. Apart from this it was amazing. Would recommend to people who need somewhere affordable to stay.
Jamal’s place suited our needs and he ensured our check-in was smooth. For one night in London, en route to the continent, it was fine and well-located.
The best thing about Jenny’s flat is Jenny as a host. She was so thoughtful and very accommodating.  The location was very convenient for me and the flat was clean and orderly.
David is a great host, directions and check in and out were really straightforward. The place is clean, quiet and really convenient for the local amenities and night life. Thank you David.

Good for a night in London if you don’t mind sharing the flat with a few other strangers.
Kitchen and bathrooms kept very tidy and the room was secure with a lock on the door.
Easy check in and close to the metro station with a few good bars near the train tracks.
Not exactly an ideal holiday flat but for a night or two while you explore the city it’s an affordable option :-)

Simon’s apartment is very comfortable with a large lounge area, and a well stocked kitchen. I really liked the spacious conservatory bathroom with a great shower and bath. Washing and drying facilities are also available. Great location a beautiful street close to the station and restaurants and even though it’s a basement apartment it’s very light and airy and has a small courtyard. I would happily stay there again.

We had a lovely week exploring London with this apartment as home base! It’s quite small, but very manageable for two guests. We particularly loved the balcony, kitchen amenities and location! Max and Billie also provided excellent communication throughout! Definitely recommend :).

I echo everyone else's opinions in terms of how phenomenal Isabelle is. She's just the most delightful person I've met for one, and is the best host I've come across. I intend on returning in the near future just because of how amazing she is.

Stunning studio apartment, beautiful neighbourhood and really wonderful hosts!  The space looks out on the most beautiful garden and backyard.  Green space in London accommodations is sometimes hard to find - this place has it all.  We will definitely be back!

Very clean and very well managed. The location is wonderful to look around bankside- all walking distance from Tate Modern, Borough market and London bridge. The hospitality of the host is memorable. I enjoyed the stay.
A great place to stay in London. The location was convenient (easy to move around with public transport and Robin’s oyster cards) and the apartment was as described. Would recommend.
Good location however lacks character. Appears to be still under renovation. Basic bedding, lacks dishwasher & clothes dryer. Suitable for large group if you need a basic place to stay.
This place was nice break from the london bustle. Not for everyone, only those seeking a local experience . Good value for the price.

Orla’s place was great. The house itself is very spacious and we had plenty of space. The rooms were spacious and the living room and kitchen was great for us as a family with a one year old. Very close to the tube station and perfect if you want to explore London. Will recommend to anyone.
Great little find for proximity to Wembley. We had all the amenities we needed and was great value for money. The free on street parking was a great bonus. We’d stay again!
The hosts showed excellent hospitality and were very accommodating. The room was very comfortably furnished. The entire experience was convenient and enjoyable.

Sophie's place was great. I kept messaging her asking her questions about stored and restaurants, and she took the time to quickly respond each time. The flat is spotlessly clean. And very up to date.
Absolutely marvellously located apartment! Super clean, Kris was incredibly nice and friendly. Could not recommend more!

Fantastic location. Chris is an exceptional host. Very kind and always enquiring after our needs. His home is amazing. So clean, tidy and comfortable. We had access to our own private accommodation and we were delighted with so many additional  extras - fruit, cereal, tea, coffee, toiletries, washing capsules....  A 5 minute walk from the station. Train to central London, about 15 minutes. I highly recommended this accommodation. Fabulous location.
The flat is truly stunning. Plus it's perfectly situated for anyone visiting Wembley or the surrounding area.

The Garden Flat is a perfect Airbnb for your London holiday. The decor has an English Cottage flair, making it feel very comfortable and cozy. For a basement apartment there is a great deal of light, again making the flat cozy.
Carey is a gracious host. The communication was easy and clear. The flat was stocked with all the toiletries, basic groceries, and local tips provided.
The bed is very comfy and we were surprised by the water pressure and heat for an older townhouse. The Garden is very cute however the London rain kept us from enjoying it. Next time :).
The flat is conveniently located on the Victoria line and easy to get into the city center. It was nice to be in a residential area and feel what it would be like to be a Londoner.
We will be visiting the Garden Flat again!
Anne was a great host, breakfast was provided and the two bedrooms were a great size whole house really clean and very welcoming.

The accommodation is located in a very convenient location between 2 tube stations right in Camden. The flat itself is a bit old but it was clean and had everything we needed for our short stay in London.
The apartment is very well equipped and very comfortable. Clean and close to the center and shops. Good choice! Recommended.

This flat is comfortable, clean, stylish, and quiet and included everything we needed for our stay.  It was a perfect home base as we explored Kew Royal Botanic Gardens and the National Archives. The flat is located in a quiet residential neighborhood and is also only a few minutes’ walk from the Kew Gardens underground stop (on the District Line) making the trip to central London quite convenient (30- 40 minutes) when the train is not out of service. Rosie includes suggestions of good nearby restaurants and local attractions and was extremely quick about responding to our questions.  Highly recommended.

Tt's place is really great! Close to the tube, easy access to the airport.
Ms. Tong is wonderful, and very kind.
Room was spacious and kitchen was clean and easy to use, not a bad place to stay and value for money.

Anne was a great host if not the best ever in my case. She provided everything that me and my family needed. Everything was how it was supposed to be. I strongly recommend her offer if you're planning to visit London.

Big space which we needed for a family of 5 (3 young kids). Great location and lovely park view from the open plan living space downstairs. Everything went smoothly with host from entry to exit. Property came with residents parking just over the road but be careful as one area is for business use only! (host  provides parking permit). Would stay again and would recommend as a relaxed and informal environment with a host who appreciates family life.

My second stay in the flat, loved It just as much as the first. Wink is a wonderful host, was extremely accommodating of our dog and young baby. The flat has everything you would need for a stay and the location so close to Stockwell tube makes it so easy as a base to explore the city. Very highly recommended

Sophie is an attentive host and her flat is clean and well-equipped.  It was great to have two bathrooms and a shower stall as well as washing machine, appliances, and a fan.  We had a couple of problems, which Sophie quickly responded to via messages; however, we were not able to solve them without the help of someone in person .  The flat is as described and near a park, stores and restaurants, and the tube.

I am already missing Juste's place. Everything from pre- arrival to arrival were fabulous. Juste is really friendly and prompt in her replies. Her place is easily accessible by two tube stations and walking distance to borough market. Her place is really clean as well and I love how comfortable the furnishings are. It really feels like home away from home. I would definitely love to be back with Juste at my next trip to London.
Great cozy place to stay, really clean and great amenities, easy check in, would stay again.
Another lovely stay with the very friendly and helpful Inge.  Lots of interesting fellow guests to talk to and a comfortable place to stay.

Chris’ apartment is really well located close to a large supermarket (Sainsbury’s), and about a 10 minute walk to Wimbledon rail and tube station. The space is as described with all mod cons. I couldn’t get the temperature controls to lower the temperature (there is a large fan in the under-stairs storage), so having the info available to guests would be my suggestion.
The apartment is part of the main house, so while there is a separate side entrance, you do walk past the coats and shoes in the hallway past the main kitchen/laundry before heading down stairs to the apartment. This may not be separated enough for some guests. Chris is really helpful, and available via text or phone my whole stay.

Great Notting Hill apartment! The space is small but it was fine for my husband and I. The location is great and is really close to the tube as well as a good coffee spot. I would highly recommend staying here on your next trip to London!
Great location, easy to get into London on train. Close to Pickford Lane shops. Great sized bedrooms. Extremely helpful hosts

Lovely flat! Stylish, clean and comfortable in a great central location!  There were two of us and there was plenty of room. Our hostess Sophie is lovely as well. She offered many travel tips and genuinely cared about our experience. Highly recommend!

Perfect base to explore London. The flat is very nice, transport is very convenient and the host is very attentive. There are nice restaurants and bars too. We were very happy with our stay here and would book again !
The place is just as advertised. Perfectly fine! Miriam is a great host. And she makes nice banana cake ;) :)
Clean and comfy.  Host was great!  Very responsive and provided great information.  Great access to buses in exchange for a lot of vehicle traffic noise.

This accommodation is truly recommendable.  If you are going to the tennis at Wimbledon the location is perfect, or if you wish to travel further afield the underground station at Southfields is only 10/15 mins walk away.  A truly great place to stay!
Fantastic location for the tennis and good selection of local restaurants and food shops. Nice place, newly opened for AirBnB.

Kamals flat was very clean and close to Pancras and Kings Cross stations, just a five minute walk. The flat was very dated but you could see that Kamal did his best with what he had. Was disappointed that there was no air conditioning and the washing machine was broken. Other than that it was lovely.
Great location for easy access to sight seeing. Loved the flat. Ana was always available for anything needed. Perfect! We will be back.

This is a very spacious and comfortable house, spotlessly clean with a lovely garden and with everything in the house that you could need. The location is great for visiting the local attractions such as RIchmond and Kew. Definitely somewhere we would like to return to in the future.

Sophie’s flat was very spacious (especially, as I understand, for London standards) and very clean and neat! Lots of great kitchen supplies for anyone wanting to cook. We slept well in the comfortable bed and quiet neighborhood. Also appreciated the ease of check-in, check-out and the tips for pubs, restaurants, etc! Thank you Sophie!

I very much enjoyed my stay in this place. It is stylish, comfortable, clean: a lovely place to stay. The appartment is located just off a main road so you might hear some of it when the windows are open. The location of the place is good: it is very easy to reach all of London's great sights, as subway and busses are near to you. Would definitely stay again!

Miriam is very kind and supportive person:) Her place is super clean and very close to Paddington station. There are lots of shops such as Starbucks, Costa and Sainsbury’s. If you go to the station, you can see more shops. If I come to Paddington again, I’d like to stay her accommodation. Thank you, Miriam;)
Lovely house, great place to spend a weekend with some friends. Walking distance to Twickenham station too, and nice parks around the area.
The place served its purpose for our stay. Easy location to get to train, store, and eating places. Very spacious where we all had our own bed and room.  Easy check in. Thank you.
This London flat was wonderful!  Very comfortable!  Especially loved the doors that opened onto the courtyard!
I recommend this place for anyone,, very clean and super spacious, the garden is extra ordinary. Thanks Vikash

Tamara's place was very clean and modern. The kitchen is separate from the living room so it is easy to stay quiet when others in your company want to have a bit of a lay in. It is in a great location of London. A 10 minute walk from the tube makes it a breeze to get around London and the UK.

Miriam's lovely flat is conveniently located near Paddington railway station. Mine was a last-minute reservation for one night, Miriam replied quickly and was kind enough to let me drop off my luggage in the morning. Pay attention when you get out of the station from the underground, as Paddington's quite big. As a solo traveller I felt safe and comfortable at all times and appreciated the quiet hours and comfortable bed :)

Monica's flat is lovely, as is Monica herself! She communicated promptly and gave several helpful suggestions for nearby restaurants. The flat is in a wonderful location and is quite bright, especially for a garden apartment. Comfortable and very clean -- would love to return!

The room is spotless and very comfortable and Anshu is a careful host. I wasn't given a key, which was unusual and not ideal for me to, though Anshu was always there or nearby to let me in. The area is great and parking in the road was no problem.
Great flat. Very convenient for London and good to have a parking space. Carolyn was very helpful and answered queries rapidly. Thank you.
A lovely, modern apartment in a great location with good outside space.  Good quality supportive beds.
Humayun offered great hospitality, he was very welcoming and assisted wherever he could, the place was clean and tidy and he was very friendly. Thanks Humayun.
Miriam was great, there were other guests there too and we got along amazingly! Had a great chat over tea in the kitchen! Felt safe, nice clean place! Miriam was lovely!

Lovely place! We stayed during 4 days and we had a great time.
The place is small, but it's near everything you need like supermarket, restaurants, etc. I highly recommended to everyone.
Check in/out is really easy.

Ana's place is really well located around 3 tube stations which was very practical to move around. Ana was very attentive to our needs.
All in all lovely trip :)
Wonderful location, very secure and amazing nights sleep! James is very helpful and always responds promptly. Highly recommended!

Jennie’s home is a very comfortable and convenient place to stay in London. Large spaces so you have room to spread out. It was very quiet at night and early mornings. Jennie responded very quickly and was there to greet us. Welcome chocolates and basic food supplies.
I would definitely recommend staying at Jennie’s apartment.
Great location for Hyde Park playground and easy tube links. This was a perfect apartment for my family’s 2 night trip to London. We would definitely use it again.

Carey aka “Wink” was amazing! She was very helpful in guiding us wherever we needed to go. She kept the place extremely clean. The place is in a great area with quick and easy access to public transportation that literally gets you wherever you need to go. Highly recommend this place! We will be back for sure!
