The shops and tube are only ten minutes walk away an the park where the house is situated is a lovely place to walk. Gated entry at the property means it feels very secure. The hosts were very helpful and responsive to queries. I had to change my dates and they were very accommodating. I would say this Airbnb is a good deal - the space is not huge but offers much more than renting a room in someone’s house.
Nice house on a calm residential street chose to bus 450 and about 1 km from the commuter train and Tesco. Very helpful and caring host and good cleanliness. A great option for a holiday in the city!
Lovely,tiny but everything you need you will find it, T.V very small like screen size for laptops ,
Federica was a great host; place was perfect, clean and spacious! Definitely recommend staying here!

The best air bnb experience ever. Wink went over and above to make me and my dog, Lulu, comfortable and she even dog sat for me when my plans changed suddenly. Honestly felt like a home away from home and if I’m ever in London in the future I’ll for sure be booking again !

Geoff is not at home for check in, but he give accurate directions and arrange his son in law to greet me which is so considerate. Geoff is happy to talk to if he has time and at the same time respect private space.

A lovely flat as shown in the pictures. Very comfortable. Location is amazing as very convenient for central London. Use of parking was a great bonus. Great communication with host, and check in worked fine. Thanks for having us.

This flat is very conveniently located in a vibrant multicultural area.  Very easy to walk to Victoria Park and other local amenities. I have been a couple of times now and Tracy is always very welcoming and helpful. I have really enjoyed staying here.

My wife and I had an excellent stay at Denise's annex. Her and Jonathan were extremely kind and helpful and I hope to see them again. The place is very comfortable, quiet and well equipped. It is in a great location with good parking (if needed) and transport links. I definitely recommend.

Lovely little studio in a great spot in Notting hill! Despite being in a heatwave the studio stayed nice and cool (the powerful fan was very helpful) and it was really nice to sit out on the balcony. The key system worked really well and it was a great location to use a as base to explore all over London. Will definitely use this place again!

We just so happened to be staying here on a couple of the hottest days of the year. Ali bought us the biggest fan you can think of for our room to help us stay cool as that room on the very top floor does become quite warm during good weather.
Whole place was very clean, we were also very impressed with the kitchen. Location is great, within walking distance to many things like cafes, shops and great transport links to Central London.
Bathroom would benefit from an update.

Such a lovely, well equipped apartment in a great location. Staying during the heatwave made us especially grateful for the fan, outdoor space and multiple patio doors! Being a short walk away from some great bars and restaurants was ideal too - no need for public transport but plenty options if needed. Everything you hope to be provided in an Airbnb was there, and so much more too. Thank you Van for a great stay, we’ll definitely be back.

Nice flat, spacious and in a good location. Great to have secure underground parking and extra bonus of great tech with Sky as well as firestick,. Didn’t feel Airbnb ready as lots of host possessions around so had to fit in round her stuff. Also attention to some details for booster cleaning needed especially in Covid times - oven, crockery, utensils, cushion covers. Otherwise all surfaces and floors were clean. Some wear and tear so flat needs some work to justify price paid.  otherwise had a comfortable stay and host was very nice, responsive and helpful.

Very stylish and exceptionally comfortable apartment in a fantastic location. Very clean, well equipped with lots of extra touches
Communication was spot on, James is a great host
The bedroom was quiet, dark at night and very comfy
Highly recommended...

Loved our stay! Notting Hill is beautiful with plenty to do and see. Tom’s flat was a perfect location to walk around and was clean and decorated very nicely. Checking in and out was a breeze. Would recommend this space to anyone traveling in this area 100%!

Great location, very clean, straight forward check in and very quiet.
Will definitely be back.

This is a brilliant flat in an excellent location. The photos do not do it justice. Highly recommend. We all loved it.
Tea and coffee provided so grab some milk on your way in.

I loved staying at this charming, sunny flat, which is just steps away from Marylebone Station, and a short walk to Marylebone High Street (one of London's nicest spots for shopping and dining) and the West End. The flat itself has everything you could possibly need, including a fully equipped kitchen, and the quiet bedroom has a comfortable bed with crisp white linens. An ideal little pied-a-terre and unusually good value!

Bert was a great host- very communicative. Her place is very nice, in a safe and quiet corner of broadway market. It is very interestingly decorated, with a lovely collection of books too. All in all a very nice stay.

Amazing apartment, fantastic location and great host. Chris was on hand for local information. We felt so welcome and at home - the apartment was spotless and finished to a high quality. Has everything you need.
Quiet area, near wonderful cafe and great location to station and high street.
Would love to stay again. 5 star host and property. Thank you so much Chris!
Great place in the heart of Angel, 8min walk from the tube station, but still very quiet. the toilet had some initial issues but David was super responsive and fixed them right away.
Great flat in a great location, handy to get to wherever you want in London by tube, bus or on foot.

The flat is very close to Mornington Crescent tube, making it easy to get around. The immediate area is not the prettiest part of London but it is just a 10 minute walk to King’s Cross (the newly regenerated Coal Drops Yard and Granary Square are worth a visit) and Regent’s Park. The flat itself is spacious and surprisingly quiet. The beds were very comfortable.

House was perfect for a quick weekend in London visiting family. It was clean and tidy, and in a good location. Gabriel was accomodating when we had to leave early on our check-out day and was prompt with most communication.
Thank you so much- we had a wonderful time and the communication and instructions were excellent! Brilliant location and the apartment is beautifully appointed. Very happy!
Great stay at this lovely home in Peckham! Perfect location, clean and tidy! Everything we needed for a girls weekend. Thanks so much Lydia!

Gorgeous flat that looks so much nicer than the photos. Came for my anniversary with my boyfriend and she left us some chocolates, candle and even a card!
Carla was welcoming and informative.
Definitely recommend!

Nice flat , small but well appointed in a lovely quiet road in Kew . We had a great few days . Thank you for sharing your property Rosie .
Just a note to other visitors :
I did the typical man thing of not reading instructions … so missed out on parking permits from Rosie ! My fault completely , we put it in a car park for the weekend and walked , which in itself was better for enjoying the surrounding area .
Nice place and Good locate which next to underground Station. Nice host and very friendly. Quite noise and maybe trade off by convenience. Highly recommend for others.
There was no hot water for the bath or shower, the beds were not very comfortable. We also couldn’t dry our towels easily because the towel rail was disconnected and on the balcony
Great apartment  amazing location. Very clean. John was very helpful and showed us around the flat and carried our bags up all the stairs, so kind. We had a great visit.

The flat is incredibly spacious with a living area on the first floor is open to the dining area that  allows for at least 6 people to be seated around the table.  The view outside of the park where many people come to walk their dogs is beautiful and fun.  The bathrooms were spacious and nice-one en-suite and the other with an entrance from the hall that was for the people in the other bedrooms.  So fun to walk around the residential neighborhood and explore the Hampstead Heath.  Daniela is very responsive and seeks to make her guest comfortable in anyway she can.
We would highly recommend and will stay again once back in London. Thank you to Gary and Bianca.

Tracy hosts an original, stylish Airbnb in a very good location. The apartment was spotlessly clean and comfortable, but with a relaxed feel. My one tip - admittedly from the point of view of a country girl unused to London noise -  would be to wear some ear-plugs at night. Once I obtained them I slept really well as the bed is super comfy with soft linens. My friend told me the back room was very quiet. There is a particularly nice, well-appointed bathroom too. We really enjoyed our weekend here, would definitely return and highly recommend it.

Michael called us in advance to check if it was ok for us to stay in the min house rather than the garden flat. The house was beautiful and a lovely place to stay. The area is charming with lots of lovely restaurants and cafes etc.  Didn’t see the garden flat, but was super easy to deal with Michael and he was a great host.
David’s house accomodation is perfect. Calm and nice place. At the same time 2 min. Walking distance for city center. Comminucation also very good. He immediately answered everything.
The flat was perfect for my friend and me. We used it as a base for a night out and two day festivals over a  long weekend. Very clean and tidy. Would definitely stay again.

lovely people clean close to buses and tube .
close to city center and free parking at property. highly recommend

Good sizeable place and excellent amenities.
Location is great and the place feels private even though in central London.
Anne's place is very nice,clean and tidy,Anne is very nice and kind lady,I really enjoy my time stay in her house, will definitely recommend it.
The accommodation is clean and placed in a quiet street. Ali is very welcoming. The bathroom could be renovated.

Great location, walkable to Portobello Road and  next to Notting Hill Tube - the Central line is handy for everything in London. The flat had everything we needed - it was an ideal base. Cute balcony too!

This apartment is in a great location just 5 mins walk to Goldhawk tube station. And the number 94 bus that goes to Piccadilly circus is just 30 yards down the road. There is a Sainsbury’s just down the road and a majestic wine opposite!! As well as plenty of places to eat and drink.
The car parking space was brilliant as I have limited mobility at the moment.
The apartment is clean and spacious with really high ceilings and doors. It is light and airy. Considering it’s on a main road it was very quiet. It had a good amount of crockery and glasses etc, unlike some places.
Check in was really easy and communication with the host really good and extremely prompt.
We would definitely stay here again if we needed to be that side of london. Recommend.
Nice place to stay the night, and Anne was a great host, especially considering how last-minute I booked!

Jennie's place was a home from home. It was in a great location and came with a parking space and was a 2 minute walk from the underground. It slept 2 adults and 2 children just great. The facilities were good. Check-in was difficult as the key had to be collected from a local supermarket and the name had been changed which frustrated us somewhat. After that we found the parking space with direction from Jennie although no bike shop was found so was  more luck than judgment.  We had a fantastic stay and I would stay again now I know the drill so to speak.

Lovely apartment in the heart of Shoreditch and East London! Perfect for a weekend away and the open plan downstairs makes it a perfect hosting venue, all I would say is be v mindful as there are strict guest and noise limits so only book if you are planning a quiet weekend - as we had. The upstairs of the apartment had a bad smell and some carpets weren’t entirely clean when we arrived but otherwise we had a fun stay, and there are many useful facilities and features such as bikes, games, books, maps etc. Communication was great and Julian was generally prompt with replies - but as mentioned be prepared to be warned in advance about noise/partying etc as I imagine a lot of previous guests may have unfortunately abused these rules! Thanks for the great stay.

THE DREAMIEST APARTMENT!! I wanted to live there tbh. I highly recommended a stay. The location is so central. The place is even more beautiful in real life, and the bed is the squishiest comfiest I have ever slept in! The host James was so easy to contact if I had any questions or problems (which I didn’t!). I had the best time here :)

Brilliant stay at this flat! It was clean, spacious and very comfortable. Great location but I’d say a small downside was the noise from the main road. But other than that, could not have asked for more in Central London! Would highly recommend and would stay again.

I stayed at this apartment with my husband and children (6 yrs, 4 yrs and 6 months). Lisa gave us clear instructions about check in etc. There is a lift in the building which is convenient if you are using a push chair. We also had a travel cot for the little one which was great. The apartment was clean and spacious and was located right next to the high street with all the main shops and food places etc.
Would definitely stay here again and would also recommend to others!
Lisa was a great host who always replied to any queries that we had!
Thank you
Great little 3 bedroom property with everything you need and in such a convenient location, close to the tube station. Carolyn, the host was faultless in her communication.

My experience at Geoff house has been amazing! He was super helpful whenever I needed help and the room is exactly as in the picture, small but clean an cozy. The location is perfect, you can go everywhere from there!
Totally recommend!
A great visit, easy check in, very clean and all equipment you need, good privacy and affordable price and payment plan
Very nice studio in great location. Details about flat on Airbnb are super accurate. Branca was a great host and responded very quickly. Would definitely book again.

Great apartment in a well located area of North London. The flat was clean and well-equipped and Robin was very responsive with communication related to our last-minute booking. A great base to explore the city.

Isabelle could not have been more helpful and welcoming in her home. She made sure I had everything I needed and more. Her breakfasts were an added bonus not to mention the use of her sitting room in an immaculately clean house.
Good location, good price, and very spacious. However, not the most clean and some features was broken.

Lovely apartment with great transport links to the Northern line and Victoria line.
Carey was great to deal with and had clear Communication when booking and was extremely welcoming.
Would recommend to anyone looking to stay in the area.
pleasant host. always willing to help and offer assistance. and  a very quick response  time.

Geoff was an amazing host! I highly recommend this spot for anyone visiting London. It was fairly close to all the public transit and the value for your stay can’t be beat. Geoff made check in simple and gave me some tips about the city. You’ll be happy you chose his home for your trip.

House of Kip provides a super stylish, modern and comfy place to stay in a fab location at fantastic value within central London. Three of us really enjoyed our long weekend stay here and would recommend to anyone looking for a cool place to stay in London.
Great location and value. An ideal base for a trip to London. Despite being a studio, it was well equipped with facilities and Zhaz is a very considerate host.

Lovely flat in a great location. Amos was a great host who made staying there very easy. I loved all of the houseplants and the flat was a great base for staying in London. Thank you - I’d definitely stay again!

It's hard to write a fair review - as when I stayed the co-working space was being refurbished. So this is a business where they've turned a number of these room above into small studios (bedroom with a basic kitchen and separate shower/toilet). And all I can say is that mine was clean and ok. The area is good with  good transport links. Down to Liverpool Street or across to islington. Check out the dusty knuckle bakery and allpress coffee.

Toms place was even more gorgeous in person. Great area. Travelled alone for the first time over seas and felt so comfortable and safe in Toms place. Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in London. Will definitely be back.
it's a very clean neat and tidy place no hassles what so ever in train distance loads of takeaways I would recommend it to anyone anytime

A compact 1 bed flat located in a great location in the heart of Mayfair. Spacious living room, bedroom and ample for 2 persons. Modern kitchen and bathroom. Ideally located close to the numerous restaurants in Shepherd Market that can be walked to. We enjoyed staying here. Fantastic and friendly check in team at reception.
The landlord is a very kind person who helps to carry luggage and deposit it for free. It's really a good choice for a trip in London.
Excellent value for money in a fantastic location. This is a good listing if you're looking for base while you're exploring the city.

Isabelle is a charming hostess, and made us very welcome in her home, with the rooms for us being a dedicated and private space. We were completely happy with everything on offer, and hope we will get the chance to go back. Mr Darcy the cat is a friendly character, and has excellent manners.
Convenient for London's excellent public transportation, good street parking if you follow the rules, easy walking to all the shops and restaurants we needed, and - thankfully - not a long drive from the M4.
Highly recommended.
Great apartment! Very clean with lots of space. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend. The location was great as well!

The apartment located in a very safe and quiet place. It has a very lovely garden and all the decoration are so warm and clean. The kitchen almost have every thing. Monica knows very well about this apartment and explain many details before I checked in. I can feel that she really like this place and wish it to be fine for all the guests. I had a pretty stay here. Highly recommended!
Everything was accurate to the description and the communication was good : a very pleasant stay in a clean house

Lovely apt, Prime location, Pleasent decor, Great host
Unfortunatly we had a little guest who made our stay a bit less comfortable (a mouse), and there was no way to close the front windows with street view.
Other than that, an awsome experience!

We had a pleasant stay at Richard's. The room is very comfortable and the view is wonderful. The kitchen is very well equipped and the bathroom is spacious. I really recommend it, Richard is a very attentive and accommodating host.

We had a lovely stay here! The house is an oasis in London, with a great backyard and plenty of space. There's everything you need to cook up a storm and the house has high quality appliances and loved the furnishings. Communication was fantastic and check in/out was flexible and easy.
The location is great, 3 mins walk from the tube, with over ground and the Victoria line. Lots of convenient shops near by too.
The beds were so comfy too.
Thanks for a great stay!

Bipin is a lovely, friendly host, with great communication throughout. He gave lots of info regarding local travel options and things to do in the area. The property was very modern, clean, tidy and worth the money paid. The shower is amazing which, after a very long hot day, felt incredible! If we needed to return to the area, I'd book with Bipin again 😊.
Great place to stay. Location is ideal right near the train station. The place was really nice, very stylish and a good size for a studio. Would highly recommend for city breaks.
a cozy apartment, really well suited for couples. It's very close to central london and there are plenty of food and drinks places nearby for an evening out.
Beautiful flat with superb modern kitchen area. Victoria was just below if any problems. Not a complaint but lots of stairs to access the flat but once inside - lovely.

Cute flat with sunny balcony and comfortable bed.
There is a lot of nice places for dinner around, very good coffee place by the corner, natural wine bars and park.
I had a great stay in Rachael place!
Thank you Rachael! :)
lovely and helpful people and with all the comfort. nice area close to the tube and all the shops. I would definitely recommend it.
Absolutely amazing flat, very well equipped. Excellent location for travelling both by car and tube. Carolyn made the process so easy and was very informative. Would definitely stay again!

Perfect location, ideal space for us and surrounded by great pubs and restaurants.
Will definitely return

This is a great 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment in a prime location!  Very secure - code to the outside door, key for the elevator, and double locks on the apartment door!  Very easy to get to get cabs, Ubers, and the Tube.  Highly recommend and we'll definitely stay here again!
I would definitely stay here again, couldn't fault it for the money and the host was friendly and helpful. Recommended!

Our stay at this b and b began with having no heat on a cold rainy day.  There was no one to approach until we finally found Mariuz who came the next day and fixed the heat. He also TRIED fo fix the teleision which was an old model not fit to watch.  He arranged to have a new |TV installed. Then there was the dryer which stopped when it became very hot. There was no book, no instructions to tell us that water had to be emptied. Our dryers in Israel do not work that way. After that, a dishwasher went on and on for three hours. I suggest, as a "superhost" you have someone check to see that all is working. That there is a home owners manual which covers all the appliances and how to work them. This B and B was one of the most careless, and expensive, that we ever experienced. Our thanks go to Mariuz., The only good thing about it.

The location was perfect and the place exactly as advertised. The team responds quickly and I had everything I needed. I didn't end up needing early check-in but it is available for a fee which is convenient. The location being in the center of everything meant it was loud with outside noise both in the mornings/late nights. I'm accustomed to this in NYC, but it may bother someone else more if you're not used to it. I would stay again!

Jelena is an awesome host , very cooperative and helping.
I will recommend this place to everyone.

It is a wonderful place and I will stay here again if I have the chance.
Nina is a very friendly and active landlord, our communication was very smooth, and she was quickly helped to solve the small problems when I checked in.
The facilities in the room are perfect and full of artistic colors. Dishwashers and washing machines work well.
Gemma's cleaning is also perfect！
I'm gonna miss this place.

Absolutely beautiful loft apartment, I’m such a vibrant area of London.  We stayed for 2 nights to celebrate my mums birthday. Everything was exactly as described, the apartment is clean and quirky. Loved everything about it.  Would highly recommend a stay.
Amazing choice for either short/ long term stay. The room is really clean and Vlad is very nice and really informative
I would highly recommend this place. Very close to Bromley High street, clean and really well managed.
Fantastic Airbnb with a friendly and helpful host. The apartment is very close to Camden. We had a great time there and would stay there again.

We spent a month at Alexey's property at the heart of Covent Garden. Beautiful modern little apartment fully equipped for a long stay. The location is amazing and the price is very reasonable.
Alex is a fantastic host. Any questions or requests that we had were promptly addressed. Communicating with Alex was a breeze and he went above and beyond to ensure that we fully enjoyed our stay in London.
Just one note for people with pet allergies (like me) - the apartment is pet friendly. It is properly clean, but it's still pet friendly. :)
To summarize: great host, great property, great location. I would wholeheartedly recommend staying at Alexey's flat.
Thank you, Alex!!!
Very cozy and enjoyable apartment. Well equipped and well situated. The communication with the host was very easy and there were no inconviniences.

A fine collection of designer furniture from the 60s / 70s creates a theatrical and at the same time very authentic atmosphere. And climbing vertical stairs to the bed challenges not only your physical abilities, but also your sense of humor. In a word: INTERESTING.  Try!

All the receptionist didn’t help much, passing on the responsibilities from one to another. Not worth asking anything as they kept forgetting things or saying that they will pass on the message to the morning receptions and they didn’t. Experienced a huge disappointment with the booking bureaucracy and unfriendly rules which are designed to put the client into a disadvantage position.

Great place and great host! Made us feel very welcome, and was very attentive to everything we needed. We could not be more appreciative of our time with Isabelle and Mr Darcy, and showed us how to navigate the city. Hopefully see them again! Thank you again!

Beautiful place. Attentive and 24 hour staff. Very quiet and central location near Exmouth Market which is the perfect little collection of shops, restaurants, and cafes. I’d recommend this place to anyone.

A true, proper homestay. We booked for a longer term and we had a wonderful experience. Daniela's home is spacious, with living and dining areas, a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable beds and renovated bathrooms. There is a small but curated library of very interesting books. The location is very convenient to public transportation, restaurants, playgrounds and the amazing Hampstead Heath.
Daniela is very kind, communicative and truly cared that we were comfortable and had a good stay. She responded to any and all questions quickly. We have been very happy in her home and very highly recommend her place. Thank you, Daniela.

Overall it was a good stay!
The place did look a little different than how it did in pictures on the listing but that didn’t really have any affect on our stay, however a properly fitting sheet would be an improvement as it kept popping off during the night meaning we kept accidentally sleeping on the bare mattress. There was also a fair amount of fruit flies in the living area/kitchen which meant that we couldn’t leave food unattended for long. Apart from that the flat was great, it was located close to a tube and overground station which was handy and it was really clean and tidy. The amenities were plentiful and the place was very quiet, also communications with the host was excellent - the instructions provided meant finding the keys and using things inside the flat was easy.

I had a lovely stay. The location is great and the neighbourhood is safe as well.  The room is clean and the kitchen is well equipped. Inge is an amazing host. There are extra charges for laundry (£5 per wash) but there’s a laundrette nearby. The house can get a bit cold sometimes since the heating is not turned on that often but besides that everything is perfect.

I booked this for my father. He said it was very nice, quiet, well-located, lovely and helpful staff, and perfect for one person. His only complaint was the WiFi — they had WiFi but most of the time it wasn’t the best signal which was a real hindrance that meant that he had to use data. It was also a little pricey. All in all a good place though!
Overall a good and cheap (related to other rooms nearby) room near to many sightseeing places. For me it was sufficient for my trip to london :).
Federica’s place is amazing! It is so close to many coffee shops and pubs. It is also so close to the underground which is transportation necessity in London. Highly recommend!

Would definitely return to this quaint little flat in Kew.  It is a fantastic location with everything within walking distance.  Rosie was an excellent host, very quick to respond and the space is just as cute as it looks in pictures.  Highly recommend!
Fantastic location. Apt very clean. Only snag, as it’s a basement apt, no window to speak of. Gina was very prompt and helpful and the flowers and Prosecco on arrival was a very nice touch.
Great host, always there to help or to have a little chat. I've felt like a member of their family. Thank you!

Very good place to stay, just the 2nd bed is not as confortable as the 1st one. So for 2 adults and children it is ok, but for 4 adults it might not be the best. In a midle of Soho, but very quiet as the appartment is on the other side of the street.
A lovely apartment in a location close to shops, a grocery store, and the tube.  Monica is a fabulous hostess with absolutely fantastic communication.  You won't be disappointed.
Everything was perfect. car parking wasnt problem. And the room was very clean are matched with pictures. I highly recommend this room!!!

Beautifully decorated, the kitchen area is gorgeous.
The house is a twenty minute walk to the nearest underground station which takes you into London.

The apartment was amazing and was equipped with everything we needed. The station was a 2 min walk and was very easily accessible. The garden terrace was a perfect touch for the flat. Would highly reccomend staying here for short or long term.
Nikki and Stew were great hosts. This is the second time my parents stayed at their apartment and everything was perfect. Thank you
Great house, clean, tidy and generally amazing. We were working at the Churchill Theatre so proximity was great and as a touring professional, was one of the best digs  in the area.

Tamara’s flat was wonderfully situated, an easy walk to portobello road and from Westfield, and convenient for the tube into town.
We had a very cosy stay - it was warm, with plenty of room. The flat was clean , smart and really well looked after.
Tamara was always quick to communicate, really helpful and flexible.
Thank you, Tamara!

A perfect stay, very comfortable, warm and great communication with my host, providing items to help my stay.
Ideal location for West Norwood, easy check in. Definitely will be a regular at this annex.

Overall the place was good, everything you need for a few days stay. It’s super noisy so just be aware of that. The walls are really thin and it’s right on the main strip in Dalston so you have noise both inside and out. Saying that, it is great location if you’re looking to stay where it all happens. I was given the wrong door code and key code so couldn’t get in, Shaz was quick to answer and seemed friendly, but that was a bit of a faff with my luggage. The guys in the co working space downstairs were also really helpful.
Airbnb was exactly what we were looking for. Great location and hosts were quick to respond if anything any questions came up.

Lynn's flat is just perfect. The location is amazing - close enough to Oxford Circus that you can get there in minutes, but set back enough that it's still peaceful at night. Check In was easy and stress free and the flat itself left us wanting for nothing.
Thank you so much for letting us stay, Lynn. We will definitely be back!
Host was very accommodating when my 18 year old daughter and her friends stayed at the apartment looking at University options.  They enjoyed their stay, apartment was central for all amenities
Had a lovely stay - communication was 10/10, amazing location (with lovely views from the balcony), the apartment was clean and spacious also very secure. Would definitely stay here again!

The flat is very nice and in a good and quiet neighbourhood. Sun shines directly in the bedroom, so it‘s definitely worth to climb up the stairs. Lovely breakfast nearby at Blackbird as well as buses and tubes just around the corner. Perfekt place for two to discover the city. Check in and out fast and friendly. Would come back any time, summer might be very nice to spend more time at the lovely balcony.
As per my previous stays, Bipin has been attentive and helpful throughout. A nice, quiet, private room with a good amount of space for one person or a couple.

My sister and I stayed at Lynn's flat and absolutely loved it.  It was perfect!  Clean and spacious, cozy and in a great neighborhood.  Lynn is an amazing host with super easy check in and out.  She is very communicative and even sent us amazing restaurant recommendations when we asked.  I wish I could give the flat 10 stars because it is truly a 10 star rental.  Thank you Lynn!  We will 100% be back!

Neat apartment. Great location in Camden. Comfy beds.
We had an amazing time. Would definitely recommend!
We had a lovely stay, the apartment was perfect for the 5 of us staying and in a great location!

Tiny maisonnette in the heart of London. Location is ideal to visit.
The rooms are under the level of the street, which is current in London, so no direct light in the rooms. The living room is right on the street, so you have to close the curtains otherwise everyone can see you. The street being very close, you hear people talking. You also feel the underground vibrations.
Tha appartment is very clean. You'll get salt and pepper, but that's about it: no basics like oil and vinegar. If you want to cook, you'll have to buy everything. Very strict late check out policy: £10/hour after 10am, even if there is no other guest afterwards.

Flat in a good location, quite even for light sleepers, (yes in London!). Good location with grocery store just around a corner, decent restaurants and pubs in walkable distance. Easy accessible flat (even with a pushchair), two elevators in a building. Clean and well equipped flat, two separate bedrooms and spacious kitchen and living room.
Sergio and Denise are very friendly, allowed us to drop our suitcase quite early - and even offered earlier check-in on our arrival. No issues during our stay.
Maria is an amazing host and we had great time staying at the loft. The location is good and market is only 11 mins away from where we are staying.

Tina is fantastic. She is very hospitable and attentive host. I enjoyed hearing her stories while eating her homemade pancakes during breakfast. The room was nice too. A bit noisy, but not too much if using earplugs. Location of the flat was really great. Would definitely recommend.
Unfortunately didn’t get to meet Geoff but communication was great, check in process seamless and bedroom private & comfortable.

Was super stay
Very clean and comfortable flat.
One fail from our side - we didn’t ask another key (we were 3 people with 1 key only)
Can recommend this property!
Thank you!
Clean and convenient house in the walking distance to Bromley. We stayed as a family of four with two grown kids without a problem.Our host was very friendly and responsive. Thanks for everything.
We had a nice stay at the apartment with stylish decor and brilliant cow print chair. Some of the appliances and cables need looked at. The wifi was down whilst we stayed but wasn’t really an issue.
I had a great stay at Bipin’s place. It was clean, modern and quiet which was exactly what I needed for my stay. Will definitely come back next time I need somewhere to stay in London!

The location of the apartment is perfect a little bit noisy but , everything within walking distance.
There was a problem with the shower. The water flow was very weak
The owner Paolo is a lovely Italian guy. He is very helpful and his place is very nice in a quiet area in Fitrovia. I highly recommend his place and I will definitely be back

Everything was perfection. Location: PERFECT. Safe, great neighborhood, so so close to public transit. Super clean, kitchen had everything. Simon is a very communicative, helpful, friendly host. Everything top to bottom was a 5 star experience.

The description here was very accurate so there were no surprises when arrived in the apartment. The location was perfect for our purposes as we were visiting family in Stratford area, but is also well connected with public transport to travel around London. Communication with Dominic was very fast before and during for any issues we had. Overall a very nice stay.
Orla was a wonderful and very helpful host! The place was great and I would 100% recommend!! Very easy to get the tube and local shops.

Great, clean space. More room than expected and very bright on sunny days! Easy walk to tube and grocery plus the brand new creative arts district by the river. We stayed for a month so got to know the area. Neighbors in the building were very nice as well. Host was really friendly and easy to communicate with.

Had a great stay here. The flat was a great size for 6 adults and each bedroom was lovely. Very clear instructions on how to get to apartment and how to access. Great location. Flat is  well maintained and clean
Great place with all the facilities you need! Very practical location, as it is nearby Twickenham railway station and grocery stores. Very helpful and polite hosts. Would definitely recommend!
Excellent location and excellent apartment with friendly flexible host who met all our needs for what was a FANTASTIC long weekend away!
Great communication and clear directions, house was spotless, cosy and had everything. Beds were very comfortable and quiet location, would stay here again.

Barbara’s place is lovely. Barbara and her husband are warm ans welcoming people and make you feel comfortable in their home. Very clean and tidy and good wifi. Only a short walk to the DLR and other transport routes. Great view of the thames from the lounge and bedroom window. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Good price for a decent flat. Rather calm given the area.
The flat itself has not a lot of furniture or equipment but it's clean and it's good value for money.
I had a very good stay in Olga’s flat. The location was convenient for my research at different public archives. You can also enjoy agreeable conversation with the host.

The apartment is very spacious. The beds are comfortable. Very quiet and yet centrally located.
From Heathrow with express to Paddington and with bus No. 27 in total 45 minutes at the destination. Key in key box.
Simon checked online to make sure everything was okey.
Good wifi, Netflix, 2 TVs, all devices work.
I recommend the apartment to others.
We had a great stay in Faiza and Al’s flat. It was really clean, very close to Bromley High St and they were extremely responsive and great at communicating.  Definitely recommend.
Hyacinth was amazing. Communication was great and the stay in the home was fantastic. We cant thank Hyacinth enough for all of the help she gave us

Great location, great communication and easy access. Max and Billie are really helpful and quick to respond. You can get a bit of noise overnight from the room above (the mezzanine is pretty close to the ceiling above) but comfortable overall and great base.
Geoff place was ok. The big problem was the heating was off during the night. He did provide an heating fan but it was extremely noisy what made our sleep really bad...
This is a very charming flat in a brilliant area of London. For the house plants alone, it is worth a stay!
Simon's place is the perfect location in Notting Hill and so comfortable and cozy! I cannot wait to go back for a second time!
Great place, exactly as advertised. The room was very clean and great value for money. Bipin was a lovely host.
Great location just not great beds as one was broken and the place doesn't look like it has been deep cleaned and refreshed in some time.
The apartment is clean and well situated, I’m just disappointed that the price changed after I already accepted it both times that I stayed there.

I highly recommend this place if you are staying closer to the area.
Iyisha is very attentive and kind. I
felt very comfortable staying in her home.
Julia's place is really nice, comfortable, super clean. My stay was great and I strongly recommend this place.

Inge's place is tastefully decorated and the en-suite bedroom we stayed in was immaculately clean and had its own key. The location is good - 6/7 mins walk from a tube station and you can easily walk into Chiswick with lots of restaurants and cafes, though the house is very close to a main road with a constant stream of traffic. There is triple glazing so it didn't bother us but light sleepers might want to bring ear plugs. There was plenty of hot water and shampoo and conditioner already there for us. We didn't spend much time in the house but the kitchen and communal spaces were very clean and well equipped.

Location is Incredible, so very special, you will feel like a millionaire every time you walk out of the building.
The flat itself is spacious and feels very private on the top floor of the building with offices on the floors below.
The elevator takes you to the third floor and once through the secure door to the flat it’s another flight of stairs up to the living/kitchen and bedroom spaces.
The flat was obviously finished to a very high standard when originally done, but is now showing it’s age with obvious signs of heavy use - it would benefit from a paint and carpet refresh, along with some improvements to kitchen supplies (pots/pans/serving items).
Having said that this is really great value given the size of the unit and its truly amazing location. I would stay again.
A very comfortable place to stay, easy access, close to the local town, great host, very accommodating and helpful, definitely will be a regular at this place
A very comfortable stay at this lovely self contained annexe, which benefits from a super en suite bathroom and off road parking.
Such a beautiful apartment, and to top it off with a sexy view definitely worth booking and experiencing some of the magnificent views london has to offer

The flat is exactly as described and the location is perfect! On arrival the flat was immaculately clean and it is very well equipped. Wifi is great for those who need it, and the built in Netflix feature on the TV is a nice plus. Simon is very easy to communicate with (probably the best host I’ve experienced to date). Highly recommended.
Fantastic location and decoration. It was lovely to arrive to a pint of milk and some seasonal chocolates. Branca’s communication was fantastic throughout. I would definitely stay here again!

This was my second time staying in Marcus’ lovely flat.  The location simply can’t be beat - right in the heart of Covent Garden and a quick walk to so much.  The flat is ideally laid out to be a home away from home, with comfortable family room with cute balcony overlooking a private courtyard, spacious dining area and well equipped kitchen for when you want to take a break from the restaurants or simply brew a pot of coffee to start the day.  I look forward to returning again soon!

I had a pleasant stay at Geoff’s place. It is centrally located, easy to walk to bus and train. Geoff was very helpful in offering directions to get around and flexible with check in/check out time when I asked. Great experience overall!

We had a great time at Faiza’s place.  Excellent communication, place was immaculately clean and location is ideal as so close to town.  My son didn’t want to leave and we will be back in the new year!

Good views from the living room and the bed room! The check-in process was a bit annoying where the keys needs to be collected from a place which about 1/2 mile away. Then to drag the luggages across side streets wasnt really fun.. Checkout was the same.
The place is very clean and perfect location with everything you ever need from bathroom stuff,, kitchen stuff .. everything is perfect
A very stylish comfortable house . Small  well designed outside space a real pleasure to look out onto. We enjoyed our stay here . Thankyou .

Tamara's flat is very well laid out and an excellent choice to stay when visiting London.
It offers two large double bedrooms + one single and a generous lounge as well. One of the two bathrooms is however a bit of a squeeze, but apart from that, everything is exactly as advertised.
The flat is situated in a residential area with little street/traffic noise and about 10mins walk to Ladbroke Grove tube, Tesco Express, Sainsbury Local etc and a 20 min walk to Westfield Shopping Centre.
The kitchen has everything you might need and the dishwasher, washing machine and dryer were great to have, together with detergent and tablets for the dishes.
Tamara was super responsive as well as incredibly helpful, and I have no hesitation in saying that she's a wonderful host and the flat is a no-brainer.
Great location, comfy bed with option to turn into twin beds. Kitchen was great for cooking meals and the bathroom was spacious. Would stay here again.
Our stay was great and everything went smoothly. Hayley is easy to talk too and replies fast to our questions.

We stayed at Tamara’s apartment during our visit to London. It was a great location for our needs. It was a clean, cozy, well-stocked accommodation. We enjoyed rambling down nearby Portobello road looking at the shops. I would stay here again.

We stayed at Nina's for 5 weeks. It was great for the long stay.
Wifi worked great for the remote working.
Nina was super easy to communicate and helpful when in need.
The place is spacious and has pretty much everything you need.
Though it's a bit far from the city center, it's pretty easy to move around, as the bus stop is super close.
There is Tesco right next to the AirBnB, which was very convenient, and I actually liked the quietness away from the city center.
Highly recommend!
A great place in an awesome location. It was close to several food spots and great nightlife, making my new year's weekend such a memorable one.

I live down stairs and was having a new floor fitted through out my flat - when searching for a place to stay for a few night Sophie’s place came up and just ideal for me and my little boy. Enjoyed the stay and the place was clean and tidy, also Sophie’s communication was quick and efficient.

Very spacious flat located in Shepards Bush area just 15 mins walk going to Westfield Shopping Center. Right beside the flat is a coffee shop where you can get your nice breakfast and 3 mins walk to a small convenience store. Overall I love my stay in Stephane's flat.
Really nice place. Clean and presentable. Friendly, accommodating host. A bit loud at night due to it being on a busy road but that’s no fault of the landlord of course.
Very clean and perfect place to stay if you are around London city . Host Gordana was very helpful & understanding person . Walking distance to Hyde park and other public transport. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Communication was so easy with Max & Billie, replied very quickly to all my queries. Location was great for everything in walking distance also a lovely balcony :)

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at The Rosebury. The apartments are just a 10 min walk from Farringdon Station and other amenities.
The apartment was clean, the staff were friendly and very helpful when we needed help with a blind that wouldn’t raise. There was a fully fitted kitchen with everything you’d need for your stay.
I would definitely recommend to others and would book again with Supercity Aparthotels.
Homely and beautifully decorated flat 2 mins from Dalston high street. Alexi was super communicative and went above and beyond to accommodate us. Would certainly stay again.
We stayed 5 weeks in this beautiful flat and enjoyed every single day there. Thanks Agat for your kindness.
Beautiful, clean and in a great location. This is the second time we’ve stayed here and it was just as great as the first time. We’ll definitely be back.
Awesome location, nice apartment just like the pictures, well decorated and well thought out. The host is highly responsive and accommodating. Lovely stay 10/10 would recommend.

Daniela is, by far the most warm, welcoming and gracious host you will find on this platform. By far! She went out of her way to make sure my family and I had every single thing we needed. The house itself has a lovely view of the park, a supermarket, everything you would need in the kitchen to sustain yourself comfortably. Location was very convenient with pharmacy etc. 2 mins down the road -
A lovely space in London, really homely and a perfect refuge after a busy day in a busy city!
A great location (for work purposes). The property was clean, well equipped and very comfortable. Off-road parking is a bonus. Would recommend Bipin's place.
We had a cosy stay at Sancha's place. The room was very nicely set up and it was very helpful having a fridge, kettle and microwave there!

The stay was very nice, Agat thought of everything. You will find all what you need and more inside the flat. I would definitely recommend this place as it has great amenities in the near and great public transport. It was a very pleasant stay.

Amazing Airbnb Experience
We've stayed for couple of weeks at this apartment, and it would be an understatement to say that we loved it.
As part of our move to UK, this was the best of our AirBnB experience out of changing 5 other AirBnBs.
This Studio is fully loaded in terms of kitchen equipment, a large TV, a huge Bed, Dishwasher, Oven and a lots of cutlery. I can't imagine if there was anything that we did not find while staying here for almost a month.
It is well located in close proximity with East Croydon / West Croydon stations allowing you to easily navigate to any part of London.
Apart from how well built and located the Studio is, Gary and Bianca have been great Hosts allowing all the help and being available 24 hours for any questions.
Thanks Team

A very good experience, lots of space and the location was easy to find.
The communication with Julian was very smooth and we felt we were in good hands.

The flat is beautiful just as pictured, in a central and convenient location. The hosts (Joanna and Stacy) are very friendly and helpful, as well as being very accomodating on my requests. Highly recommended!

The apartment location was absolutely stunning! Really close to the underground and the balcony was just such a nice addition! I enjoyed the pink decor of the apartment however some elements of it where a little tatty. Unfortunately we got woken up every morning at 7am from other guests stomping around and watching tv as the noise isolation wasn’t the best. But overall this apartment was fine for the week and we did enjoy our stay here as the area is beautiful
As a family of two adults and two children this was perfect for us. Spacious, centrally located, good amenities. Anna was very responsive and well organised.

Isabelle was a lovely and welcoming host who went the extra mile to make sure we had everything we needed. Her home is such a beautiful place filled with vintage furniture, artworks, music and books that made us feel at home instantly. Mr Darcy was also a very sweet and sociable furry housemate. Would absolutely recommend her and her house to anyone looking to stay in London.
He is really friendly and gentle. He will patiently solve the problem for you whenever there is a problem. I think everyone who comes to Kingston should feel his enthusiasm.
great location, and a lovely place to stay. Max & Billie communicates everything so well to us, and the pictures were so accurate to the stay.

Thanks to Jodie and Josh for hosting my parents while they were visiting us in Ladywell.
The accommodation was clean, bright and spacious and just what we needed.
We had a lovely welcome with some kind extra touches to help Mum and Dad feel at home.
Happy to highly recommend.
He is really friendly and gentle. He will patiently solve the problem for you whenever there is a problem. I think everyone who comes to Kingston should feel his enthusiasm.

We had a wonderful 4 weeks stay at Ant’s place. Ant was very attentive and provided detailed guidance on the steps to “check in” and what to explore around the area.
The flat is spacious (for 2 working adults who sometimes work from home), very quiet and peaceful and has a great view overseeing the nearby area. Ant’s unit is also within walking distance to all local amenities, i.e. grocery stores, cafes, pubs and transport links (bus stops and tube station).
I would highly recommend Ant’s place for anyone who’s looking for a short or long term stay near the city centre.
Comfy flat, cosy and warm. Close to all amenities and fantastic communication throughout. Can’t fault the host, he was very helpful, considerate and quick to respond. Would stay again.

Lovely place to stay, flat is really nice and is perfect if you’re going to Printworks as it’s literally a 10 min walk. Close to Central London and public transport so is ideal for whatever your plans are, would definitely stay again!☺️

I stayed here few times due to my medical placement, it has been pleasant and the location is very convenient as the hospital is 25mins away walking.
The location is quiet and shops are quite close.
Nice modern flat right in the center of London. Everything was very clean, modern and comfortable.  Communication was also excellent. I’ll be back.
Very nice stay ! Amos is super flexible on check-in / check-out and communicated very well !
Exactly as advertised, very clean, Robin was incredibly helpful whenever needed. Excellent location for central London. Highly recommend!!

Richard's place is located in a great quiet neighborhood close to the Greenwich Park but also just few mins away from the train/DLR station. The house is on a hill what gives amazing views on Canary Wharf. Richard is also a great host, very easy to communicate with.
Location is perfect, bed is so comfy, shower pressure is good and. Overall our stay in Max and Billies place couldn’t of been more of what we wanted. (Couple 22 & 24)
This is a wonderful place! Very stylish and cosy. We felt like home and would always return. Great communication with host, who did everything to make our stay a wonderful one.
Absolutely amazing flat, clean and tidy. I wish we could have stayed there longer. Brilliant location for tubes. Great communication from hosts. I will be visiting again 🥳

This was quite a find and exact to the description. Loved the location - with handy local shops and restaurants. Found a brilliant Greek restaurant just opposite and a lovely Portuguese bakery just beside it. Easy access to the tube so everything was very handy. The flat was spacious and had all required amenities. Lisa was always very helpful too. Will definitely try here first if we get back to London.

Chris was a fantastic host and took care of every detail during my stay. The space is perfect for those wanting a cosy stay plus everything you need in the one place. Location was perfect with the station, shops and wonderful cafe down the street. Highly recommend!

Super equipped and super-cozy design home; in quiet but lively area.
Subway is very close. I hope to come back again. Marina

The apartment is very close do subway station and  buses.  The walls need some painting because they do not match the advertisement images.  The neighborhood streets were dirty, different from other parts of London. We also had a hard time to find a working phone number to ask about the extra bedding that wasn't easy to locate.

It's very clean and nice (just like in pictures). Everyone is friendly and helpful. Location is also good. I really can't think about any negative aspect and can only recommend to give this place a try.

Great little apartment on Linden Gardens with everything you could need for your stay. It's so close to all the London action, but in a very sleepy street, so perfect for a good night's rest before another day in the city. :-)

This is the perfect homely flat in the perfect location. Super spacious, with great light boasting through the living room window. Yas was the perfect host, attentive, flexible and with attention to details that will make you feel valued as a guest and taken care of. Can’t thank her enough.

Absolutely perfect apartment for staying in the West End.
Spotless, well equipped, exceptionally quiet for its location - with very communicative and friendly hosts.
I will be staying again - ‘nuff said!

The main host India is unreachable. Had an emergency and had to check out early, tried to get in touch with host to try and work it out. Completely went in the dark, Airbnb couldn’t reach them either. Wouldn’t recommend staying here.

Thanks, does what it says. Everything worked and was to a high standard. Bed was comfortable (it’s 2 single mattresses though), sofa was fine but as others have said it has lost some of its firmness, appliances worked fine, shower was good with plenty hot water. I’d stay again. Thanks
Robin was a great host and made sure he was at the flat when  a registered letter was sent in my name. He was very flexible as well about check out time.

It has been a perfect stay in London for us : a nice and well equipped apartment and a superb location. The welcome has been very kind and efficient when we arrived. I wish we could stay there when we come back to London next time.
I highly recommend the place.

Tiffany‘s house on The Green exceeded all expectations. The house was spotless throughout and equipped with everything you could need from a holiday home.
All communication was effortless and Tiffany was a fantastic host.
One of the best AirBnb places I have stayed at.
The room was spacious and lovely! I arrived at the place 4 hours before the check-in time, but Geoff was kind enough to let me stay earlier:)

Perfect flat for our London weekend getaway. The flat was clean, warm and had everything we needed and Sian was super quick to reply to any question we had. The check in was smooth and simple and the bedsheets and towels clean and crisp. Comfy beds and fluffy duvets were a plus and added to the hotel feel. Would definitely stay here next time I come to London!

This apartment is ideally located for exploring London with a fair degree of attractions walkable.  It is also very close to the tube so it's easy to get about.  It's a nice neighbourhood and the street is quieter than you may expect in central London.  The apartment itself is well appointed and comfortable.  Nick was an excellent host with friendly, clear and precise communications and provided advice and flexibility when we needed it.  I would definitely stay here again if I return to London.
Sherry’s apartment was 10/10! So clean and the communication was excellent will 100% be staying here again if I’m ever in the area
Carey’s place is fabulous! We had a great weekend. The place is very well equipped, well located and Carey (subject to confirmation with her) is very dog friendly.

Great flat with everything you need for an extended stay. My family and I stayed for six weeks while I was working on a secondment in Woolwich and we were very comfortable. Agat is a great host who always responded to messages quickly and was even able to provide a high chair for our child. Recommended!
Absolutely fabulous! Great location, super lovely apartment, everything spotless, smelt delightful!  Tamara is a really good host with quick and helpful communication. Highly recommended!!
It was  lovley to stay at Monicas apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and silent. I enjoyed the time there immensely. I will come back again. Chris

This is a nice place to stay if you are looking for a room in a great area of London.  Its very compact and  the bedroom is accessed by loft stairs, which might not work for anyone who is a little unsteady on ladders.  The loft height was also a bit low for my 6 ft tall friend.   That said, we had a comfortable stay and I would book again without hesitation.
A great location to explore London for a few days! Easy check in instructions and the place was super cute.
The apartment is very comfortable and in a good location with great views. Check in and check out was extremely easy.

GORGEOUS apt in the most incredible location on a quiet and quaint street. It is only a few minute walk to the tube and Portabello road. Instructions are clear and the place well cleaned and kept. The loft bed is off of a ladder so you do have to be comfortable climbing a bit but it was very cozy. There is also a futon. Would certainly recommend!!
An excellent home! Well kept and beautiful. With public transit it was easy to get into Central London in just 50 minutes.

Great house with LOTS of space. Great location too. House was equipped with everything you need. The rooms are all large and communication with Vikash was great. A very accommodating host. Will look to stay there again.
Isabelle was really kind and accommodating. Her flat is beautifully furnished and the bed super comfy. She also prepared us an amazing breakfast and gave us a lot of privacy. Definitely recommended!

I spent 8 nights at Tamara’s place with 2 friends earlier this month. Everything was perfect: clean, quiet, and as described. We appreciated the many thoughtful & tasteful touches throughout the home. Check in and communication with Tamara was super easy. Highly recommend! 😃

Simon is a great host; very kind and responsive. His unit exceeded my expectations in every way. Everything was in place in the large room, and the large bathtub healed the tiredness of walking around sightseeing. It’s located at a very nice and quiet area yet 5 minutes walk to Notting Hill subway station, bus stops, stores and pubs, major super markets, etc. You can access to any London’s popular places easily. I would definitely like to stay at this unit again if I had a chance to visit London in the future.

Very cute and perfect space for a couple. The staff communicated very well with quick responses, they are very helpful. Highly recommend! It’s super close to the train station which makes exploring much easier. The space was clean and well kept up.

Excellent location!! Beautiful property. Just a five minute walk to the Green Park tube station in one direction, and about a 10 minute walk to Picadilly Circus. Robert was very attentive to everything we needed, and we felt safe in the area.

This is a lovely place fresh and clean. Decent sized rooms with good facilities  great location 2 mins from Mornington cres.   Great to pop to Camden high street and lots a good places to eat and drink.  Lisa is lovely to deal with an responsive.  Would stay again and recommend

I had a lovely stay at Robin's place. There is beautiful light, plenty of space, and it was very quiet. Robin was welcoming, friendly, and very flexible about check in and out times. It was easy to walk to various local cafes and pubs or to catch public transportation to visit anywhere in London. I was there for three weeks and had everything I needed. I had a great stay and would book again!

Fantastic little space to stay whilst visiting London. Close enough to central but far enough away to enjoy the suburbs of the city. Peaceful and beautiful location - room was clean, spacious and had everything we needed. Fantastic communication from Bipin and we were made to feel very welcome. The parking is an added bonus - we will definitely return!

Simon is a perfect host, super responsive, and very friendly!
We even got a "Welcome Package" with some basic food and sweets.
The flat is cozy and the location is perfect.
We would love to come back on our next trip to London.

Daniela is such a warm-hearted host! She was quick to respond in all communication, was flexible on both check in and check out. She came back with some toys even for our little girl which was extremely appreciated! As for the place itself, great location, close to parks and a supermarket. It is a very spacious place and lots and lots of light! You won’t regret staying at Danielas!

I would note that this is a garden level, or lower level apartment and therefore a little damp. I still highly recommend as it was such a great location, very clean and Anna was amazing! She was very thorough in directions and with the apartment manual. Any problems (and they were very minor) were dealt with promptly. We stayed with two kids and recommend for a family since it is a safe location and close to parks:)
Such a great place! Everything from the house manual to resources to help navigate the area, Gary and Bianca are super helpful and were very transparent throughout our whole stay.

This place is like it seems! Clean, cozy and great neighborhood! Bipin was an amazing host. Was there for anything that I needed and we talked quite a bit. One of the best host I been to yet! Even though I was there for 2 nights only. Thank you!
We had a great stay here, location was fantastic and easy to find. The apartment was clean and quiet. Highly recommend.

Location, location, location... close to the tube station, bus stop is just in front of the house, Middlesex University is stone throw away.
The house is spacious, and have a great balcony so you can sit and relaxe.
The host was very cooperative and offered help.
while the house is well equipped, it needs some renovations and modernization.

Beautiful apartment with absolutely everything we needed. The apartment was clean, tidy and easy to find. The location was very convenient and communication was excellent. We will definitely book again if ever we are back in London.
Great location. The TV is tiny and the the washing machine is very difficult to use. The sheets are not clean but the rest is great.

The apartment is well situated and exactly looks like the photos. The bathroom is definitely stunning and comfortable. The two things which can be improved: 1. the mattress is too soft or maybe just a bit old. 2. I lived for 3 weeks but there is nothing I can use to clean the apartment by myself.
For the rest is all fine, except that it doesn’t look like home. But I am sure it fits for 2-3 days short stay.

This apartment was excellent value for money, very quirky and spacious. It has all the amenities you could ask for and was very clean. The host was most accommodating. Would definitely stay again. Location felt very quiet and peaceful, no noise from the road or subsequent apartments. Very happy with the experience :)

Beautifu, quiet room in a beautiful quiet house, in a very peaceful location.
Hosts are really lovely, welcoming helpful people.
Many thanks

Sylvia's place is lovely. It has everything that you could wish for. Sylvia was very responsive throughout my stay and resolved a minor problem with the flat very timely. I highly recommend staying with her.

This was such a fantastic and beautiful place to stay - the garden is stunning and the flat beautifully decorated. It was both cosy and elegant and is incredibly well appointed. Carey is a brilliant host and I hope very much to be able to return. Thank you so much for a great visit!

We had an amazing stay at this beautiful apartment. It's spacious, clean and well located. The amenities are second to none. The coffee machine made delicious coffee - a real bonus as we love our coffee. The parking space is a real plus when looking for accommodation in this area. Nada is a a fantastic host and we could not recommend the property more.

The location is perfect. We had a lovely stay and enjoyed the hospitality.
We were even allowed to leave our bags with the owner, since our flight was later than check out, that was very kind.

An incredibly kind and attentive host with a beautiful room, the property is very clean and tidy and is in a good location for an excellent price. I could not recommend Lyisha more. I highly recommend staying with her and I will definitely be returning to stay again!

Harriet’s place was great for our stay in London with a toddler in tow. Downstairs is very spacious with a well equipped kitchen, upstairs is smaller but suited our needs. The house is positioned well for local shops, restaurants, parks etc. and there are good transport links nearby. Communication was excellent and Harriet always responded quickly to messages. She organised parking just outside the house, and when we left and forgot a set of our keys she posted them back to us! Thank you Harriet for a lovely stay!

Great flat in central location- comfortable, clean and full of cute touches + easy to walk to Broadway Market and other great nearby stops and a quick bus or tube/overground ride to many other locations. Nina was a great host and very communicative and helpful before, during and after my stay.

We had a very pleasant stay in this contemporary lovely apartment. An extra we did not even expected was added to our booking and that was an amazing surprise. All people from the office were very pleasant and polite especially Adam. We definitely will be back to stay in this apartment in the future and I would strongly recommend staying there.
Tina is a great host and makes sure everything is super clean. The room was comfortable with a bit of noise from the boiler when a tap ran, but that didn't bother me very much.

Pro: The location of the place is great.
Cons: The cleanliness of the place leaves a lot to be desired, especially the room and the bed. It is also very noisy.

Tom is a great host, very easy to speak to. The location of the flat is great, very close the notting hill center.
The only downpoint would be the furniture which is pretty old, a blind fell, and the bed is really bad. No way to make the room dark also.
But at a good price, the apartment is ok to enjoy London !

We had a perfect weekend at Carey's. The flat is exactly as described. It is comfortable, well appointed, and in a great location. Carey is a welcoming and thoughtful host, and very accommodating. It was great having the garden to step out into when weather permitted (the bedroom is at the back too which is great as the house is on a fairly busy street). Really comfortable bed. Wonderful provisions for kicking off our breakfasts (a rare delight!). We certainly hope to go back.
Wonderful private room in a house right next to the tube! Super clean, great light, and sink inside the room made this a great experience.
Safe enclosed house within a private complex, great to be so close to London with parking included. Very helpful host and lovely to meet Leo his ginger cat.

Alexis place is absolutely lovely. We are a family of 3 adults and all of us liked it a lot. Comfortable beds, well equipped and stylish rooms. Easy transport, we liked the neigborhood. The apartment is personal, varm and it feelt like and we were grateful that we found it. Alexi was easy to communicate with.
Great flat, really good location. Absolutely loved our stay here, and we will happily stay again. Thanks Tom!

We loved our time staying at Jaydin’s and can’t recommend him enough. He went out of his way to welcome us and make sure we were comfortable. We felt comfortable enough to go out all day and come home and Jadin would allow us our space but we would be more than welcome to go chat with him. He gave us lots of advice of what to do in London and showed us the roof top terrace which was lovely. He even cooked for us one evening which was so great especially after being on the road for over a month. Thank you Jadin, you are fabulous!
Perfect location, clean and just like the picture. Many cafes, restaurants around the apartment, but not so noisy. Highy recommended.
Good location, great balcony. Flat itself was smaller than it appears in photos, but is pretty well set up for a short stay.

Location :
The nearest busstop is around 3 min walk and has frequent buses to reach train station ( Putney Bridge).There is a ASDA nearby ( open 24 hours) if you need food or groceries.
Rooms:
The room is very clean and Sancha ensures that you have everyting you need ( coffee bags,cookies, dark chocolate,slippers, dryer, bath towels).There is a microwave , kettle and a mini fridge to use.
The check in and check out process is simple.
Would definitely recommend this place .
Simon was an excellent host and the apartment is in an excellent position in Notting Hill.  Highly recommend.

Overall, it was as expected & pretty good value for the price. When I got there, I messaged because there were no towels and got a response within an hour or two and I was able to get some. Then around 10pm I messaged again because I was getting ready for bed and noticed there were no sheets on the bed. I stayed up for awhile waiting on a response but did not get one until later the next morning. The host said that what was on the bed was their “sheets” but it had the texture and appearance of a mattress cover and by all accounts looked like one based on ones I’ve seen before. It was not a traditional sheet set with a fitted & top sheet and definitely didn’t feel like sheets either, so that’s something to know if you’re planning on booking!

Nikki and Stew are the best host I have met; very kind, very helpful and very considerate. My staying with them was on a business trip, during pandemic, and I encountered several traveling issues , very much appreciated Nikki and Stew they offered me immediate help to ease my puzzle everything when I asked.
The apartment is located in an excellent area; quiet, convenient and beautiful neighbourhood, very easy access to stores, cafes and restaurants, short distance walk to the River Thames, about half an hour to the central London. Apartment itself is equipped with everything I need for a long stay.
I will definitely choose to stay with them again when I visit London next time!
A very nice place to stay for a few days. However the noisy bed and the sound of people walking at late hours might keep you up.
A perfect location, worth a try. Could be busy (noisy) at night, but windows are modern and cover the street sounds. Clean and cozy

Good location and sunny exposure. Could have been cleaner - bathroom shower area has some mold. Basic products such as shampoo, body wash, and soap for washer missing. Overall our experience was average .

Great place between Hammersmith and Chiswick — on St. Peter’s Square.  You will have flatmates but otherwise the full house to use as you wish. Kitchen has all the tools you need, lots of grocers on the high street (Sainsbury’s and M&S but I recommend the polish deli, the Thai market Smile, or either of the Persian markets).  And Inge is wonderful, right next door but you’ll see her everyday — a wonderful soul. Metro is close (less than 5 minute walk to District line; or 10 minutes to Hammersmith Station — Circle, Hammersmith-City, Picadilly, & District lines). Plus the Thames promenade is right there! Easy access to both Heathrow and Gatwick, and Westminster of course.
Very clean and tidy the room was very nice with a great view and on top of that there is a rooftop with one of the greatest views in london, 360 degrees above London. Was a great experience.

we had a wonderful stay at Bianca&Gary's studio. It's well designed, clean and calm.
Great communication and clear informations !
I recommend highly to visit London.
Thank you 😊

Anna is a great host !
The check in and check out we’re very easy. She managed the schedule to allow us to drop our bags when we arrived and to leave them at the apartment prior to our flight.
She gave us a lot of tips and information : nice restaurants, pubs, things to visit, etc.
It is really easy to contact Anna via air bnb or WhatsApp.
I truly recommend her

Starzeus’s space was exactly what I needed for my trip. Very clean, quiet, private and cozy. Moreover, he went above and beyond to make my short stay as comfortable as possible. He made arrangements so I can have an early check in and responded to any of my messages promptly. Without hesitation I would stay with him again & highly recommend him to anyone.
A great little place - very clean and modern, has all the amenities you need and only 5 mins walk from the local station.  Very easy checkin and a most welcoming host!  Thank you Bipin!

Great house in a quite area. I didn't meet Shelly but Louise was very friendly and was quick to respond to any queries. There was an issue with a blown fuse in the kettle and Louise ensured the issue was rectified immediately and ordered a new kettle for us straight away. The only thing I did miss was utensils in the kitchen such as a wooden spoon, strainer and chopping knife. I otherwise could not fault this Air BnB, I would recommend it to anyone staying in London! Thanks so much for having us.

Really great place, the studio was clean, airy and spacious. Comfortable with all the facilities we needed. Denise and Jonathan were lovely and welcoming, thank you for breakfast ☺️ Would highly recommend a stay.

Excceded expections, immaculate & lovely apartment, felt like home. Sandra is a professional yet very friendly approachable, accommodating & welcoming, top notch communication, everything is well thought.
Many thanks for the lovely flowers, made our daughters very happy. We will share the experience with family and friends.
Highly recommended. Veldig fint.
Great location, only a few minutes walk to the underground station Hendon Central (Northern line). The apartment is quite spacious, six of us slept in three separate rooms.

Great location for the using the underground, plenty of local useful shops. Short walk to Camden Lock/Camden Town, nice light and airy rooms. Clean, tidy and neat little spot with the necessities for cooking if you are not looking at eating out every meal of the day.
Would stay again in Camden area

This room was perfect for my trip to London for work meetings. It’s a lovely clean room with a luxurious bathroom in a beautiful family home. It has a desk overlooking the garden which was very useful. It’s on a quiet leafy street but only a few minutes walk to the tube station. The host was very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

Was the perfect intro to london for me, ideal location. The hosts get back to you straight if there’s any issues and the co-working space downstairs is great and the staff are awesome.
Highly recommend, would stay again :)

This was our first time visiting London, and I'm so happy we found Tamara's flat! The location was perfect - we spent the day walking around Notting Hill, and made it over to Hyde Park & Kensington Gardens. The flat itself is absolutely stunning and we had everything we needed for a wonderful stay! Highly recommend!
Cozy attic room in a lovely home, Greenwich park is nearby, very kind and welcoming host.

We loved our stay here and would recommend it to anyone traveling to London! We ended up being upgraded to the one bedroom and have nothing but great things to say. George and Paolo were very helpful and the flat made it easy to get around London, plus  had everything we needed.

Great location. Beautiful apartment.
I will be back again, next time I'm in London!
Thank you.
