Jaqua is an amazing host! Great communicator and the venue is amazing! Well look after garden with great bar and facilities. Will definitely stay again

The location was great! You are at the train station in 1min. Our room was also clean and comfortable :)
But with the host we definitely hit the jackpot, Jadin is a super nice person and we enjoyed the time we had together! Definitely will come back! We recommend!
Sturm & Maxima approved 🤍👍

A great flat and ideal location for the Printworks were I was working at an event. The flat is clean and comfortable. There's some restaurants and a supermarket close by.Highly recommended and will hopefully be back to explore the area a little more

Perfectly located cleaned and furnished
Don’t hesitate to book ! Kamal is very ni e and welcoming !

Fantastic airbnb with very lovely hosts. Peaceful area with easy access to transport links. Ideal if you want to be in London without the noise and bustle.Spotlessly clean, all the essentials and more, comfortable bed, great views, huge deck....one of the best airbnbs we have stayed at! Loads of space. Lovely walks in the parks.We will be back soon!. HIghly recommend! Stay here you will be so glad that you did

Highly recommend.
We always stay here when in London.
Third time staying at this great little place.
Mo and Alessa are very nice, friendly and easy to deal with.
the place is clean and quiet while being very close to the heart of Camden

We had a very nice stay at Valery's flat.  It's well located directly across from Kentish Town Underground/Train station as well as a bus stop that will take you into the heart of the Oxford Street area!  Other really cool places (Camden Town, Hampstead Heath, etc.)  are within easy walking distance.  The accommodation is spacious for London standards and very comfortable for a two bedroom flat.  We didn't cook at the flat but it seemed well stocked.  The check in was straight forward - we arrived at 14h00 and they were ready for us.  There's a new bakery just down the street from the flat...Kossoffs....it's amazing!!  We'd definitely stay here again.

The place was clean which is the most important thing to me. It’s also walking distance to many places. Just 6 minutes walk to Oxford Street. We dropped our luggage early and picked them up without any issue. I will definitely come back again.

The flat was in a great location and I really liked having a small kitchen. The Caledonian underground station really is a very short walk and the Picadilly line is a really convenient start for everything you want in London.
Great apartment in the perfect location. Lisa was great. Good communication and if we needed anything she was there. Enjoyed our stay immensely. Would come back again.

Very quiet
Beds very comfortable
A lot larger than looks in pics
Lots of food options within minutes walking
Very safe neighborhood

Our stay was perfect place is so homely and well kept Sandra is wonderful host will definitely stay again
Samreen Cope

Beautiful apartment in a wonderful and well kept antique building crates a unique and amazing stay. Kathrine was very welcoming and helpful. All contributed to a lovely vocation at the centre of London.
The perfect location, next to the central station. Everything went perfectly and very good communication with the host. Very happy :)

We strongly recommend Paolo's appartment. We had a great stay. The appartment is perfect for visiting the city. It is very conveniently located, it has all what you need and it is very comfortable. The host gave us a lot of recommendations and suggestions for visiting the city and he allowed us to leave the luggage. Looking forward to coming back again!

10/10
Inge was super helpful and communication was great throughout. The house is awesome - super clean and in a great location. Definitely recommend!

The flat is lovely, exactly as in the photos, with a very high ceiling. Sandra and Nordine are very responsive and accommodating, ready to respond to any questions. Flat is close to Upper Street and Highbury Fields. Would very much recommend staying here!

Absolutely perfect! The location is very convenient. The apartment is very comfortable, well equipped and clean. Yas was so accessible and gracious. Thank you!
I know I’m going to come back and stay here again!

Carolyn’s place is very nice and spacious. All the bedrooms were comfortable and stylish, and she went above and beyond to provide us with bread and milk for our stay. Wifi is good. Great selection of confectionary too! The place is further out than some, but the location to the tube station is so convenient - you’re in central London within 30mins!
located near to Stockwell station just a few minutes walk, the room is small but comfortable to sleep in after a very tired day of touring London

Isabelle is so lovely! She’s warm, kind and generous, and her home is not only comfortable, but it’s filled with her artistic sensibilities as well. I could not have asked for a better experience, nor a kinder host, for my first trip back to London in more than a decade. It was a privilege to share her home for a couple of nights. I promise you will feel right at home. 🥰
Excellent location and host, made us feel welcomed. The apartment is a perfect fit for any traveling couples.

Location is great, minutes to train stations. We only stayed one night because we were leaving the following day. Check-in was simple. A few things you may want to look out for:
- you have to climb 3-4 sets of stairs and the hallway is pretty narrow, it was difficult with a stroller
- the tv wasn’t a smart TV (not a big deal for us because we didn’t stay long)
- the washroom door doesn’t close all the way and there isn’t a lock (again, not a big deal for us)
Overall, it had everything we needed and the price reflects the location (close to restaurants, etc)

Very kind and avaiable host.
The place is just perfect, very functional and in a strategic position to vist London!
Warmly advised!
Thank you very much Jadin for your hospitality. The location is right next to the station, which is really nice. Nice place, great view as well!

Everything was perfect from the check-in until the check out.
Good Location not too far from the underground.
I’m highly recommend this host
Eva's place is wonderful, super clean and in great location in Highgate which is good for Queens Wood and Hampstead Heath🙌
Jodie’s place was great - it was clean and easy to check in and had everything we needed. We checked in quite late and it was no problem. Very much recommend.

Really enjoyed my stay at Van's charming flat. Communication was excellent and the self check in process was very easy with clear instructions. Location is fantastic on a lovely tree lined street yet steps away from Camden and Prim Rose Hill along the canal. Very convenient transportation choices just off the Northern underground line and many bus choices for easy access to the city. The flat itself is lovely and very true to the photos. There is plenty of natural light from the large windows and the building was very quiet during my stay. I really appreciated the many thoughtful touches throughout the flat and felt very much at home with the extra garment racks in the bedroom and basic necessities provided in the kitchen and bathroom. The flat is well maintained and cleaned to a high standard. I would highly recommend and hope to stay again soon.
A truly wonderful place to stay, very stylish and relaxing, and super easy to get around with numerous buses nearby.

The cozy flat of Isabelle is really something special! It is so sweet and comfy and the bed is just wonderful! We just needed one room but there is a second room and an en suite bathroom just for your own use. Everything was absolutely clean and Isabelle made us a lovely breakfast and we really felt at home! Not to forget the great advices for the buses and locations! We will definitely come again!! Thank you Isabelle!

The apartment was great - very comfortable, modern and clean. It was walking distance to where we were going (20-30 min). Wifi was slow but a high speed service was installed as we left. Host team were very responsive.

Great location with easy access to all that London offers. The place was small but cozy. She provided us with a bottle of processing, fresh fruit, coffee, tea and milk. Small details that were really a nice touch. Thank you!

Miriam was very accommodating & checked in regularly to see if everything was alright!
The location was great too - close to train/bus stations & lovely area to stroll around.
Comfortable,  clean and well located. I heard no noise from any neighbours and the shower was hot with good water pressure.

Nice little apartment in front of a park.
Very close to the underground and with a huge supermarket just a few steps away.
Hostess super receptive and helpful.
It was a pleasure to stay in this accommodation, clean, very helpful communication and all comforts. Thanks! Highly recommended

The apartment was great, very big and looked exactly like the pictures and it had everything I needed. The area is fantastic - right outside Liverpool Street Station where you can catch the bus and the tube. The service was amazing and the check-in very easy. I would definitely recommend it!
Huge place and a fantastic location! London is massive but it’s close to plenty of great restaurants and attractions with the tube near by.

Gordana was like a family! Extremely welcoming, very human, very supportive. We had situation with our original departure schedule 5am. Gordana understood our situation and was extremely generous and supportive. True Super Host. Not to mention location of the apartment. The amount of space. Very positive Experience!!!
The spot is perfect, you have access to all London and calm enough to sleep well and have the best time you can visiting the city!
It’s always nice being here, it feels like home. Whenever I’m in London, this is my go to place. Thanks again for everything, see you next year!
We had a wonderful time and will definitely be looking to stay in a Kula apartment next time we visit London. It’s clean, comfortable and stylish while being in a prime location but not overpriced!

Absolutely amazing host and a beautiful house. Very clean and cozy with everything you’ll ever need including breakfast, tea and coffee every morning.
Located in a safe and convenient neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. Highly recommend. You will be missing out on a great place if otherwise.

Beautiful flat in Earl’s Court. Close to two tube stations and buses which was very convenient. It was beautifully decorated and was well stocked. Communication was great and check in and out was a breeze. Nice quiet neighborhood with some great food places nearby. Prince St. was fun and unique and a visit to Evans and Peel Detective Agency is a must! Would definitely stay here again. This was our first Airbnb stay and we were not disappointed!

A great place to stay while visiting London. Super close to Edgware underground station and about 10 minutes walk to Paddington Station.
The apartment is small, but well equipped. 4 people can stay here easily.

Another fantastic stay here. ‘Home’ from the “Les Mis” in 20 min - such a brilliant location.
Apartment perfectly clean and ready for visitors as usual - and plenty of space for all the family. The lift made it perfect for grandparents also.

This is a wonderful flat in a great location. Ease of access to the Green Park Underground station was a huge plus for our family. Kitchen has everything you need and the rooms and lounge were lovely. AC works very well and access to the flat is secure.

Comfortable place, well furnished with style and convenience. 10 minute walk to the north (quieter) end of Portobello Road. Shops and cafes on Goldborne Road were much appreciated. We especially enjoyed the Lisboa Patisserie, the Golborne Deli and Wine store, and the pie and mash shop (usually seen in the East End of London). We would happily return.

We loved staying with Anne! She made us feel right at home and she was incredibly welcoming and understanding. Her advice was phenomenal and I loved recounting our days with her when we got in each evening. I highly recommend staying with her!

Lovely place in an excellent location. The tube station is so close, you can get everywhere so easily! I loved the little balcony looking over the very beautiful street that the flat is on. Highly recommend!

Absolutely loved Marijana’s place. It was very cosy and comfortable with lots of space. In a perfect central location, a couple of seconds walk from the tube. Other reviews said it was noisy but we didn’t find that at all. Hope to be back soon!!

Quiet and bright apartment, and very clean!
Tania was an excellent host and always available.

Nice stay in London
Lisa is a super Host
Everything was good 😊
Great location : this apartment is located near to St Pancras Station (only 20 min by walk or 3 bus stations) and the town center is very accessible by underground (the near station is only at 200 meter)
Great Equipment : the apartment propose all equipments do you need (3 rooms with confortable beds, a big lounge and a kitchen full equipped)
We were 4 adults with 2 babies (1 year and 3 years)
Lovely homely flat. Great location. Graeme is super lovely, really quick to respond and extremely helpful. Check in/out really simple. No fuss. We were very happy visitors!

My GF and I stayed in the room for 5 nights.
Our stay in Greenwich was great. What you see is what you get: a nice attic room in a beautiful house in Greenwich. The place was really clean (Kris even replaced our towels during our short stay) and they had nicely set aside cutlery, plates and cups for us to use, as well as some free space in the fridge. The room has a nice view towards Canary Wharf.
The communication was excellent both before arrival and during the stay.
Keep in mind that there is no door for the room (only the stairs) and that you have to walk uphill a bit to get to the house. Both these things are described in the listing.
All in all we had a great time, and would definitely recommend this place!

A beautiful and quiet house with a very nice walled garden and a great view (there is a little park just in front of the house). The huge kitchen with adjoined dining-room is well equipped. You can reach Angel, Upper Street and Angel tube station as well as the overground railway stop in no time and a bus stop is really close as well.
The communication with Tania was great and she was very helpful allowing a late check-out.

Lovely stay in a central part of London. The apartment is small but big enough for two people to stay in. Very conveniently situated near public transport and Santander bikes, and all kinds of cozy pubs and restaurants.
Cozy little apartment in pictoresque Notting Hill! We really enjoyed our little girls trip and can absolutely recommend staying at Max & Billies‘ flat.

It was a wonderful stay.
Monique is a very attentive host, and the house is clean, well kept and welcoming.
The train station is very close to the house, excellent!

Me and my girlfriend stayed over the weekend and all we can say is that the place was fantastic. The view was amazing and despite the location being slightly out of the of the main city centre, it was easy enough to navigate to the nearby subway and make our way about London!

Very nice (all basic needs completely fulfilled , but no luxury) and well located flat. Great communication with host. Detailed, but still fast and precise information. Very professional. We highly recommend it.

Perfect place to be for one night or more as the situation could not be better! Quite street, cute flat! Just I would add some better stores to guarantee a darker bedroom to sleep 😴 our upstairs neighbors were super noisy until 1h30 but this has nothing to do with the host. Super check in too , George is adorable

This place was great. The location is very good, the house was very clean and in good condition and very comfortable, and we had no problems at all. There was a slight problem with not enough hot water flowing for showers for 4 people, and Vikash fixed it immediately and very well.
We highly recommend this house.
We had a great stay.  The location can’t be beat, easy walk to 3 different tube stops.  Plenty of restaurants  and pubs, small supermarket.  Highly recommend for a family of 4.

Very good location with a lot of space to spread out. Close to the train and an underground stop, as well as Tower & London Bridges and the water front. The Borough Market is just down the street with amazing food options. Many other restaurants near by.
Needed help with the dishwasher and the owner was very quick to respond and help out.

Anne’s house is a great place to stay, it’s very close to central London and is well serviced with any amenities you could want.
Located on the edge of historical Epping Forest, there are also wonderful walks to be had.
Anne is a wonderful host and great to talk to.

This is a lovely little place,  very unique and the location couldn’t be better. We enjoyed the patio area and the proximity to the park. We also very much appreciated being accommodated on a slightly earlier check in after a red eye flight with our kids. Will be back!
Stayed for one week, neighborhood is very nice and convenient with many shops and restaurants and access to public transit nearby. The room was clean and comfortable and Miriam was a great host!
Really nice comfortable flat in a quiet block, as described. Dominic was a friendly helpful host, highly recommended
Such a lovely place to stay! The good communication with Max and Billie made everything really easy and the studio was lovely.

Carey's flat is beautiful - spotless, spacious and so well equipped. Everything is finished to a high quality and well thought out.
Carey is an excellent host, nothing is too much trouble. She is warm and welcoming. This flat is the perfect place to explore London from - a 2 minute walk to Stockwell Tube Station. Airbnb at it's best!

I must say that I have a very, very pleasant stay at Julia's.
Highly recommended.
Its cosy, its comfy, clean and very well located.
Host's are simply wonderfull, very rare.
Really enjoy!
Nice little studio apartment in beautiful neighbourhood. Only problem was the shower, which I didn’t find very user friendly.
I had a great stay at James's. Good location close to town and shops and very friendly and helpful host!

Jadin is great and very supportiv host. He did an extra supportiv effort at my departure in appartment! Appartment is very nice and clean. I have more then I needed. Location is excellent and very well conected (bus is literary infront of appartment). If you plans include O2 then even better for "jump in/jum out" Lomdon. Warm recommandation!

Paolo’s apartment was exactly as described. I arrived via the great Portland street metro from St Pancras. The flat is just a short walk from multiple metros and is conveniently located by cafes, markets, restaurants, and pubs. I arrived early and Paolo was happy to let me drop my bags off early. By the time I arrived the apartment was ready for check in! Communication was great I would highly recommend.
Really enjoyed my stay. Clean apartments with everything you need. Easy check-in. Friendly staff. I will happily come again!

Barbara was a wonderful host..made you feel very welcome.
Great location and fabulous views!

The place is amazing! Cutely furnished, spacious, unique, and so many personal touches. Not to mention the beautiful backyard and the two lovely dogs! Then of course the excellent proximity to a Tube station, making getting around London a breeze.
Carey was likely the best Airbnb host we've ever had - extremely friendly, communicative, and had amazing and detailed suggestions for visiting London. Couldn't ask for a better stay. Highly recommended for anybody staying in London, and we plan to come back to the same Airbnb next time.

Denise and Jonathan were amazing since the beginning. They had the room ready for my early arrival and were constantly in contact just to see if I needed anything.
The pictures are just for reference because the room is way more beautiful than you can see in those. It is really cozy and comfy.
I would totally recommend this place to anyone that wants to enjoy a silent time and just be calm, and have really amazing hosts.

Everything was amazing, very very nice host with a good surprise!
If I had to go back to London I will definitely come back
Not a bad little place, a little cramped but still ok. Bed and shower were a little small but it's very close to the subway which is a big plus.

Debbie was very good host, with quick communication and provided us with detailed instructions and a long list of the restaurants recommendations. The apartment is very conviniently  located in 5 minutes walking distance from the Kings Cross station.

Everything was amazing. The accommodation is near to the supermarket, bus stop, pharmacy, everything you need! I highly recommend!
Maria and Stephen are great hosters and helped me and my father a lot!
I can’t recommend this apartment enough. It’s an amazing location and is a home away from home. Great communication with Lisa as well. We’ve had an amazing stay!

Awsehome host. House was very clean and have everything you will need for a vacation home. Guest was very responsive and checked in on us throughout  to make sure we having a great time. Visited with family and kids, kids had a lot of amenities to keep them busy and they had a great time. Only thing is London was a little warm when we visited and not enough fans for each room other than that had an exceptional time. Will definitely come back again. Thank you

Why pay for a pokey hotel room in the City when you can book this delightful residence? We had booked to see the rugby at Twickenham and this property was perfectly located. The photos don’t it justice. It is beautiful and spacious and the air conditioning was very welcome given the soaring London temperatures over the weekend. Tiffany was responsive and super helpful. I would thoroughly recommend this property especially if you are there for the rugby. There are some great watering holes and restaurants nearby.

We had a great stay at this lovely apartment with everything you need. Nice and quiet location, still close to public transport. Very nice and prompt communication with Tom, before ND also during the stay (despite we never met in person 😉). Definitely going to consider this place for our next time in London. Many thanks!
This AirBnb is in a PERFECT location. The check-in process was simple and easy. Great amount of space for a couple. Only complaint was that there was no AC on a hot night.
Extremely happy with the stay at Valery’s. John helped with the checkin, very nice process.

The apartment is very spacious, clean and supplies everything you need.
The communication with Mel was excellent and she replied very fast. Also the check-in worked easily without any complications.
The apartment is located in a quiet area with lots of shops (supermarket etc.) and restaurants around. Clapham Junction is only 5 minutes per foot.
We can totally recommend this place and would love to come back again.
This is a great place to stay. Location was spot on for my needs. The flat is light and airy with good views from many aspects. The lovely artwork adds colour and an artisan feel. Fully equipped.

We had a very nice time at Nadine's apartment, it was very clean and we had everything we needed, it was very easy to get around and Nadine's team were very responsive.
The check in was a bit confusing because there are a lot of keys and lockes, if you're doing a late check in I suggest to ask Nadine in advance wich key opens what to avoid the time it took us trying all the keys, we wouldn't give up the apartment for that, and would definitely come again!
Thank you for a wonderful time!

the apartment is in a perfect area, a minute from the underground.
there are a lot of stairs to walk up and it is above a restaurant, so there is a kabab smell all day (not at night but if you close the windows during the day then its not a problem)

The apartment is cozy, comfortable, tidy n clean, not short of necessary bathroom n kitchen supplies too. George, the gentleman who lets us into the apartment is so helpful n understanding. Communication with him was prompt, clear n sharp. Would return again!
Superb modern accommodation which is so quiet for London, no traffic noise only bird song from the park behind

Great location and functional, convenient flat. A bit snug for a family of five, but would be perfect for four. Having two full bathrooms was great. The walk to kings cross is just about 6 minutes, tesco is just 2 minutes around the corner. The cafe and pub on the block are both great— friendly and convivial.

This basement flat was in the perfect location.  It was a 6 minute walk to two main underground tube lines which are very user friendly to navigate.  The neighborhood had great restaurants and pubs.  Anna was very responsive and accommodating.

Place was just as described and in a perfect location.  Paolo and his property mgr George were more than welcoming.  We had major issue with travel documents and loss of phone and they helped me use their personal lapptop to sort things out.  I would definately stay here again when in town.

It was cozy and clean. I had an issue finding her house using Google Maps and it took 30 minutes to get into her house around 9:30. If your priority is having a private room, I'd recommend her house. But don't expect other warm communication or spending time together with your host.
Awesome host and lovely apartment - very flexible with arrive times. Ideal location for DLR - used for a concert in Hyde park

We rented Jodie's annex for my mum to come and stay nearby when she was helping us with our new baby. It's a lovely, modern, clean, self contained apartment in a pretty setting and in a great location very close to Ladywell village. Jodie was very friendly and accommodating throughout and we would definitely rent the annex again.

Decent place to stay. Price reasonable. Close to Bow underground.
Jahed, who looks after the house, was nice to talk to. Other guests staying there were nice as well.
Great communication and Herman was really easily reachable all the time! Room was just what promised, could recommend this!
We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. The flat was well kept and clean, the bathroom was well maintained with a good quality shower. The integrated speaker was a nice touch.

What a gem! Superb apartment, spotlessly clean and in a great location. Easy access to the local and wider amenities with Camden in your door step. Would certainly recommend breakfast at Adrianas just around the corner too. Will definitely be staying here again!

A lovely appartment! Bright, clean and with everything you could need.  A nice bed, comfy cauch, good fridge, coffe and tea and fluffy towels. The neighbourhood is great, lovely cafes and restaurants and an easy busride from KingsCross.
Beautiful room and a great host. Great value for london and an easy subway home if you are in the city. 5/5 in every way if you don't want to pay the huge money for a location right downtown.

Tom’s place was lovely. He’s an accommodating host and quick to communicate. The location in Notting Hill is wonderful and it’s so close to transportation to get around the city easily. I would recommend staying here!

Good place for a short stay. There was a problem with the water running from the cheater but the host remeided it quickly. Very good localization. The flat looks bigger in the photos, its very hot inside but its enough for short stay.

Our stay at Tracy’s place was wonderful! The location is superb with the bus and underground station being so close. The place itself was very clean and the amenities were great. Tracy was also easy to get a hold of! I would recommend this airbnb to anyone I know passing through London.
Great stay for the price, super close to East Graydon Station. The hosts were great with communication. Most definitely would come back!
Fantastic communication, he really helped me when I made a mistake on my booking. You saved my bacon, top guy!

Absolutely wonderful experience. Everything as described / very comfortable, elegantly and thoughtfully appointed, in perfect location for access to the charms of Wimbledon - and Chris was a perfect host - helpful, warm, communicative. Cannot recommend highly enough.

This is one of the coolest flats we’ve ever stayed at with Airbnb. Attention to detail was a 10/10. Lots of amenities/extras for the whole family. Excellent location, great flat, and a very communicative host.

The flat was in a good location for travelling in and out of the city, which was just what we needed. The nearest tube stop was only a 10min walk if that.
The view from the flat was amazing, and we enjoyed having breakfast on the balcony each morning.

It’s a fantastic and cozy place. The location is great, and you can travel almost anywhere from the nearest tube and bus stations, which are only minutes of walk away. Many fine dining places are also in the neighborhood. On top of that, Tuna put in a lot of effort keeping the place clean and helping the tenant as much as she could. Really appreciate it!

I would definitely recommend this flat and would like to stay again. Very comfortable for a family with small children or a couple. Equipped with all you need to make a quick meal or just store snacks. Very clean and quiet! The neighbourhood itself is nice with several restaurants and cafes around and a supermarket right around the corner.  It's also super close to Oxford circus and Goodge street tube station, but we ended up walking everywhere, as it was so ideally located.
Great apartment, beautifully finished. Immaculately clean. Had everything you need. Amrita was very accommodating and a great host.
Good value place considering the location and the size of the flat. Hosts were very helpful and were kind enough to let me check in early
Quiet flat in very good location, excellent public transport connections around London (both tube and several bus lines)! The communication/check-in/check-out process was very smooth!

Lovely accommodation, felt at home so quickly. Great location with a short distance to tube and it was surprisingly quiet. Tracy is a great host and super helpful and kind . Perfect spot for sight seeing if you don’t want to stay in the middle of all the London chaos
Mo’s place was excellent. It was very conveniently located, near a tube metro station, pubs, shops, the Camden market and grocery stores. The room was very clean and spacious for 2 people!

Just book it, and Helen will be there to take care of you. Everything was provided for as described, and even during some hiccups (I forgot how to use the shower button), Helen was quick to respond and resolve my concerns. Excellent level of service!
Eva and her family were so nice and helpful. The room was cosy with a beautiful garden view. And the exclusive bathroom was spacious. I want to stay at her place when I visit London again.
James’ apartment was perfect for our trip! It was a great location and they were very responsive with any questions we had about the apartment.
Had a very lovely stay an Nadas place! Very calm neighborhood, not a 10 min walk from Wimbledon Tube. Lovely apartment and great host. Thank you very much, Nada!

Nev's apartment is clean and comfortable with more than enough room for 7 of us. The location is perfect if you are going to the Spurs stadium with plenty of shops and bars nearby and the tube is in easy walking distance. communication with Nev was always very clear and checking in and out could not be simpler.

Book this place! Don’t hesitate! We came for the Adele concert in Hyde Park and this location was perfect, the space is beautiful. The check in was super smooth and convenient, the location was great for food and shops nearby. Quiet street and just absolutely stunning room. Would definitely book again. Thanks Max and Billie for our stay!
Great location by the tube and nice and clean! Will say the bed was super uncomfortable, felt the springs all night.
The locations was the most ideal. The apartment is spacious and does the trick. Very basic interior but adequate. The linens were questionable with stains that looked fresh.

They apartment was very clean and well located. Lots of restaurants near by. The room was lovely and bright with lots of natural light . Miriam is a wonderful host and if I find myself back in London I would most definitely stay there again .
Nicole's lovely little apartment was just as described in the pictures. Easy communication & check-in and great location. We definitely enjoyed our stay here!

Perfect location!  Very central and easy to walk to all of the major destinations in London. The views in the flat are stunning! Max was an excellent host and made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend!

The Airbnb is a great place to stay. It was very clean and it is located in a fun part of town with many shops and restaurants. It is only about a 10 minute walk from the tube, where you can quickly get into Zone 1 London. Mercedez was responsive and helpful. Overall a great place to stay!

Beautiful apartment close to the underground (tube). We were able to be in the city centre within 25 mins, the transport was very convenient. Nicely decorated flat in the house with privacy and in a good neighborhood. Tesco store is available by walk in 5mins or next to the tube station was convenient 24/7 supermarket. Carolyn went above and beyond to make sure that we had everything we needed, very fast and nice communication. Thank you for being a great host!
Nice quiet central apartment, with lots of kitchen equipment to cook with. But it was a bit dirty...

The flat is roomy, comfortable, and clean. Our two teenage boys enjoyed relaxing in front of the television after a long day of touring. The beds and bedding were very comfortable.
The washer and clothes line were super helpful for a family of 4.
We had a lovely stay.

Cozy, clean, well located, with everything needed. Really cute apartment. Metro, bus to Picadilly Circus and supermarket really close. Me and my family had a great time in this apartment. The hosts were easy to communicate with.

The apartment is very conveniently located 15min walk from Jubilee line. The room is very spacious, perfect communication with the host. Bonus point: I had an issue with the wi-fi on the first day; Herman took care of it in minutes. I would definitely visit again!
Lovely clean house, with bed which feels old but slept amazingly, Eli is a lovely host, doors can be a bit noisy during the night, but I slept very well.
Excellent stay. Very well prepared room. Everything i needed and expected was there. Excellent location. Thank you Artur.
Sola was great left us snacks milk and water in fridge plus snacks and wine couldn't av asked for a better host house was great too 👍
Great little place for a solo or couple stay. It is quite small but has everything you need.

Gorgeous flat and really good location. About a 15-20 minute walk from several stations. Nice garden to enjoy your morning coffee. The flat itself is beautiful and Rosie is a wonderful host. She made sure we had breakfast essentials even going so far as asking which king of milk we preferred. Overall we had a great time and would highly recommend.

Place was excellent for a night, central location with easy access to public transportation. Just what we needed.
Only negative was the elevator being broken. Great place, would stay again.

I stayed at Rosario's place for a month and my experience was very pleasant. I had a lot of privacy, the room is comfortable, quiet, well equipped and has a beautiful view of the park nearby. Rosario made sure I had everything I needed for my stay and was always willing to help.
The house is near Stockwell tube (Victoria and Northern line) and is quite easy to get to the center of London. I felt super safe and, in addition, there are supermarkets, cafes and pharmacies close to the house. I absolutely recommend Rosario and her hospitality in London!
1 Bedroom flat (plus sofa bed) is in a fantastic location—near plenty of pubs and good restaurants and under 10 minutes (walking) from several Tube stations. Would stay again next time I’m in London!

Flat was fully equipped with everything we needed - 2 TVs with Netflix access, kitchen utensils, soaps, microwave, stove, fridge, washing machine and iron+ironing board in the shared laundry room on the top floor.
Host was quick to respond and provide assistance when we needed. Check in and check out was simple and easy. Location was fantastic.
Marijana had informed us beforehand about the flight of stairs to get to the room, so we were kind of prepared for it, but definitely not recommend for travellers with huge luggages as the stairway is quite narrow and tiring.

Amazing room with a really friendly host . Had an amazing stay and communication with Ali was always brilliant.
Only downside is that the shower head pressure is low and the water can switch between hot and cold quite a bit. That wasn’t a massive issue since the room was still great value for what we paid and how lovely the room was

Clean and neat and well equipped apartment. Attentive and serviceable landlord.
Great location, close to shopping, shopping at Camden Market and subway and bus.
Can only be recommended.
Family from Denmark

Good place for short and long trip.
Vlad is a friendly and easy going host.
James is friendly and the room is perfect. It is very close to the airport but it isn't too loud. A piece of nature in the garden

Wow! I cannot sing high enough praise for Nada’s flat! It’s gorgeously decorated, located close to transport links, and Nada was a wonderful host. There was a wealth of snacks and drinks to choose from, and Nada was super helpful during check-in and the stay. Definitely worth booking!

The apartment was very well located in a nice part of London, with restaurants, pubs, tourist sites and public  transport all within walking distance. The apartment itself was was well appointed with a great kitchen, a TV in all rooms, comfortable clean beds, great water pressure on the shower and AC. I wouldnt hesitate to return if I was staying in London again and I would also recommend to family and friends

Eliana was a great host. She waited for us even if we checked in late in the night.
The room is in a cosy house in Clapton. It’s a nice residential area in East London. It’s connected with buses - but it will take you a bit to get to the Tube or Overground.
The bed is not very comfortable, it makes quite a bit of noise every time you move. Also, the walls/door are not fully soundproof- so you hear the noises from other hosts in the house (when for instance they open/close their room’s door, use the stairs or go to the toilet).
All in all: great host, nice area, but not the best sleep.

Nicki and Stew where lovely hosts. Very quick and responsive with answers on questions. The property was extremely, clean, comfortable and the location was ideal within Richmond.
Would highly recommend staying with them.

Lovely clean apartment, perfect for a weekend stay! Short distance from the underground and a little noisy but that is expected in London. We had all the amenities we needed and would definitely stay again!!

We had a very nice stay at Tay & Marina's! The bedroom is at shown in the pictures, very clean and functional, with all the items we needed and in good condition. Accommodation well situated, walking distance from the Flower Market, Bricklane and subway. We didn't meet them, but the check-in/out process was super easy, with very clear instructions; communication was always quick and smooth. The only inconvenient we had, was the heat; but we were there during the heat wave and I guess everybody in town suffered from it. It is a very good option price/quality wise, I highly recommend it!
Everything was perfect, great communication with the host, ideal location for exploring the city and the best thing is the owner's cat :). We would definitely come again.

This was a perfect apartment for a few days' stay.  Very comfortable, thoughtful layout and appointments.  Lovely private deck.  Coin op laundry available.  Croyden appears to be a neighborhood that will be experiencing a turnaround soon.  It was very quiet and felt safe.  We even slept with the folding door completely open at night.  Easy location to the bus and train, and short ride to London proper.  I would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful,  clean, air conditioned rooms with all the amenities you would need. And in a great location!

Hien and Jason were great hosts. Their place is perfect for getting a large group together with plenty of indoor and outdoor space. The rooms were very comfortable. The kitchen is awesome. A great deal of natural light. Plenty of space to be together and plenty to get in your private time. Also, beautifully decorated!
There are restaurants nearby, a very short walk to a small market (the Co-op) with fresh produce and reasonable prices, and 15+ minutes walking to a huge Sainbury's grocery store. The path next to the house leads to a park for relaxing or taking children. Around the corner is the New Eltham station that can help you get to anywhere you want in the London area.
When we bring our crew back to London, we'll check first to see if there is availability here!

Harriet was a wonderful host. Her house is super homey, cozy and a place where you really want to hang out. The small garden at the back of the house is an absolute gem!
Communication with Harriet was super easy and she was great and flexible to let us check in a little earlier than expected. The location of the house is also great. Not too much noise, but still in a central, buzzing area in Hackney with loads of great bars, cafés and shops. All in all we had a really great stay at Harriets house, that I would recommend to everyone :)

My 11 year old son and I stayed for 10 days and had the most amazing stay. Communication before and during our stay  was with David and it was superb and quick. Mariela met us at the apartment and was an absolute delight. She ran through how things worked at the apartment and was very thorough. The location is fantastic: 2 mins walk to Gloucester Road station, 2 mins walk to Sainsburys and a 15 minute walk to the museums. The apartment was clean and bright and well decorated. A cleaner came in twice while we were there which was a pleasant surprise. I highly recommend this property and will stay again whenever I stay in the area.
Great location and excellent communication with easy check-in and quick response. The garden flat is worn and can smell musty.
Excellent in all aspects - even better than what the photos show! I spent a couple of weeks here and slept so well. Eva and her family are easygoing and very welcoming. Strongly recommended.

Rami is a great host, ever so accommodating, who went to the length to send us back by post an item one of us foolishly left in his flat - at a time that wasn't convenient at all for him I should add. Thanks for that.
His apartment is 20-30 minutes away from central London by metro (3 convenient lines nearby) in a very lively neighbourhood - but the street itself is super quiet. It has two lovely common living spaces and is well equipped by anything you would need in a short or longer stay. In other words : do not hesitate !

Could not recommend Kula highly enough! We throughly enjoyed our stay, the apartment was beautifully decorated and much bigger than it looked online, the cleanliness was perfect, location excellent and the hosts are really easy to communicate with and went above and beyond for us. We will definitely be returning next time we visit London!

This is a rare find. Agat is a great host and the place is fabulous. Its walkable to station and everything else is close by. The apartment was super clean and also had a baby chair to our surprise. Strongly recomend this place !
Lovely flat, well kept and nicely decorated. Nada is professional and very generous. We had a comfortable short stay.

location is very convenient. You can either take central line/ Hammersmith and City line to central London. Room is very clean and you will be able to use the kitchen and washing machine. Host is very responsive. I will definitely revisit if I come back to London.

Lovely room and house, very nice for its reasonable price. Right around the corner from the venue where I wanted to see a concert, so a perfect find. It was awfully hot weather during my stay but the hosts provided a fan and later even had blinders installed.

If you’re looking for a place to stay with a great location, look no further. So close to the station with lines travelling to many London sights. Tina was a great host, and her place was clean and provided all the essentials.
Very spacious apartment with pretty much everything you could need. Amazing location! We had a lovely stay.
The condo has everything we need. It is a bit small but it is London though. It would be much better if the interior can be upgraded. It is just too old for the entire unit.

It is a very nice flat that is close to the Wimbledon Tube Station and National Rail. Lots of good restaurants within walking distance. Very clean flat and nicely decorated. The owner, Victoria, is extremely pleasant and flexible. We had a wonderful stay.

Everything in this flat was very well presented and welcoming, and we had a lovely time despite we were there during an extreme heat wave. The room was provided with a fan that surely would be enough for a regular summer (no one can be truly prepared for such extreme heath in a city that is designed for cold weather). Checking in and out was simple, the instructions were clear and we didn't have any issues. The shared kitchen was nice and clean. the location is perfect! there are plenty of local shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby, with a bus stop just outside the flat a a short walk to the overground station.  Thanks Tay and Marina, I'll recommend this place when someone asks me about a place to stay in London.
Tamara's place is a gem! Highly recommend and will look forward to staying here on our future trips to London.
The room is very clean. Jadin is a very interesting and nice person. We had a very pleasant stay.

Fantastic place and well organised for large groups with kids. I stayed with my family (10 people) and everyone loved it. Hien and Jason were great hosts and always responded quickly to our inquiries/requests.

The host was awesome! So sweet and reliable. There are like 5-6 flights of stairs even though it’s between 2-3 floor. It was a rare heat wave and there isn’t AC and she was nice enough to provide us 2 fans! I would stay here again (with less luggage lol)
Rachel was a great host and quickly responded when I had issues with the door. The place is a nice space, but there were bugs in the bathroom and the building could use a deep clean and a lot of TLC.
Great location (as long as you don’t mind some late night train noise). Easy check in and clean room. Small kitchen which was great for making cups of tea and snacks.  Thanks for a great stay!
This was a great location, near Southwark Park and other amenities. Easy and painless check in and check out. Nice, well cared for flat.

Our stay went well.
The bedroom is really nice and big.
The bathroom is used by many people so it'snit as cleaned as expected but it was ok.
We really enjoyed our short stay at the apartment. It is perfectly equipped, the surroundings are nice and relatively quiet, even on a Saturday night.
Well equipped flat in Camden. Beds were comfortable. 10 minute walk to transportation and some great restaurants minutes away.

Highly recommend this lovely Airbnb in London. The hosts are wonderful and very accommodating. Unfortunately we were only staying in London for one night but they were able to recommend a great walking route to optimize our time there. Apartment was clean and cozy and had everything needed to make our stay comfortable.
Rosario and his wife are very nice and welcoming. The room and the bathroom are very clean, their flat is close to Stockwell Station, one metro stop from Vauxhall.

Best stay in London ! We spend 3 night (2 teens and myself) in July.
The place had everything we needed, it is cosy but that wasn’t an issue as we were always out. Absolutely fantastic location where you can walk to most touristic places, shopping and great neighborhood with nice restaurant literally downstairs. Yet, the place was super quiet and we had no sleeping issue.(bed was confortable) . I highly recommend it! Georges was super helpful for all check in and local recommendations.
I would stay there again.
Just one thing, best to travel light as not a lot of storage capacity and stairs are narrow.
Great room for persons of two, spacious and had everything you needed, facilities for basic house needs were all available.

Fabulous place. Exceeded our high expectations! Location is wonderful. The proximity to Twickenham Green is like being in the centre of an English village.  Tiffany is a fabulous host and communicator. The one minor issue we had due to the unprecedented heat was quickly sorted.

Fantastic, quirky place in a fab location. Only a 8-10 minute walk to the Portobello Market with plenty of wee cafes and cake places. A few shops just along the road to get groceries. Just along the road from the tube which are our trip so much easier. Would definitely come back here again.

Amazing property. Great shared garden. Big house fitted our 2 families well. Hosts were really patient storing our stuff after check out when our taxi was delayed collecting us. Highly recommend. Thanks for a great stay!

Paolo’s place was amazing! Great location, quiet neighborhood - we highly recommend this stay. We appreciated the apartment manager walking us through the appliances and necessary details about the space before checking in.
I strongly recommend that place. Lots of space, everything is clean, kitchen is fully equipped. They respond to messages promptly.
It was a great stay! Alexey was a great host and was available all the time to answer all our questions. The location was fantastic. Overall a very pleasant stay! We would surely come back again

Overall really enjoyed our stay at Paula’s flat! Wi-Fi was a tad spotty during some video calls, and there weren’t empty drawers or closet space to put away clothes - but that’s because this is really Paula’s home and was full of life and character, also the best part about the flat. This place is good for friends traveling together, though one room only has a crib for Paula’s son and an air mattress, so it would ideal for a couple/ single parent, traveling with a small child. Location was great just off Bermondsey street, and Paula had great communication which made the check in/ check out process easy

Lovely house, clean and comfortable; nice 10-min walk to the tube station, which has a big supermarket on the way, and one train ride to central London.
Sandra has been very responsive on any question, the entire stay including check-in & out has been smooth and pleasant.

A lovely room in a conveniently located self-catering accommodation - great if you want to stay close to inner city London without the noise and bustle. Room was tidy and well appointed, with a fully equipped shared kitchen and a nice outdoor patio.

My husband and I stayed at Sandra’s home for 2 weeks in summer. It was absolutely delightful! We were greeted by Nordine when we arrived and he quickly showed the place around. The flat is very spacious (considering its in London!) and just a few mins walk from the nearest tube station. Nordine helped us out a lot and was extremely accommodating. Will definitely come back and highly recommend the place 😊

This is a really great place to stay, lovely host and a great location. Easy walk to go out and eat, good links to travel to central London or out to Kew etc. Isabelle is a friendly and helpful host and makes a lovely breakfast. She has lived in the area for a long time and has lots of suggestions of things to do and  transport options.  We had a fantastic stay and will return!
Good flat in a great location! Everything was as described and communication with Sian was easy (including the check in).

Excellent and comfortable stay. The room, shared bathroom and shared pantry area was clean, neat and well equipped. Conveniently located near the tube and Westfield mall. The area was also relatively peaceful at night so my sleep wasn't disturbed by loud noises or traffic.
Excellent stay for our family of four. 10-15 mins walk to closest tube and overground station. There are a few nice restaurants close by recommended by Michael. We enjoyed our stay.

Isabelle is the kindest host and made us feel very welcome! She’s very sociable and down for a chat but also respect your privacy. We had the best time and Isabelle played a big part in that. Would highly recommend and definitely visit again!
Nearby transportation in a quiet, safer london neighborhood. Great quality for the price and easy check in. I felt very safe and comfortable.

Anne is a very loving hostess. She was always open to our questions and had good tips on places to visit. Every day she managed to make our stay with her a pleasure. She gave us a lot of space in her house and in the garden. Everything was neat, clean and tidy. If you travel a lot in the city center, you have to be prepared for travel times. For us that was fine. Breakfast consisted of cereal, toast, butter and spreads. Coffee, milk and juice were always available. Great! Anne's pets (cat and dog) are an added bonus. We had a great time at Anne's.

Super place. We felt right at home straight away and the home had everything we needed. You can see the owner pays special attention to his lovely home, and he was ver responsive on anything we asked. We would definitely stay here again.

This is a large room with a comfy double bed.
There are lots of extras not found in some hotel rooms. Tea/coffee making facilities, iron and board, fridge and fan during the Summer.
Sockets with USB ports.
James is a cheerful host making me feel very welcome.
We had the best weekend in sandras flat! Very clean and comfortable. Great location and helpful and respectful hosts. We will definitely stay here again when visiting london
Gina’s place was just like the photos. Great location and we enjoyed the extra touches of the muesli and fruit. Would definitely stay again.

The house is perfect for a family vacation. Beautifully decorated with lots of space and garden too. Closed to the bus stop and shops, quiet at night so we were able to enjoy time at the garden having a drink. Megan was always available in case it was needed it. I highly recommended to stay in here if you are coming to London!

We had absolutely lovely time staying at Isabelle's place. A true home-like atmosphere, and a wonderful host that made us feel both welcome and cared for. Breakfast was delicious, we're gluten-free and dairy-free and Isabelle catered for us without a fuss, even baked us a cake! We asked to use the sofabed and Isabelle turned out living room into a second bedroom for us. Both beds were comfortable and we had our own private bathroom with lots of toiletries to use. Bathrobes were a super nice touch. During our time there we felt tended to, but also had our own privacy. Fantastic location close to all types of public transport, with tube few minutes walk and bus running all night. Many places to eat short walk away and a supermarket as well.
I strongly recommend this lovely place to anybody who is looking for a wholesome and relaxing time in the heart of London.

Amos’ flat is beautifully light and airy. Its in an ideal location for getting to the centre of london, we chose to walk the short 10ish minutes to Finsbury park station as it had the best access to the centre. There were also plenty of restaurants and fresh produce grocers on the way that we’d love to try the next time we visit!

The home itself was magnificent. It had everything we needed. I have zero complaints for the home. The communication was fantastic. The subway/tube a short quick walk away from the home. The listing is spot on. Will definitely return one day.

very cute and quiet, got all you need (no air-conditioning, but 2 ventilators).
communication with Federica is perfect, respond almost immediately.
not suitable for disabled (narrow and too many stairs).
bottom line - recommended.

Ali is a lovely host and was accommodating of my requirements. Flat is dated, but very clean although plumbing needed to be addressed as there were some blockages which Ali set about fixing. Comfortable but a little over priced compared to the competition.

Ideal for travelers on a budget, this flat has all the basics and a new bathroom and kitchen appliances. Also, the lobby and access to all the flats is secure and locked.
It's only a couple of blocks (about to 6-minute walk) to Kings Cross and St Pancras stations. The lift was out of service during the time of our booking so check with owner if climbing a few flights of stairs is an issue for your party (in case the lift is still out of service).
It would be a bonus if the property had WiFi although our group made do using our mobile phones.
This property is clean, tidy, and has all the basics plus laundry and a balcony to hang out your washing. Our group agreed that we'd book this same property if we find ourselves returning to London in the future.

This is an excellent place to stay. It is well connected , being a short walk from Shepherds Bush Market tube station. The room is very clean and well equipped, including a much appreciated fan.
The shared bathroom and kitchen are well equipped .

My stay at Rosario’s was just what I needed - a cozy bed to sleep in after a long day of exploring London. Rosario and Rafael were extremely kind and thoughtful during my stay. I was only in London for a short period but Rosario made me feel at home and provided toiletries, sweets and coffee/tea. The location is southern London but a 5 minute walk to the Stockwell station with access to the Victoria and Northern line bringing you to the heart of London and it’s tourist attractions. I felt extremely safe at Rosario’s which was important to me as a woman travelling alone. Would recommend!

We had a lovely stay at Sergio’s flat! Good location, close to buses and trains. The flat was clean and well equipped with everything we needed. Our 4 year old son loved the bunk beds and toys! Sergio was easy to communicate with and responded quickly.
Amazing stay, couldn’t have asked for a better house for a small group of people to stay in.
A very convenient place to stay if you need somewhere close to the Heathrow airport terminals. Very clean.

Wonderful light, airy and quiet apartment a few minutes walk from the train station.
This fully equipped apartment sleeps 5 comfortably with a large lounge and kitchen and 2 bathrooms.
Tamara is a super host and we will definitely be back.

The apartment was very spacious and had most amenities. The location is fantastic. Very central and close to stations (Baker street & Marylebone are 5 & 7 mins walk respectively). It is 15 mins walk to Bond street and then Oxford circus just further up. Excellent location if you love to be in the Centre of all attractions and shopping in London. Communication was good and effective. Vas was very kind and reasonable and accommodated my requests. Check in and check out was seamless and he even granted us a late check out. Overall, my family and I had a lovely stay and we would definitely be back again.
Great location, incredible view! If you’re looking to get a lot accomplished and feel safe, informed, and comfortable, this is the booking for you! Max is a great host.
Super nice place in a very serene location in London.  Very sizable, bright and sunny apartment fully equipped with all mod cons and two balconies. You can really stretch out and relax here!

We have just returned from a lovely few days staying in this Air bnb. Fantastic location and a great flat. Very clean, comfortable (especially the bed!) with everything you’d need for a city break. Also, great communication throughout. Very kindly kept our luggage on our last day to enable us to do some last minute sightseeing. Would highly recommend!
Alexey's apartment is very comfortable with many facilities. The location is great. The communication with Alexey was great too. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT.

The apartment is superbly located, it is functional and tasteful. I particularly appreciated the bathroom,  small but equipped with both bathtub and shower, and very new - definitely not a given in London. Communication with the host was perfect and smooth.  Would definitely recommend.

Incredible flat in one of the prettiest parts of London! Super comfortable with everything you need for your stay. Quiet street that is only ten minutes away from Hyde Park and Notting Hill Gate. Lots of incredible restaurants and things to do nearby. Easy access to transport links. Loved my stay and highly recommend it.

communication and response time, checkin, cleanliness and location is great and lovely, and many other guests mentioned good feedback which i agree with.
3 important points to note.
1. Its mentioned that there is 1 bedroom and a common area, but the bedroom has no door, its just a big opening near it, with no privacy, which brings up the 2nd point.
2. It was listed as for 4 guests, but it actually good for 2, for me and my wife with 2 kids, it was a bit tight.
3. Not good in summer with heatwaves, the flat had no aircon and only one small fan, the air doesn’t circulate, which made it unbearable to stay in, in some days
If the host addresses the 3 points above, i think it will be a good place for max of 2 people to stay and enjoy anytime away from summer.
Great Location, easy access to public transport! Granola and milk was a super nice touch, gina was easy to contact, great for a short stay!

Clare is a lovely and attentive host. The home is just as beautiful, if not more beautiful in person.
We had a lovely stay.

Eliana's space is exactly as it is in the ad. All very clean and quiet. There is a bus stop on the same street that connects you to the center, places to eat and shop also close by. Easy access also to the overground at a 15 minute walk. My experience was very positive!

Lukas is a cool host. He is a humble guy and is service person and takes care of details. All as expected !
Thank you Lukas!
Tidy well-designed studio near Notting Hill Gate-underground. One small remark: the bed on the shallow vide is less suitable for the taller guests.

Couldn’t recommend Nwike enough as an amazing host if you’re looking for a lovely, private place to stay in a great location just outside of the city centre. My trip was extremely enjoyable and Nwike’s communication was extremely helpful whilst I stayed the night.

Spacious, easy-to-find townhouse with the bonus of gated parking. Great communication with the host, checking on us beforehand with reassurance to get in touch if we had any questions.
The house is large, comfortable, and homely with good facilities nearby and an easy walk to Southfields underground.

Just perfect!! Amazing location, super clean and really functional. Paolo and George were highly responsive to any questions and helped make our stay and visit to London an amazing experience!!. Will definitely stay here again on any return trip to London!
A lovely apartment, really comfortable and no problems at all with getting keys etc. Communication all very easy. Location is great too; a really handy walk to the District Line tube.

Thank you Ayo. My family enjoyed their stay.
Rooms and shared areas were clean, location is walking distance to tram and served well by buses.
Overall a very good stay.
Thank you for being a kind and helpful host too!
A great apartment in a great location. Quiet and peaceful with a lovely garden to relax in.  Finished to a high standard. Highly recommended
Great location in quite street near underground, however the aircon and wifi were not working at all the whole time we were there. Very frustrating

Frank was very hospitable and kind! The room was airy and spacious, and the bed very comfortable!
Highly recommend, check in was easy and accessible!

Helpful hosts. A lovely,  clean and well-equipped apartment, with comfy beds too.  A great,  central location,  which was quiet at night,with a couple of nice cafes just around the corner. Ideal for activities in Central London.

Tina’s BNB is a gem! My checkin was smooth and the room + bathroom are spotless and very cozy. There is a lot of storage space in the room which is so rare. Tina was respectful of my privacy as well as super helpful. The neighborhood is a huge plus with the tube and many cafes right around the corner. I particularly enjoyed the closeness to Hyde Park. I would recommend this BNB to anyone who is considering a budget yet, comfortable stay!

Nice, cosy apartment located conveniently for the centre of London, with easy access to the underground including the new Elizabeth line. You can actually walk through the park in front of the apartment to the Thames path, by beautiful gardens and equally beautiful athletes and runners. The apartment is 5 mins from a 24 hour Tesco and 20 mins from the Thames ferry. It has a toilet and separate shower and bathroom. The kitchen includes a hob and microwave and expresso machine. Excellent wi fi. Nice area in general.

My boyfriend and I stayed the night here after traveling back from Croatia to break up our long trip back to California.
Good value and in a great location…the bus stop is right out front to take you to Heathrow.
The house is definitely older and has kind of a smell to it but it didn’t bother us. Comfy spring mattress and a large shower!

The location is excellent!  But as others have said, there are 55+ stairs, and it is very difficult with overseas luggage (unless you are young!).  The interior stairs to the bathroom are a bit challenging during the night as well.  Otherwise, it is clean and comfortable.
Good value for money. Apartment is exactly as it is on the pictures. James is such a kind soul, he made our short stay very pleasant. I 100% recommend.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Peter is a wonderful host who is very easy to communicate with, very helpful with anything I asked. Would definitely stay here again.

Small room but great people who offered it.
They even put free snack bars and some water in the room when I checked it.
Apart from that I have to say this was probably the most clean Airbnb I ever had!
Would highly recommend
Great host, the place was clean and was at a good location! Didn’t disappoint! Loved my stay

Lovely home and garden, responsive and helpful communication with the host, great for traveling with children. Plenty of shops and takeout nearby, but also really easy to get to the city center on the tube. Thanks for letting us stay!

Great host, communication was great and fantastic location for the Tower of London & Thames. Beds and bedding and sofa really comfortable and clean, nice bedding. Ideal for a short stay to explore. We would stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay in this unit. Paulo and George were helpful. The location was fantastic for us. We were able to walk almost everywhere we wanted to go. Mind you that we have no problem walking 10 miles or more a day. It’s it’s also close to several tube stations. The flat itself is quaint and had everything we needed. We were glad we booked this unit
Great place to explore London from. Quiet at night, close to the train, and tons of small bakeries and coffee shops for morning walks. Shower works well and the bed nook is cozy.
Great stay, clear contactless checkin, right near the train, quiet, clean. Would definitely stay here again.

Wondaful home away from home. Has everything you need.
Getting in and out was super easy and comfortable.
Location is great. Very near the park (which has playgrounds) and mall.
A slight problem with one of the showers kept this at 4 stars but  this was an immaculately clean, ideal base for our family at a very reasonable price.
One of the best located airbnbs in all of London. Large flat with plenty of space. Great host
Great place in London! Location was perfect, and the apartment was very clean and practical. Loved all the modern touches and how close we were to everything. Would highly recommend.
This was a wonderful spot to stay! Walking distance to Kings Cross and many great restaurants & shops. We would definitely stay here again when visiting London!

It was beyond our expectations and so beautiful. It is on the third floor so I wouldn’t recommend for a buggy or heavy luggage, but we did not have either in this trip and it was honestly incredible.
Location
Spaciousness
Decor
Amenities
Roof top
Thank you so much x
We enjoyed our stay at Paolo’s. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet and is the perfect location. The Airbnb is great for a quick trip to London!

What an amazing stay!
Clean, amazing location and safe! Really impressed and the sweet tray was an extra cherry on the top!
10/10 would recommend to stay!

The apartment was just as described, charming and a fantastic home base for exploring London. It’s just a short walk from Old Street street station and right in the middle of the restaurants and nightlife of Shoreditch. We enjoyed our stay and would love to visit again in the future!

Isabelle is an exceptional host. She was helpful and kind but not overbearing. It would be difficult to regret staying here. Everything is brilliant: smooth check-in; clean; spacious; well-located (next door to a pub, close to underground, etc).
And her cat, Mr Darcy, is delightful and just as friendly as her!

We stayed at Daniels property for over 2 weeks whilst between flats. There are not a lot of amenities around however it is very close to bus stops, Seven Sisters tube station and overground trains. Nice neighbourhoods are a 30 min walk away. I would note that the property is situated on a main, busy road so can be very noisy at night with vehicles. Daniel is an extremely responsive host.
John was a great host, very helpful and friendly. And the apartment is just as advertised. I enjoyed my stay!

2 bedroom/2 bathroom flats aren’t all that common in London. Excellent location & walking distance to several stations as well as Hampstead. This is located in a residential neighborhood and is a flat inside a large private residence. There is some outdoor space & everything works well. There is even an electric clothes dryer which is also unusual. Excellent value for the size/location.
Great location. The apartment has everything I needed. The place is clean and looks better than the pictures. Highly recommended!
This place was perfect for me. Sadly I was here for a funeral. However, the location was ideal, and Jan was lovely, a great hostess.
The room was clean and I had a nice time at the apartment. The host was very friendly and responsive to messages. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Sergio's place was great and he and Denise were fantastic hosts. Communication was efficient and responsive and they were extremely helpful and accommodating with regards to our arrival/departure schedules.
The apartment has everything you need and is very comfortable. Despite being close to a number of pubs (which is great in the evening), the apartment was nice and quiet at nighttime.
I highly recommend the place and would be happy to stay there again in the future.

Big spacious bedroom in beautiful flat. The location and value were amazing and being able to spread out in the room was really so delightful after being on the road for a while. The bed was incredibly big and comfy!
Suzy was an exceptional host. I was a bit worried about sharing someone's space as I had never done it before but she made me feel welcome and had everything I needed. Including letting me borrow some extra hair tools and helping me with laundry. I came and went as I pleased and she was full of recommendations in the neighborhood... which is awesome. I would definitely stay again.

Choose this house if you want a comfortable stay during your stay in London.  The host is very friendly and will try to make you feel comfortable.  The interior is well and cutely decorated.  Cooking and laundry can all be done at this home.  However, i cannot hide disappointment because i found several spiders in the kitchen, especially on the countertop.  I'm very surprised as I'm not used to seeing pests in my house, but I recommend this house to those who don't care.

Safe and quiet area, clean and everything needed is supplied, good price for travelers in London.
The host is really nice and kind to reply our questions. We have a good communication.
I’ll recommend this house to my friends who will stay in London.
It good quality for money accommodation in Poplar . The apartment is clean , all utilities/ appliances are up and running . The host is responsive , cooperative and helpful .
Next to the road very easy to find. A little bit noisy at night time(you can hear the cars passing from the road). Otherwise this is the perfect place for staying.

Anne is a fantastic host! She is kind, meticulous and extremely well organized.
The room are wide and very cleaned, and beds are super comfy!
The place is very well served by buses and the train station is at just 10 minutes walk distance.

I enjoyed my stay at Starzeus' home. He was very welcoming and helpful. A cheerful face that put me and my friend at ease. He offered me and my friend a little nugget of hidden London that was a boon for us. His place is very clean, very spacious and very peaceful.  I do recommend this property for anyone looking to stay in a small town in South London for respite and/or as a base to travel into Central London for sightseeing and/or nightlife.
Wonderful little place. Tucked away nicely with no street noise. Clean with a lovely plush carpet and very comfy bed. Refreshments provided.
Conveniently located to tube stations, or a short cab ride to anywhere you need to go.

Tom's Notting Hill flat is as described, conveniently located and a great base for exploring all things London.  The tube station is just around the corner, Portobello Market is two blocks away and Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park are an easy walk.  We would gladly stay again.
Emily’s flat is fit for small family or small group to travel in London.  It is close to Borough Market and there’s a coop within a few minutes walk.
This was more than expected, everything was amazing and especially the terrace which was great to have. Location is very close to everything. Rob was amazing and helped us with everything.
All was great, well stocked, great location, good communication. We are in many nights and was very comfortable and the stay for two couples was very nice. The location couldn’t have been better.

The unit location is absolutely brilliant, close to many restaurants and the tubes. Very convenient and enjoyable. The only issue we had was the shared bathroom and toilet which were unfortunately very untidy when we used them.

It is a good apartment with top location that worth the money. Not noisy but in the centre, large rooms and comfortable bathroom.
Definitely worth a visit at Kula!

What a cute, fun place to stay in Bethnal Green! Just a two minute walk from the tube station, in an historic bldg settled over a great coffee shop [Sazzy&Fran]. We could not take our eyes off the decor and found something new every day. Clear instructions provided for everything, and the beds were really comfortable. Well-stocked kitchen. A lovely place to come home to after a day of walking around London!
We had a very nice trip, the location is perfect, the room is clean and spacious but it's very noisy, we heard everything like we were in the street and the certains aren't really usefull

Totally recommended place, particularly if you're going to the O2 for some event. The place is a walking distance of Canary Wharf Station (just one stop from the O2).
The room is spacious and Humayun is there if you need anything.
Great value and a fab location. Close to lots and also close to public transport. The little cafe around the corner called Kin was delicious too. Sofa bed was comfy too.

This is a wonderful place to stay, the flat is just as the pictures show it, perfect for a couple on a long or short stay. The location is amazing;  close to shops, restaraunts and the tube, and just around the corner from Portobello Rd. Simon is a great host, very responsive, and we will definitely be back.
Fantastic flat.  Lots of room, very comfortable, easy access, host was excellent.  Highly recommend this flat and we intend to stay again in December!

Omer is a great host, flat was amazing and very clean, Omer helped us with brand new table fan within a short time. Place is very close to shepherd bush market station hardly 5/6 minutes walking distance. There are so many good restaurants close by, 10 minutes tube to Oxford street and nearby. We’ll definitely come back to stay. Thanks Omer

Great location - so close to the station and nice and quiet! Just be wary there are quite a few steps up to the unit. Could also have been more amenities like soap in the shower and more than 1 towel provided. Overall, a comfortable stay.

This studio flat was more than enough space for one person let alone two people. The kitchen had more than enough appliances and there was shampoos, conditioners, etc offered. It was a great, quiet stay in a beautiful private patio. I absolutely recommend this to anyone who's looking for a stay in downtown London.

Lovely place in a great location. Lots of fast trains from Bromley South into the city so very convenient for travel.  Bromley town is quite large so lots of shops and restaurants there too to explore. Great hosts - very responsive.
I had a great time at Artur's place because it is clean and comfortable and has everything you could need.

The host was very kindly! And the home was very clean and wonderful.
I had a really comfortable time here. The surrounding neighborhood is safe, too. I'd like to stay here again.

Jill's apartment is comfortable, tasteful and has most everything one needs. I was there for a three-week stay for work and am glad I booked. The pictures don't do it full justice and the garden itself offered a wonderful place for breakfast or an evening cocktail. This is a fully functioning flat and has basic utensils/appliances for self-catering (I even baked pizzas with the counter-top microwave-convection combo oven).
One caveat is that this part of London did NOT offer great cell phone signal for my international carrier (G@ogle Fi), and unfortunately Jill's wifi seemed on the fritz during much of my stay. That meant I had to go to coffee shops to work, download, upload, etc. more than I would have liked. Raynes Park is pretty convenient for that.
Perfect little studio apartment, has all the amenities. Super cozy in the cold weather. Great location, easy communication.

This apartment worked for our quick stay in London, though if we had stayed longer it might not have been the most comfortable.
