Lots to do, Lots to eat! Never a lack of things to do! Our only issue was the smell coming from the downstairs bar & the restroom. The restroom smelled at times, and the upstairs would begin to smell like cigarettes at times (which is not the fault of the Airbnb, it’s just what comes with staying in a very popular area). Overall, we were satisfied with our stay!
Great place for a visit to London. Underground is a few minutes walk and also a lot of shops and restaurants in the area.

The apartment is perfect, immaculate and spacious, can’t recommend enough. We were travelling to London to see Arsenal and the stadium could not be any closer, highly recommend to any fans travelling to the emirates. Nordine was really helpful and friendly, a brilliant host. Excellent place, 10/10.

Great self contained unit for one person for a few days!
Helen is very friendly and she also stored my luggage before the official check in time and after check out!
The room is really quite although it is directly located in Chinatown!
My stay was lovely! Jill was very responsive and kind and made sure I had everything I needed. The flat as very clean and tidy and looks as per the pictures. Thank you Jill!

Fantastic place to make our home base for our family with young kids. Very close and convenient to both bus lines and underground station. Tasty food options, pubs, and coffee all within a few minutes of walking.

The apartment was exactly like in the photos, it's modern and neatly decorated and has a private and quiet surrounding. The apartment itself is perfect with well equipped kitchen and living area. It's especially comfortable when it gets freezing cold outside.
The only downside we had was personal. We booked for a month but we didn't stay for too long due to the transportation issue. The bus stop is very near, but we found that it's an added cost if we want to take the train frequently minus the 15 minutes walking in the freezing weather. Nevertheless it was a good stay thanks to the hosts.
Great location within 10 min walk of Tower Bridge and 15 min walk to London Bridge.  Lots of restaurants near by and a cozy little pub right across the street with amazing food.
Sancha has thought of everything! We had all we needed, it was very comfortable and spotless.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would recommend it.

Flat was exactly same as at photos. We liked.
Communicating with Tay and Martina was comfortable and easy.
We found key without problems.

oh wow, where do I start! I’ve had the most wonderful weekend staying at Suzy’s place. such a beautiful space & as for Suzy, the most amazing & helpful host I’ve ever come across. I can’t wait to come back and stay again. Suzy was super helpful with recommendations & transport around the area & very welcoming. I’ve told everyone all about you Suzy & I won’t forget my first ever stay in Hackney. see you again, very soon I hope! ❤️
We had a great stay in this lovely apartment. Nearby the metro (King cross) in a nice area.

We really enjoyed staying at Marina and Tay's Airbnb. Our room was named "Happy". The location is really good. Very close to the "Bethnal Green" metro station, in addition to having a bus stop in front of the airbnb. The impeccable cleanliness as well as the structure of the place. We only had difficulty with the heater. The instruction was that it turned on and off automatically and we would only have to adjust the temperature, but some days the room got really cold even with adjusting the temperature. The floor is made of wood, so you can hear every step or noise that the guest in the room above makes.

Very unique to find an apartment on the back of building so very quiet. Great location to restaurants and shops.
Note that at the bottom of the bed is a frame so it might be an issue for tall people.
George was extremely quick to respond to any message. Overall it's a great little central place to stay.
Jose’s place was a lovely way to settle into London. He was so friendly and accommodating, highly recommend!
Fabulous stay at Miriam’s place. From the moment I booked she was totally on it with help and advice. Great area and really good value. Highly recommended!

This flat was the perfect place to stay. It was even better than the pictures. it was so homey and had everything you needed. I lived the private garden and dining atrium. The neighborhood is close to incredible shopping but on a quiet street. I willstay here again when I return to London.

Had a wonderful stay with Tina. Would absolutely book again.
No problem with the boiler noise mentioned by others.
Tina was very responsive and welcoming, including giving me some space in her kitchen to keep a bit of food. It was a very quiet and private location right near Kensington and Notting Hill. Very walkable, bikeable and lots of public transit choices available.

Located in the heart of Soho. This amazing studio apartment was perfect for two and perfectly located to get around the city! Using the tube (underground) was effortless and easy to get to from this studio. So many places on the same street to eat and grab drinks. Super diverse community, perfect for an active couple! Absolutely loved staying here!! Thank you, Tina!
Great stay - no problem with finding the place and checking in :) The place is clean, it offers everything you need for your stay, highly recommend, this is a great localization for your London trip!
Very good location on Fulham Rd in Chelsea. Thoughtful, quality decor and fit & finish. A place someone would want to live. Professional host is cheerful, polite and extremely helpful & responsive.
I am sure you cannot find a better host than Starz on Airbnb. He supports and helps as best as he can. Had an enjoyable time here

Fantastic spacious apartment close to all the attractions of Soho and the West End.
Well furnished and excellent communication from the host. I would love to stay again.
Fantastic alternative to our old hotel room. All amenities as described and the responsiveness of Nikki and Stew was great. Thx and we’d love to come back

Amanda said to make ourselves at home and that is what we did!  Very comfortable flat, exactly as pictured.  Great location close to Tube, overground and bus.   We stayed here happily for over two months.  Having a dedicated parking space was also great.

Nice, clean place to stay with a good location close to Heathrow if you drive. Big room will some nice extras like a fridge, bottled water, tea and coffee. James was friendly and always replied promptly. I would definitely stay there again

Excelent location with good commute to London in the tube, the station is within a pleasant walk. All the necessary amenities are also within the local area and therefore anything you might need will be easy to get
.

It was a wonderful place to stay :) Not to far from King’s Cross Sta. / Angel Sta. but the area was quite and peaceful!
The room was big enough for two, furnitures were neatly arranged and the bathroom was clean! They had a heated floor so it was cosy in the room :)
If the room had a handles in the shower room door, bathroom door & a handrail by the stairs, it would be more useful!
Gina welcomed us with a fruits & Prosecco! She also left a guide book about the room and there facilities, and provide recommendations of the restaurant and places to visit! Her hospitality was wonderful!!
Thanks you for a lovely stay <3
Starzeus was such an amazing host, ever ready to help, very friendly. His place felt just like home and I look forward to going back sometime soon.

Matthew has a very clean, modern, and stylish flat. I loved his taste in decor, mixing the old with the new. We had a very pleasant weeks stay. The tube station is about a five minute walk where you can catch both the Northern and Bakerloo lines. The beds are amazingly comfortable. The shower heads make for a very refreshing shower. I would stay here again.

We had a lovely time in London and in this Airbnb. The location was absolutely top, so close to everything but in a quiet street. Buckingham Palace and the Royal Parks were minutes away and we had easy access to bus and underground with Victoria Station close-by. Also there was a shopping area minutes away if we needed anything. The condo was well stocked and even though we were six people, we didn’t miss anything. The beds were super comfortable as well. Andy was so helpful re any questions we had. We highly recommend and would definitely return.
Hard to beat the location & considering it was well sound proofed. The only thing I’d say is it was really hot in the apartment. But this was good to dry washing!
5 stars for everything - the apartment couldn’t have been better. Absolutely stunning inside, very private but also just odd portobello road so it’s lovely to walk around the area.

My boyfriend and I had such a lovely stay at Kar’s studio.
It had everything we need. The kitchen and bathroom were very clean and everything looked exactly like the pictures.
Kar was super friendly and flexible with the check-in hours and made sure we had a comfortable stay.
The only minor point (but very small if you’re a vast sleeper) you can hear people walk up and down the waits during the night as well. Sometimes it’s a little too much. But for the rest, we would definitely recommend this place!
Our stay was amazing. We had a no problems with the check in and checkout and perfect communication with Tay & a Marina.

Very sweet and cozy apartment.
Great kitchen, nice bathroom, warm and quiet bedroom with great bed.
There are lot of useful staff that Amrita puts in place and we feel she's really takes care of guests.
Walkable from the railway stations.
Hope I can get back here someday.

This was a wonderful flat in an excellent location in Hammersmith, 3 minutes from a tube station!  The rooms, kitchen, and den were very nice and newly renovated.  We would definitely like to stay here again on our next trip to London.  The host was very friendly and responsive, and very helpful with recommendations and tips on the neighborhood (and there were many nice coffee shops, a wonderful French bakery with incredible croissants, and many restaurants a short walk away).  5-star place!

From the day before check in, to being able to drop bags early, to responsiveness during the stay, the host and house manager were fantastically inviting. Upon check in, the manager George gave us some great recommendations and they were accurate and fun. This rental was a small studio apartment in a building of apartments, so we had our own space, privacy and quiet patio. The street that it is located on is super safe with easy access to multiple underground stations as well as the bus line. Would highly recommend!!

Paolo’s place is very centrally located and very clean. It is enough for a small family with 3 members. George is super helpful to carry our heavy luggage up to the 3rd floor. We highly recommend this place.

Marijana was an incredible host. Super responsive and great with communication.  Very helpful when needed. Our stay was perfect. The tube station is practically across the street. Lots of food options as well. Very central to everything we wanted to see. Thank you so much!
Simon communication was always quick and helpful. The flat was big and comfortable. Location perfect so many thing to do perfect London stay in the heart of Noting Hill.

We had very easy and friendly communication with Anna. Location was convenient - be prepared to walk a while to the metro station and nearest shops. The house is big with many sleeping rooms, bathrooms and beds to accommodate big families. There is a nice garden with a veranda, making the morning coffee very nice (if it is sunny). Anne's cats had good manners and the kids enjoyed looking after them.
Josh's place was great for my visit. Easy to get to, nice and clean, and very quiet. You'd never guess you were in the middle of London.

A quiet retreat from the hustle and bustle of the big city. We enjoyed staying at Giovanna's flat during our trip to London. There's a relaxing living space to hang out in, the bed was comfortable, and though we didn't prepare any meals other than light breakfasts, she provided a well equipped kitchen, should that be what you need. The photos and listing accurately describe the space. If you have accessibility needs, there is an small elevator that will take you to the first floor flat. Conveniently located next to King's Cross train station which makes it easy to travel to other parts of London, as well as destinations outside the city.
Had a great stay with no issues at all. Orla was very friendly and proactive. She had so many tips and it felt like home.

It was an amazing stay! James is an excellent host! Made me feel so comfortable, had a nice little conversation. Room was in immaculate condition everything that I could think of was available in the room.
Thank you for hosting me James :)
This apt is so close to Covent Garden and has quick eay access to all of central London sights. it was definitely on the "cosy" side of living  - small but comfortable.

I stayed here for three weeks for a work trip and it was great. The area was safe and well-positioned for my work. The park across the street was fabulous for morning runs. There is a major grocery store a 3 minute walk from the flat. And a really great yoga studio/cafe where you can book massages and other treatments. Carolina was a lovely host. Very responsive and kind. An issue popped up (as they do from time to time) and she took care of it with a quickness. Would stay again!
James was such a wonderful host! He dealt with my excessive requests with a smile and was so helpful in whatever I needed! Highly recommend this stay.

I stayed at this Air BnB for just over a week with my family (partner and two kids) and it was perfect for us. The location is fantastic -- we loved the neighbourhood and took advantage of the local parks, restaurants and coffee shops but also loved the location for its ease of access to many different parts of London. The local station has underground and overground service, is super convenient to get to, and it's easy to get from there to all the tourist destinations. Check in was very easy with clear instructions. The flat was very clean and Amanda was extremely responsive to all our questions. The kitchen is very well equipped with anything you need and there are lots of grocery store options within walking distance. Beds comfy and the neighbourhood is lovely and quiet. All in all I would highly recommend Amanda's place to anyone looking to stay in London. I would stay there again for sure.

Very nice place to stay. Clean, Nice and cosy.
Very close to tubestation and restaurants.
I would recommend to stay there.
Mariana was very helpful and responded quickly when I had questions.
Looking forward to book with her again.
We had a very pleasant stay. Gary’s place is very clean and everything organised well. Gary is very responsive to my immediate doubts. Highly recommended stay.

We had such a lovely stay!
Looks exactly like the pictures, was clean, super easy to find and the host seemed really lovely and helped however they could.
The location was also perfect with the Crossharbour DLR and a Tesco express being just over the road!
Thank you so much for our stay :)

We stayed at Susan’s place on our family trip to London. We had a wonderful time in their charming and homely house. Susan’s son Ewan took care of the communication. He was very helpful and always quick to answer. The house itself is more charming than you expect from the pictures, and a place were you really relax and feel at home. You will find charming pubs, excellent restaurants and breakfast places just a short walk away. There are also bus stops with buses going to downtown just a block away. Wholeheartedly recommend this place.

Would definitely use this place again,I was up at the oval watching cricket, the accommodation was about 15 minute walk,so was ideal.The house was gated off from the main road so felt very safe ,was very happy with price and accommodation.

Everything went as per expected and the stay was comfortable. The shared kitchen allowed us to meet with other guests staying in the same apartment from other floors and had wonderful conversations sharing experience and recommendations with. The location was great with the bus stop right in front of the apartment's doorstep as well, making it convenient to come home to after a long day out.

All three of us very much enjoyed our stay here. We liked the area too. Lovely cafes and restaurants around and shop only 30seconds away to get bits if you needed to. Perfect place for visiting London. It was clean and safe, and George downstairs was extremely helpful. Nothing seemed to be a trouble for him.
D.

✅Positive: The place was perfect as a family of four, because we only slept and ate breakfast there. Its quite tiny but not uncomfortably tiny, we were actually abel to eat breakfast comfortably with six people when my brother visited. Everything was easy to find and manage, also the apartment is very close to groceryshops and some restaurants. Underground was very close and so were the other tourist attractions were also in walkable leghts.
❌Negative: Kitchen was fully stocked, only thing we were missing was the coffee machine or a pot, there is a kettle. The biggest con was that the showers drain was clogged and when you finished your shower your feet were in the water like a bath. The other con was that you couldn’t sleep in the bedroom some nights because the neighbours were having parties.
IN CONCLUSION very nice place and would recommend for a friend. Hope to come see London soon again!

Kar is very good host . Kar gives us very quick response always. His property placed near super markets. Its very convenient for foods and transportation. I like so much.
Thanks kar
Waheguru mehr kare ( god bless you )

This is a lovely 1 bet flat equipped with everything you need. A perfect location in central London for going to the theatres and shops etc.
The host was very helpful and arranged a early bag drop off for us so we could move freely around London before check in.
Flat was quiet for central London and idea for our trip. Would definitely book again for another trip to the theatre.
Many thanks for having us !

I would thoroughly recommend Carey’s lovely flat. Carey has been the most incredible host- incredibly kind and understanding when our plans changed. The flat is well positioned and has everything you need. Carey is such a fun and interesting host and it was lovely to get to know herd and met lovely dogs. Super place, highly recommend and we will be back
Kar was super responsive, the place was clean and tidy while the location is fairly convenient and close to Portobello area
We had a great stay at James’s family home. The house was super clean and it felt really cosy, we had very clear instructions and stayed for both remote work and more chill time. Would recommend 100%

This location is great and close to several underground stations.  Bed were very comfortable and firm (both in the main bedroom and sofa bed).  Very clean and friendly and responsive host.  Thank you hosting us!

Had some issues with communication in regards to check-in and late responses. Other than that, the place was great and clean. The location is close to the bus stop as well as the underground station, and there are plenty of restaurants nearby. Overall, we had a good stay.
It was a cold period, the place received no sun to warm up, and no information about the heating...wich is very poor. Otherwise no problems.

We loved our stay at Joanna's place! It was exactly what we needed: a nice, clean and comfortable spot in a centric location. We walked to many places from there and had great dining options nearby. Highly recommended!

Anne provided us a nice place to land in London and recover from jet lag. She recommended great restaurants just a few minutes walk away. With beautiful Battersea Park right down the street it was a relaxing spot to get some rest and a walk or two.
Fantastic location, Joseph was extremely helpful and quick responses. Great stay for an overnight so close to Camden Market and the Kings Cross station!
Nice place. I found it a bit hot at night (I think they leave the heating on all the time), and so found it a bit difficult to sleep, but otherwise great
Beautiful spacious and comfortable house. Very well equipped.  Lovely location with great selection of restaurants and small shops within walking distance.

My wife and I stayed here the weekend we ran the marathon. Really lovely location, lots to do and very walkable to nearby cafes, park, stations, etc. Joanna was an amazing host. Very good communication and was flexible with us being able to drop off luggage early and leave it after. Would definitely recommend this place for your stay. We hope to return soon!

Lin's place is a beautiful condo in a beautiful area. It is right across from the water, a one minute walk to a Tesco and a two minute walk to the train station. There are also several restaurants very close by. This is great for someone looking for a nice and quiet place. It is in a very nice, quiet, safe and quite upscale area.
Lin was a great host. She was very responsive and really went beyond her duties as a host. She quickly replied to my messages and was very helpful.
I booked the place for my friend and she had a really good stay. Everything was easy and well organised. We would recommend the place. Big thanks to Jill for all her help.
A cozy spot near many beautiful parks, tasty restaurants, and tourist attractions. Appreciated the responsive host as well when we had questions.

Good location, few minutes walk to underground and overground stations. LIDL nearby, convenient for cooking in the flat. Of course there are many restaurants and 15 minutes walk to Westfield Shopping Mall. Monica is quite hospitality and help me a lot. The most impressive is I met squirrels in the garden of the flat, they are so cute. Nice stay in London.

Rosemary was the epitome of an excellent host. I cannot recommend this place highly enough. It is a 12 minute walk from the Kew Gardens tube stop, and very safe even late at night. It is 10 minutes away from beautiful pubs and coffee shops. The kitchen, (newly renovated!!) bathroom, cozy bedroom, and spacious living room make this place a home away from home. We cooked food almost every night and always looked forward to coming back. If you're looking for a place that can access London easily, is safe and homey, and has beautiful places all around it, look no further. I would come back and stay at this same place again and again!!!!!
Christelle’s place was perfect for what we needed! The location couldn’t have been better,  and the communication was great! We will be back!

Sergio was very helpful with check in and accommodating our early arrival flight. Sergio was always very quick to respond. The place was exactly as described and is great for parents and kids. About a 10 min walk to the Old Town tube station. The Islington neighborhood was calm (for London) and felt safe. Lots of restaurants within walking distance or to get delivery from. All in all a great place to stay for a trip to central London.

What a GREAT location to stay!!! The place was nice and quaint and very clean. The host was very good with communication and ensured that I arrived to the place safely as well as checked to see how our stay was going. In addition, the host provided recommendations on restaurants, transportation, groceries and other things which made our stay very easy and not stressful with this trip being our first time to London!!! I would DEFINITELY stay at this location again on my next trip 😊😊
Great location. Easy to get to from the train station and a great area to be based from in London
The place is in a great location in the centre of London but still quite and private. The kitchen and bathroom is well equipped, bedrooms are comfortable. We had a great time.

It was a clean and friendly place in a peaceful neighborhood.
Transportation services are nearby.
We had an amazing trip, will stay here again
if given the chance.

The pictures of Tara’s place do not do it justice.  The house is gorgeous!  It’s well stocked and beautifully decorated.  Tara is a very responsive host.  The surrounding area has a beautiful park, restaurants & shopping.  I highly recommend it.

Accessing the apartment was really simple and the location was great, literally a 5 minute walk to the overground.
Rafaa responded to any questions I had pretty quickly
The apartment was clean, just a little more compact than expected, great for 1-2 people, we were a little cramped with 3 but it is manageable.
Would definitely stay here again when visiting London, it’s a great price
This was a really brilliant family home with all the amenities you could need, including toys and a trampoline to entertain children

This is really an excellent appartment with fantastic location! The appartment has two bedrooms, two spacious bathrooms, a nice livingroom/kitchen area+ a huge balcony. The double beds are very comfortable.
The location is next to the river Thames and just a few minutes walk to the Elizabeth line railway station and to the Uberboat pier. There´s a easy connection to Heathrow airport with the Elizabeth line without any train changes and it takes only about 20 minutes to downtown London. There are plenty of shops, pubs and a nice caffeteria quite close to this appartment, all in all great location!
Daniel was a very responsive host, we got quick answers to all our questions.

Fabulous stay in a great Airbnb. Lovely and clean with all mod cons.
Would recommend
Convenient location to Underground and restaurants. 52 steps to fourth floor was a bit inconvenient for us seniors but was not too bad.
We had a good stay at Branca’s place, it was very well located close to cafes, restaurants and public transport. Branca is very responsive and the place is as described.

We had a wonderful stay at Jenny’s place. Looks exactly like the pictures, so bright and cozy. Close enough to everything, but not in the hectic part of London. There are cute little restaurants in walking distance as well as a little shop that sells all the essentials right across the street. The tube station is a five minute walk, and there is a bus stop almost right outside the door.  It was a nice peaceful retreat to come back to after long days of sightseeing. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay for our first trip to London.

I had a lovely time staying here. The flat is modern, clean, and well equipped, with a nice view of the canal and the Shard too. Mike is a great host, he communicates well and responds to messages quickly, and the check in and check out process was smooth. The area is quiet, and right on the canal which is great for walks. It's also in walking distance to Canary Wharf, and it's easy to travel into the city. I would definitely recommend staying here, and look forward to returning soon.

Evelyn was a great host, being very kind, helpful and informative!
Everything was as described, and I can see why the other guests gave such good reviews!
I will definitely recommend this accommodation to anyone who's looking for a peaceful and relaxing stay!
I've stayed here on many occasions and always feel right at home. I love the vibrancy of Soho. Totally recommend.
4 stars just because I can’t do 4.5 as the shower wasn’t working but everything else was amazing. So thank you for the stay and will definitely stay there again soon

Very clean and convenient to Underground stations. Easily walkable neighborhood with lots of food and beverage choices. Small grocery right up the street to get supplies for our stay.) Paolo was very responsive and quick to respond to questions. George the Concierge was very helpful, friendly, and accommodating. He gave us lots of great recommendations.

We have recently returned from a fabulous stay at Jaquas lovely farm house. The house was large with a beautiful garden. The conservatory was a big hit for us with its own fridge and cocktail making area - where we prepared drinks and danced the night away celebrating my sisters hen do! Jaqua was a great host, meeting us on arrival to show us around. Would recommend this property for large groups wanting to spend time together!
Very good host and everything was clean. They only thing that was a bit far from city centre and metro station.

Nice apartment with everything u need.
The mattress on the guest couch is not comfy. But the rest is nice for a few days in London.
This place is super cute and looks just like the photos. It’s spacious and really clean. Natalie was a great host and sent through clear instructions. I would definitely book again.

Very central location, close to just about everything. It was a really convenient place to stay. Spotless and clean, and ideal for a short trip. I found the bed a tad uncomfortable; an old memory foam mattress sagging in the middle (and I’m pretty light) and I couldn’t get the TV to work. Other than that everything was as described and despite being right in the middle of Chinatown there wasn’t much noise.
Really happy about our stay at Lin's place! It's right next to the river, very private and safe location. Very close to the center too! Can definitely recommend to anyone who is coming to London :)
We really enjoyed staying here. The flat is beautiful, modern, and clean. The host is very friendly and easy to communicate with! I totally recommend the place.

Everything okay, especially the host.
I’ll choose another time this place for another trip in London.
You can find public transport that help you to reach every place, only with 5 minutes walk.
The house was very clean and comfortable.  The kitchen was well equipped and everything worked.  There is no TV but it was relaxing to read books!

Great lovely Host, helped us with directions and gave us local recommendations, lovely place had all the facilities u would need. He let us check in early and didn’t rush as which was a very lovely gesture. Definitely coming back :)
Really enjoyed my stay here. I appreciated the little touches and tasteful decor. The suite was very modern and as pictured. I will definitely be booking here again!
A perfect homebase for a trip to London - everything was so accessible and convenient! I would definitely stay again.

Shelly's place was as described. It was a cozy and calm place but still close enough to the city by bus and tube. Clean and well decorated.
Shelly was very helpful and accommodating. We really appreciated our host and our stay!

Great place to stay for a night or two in London! Good location and pretty much all of the necessary amenities.  Wi-fi would have been nice to have, but we knew ahead of time it wouldn't, so that wasn't a suprise. Overall, I'd recommend it!
Peter’s place was just as advertised and he met us when we arrived to go over everything. Perfect for our stay in London. The tube station was a short walk and the best way to get around London.

We spent a week at Sophie’s place and had an amazing time. The place is so quiet and really lovely, near stores and some cafés and a little less than a 10 minutes walk from the subway station. Everything was clean, and Sophie responded really quickly to all of our questions. It’s truly a perfect place if you want to spend some time visiting London !

Nada is a generous and helpful host. Her home is lovely and well appointed. Her sun-lit flat has well stocked kitchens and clean bathrooms and has a spacious master bedroom. Overall we loved our stay and would certainly recommend.

Great location near Buckingham Palace and Victoria Station, yet on a very quiet street.  The home was equipped with everything we needed.  Andy was very responsive to our inquiries and requests.  Thanks for a great stay!

we had a great stay
hosts were very easy to communicate with and very responsive
location was easy walking distance to baker st station with many underground lines at that station
as well as easy walk to regents park
the space was very clean and beds very comfortable
welcome food/drink kit much appreciated after a red eye from overseas
host was also great with accomidating us for early arrival to check in and show us all we needed to know about the flat
bathroom areas are very tight but water pressure was great in the shower
would for sure recommend
Great location and amazing hosts. This is a great place to stay for a short or extended visit. Highly recommended!

Thanks Sanya! We had a great visit. This flat is in an extremely great location with easy access to 3-4 tube stops. The Elizabeth Line Tottenham station is 4 blocks north and provides a fast/lower cost alternative from Heathrow. Perfect place if you are on the go in Central London. I will be back in the fall!
Would highly recommend.   Tamara was very responsive.  The place was clean. We had everything we needed.
Easy check in and checkout. Apartment as it is described. Near the Tube. Delivered what was promised. I would stay there again.

This stay was absolutely wonderful! You can really tell that the owners spend their time caring about this place and making it feel homey.
When we arrived, the instructions of getting our key were very clear and straight forward so we didn’t have any issues. It felt like we were there alone since we barely heard anyone and we never had to wait for the bathroom since there were two (unusual for shared bathroom accommodation).
Everything was labeled, we had our designated spaces in the kitchen and it was all very clean and tidy. Even though it’s by a main street we didn’t have an issue with the noise or anything. There was also a shared terrace which was very cute, we loved having our coffee there and sitting in the sun💕
We definitely recommend this place for anyone who wants to stay in London and avoid the high prices of central London👌🏻
was a lovely stay! comfortable bed and nice hot shower, not to mention being so close to the underground meant it was so easy to get around anywhere in the city!
It was my first stay at Anne's and I really enjoyed my stay. She is really friendly and helpful. I will miss playing with Codie(Anne'sdog). Whenever I am in London again, I will be staying here.

All amenities were as mentioned in the description. Also extra care was taken to provide extra towels, beddings and toiletries. Sqeaky clean place, well maintained and beautifully arranged. The alleyway leading to the apartment may seem desolate, but the flat totally is worth the price and the alleyway is of less concern. Will definitely recommend Uri’s place

A tidy, well-organized place on a quiet street with so many great restaurants close by (great coffee just two doors down), and an easy walk to public transit options. You can easily walk to places like Oxford Street, the BBC building, Regent's Park, and get almost anywhere from the Oxford Circus or Goodge Street Underground stations nearby. A really great home base for exploring London.
Raul and Carol’s apartment is very easy well located and easy to get to. Newly redone with all of the modern amenities you could want, and great style.

I had a wonderful stay! The room was incredibly comfortable, providing a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. Jadin was exceptionally kind and friendly, making me feel right at home. I truly enjoyed my time there and would highly recommend this accommodation to others.
The flat was clean and the host was very accommodating. Wish there was a lift to reach the flat, but other than that they are very attentive and helpful hosts!
Very easy to check in and host was responsive! It’s in a residential area and about 10 minutes to the tube station. Easy to walk to just important to note if you have a suitcase.
A beautiful, stylish, modern place with a very responsive and friendly host. Just like in the photos and well worth a short or a long-term stay. Thumbs up!
Easy walk to underground. Spacious. Away from tourist area so was not flooded with people. The neighborhood had a more local vibe. Everything was lovely.

Thank you so much Hien, your place exceed all of our expectations! The garden was perfect as was the living area for our family! We had a few issues with the upstairs shower but Hien was so quick and responsive to sort the issue!
There was a coop just down the road which was great too.
Thank you very much Hien!

We had a nice stay at Mo's. The accommodation was as in the photos. The bathroom was clean. Although we were not alone in the house and shared the bathroom with others, we still had our privacy. The Airbnb is super located and we were everywhere quickly. The small supermarket across the street was great for buying drinks and snacks.
Would recommend this place!

This is one of the best air bnbs that I’ve ever stayed in! Highly recommend staying here for multiple reasons: the central location is heaven for reaching all parts of london; despite being in the center, this street is quiet; the apartment building has a lift and the apartment itself is spacious with tons of natural light; Lynn is an excellent communicator and helps above and beyond; and we loved the streamlined and clean aesthetic of the apartment! Would definitely stay here again!! And also we traveled with our toddler and the extra/second bedroom was perfect for her.

My stay at Christian's place was amazing. I stayed for a long time and even though the apartment hosted other people the room was quiet, warm and calm. The usage of shared rooms like kitchen and bathroom was easy too as the other guests were very respectful.

Marc provided great instructions to the place and how to get there via public transportation.
Unfortunately when we got inside the place was underwhelming and the photos didn’t align with what we got. There were marks on the kitchen counter and floor, a leaking shower, small holes/cracks through the walls, the exhaust fan didn’t work and neither did the lights in the toilet. The place feels like it needs a thorough clean and refresh.
Great place, near kings cross station. Quiet and lots of things to do around. Great communication and easy to access.

Great place to stay in a really nice area! A bit far from the centre to walk (unless you want to enjoy the walk itself), but excellent connections basically right outside the door. We are super happy with our stay! 😊
The apartment was great. The location was very central and easy to walk to many major sites. The  apartment was spacious, beautifully decorated and well stocked. Will definitely stay here again.
The location of the apartment is very good. It is very close to bus stops and metro stations.  There are many things for a family stay in the apartment, it is comfortable and pleasant …
Shoreditch is an amazing area and so was Branca’s apartment - it had everything essential to “crash in” for a couple of days. Cute and clean. Recommended!

Suzy’s place was perfect! The room is absolutely lovely (quite a large space with lots of natural light), and Suzy is a great host. She went above and beyond with recommendations for the area and was so helpful and kind. I highly recommend staying with her!
A beautiful flat in a great location with a great host! Would recommend and would absolutely stay again!

Carolyn was an absolute pleasure and even allowed us to check in quite early so we could immediately start sight seeing without having to drag our luggage around. She was very communicative and offered many tips to ensure we had a great visit! Would definitely recommend to anyone considering a vacation to London.

Great neighborhood, beautiful apartment!  Very quiet at night, super clean, and very well stocked with toiletries, soap etc.  Multiple tube stations within 10 minutes walk, including new Elizabeth line that goes directly to Heathrow - very convenient! George, who was there to let us in, is super friendly and helpful.  Highest recommendation!

Been multiple times to London but this was the most enjoyable one. Place was spacious, calm and felt homey. Quite easy to reach my favorite places from there as well.
Robin the host was helpful & responsive.
It’s a regular business trip so may come back again next year.
Lovely lady Everything was neat and tidy and clean. The room was quite small but was all we needed.

Staying within Cara was such a lovely experience. I had to make some last-minute changes to my accommodation plans, due to personal reasons. Upon first communications, she was understanding and welcoming.
She planned check-in around when I was free to get in, and gave me a lovely tour of the house and offer commodities throughout the stay. The photos match the apartment, and is an amazing location if you have any events to attend near the O2 Arena, ExCel centre or fancy a nice getaway in a lovely scenery with views of the city and the waterfront.
As her first ever guest, I was honour to be given the chance and will keep this location saved for any future events within the area I may attend within the area. 5 out of 5 stars, keep being amazing Cara =D

Anna was such a great host, she was super communicative; reaching out before and throughout the stay! She  was accommodating and allowed us to leave our luggages at the airbnb prior to check in and was also willing to let us store it after check out too. It was a fantastic stay, everything was super accessible and had everything we needed with extra towels and toilet paper.

This flat in Camden Town was a great set up for our family of 2 adults and 2 kids. It is one of the few listings I could find in our price range with space for 4 people in 2 bedrooms rather than a bedroom and sofa bed.
It is a short distance away from Camden High Street, which made it a little quieter and more private. Bus and train access are nearby, and walking along the canal was a fun afternoon outing for us.
Tim and Miriam were incredibly responsive throughout the booking and trip planning process, and they provided resources like restaurant recommendations, and even babysitter recommendations. We were too tired at the end of every day to actually use a babysitter to go out, but it was nice to have the information.
Overall, this was a great place to stay for our kids' first London visit.

The apartment was really good. Close to both station and Straford Center with plenty of shops. Good wifi. Good bed. Coach was ok. Not far from central London. Well equipped kitchen. I would come back anytime.

We had a really nice stay at Jorge’s place. The flat is perfectly located, quiet and nicely decorated. Nice cat too.
We had really easy communications with Jorge and he was very flexible. Thank you!

Mingshu is a friendly and amazing host who warmly welcomed me into her beautiful home. I felt really comfortable throughout my stay and felt right at home immediately. The room I stayed in was beautiful and I could not ask for anything more. Though I only stayed for one night, I really wished I could've stayed there longer because Mingshu and her friend were so sweet and kind, and I loved how cosy the home was. Would definitely recommend and stay there again next time!
James place was fab for me and my friends to stay on our visit to London, a home away from home :)

Tina is very nice, the apartment is clean and very well located, just by notting hill tube station. I would change the mattress as it is worn out on the right side and put blinders on the window as in the morning there is a lot of light coming through the curtains.
Overall a nice stay!

We had a lovely stay at VanZyl’s place. It is located in a very decent neighbourhood, easy to check in and out, very clean and well furnished place. It had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable.
We were allowed to store our bags for a bit after checkout time and that really helped. We would definitely be booking this place again on future trips if available. Thanks for hosting us.

Akmal was a super host who took care of our short stay to the fullest. The accommodation was close enough to the central London by walk and was super close to underground. The area was safe and the apartment was clean. Not a single bad thing to say. Thanks.
Booked the place based on location to St Pancras station. Was ok for one night, but I would not stay there again.
Great apartment! Super clean. Had everything you’d need. Within walking distance to lots of restaurants and shopping. Nikki and Stew were always quick to respond. Would stay here again.

Anna's place was nicely located right by Hyde Park. However we were not aware this would be a basement unit. Besides that it was nice, make sire to contact her beforehand if you need anything such as Linens.
We enjoyed our stay at Kar’s place! Everything was great, aside from the noisy neighbourhood, but if you’re used to the noise, you should be fine
We loved everything about this space: the location, living space, kitchen, and comfy bed! We'd love to stay here again sometime!

This was my second time renting through Paolo, and this experience was just as good as my first. I have no complaints and will definitely rent one of Paolo’s properties again when I return to London in the future.
Peter was a great host. The flat is spacious and light, unusual for London. We enjoyed the Thames walk and proximity to Kings Road. Highly recommended.

This room was good for the price! Not directly in the city centre but very easy to reach via train. Herman was very responsive and the check-in process was easy thanks to the pictures he provided outlining the process. My only qualm is the common were a little dirty. Specifically the bathroom did have some mould in it. However, despite that small issue the stay was great!

Had a very pleasant stay.
The most superb accommodation way better than travelodge or premier inn at that price.
Great location, clean, well equipped house.
Uri was very responsive host. Will come back again surely.
nice place far in the east of London. Quite cheap for London, but also nothing Special. one Bed is a sleeping Couch and it Tends to be noisy as the flat ist located directly over a small shop
Nice place that was very close to metro station, but the only problem I had was the shower only had hot steaming water it was impossible to shower in

Very convenient location with everything you need. Excellent communication, would definitely come again.
Thanks for a great stay.

Great location with really easy access to restaurants and awesome bakery. Plenty of space and the place looked almost brand new. Be ware it’s a lot of step’s especially if u have luggage.   We went with family of 4 so plenty of space for all of us.
Warm and welcoming family home in a great location at a very reasonable price. James is the perfect host! Would definitely stay again if the opportunity arose.

It was a great place to stay for us to stay as an extended family of 9 attending Lords cricket ground as the bus route is great. Guru is lovely, very friendly and helpful. This was a return visit and just as good as last year!  Thank you so much.
Perfect accommodation if you want to be in the very heart of Soho to enjoy everything it has the offer, the restaurants, theatre and nightlife.

Nice stay in Camden Town, the apartment is cozy and nice and James is a nice host.
Little alert for tall people - I am 1.95 - the apartment is a bit low and the couch is pretty short, so consider this if you are a group of tall people.
Other than that 100% recommended if you want to experience Camden and London!

We were hosting a large family gathering in Enfield, with people travelling from far and wide.  This accommodation was perfect for our needs to accommodate family members, who told us they were very comfortable and slept well at the apartment.
Kelly's place is lovely and bright. it was the perfect location for us to meet up with our daughter who lives nearby. we enjoyed our stay.
It's is a very beautiful place to have a party. We really enjoyed their.we loved to go back

Rosemary’s house is beautiful, everything you need as a couple, bathroom is amazing, love the mirror with speaker !
We didn’t use the kitchen but it has everything you need to cook up a lovely dinner. Backyard is big, bedroom cosy, and great living room, 8-10 minute walk to Kew Gardens overground station. Lots of great coffee locally. I especially liked Gail’s bakery.
Would definitely stay again.
Very comfortable , modern, quiet and well located apartment. Matt's communication was excellent. Highly recommended.

Superb house, would 100% recommend! Excellent quality finishes, comfy beds, surprisingly soundproof, spacious living and dining areas & more than enough space for 12 adults for a long weekend. Hein was very accommodating when booking, and helpful when we had a small issue opening the front door on arrival. Favourite aspect of the property was the close proximity to the train station- perfect to explore the city only a 30 minute train journey away from Leicester Square!

We really enjoyed our stay in Alistair's flat, which we found reasonably spacious and well-decorated. He was very responsive when we had questions and gave clear instructions on how to get in. If you're looking to stay outside of the most touristy parts of London, but still be (long) walkable to them and very close to the Tube, this is a great option.
We had a wonderful long stay in Katherines lovely place. We felt very safe and enjoyed the flat and area. The area us absolutely amazing with Belsize Park and Hampstead Heath just around the corner.
Everything was perfect. In the apartment there was everything we needed, including dishes, spices, towels etc. The flat is nice and comfortable, and it’s quite big.
Great communication and since we got in earlier than expected she let us check in earlier! Place is clean and close to metro which was so convenient.

Dear Simon and Hugh, thank you for hosting us! We had a very comfortable stay. The house was cosy, clean, well equipped, in a quiet neighbourhood yet convenient with shops just outside and it’s very close to town. Simon’s been very responsive and has been super helpful! We had a wonderful stay and we would highly recommend to others visiting London too!
We have stayed at Katherines previously as the location suits us. The flat is always well presented and her communication is fantastic. We would stay again.

Clare’s place is such a wonderful flat. Great location and felt just like home. Clare was super responsive and had left us with clear instructions and great local recommendations. Would highly recommend this listing. Clapham junction is just a 10 minute walk and the location has plenty of great restaurants and grocery stores. Overall a very enjoyable experience and would visit again.

I had the loveliest stay. The apartment is very charming and not only looked like the photos but was actually better in person. The kitchen and bathroom were pristine and the bed was very comfortable. Excellent light and the neighborhood was perfect. There were so many restaurants, cafes, gelaterias, and even a wonderful movie theater all just seconds away. Raul & Carol were very responsive and tremendously attentive when I had questions. I have stayed at their other properties and they are really fantastic. I would stay here again.
My family and I had a wonderful stay at Hugh’s apartment. It was so clean and lots of space for everyone. Would definitely stay here again!
Paolos page was wonderful! In a safe nice quiet neighborhood about 5 minutes from the hustle and bustle of soho. Flat was clean, comfortable, and paolo was very accommodating!

Uri’s place was clean with comfortable beds and a large bathroom. Uri is super responsive and accommodating. You need to take the bus a few stop or walk about 20mins to get to the subway stop, but this was a minor inconvenience. Overall a lovely stay!

A great location between London and tower bridge. Super functional and practical for a family trip with one queen and two single beds.  Awesome local bars and restaurants as well as supermarkets nearby. The building looks run down but the listing itself was nice and offered everything needed.
Location was ideal for our family of 5. It was convenient to the Underground stations that took us everywhere we wanted to go. And Ana was great at communicating with us.

i enjoyed my small stay.. the place was neat and cozy..
as the house is old, the floor squeaked a lot when the guest in the other room was walking, which woke me up at 4 in the morning :D..
This was a great stay. Tons of space and very central location! Marijana was very accommodating and let me check in a little early!

Great host and a great place aswell in a wicked location.
Gina even agreed to let me stay later for a small fee as my flight on check out day was late at night. Was much appreciated!
Great experience all round

Beautiful overall but there were some things I noticed could’ve been cleaned a little better in the bathroom . Also the apt is on the 3rd floor . A lot of stairs so be prepared if you have a large suitcase

Robin was the most responsive AirBNB host I've ever met... and that includes me! He's a very kind and helpful guy and the space was as advertised. From a price to value perspective I can't believe you could get a better deal. It was just me, but it could comfortably fit more guests. Highly recommend!
What a wonderful place to stay!  This apartment has the most modern amenities I've seen in an Airbnb, and Matt did a wonderful job of communicating.  Top notch!

Beautiful studio with a fantastic garden, you will wake in the morning with the song of the birds. Nice neighborhood, quiet, walking distance form tube, markets, some restaurants. Also very close to the Wimbledon common, a fantastic park for walking and jogging and if you are going to watch some matches at the Championships you can go on foot also. Denise is very kind, always willing to help and make your stay more comfortable.

Thanks for you hospitality and friendly approach.
We had a great stay and would recommend your house to anyone who wishes to stay there

AirBnB but w hotel hospitality. Center of Soho.
Highly recommend. Would stay again.

We enjoyed our stay at the apt, it was well appointed, clean, spacious and stylish. It was a great location for what we wanted. We stayed on a Saturday and Sunday night, the Saturday was very noisy on the street below our window which went on most of the night however it was very quite on the sunday night. Overall we had a great stay.
Very nice and clean place to stay. Super easy walk to the closest tube station and bus stop right outside the  front door. Highly recommend

A friend and I were meeting in London for a long weekend stay and this place was in a perfect location to get to so many places shortly. The block was nice and quiet but had several restaurants around and a grocery store right up the block which was very convenient. The train station was within a 5 minute walk where we went to several market places to shop, eat,  and explore, including the Camden market. Sandra’s co-host came immediately as I arrived to the place to bring the keys and show me around the place and how to use all essentials. He was very friendly and informative. There was also a Dyson air conditioner that really helped keep the room cool as it was a very hot weekend. Check out was extremely easy as well.
Enjoyed my stay at Jorge’s. Nice and quiet neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. The cat was chill and didn’t cause any trouble. Would stay here again.

Shlome was so helpful every step of the way throughout my stay. Super quick at replying to any questions I had and so friendly! The apartment was very clean and well presented, and I will definitely be coming back!

Great location and very responsive hosts! Small space but perfect for our quick one night with three guests. Location is truly everything about this place - the neighborhood has lovely shops and restaurants and just a short walk to the hustle and bustle of central London. George is on-site and was very responsive. Great choice!

Denise’s place was excellent! It’s bright, spacious, and has a retreat-like vibe to it with a gorgeous view of the massive backyard. Denise was a wonderful host—communicative and very thoughtful. Everything was great about the place, including nice touches like milk (of our choice), cereal and fruit and nice hand soap and lotion etc. Bed was comfy and the wifi was great as we needed to work online for a couple of hours. The Wimbledon tennis courts are literally around the corner and there are nice cafes and places to eat within walking distance from the studio. The studio is a 15-min walk from the train station, but there are several bus stops right next to the studio that will take you to the station or to Wimbledon village. Uber is a good option too—ours arrived in 0 mins after booking. We highly recommend Denise’s place and will definitely stay here again!
Great location and nice place. Only issues is no ac (gets very hot) and very poor Wi-Fi signal

Great location right next to Portobello road and nearby tube station. Plenty of room for 3 people with great storage space in the closet. Bed was very comfortable. It was an unusually warm week in London so glad there was a fan to use in the bedroom. Host was very responsive and accommodated a late checkout. Overall a great stay!

This place is great place for catching public transport, and has pretty good food places near by! I had a great time staying here! However I’m pretty sure there are four flights of stairs and not three. The place was clean and great for two people
The Beds were very uncomfortable and hard, tried sleeping on couch but the couch needs a good cleaning.
Exactly as described, clean and perfect for a short stay. Noisy area but ear plugs provided which were great! I would definitely recommend this stay. Thanks both!

Lovely apartment, very clean and well decorated. Giulia was super friendly. Easy to get to from the centre of London.
I would happily stay again :)

Great location! Very clean with good shower. Close to transit and very walkable. Good security , we felt very safe. There are a lot of stairs so if you have mobility issues be sure to ask questions to see if the suite is suitable . Overall a super place.
Lawrence and Otto
Gary and Bianca’s place was great! They always responded extremely fast if I had any questions and Croydon has a lot of great food and activities to do!

Goo’s place is superb - exceeded expectations, it’s decorated to a high standard with attention to detail, in every aspect
It’s the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in
Bedrooms are huge with two bathrooms
It is just so peaceful despite being in the throng of the city
So easy to get around London but perfect for escape from the hustle and bustle of London
The decor is stunning, the beds super comfy, linens immaculate
Attention to detail - coffee pods, range of teas, sugar, honey, olive oil salt and pepper
Easy access to the apartment with a lift to transport our luggage
This place is an absolute find
Thank you
Can’t say enough about Jennifer’s place. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four. Loved everything about the flat and the neighborhood. Will definitely try to go back again!

Great position, just a few minutes away from the underground. The room is in a shared house and matches the photos. Good value for money, the price is quite convenient — in terms of quality you get what you pay for. Could be cleaner though

The apartment was lovely, exactly as described. Amanda sent through lots of recommendations for things to do around the area. We stayed here for a week and is close to the tube station which takes you both to wembley stadium and into london. Beautiful apartment in a lovely quiet area.
We had a wonderful stay! Close to trains and buses, very easy to see all of London and come home to a quiet area
I'd recommand it despite the issues I mentioned. It's close to one of the largest malls in London Westfield, the neighbourhood is not the best but quite familiar.

The flat was in a good location, close to two stations, easy access, a valuable parking space and Clare is a very friendly helpful host. Lovely sunny lounge room with shutters, the outdoor area we found very difficult to access and needs some attention. Quite a number of restaurants, taverns within close walking distance and very close to Clapham Common.
Most convenient place to be if you are travelling for work. The place is quite, comfortable and well connected. The host was very cooperative.

Paolo’s place was perfect location in soho.  Walkable to everything.  He has an on-site manager George who was there to greet us.  Only negative if any is no a/c, which normal in lots of flats in London.  Needs fans in every room and it would help.  But that was minor.  Thanks for great trip.
walking back from east croydon railway station to the appartment late at night is not a good idea. we did not feel safe. But the taxi was a good alternative and only about £9.
Loula was really nice, her place is clean and tidy. The flat is really well connected (underground, dlr and buses)

We loved Harriet’s little house in Hackney. The pictures really depicted the house. We asked to check in early because we were arriving on an international flight and Harriet was very accommodating. Harriet was also really prompt answering any questions we had. The house was really clean and really well supplied with dishes etc!  We loved it. The backyard was perfect for a glass of wine!  We wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

An amazing location in walking distance to great pubs, cafes, shopping & easy transport into London. Kathy’s place felt like a real home away from home, including sweet treats on arrival. A sweet backyard and lovely kitchen/living space for the whole family to enjoy. We would happily stay again in this charming home.

Our family of four had a wonderful stay at Tracy's!  The place was larger than the pictures convey, which was a pleasant surprise. Our teens were very comfortable on the pull-out sofa, and the second bedroom. The location was great - under 5 min to walk to the Bethnal Green metro, and multiple bus routes to choose from. We also ordered excellent carryout from a Thai place right up the block.
Fantastic location! Super comfortable and roomy flat.   Vas was a fantastic and gracious host.   Absolutely loved our stay, location was ideal for us and super convenient.

We had a great time, everything was as described. The place is very easy to find, we had very clear instructions on how to get in and stuff. Clean, cozy, and extremely pretty overall, and I wish we would have stayed longer.

Great Place BUT not ideal for tall people as the second room had a sloping ceiling under the bed and the bathroom.
great for 2 couples.
The house was so lovely and Sandra was really welcoming! The facilities were clean and great to use, and the room I was in was extremely comfortable and had everything I needed! A great stay! :)

Helen’s place was fantastic. Great location and steps away from public transportation. She was very responsive and communicated well. She was also flexible in allowing me to store my luggage after checking out, great host!

Had a great stay at Heydon’s place! Great location, comfortable room with nice lighting and a beautifully decorated apartment. Heydon was a great host who was flexible with check in and great at communicating throughout.
Highly recommend for a solo traveller!

Kristy's place was great and she was a wonderful communicator, both at checkin and with questions during the stay.
The bus stop right outside was very convenient as well.
Perfect for the 4 of us for 2 weeks!
Tina’s place in Soho is very cool and at the heart of nightlife in the area. The place was spotless, comfortable and easy access to countless restaurants and activities.
Easy entrance, nice and clean. But was too hot inside without any alternative. Leaking from bathroom down to living room. Not good curtains, too bright at morning.

Exactly as described. Pristine sparkling clean. Safe working class friendly neighborhood.
1/3m to N Bromley station but the S Bromley station is a .7 miles walk and is more practical (and a fun walk through the pedestrian shopping area or a 9£ taxi) for reaching LonDon, as it is a non-stop 15’ train to Victoria station.
2-3 pubs within 300 yards of unit; and many good cafes just by N Bromley station .3 miles away. Also a large Sainsbury’s food store there.
Parking is easy but confusing. Free street parking right in front except noon-2 Monday- Saturday; have Faiza buy you the scratch off 4£ dash display paper if parking then OR have Faisa show you where you can park safely on street all day free just 1-2 blocks away. We did both.

I think it was the cleanest place I’ve ever stayed via the airbnb booking. Very modern facilities and renovation. Lukas was helpful and friendly. If I were not rushing for the coursework deadline , I would definitely explore more about the surrounding.

Anne welcomed us into her home for a short day. Slept really well. Great location. Very accommodating of our dogRosie.
This was our first time sharing someone’s home which I was a little anxious about but would definitely stay again.
Thank you Anne
Carey was a fabulous host with a real personal touch. The flat was close to transit and beautifully taken care of. I would definitely stay here again!

Inge was absolutely lovely! The place was very clean and private. Well located with many cafes and restaurants nearby.
We definitely would come back :)

Jeff's place was perfect for our short London visit travelling with our 3 small children.
He was very helpful and flexible around the checkin and was available when we had a question.

I had a wonderful stay in Suzy's apartment in Hackney, wehre I felt at home right away. Everything, from checkin to checkout, went absolutely smoothly. The room was very spacious and homey, and the location perfect for exploring London. Suzy is incredibly generous, warm and friendly. She gave me lots of great advice to explore the neighbourhood, regardless of her busy work schedule. I can absolutely recommend her and her room to anybody who wants to experience the true Hackney vibe!

The apt is in excellent condition and very clean.
Bathroom and kitchen-corner are renovated and the bed in the bedroom is very comfortable.
Location is very near to bus stations.
Alexandra responded immediately to our questions.
Dear Alexandra we thank you very much for hosting us!!
Beautiful place to stay. Close to any amenity you would need and a quick tube ride to local attractions. The neighborhood was very nice and easy to navigate. Would definitely stay again!
Sandra was an excellent host. The appartement is spacious and very well equipped. Recently renewed and close tò Arsenal Stadium, it's the best place tò stay for your next trip to London!
Dominic's place is very close to the tube station, which was great for us. Dominic answered quite quickly when we had any doubts. The pictures reflect exactly how the flat is. We enjoy our stay.

Debbie was a great host, and the apartment was perfect for our needs.  Very centrally located, close to several public transport options, and nearby lots of great London attractions.  The apartment was clean and comfortable, with plenty of room and a nice kitchen space.   Would absolutely stay here again when returning to London.

I enjoyed my stay here - I was a bit nervous about sharing a bathroom at first but you didn’t even notice there were other people. You had your own room with a shared bathroom and kitchen space. Room was clean and tidy!
I had a great stay at Alessia’s flat. She was super helpful , friendly and made me feel at home. Her place is super confortable and well connected. Thank you again !

Victoria's Place is a lovely flat.  Very clean and comfortable with excellent amenities.  A short walk to the tube and some great pubs. It was nice to be in a quiet location like Wimbledon.  Victoria made the booking and check in very easy.  Everything was clearly explained. Would highly recommend.
I had a fantastic stay. Iyisha was so helpful and very responsive to any queries I had. The area is nice and private but accesible to transport links. I will definitely be back!

larger room than the pic, less than 10 minutes from Stockwell Underground station, kind host , clean room , fast reply worth to pay
it's little bit tricky to find, stairs are bit narrow but not a serious problem

Amazing accomodation, very close to London. Very comfortable accomodation. Beds were great. Getting in was easy and the location is walkable to a Lidl or Tescos.
There were buses every couple of mins to London and nothing took more than 30 mins. Kirsty was very responsive. No issues with the place. Highly recommended.
Jadin has been a great host , friendly and communicative. The place is right next to DLR station so getting to the place was pretty easy . I would love to stay again !
We stayed here for 2 weeks and it was wonderful! Spacious and we felt right at home. Easy transportation to and from the city and we felt safe in the area.

It was clean and very good located for Terminal5.
If you have time, you should visit Harmondsworth and the park with little rabbits.
I slept with earplugs really well!

Really nice room, had everything you could need, and having access to a balcony is just so nice. The place was clean and Ajit is very friendly and helpful. The walls are thin though, and I think there is a school nearby as there were a lot of loud kids in the morning - I recommend bringing earplugs if you are a light sleeper. Other than that, it's a very quiet area, with many different tube and train lines within a 10 minute walk.

We had a wonderful stay at Kinga's apartment. It was as described and pictured, was comfortable and clean and in a really lovely area. Kinga's instructions for getting inside were extremely helpful and informative, and we really enjoyed our stay. If we are ever in the area again, this would be a first choice of accommodation. Thank you!

Great location especially for Hyde Park.  Very nice touches with cold bottles of water in the fridge, biscuits and fruit.  No WiFi but it just meant we used data or actually talked to each other.  Bathrooms were spotless. Bed was too soft for me but that’s the luck of the draw. Overall I would stay again as it has everything we needed.
Gina is a terrific host; kind and responsive. The appartement was just what we wished for. Nice little restaurants and bars just across the street.

Monica’s place was perfect for our weekend trip to London fir a weddings it was a great location and the street was very sweet. We loved the back patio and the flowers/garden area and the conservatory.
Both mornings we ate at a great little place around the corner called Zarathustra Cafe. We highly recommend it!
Monica was a wonderful communicator !
Very nice place, had problems to check in but host was very responsive. Overall a charming place:)
A great place to call home. The apartment had everything you could wish for. Beautifully appointed an considered. A great courtyard to enjoy the London summer!
Jamie was a great host and his apartment is conveniently located and spacious. We enjoyed sitting outside and the 3 bedrooms are large and comfortable.
Enjoyed our stay. Easy check in. Good place if you want to visit London but avoid the busy areas. Easy access to the train station too. It’s a bit warm at night time but fan is provided.
Jadin was very friendly and helpful at check out. Room was cozy and we enjoyed our stay. It was also a good bonus to have a monitor in the room. Thank you.
Very nice place near the overground train station, restaurants and a supermarket. Great base for exploring London.

perfect location for those who wants to shop or party in Central London, complete amenities such as laundry machine, full kitchen set and comfy bed
perfect for solo or young couple, as you may have to walk up and down the stair with your luggage
will be back for sure

Marvelous place, lots of livingroom space and big bedrooms, great apartment for 4 people. Neighboorhood is really nice and close to wonderful Hamstead Heath. But Crouch End is also lovely for a quick dinner and drinks. Try Banner's! And with the Archway tube you reach the centre in 20-30 minutes. If Steve allows us, we will come back.

Staying at Jose’s place was awesome! He was super helpful and I couldn’t have asked for a better time there! His place is close to some amazing cafes and restaurants and only a quick walk to Battersea Power Station and the tube.

We only had one night in London but this apartment was super convenient to the train station and I loved that the bedrooms are on the lower level and it was very quiet. And the Blue River restaurant on the same street was excellent and so convenient!

I had a nice stay here. The location is great. It's about a mile from South Bank so very walkable.
I was there about a week and didn't have any major issues. I believe there are 4 rooms being rented out in this place so there are people coming and going if you are there long enough, but it was fine. I will probably stay there again next time I'm in London if available.

Julia’s property is very nice and clean. It has a mini fridge in the room which is ideal and very useful. The room is very comfortable and no fault to say, to be honest. It is a walking distance to Westfield Mall and Shepherd’s Bush Market station.
Would definitely book again.

Perfect in every way for my needs. Comfortable bed, perfect location and nice to sleep in. Recommend sleep mask and earplugs due to street noise and boiler. Loved the place, will definitely stay again if I’m London. Recommended.
Fantastic location for access to underground and Lords cricket grounds, very safe and clean. Host was very responsive- even organised fresh towels during our stay.

If your looking to not stay in the business  of London this area was perfect. Retrieving the keys was not the usual for an Airbnb. We have stayed in multiple Airbnb maybe suggest a a lockbox. We honestly thought it was a scam upon arrival. Other then the key issue this flat was as described.

The space was amazing!!! It was very clean, comfortable, and all the amenities worked as advertised. Additionally, the area is very accessible via the tube, and a lot of local stores and malls around. I would definitely rent this space again next time I am in London!

This is a good, clean & comfortable house. It had all we needed for our stay. Vikash was very helpful & answered any questions quickly.  This property is situated in a quiet (as much as you could get in this part of London!) cul-de-sac, but has easy access to buses and trains.
Helpful host and easy location from Canary Wharf tube or the DLR. Well priced for the area. Would consider staying again.

Tod was very helpful and quick to respond to questions. Location is great for local amenities and transport links into the West End. Park is only a short walk away. The Eagle pub  is just around the corner and is dog friendly with a great beer garden. Perfect for a summer afternoon after a stroll in the park.

Extended family of 15 stayed here comfortably. Huge yard, lots of room for kids to play, toys and games for every age group.
Jaqua was a wonderful host and went out of her way to ensure that we had everything we needed
Gareth was fantastic with responses and communication. The room is small with all listed amenities. Slightly different to pictures but not significantly. Very close to transport

Absolutely loved our stay! Mael was super communicative and so kind. The apartment looks just like the photos and was the best place to feel right at home in Shoreditch. BoxPark and so many great restaurants nearby, right off the train- I can’t wait to come back!
Great location , close to all stations and restaurants ,  clean and beautiful penthouse apartment . Would definitely stay again !
Tania was an exceptional, friendly and efficient host. Her accommodation surpassed our expectations and made for a wonderful stay in London. Would highly recommend. 10/10!!!

Great little studio, and had everything we needed for a couple of nights. Hani responded promptly to messages and provided good details on access. 5 minute walk from the station and near lots of restaurants and bars. We'd happily stay there again.

Cara is a lovely host. Very helpful and made me feel at home. The place is perfect for the O2 or short breaks in London. Would definitely recommend. Would be my first choice if I have another event at the O2 in the future.

A great place in London location wise, especially if you are visiting the Olympic Stadium or surrounding areas. Neha and Paul as the hosts were extremely proactive and helpful right up until check out. The house was perfect for our needs as a place to stay for a couple of nights, and was very reasonably priced given the location and with it being London. Would definitely stay again!

Overall a good stay in a diverse neighborhood. The rooms were comfortably furnished and the kitchen was generally well-stocked. The building is shared with four other rooms so it can get crowded and busy, but it was easy to get in and out. The room was cramped with the sofa bed laid out and the shower only had soap so we had to buy shampoo. The building must be a little thin, as normal noise can be heard across the building so it’s necessary to stay extra quiet.

Perfect little apartment in a great spot. If you're not bothered about the quality of the WiFi there's nothing to mark this place down. I needed it to be more stable and more bandwidth to do a little work and it wasn't up to it. Otherwise, an absolute gem!

This house was a cosy retreat and was welcoming to return to after busy days exploring London. We enjoyed watching TV in the comfortable living area. The house  is beautifully decorated and well-equipped. The garden was a nice bonus. I  would recommend the house for a family. Our teenage son and daughter each got their own bedroom and there ia a en-suite master bedroom.  All the rooms are very bright and clean and we found the beds to be extremely comfortable. I loved the nearby train connection from Bromley North to Charing Cross. A very simple platform change is required at Grove Park. Bromley South is a great shopping and eating area in its own right with fast direct trains to Victoria. Faiza gave excellent recommendations and stayed in contact but was never intrusive. It was an easy and fuss-free check-in and out.  I hope to return to London next year and would be very happy to stay in this AirBnB again.

Ali’s place really great, it was just what I need for a 5 days stay… it has everything you need.. Ali was really kind and helpful… he helped with my suitcase and always checked on me! And the bus stop just by the side of the building was the icing on the cake… train station is a 10 minutes walk from the place… lots of stores and restaurants around! I had an amazing time. Thank you Ali

Nash was very helpful and responsive when making the booking
On arrival both he and his wife made me feel at home and after checking in we chatted whilst I waiting for a friend.
The room and house is very clean and spacious, the bed was large and very comfortable
The bathroom was very clean with a very good and large shower.
I could not find any fault with Nash's house and the reception I received from his family was exceptional.
The next time I go to Wembley I will definitely look to stay again with Nash
Thanks very much Nash
