Great apartment and very convenient for family of 4. Everything was excellent! And great host very responsive. Pace was extremely clean and nice! Great location cannot beat it

Beautiful apartment in a lovely part of Chelsea. The space is very nicely decorated and has everything you need. The neighborhood is wonderful - walkable, great restaurants and pubs, close to the tube, and very picturesque.
Raul was extremely responsive and communicative and made the stay easy. Would definitely recommend!
Amazing location, with a stunning, modern flat with all the amenities. I will definitely be back again.
Dahlia's place was exactly what we were looking for for our stay. Very comfortable and clean. The check-in and check-out were really easy and everything was as advertised. 100% recommend

Great apartment with so much space !! Gordana is a great host really flexible  with check in times and held our luggage while we went out to explore . The apartment is beautiful and clean in such a nice area . Beds are really comfortable ! We definitely would love to stay here again .

Victoria’s place is fantastic!! The location is beautiful, I loved the art deco vibe of the building and nothing was too much trouble for the reception/ concierge staff. The actual accommodation was the perfect size, clean and well maintained. Check in and communication also perfect. Cannot fault my stay!

Great value for money in an excellent location to explore London.
Fresh and clean feel, communal areas clean and warm too, comfortable bed and lovely shower.
A small hitch with not being able to open the microwave door was dealt with promptly.
For a few days it was perfect for us although if we stayed longer or had a lot of luggage then a larger room with chair would have been preferable.
Would definitely return.

What a great place to stay in London! In a cool area near Borough Market. The room is very nicely decorated and feels like a sanctuary in London. Zuzana is a fantastic host and pays attention to the small details

I liked staying here, it is an amazing location with a lot of restaurants and coffee shops! They responded very quickly when I wrote, no matter what problems there were, they were quickly corrected! The only thing I didn't like was the view from the window!But overall it was great!
The apartment has anything you need for either short or long stays. Nothing bad to say about it. The whole experience was pleasant.

Joe’s place was a functional stopover when traveling by train at Kings Cross. The flat is small, but our family of 4 was able to manage fine. One of the pull out beds is broken at the top and sinks down and there is a strong sewage smell coming from the bathroom (we were able to fix that by placing a cup over the shower drain).
Overall, the location is great and the accommodations are okay for a one night stay.

My friends and I had a perfect stay. The accommodation has all the creature comforts you need and we felt right at home.
There is a bus stop at the end of Mason Street which takes you into Soho and London Bridge station is just a short walk.
On the way to LB Station there is Bermondsey which has cool little cafes and pastry shops for a morning walk.
Shlome is also highly responsive, professional and helpful. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Great spot for weekend in London after catching train from Paris. Close to Kings Cross and short walk to stretch of restaurants in Islington. Walked to and from a show at Barbican and felt safe. Great flat and kids loved it. Some road noise but nothing problematic. Beds are spring mattress and probably not best for large guests due to size. But those are only nits. Flat is really well equipped and sharply decorated. Kenny was terrific host. Thanks for having us!
This is a great place to stay if you are a small group. It’s about a 13min walk from the nearest tube. Taylan and Marina were very helpful and responsive!

The apartment was nice, clean, and cozy—perfect for up to 5 people. The district is also clean and relatively quiet. Olivia, the host, was pleasant and always happy to help and suggest things. Would recommend.

Pawel’s AirBnb was exactly as he describes in the listing if not better! He is prompt, attentive & coherent with his instructions.
The room was spotless & so was the dedicated bathroom. There is a bistro right across the building & the free parking was definitely bonus. I felt safe walking back late evening.
I would highly recommend his Airbnb for anyone visiting London, who wants to live close to Tower Bridge.
Mike is a great host! He provided helpful instructions immediately after I booked the flat, and he ensured everything was in order throughout my stay.

Harsha’s place was perfect for our stay in London. The apartment was cozy, very clean and equipped with everything you need for a lovely time. There are lots of restaurants and shops in the area and public transport is easy to access. Thanks! We loved it!
The location is fantastic, the apartment is wonderful except the bed is extremely uncomfortable and hard. Hopefully they will replace the mattress otherwise it is lovely.

The house is really lovely. It is a proper home, well kept, bright  and very clean. I am local and I needed the house while mine has being refurbished. It is in an excellent position to get to London. The are many good shops and a beautiful shopping mall walking by where you can find anything you need. The bed was comfy and the all house is very quiete. Faiza is a very helpful and fast responsive host and a nice person to dial with. I would choose it again if I needed it. Thank you very much

A really lovely apartment in an excellent location. We hadn't noticed that the list if amenities didn't include a TV or microwave, but we are pleased to have stayed there regardless. We found the sofas and the bed really comfortable and very well presented.
Stayed with work colleagues for a few nights. Very smooth and easy and perfect location.  Very pleasant host!

We absolutely loved staying at this flat. Felt like home to us!  Great location and the home is beautifully decorated!  High end appliances and everything you need for a comfortable stay!  Thank you Chris for a wonderful visit to London!

Staying at Evelyn's was a peaceful treat. The bed, room, and bathroom were all super clean and fresh, and the wifi in the house was perfect. The neighbourhood was quiet with several shops and cafes near Wood St station. I especially appreciated the burek at Wood St supermarket and coffees at Coffee Boxx. It was very helpful to have a launderette nearby too. Evelyn is a kind and gracious host and I loved my stay in Walthamstow!

Fabulous stay in Covent Garden. The apartment was perfect for all our needs and incredibly convenient for theatres, restaurants, entertainment and shopping. Our host was in regular communication and readily available for any queries if required. We didn’t have any!
We wouldn’t hesitate to revisit.
Great location!! Could walk to shows, restaurants, tourist attractions, and all the shopping! Could not believe how quiet it was considering the location.
Julia’s a great host, very responsive, proactive and friendly! The room was very comfortable, the communal areas clean and matched the photos. Had a fab time!

Isabelle's home is perfect for a weekend getaway in London. Close enough to the city traveling by tube. The apartment is beautiful and very clean. I enjoyed looking at the decoration and the interesting books she keeps. We had our own private bathroom, which was wonderful, and Isabelle always gave us our space. Plus, having a homemade breakfast every morning at home helped us save money and also allowed us to immerse ourserlves in the culture, as Isabelle sat at the table with us to tell us about her life in this wonderful city, the things we should do and places we should see. We truly felt at home! I hope to be back one day.
new   clean flat with a great location! host easy to deal.with. Very smooth stay. would.go back.
It is a great, small, cozy place. Was nice to stay even for only 1 night. Clean space and easy to travel anywhere!

We had a lovely stay at Daria's  place, it was nice and clean and well located. She was a lovely host and was on hand to answer any questions we had and checked in on us during our stay. Would recommend her place if you want a central and convenient london stay!

Anna was great. Great location, very clean. Only negative was it didn't sleep my family five super comfortably. The extra single bed is toddler size . Definitely not big enough for my older kids. Other than that it was great.

Very nice, clean and modern accommodation.
Despite being located in the curve of a main road, it was very quiet.
Bedroom is on the back side but sleeping on the sofa bed in the living room is very fine too.( we were 3)
Very clear instructions to get in and very pleasant communication with Shlome!
Please note the deposit and the online form to fill in via Superhog.
Very well located when coming from St Pancras!
It felt very safe, tidy, and a place you can definitely rest!
I do recommend Shlome place!
Olivia was a wonderful host and very easy to communicate with. The house was extremely clean and comfortable. Walking distance to Victoria Park and with good transport links.

Excellent host. Very nice and kind. He went to welcome us as soon as we arrived. Always answering our messages on time.
Lovely apartment, nice decoration, excellent location. 5 minutes walk to the underground. We definitely recommend it.

Gary‘s apartment was clean and just like in the pictures. It was easy to find and with his instructions easy to get into.
There is a bus station very close by so you can get quite fast to East Croyden and Victoria.
Whenever I wrote Gary or Bianca a message I got a quick response. Both of them a super nice.
I would definitely stay there again.

Great location right in the middle of Knightsbridge.
Close to most of the main attractions. big space, modern furniture, fully equipped kitchen, clean bathrooms, lots of towels. Host was very responsive and helpful with booking and checking in. I can't stress enough how great the location was. Would book again. Thanks!!
Better than staying at a local hotel like I usually would. More space and homely type atmosphere! Everything you need is on your doorstep!

I only stayed for one night to go to a concert but it was an absolute pleasure to meet Mingshu!
The room was lovely spacey and the bed so comfy ☺️ Mingshu was a fantastic host, so friendly and helpful! Even let me borrow her powerbank after I forgot mine!
It’s a 20min walk to the underground and definitely a good area to stay in if you want to visit a concert in Wembley! I felt very safe on my way home and Mingshu made sure I knew how to get in at night!
Excellent location literally one train stop away from London city centre. Good food and shops around plus Battersea Park a short walk away.

WOW! MAURICE WAS A SUPERB HOST! Absolutely amazing property. Loved it the moment we stepped in. Kids loved it too. He was very responsive to my messages even outside of working hours (due to my fault arriving very late, but he didnt complain one bit). The rooms were perfect, kitchen was perfect, living room was immaculate. If you're reading this review, this is the confirmation to book now and not loose this! Its impossible to regret, i even wanted to extend my stay just a bit longer because of how nice the place was. Thank you once again Maurice!
We had a wonderful time exploring London from Chris’ place.   The home was a perfect launching point for us to enjoy London.   Would stay again if we  ever have the chance to return.

Lovely family home, lots of space and bed/rooms, ideal for our large group of two families. Rachael was super easy to communicate with before and during the trip and very generous with all the toys, LEGO, books, bikes, and activities in the garden. The kids loved the trampoline in the garden. We had a wonderful time.
The house is only a 10 min walk from East Putney so well connected to London, and in a lovely neighbourhood. The tube line near the house is barely audible, and the house is very well set up for kids and for cooking with two ovens and a big fridge which Rachael kindly emptied for us to use!
Note they do have a dog and there is some dust, so if you have allergies take that into account.
Thank you for a lovely long weekend Rachael and family, we appreciate your help with everything!

Very cozy and nicely decorated flat with great location. However it is a bit overpriced for the quality you get. It‘s on the lower ground floor with tiny windows that can’t be opened. No curtains so it‘s bright at night. Noisy from shops and other flats upstairs. And very low water pressure in the shower. Apart from that we liked our stay!
The place is as described, nothing more nothing less, which I consider a good thing, you get what you paid.

Ariana's place is a very clean, modern and well-located apartment within walking distance of Tower bridge and other central locations in London. Keys are to be picked-up at a shop near, which allows flexible check-in hours in case you're running a bit late. Ariana remains very responsive before arrival and during your stay. I definitely recommend.

Nada is a perfect host and her lovely apartment is bright and airy.The King’s size bed is very comfortable , her living room is luxurious and her family  bathrooms was  spotless with  hot showers and bath facilities  to be enjoyed  at leisure with a separate additional wc .In the kitchen Nada very unusually in our experience offers an open pantry and our daughters who popped by were very happy with the wonderful section of soft drinks and teas available…very generous.This was our second visit!!Fabulous Airbnb in a wonderful location.

Really nice and functional apartment in the lovely Wimbledon Commons area. Kitchen equipped with what you would need and nearby shops for groceries just a short walk away, and also several good restaurants in Wimbledon Village just a walk away. A small living room area for relaxation, and plenty of TV channels. 2 bed rooms with comfortable beds and cupboards for clothes. All in all a superb apartment if you are up for exploring London and meeting family and friends. I would say that for a family of four this is a very convenient place to stay in when visiting London and in particular Wimbledon.

The apartment looks better in person than in pictures. The location was ideal with overground station (reliable) less than a five minute walk away and provides easy transfer to underground. The surrounding area has restaurants and a grocery store nearby. There is a street food market with good options on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Would recommend Lots Road Pub (10 minute walk). Lin was a great host and very friendly. Would definitely stay again as it provided a close stay to central London without all the hustle and bustle of the city.  Previous comments regarding the hot water were not an issue.

This is a great place to stay if you want to visit London. It's a quiet street, there are shops and restaurants within 1-2 minutes walk. The Underground is also very closeby. Olga is a very helpful host!

Cristina is a wonderful host. I felt really welcome and she was always very responsive to any query I had. The location is top notch and the ensuite had everything I needed for a medium-long stay. Beyond all that, one feels genuine hospitality from Cristina and her daughters Rossella and Federica - I felt very lucky having the opportunity to meet them.
We loved the area, the building was nice. Although it's close to the railroad, there's not much noise. Very nice flat.

Excellent apartment, very close to underground and bus connections. Comfortable beds and good selection of pillows. Apartment had coffee, tea, sugar, condiments also shower gel, shampoo and conditioner. Loved our stay here for 2 adults and 2 children.
Evelyn is an awesome host. She was responsive and catered to all my needs. Had a great time staying there and will surely be back.
The room is not an en-suite, bathroom is outside of the bedroom. The flat is next to the street  but earplugs were provided. Pawel is very helpful.

Beautiful home and great communication from host. Home just as beautiful as in the pictures. Bus stop just outside and tube station around a 10 min walk. Views of the Shard from window. Lidl very close so great for little bits and bobs. Easy to access as Shlome provided clear instructions. Would recommend and come back!

I enjoyed my time in Yassine stadia. It’s a great space and is located close to public transport - making it easy to get around the city. Yassine is also very responsive and easy to work with. I highly recommend
Perfect place to stay while visiting family, and for exploring London. Clean, well equipped and comfortable. Andrea was friendly and helpful! A great stay.
Vas was really responsive and gave clear instructions regarding entry. The place is really clean and in a great location. Would visit again when in London

We highly recommend this host and property!  Isabel is one of the most organized and supportive hosts we have encountered in our BNB travels…. Every small detail has been thought of!  The highlight of the excellent breakfast is the freshly made fruit salad and pastry assortment.  Her knowledge of and support on potential options to visit and times and ways to get there was very useful and a great timesaver, The short walk to the Tube and other public transit options and great proximity to downtown London is.also a plus.  A definite return for our next visit to London.

This comfortable and simple apartment couldn’t be more well placed to walk to so many great destinations. There are restaurants, everywhere, and cafés as well. Everything you will need is within about an eight minute walk. I have stayed here twice and plan on staying again later this year. Highly recommended.

Great place for solo travellers! The room is clean, cozy and is packed with everything you might need. Kensington is such a beautiful and centrical area. Tina and David were very friendly and flexible. Will definitely book again for my next trip to London!

The room is great. Very convenient for stay.
M&S and wait rose are just downstairs, there are lots of cafe, bakery, restaurant nearby
Recommend to all
James was very helpful from start to finish. All areas I stayed was very nice . James communicated throughout and was very accommodating for my needs . Fantastic host

The places was fantastic, we left the bnb with some mess and thought it might be an issue but the cleaning staff were very humble and didn’t say a word. The location was fantastic just few steps and you are at picadally, train station is near like 20 steps and 24/7 grocery stores too.
Welcome London were very friendly and communication was smooth will book with them again
Thank you for a lovely stay.
Just one thing we had some music being played and heard a knock, there was a guy staying right next to us he had a bnb too but was very rude and harassing us to call the police but we took matters calmly and sorted out. Just a suggestion that guest shouldn’t be allowed to scream like this or talk like this to other guest, since we are tourist and get scared easily with these type of situations
Overall had a lovely stay
9/10

The information given beforehand was clear and helpful. The home was clean and tidy and in good condition. There was plenty of crockery and the washing machine and dishwasher work well. If you are in a large party you might want to bring your own large pans, and some more cutlery. The dining room is very cramped. It was very helpful to have three toilets, and three showers.’ Grateful for a nice stay.

We loved this flat! It was exactly as described, and I thought the location was great. Within easy walkable distance to many of the things we wanted to see in London. There were also multiple bus stops seconds from the flat, and an easy walking distance to multiple tube stations. Gina left a book with recommendations, as well as a bottle of Prosecco and fresh fruit for us. Would definitely stay here again if I return to London!

Had an amazing stay with my family. The location was very safe and within walking distance to everything. It was very convenient. The place was gorgeous and spotless. It had all the necessities provided with comfort.
Definitely recommend and will be booking again when back in London.

Raphael is the best host I have ever seen. I say this with all my sincerity. The flat I stayed in was spotlessly clean, comfortable and there was nothing missing; even more. My questions were answered with such a genuine and friendly approach that it is definitely the address I will stay at when I go to London again. Raphael shared all the information as well as great recommendations which I needed with the during my stay in London. I'm glad I looked at other comments and found this place. None of the comments are exaggerations. My family and I were very pleased with the accommodation. Thank you very much again.

Check in and out was great. Clear instructions and easy access. Overall the communication with Kar was good. I liked the Appt. location as it was easy to get to everywhere. The Appt itself could have been nicer. It's very small and feels a bit old but to be fair from the pictures you can tell its not big. The kitchen is of good size though.

Jelena is a great human being . I booked a single room but She upgraded me to a double room for the same price . I felt very happy . The house was clean all the time . Toilet was next to the room . Had lot of privacy . Jelena was friendly and warm . She offered tea and biscuits and talked heart-fully . Would recommend to anyone and would love to stay again .

Would be better if there was internet access despite password was provided.  Apt lift was not in working condition and there was also power outage during our stay. Otherwise very spacious apt and great location!

We had a wonderful stay at Monica’s place. Feel at home with the nice decorations. The kitchen is small but lovely, it provides everything we need. The conservatory is superb! Would love to come back here. Thank you Monica.

We had a fantastic stay at Tamara’s! The place was spotless and wonderful! We had a very pleasant stay. It is a pretty far walk to the metro if you’re not a walker. If you are a walker it’s safe and fine. There’s some good eats within a ten/fifteen minutes walk. There’s a Tesco express five minutes walk away. We would stay here again.

Location could not be more perfect. Set down a quiet and cozy cul-de-sac against such a stunning park. From there you can get to a walking path along the river that will take you anywhere you need. Felt central to everything yet the immediate area was peaceful and two blocks in any direction had shops/restaurants. Really superb communication with the hosts as well. Incredibly responsive and frequent check-ins.

Lovely stay at Michael’s .. we felt right at home .. very responsive , helpful host .
Great location .. easy access to the city .
Lovely apartment .. will definitely be on my wish list to book again .. thank you Michael .
Nice view, but very uncomfortable beds mattresses, also the photos are not the same real flat. It needs more furniture and decoration.
Adam was a great host. There were road repairs just outside that lasted a week so a bit noisy. Otherwise everything was absolutely great.
Had a really nice stay! Everything was clean and comfy. Had all the necessities. Definitely would go back.
Had a wonderful stay. Apartment was remodeled nicely and clean. Short walk to main transit hub, shops and restaurants. Located in quiet street and T&A were responsive and kind hosts.

Matthew’s Notting Hill flat is stunning, pristine, and spacious. It’s equipped with everything you could need and very comfortable for 2 couples to stay. Matthew is a super responsive and friendly host. The location is amazing and really can’t be beat. It’s the perfect jumping off point for exploring, shopping, dining. Highly recommend staying at Matthew’s flat if you’re looking in the Notting Hill area!
Enjoyed my stay in Stephanie’s beautiful flat! Great location with lots to do around, and ~6mins from the tube. Would recommend!
Van’s place is spotless and comfortable, particularly the bed! We needed the washer/dryer so that was handy. Outdoor space is a BIG plus.  Will return.

Sandra and Nordine were very kind and helpfull. Their place was very nice, clean, spacious, and easy to access from train station. I would highly recommend their place and will come back if I have opportunity to visit London again in the future.

A very comfortable room in a lovely terrace house -containing a lot of books and beautiful plants. Frank is welcoming and the area of Stoke Newington is a great escape from the bustle of central London with lots of nice cafes and shops.
A great flat, very clean, cozy and modernly furnished. Conveniently located just a short stroll from the tube station. Recommended!

This accommodation was perfect for us, 1 minute walk to the bus stop and easy connection to the main touristic attractions. Very dog friendly, beautiful newly refurbished apartment with everything we needed in the kitchen, including nice coffee and tea. Communication with Michael was amazing, quick and friendly response. Having parking was a huge plus! Definetly recommend!

Stunning flat, in a great location just along from Kilburn station. Great décor with a lovely vibe.
Katy's attentiveness was a great help. Will stay again on my next London trip.

It was an excellent location for our family. The staff at the Nell Gwynn were friendly
and the Matthew was very responsive to any questions we had. We really enjoyed our time in London.

Really lovely place!!! Even better than the photos. Sofa comfortably sit 4 adults which was great 😊 lovely little garden. We stayed before the London Marathon and it was conveniently only 20 mins away from the EXPO (where you have to collect your bib before). Having the super king bed was a real treat!!
We absolutely loved Jamie’s flat! It was in a great location and had everything we could hope for! Would definitely recommend and we would love to stay again!!
Responsive host and great location. However, my friend and I both noticed a bad odor, maybe mold? We couldn’t identify the source, but sleeping with the window open a bit did help.

We loved our stay at Michael's place. The decor was beautifully colourful, the beds were extremely comfy! The space was clean and had everything we needed. Michael welcomed us on arrival, had communicated before we arrived with recommendation of where to eat and photos of how to find the property.
The only downside was that we were only there one night and had plans so had to leave early in the morning and couldn't enjoy the space for long!

The host was one of the best I have dealt with and we've used airbnb many times. He was friendly, great communicator, and when we raised an issue, he fixed it straight away.
only 5 minutes walk from Angel tube, it was a handy location to be in.
The basement studio is a decent size, and accessed internally via some steep stairs.

The communication with Olivia was great and we could reach her at any time of the day. The apartment was very clean and beautifully furnished - we had everything we needed. The location is also good and you can get from the train station to the city center in just a short time.

I loved staying here!
the traffic was a bit noisy and thought it would bother me but it didnt!
Lovely erea. easy walk to the train station
and getting to anywhere in London.
Thank you Inga for the stamp and posting my card!
See you next time!
Flora
We loved the location and the parking space. Host was responsive and made sure we had everything we needed even after check-in. Thank you for a great stay!

My parents had a lovely stay at Harriet's place! The house is specious and nicely decorated. We really appreciated the well equipped kitchen. Also, they slept very well and said beds were very comfortable :)

We had a lovely time at Olga's place. It was warm and cozy and we had everything we needed. Our only suggestion would be the inclusion of a microwave for the easy heating of meals. We highly recommend this place.

Had a lovely stay here. The house was clean and comfortable and nicely decorated, was easy to feel at home.
The nearest tube is 10/15 mins walk away but there is bus stop is right outside which goes direct to the centre if you are looking to reach tourist areas.
Sholme was a fab host, friendly & quick communication from booking to check out.
Happy to recommend this place :)
Olubunmi was very responsive and proactive host, kids enjoyed themselves and would definitely recommend & revisit.

This property in Balham was perfect. Well furnished, great bathrooms (excellent showers!) and a well equipped living space and kitchen area. The flat is 5 minutes from the underground station giving great access to into London on the northern line. A really relaxing flat to base ourselves at.
Andy could not have been more helpful, very proactive and sent a fantastic guide to the flat and the surrounding area prior to our arrival.
Balham is a great part of London with great eating places, coffee shops and bars.
No hesitation in recommending this great place to stay and a fantastic host.
Carey is great! Only thing is it’s quite loud in the flat you can hear everything above! Thank you!
We had an excellent stay and would love to return. Joanna was so helpful and accommodating. The place is adorable and in a fabulous location. Thanks so much for a very enjoyable week.
Great apartment in a great location, Antonio is a super nice guy!! Will consider it again for future trips

The room is very clean. My flight arrived in the evening, the house was very close to the airport, I was very easy to find under the guidance of the landlord. The landlord is very kind and easy to communicate with. The room rate is very cost-effective and booking is recommended.
Location is a hit for us only few minutes away from Marylebone underground station. Everything was as pictured. Cleanliness can be improved. All in all we’re satisfied with our stay. Thank you Sian.
Tom is an excellent host. The flat is located in a beautiful neighbourhood that is well connected to restaurants, shops, and trains to Central.

I loved Gio’s flat, it was my fisrt time with airbnb and I’m totally satisfied about it. Everything was perfect, Giovanna is really helpfull, her house so clean and confortable, I was with my 12 y.o. son and this came out a perfect solution for my trip in London. The position of the house is great because it offers many tube lines. The zone is lively if you want to hang out at night or have dinner in a nice place but if you decide to stay at home and relax there’s everything you need to cook and some shops close to the flat. I absolutely recommend it!!
Great stay and updated interior! Easy to get in and out with great communication from host. 5/5 would stay again

We had a nice stay at jadin's place.
They accommodated us very well the room big and clean. We felt at home.
They allowed us to book in early which is a plus.
The place is very convenient to get buses or trains. Walkable distance to canary wharf
Responds quickly to messages. Communication 👌.
I would definitely go back again on my next visit to london.
This property was in the most perfect location for our trip! We very much enjoyed our visit in Notting Hill, HoK Living’s apartment was a great base for us.

Self contained, private and comfortable. just what I needed
Justyna was very helpful and responsive to questions

Thank you so much for letting us stay at your beautiful home. It was perfect for our get together. We would love to come back in the summer. 100% recommend. Jacqua is very attentive and down to earth!
James was a fantastic host and the flat was conveniently located near all main attractions. It was the perfect place to stay for our trip.
Great location and well stocked apartment with olive oil, salt, pepper etc all provided. Pretty quiet but there are stairs so not suitable for those with a stroller/mobility issues.
We found it was a nice clean little room with all the basis equipment. Sancha was quick to respond to our requests. We would definitely come and stay again.
Great, affordable room for a stay in East London. Everything you need is there and Artur a great host!

Sandra is friendly and helpful. I had everything I needed to rest in between attending events in London. It was easy to get there and easy to find. It was quiet and peaceful to stay at Sandra's place. Great value! I definitely recommend staying at Sandra's place

Always good to stay at Julia’s in Shepherds Bush. Lovely cosy room with what you need. Easy access to transportation and the city life on a quiet street. Room and bathroom was clean and fresh with comfortable bed and the shower had good water pressure. Julia was fast in response to messages and a lovely host.
Thank you! Hope to come again.

Julia and her family are great hosts. very kind and responsive.
The flat has a wonderful location.
highly recommend
Mary is a great host, friendly, warm and responsive. Flat was in a nice area, near the tube and quiet.

We had an really good time in London and we want to thank Justin and his wife. They both have been really sweet and helpful with us. The flat is very comfortable, cosy. It is very well located, with many shops around, parks. It is easy to go anywhere in London thanks to the tube station close by as well as the buses. We slept very well, the beds are comfortable, the kitchen well equipped. We really recommend this place!

So we didn't have to pay the very expensive accommodation costs of places in or close to central London, we were happy to do the commuting to the city for sightseeing. Trains run frequently but beware if you want to catch a train after 11:30 pm.
The apartment is well-renovated, in a quiet neighbourhood and spacious, excepting the bathroom, which is a bit pokey and, incidentally doesn't have good water pressure.
The kitchen has everything you need for cooking meals.
We stayed six comfortable nights there.

Absolutely perfect place to stay in London! Great location- short stroll  to station, but quiet enough to have a restful stay. Exceptional host, very communicative, very easy to work with, and highly responsive! Thank you for your hospitality!

Our large family stayed st Antos property and felt right at home. Hosts were very responsive and provided more than enough guidance in how to get from the airport and what to do in the area.
The property is located in a convenient neighborhood with lots to eat and drink. it was also near public transportation which made it easy to go to central London.
The property itself was in a quiet complex with plenty of room for a large family. it was very clean and had all the amenities we needed for our stay. I would highly recommend this place!
Great apartment and extremely convenient location with everything you need to feel at home. Plenty of towels and linens and a very comfortable stay. Thanks London Team!

Lovely cosy room with lots of thoughtful touches. Firm but Comfortable bed and location has excellent connections to the rest of London. Surprisingly quite quiet given the busy location. Host was friendly and accommodating.

Beautiful loft with everything needed. Equiped kitchen, washing machine, fridge, powerful shower, beddings, towels. Location is fantastic with easy access to buses and train. Hosts were very attentive but breached the contract of late check out even when my request was for me to just keep my bags anywhere they provided so I could go out for last minute shopping to while away the time because my flight was late in the night! Maria refused to honor my request and I didn't have a choice but to check out at 10:20 a.m. and left for the airport that early for a 10:35 pm flight. Thank God I was able to do bag drop at the airport and left for the city instead of sitting idle at the airport till night.

Close to two underground stations - Whitechapel and Stepney Green - so access to all over London, plus bus lines, it is a good location to base yourself for leisure and business trips.
The apartment is on the 2nd floor and room 6, where I stayed, was a comfortable single bed at the end of the corridor, the shared bathroom being on the same floor. The room was rather hot, which might be an issue in the summer.
The host was friendly.
This Airbnb exceeded all expectations. From the cozy ambiance to the impeccable cleanliness, every detail was perfect. The host was incredibly welcoming and accommodating.
Andrea is the best host I have ever encountered via airbnb. She is so friendly and helpful. Flat is extremely clean and definitely very very comfortable. Thanks for hosting!
A great place to stay! Spacious flat, with many wonderful amenities. Loved the balcony! Would stay here again!
Spacious apartment with all needed amenities. Fully equipped kitchen. Two comfortable bathrooms. Very cozy and spacious for 4 person family. Thanks for being flexible with checkin time.
Very nice apartment, we stayed there as a family (2 adults, 2 children). Perfect location, highly recommended.

Matthew’s place is perfect for a stay in London. Notting Hill is a beautiful residential area with lots of charming cafes and shops. The apartment is only 10 minutes away from the Notting Hill Gate Station. It’s very clean and comfortable and has everything you could need.
We had a great time at Matthew’s place. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly as in the pictures.
We would definitely come again and strongly recommend it!

We've been more than happy with the apartment. Everything has been as described and you've got multiple options to get to any place in London. Limestone Station is just a 5 minute walk away and you can get pretty much anywhere from there on onward. Mike has also been great with proactively helping with travel times and any other questions we've had. Thanks again for letting us stay at your place.

The apartment was nice and comfortable, like to be at home. Very clean and both Tracy and Russel very kind and helpful. Our kids loved to stay at Tracy’a apartment. The tube is 5 minutes by foot and the neighborhood nice.

Great for a short stay in London! The area felt safe and was a short distance to a Farringdon station and multiple bus stops. Check in was easy and the front desk staff were friendly. The apartment was small but very clean and easily accommodated 2 people. The in unit clothes washer was a nice amenity.
Rosie’s place was perfect for what we needed. Close to Kew gardens and transport. Beautiful area.
Good place for the price. Near the underground, but too close(noisy). Sofa is very uncomfortable to sleeping two people.

A lovely place to stay over the weekend with many amenities and a personal touch.
The house is charming and we would highly recommend.
Thank you, James, for a wonderful stay.
The best location, super clean and so easy to find!! Loveddd staying here. Also made me fit
Beautifully finished apartment in a great location, would definitely recommend to anyone..Added bonus of an EV charger on the street too!
We had a fantastic stay! The photos look exactly like advertised and very quick to get into London! Hien was very responsive and accommodating! I would highly recommend this lovely home!

Georgie and Rory’s house is a home away from home. It has everything you’ll need for a comfortable stay in a great location 5 minutes walk from Twickenham high street and close to the river for a scenic walk. Parking was easy outside the house and Georgie sorted out a parking permit for our stay.
A great base if visiting the area!

Gorgeous Airbnb that is absolutely perfect for events. It was my birthday & I have a small baby & Jaqua’s place was perfect for families as it was set up with a travel cot, changing mat, play area for babies & more. So many details really thought out & because of this, it exceeded our expectations! A perfect location for people of all ages to come together to celebrate

This apartment was so beautiful, modern and definitely what I and my family needed. Justyna was always responsive and helpful as well, so we had no problems at all. Thank you Justyna, we loved staying at your place
Convenient location with good connectivity. Big Westfield Mall and ethnic community shops nearby. Compact but comfortable room. Glad to have use of the kitchen for coffee, toast, reheating, etc.
While a bit out of the way… the apartment was fabulous.  Really appreciated the book with all the details in one spot including the best restaurants.  Kirsty accommodated our needs cheerfully!
Our stay was unforgetable. The location was amazing close to everyything ,metro was 1 min away and Simon was so helpful whatever we needed was there for us immediately.

After traveling to 22 different countries in 2 1/2 months on this trip this was the top two of my favorite Airbnbs. The room is absolutely perfect.! Spacious, super comfortable bed, wonderful bathroom with plenty of hot water and great shower pressure, easy to get into the city within an hour, and the best Airbnb host! I have found my place to stay in London whenever I come if it’s available. I will always try to book right away. I had a really fantastic time and only wish I was able to stay longer. I can’t say enough about this place but if it’s available, I wouldn’t hesitate to book it if I were you.

This was my first stay in an airbnb. It could not have been better, spotlessly clean, bedroom and bathroom. James was very friendly. He was there if needed but not overwhelming.I will not be staying in hotels any more if all airbnb are good as James’s place.

We had a very good stay at Kula's apartment in Emerald Street. It is located near two Piccadilly Line underground stations which is very convenient. On day 2 they informed if everything was ok. I asked a question about a window and made a remark about the state of one of the mattresses. Their guest services responded quickly and offered us some alternatives for the mattress. We agreed on them delivering a new mattress the next day which was more than I would normally expect. I would recommend Kula and especially their guest services.
A short stay for business, the perfect place to share with colleagues rather than an impersonal hotel.
Lovely place to stay, in a great location!  Daria very friendly and responsive! Wonderful all round!

Matthew was great host, he was very helpful at arrival. The instructions were clear and the apartment was clean and cosy for family of 4. Grocery shop was on the way from train and the kitchen had all equipment we needed to prepare breakfast and dinner.
The location was good accessible by train from London Bridge and Charing Cross.
We had lovely time with children London.

Lisa’s place was perfect for a night in London. A group of us were coming in and traveling to Scotland so this was exactly what we needed in a place as a pit stop. It was about a 10 minute walk to Kings Cross Station, which was perfect. There was a little convenience store and a Costa that was great for little things and coffee in the morning.

Spacious place in greater London area with an adorable price. This is a very good deal. The living room has its own door and  separated from toilet, which means you can use it as a private room, it’s super convenient. Bernard also took good care of us, provide us as much as possible.

From the moment we arrived at Jacqueline's home, we knew we had found exactly what we were searching for—a peaceful retreat not too far from the hustle and bustle of central London, yet well-connected by public transport. The tranquillity of the home provided the perfect backdrop for our stay, allowing us to unwind and recharge after our daily excursions.
The bedroom is peaceful, with a **comfortable bed** that delivered good night's sleeps. The kitchen didn't disappoint either; it was **well-equipped** for our culinary adventures, making us feel right at home. The living area was a cozy ambiance that made our downtime very enjoyable.
But what truly set our experience apart was the host, Jacqueline. She was **fantastic**—always nice and incredibly responsive, ensuring that our stay was smooth and pleasant. Her attention to detail and warm hospitality shone through, making us feel welcomed and valued.

What an absolutely wonderful stay! Jaqua was an amazing host and the place couldn't have been more perfect. We were a group of 9 ladies there for a hen do and everyone loved it! Everything was beautiful and clean and the garden was so much bigger than even the photos suggested. We loved the bar and the hot tub too! Thanks Jaqua :)
My sister and I had a great stay, it was the perfect place for the two of us. Thank you for everything Tam!

We had a lovely stay at this apartment, it exceeded our expectations.
Communication was really good, location excellent.
Would highly recommend.

We had a fantastic stay at Stephane's place in Shepard's Bush. We used both close by Underground stations to get around and were happy with the local grocery stores. We also used the free parking space and loved the amenities. Would definitely recommend to others!
Sanya’s place was exactly what we needed for our first trip to London. The location was very central to restaurants as well as public transportation. I would happily stay here again.
Nice little place, the amenities provided were very basic, 2 plates,bowls,cups etc. nothing to cut bread or meats for cooking.  Was quite close to the rail system

Lovely place: the kitchen is beautiful and fully functional, the living room is cozy, the bedroom under the roof is a gem and super comfortable (the steep stair up, however, might not be right for people with reduced mobility or equilibrium).
Friendly host: Andrew was very easy to communicate with, allowed us to check-in early and check-out late, and offered that we consume all the food we encountered. We felt completely at ease, like in the home of a friend we never met. 5/5
We had a great time in London / Balham, and we were lucky to have such a kind host and comfortable stay! Thanks a lot, Amy!
A great centrally located (for the City) apartment.  Clean and tidy and with a modern kitchen and bathroom. Would stay again.

I had an overnight stopover and this accommodation was perfectly located to London Heathrow Airport. James was very helpful with directions and also very flexible with check in times as my flight from Dublin was delayed.

Lovely location very easy to walk to Wimbledon Village or Wimbledon Broadway. Both destinations have much to offer in terms of restaurants, shops, theatre, pubs and cafes.  The area surrounding the flat is peaceful and lovely. The open kitchen reception area has a tree house vibe: calm and open.

We had a great stay at Tonia’s place. It is extremely well located close to a number underground stations as well as groceries and very nice restaurants, cafés and pubs. Tonia is a wonderful host, very attentive.  I would definitely recommend her place!

I felt comfortable and cozy :)
everything was tidy and clean
I'm so happy I found a nice place not so far away from the popular zones of interest for a very fair price!
Thank you so much for everything

Had a great stay at Gordana’s place. Was a smooth check in experience. She was very responsive and helped through the check in . The place is really good and as described. It is also in a very good location very accessible to buses underground’s and parks.

Jennifer was very kind and helpful. Her place is beautiful and extremely comfortable. We could not have asked for a better place while staying in London.
Carole

Absolutly fanrastic stay! Location was perfect, situated in a charming neighborhood, with shops, restaurants… etc. The appartment itself was spotless and stylish! Will definitely stay here again on my next trip.

Usman's place was wonderful for our trip to London. Close to the train and local eateries and grocery stores. The apartment was clean and quiet. It was also decorated really well and was a fun place to stay. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking at night and we enjoyed having the doors open in the evening for a cool breeze. Great neighbor and super kind host. Thanks Usman.
It was very well located.  The stairs to the 3rd floor were steep and tight! Once in the space it was very comfortable.  Paolo was very helpful and communicative.
I apologize for not sending review sooner but I was out of the country for two weeks and did not have access to be able to do the review until now.  Alexey was very responsive.
It was a great place to stay. Walkable to Euston station as well as Mornington station. Close to London for seeing the sights. I would definitely book again
It was a wonderful flat with nice and new furniture, had everything you'd need in the kitchen and the bathroom

I liked my stay at this apartment!! Some things could be updated, like the air condition unit, but the area was super nice and walkable. Very close to the Waterloo station. Inaam was helpful in answering my questions!! Would recommend.

This was our first time in London and had a great location to stay! It was very convenient and walk close to the tube station and many restaurants and nightlife.
Natalia was so responsive and helpful, she was a great host 😊

Perfect little hideaway just a few minutes from the Warwick Road side of Earl's Court Station. Right in the heart of things, but tucked away and peaceful. Great selection of interesting books for readers.

Shlome was great and responsive.
Check was straightforward.
Location close to the underground and local transport. Safe location.
Overall the place is good, just smaller than appears.
Still a great affordable location.
I would recommend it!

We are a family of 4 and stayed at Andrea's place during a visit to London. We ended up arriving quite late; Andrea was not there but we were able to get the keys from a neighbour. Thanks for accommodating us!!

Pawel was a great host, very friendly and had great response times to questions I had. The check in and out process was smooth, the location was ideal and the accommodation was exactly as described. I would definitely recommend staying here😊
Truly a great area and very accommodating/responsive host. The place was very clean and had all we needed. Price was appropriate for the area it was in!
James accommodated our late flight and stayed up to greet us when we arrived. He was kind and showed us around. The place is pretty, and is exactly as listed! Definitely would stay here again! 🙂

The apartment suited the three of us comfortably. The space is good. The property felt secure, with an easy-to-find location. Everything was clean, especially the bathroom, which was impeccable and featured a perfect shower. Highly recommended.

Had a wonderful stay at Shlome's flat.  It was spotless, well decorated and the location was great near bus stops and pubs and shopping. Shlome was very responsive to questions and allowed us early and late check in for a fee.  There were 5 of us traveling and the flat was a bit tight, but we enjoyed the flat.  Several people commented on the stylishness and cleanliness of the flat.
Colberg Hosting is a great host, was flexible with my check in and very communicative all the time.

Matt's place is just as shown in the images. A very modern design.
Matt contacted us a couple of days before we arrived giving us all the relevant information. When we arrived self check-in went very smoothly. There's no lift so you have to contend with steps but don't let that stop you. it has a very modern AV system and quite a bit of closet space. The whole place was very clean and a cleaning service came through while we were there for no extra cost.
Nearby are lots of shops, of all varieties, restaurants and an Underground station. It's a nice area so we didn't feel unsafe walking around and everything was very convenient.
Self-checkout was very easy when we left.
One thing to note is while I didn't engage with Matt much the times I did he was thoughtful and very fast at responding.

I had a great time at Frank's. The place is located in a very charming and quiet neighbourhood. The room and the washroom were clean, bright and spacious. There's a beautiful garden and it's easy to get to the city centre. I would recommend Frank's place to anyone planning a stay in London.
Amazing location, amazing people unit, service was amazing and amazing host.  One of our favorite Airbnb experience

The place was cosy and nice and very tidy, clean. good size for 3 adults. Self check in was convenient and communication was fluid. All equipment is useful and kitchen with basic equipment. Bus station is around and subway is 15 minutes walk. It was quiet at night. We had nice time in London.
Small pity’s the entrance of the building(stairs)was dirty and isolation of the living room wasn’t very good (we can hear our neighbors) but the room was okay. For us only one problem was the bathtub was very slippery but there was no handle to hold when getting in and out, we had to be very careful.

Booked on behalf of work colleagues from one of our international offices who were in London to work from our HQ in Vauxhall for a few days.
Great location for getting to our office. Slight cock up with keys in the wrong key box for check in but otherwise great hosts. Spotlessly clean and very fair price when compared to local hotels.
Will 100% book again.

All the surprises about this flat were good ones! The listing description is accurate, but the place is more spacious than we’d imagined,
the bathroom more modern, the street more quiet.
Our gracious host got back to us immediately when we inquired about early check in.

Vas’s apartment is in a fantastic location, less than a 5 minute walk to the tube. It’s located in great area. Vas responded to my messages very quickly & was very accommodating when we arrived. We were able to store our bags before check in while the cleaner was there. There was no one arriving directly after us and we were able to leave our bags till 3pm if we wanted.  Definitely would stay again & would recommend this apartment.

Deb is a great host, very supportive and quick to respond to queries. The appartment is perfectly located for visiting London, with bus and underground stations nearby. Very comfortable, well furnished, and quiet, allowing for good rest after very active touring. Will certainly return on my next vacation in London. Thanks Deb.
James was an awesome host, very accommodating to our needs. He was there for any questions we had and we would definitely stay again.
The property is amazing, with easy access to all major sites. The house is well established. I really enjoy my stay here and I will definitely recommend this property!

place was super clean and smelled so nice and fresh. furniture seems to be very new. everything was exactly as the description said. close to the tube and a super easy commute into the city centre.
host was friendly and always replied super fast.

Pawel’s place is a great choice to stay ! He gave precise instructions on check-in and the place is exactly like in the photos. The bed is comfortable and amenities are upto the mark. The bathroom is extremely clean with hot water and a bath tub.
Mark is very polite and friendly. He went out of the way to give us medicine when required and also told us where to go around in London.
His place is 10-15 minute walk from the tube and there is a bus station just outside the place. Grocery places like Tesco is 3-5 min walk.
Overall a great experience and we wish Pawel the best !

From start to finish Ayub was very responsive and friendly. The property had recently been refurbished and was in a very clean and good condition.
We had a lovely stay, thank you!

Loved this place, couldn’t believe the size of it considering it’s behind someone’s house! Thought it might not be that private but it was totally secluded. Wasn’t sure what to expect when we arrived but were very impressed. Lovely stylish furnishings, very clean, lovely bath, big kitchen, big Tv, comfy bed, even a small garden. I would definitely stay again. Thanks so much!

Raphael’s place is in a lovely area, right near the park with very easy walks to 3 Tube stations. We had 3 people, including our 10 year old son, and it was a perfect home base for our London explorations. Raphael was a very helpful and accommodating host and a fount of knowledge about all things Bayswater. We would definitely try to stay here on future visits!

Perfect home for visiting London. Calm neighbourhood, but near to underground station.
The flat is small but everything what you need.
Recommend the restaurant Fumeiro near the flat.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly welcoming and attentive, ensuring that every detail was taken care of. The space was immaculate, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, with easy access to local amenities. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay.

It’s a great place to stay in London. It was the best experience staying there. This place is very well maintained...Upon arrival we were warmly welcomed by the Owner(Aunty). Hosts were extremely friendly. The room was spacious and comfortable. We loved the ambience
I would highly recommend this place!!
Thank you Aunty & Uncle for being a nice host.
The apartment was nice and matched the photos. Monica was very helpful and responsive. Easy access to the Underground to get where we needed to go. Great experience!

Fantastic one bedroom flat in a great area between Leicester Square and Covent Garden. It's a busy area so it's not silent outside, but there were ear plugs provided and the location was worth it. The pull out couch worked great for our two kids as well. We would absolutely stay here again!

Michael was very helpful and flexible with my group's need to check-in early, replying to all my messages promptly and helping us with our demands however he could.  He was incredibly pleasant and hospitable in person, and the flat was clean, comfortable and cosy.  Will absolutely be booking with him again when next in the area!
Richard was a lovely host. His place is a great location and super awesome vibe in the city!

Our stay was wonderful. The home was very clean, decorated beautifully and close to Kings Cross. Giovanna was very accommodating for our early baggage drop off and always responded to our messages. Great size for two people, had everything we needed. We would certainly book with her again!
we stayed here for MCM comicon and it was a great place! a quick walk from the excel centre, comfy for my friends and I, and a quiet neighbourhood with enough space on the drive for 2 cars.
James is an amazing host! Very responsive and accommodated our check in time. Room was clean and nice . Would definitely stay again .  Provided water , cookies and coffee , totally worth it .
Everything was just as described. Louise and Shelly were very responsive. Amenities provided were very useful. The area was very peaceful. In short, had a wonderful experience!
We had a great experience! Place was clean, close to the stations and very comfortable and cozy.

We had a great stay at Mael’s place, it’s spacious and central to everything we wanted to see. Great recommendations for places to eat and drink, top notch/nosh!
We had a late flight so he let us hang out after the normal check out time, this was a lifesaver as I had a sick child.
Thanks Mael.
Nice in general. Tidy. Kitchen is quite big and equipment is clean. Ventilation is slightly not enough, making the process of cloth drying very slow. Toilet looks very clean but shower head is weak.
Our week at Katherine's very modern basement flat was ideal,  providing  the much needed comfort, privacy and homeliness after weeks of travel.
Had a good stay on my business trip. Close to Tufnell Park station and Kentish Town. Thanks you, had everything I needed with some little complements!

Iyisha was so kind and made sure I had everything I needed for my stay. Very comfortable and quiet so was able to work and think and slept very well too!
I would definitely stay again without hesitation.

We really liked the place. The apartment looks like on the pictures. We stayed one week and we missed nothing. The communication with Adam was fast. He is a funny guy. If staying in London once again, we would come back to Adam’s place.
The apartment is located near coffee shops, stores, bars and restaurants. The bus station is 2 min away and train station around 10 min away.

What can I say, this flat was amazing. Very close to multiple bus stop and tube stations, so getting around the city is convenient. The place was amazing, and had everything we needed for our stay. This is an amazing flat to book for your stay if it is available.

This apartment is great and very close to the metro station, making transportation convenient. There's a park very close to the apartment where you can go for a run. Sophie responded to messages quickly and was very considerate and kind. We had a wonderful week in London.

Brand new, spotless, high-quality, well-furnished large room. 60 seconds away from the bus stop, and from the tube, and from restaurants. Perfect, really. I would have liked thicker pillows, but I guess that's a personal preference.

Perfect apartment in a perfect location. We loved being in the thick of Notting Hill. Can step outside and right in the heart of everything - but not noisy! Outstanding host. Thoroughly recommend and way better than staying in hotels

Peaceful, comfortable, clean and convenient.
We had a good nights sleep on good quality bedding. The location is tranquil and handy for convenience stores.
It was good to have a separate kitchen and this was very clean and functional.
Room was spacious, light and airy. Overall a very pleasant stay.

Great host, very very responsive; super convenient location (few minutes walk to two different metro lines; it's possible to store luggage before and after the stay (after confirmation from the host).
Thanks for this stay! :)

Good location near metro station 2-3 minutes to walk. The apartment of rina is very clean was a pleaure to stay here
Thanks

The place was great in every way. The hosts provided lots of things like drinking water, coffee, condiments etc. The location is amazing, super close to the Paddington station which for us was great as we were in London for the Champions League final. The terrace was lovely as well and the place was very clean. Would definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a nice and quiet area with subway stations nearby.

Amy’s flat is a great place to stay. Easy to find and in 10 minute walkable distance to Balham high street and tube station.
The flat itself is located on the 1st floor of a converted house and spans over 2 floors. It was clean and well stocked with all the amenities we needed.
Beds were clean and comfortable.
Amy as a host is everything we needed, always prompt at responding to messages and answered any questions we had. Thank you Amy for letting us stay at your place and wouldn’t hesitate in staying again.
We had a lovely stay at the flat. It was super clean and tidy, a lot more spacious than expected. Photos do not do the property justice. Great location. Would recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay. The place is so nice. The only issue we had was the trains were quite loud going past.
Second time staying here.  Stylish and well located space. Richard the host is always very responsive. Highly recommend.
excellent choice, very clean and a great location.  Julia and her  mother are very polite and helpful. 100% recommended.

Amazing week in London and ideal location to both go into the city and drive to locations outside the city limits. Comfortable accommodations and centrally located for several tub stations/restaurants, groceries, etc.
Parking was a little tricky but that's no reflection on this listing!!! Private patio is a great "tucked away" space to unwind!! I would definitely stay here again if I return to London. Many thanks for being such a great host!

Cara's place was absolutely perfect for a concert at the o2, was home in 10 minutes. Great location and host as a solo female traveller. Cara was really helpful before and during my stay, flexible with check in as I arrived a little earlier than expected. Would definitely stay again if attending the o2 or needed to be in Greenwich area
Jinny’s place was spacious, clean and in a great location. She was very responsive and overall had a good stay.

We occupied this space for a month. It is immaculate and comfortable. It  was easy walking to the southeastern rail station, shopping and restaurants. We can't say enough about our gratitude to our hosts. One of us had a medical emergency and was in the  hospital for a week. Our hosts went above and beyond in their attention and material aid. This included personal  hospital visits. We can give no higher recommendation to our hosts than what we write here.
Very lovely host and everything was as described. Location ideal to go the o2 and easy access to transport

Great location but can be loud in the evenings, but nothing too terrible. The liveliness of the area is expected. Host is responsive and provides lots of amenities that many would not expect. Absolutely great flat for a stay in London.

A great apartment that met all our needs! Great location close to fabulous restaurants and shopping and convenient to Clapham common and Clapham junction station. The apartment is small but had everything we required. Communication with Kelly was great and she responded immediately to any questions we had.
Would recommend!
Lovely  place, ammenties neaeby a home away from home. we will be back soon
A lovely place that was right near the train station and nice and quiet  A great place to stay.
close to the stockwell underground therefore very easy to get to it and go to the center of London. Neighborhood is chill and the place is quite peaceful.

Staying in Chingford was a delightful experience, largely due to our wonderful Airbnb host. The host’s friendliness and willingness to help with all our queries made our stay stress-free and enjoyable. The house was just as described – spotless, cozy, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The host’s lovely dog was an added bonus, providing us with some joyful moments. The location was perfect for our family visits, and we appreciated the tranquility of the neighborhood. We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming stay in London.

This is a fabulous flat, we highly recommend.
It is very spacious, this everything you would want, from kitchen equipment to bathroom items, even fresh roses in the lounge room.
It was very clean, well maintained, and has quality linen.
It is located in a beautiful and quiet area but only 5mins walk to the tube station
Simon is a lovely host, very friendly and thoughtful.
We hope to stay again one day.

We loved our stay! Beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to paddington station and Hyde park. Also easy access to bikes. The home was very big - three queen sized beds and 2.5 baths. All
On one floor (below grade). I would recommend this flat for a group or family! Thank you Gordana for being so welcoming and helpful!
great stay at Numa London. great location with easy access to public transportation. Room was small, but if you're only using it to sleep like we were, it's totally fine.

Clean and spacious flat. Neighborhood has quiet evenings and lively days, and feels very safe. we were so happy we didn't stay in tourist central. Sophie is attentive yet unintrusive, excellent communication, and a top flight professional.

The location is perfect: in Chinatown, (great food) and adjacent to Soho, Covent Gardens and Westminster. It was surprisingly quiet. Right outside on the street is the bustle of Chinatown, but the flat is on the second floor and facing to the back, so there was no noise.
There is a lift, which was very helpful for the luggage. The flat is small and very practical: several sockets and therefore easy to recharge your phone, place to hang clothes, microwave, kettle, fridge, etc.
The check-in was in person which was nice.

Recently stayed at Michael's place.  Location was perfect for our weekend visit to London and for attending a sporting event at London Stadium.  15 min walk to train and to stadium.  Michael was very responsive to questions and provided great info re: train travel from airport and location of closest grocery store etc.  Looks exactly as pictured.  Would highly recommend

Easy to get to Northern Tube station to take you in to London.  Also bus stop just outside flat.  The flat is in a very nice area.  And inside appearance is nice and comfortable.  Adam was very helpful and ready to answer any questions we had.  Over and beyond, even helping us pick a stay for our next stop on our holiday
the coziest 2 bed flat with a lot of space. i was very surprised at how big it was but it was absolutely fabulous and perfect for a 2 person trip. would deffo book again as gareth is a lovely host xx

Alexi is a wonderful host and that alone makes this worth 5 stars. The cherry on top is the home. It's beautifully unique to London, there are even views of the Shard and other skyscrapers from the upstairs room. The hot water and pressure were excellent. The beds were comfortable. I would come back and recommend!

Staying with Isabelle was like coming home to my sister. She was welcoming and more than helpful with finding the best way to get where we wanted to go. Our breakfasts were exactly what we wanted to start the day, and Isabelle was flexible with that, too. Our bed was very comfortable and the room exceptionally quiet, especially considering the wonderful pub next door. (Wonderful food and drink there too!)
We appreciated having the front room to relax in and Mr Darcy (the cat) was surprisingly good with staying out of our bedroom but came for some pets when invited to.
We loved ‘coming home’ here and recommend this lively lady and her home.

Loved being close to the Borough Market and everything else around the Tower Bridge and Southwark area of London.
Great rental for a family of four with two teenagers thanks to the pull out sofa being a comfortable third bed.

We had a lovely stay in Damini and Ashok's lovely house in a quiet neighbourhood. After a warm welcome and chat with both, Ashok showed us to a well furnished room with generous bed and thick curtains to give a dark room. En suite bathroom had a good shower and facilities. Breakfast in the  morning set us up for the next day. Spot on for us. Thank you!
Great place, really clean and very good and easy communication with Marijana. This is my second time staying in this airbnb and would definitely stay a third!
Great stay and perfect for our stay! Incredible location to paddington station, making it easy to get around everywhere. The hosts were great and easy to work with.

Fitzroy Square is such a special place - a hidden treasure in the heart of London. Rebecca is a wonderful host, is so flexible and helpful, and made us feel so welcome. Loved the treats she had for us in the flat after arriving from a long overnight flight.
Anyone who stays here will understand what a great find this is!

Evelyn was a wonderful host. She was always quick to respond and gave clear instructions upon check in and check out. The accommodation was great and well-located to get into London. Thank you to Evelyn for a wonderful stay!

Really comfortable and clean with high quality fittings.  Quick responses to queries.  This place was great for our two night stay and pretty easy to get to using public transport from central London.

My family and I had the most pleasant stay in this spacious and upmarket apartment in central London. Our host Ana was most attentive and accommodating to all our needs.
Definitely coming back!

My family of 9 stayed in this lovely 6-bed house during our weeklong trip to London. It exceeded our expectations - very clean and comfortable. There was a travel cot/crib and high chair available for use during our time. Being right next to a pub was no issue; we never had any noise in problems when bedtime came around. Location couldn’t be more perfect - close to shopping, food, transportation, and even a large park with a popular playground for the kiddos. Would definitely stay here again next time!
The place was exactly as it looks. My teens usually prefer a hotel but loved this apartment.  Great location (quiet yet close to it all) and very responsive host! Hope to be back!

After more than 200 trips to Europe, I know a little about where to stay, and Olga's flat was superb.  Super-quiet back street, yet close to public transport and Santander shared-bike stations.  Charming furniture and decor, a great desk for working, fully-equipped kitchen, and wonderful details seldom found in Airbnbs, like motion-activated nightlights in hall and bathroom, and posh bedding.  And Olga is a fabulous host, friendly and responsive.  A great place!

I am afraid not much to write home about. If it meets your budget, it’s a place to stay and that’s about it.
The shower water temperature control is broken and needs to be fixed immediately, it only pours scalding hot water at all settings. I tried to raise this with the team but they misunderstood and simply sent me a video on how to operate a it rather than send someone to fix it.
Location was perfect for the activities we had in mind in our stay and we did have everything we needed

Nidhi and Sam are helpful,  responsive hosts. Marina was a lovely greeter too! The welcome pack and flowers were very nice. We ate the fruit and toast for breakfast every morning. Location in Marylebone and close to the Baker Street tube are very convenient. The only request is one more comfortable seat for relaxing after long days touring London!

We had a warm welcome and help with our luggages. The fridge was packed with basic necessities such as butter, coke and milk for us to use
We had spices, sugar, coffee and they even got us cookies upon our arrival which was thoughtful and nice
The toaster was not working but all the other amenities worked properly
Jodie also helped us book our Uber to and from the airport upon request since we could not do it with our e-sim to avoid us pay expensive airport transfers.
The location was perfect for what I wanted to see in 3 days walking distance to many great places in center of SoHo- had a great time
Shola was a great host. Gave me great recommendations in what to do while and London. Very gracious and flexible about checking-in and out. Shola was incredibly responsive as well.

We had a very convenient experience living at Maria’s. Not only was her house all well equipped, it was beautiful. We’d love to stay at this same place whenever we visit London.
Maria is so organized, responsive and nice that it was easy to get any questions answered. She was also proactive in sending all instructions in much advance.
We appreciated our stay at her place very much

Very hip flat that actually feels like a home (not at all a typical sterile Airbnb experience!). Kirsty was super responsive and helpful and gave us the sweetest gift baskets of goodies to help celebrate the wedding we were attending. It’s a short walk to buses and some nice cafes. Would definitely come back!

Monica’s flat was just as described - looked exactly like the pictures.  Very cozy and inviting. Lots of immenities available - from shampoos and soaps to coffee, oils and vinegars.   The location was perfect for us - less than 10 minutes to walk to the local tube station that took us everywhere.  Neighbourhood is quiet and filled with local pubs and restaurants all within walking distance. It was nice to come back to a quiet place after the hustle and bustle of London.  Monica was very proactive and responsive.  Would highly recommend to anyone.

Had an outstanding visit to London in Matthew’s Notting Hill apartment. Location was excellent and communication before and during our stay was incredibly helpful.
Highly recommend!
There was a sink leakage problem but the homeowner fixed it quickly and promised to make a discount for it. That was responsible. Also very easy place for public transportations.
The location of the house is great. It’s clean and very close to transportation options. You’re a 5-minute walk from Hyde Park. We had a wonderful stay with our two children.

The Host Ali is an absolute gentleman allowing you to enjoy the beautiful property that he has created.
Does not disturb at all except for when we go to him for inputs.
Quite proactive in giving inputs and instructions and immediate response to messages

what an amazing host and great place to stay great location will definitely be staying there every time I go to London.
it feels so homely and comfortable inside its literally gong from home to home,
Fazile always replies promptly when asked questions,
really is 100% amazing

This place is a GEM in the heart of Sloane Square.  It is perfectly furnished and felt homely. We mostly walked everywhere but it is very close to the underground.   Ate in the surrounding neighbourhoods.   Thanks Ange.   See you next year.
great little appartement. very comfy clean and fully furnished. the host was always available and very helpful. the place is 30 min walk from London bridge.
Cozy and cute place to stay for some nights. Wembley is very nice. Near to accommodation is London designer outlet shopping centre. Easy to get to central city.

This place was lovely and clean and the host was very welcoming and respectful. Made us aware of local amenities.
The en-suite was perfect for us.
Would have been nice to have a TV in the room but not a big issue.
Nice and clean and easy to find plenty of free parking in the street.

Accommodation just as described, ideal for a short stay. A convenient location for exploring. Kar was very responsive and helpful. A tiny bit of noise from people entering adjacent studios but very quiet for London. Our only points for the future are the lack of tea towel (the side was very wet after washing up) and a fan for summer months. Thank you for a wonderful stay 😊

We thoroughly enjoyed our time at this Chelsea flat - location was great for walking to the tube or enjoying the local areas. Neighbourhood was very quiet, which was a great relief after being in the busy downtown London streets all day. The flat is as described and very clean - just note that one bedroom/bathroom is quite a bit smaller than the other so allocate rooms accordingly! Would definitely stay here again on another visit.
This is a straightforward and no-frills Airbnb but it was all easy (though probably helped by my knowing the area in finding it) and safe, and certainly well worth the cheap price.
Tina was the kindest host! The noise was not an issue for me at all. The location was perfect to go sightseeing with a quick jump on the tube under 2 blocks away
This is my favorite airbnb in London, and Inge is a wonderful host.  I have been coming back here where I am in town for business for eight years.  So sorry others have found out how good it is.
All great. Stayed for one night. As described. All clean. Next to station. Would choose again.
