We thoroughly enjoyed every moment and would highly recommend it to others!"
Mingshu was very accomodating host ! place and location is great for a night in london

Our family of six and our year old grandson had a perfectly amazing stay! This townhouse was beautiful and so clean. We felt right at home. Easy to find, centrally located. We found fantastic nearby breakfast place, they were so friendly. Would stay here again for all our London visits! Can’t say enough about our wonderful host!

Nina is a great host, responsive and always ready to help. I stayed in the cabin for 1 month.
The cabin, even though it is only 40 min away from the city center, gives you the feeling of being in a forest. It is nicely decorated, with useful things for longterm stay. thanks for everything!

Was such a pleasant stay and exceeded our expectations. Olutosin was so kind and welcoming upon check in. Pictures and descriptions of the property was accurate if not better in person, was such a clean and tidy place and the bed was so comfortable.
Free on street parking which was a bonus especially in London and the high street was so close with lots of restaurant options. Perfect weekend stay! Couldn’t recommend it more :)

We had an absolutely fantastic time staying at Fazile's place. The house was spotless, and the thoughtful touches made us feel right at home. The location was perfect, the home was cozy and clean, and Fazile was always available to answer our questions.

We had a great little stay in the apartment. Host was good at helping and very responsive when we had issues with pre-registration forms.
Good location and walkable to many bars/restaurants and also metro stations.
Would come back and stay another time.

My stay was okay. the beds were comfortable, was able to find extra towels after a while. It is very cold at night. Essentials available  like shampoo, adapters, and plenty of light. Only negatives are : the shower drips after you get out and doesn't stop.. squeaky floors.. stains on one of the mattress covers.
A perfect place to stay. Hazel is a very friendly host. She always want to help. Breakfast was delicious and extensive. Rooms are cosy, clean and provided with everything.

Shlome's place is a great place to stay. I would book again if I ever get the chance to go back to London. Only a few minutes from local attractions. The walk to Borough Market is a short distance from the Airbnb where you can find lots of food from different places of the world. I highly recommend this place if you don't mind walking. Most must see spots are about 30 minute walks, which for us was not bad with a 12 & 15 year old.

The flat was centrally located, so it was fairly easy to get to the various train stations and bus stops. Anything that you could need is located nearby. The flat was lovely and the outside space was a lovely addition. My only complaint is that storage was very limited, so if you're an over packer like me, it may not be optimal.
Lawrence was very flexible with my checkin and checkout, which was extremely helpful given my early arrival and day of checkout plans.

Michael, Julie Ann & Trisha made us feel welcomed, they provided all necessary directions for accessibility.
The Room was good enough for 2 persons and the tidiness of both the room and the washroom was great along with the amenities provided

Location amazing!
Sanya was very responsive and overall a great place to stay for our first trip to London.
Private, large, safe and cosy place to stay for good access to Croydon, Gatwick & London. Great, very responsive host, property is well equipped with a modern fun design furnishings…

The only small issue was having to wait for the key to arrive because they had put on new locks. But otherwise, the apartment was very large, very nicely decorated and warm and comfortable. I had everything we needed in the kitchen, Which was really great, and even had extra towels, the possibility to sleep in three different rooms. There were three of us and we had tons of space. I would definitely highly recommend and will definitely be back.

What a perfect spot for our London holiday! Clean, modern, safe and spacious. Tucked away from the craziness of downtown in a quaint and quiet neighborhood — yet still a short walk from the Victoria line, it was the perfect spot. Only thing we would do differently is put in Regency Cafe as the location on the ride share (cafe across the street), instead of those provided as it was initially difficult to find and caused us to get lost. Would definitely recommend!

Robin‘s flat is a light filled place in a lovely townhouse. It’s a quiet residential area with easy access to shops, pubs and  public transport. The tube is only a short walk away and takes you to all other connections  and straight from and to to Heathrow.

Shlome’s place made for the perfect stay while in London! The flat was off a quiet street all while being an easy 5 minute walk to Hendon Central Station. Also many small stores right around the corner. Check-in was easy with a personalized code. The flat itself was cozy with many windows giving wonderful natural light. Exactly as pictured and it felt so easy to make it a home for a week during our holiday. Shlome’s hospitality was a gift and they made sure our time in the flat was perfect. Would highly recommend for your London holiday or any trip in the city!
The apartment was clean and tidy, just as described. The owners were responsive and helpful in directing me to Soho and Chinatown, a reasonable walk from the apartment. I'd stay there again.

Ellie was an extremely gracious and responsive host! We loved the Airbnb - it was clean, comfortable, conveniently located (and even had a washer AND dryer!)
For light sleepers, there are some quiet train rumbling noises as the tube passes by underneath, but nothing too disruptive. I would definitely stay here again.
Quaint dwelling. Probably just needed lettered to indicate which apartment was which. Great location with easy access to public transport, restaurants & Portabella Road. Enjoyed our stay.

Great stay, easy check in. George, who greeted us at the property, was very helpful during the check in process and gave us all the information we needed. Paolo responded to all of our questions promptly. Thank you!
Good property to stay. We stayed for two weeks. However this property could benefit from day curtains as it is on the main road and also spare set of Duvet and sheets.

We felt at home in Tima’s house. She is friendly and responsive. The place was amazing and a very accurate listing. 5 minutes walk to the river and It has a peaceful neighbourhood. We will come back Again.
We really enjoyed our stay - the flat was very comfortable and we really enjoyed the location. Van was always very quick to respond and was always very helpful.

Fantastic accommodation, very clean and has everything you need for a weekend break.
Excellent location with some fantastic restaurants a few minutes walk from the apartment.
Tube station is at the bottom of the road which is very handy.
I'd highly recommend this apartment and would definitely come back.

Barbara and Richard took great care to make sure I felt at home during my stay. Their place is clean and easy to walk to. Barbara is very quick to respond and was very helpful in all her communication. Looking forward to my next stay!

Fantastic stay in the loft - only there for one night and wish I could have stayed longer. Space has been well thought out, everything you might need is there, including a washing machine and kitchen space. The bed is extremely comfortable and I had a good night’s sleep. Just a few minutes walk from Blackhorse Road station too, so very convenient for getting into London.

We had a fantastic stay in this property! Very clear instructions on how to enter the property.
Very close to the under ground.
Very clean and tidy! Extra bedding left for sofa beds.
Private outside area.
Only slight downside would be that there isn’t much sitting furniture for the evening when wanting to relax - there was however plenty of table space for dinning chairs for eating.
Would 100% stay again.
Thank you.

Ellie was very polite and thoughtful. The flat was amazing. Clean and cozy. The location was excellent. Next to the tube station and bus stations. Only 10-15 minutes to Covent Garden, Oxford Circus, Trafalgar and many more central and touristic areas. I had great time.
Thanks for everything.
Really I like the place was super nice super clean I would really Choose it again I had a great time very safe

We had a lovely short stay in London and really enjoyed the flat. It was very comfortable, clean, and conveniently located close to the city center, which made getting around easy and stress-free.
Deb, was friendly and accommodating, ensuring everything was ready for our arrival.
Overall it was a great experience, and we would happily recommend this flat to anyone visiting London!

Overall, we enjoyed our stay. The place was nicely decorated and quiet, the beds were very comfortable. There were some little things that probably could be improved, for example it would be nice if the owner could send a picture of the front door and a lock box for easy identification prior to arrival. We had some hard time to find it at first. Also, one of the radiators in the bedroom was turned off but the owner was very responsive and helped us quickly to turn it on.

I had a really enjoyable stay at Monica’s place. The apartment was perfect for my solo stay in London.
Monica was the the perfect host, very proactive and responsive

Probably my 4th booking.
10/10 like my others reviews down below.
Thanks.
Sarah was a super great host. She was both respectful and prompt when communicating. The place was clearly deeply cleaned before my arrival and the location had very easy access to transportation.

The flat is compact but has everything you need for a short stay on London, and the location is excellent.
Communication was excellent, helpful and efficient.
The space was perfect, high ceilings, great kitchen and dining space which opens up completely into the roof terrace

Evelyn and her lovely family are very kind and hospitable. Their home is spotless, comfortable, and cosy with everything you need. The location of the house is very close to Wood Street Station on the overground (only 5 minutes) and Walthamstow Staion on the Victoria Line (only 12 minutes) I would stay again and highly recommend their place to others :)

I'm a true city girl, I wanted to specifically be immersed in one of the most populated areas of London with restaurants, coffee shops, pubs, jazz clubs and liveliness....so for me, this airbnb was absolutely PERFECT... the host was beyond amazing, super responsive and flexible in the best ways! If you want to be in one of the most popular areas, this is it!

The location is good, the bathroom is shared but relatively clean. However, the room is noisy due to sounds from the other room, and the floor is bad, definitely causing disturbance to people in the room below.

The Nell Gwynn house is perfectly located with a direct Tube to Heathrow. The building itself has a glamorous Art Deco vibe and an inviting lobby. The kitchen allows guests to economize by preparing meals. A handy supermarket and pharmacy add to the convenience. Matthew and his team use modern technology with a personal touch. Finally, the place was very clean. I can't wait to stay at the Nell Gwynn again!

Mingshu has to be one of the best hosts here. Very friendly, warm, helpful and kind. She made sure you have everything you need and assisted if you had any questions at all. The house is very quiet guaranteeing a good night’s sleep. Big beautiful kitchen if you fancy to prepare a meal and lovely shower with great water pressure. Highly highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment. It is a great location and the Golden Square Team is absolutely fantastic. Thank you. We will come back!

Starzeus is like a brother. So warm and supportive. He proactively helped me on everything even when he was sick.
I strongly recommend him as host to everyone.
Carlos was always quick to respond to any messages. The accommodation was exactly what we needed for our group of 5. Great host and very responsive!
Great value for money. Location was very easy to find and close to the central. Customer service 10/10, replied to our messages late friday evening. Definitely recommend

It has an amazing view that you can see the second you step into the place, the train station is right next to you which made it easier for us to get around and communication was perfect with the host and there’s a good couple food spots around where you are, would definetly stay again 😊

We enjoyed a couple of nights away in this lovely comfortable apartment. Communication was  great . The apartment was a 10-15 minute  walk to Willesden Green station for easy access to the underground and the local area was great for eating out and well stocked convenience stores. We Would definitely want to stay again. Thank you

Deanna’s flat was perfect for our short stay in London and made us feel right at home due to its lovely design and the small details that were paid attention to. Very important one: the converter for power plugs. Since there was one in the flat we didn’t have to buy one ourselves. :) We’re happy to come back!
Thank you for a nice stay! The host was welcoming, helpful and the location was also very comfortable.

Flat was spacious and had a balcony. Not much convenient in the area and about a 15 min walk to the knightsbridge or Sloan station. Two cool little pubs about a 10 min walk. Host was responsive to a few issues but overall not a terrible stay.

Alexey was a great host- he was quick to communicate and easy to work with. His flat was clean and comfortable and served as the  perfect home base for a trip over to London for three of us- the location was super easy to get wherever we needed! The flights of stairs are a bit narrow/ long so plan accordingly if traveling heavily!

Really nice all in one flat in a very good location, close to the tube and plenty of bus lines. Sandra and Nordine are super responsive and met us to show us the ins and outs of the flat. Would definitely recommend, especially for Arsenal fans!

I loved my stay here! The location was perfect and I was in close proximity to where I wanted to explore. The space was very clean and had a spacious feeling. Super modern but still had a warm feeling to it. I loved the glass roof in the living/kitchen area. Would 100% stay again and the hosts were lovely enough to offer a 10% discount if I book again which has definitely inspired me to book another trip soon. Thankyou so much!
The property is very near to stockwell metro station and easily accessible to other major attractions easily. The host was super supportive and kind. A Much recommendable stay.

lyisha was the perfect host: a quick responder, very friendly and always looking to accomodate anything you might need.
I was alone in the accomodation these few days and felt right at home in a very clean and cosy place with all you might need.
A splendid spot for visiting London with a bit more calm in your mornings and evenings.
Carey was a great host. The place is extremely conveniently located, next to the Stockwell tube station. Carey really took care of us and loved meeting the friendly dogs. Highly recommended!

Wonderful stay in a great location, walkable to so many restaurants, shops, pubs. Clean and Gio was so responsive to any requests. Highly recommend the flat  Quiet although on a very busy street. Would stay again when in London

Amazing place, the flat was even more spacious, modern and lovely in person. Very close to Canning Town tube station so getting around London was easy and straightforward and in a really nice area with shops for easy access. Spotless room with lots of amenities and a good view- balcony was an excellent addition! Host was helpful and never took long to respond. Would definitely recommend.

Me and my husband spent 3 weeks at Nina's apartment and it has become "home" for us quite soon. The apartment is nice and cozy, with a fully equipped kitchen, well organized spaces and enough room for two people to share comfortably even during stormy days.
The place is clean and well heated and the laundry ensures the possibility to travel in a lighter way. The neighborhood is quiet and although the area is not very central, it is very easy to move around with buses, as many stops are really close by.
Many services are close as well (supermarket, gym, parks).
Nina as been very responsive, always quick and on point, her descriptions are precise and detailed: what you see is exactly what you get.
We had a very good experience and we'd recommend for everyone wishing to stay this long and to experience a less touristy way to see London.
Just a 20 walk from Brixton o2 the bed is very comfortable, house smelled clean upon entry very satisfied

This might be the nicest, most well appointed AirBnb we have ever stayed in! Lovely touches everywhere. Huge bedrooms, lovely and big back garden, best kitchen with all necessaries..and much more. Chiswick is now our favorite neighborhood in London. Sandra is easy to reach, was very helpful and gracious with everything. Highly recommend !!
Excellent location short walk from Earl’s Court tube station.  Great neighborhood with many pubs, restaurants, cafes, and grocers in walking distance.

it was ok. some minor stains in sofa but had a bed sheet to cover it with.
Very warm
Lovely flat next to the river with tons of amenities right outside the door and great connections around London,  I highly recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Justin’s place. It was clean and as described. It was very quiet even though it was on a Main Street.  It was perfect for a family of three with a teenager traveling together. Justin let us check in early which we really appreciate after flying from Australia. A great place to base yourself to explore London with the tube and buses so close by. Thanks to Justin for making it so easy for us.

We stayed for two weeks and also worked remotely. We utilized the desk that was provided and the Internet was reliable for video calls. The location was amazing if you want more of a local feel - 5 coffee shops, 3 pubs, wine bar, restaurant, etc. on just one street a block over. It's about an 8 min walk to the closest underground station and a small M&S grocery store is about a 10 min walk as well. They were incredibly responsive and I felt like they wanted to make sure we were having an enjoyable experience. The pictures are SLIGHTLY different than how it is set up, some furniture has been moved around.

Me and my wife stayed here recently and had the best time. Flat is located in beautiful and  picturesque  Hampstead. All shops, bars and restaurants are walkable and Adam couldn’t have been more friendly and responsive and was the perfect host. Will definitely book again!

Sophie was very responsive. The flat is extremely quiet which we appreciated. There was an issue with the washing machine which she responded to and tried to fix as best she could. About a 10 min walk to tube stop and fair bit more for anything better than very casual restaurants. All in all we were happy with the place and would recommend it gladly.

Couldn’t ask for a better located house, right by the common and a short walk from Clapham junction with plenty of coffee shops and amenities nearby. Flat was very spacious and perfect for our needs. Host was very responsive and flat was very well equipped with everything we needed! Thank you.

A great place to base yourself for a visit to London. We walked from Clapham junction station which was about 15 mins when we arrived and then commuted in and out of London via Clapham common underground which is about 15 mins away also (by bus). A really clean, peaceful and fully appointed property that we really enjoyed. Instructions were very clear and access was a breeze. The beds were like clouds and with 2 bathrooms we were all really comfortable. Thanks Clare your property is amazing.
Great stay and hosting. Cara and Sarah were amazing 🙏🏻 recommended for any trips to the O2 Arena or local area
We had a comfortable  stay at Abi's. Flexible checking in was a bonus. 5mins walk to the nearest tube station. Will stay again next time in the city.

Absolute 10/10 location. Wonderful position to get to everything and layout of flat is perfect. Not very well fitted out however with rock hard beds, one towel each (6 night stay), very limited cooking utensils, no washing detergent and an early wake up everyday due to construction. Worth staying but ensure the venue is prepared for your needs.
Hannah was extremely helpful and replies quickly. The house is in a convenient place to commute to London. We would stay again at Hannah‘a place.

The place is incredibly cozy and is situated at a really nice location.  The flat is well secure and Victoria is incredibly responsive and welcoming. The kitchen is well equipped with everything and I can say the same for the bathroom. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a cozy place to stay in London since some major tube stations are just a few minutes walk away from the place.

Very enjoyed the time stay in Sandra’s place, everything is nice and perfect! Good place to have rest and go to Heathrow. Around 10mins walk to the Holloway Station, very convenient! Hope to come here again!
Fabio was very responsive and helped with whatever we needed. The space was so close to a tube station, easily connecting us to the rest of London!

The bed frame was really shaky and any slightest movements will result in a loud squeaky voice. The room’s description also didn’t mention that the bathrooms and toilets are shared. The walls are thin and can hear sounds from other apartments easily

Great location and great apartment! Very friendly host who provided amazing local recommendations for the area. The park is very close and is beautiful. Bus stop is very close with short ride to Oxford street. You can also walk 30 minutes through the park to natural history museum and winter wonderland. If you have a kid there is a wonderful playground nearby in the park. Thank you

We were visiting family for Christmas so this was perfect to be nearby but have our own space.
Had everything we needed and close to local shops.
Only negative was the mattress on the bottom bunk bed wasn't that comfortable but my niece is used to a firm mattress.
We absolutely loved this place and its location! Lindi was over and above helpful for us. We cannot wait to come back and wouldn’t bother looking for anywhere else to stay!

I have had some issues during my stay at this accommodation. If someone cares about a tidy place, I would not recommend it. However, the host’s response was very appropriate and kind, and he also suggested solutions to resolve the issues.
We had a decent stay here.  Location was a real five star.  House needs some real improvements and better cleaning too.  Otherwise was a great stay.
We had a wonderful time exploring London. Richard’s place was conveniently located near public transport.  We loved staying in a less touristy neighborhood.
Lovely stay. Clean and tidy I personally didn’t have any issues with noise outside but I am a heavy sleeper. Would stay again and recommend
Lovely house. couldn’t of asked for better hosts. Really appreciate it thank you 🙏

Nice place.  Quiet enough area.  15-minute walk to Surrey Quay shopping center and tube spot was easy.  Had everything we needed in the house.  Had to share walls with neighbors on both sides, which wasn't ideal, but so London.  Not near any action, but that was the whole point for our small family of four.  Recommended.
Great host, and the place was warm and clean. The flat is right over a tube line and so if the noise and vibrations from the trains will affect sleep then this isn’t the place!

Won’t stay here again. I love the area but this stay was missing lots of little things. Bad bed, smelled weird, and when I asked for information like what kind of coffee pods to bring for the coffee machine I was given the wrong answer and ended up with no coffee. It’s perhaps trivial, but something as easy as telling me the right coffee pods (or just providing some) goes a long way to making a stay enjoyable.
Tina is a friendly and warm host. She was really welcoming and kind. I definitely recommend staying with her. Moreover, the location of her place is extremely well connected.

The location is great. The house is a short walk to the rain station that links to London well.
Clean, comfortable and warm house.
The flat was easy to find and in a great location to get about London. The flat was comfortable and clean. There were no problems and would definitely stay again!
Good place to stay in London. The only thing was the check in time was later than advertised but otherwise very happy with the stay.

Anne is very kind and makes you feel at home immediately. She answers very quickly and helps if there are any questions. Everything was as described and the beds are super comfortable! We would definitely stay here again.
This was one of our favourite airbnbs so far. So cosy, beautiful, clean, good location and just perfect for a family holiday. 100% would recommend!

Great place in a great location!  The place was exactly as described & pictured.  And, Alex was a great communicator.  We were so appreciative that he was so accommodating and let us drop our bags early so we could sightsee.  Highly recommend this place!

Natalie’s place was absolutely perfect for our family of 6 for. Week over Christmas time. We had space for everyone to spread out when needed, and gather together when needed! Dining table was large enough for us plus our London family to gather for Christmas Eve and birthday celebrations, and the living room was cozy for playing games or watching a movie together. The location is excellent about an 11 min walk to the tube, but also easily accessible bus to Chiswick Road and anything you could ever need. Natalie is extremely responsive and helpful anytime. I highly recommend!

Would absolutely stay here again.
- Vas was very easy to communicate with and was flexible with us on check-in/check-out times. Excellent host
- Location was perfect, close to Regent's park and other restaurants/shops in Marylebone. Street is busy but felt safe
- Great TV, laundry machine, wifi, heat, and lighting
- Parts of the unit are a little cramped/aging, but everything was functional. The place easily accommodates a family of 4
- The small touches (coffee/tea, decorations, bathroom amenities) were really nice
Thanks Vas!

We had a great experience at Mariam’s place.
House is very clean, neat furniture and all supplies are available.
Location was amazing for us. Very quiet neighborhood, great Battersea park right in front, and not too far from central london.
Mariam was amazingly helpful and very responsive. She made our experience even better during the vacation.
Price was high, but I guess that’s London.
You can not beat the location, it is next to everything you need. Will be back again!
The host is amazing responds very quickly to any questions or queries. The location and accommodation was fantastic. Will recommend anyone wanting to stay in central London

Their home was immaculate and very much matched the description as well as the pictures. It was very clear that they take a lot of pride in their home. We greatly enjoyed our stay there. Also, they were very communicative and responded very quickly. I honestly cannot say I wouldchange anything about the experience.

What an amazing host!   Completely responsive - and so helpful with recommendations, travel tips, how tos, etc.   Made the trip easy and so less stressful.   The apartment is great and it’s a great location - apartment has an amazing view and is very clean.   It’s very quiet too - cannot hear neighbors or outside noise.

We had a lovely time at Calandra's. She was a great host from the beginning, very communicative, kind and helpful. We were in touch before our stay and during. She made sure we were settled in properly and even left us a welcome gift. The flat is very homey, bright and comfortable and we enjoyed staying in with our two children in the evenings. We used to leave in the area and were keen to stay near our closest friends. The flat ticked all the boxes and we would definitely recommend both Calandra as a host and her beautiful and cosy place. Thanks Calandra, we hope to stay in touch!!

Name on the flat was written incorrectly which caused minor issue when checkin. Other than that everything was fantastic: house is new,  clean, and has everything we need. Location is right next to underground station very convenient.
James was very responsive and friendly. The house was as expected given that it is a family home. The location and layout of the house was perfect for our family get together (ages 50 to 16).

Very comfortable. We had a safe and warm stay.
We had all the necessary amenities.
Ali was always available when needed.
Plus point to the parking slot in the front.
We will definitely book again.
Thank you for your services

We enjoyed staying in Tracy’s home - easy to get anywhere with the tube and bus just minutes away.
We enjoyed feeling like a local - trying neighbourhood cafes and restaurants.
The house is comfortable and cosy and has a well equipped kitchen.
Only things to note: the flat is on the second floor so if you’re adverse to stairs this is not for you and it is across the road from a busy police station so at times a bit noisy.
Thanks for hosting us Tracy we really enjoyed staying in your neck of the woods for our London week.

This flat is absolutely stunning, spacious, and easy to feel at home in. The bed was extremely comfortable and the cinema setup with projector and great sound system made watching films a major part of our time here.
The unit is only steps away from the overground in an otherwise quiet cul-de-sac, while being a couple minute walk from the heart of Greenwich. Truly great neighborhood.
Simone was a great host and we would definitely stay here again.

This flat is ideal for anyone wanting to stay in heart of buzzing and vibrant Angel. It is comfy and nicely decorated and the kitchen is well stocked. Atilla is really helpful and quick to respond and the flat is easy to find and access. Would definitely recommend!

We enjoyed our stay at Lorenzo’s place. The location is great, and everything is very walkable. The beds were comfortable and everything was as described. Our hosts were also very responsive. Would stay here again.

Jinny was an incredible host, always responsive and helpful.
Flat was very spacious and located very centrally 1 minute to the next subway station with lots of supermarkets and restaurants nearby.

I felt a really warm welcome, we “wowed” for hours about the beautiful room, and everything you need you can find it in the room, even some normal cold pills.
And they can store our luggages for hours before checkin and after checkout, which was really helpful.
And everytime I reached the host, she can reply in seconds and give us help.
Deb’s place was wonderful! Clean, tidy and great location. We enjoyed our stay here. Thank you again for having us :)

Great stay ! Lovely responsive host!
Great house ,nice location, had a shop next to it Incase you want to buy something ! There are supermarkets nearby and fast food eateries across the street !
Really peaceful stay here. Great, communicative, hosts who made it all a smooth process. Would definitely stay again.

My two teenagers and I loved our stay at Ant's place. The apartment is fabulous - even better than the pics show it - and with beautiful views. It's located in a great spot - an easy walk to the Bethnal Green Tube and walkable to other parts of East London like Brick Lane/ Whitechapel, Hackney and Bow, which we really enjoyed exploring. It's also an easy connect from Bethnal Green Tube (Central Line) to other parts of the city. Ant is a lovely host - friendly, generous and proactive. It was great to
come home to Ant's place after a day of exploring and to be able to do our laundry, cook for ourselves and just chill out in a gorgeous space. One of the best AirBnB experiences I've ever had - highly recommend (and thanks Ant) 🙌🏼

The house is wonderful for its age, character and history. We really appreciated the library and all the quirks and general history of the house itself. Some of us went on a quick trip to All Saints Church cemetery in Edmonton to see Charles and Mary Lamb's graves ... because the house provoked an interest to see and know more.
It has many quirks - but these are so well explained by the hosts - so you know about them before you come. The character and joy of the house totally made up for the quirks. Size was great - for our family group of 7 it was ideal - plenty of space to eat and hang out and individual nooks and crannies where people could do their own thing.

Rosemary’s flat was an amazing place to serve as home while staying in london. It had everything we needed and was much more spacious than expected while still having a cosy, homely feel to it. It was one of the easiest check in and check out experiences i’ve ever had and was an excellent location too. Would absolutely recommend to anyone looking to stay a short distance from central london but wanting to have a small, quiet village feel. 10/10 host

Unfortunately not a great stay! The check in and check out location is a good 10 min away, which when you’re short of time and have heavy bags, really wasn’t ideal.
I had an incident also during my stay where I was locked inside the flat after using the security lock, with no info in the house manual on how to unlock it! I tried to contact the number of the listing, but it instantly disconnected. I then called the emergency line the host listed, waited on hold for nearly 20 minutes and then the line disconnected! I ultimately found a YouTube video that helped me but when the host finally replied, they just said the maintenance team would look into it.
It was clear that the Airbnb was owned and run by a company, but the whole process was really odd and the lock in experience and check in/check out location really let it down.
The flat itself is basic but does the job.

We enjoyed our stay so much! Billie and Max were very helpful and responsive, location was great close to the tube and bus stations! Safe area as well. The same as the photos. The only thing is the walls are very thin and you can hear everything to the people next to you/above you. But we were out and about most of the stay so it wasn’t a big deal. Would definitely stay again!

My boyfriend and I enjoyed our stay at VanZyl’s place! The flat is beautiful and clean. The location is great with a quick walk to Camden town and the tube. Lots of great restaurants and shops close by!
Justyna was an excellent host. Everything was clear and she was quick with responses to messages. Will be booking through Justyna again for our next stay

Very nice apartment in very good position and very friendly host. Everything was great.
Definitely recommended!!
In my opinion for 5 people is quite stretched (sofa and the additional mattress are better for single use).
Bed mattress was pretty soft but at the end we were so tired after walking all day that we slept fine anyway.
Great location, perfect spot for our travel needs. Very easy to access with clear instructions.  Cozy location for the two of us.

10/10! Felt right at home. 1 of my favorite Airbnb’s I have stayed in thus far. The place is cozy, clean and well located. George was fantastic! He walked me through everything, very detailed! I would definitely recommend Paolo’s place!

Everything was very good with the apartment. Comfortable bed, sufficient space, good location. My only issue was some plates and pots were dirty and I needed to wash them up before eating. Host was very apologetic and I am sure this will be addressed in future
The flat is located on the lower ground with a lift. Small but useful. Doesn’t have a window for fresh air. Good helpful communication from the management team.

This was an absolute steal! In the heart of a great location with multiple restaurants near and close to a main train station. It was easy to find and get into the place. I would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment was amazing! It had so many great amenities and the location couldn’t have been better—prime spot! Having one and a half bathrooms was definitely a bonus. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

The host communicated very well and had no problems with checking in and out. The host offered their main office for us to leave our luggage which was super helpful. I could not find anything wrong about this place. It was beautiful and super clean! The location was perfect, everything was within walking distance.

Juste’s home is beautiful and clean, which I really appreciated. Unfortunately the room was at 14°C when I checked in late at night, the device showing it had not been heated for at least a week. The first night was very cold as the heating did not rump up (although set at a higher temperature). I think that’s a shame as the host later told me they were able to set the temperature remotely. I believe that, in winter time, heating in the room ought to be on for a guest’s arrival. Otherwise, as I said, beautiful and clean.
Lovely little place in a wonderful location. Note that the pictures show two different apartments; there is only a single room in the apartment. Great all the same though. Recommended

This was my second stay at her house. Everything was perfect as before. The room and it’s bathroom were clean and tidy. As I mentioned in my previous review, it's only 5 minutes from Wood Street Station. Thank you Evelyn 🙏🏽

What a gorgeous place!
Very homey & an incredible space
Kyri was a fabulous host always responsive and very proactive
1000% recommend staying here you will NOT be disappointed!

I had an amazing stay at this charming apartment! The place was spotlessly clean, well-decorated, and had all the amenities you could need. The location was perfect - close to both Maida Vale and Little Venice, making it super easy to explore the city or just enjoy a tranquil walk by the canal. The host was incredibly responsive and welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy and convenient base in London!

Vas was an excellent host. Very responsive and accommodating. Marylebone can be a noisy area, but the flat had bedrooms in the rear of the unit and they were extremely quiet with blackout shades. The flat was homey and stocked well. The location for us could not have been better. Extremely walkable with close access to charming Marylebone High Street. Restaurants close by. Even better was the easy access to Baker Street Tube station and numerous popular bus routes. Couldn’t recommend it higher.

Perfect for what we needed while working away .
Ali was always on the phone if needed etc

If you’re looking at staying here, DO IT! Michael’s place is even more beautiful than in the photos. The place was very spacious and clean which is rare to find. The neighborhood is very private with many walkable areas. Westfield shopping mall is in walking distance as is the metro. I would definitely stay here again!
Fantastic flat in a beautiful part of London (Chelsea) near the river with good access into central London.

There was a bit of issue initially communicating but the host kindly accommodated my request to drop off the luggage early.  The place small but is very clean and comfortable.  Recommend for a single female traveler.
Alex was a fantastic host and was very accommodating to our request for an early check in! Would absolutely recommend!
I had a great time in London and could get some good rest at Olushola‘s place. Thanks for having me!
Second time I stayed in one of Max and Billie’s studios. Really enjoyed it again! Place is just like the photos and the description. Communication with the hosts is very good aswell!
Nice flat, clean, warm and comfortable.  The host was very responsive.  All good.

This was a great apartment for our family holiday to London. Great views, very close to transport and a supermarket and only a few kms from some major attractions. Very secure which was also big priority for us. Despite being close to train lines, we never really heard them. Would recommend staying here.

Stewart was super quick to respond and the place was lovely. The location is a short walk to St Margarets train station which made it quick to travel into central London. Recommend this little oasis outside the hustle and bustle of London.

This was a great flat for a few days in London, doubly so if you are planning to attend an Arsenal game as the flat is right next to Emirates Stadium (fortunately down a quieter side street). There are plenty of restaurants and cafes within 5-10 minutes walking, as well as a small grocery store on the same block. The flat was spotless and matched the description and pictures in the listing. Finally, Sandra and Nordine were very helpful and quick to respond to any inquiries. I’d gladly stay here again and would recommend the same to others looking for a place to stay in North London!
Great location with fast access to public transport. The appartment was clean and perfect for us. It was a great stay!
Excellent place to stay loved it very clean very comfortable 💯 stay here again no problem great price too for London

Overall a bit disappointed. The furniture doesn't match the photos - in particular the sofa has been replaced with something very low and uncomfortable. The shower slider is broken.
More importantly, the place wasn't completely clean - there was some litter on the floor from a previous resident and strange green marks on the draining board. It's hardly the end of the world but there was no way for me to clean - I had to go out to buy cloths and cleaner (I see I'm not the first to have to do this). Cleaning materials are a pretty basic requirement.
There are no plugs for the sinks, but that seems standard in most London Air B&Bs - I wonder where they all go?
Location is excellent and surprisingly quiet at night.

Beautiful place located in the center so very much appreciated. Room is wonderfully decorated and it felt like a dream in there for a week.
Thank you:)

Second time staying at Elena's! Just as good as we remember it. Lots of space, access to great back yard if you want to stay at home. Close to everything Muswell Hill has to offer - great restaurants, shops etc...Easy access to transportation. We'll be back !

Tonia’s place is awesome! My gf and I had a lovely time for a week and feel very welcome. Everything is well placed and equipped. And Tonia always respond messages in time and is a warm person with a thorough sense. We enjoyed here very much and will come again the next time!

Paolo was an exceptional host and even accommodated us by storing our luggage post checking out of the property. The place had everything we needed for our short stay, and is in a great location! Highly recommend!
I had a great stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Tina was communicative and made sure everything went smoothly. I’d definitely stay here again!
Very close to West Kensington metro, plenty of cafes and shops near by. Apartment was clean and did the job.
Unfortunately the accommodation was untidy, dirty and unhygienic and we had to change locations after 1 night
Herman was a great host, easy to deal with and communicative. Room was clean. Bathroom and kitchen not so clean. Water in Shower not 100% functional.

A wonderful home from home ideally situated for easy access to my customers. Hazel, Simon and Franky were amazing and made me feel right at home.
Thank you for accommodating my special dietary needs and for washing my clothes at short notice. I’ll definitely check for availability the next time I’m down.
Thanks so much

The place was OK but just to sleep. The flat needs some improvements and furniture & mattress are very old. On the day I left there was no running hot water.
The room is extremely noisy as it's facing a footbal field with people training until 10pm.
Christian was very nice and helpful.

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! I needed to extend my stay, and Tina accommodated me right away, which I really appreciated. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Excellent communication and a smooth experience overall. Highly recommend!

The host keeps the prices low and than after checkout send extra payment request and outrageous allegations to claim money.
Keeps calling and messages.
Ridiculous behaviour. All the items in the fridge were expired and my kid was almost going to drink expired milk. Mould on all eatables. First says check out max at 3 pm and than deletes the message but took a screenshot. And claim lost revenue for not leaving on time. Terrible experience.

Me and My parents enjoyed staying at the apartment, the surrounding is great, private and peaceful ...Ayub was very friendly and supportive so we didn't have any hard time communicating with him....everything went well

Amazing host. Vas answers his messages very fast. He even accepted me to buy more kitchen appliances which he reimbursed immediately. The apmt was big, clean and in an amazing central area of London. I highly recommend it and will for sure go back next time I travel to London
This was a great stay. Felt a lovely homely flat with interesting interior. Very comfortable. Exactly like the photos, and communication answered very quickly.
The place was great and close to the trains. Host was very helpful and accommodating. Great options for dining and drinks in the area.
Nice apartment in a great location.  Very spacious with many amenities. Would definitely stay again. The host was very responsive and even delivered a baby bed for us after hours.

The apartment was absolutely beautiful, mine and my partners style completely and it gave us decor/colour ideas for our future home. The room was so cosy and tranquil, a lovely escape from the hustle and bustle of outside. We couldn’t recommend the stay enough, when in the area again we will definitely be returning 🤍

Shaz was very responsive and helpful with the booking.
Place is good for a short stay for 2 people with a well equipped kitchen. Toilet is small but manageable. Was nice to find some hair products and soap!
Wi-Fi was not powerful.

My friends and I traveled to London for the first time, and Edo’s place was perfect for us! The apartment is very modern and beautiful. Everything felt very new and clean. The train and buses are all within walking distance. I would definitely recommend booking!
Amazing stay with an amazing host!  She accommodated everything for us, even a midnight check in when we got delayed getting to town.  Awesome place to stay!

Location was good,  and apartment was as depicted in the listing. Do note that there are two flights of stairs to climb. The host was however unresponsive to any of my texts asking if we could do an early check in or drop off our luggage.

Gunalan was incredibly responsive, friendly, polite, and respectful. He had a great sense of humour and made my stay in his apartment enjoyable and comfortable . The apartment was spotless, well-prepared, modern, and exactly as showcased. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would recommend it a thousand times over. I will definitely be visiting again without a doubt.

Everything was perfect except a noise. Earpod is necessary.
If a noise will be solved, I will use this place again.
Great place and good value. Walking distance to Notting Hill, which has good spots to eat and shop. Main London areas are close via metro.

Mary was very helpful and place was very neat and tidy. definitely recommend and will be back for more holidays. Peaceful location and near to local station . Over all very responsible host and good place .
Ellie was an exceptional host! Great communication and hospitality! The airbnb was in an incredible location - would thoroughly recommend it!
The property is spacious with a great view and in a good spot for access to transport and Canary Wharf.

Great location for young travelers. Streets get noisy at night due to fun pubs below but you can sleep well with the ear plugs provided. Located close to Chinatown so there’s plenty of great restaurants and Michelin spots to try. WiFi was super slow and the shower water didn’t stay hot long but overall the location and easy checkin /checkout were great. Love that they have a washer too!
Great location, Parimo was great at communicating and really responsive, the flat was cozy and true to photos, the only down side was the beds, they weren’t comfortable at all.
Great stay! Room is spacious, bed is extremely comfortable, and everything was clean. Cold water in the fridge was a treat. James was very accommodating and quick to respond.

A small, modern apartment in a superb location just a short walk from Hampstead underground station. The area felt safe and was surprisingly quiet at night. Check in was easy and communication was good. Recommended.

Had a great stay The host was friendly and made check-in easy without face-to-face interaction, which I appreciated. They left chocolates, biscuits, and even coffee for the morning. The apartment was cozy with a great view, plenty of towels, and two bottles of water. Outstanding 5-star customer service

The perfect perfect place to stay! Hannah was so lovely and accommodating right from booking all up until our stay. The flat is absolutely lovely and very spacious - had so much room! Would definitely recommend staying here you will not be disappointed.

Perfect location for sightseeing and very quiet considering it's location.
Communication from the host was excellent and very responsive with any questions.
Would definitely book again and recommend.
Absolutely fantastic accommodation.  The room was clean, cozy, and charming as possible.  Highly recommend.
Great host who is extremely responsive ! The airbnb is within walkable distance of Vauxhall. So pretty centrally located and easy to get around. Highly recommend :)
Mos place was a good option for a short trip to London. the place is clean and it looks as in the pictures. Loved it is walking distance to Euston.
Lovely stay for our surveyors working in the area. Will definitely go back in the future!

Matthew's flat is ideally located on Ledbury Road in Notting Hill, close to some of London's finest restaurants, including The Ledbury, Caractère, and Dorian. Public transport links are excellent, with buses to central London and easy access to tube lines. The flat itself is pristine, clean, well-equipped, and thoughtfully laid out, providing everything needed for a short to medium-term stay. The host is exceptionally helpful. Highly recommended.
Very nice place the only thing was that were some kind of   works in the building and a some point is was getting annoying the noise. the rest overall all good .
Thank you very much, I had a very nice stay, the one lace was clean and very well connected to the center. I recommend it.
I had a lovely stay at Imran's. I 💯 recommend him. Thanks Imran 🙂

Max is an exceptional host who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. He was incredibly considerate, arranging early check-in when we arrived and late checkout for our evening flight. Communication was always prompt and clear.
The apartment itself is spotlessly clean and well-maintained, with amazing views and great natural light. The location is absolutely prime - we loved being within walking distance to three charming bookstores, cafes and countless fantastic food options in the neighborhood.
The space is peaceful and comfortable, despite being in such a central location. Everything worked perfectly, and Max's detailed instructions made our stay seamless. Would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a perfect London base. Thank you for being such a thoughtful host!
A couple of square metres that feel like Tulum in the middle of London. Everything was very welcoming and we felt very cozy. The moss on the walls is very unique.
Prajesh was really lovely and made accommodations to suit my stay! Property is amazing and had many amenities. Very spacious and inviting. Would definitely recommend for larger groups!
We had a lovely experience celebrating a birthday. Would definitely stay again & Jaqua was a great host.
Great stay. Exactly what I needed for when I was in London for a course. Microwave worked but timer didn’t. Mild inconvenience as I just used the timer on my phone!
I enjoyed my stay. Instructions were clear and check in was easy. It was exactly the same as the photos. I’ll definitely recommend.

Apartment was very clean and has everything needed for a week stay. We had great communication with the hosts, they even find a solution where to leave our luggage on the last day.
Location is great - just on the river, walking distance to Big Ben. Just on Vauxhall tube, opposite bus station, 3 supermarkets within a 5 min walk.
Nice restaurants and take away near by.
Overall excellent place if you are visiting London as a tourist.

We had a great time staying at Adam's flat in Hampstead. The flat is very well located in central Hampstead, near the no. 46 bus stop. It's light, quiet and as described. Adam met us at check in and was very helpful. We hope to be back. Ross and Anthony.

Our stay at this flat was very comfortable. The location was perfect, as it was only a 15 minute walk from Hyde Park and near two tube lines. Lots of restaurants could be found around it as well.
The landlords were helpful and quick to respond to our questions.
The flat was clean and well organised, excepct for some water damage in the bathroom and an agressive smell from the drains. This smell was our only issue with the flat.

I had a wonderful stay at Sancha’s. The bed was comfortable, and the room was well-equipped with everything I needed. I especially appreciated the refreshments table. The bathroom was spotless, which made my stay even more enjoyable. Sancha was kind, flexible, and incredibly empathetic, making me feel truly welcome. I would definitely stay here again!

This is an outstanding well designed, sophisticated flat just off Oxford Street… I could hardly believe about this Joker I booked almost accidentally.
Super comfortable living room, airy and bright with a large Sofa, 70 inch TV. My bathroom was super cool with shower and tub, exclusive fittings and Hotel style towels, soap and linen. The bedroom was quiet, I slept like an angel.
I loved to communicate quickly and efficiently with the host, everything was easy to arrange, lovely personal check in, the manager keeps the place in a super clean shape. Everyone will absolutely love this home, I was traveling with my partner, but an ideal home for families or couples traveling together.
Stellar host! Really good alternative to  staying in proper London. The flat was great, modern, and easy to navigate.

Shelly's small apartment was perfect for three people for a few days of exploring London. Tower Bridge is just a 30-minute walk away, and there are bus stops and a metro station nearby. The apartment is located in a very quiet area, where you might even see foxes. The kitchen had everything needed to prepare an English breakfast. The apartment was warm and comfortable for sleeping, even when it was only 2 degrees outside. Thank You!

Incredibly affordable! Nice studio with everything we needed. Direct train next to London Victoria (ten minutes) with a 10 minute walk to the station. East Croyden was a place within walking distance of everything - we enjoyed it here. Extra plus for clear instructions on directions, check-in and other. We will return!

Anne’s room was spot on. It was a lovely place to stay and Anne was a very good host.
I would recommend staying.
It was a good place to stay!!! Maybe having a broom and a broom shovel would have been very useful to clean the dust on the floor.,!! Very thankful.,!!!
The apartment was centrally located and the room was very spacious.  Clean and comfortable for one night, no issues.  Host provides excellent access instructions too.
good area, cute space, although i will note the wifi connection is terrible and service isn't amazing either but it's not that big of a deal to me

Stayed here for a week whilst working in London. Lovely and super private place in London which for me has been really hard to find over the years
The apartment was super clean on arrival. Ana was a super host with clear instructions on how to get in.The private and secure parking was a super plus for me with my work van and staying London!! The apartment has everything you need and more for cooking and has your everyday needs covered!!
Tube was a 15 min walk away same as the gym with loads of pubs and restaurants 5 mins walk away!!
Ana is a 5 star host don’t pass up on staying here if you working or just visiting London
Will be booking again if I’m working in London

We had a fabulous stay here! It's a lovely apartment and feels very homely and cosy. The beds are comfy and the kitchen had everything we needed. Martina was really helpful and responsive. The batteries in the TV remote control ran out on the first night and Martina had some delivered the next morning so that it wouldn’t impact our stay. The TV in the bedroom isn’t a smart TV so needs something plugged into it but this wasn't an issue for us. Only a 15 minute walk to the tube station with shops close by/along the way. We would definitely stay here again!
Sam & Nidhi were great hosts. They were always very responsive and friendly. The location is excellent.
Great spot right near everything worth seeing. Easy to find and quick walk to all parts shoreditch + overground

Great location near good restaurants and shops.
The number 360 bus was opposite and frequent.

Had an amazing weekend here, so convenient as the DLR was just outside as well as shops and place to eat. Very clean, had all the amenities listed, the host was always responsive, check in and out process was simple; we didn’t have any issues. We would love to stay here again!!
Thank you, our stay went very well. The place is spacieux and the room are nice
Great apartment for staying with friends, comfy beds and good sitting room area. nearby Old Street so handy for anyone staying east!

Daniela was a kind, very responsive and flexible host . We appreciated being able to leave a little later on Sunday morning.
The bedrooms and bathrooms were immaculate however the kitchen and dining area which was cluttered and tired-looking.
It was also a shame that we couldn’t get the hot water system to work so that we all have a hot shower in the morning.

A great place to stay. Excellent area with restaurants and cafes very nearby. 10 min walk to the Underground station and just a few stops needed to get to most places you want to visit
Will hopefully stay again in the future.

Paolo was a perfect host. We received a very friendly welcome and were allowed to leave our luggage before check-in. Paolo was also extremely flexible when we checked out, thank you very much!
The apartment is perfect, equipped with everything you need. Oxford Street and many central points are within walking distance, as well as a supermarket and many cafes and restaurants. We would happily stay with Paolo again anytime.
Jason’s place was very convenient - located close to Excel center and was very spacious.  Multiple bedrooms with more than 1 bed.  He was very flexible and always responsive as a host.  A+

Usman was a super host. he went above and beyond to accommodate us. Parking was easy, and the building was easy to get into. the location was perfect, a stone throw away from the station and portobello market.
The flat was very clean and with everything you need and more, full of character and stunning high ceilings, very cleverly designed. Definitely will be staying here again. It felt like home!

The perfect location for attending an event at the O2, just a couple of minutes walk to the cable car & less than 15mins walk from Canning & Custom House train stations. The apartment is a great space, spotlessly clean & with views of the O2 from the balcony.
We don’t know the area but found more than anticipated, with the Excel Centre at the end of the road, a Tesco Express a short distance away, along with restaurants and a lovely semi permanent pop up street food market.

A stunning apartment in such a great location. Perfect base for public transport nearby - plenty of bus and tube options.
Very comfortable beds and hot showers too. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby - good for groceries. Recommend the deli across the roundabout for yummy pastries and fruits for breakfast. Matthew was a responsive and friendly host. Communication great too. Would definitely use Matthew’s place for future visits!
He is a great host and the place is nice! Recommend to stay when u visit London. London street and selfridges just 10-15 mins walk from the house.

The room was nice along with the rest of the apartment. The lockbox would not open when checking in with no communication from host, only the cleaner. This unfortunatly delayed my plans for the evening, but despite that I was appreciative for the cleaners communication and was able to come to the apartment relatively quick. The location is great public transport wise, tubes and busses are 8 minute walk away max, although at night it can get quite loud from outside.

The place was great. Would definitely go back if I needed to be in the area, felt more like a hotel with all the amenities. Really enjoyed my stay.
But full transparency because I think it’s important to know: My information got stolen & I had a woman texting me claiming to be from the company & saying I needed to re-confirm my bank details or my booking will be cancelled. She had all my personal details to confirm she knew the booking. But because Airbnb says to only communicate through the app, I never gave any info so I’m safe. But this was very scary. The company of this listing did email to apologise about the situation. Just thanking God I wasn’t dumb.

Pictures are a little outdated and the apartment can use a bit of love
The apartment is spacious enough for a solo traveller, and location is pretty good for access to public transport
The service is wonderful. Kerisha has done a good job. I am looking forward to come back soon
stayed here with my son for a trip away to London. the flat had everything we needed for our trip and was close to the tube. would look to stay again if we're down again.

Excellent place!
We were warmly welcomed by George, who kindly explained the basics and gave us great recommendations for our stay in London.
The apartment is small but charming, with everything you need for a stay in this wonderful city. It’s located in a great area with the Underground nearby. Nice neighborhood, good shops, and excellent hospitality.
We highly recommend it to everyone and would definitely come back!

I stayed here not long ago and had a last minute trip come up and was able to stay again and had another great stay. I think this will be my go to place to stay when I’m down for work if it’s available. Spacious , homely and comfortable . The little details like secondary glazing show the thought that’s gone into making this a relaxing place to stay. I was surprised how quiet it was in such a central location . Look forward to visiting again !

Overall the apartment was great.
The only downside was the shower. The temperature dial did not work and it was really hot + the shower door is missing which makes the entire bathroom extremely wet which lead to mold on the ceiling
Great location but flat could use some repairs (lights in main room flickered, shades on windows were broken, etc)
Great location, Ellie was very good at replying at any time, answering questions swiftly and helpfully. Would stay again.
Brilliant location a stone’s throw from London Bridge and Borough Market. Flat was comfortable and ideal for what we wanted. Thank you!

This Airbnb exceeded my expectations. The cleanliness was top-notch, the bedroom was generously sized, and the bathroom & kitchen’s cleanliness was a highlight. But what truly made the stay special was the amazing host, who went above and beyond to ensure I had a comfortable and pleasant visit.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly accommodating, friendly, and quick to respond to any questions, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. The apartment itself was spotless, just as described in the listing, and located in a great area. A special touch was the complimentary snack basket, which was such a thoughtful and appreciated gesture. Overall, a fantastic stay—I would definitely book again!

Really cute place!
We had a really nice stay. The flat is super clean and cosy, and in a beautiful area too.
Well connected with the tube at 2 minutes and buses to Notting Hill.
The only thing were the other guests, a little too noisy during quiet hours.

Great place to stay,the house was clean and you gonna find everything what you need,Close to shops, bus stop and DLR station.
The host was very responsive.Definitely recommend.
The Airbnb is located in the heart of all the action. It’s above a pub, The noise at night made it very hard to sleep.  This when on to about 2:00 to 3:00 in the morning.

I booked this apartment for my parents and they absolutely loved it. James and his team were very communicative which I appreciate, all intrusions were very clear. The apartment was spacious, clean and they had everything they needed. Will book again in future. Thank you.
Very good location and clean house!  Host very responsive. All we need was there. Only issue was heating, that could be a bit better.

The stay at Mo‘s place was wonderful. Alessa answered any questions quickly and both her and Mo were very lovely in person. Due to the flexibility on the day I could even leave my luggage a bit longer in the room before leaving. Thank you so much for the pleasant stay - total recommendation!
Matthew's place was modern, spotless, comfortable, and in a great location. He was one of the most responsive and caring hosts I've had. I highly recommend.

it was a great spot, very clean and organized, the shower was hot. Artur answered always very quickly any question.
The localization is very good, at Zone 2, less than 10' by foot from Bricklane and Shoredish, the coolest places at London. The tube was 10' away, 3 diferents lines, including Elisabeth Line, straigh foward from Heathrow.
I recomend 100%.

We loved Anthony’s apartment. It is well located, and a great space with everything that one could need. In addition he is a very friendly and responsive host. As is evident from all of the reviews, his apartment is ideal for all those wishing to be in central London and particularly those seeking a long-term stay.
The flat is in a tower block of council housing in a large social housing area that is not safe to walk around alone at night. The inside of the flat was as described and very comfortable.
Great apartment in a quieter part of London, super easy to get around the city. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Excellent location. A bit noisy in the morning (construction or similar) but nothing out of the ordinary. Apartment is beautiful and matches the description very well. Very comfortable beds. Sofa i bit stiff but that's snormal.
Quiet in the evenings.
Missed coat hangers. I think we spotted one in the whole apartment. 5 people (3 teenagers) so we missed a 2nd bathroom but that's on us. Feels recently renovated, and it is very nice, but perhaps not top notch in all details. Cleaning was ok, some of the kitchenware should have gone another round in the dishwasher.
But overall, a really nice place to stay for a few days.

I had a great stay.The flat was beautiful and very clean. It had all the amenities you would want.
I loved the full bath and big TV. Shaileen was always helpful and responsive to any questions I had which was great. I really liked the flat because it was so safe and secure. I would definitely go back to stay again.

I had a great stay at Anne's place! Location is well connected by buses which bring you to the main metro stations. The neighbourhood is lovely and felt very secured. The bed was comfy and very clean, so I slept like a baby.
Overall, Anne is a great host who made sure I have everything I need to have a pleasant stay!

This was possibly the best Airbnb we have stayed in! If you want luxury of a hotel but the comfort of home, this is it.
The space is incredible with a full kitchen, shower, washing machine and more. The addition of a smart TV and fast internet meant we could work from home when needed and we had entertainment for the nights we weren’t out.
I honestly couldn’t have picked a better place to stay and Michael and Kelli were great hosts.
Thanks again!
Great, quiet location and a clean space. Perfect for a couple or solo traveler. Walkable to really good restaurants and the British museum. Would definitely recommend!
The flat was great and Olushola was a really good host! I'm glad that the flat was in a lovely and safe area and would happily stay again! :)
Everything was perfect and perfectly explained. Marijana was super reactive for any question or doubt. Thank you so much!

Staying at Alexey's place was a delight. We were there almost two weeks to go to theater, music performances, and museums. Often the theater was only a 5 minute walk away and restaurants were everywhere as well as good grocery stores for supplies to eat at home. This was our best stay in London and I know that was due to the location! It was also very quiet once we were inside and the bed and sofa were comfortable. Thank you, Alexey!  I would highly recommend to anyone who wants to actively experience all that London has to offer.

Ana was super friendly throughout, went out of her way to help us with the best route to take with multiple options for transport throughout our stay.
Inside was beautiful with a fabulous of outside space!
Had everything we needed for our stay to be comfortable: would absolutely stay again;
Thank you so much Ana it’s was a pleasure.
Everything was fine. Nice and quiet place, close to the centre of Twickenham and to the stadium (15 minutes walk).
This is a small but nice, clean and well located place to stay in. The host is very nice and replies quickly.

Jadin is a friendly host who received us very well and made us feel welcome at his stay. He insisted we feel the place to be like our home. The place has all the listed amenities, we cooked multiple times and ate our Indian food which we so dearly missed. The place is literally next to Langdon park DLR station and we have a bus stop right opposite to the stay. Good frequency of buses and trains to Central London.

I had a really nice stay in this apartment. Parveen and Shoban were reactive and flexible, despite my late arrival. The apartment was clean and well-furnished. It was very close to Horseroad Station (Victoria Line), which made the access to the city center easy and convenient. There was also a supermarket and a few shops nearby. This apartment was ideal for my trip, with a great quality/price ratio.

Exceptional apartment close to the city. Walking distance to Clapham Junction.  Maria was extremely helpful and went out of her way to accommodate us. The apartment is  very well set up for toddlers. Our boy was right at home.
Affordable, Convenient, Clean. Everything was perfect. I would like to come back again. Thank you very much !

Excellent appartment located in the heart of Shoreditch.
During my stay there was construction noise in the building. Otherwise I would have given 5 Stars. Branca was responsive and offered a solution.

Monica was a wonderful host--friendly and very quick to respond to any questions. Her flat is lovely, and had all the amenities you'd need. I was there for a convention at London Olympia, and her flat was a pleasant 10 minute walk--so the location couldn't have been better. It's also close to the underground and overground trains. Sadly, I didn't get to spend time in her garden or very cute conservatory/dining room. The bed was incredibly comfortable--which is important when one is on a business trip! I would stay at Monica's lovely home again.
Fantastic location by Hyde park with access to multiple bus/subway accesses nearby and very spacious. We had a good stay with 7 of us comfortably.

This was my third stay at her house. Everything was perfect as before. The room and its bathroom were clean and tidy. As I mentioned in my previous review, it's only 5 minutes from Wood Street Station. Thank you, Evelyn 🙏🏽
Perfect location for us. Very well appointed house, kitchen in particular. We had a really good stay and would recommend

Right from the first phone call to Harv i knew how good this property was going to be and how responsive he was going to be. This property is to a very high standard and is most definetly  home to home. Spotlessly clean and well stocked with all you need. Highly recommend this house and will definetley return.

As neat of a spot as it gets. The flat is a vibe, and so is the area. Go check it out!
Spacious, light, right next to the canal.

The place was perfect for what we required, the only trouble was the Phone key to get in , which was my own fault as I missed the email.
They was quick in replying and helping out when required!
Fully recommended!
Carolyn was such a lovely host, always quick to respond to questions and had such a lovely flat. Would definitely recommend to any who is visiting London as the location is fab as well.

She is an amazing host . She’s very responsive and very kind and helpful . Helped me to get their gave directions. Also cooked a really yummy meal for me. The room was very nice and clean and very spacious. The bathroom was very clean. Best price for the value for someone Iike me who travelled to London on a budget
we loved the whole of the stay! beautiful home in a great location. Victoria was very responsive and gave good instructions of how to get there and access. very flexible with check in and out too!

Amazing place - great central
Area close to public transportation , plenty of cute places to eat and walk around . The place had 5 bedrooms , each with their own bathroom which was super impressive and convenient since we were a large group . Would definitely stay here again !

We had a very pleasant stay in Raphael’s place. It’s located in a beautiful and peaceful neighborhood, short walking distance (6-12 minutes) to restaurants, grocery stores and public transportations (Paddington station, bus 94 and 205, two metro stations etc.).  Convenient self checkin and checkout, and we were able to get an early check in too, very flexible and friendly host!

Our stay at Shlome’s place was great. Shlome was a great host who regularly enquired if we were doing ok and needed anything. Shlome also let us checked out a bit later on our departure day without additional cost. Communication was great and easy. Shlome’s place was very comfy, clean and spacious!
Highly recommend !
Great location, perfect for Wembley events, clean, good facilities and excellent communication from host.

I had an amazing stay at Pawel’s place.
From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The home was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The bed was incredibly cozy, and the space was thoughtfully stocked with little extras like coffee, toiletries, and local recommendations.
The location was perfect, close to my workplace yet quiet and peaceful for a good night’s rest. Communication with Pawel was seamless; he was responsive, friendly, and truly went above and beyond to ensure I had a great experience.
Looking forward to staying here again in the future.

I very much enjoyed my time here! It is a perfect
part of england so that everything was in walking distance!
It was my third time at Paolo’s brilliant flat, and once again couldn’t fault it. Looking forward for the next time!

I had such a lovely stay at Adam's place. It was the perfect respite I needed after traveling for more than a month before heading back home to the states. Great location with tons of places to shop, eat, and hang out. Adam was extremely communicative and expertly helped me navigate how to enter the apartment when I arrived. Thanks so much!

The location is perfect if you want to be in the premier shopping district of London. Everything is easy to get to. The place is surprisingly quiet for being right on Oxford Street. We very much enjoyed the location.
I was very happy to enjoy a few nights. It's a  great location , easy to every where.
The host was super friendly and made check-in really easy. The flat was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. Would definitely recommend!
Huge room with plenty of space in a great location for Canary Wharf, O2 and the city.
I had a great stay at Sandra's place.  Very spacious double room, everything was clean and tidy. The area is very quiet and close to public transport. Would definitely recommend.

We picked this spot as our last night of stay before ending the trip. The flat is located about 20 walk from Kingcross, accessible by foot, bus or metro, very convenient. For those with large/heavy luggages, this flat is on the 2nd floor with stair, we booked knowing this info so it wasn’t a problem for us. The flat is equipped with everything Travellers would need, highly recommended.
Was a very nice view from the apartment at night times, decent gym to use as well, all round good place

This was perfect for my needs when visiting a friend. A comfortable, private and well presented room in a nice quiet residential street, a stone’s throw from the bustle and vibrancy of Harringay’s Green Lanes. Unal’s communication was proactive and the check in instructions super helpful and clear. It was also very good value for money. Highly recommend.
A great stay! The host was super friendly and commutation was amazing! Would defiantly stay again! Thanks so much.
One of the best Airbnb places where I've stayed! The flat was lovely, very clean, easy to get to. I'd gladly stay there again.

Cool apartment overlooking Croydon and right by Boxpark, east Croydon station, Sainsbury’s nearby etc. Very spacious and clean. Probably lacks a little character / amenities but overall it was a great place to stay.

Another great stay! This was my second time staying here, and it was just as comfortable and welcoming as the first. The host is consistently responsive while considering my urgency situation of flight cancellation and thoughtful with all possible help and support , and the space is clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. It really feels like a home away from home. Looking forward to coming back again!

As a family of 5 girls we had a great stay.  about £25 in an Uber to ABBA Voyage and a great place to lay our head for the night too.  Olivia was very responsive through messages too. I would stay again.

We had a great 2 night stay at Elsa's place. It's very comfortable for 4 people, very clean, well equipped with everything you  need for a short stay.
