The apartment was centrally located making it super convenient to walk to most places of interest. Lots of great restaurants and shopping located very close by.
The apartment was spacious and very well maintained. Lynn was checking in throughout our stay and responded quickly to any inquires that we had.
All in all definitely a place we would come back to again for future stays in London.
Michael

We had a lovely time at Elsa’ place. Really homely, a spacious living and kitchen area with two decent sized bedrooms. It was perfect for the weekend we had in a great location. Would definitely recommend and would stay again if needed. The only thing I would say is that the shower did go cold whilst showering a few times but it quickly sorted itself out. Thanks very much Elsa.

Great flat in a fabulous location, close to Battersea Rise and Northcote Road but the flat itself is very quiet. Balcony was nice to sit and catch the morning sun. Only thing is the drain smell from the bathroom which at times is overpowering.

good price especially for the location, there was an issue with the bed the first day but they immediately came to solve it.
also a bus stop right in front of the house as well as great food spots

Chris is a great host, helpful and responsive. The flat is perfectly situated—a quiet respite around the corner from bustling Westbourne Grove. The flat is up several flights, we had large suitcases but once settled it was fine. Perfect size for a couple. Would visit again!

We stayed at the farmhouse for a hen party and it was perfect for us!
The garden and outside area was a highlight and we really appreciated all the space and outdoor bar.
Jacqua was a great host, easily contactable and very welcoming

Place was very well priced, and as well as that, the staff were very friendly and supportive to our needs. Very responsive, and always happy to help where they can. Place was exceptional, nice location and scenery, good pricing, and overall a great experience.
All Perfect, the room is clean. Communication about check in and check out also great. Very well. Recommended
Adam was a great host.  Lots of communication, met us at his home and helped us with our luggage.  Would definitely recommend!!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The property was spotless and very well maintained. It came with all the amenities I and my family needed for a comfortable visit. The host was excellent, friendly, responsive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our stay. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean and welcoming home away from home.

Enjoyed 4 nights at this beautiful townhouse. Orla and Rob were very good with the instructions and suggested few local places to visit. The hosts allowed us to check-in earlier, which we really appreciate. There are two bedrooms one with a large king size bed and the second one with small double bed. The second bed is arguable not big enough for a comfortable sleep for two adults.
a quiet and peaceful place, one thing that really annoyed us was the creaking wooden floor.

Nice apartment and location, however there were issues when I came home one night and realised the cleaners had come in during my stay stripped the bed and left it unmade. This was an invasion of privacy and left me quite unsettled, unfortunately the management team weren’t particularly helpful.
Thankfully, the owner reached out and she was very understanding and personally resolved the issues which was very kind. Seems like I was unlucky, she addressed the management team & cleaning service so it wouldn’t happen again.
Brilliant accommodation in the perfect location, managed to book us in at late notice with no issues, would highly recommend.

Had a lovely stay at Ellie’s place. A beautiful little apartment in a really great location. Really close to the tube and the main attractions and was really easy to find. Ellie was helpful and super quick with her responses. Would definitely recommend a stay here!
Loved my stay here! The place was super clean and host was always so responsive and helpful! Will definitely stay here on my next visit to London!

It was actually better than I expected. Room was nice and clean. Location also was good. 10 minutes walk from the nearby station. For a solo  traveler, it was very good. I would love to stay here again. Thank you Arthur

We had a good stay at Lisa’s Airbnb. The place was squeaky clean and looked just like the pictures. The host was extremely friendly and went above and beyond. The Airbnb was in a nice area and was close to public transportation. I would recommend this place to anyone!
this place is super easy to  find,  feels like home, not noisy neighborhood,  lot of options to  go for walk and restaurants,   I love this place

Peter's apartment was great. Had everything that you could have asked for. Peter is an amazing host and he let me an early check in and late check out. I loved the stay and would definately be coming back here again. Thank you Peter.

Thank you Reshma and family for allowing us to stay at your property. Exactly like the photos. The welcome basket was a real treat too!
Thanks again
Kieran

Stayed at Rebecca’s place for almost 2 weeks as a family of 3 (with a 4year old kid). We had a great stay, it’s a spacious apartment with everything needed. It’s located within walking distance of public transport and restaurants. Rebecca was always a message away, and very helpful and responsive on all questions / requests from us. I would highly recommend staying here!
A friendly host, attentive and responsive. A lovely place, well looked after, host gave great tips on things to do nearby and places to visit. Recommend highly. Will gladly return again.

Wonderful place, best coffee place across the street. Little noisy area on the weekend but that’s not a complaint.
Loved it. Would stay again. 10/10.

Great stay, great location, great host. Water pressure in the shower was good which is a need after walking around London in August! The beds are quite firm and the room was very warm but the host very kindly left a fan.
Just a note that the entrance we had been using had locked in the evening and caused a slight panic! Did manage to find another entrance but something to note.
Would definitely be back

I wish I could give this more than 5 stars , Charlotte and Matt were wonderful, perfect place to lay your head down after a night out, could rave on and on about how wonderful everything was but it would be a whole essay!would book again if I were to come back to London!

We had a lovely time at Sofia’s place - perfectly placed location walking distance to lots of food, shopping, and things to do.  The air con was nice as strong which was very important for us in a heat wave and a luxury to have in every bedroom plus living room!
Can’t recommend this place more. Excellent location. Rooftop views are beautiful. Anna was responsive and very helpful. Would stay again.

Amazing place to stay for 2 weeks. Mark was able to be flexible with both check in and check out. Room was lovely, could run hot at times due to no AC but there was provided fans and the communal rooms had AC and were lovely to spend time in. The outside amenities such as the seating outside and balconies were beautiful and lovely to lounge around. I would absolutely recommend staying here!
We had a very enjoyable stay in Wembley - the location was super (and very welcome at the end of the night).  Lots to see and do in the area. The apartment and host were great!
Lovely and unique downstairs apartment ideal for a short stay over the summer. Felt extremely private and was in a great location due to nearby transport links. Would stay again 100%

Great location for visiting around London, works very well as a modern one bedroom base for a London trip. It’s a top (4th) floor home but we didn’t find the stairs a problem. Everything in the accommodation worked as expected, nice lounge and kitchen area, comfortable bed. Good value, a better choice that using a hotel

We had a great stay at Richard’s home. Very convenient for Greenwich and the 02. Easy walk there and back or bus 129. Greenwich is a beautiful place, very chilled . Great views from the attic bedroom.
A very comfortable and cosy home. We felt just like home. An ideal place for a family with children. Can’t wait to book it again for my next trip!

Great spot and very spacious, the living room and bedroom are both quite large, including a walk in closet. The apartment is in quite a busy area, but I never had any issues with noise at night. Would definitely stay here again!

Great accommodation for your stay in London:
-close to a big station linking you directly to other cities and neighbourhoods,
-plenty of stores and restaurants right down your apartment,
-the accommodation itself is fully equipped and beautifully decorated,
-the room is located at the back of the building and was very quiet despite being in the middle of the animations,
Zuzana is an amazing host: she is responsive, helpful and friendly.
Will come back next time we come to London!
Very clean, lift was broken sadly, kitchen very well equipped. It was pretty loud because of the street but you get used to it.
Great place in a great neighbourhood! Short walk to the tube and plenty of Cafe's, Bar's and Restaurant's nearby. Would definitely stay again!

First time using airbnb so didn't know what to expect. This was a last minute arrangement so Anton's quick response and helpfulness were appreciated.
Check-in day was hot and arrival was late in the early hours of the morning. Anton stayed in touch and had cold water ready which was a thoughtful gesture.
Small note for future travellers, bathroom and toilet are upstairs.

Lovely cosy ground floor flat which had everything we needed for a great stay. It’s well decorated, spotless and was ideal for the three of us. Fazile was so easy to deal with and always on hand, she is a great host and very helpful! We will definitely be back to stay again in the future.

I feel very lucky to have found Alex’s place. It’s in the heart of Covent Gardens so getting to restaurants and shopping was very easy. My wife has mobility issues so this was extremely important.
The place was very comfortable, it was very clean and had most of what we needed in the kitchen. It was a hot week but the fans provided helped a lot!
There is no lift however and this flat is on the 2nd floor so carrying luggage up a narrow staircase can be a bit tricky but aside from that, it was perfect for our week away.

I had a great stay here! The place was clean and peaceful, exactly what I was hoping for. The check-in process was smooth and straightforward, and communication couldn’t have been better, her responses were always quick and top tier whenever I needed anything. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Awesome place! Great location and neighborhood. Easy walk everywhere. The apartment is smaller than it appears in the photos but it wasn’t a problem for us. Would recommend.

Great flat close to shops and transport.
FYI, the flat is on the second floor and the steps from the ground and then up into the flat are steep and narrow. Not a massive issue unless you have mobility problems and something to consider if you are travelling with a couple of heavy suitcases.
Parking is difficult, only an hour in the surrounding streets between 8.30am and 10.00pm six days a week, so leave the car and use public transport.
Overall and excellent flat, very clean and well stocked for a few days stay.
A great choice for long stay. Lovely apartment and great host. Antonio is very pleasant and responsive. Highly recommend and would stay again.

Natalia was a great host. Her place was perfectly located. We comfortably fit four people in her flat. Her communication skills were amazing. She checked in on us to make sure everything was OK. If we stay in London again, we would certainly stay in Natalia’s place. Thank you so much for hosting us.

Photos

Oguz's flat was perfectly located, very private and spacious. The window overlooks a back alley, rather than the market, so it's not noisy. Everything you'd want is right there -- 24-hour food, coffee shops, some fabulous restaurants -- and Angel station is a 4-minute walk. Fabulous stay.

Fantastic location with all amenities needed. Responsive host who gave tips for luggage storage as this was not possible
In advance of check-in. Clear communication and expectations, would definitely return

The owners were helpful, when there was a problem it was fixed right away.
The location is amazing.
Lovely apartment and great location and they were really easy to communicate with. Thank you for a lovely stay.
Wonderful place! The location cannot be beat. Loved having two floors of living and super easy to navigate around the neighborhood.

The location wasn’t what I was expecting, right near Chelsea stadium and not very close to tourist sites.
It’s a townhouse with tons of stairs, I think there must be at least 5 floors, several of which are underground which felt very dark.
One of the bedrooms was facing a very loud and busy street, which meant it was too loud and noisy to sleep on properly. Every time a car went by, the headlights lit up the whole room and it was impossible to use.
Very unsuitable for families with young kids, due to stairs and noise.

You feel at home instantly when you arrive, because you can tell someone actually lives here (not just a staged, soulless Airbnb). The flat has everything you need (including a nice book collection), the beds are comfy, and the neighbourhood is quiet with cute shops and cafés nearby. It’s a little far from London’s main highlights, but it's well connected with the overground and buses — and easy to reach from Stansted.
Daniela was super friendly, easy to reach, and made sure we had everything we needed.

very clean, very comfortable and also def worth the price. If you’re on the street side it can be noisy but with the windows closed it’s perfectly fine (they also give u ear plugs) stayed for 3 nights and honestly loved it, would definitely recommend. showers were clean and the place had everything needed. location wise also super handy, close to public transport and also has a bunch of cute little bakeries and cafes around. walking distance from the nice streets in hackney and the park. thank you for everything!
Roomy and super convenient for getting around the city! We slept well, and appreciated the close proximity to the tube and lots of places to eat and shop.
Top shelf AirBnB host and accommodation - I would highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for a great stay!

Absolutely stunning property with unbeatable views of the London skyline. The location is perfect just a short walk to the IFS Cloud Cable Car, ExCeL, and the O2, with great transport links all around. The host, Kappy, was fantastic, clear, friendly, and made check-in and check-out effortless. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay. I’ll definitely be booking this place again.

I had such a lovely stay in this sweet studio flat. It was clean, cosy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location was convenient, and the space felt very welcoming. Perfect for a solo trip or a couple’s getaway. I’d happily stay again!

We had an absolutely fantastic stay! The apartment is spacious, comfortable, and had everything we could possibly need (and more). The host was wonderful, always responsive, kind, and flexible, which really made our trip easier.
The location is perfect: Victoria Station, St James’s Park, and Buckingham Palace are all within walking distance, with plenty of restaurants, pubs, cafés, and a Sainsbury’s nearby.
Little touches made a big difference, like finding an extra plug adapter just when we needed it, and great coffee ready for us to brew in the mornings.
Truly a perfect stay, highly recommended!

Very nice apartment, perfect location and a host who deliveres! Good communication and perfect hospitality.
Definitely coming back!

Really nice comfortable home in an excellent walkable location to everything. Lovely neighborhood! We (5 of us) were apparently the first guests at this BnB, and Sacha was super friendly. Although they were still in the midst of getting things ready for business that week, they  communicated well with us and made sure they delivered and dropped off all the things we needed for our stay. Very nice hosts :)

Harriet’s place was perfect! Very clean and the garden was lovely to sit in and have breakfast through to dinner. Was a definite sun trap. Rooms were tight but nothing wrong with them.
It was an easy check in and out and close to 2 overground stations. Harriet was quick to respond and checked in with us over the weekend.
A perfect host and a perfect property! :)
Hazel is a great host, very friendly she and her family make you feel at home. Lovely house to stay in. Highly recommend

Easy check in! Lovely and clean, super responsive and an amazing location. Not one thing to fault! A huge thank you! We loved our stay so much and had a lovely weekend with our friends & family. Thank you so much :)

I really enjoyed my stay here. The flat itself is very comfortable and cosy with everything you need, in a fantastic location, especially if you're going to watch the Arsenal! I'll definitely stay here again next time I'm in London.

- apartment had everything we needed
- good location
- good Indian close by
- really good transport links. Lots of options making it easy to get around to different places
- pictures are for the block rather than the specific apartment, but was still very nice!
Alessia was very responsive and gave clear instructions, the apt is very well located, clean and nice space to stay.
Nice stay, close to a lot of stuff whilst also being private area. Easy check in and lots of room there.

The apartment was perfect for us with the separate full bathrooms. Very easy to get around with public transport. Laura was easy to communicate with during the stay and gave us good local recommendations. Thank you for being a great host. Will definitely recommend this apartment.

The lovely garden flat was located on a quiet street off the main Streatham high Road, with several supermarkets. Lots of buses and not far from the train station.
The flat was modern and spacious, the large bedrooms and the beds were comfortable.
I would certainly recommend this property and the host Laura 🙂

everything was great and up to standards apart from the neighbours being so loud untill sunrise every night.
the hosts were great and would recommend

Danny is a great host - very responsive and helpful. Were arriving late in the evening but he was happy to accommodate us. The property is in his back garden with secure access. It is much larger than the photos showed and would be great for a longer stay as it is well equipped. Easy 2 minute walk to the nearest bus stop for access to Romford station & Elizabeth line (10 mins by bus, or 35 mins to walk). Would happily stay again

Very comfy with a homey feeling. It is very lovely place, rooms and bathroom are spacious, the living room is quite spacious  and not crowded. The home is a 12 minute walk from the mall which has all the shops you need.

During my visit to London, I stayed in Kingston. Rosie’s Airbnb was lovely—clean, comfortable, and perfectly located near both the train and bus stations. There are also some fantastic restaurants just a short walk away.

nice flat bit outside London but very convenient outside straight river stop of Uber ferry which takes you straight into London. Underground 5 min walk. 20 min you are downtown. 2 nice bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, super quiet. Slowly needs some renovation here&there meaning in general all fine.

Agat is a warm and wonderful host, and his apartment is easily one of the most comfortable I have stayed in. Every little detail and need had been anticipated and catered for. The location is also very close to public transport and a lot of shops
Unfortunately, the overall location and neighborhood doesn't quite match the apartment itself. The neighborhood could be cleaner, but that's not within his control.
I still give it 5 stars, because the apartment itself is fantastic and Agat is a wonderful host

A good location. Nice and close to Earl's Court Tube and local shops. The 4th floor apartment felt a bit smaller than we thought from the photos. Due to no air-con it was very warm and stuffy (okay, it was August and a warm weekend) - we had to keep the blinds down and windows shut all day and the fan running all night just to be able to sleep.
The fridge was useful but the rest of the kitchen area was pretty redundant due to lack of space and not wanting to heat the room up any more.
The bathroom was well stocked with an excellent shower.
Maybe a lower floor apartment would be better in warm weather but air-con would help.

Great location and lovely to have a court yard.
Basement bedrooms spacious and clean but damp smell .
Steps down also a little challenging for pregnant guest and unstable spindles .
Construction in flat above very noisy first evening but very considerate when we asked to stop.
Was great for 2 night stay.

Do NOT be put off that this is at the back of a council estate. It is a lovely clean room, a few minutes walk from Camden Tube station and offering all the delights of tendy Camden. There are shops and bars and restaurants all over the place and it is a short walk to Chalk Farm if you want the various markets.
Nice place to stay, clean, host was responsive and proactive. huge garden as well. Amenities are excellent

The house is stunning, beautifully clean and perfectly situated with easy access to the tube, overground, buses and other transport links. Dainius and Casey were incredibly helpful in resolving a minor issue which was quickly rectified. A great stay. The house was exactly as described and perfect for the 9 of us. Would definitely recommend and return.

This place is located in a nice quiet neighborhood with lots of great pubs, restaurants, and shopping nearby. The host was very helpful and the space was very clean. We would definitely stay here again.

Was a beautiful place with beautiful views. Totally enjoyed our stay at the property, we didn’t have to do heavy lifting as lift is available unlike other properties around. The apartment was clean with a lot of kitchen accessories.

Oguz’s place was in a great location where we could easily walk to the local underground. Plenty of handy supermarkets and eateries too.
Our only complaint was the noise of trucks offloading supplies at a loading dock during the night next door.
Had a great stay- it was a very cute flat, well located, and clean. Branca was very responsive and accommodating, would stay again!
This is a fantastic airbnb in a great location. The road is very quiet and the apartment is spotlessly clean. Mick was very helpful and responsive in his communication. I hope to stay again!

My second stay at James’ place and what I love about this Airbnb is the easy walk to the station, quiet street, the super comfortable bed and traditional decor which reminded me of home.
Additionally, James and his wife are both friendly and welcoming, James was always responsive and they are perfect examples of great hosts.
Would definitely stay again - it’s a gem of room in a beautiful home, on a lovely street. In fact, I don’t want others to book this so I can keep the place for myself! 😁
Thanks for another lovely week James!

We had a wonderful stay at Dominics cosy Apartment. Dominic is a very friendly host who welcome us and gave us very useful  Information when we arrived. Stratford Station and Shops are nearby. We really recommend this Place for visitors who want to explore London.

The hosts were super accommodating and helpful, even when contacted lateeeee at night for check-in. The place was spacious and perfect for our get away! they also provided very clear instructions to get inside, as well as local things to go and see which was extra and very nice

Our little home in London was in a great location. Only about 1klm from Tower bridge/Tower of London and Tower Hill tube station.Located on the 3rd floor of a modern apartment block we felt very secure and a service station and McDonald across the road was great for those little groceries and food. Walking distance from St Katherine Docks and great old Pub. We very much enjoyed our stay.

Great communication, great location for a wedding we were attending.
The place was nice but just a couple of points that would make it better:
Parking should not be an add on extra cost as it’s literally in front of the house.
Also the fish tank in the bedroom was a bit too loud!
Other than that it did the job!
Rosie’s place is conveniently located near Kingston station and town center. The neighbourhood is quiet. Rosie as a host is very good at communicating.

I booked this place last minute and the hosts were kind enough to offer me a great discount despite the short notice. The response from the team was insanely quick—every question I had was answered within seconds.
The Airbnb itself was perfect for our group. The place was spotless, and the location was absolutely brilliant. It’s literally in the heart of London but not too deep in central, which made it perfect. Plenty of shops are within walking distance.
The check-in instructions were very clear and straightforward. I will 1000% book this place again when I come back to London.
Thank you very much, guys!🥰🥰

It was clean and nice. The place is small, but enough for 4 people, especially when you'll be sightseeing every day. The beds were comfortable, kitchen was also great.
The only con is the noise from the neighbours - it's not something the owner has a control over, but just a heads up, they can be loud at times.
Overall, I'm very happy with the place and if i ever come back to london I'd consider booking it again, thanks for the great time :)
Had a great time, room has a beautiful view of the city. Clean modern space with a lot of amenities. Definitely worth it.
